Gate thresholds are implemented as couplings to a constant the network builds for the distribution it is reading, with the bias parameters contributing little; how much of that constant is carried in the stream and how much in parameters depends on the architecture.

AI.tldr: Transformer残差流的语料均值方向是功能性组件：它是MLP门控群体设定工作点的参考基准；门控阈值通过与这一恒定方向的耦合实现。
AI.motivation: 残差流的语料均值方向通常被视为噪声，在表征分析中被均值中心化移除。作者希望证明它不是冗余的，而是承担功能：为MLP门控群体提供工作点参考。
AI.method: 在Phi-2中对静息门控预激活做精确分解，考察均值方向耦合w·b_L与显式偏置的贡献；用随机方向、norm匹配对照、随机初始化孪生模型、方向匹配噪声注入等实验做因果验证；再在多种门控类型和八个模型上重复扫描。
AI.result: mid-stack层中>99.9%门控的静息抑制由均值方向耦合承载，是显式偏置的48-56倍；随机方向Spearman ρ≤0.09而参考方向达0.95；移除流在参考方向上的投影使超阈放电约增9倍，为norm匹配对照的23-59倍；方向匹配噪声成本为随机方向的8-42倍。机制在GELU和SiLU家族普遍存在，仅在OPT中因LayerNorm偏置抵消而缺失。
AI.conclusion: 门控阈值通过与网络为所读分布构建的恒定方向耦合实现，偏置参数贡献很小；该恒定方向有多少由残差流承载取决于架构，均值中心化会移除功能性组件。

title: Towards Transparent Diagnostics: Investigating Architectural Trade-offs and Explainability in Malaria Detection
summary: More than 80 countries have reported malaria cases with 610 thousand deaths and are projected to increase. Identifying malaria early and accurately helps save lives. The effective way to diagnose malaria is through microscopic methods that are labor intensive and require experts with special equipment. Deep learning (DL) has shown promising results in medical diagnosis. Here, we explored various DL models: ResNet18, MobileNetV2, EfficientNet-B2, VGG19 and also proposed a model for detecting malaria presence using blood smears taken from the NIH Malaria dataset. Our experiment shows that MobileNetV2 achieved 96.35% accuracy with the smallest model size (8.49 MB) and fastest inference (1.35 ms). The proposed model achieved 97.67% accuracy, 0.9756 AUC with longest inference time (13.17 ms). The larger architecture outputs a larger model size with moderate accuracy. Upon further pruning, the proposed model gained a slight improvement in accuracy and inference time. The GRAD-CAM, SHAP and LIME shade explainable AI (XAI) insights of the model.

AI.tldr: 利用深度学习模型（ResNet18、MobileNetV2、EfficientNet-B2、VGG19及自研模型）从NIH疟疾血液涂片数据集中检测疟疾，并评估精度、模型大小与推理时间，辅以XAI解释。
AI.motivation: 全球80多国报告疟疾病例并造成61万死亡且预计上升；早期准确诊断可挽救生命，但显微镜法劳动密集且需专家与专用设备，亟需自动化方法。
AI.method: 在NIH疟疾数据集上训练多种DL模型（ResNet18、MobileNetV2、EfficientNet-B2、VGG19），并提出一个新模型；比较精度、AUC、模型大小与推理时间，并进一步剪枝；使用GRAD-CAM、SHAP与LIME提供可解释性分析。
AI.result: MobileNetV2达到96.35%精度，模型最小（8.49 MB）且推理最快（1.35 ms）；提出的模型达97.67%精度、0.9756 AUC，但推理最慢（13.17 ms）；更大架构模型体积更大、精度中等；剪枝后提出模型精度与推理时间略有改善。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习可有效检测疟疾：MobileNetV2适合轻量实时场景，提出模型精度最高；剪枝可小幅提升性能，XAI方法提升了模型可解释性。

title: COUNTERMEM: World-Model Verified Counter-Factual Memory for Language Agents
summary: Existing agent memory frameworks mainly create memory through an agent's interaction with the factual world, e.g., remembering feedback from actions taken to improve performance on future tasks. However, these frameworks seldom ask the "what if" question during memory construction: what if a different action had been taken, would the feedback have changed, and how could this feedback become useful memory? Obtaining such feedback directly in an active environment can be expensive and can alter the state needed for comparison. In this work, we introduce COUNTERMEM, a reinforcement-learning framework for constructing and using verified counterfactual memory across tasks. After a failed action, COUNTERMEM evaluates local alternatives from a copy or reset of the original state using executable world models, such as tests, proof checkers, and solvers. It stores improvements with the original and corrected actions, checked outcomes, and conditions for reuse. A learned memory-use policy selects a retrieved record or skips memory to balance task success and interaction cost, while the base LLM remains fixed. Both memory and policy are frozen during held-out evaluation. We evaluate COUNTERMEM on 12 benchmark settings across six domains. With gpt-oss-120b, COUNTERMEM improves both ReAct and Reflexion on all 12 benchmarks across six domains, averaging a gain of 12.6 percentage points over their unaugmented versions. In the four-domain comparison across two backbones, task-run tokens decrease by 7.7-42.0%, excluding offline selector-training costs. Further analyses show that removing verification or persistent storage weakens the gains, while applying verified corrections to unsuitable decisions can reverse them. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: COUNTERMEM是一个强化学习框架，通过构建和利用经过验证的反事实记忆来提升Agent任务表现，在12个基准上平均提升12.6个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有多数Agent记忆框架只通过Agent与真实世界的交互（如记忆行动反馈）来构建记忆，很少追问"如果换一个行动、反馈会怎样"这类反事实问题。而在真实环境中直接获取反事实反馈代价高昂，且会改变用于对比的原始状态。
AI.method: 提出COUNTERMEM：在行动失败后，从原始状态的副本或重置中，利用可执行世界模型（如测试、证明器、求解器）评估局部替代方案。它存储改进及原始与纠正后的行动、验证结果和复用条件。学习一个记忆使用策略，决定检索记录或跳过记忆，以平衡任务成功率与交互成本，而基础LLM保持固定。记忆和策略在留出评估时冻结。
AI.result: 在6个领域12个基准上，使用gpt-oss-120b时COUNTERMEM使ReAct和Reflexion在全部12个基准上均有提升，平均增益12.6个百分点。在双骨干的四领域对比中，任务运行token减少7.7-42.0%（不含离线选择器训练成本）。消融显示：去除验证或持久存储会削弱增益；将验证纠正应用于不合适的决策会适得其反。
AI.conclusion: 经过验证的反事实记忆能有效提升Agent性能并降低交互成本，但验证、持久存储及正确适用条件是其增益的关键，需谨慎匹配决策场景。

title: Agentic Network Traffic Monitoring
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, to appear in IEEE URTC 2026
summary: As the use of agentic artificial intelligence increases in nearly every industry, there exists a widening attack surface. It is necessary to monitor agents to ensure that agents are acting in a way that is aligned with the users intent. Auditing an agent's network traffic provides a clear record of the agent interactions. This work presents a novel approach to monitoring the network traffic of agentic systems using complex valued hypersparse traffic matrices by integrating DBOS (DataBase OS), the OneSparse PostgreSQL database, and the GraphBLAS math library. To develop these concepts an agentic simulator was constructed, allowing a varying numbers of AI agents to collectively survey a virtual environment using different strategies. The resulting network traffic matrices enable easy monitoring of the AI agents.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出使用复值超稀疏流量矩阵监控智能体系统的网络流量，通过集成DBOS、OneSparse PostgreSQL和GraphBLAS实现，并构建智能体模拟器验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 随着智能体AI在各行业广泛应用，攻击面不断扩大，需要监控智能体以确保其行为符合用户意图。审计网络流量可提供清晰的智能体交互记录，因此需要一种有效的流量监控方法。
AI.method: 集成DBOS（DataBase OS）、OneSparse PostgreSQL数据库和GraphBLAS数学库，使用复值超稀疏流量矩阵来监控智能体系统的网络流量。同时构建了一个智能体模拟器，支持不同数量的AI智能体使用不同策略协同勘察虚拟环境。
AI.result: 生成的网络流量矩阵能够方便地对AI智能体进行监控。
AI.conclusion: 基于复值超稀疏流量矩阵的网络流量监控方法为智能体系统的行为审计提供了可行途径，有助于确保智能体行为与用户意图一致。

title: Beyond the Prompt: Linking What Developers Ask, Do, and Understand with Coding Agents
summary: Coding agents can now change code for developers, who describe goals, supply context, and respond to the agent's work. Yet prompts, screen activity, and task success each tell only part of this story. We present Say, Do, Understand, an end-to-end workflow for analyzing what developers write to an agent, what they do while it works, and what they can explain afterwards. The workflow has five stages (Capture, Prepare, Analyze, Integrate, and Interpret) and three instruments: a prompt codebook, a scheme for coding screen-recorded activities and events, and separate rubrics for explaining the process and the solution. We applied it in an observational study of ten experienced developers who used GitHub Copilot on an unfamiliar codebase. Crossing task performance with understanding produced four personas. The two measures agreed for eight developers but split for two: one passed most tests but could not explain the solution, and another passed few tests but explained it well. In this sample, the personas that most often asked the agent to check its work spent the least time testing on their own. These patterns are descriptive and do not generalize beyond the sample. We recommend the workflow to computing educators, industry practitioners, and researchers to adapt and evaluate human--AI communication in software engineering.

AI.tldr: 提出 Say, Do, Understand 端到端工作流，通过提示、屏幕行为与理解三方面分析开发者与编码智能体协作，并在 10 名开发者使用 Copilot 的观察研究中识别出四类人格。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多只看提示、屏幕活动或任务成败单一维度，无法完整刻画开发者与编码智能体的协作全貌，因此需要一个整合"说、做、懂"三方面的系统化分析流程。
AI.method: 工作流含五阶段（Capture、Prepare、Analyze、Integrate、Interpret）与三种工具：提示词编码手册、屏幕录制活动与事件的编码方案、分别评估过程与方案解释能力的评分量表；以 10 名经验开发者在不熟悉代码库上使用 GitHub Copilot 的观察研究进行应用。
AI.result: 将任务表现与理解程度交叉得到四种人格。八名开发者的两项指标一致，两名出现分歧：一名通过多数测试却无法解释方案，另一名测试通过率低却解释良好。样本中更常让智能体自检的开发者，自身测试时间最少。
AI.conclusion: 这些模式仅为描述性、不具普遍性；建议计算教育者、业界从业者和研究者采用该工作流，以适配和评估软件工程中的人机沟通。

title: IndicFDB: Benchmarking Full-Duplex Voice Agents across Indian Languages
summary: Full-duplex voice agents must handle pauses, take turns, backchannel, and respond to user interruptions in real time. Full-Duplex-Bench evaluates these behaviors, but its English-only corpus and reliance on word-timestamped ASR and an English-prompted LLM judge make it difficult to extend to Indian languages. We introduce IndicFDB, which extends it to ten languages spoken in India with 12,350 samples, nearly 17 times as many as the original. We address three challenges: finding conversational events in multilingual speech, evaluating their timing without reliable word-level alignment, and judging responses across languages. We mine pause handling, turn taking, and backchanneling samples from roughly 50,000 hours of channel-separated conversations using voice activity detection (VAD), and construct human-validated synthetic user interruption samples. Language-independent VAD heuristics evaluate timing, while an open-weight transcription and translation pipeline converts responses to English for LLM ratings of relevance and quality. Across seven voice agents, commercial APIs show unexpectedly consistent behavior across languages but are either fast or robust to pauses, never both, while monolingual open full-duplex models expose further tradeoffs among backchanneling, response quality, and latency.

AI.tldr: 提出 IndicFDB，将全双工语音基准 Full-Duplex-Bench 扩展到印度十种语言，含 12,350 样本（原基准约 17 倍），解决多语种会话事件挖掘、无词级对齐的时序评估及跨语种响应评判三大挑战。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音代理需实时处理停顿、轮次切换、反馈和用户打断，但原 Full-Duplex-Bench 仅有英语语料，且依赖带词时间戳的 ASR 和英语提示的 LLM 评判，难以扩展到印度语言。
AI.method: 从约 5 万小时信道分离对话中用 VAD 挖掘停顿处理、轮次切换和反馈样本，并构建人工验证的合成用户打断样本；用语言无关的 VAD 启发式评估时序，用开放权重转写与翻译流水线将响应转为英语供 LLM 评分相关性与质量。
AI.result: 在七个语音代理上评测：商业 API 跨语言行为意外一致，但要么快要么抗停顿，无法兼顾；单语开放全双工模型在反馈、响应质量与延迟间暴露更多权衡。
AI.conclusion: IndicFDB 为印度多语种全双工语音代理提供了规模化评测基准，揭示现有模型在跨语言一致性及延迟-鲁棒性权衡上的局限。

title: Adapting Vision-Language Models for Human-Readable XAI in Industrial Object Detection
summary: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) solutions are essential for building trust in AI technologies and their integration in real manufacturing lines. However, most existing methods are tailored to technical experts, limiting their accessibility to diverse user groups such as blue-collar workers in manufacturing lines who use AI for quality control. In this work, we introduce an XAI interface for object detection in industrial manufacturing based on a fine-tuned vision-language model, designed to generate intuitive explanations for non-expert users. We benchmark existing vision-language models and demonstrate that out-of-the-box models often fall short in delivering clear, context-relevant explanations for non-expert users. To address this, we fine-tune a vision-language model and integrate it into our interface, enabling contextualized, accessible explanations for non-expert users. We demonstrate improvements in explanation clarity, instruction adherence, image groundedness, and contextual awareness over GPT 4o-mini on proprietary and public robotics dataset. This approach advances the accessibility and usability of AI explanations, making them more intuitive and applicable in manufacturing domain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向工业制造中目标检测的可解释AI界面，基于微调视觉语言模型，为非专家用户生成直观、上下文相关的解释，效果优于GPT-4o-mini。
AI.motivation: 现有XAI方法多面向技术专家，难以被制造产线上的蓝领工人等非专家用户理解和使用，而AI质量控制的普及需要可访问的解释。
AI.method: 构建面向工业制造目标检测的XAI界面；基准测试现有视觉语言模型；对视觉语言模型进行微调并集成到界面中，生成语境化、易懂的解释。
AI.result: 在专有数据集和公开机器人数据集上，相比GPT-4o-mini，在解释清晰度、指令遵循、图像接地性和上下文感知方面均取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提升了AI解释的可访问性和可用性，使其更直观并适用于制造领域。

title: Context-dependent agent evaluation with orthogonal equilibrium learning
summary: Many applications require to evaluate agents under contextual information (e.g., a prompt, task, or user group). We study how to perform such context-dependent agent evaluation from offline feedback. Existing score-based models for this purpose (e.g., Bradley-Terry) impose a transitive preference ordering, which fails to reflect collective preferences when human judgements are heterogeneous. Inspired by social choice theory, we frame evaluation as a contextual game between two players, each selecting a distribution over agents as the strategy to receive greater collective preference than the other. Then, the support of the Nash equilibrium defines a context-specific set of winners. However, learning context-specific equilibria from offline logs is difficult because each context reveals human feedback on only a subset of agents, and, hence, a naive plug-in estimator can therefore be biased. To address these challenges, we propose NashEval, a general framework for robust contextual equilibrium learning. NashEval first constructs debiased estimates of the contextual payoff matrix that characterizes the game. NashEval then learns the context-to-equilibrium mapping with a tailored orthogonal loss, which avoids the need to solve a separate game for each context. We show theoretically that errors in estimating the nuisance functions underlying the payoff matrix affect the risk of the learned equilibrium (i.e., exploitability) only through higher-order terms. Across various experiments, NashEval improves robustness of equilibrium learning and consistently identifies the set of top-performing agents across contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NashEval，将上下文相关的智能体评估建模为双人博弈，用Nash均衡的支撑集定义各上下文下的获胜者集合，并从离线反馈中稳健地学习上下文到均衡的映射。
AI.motivation: 许多应用需要在上下文信息（如提示、任务或用户群）下评估智能体。现有基于评分的模型（如Bradley-Terry）强制偏好满足传递性，当人类判断异质时无法反映集体偏好。
AI.method: 受社会选择理论启发，将评估视为两名玩家各选一个智能体分布的上下文博弈，以获取更高集体偏好；用Nash均衡支撑集作为上下文相关获胜者集合。提出NashEval框架：先构造上下文支付矩阵的去偏估计，再用定制的正交损失学习上下文到均衡的映射，避免对每个上下文单独求解博弈。
AI.result: 理论上证明，支付矩阵中冗余函数估计的误差仅通过高阶项影响所学均衡的风险（exploitability）。多组实验表明NashEval提升了均衡学习的稳健性，并能一致地识别各上下文下表现最优的智能体集合。
AI.conclusion: NashEval为上下文相关的离线智能体评估提供了稳健的均衡学习框架，能有效处理异质偏好与部分反馈问题。

title: RAISE: Reinforcing Access Control Policy Synthesis in LLMs via Symbolic Evaluation
summary: Translating natural-language access-control requirements into policies requires careful reasoning about permissions, constraints, and exceptions, and even frontier LLMs often produce policies that violate the intended authorization semantics. We construct CedarInstruct, to our knowledge the first dataset that supports both training and semantic evaluation for formally verifiable Cedar policy synthesis. It contains 5,800 scenarios across 44 domains and 1,408 representing a single synthetic organization, each with a verified target policy and an executable verification plan. On this data we introduce RAISE, which trains policy synthesizers from formal verification in two stages, verified supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by a reinforcement learning (RL) stage that learns from verifier signal. We find that SFT succeeds largely by letting models express authorization logic they already have, since untrained models rarely write valid Cedar but often reason correctly when they do. After SFT, how the verifier's information is used matters more than how much of it is used. Of six RL instantiations that consume progressively richer verifier signal, only RAISE-OC improves meaningfully on SFT; it turns failed checks and symbolic counterexamples into guided exploration and learns from the result with off-context GRPO. With about 5.4K verified scenarios and LoRA fine-tuning, RAISE-OC trains Qwen3.5-9B to surpass zero-shot GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 by 13.33 and 16.26 percentage points in semantic success on held-out scenarios, and training transfers to the independently constructed CedarBench.

AI.tldr: 本文构建首个面向可形式化验证Cedar策略合成的数据集CedarInstruct，并提出RAISE两阶段训练方法，其中RAISE-OC结合验证器信号与off-context GRPO，显著提升策略语义正确性并超越前沿LLM。
AI.motivation: 将自然语言访问控制需求转化为策略需推理权限、约束与例外，即使前沿LLM也常产出违反授权语义的策略，缺乏支持训练与语义评估的形式化验证数据集与方法。
AI.method: 构建CedarInstruct数据集（5,800场景、44领域、1,408同构组织场景，含验证目标策略与可执行验证计划）；提出RAISE两阶段训练：验证式SFT + 基于验证器信号的RL；比较六种RL实例，仅RAISE-OC有效，将失败检查与符号反例转为引导探索，用off-context GRPO学习。
AI.result: 约5.4K验证场景+LoRA微调，Qwen3.5-9B在留出场景语义成功率上超过零样本GPT-6 Astra与Claude Opus 5分别13.33和16.26个百分点，且可迁移至独立构建的CedarBench。
AI.conclusion: SFT主要让模型表达已有授权逻辑；SFT后验证器信息的使用方式比使用量更重要；RAISE-OC能有效利用验证信号提升策略合成，并具备跨数据集泛化能力。

authors: Ana Paula Wernz da Cunha Müller
title: Extraction of clinical findings from mammography and breast ultrasound reports: a comparison between specialists and Artificial Intelligence
comment: 16 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to Artificial Intelligence in Medicine
summary: Breast cancer is the leading cause of cancer-related death among women in Brazil, and the time between the request and the release of mammography reports directly influences adherence to screening, making the agility in processing these reports a critical factor for early diagnosis. In this context, this study compares the performance of a Large Language Model (LLM) with manual extraction performed by a team of health researchers in identifying clinical findings from mammography and breast ultrasound reports written in Brazilian Portuguese. Named Entity Recognition (NER) was applied through Prompt Engineering using a few-shot strategy, employing the Gemini 2.5 Flash model, selected from preliminary exploratory tests with four candidate models. The Gemini 2.5 Flash model demonstrated the best performance, achieving a Macro F1 of 0.91 and a Micro F1 of 0.98. The subjective validation, in which 29 exams of different formats were evaluated by health researchers using a Likert scale, yielded an agreement index of 93.1%. The model outperformed human extraction in overall Macro F1 (0.91 vs. 0.72), as in four reports the model correctly identified information that had been omitted or incorrectly recorded during manual extraction, demonstrating its potential as a complementary verification tool alongside specialists. The results confirm the hypothesis that LLMs, when instructed through Prompt Engineering, can achieve performance comparable to or superior to manual extraction by health professionals.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较LLM（Gemini 2.5 Flash）与人工从巴西葡萄牙语乳腺X线及超声报告中提取临床发现的表现，LLM在NER任务上优于人工。
AI.motivation: 巴西乳腺癌死亡率高，乳腺X线报告从申请到发布的时间直接影响筛查依从性，因此快速处理报告对早期诊断至关重要，需探索自动化的临床发现提取方法。
AI.method: 通过Prompt Engineering结合few-shot策略进行命名实体识别（NER），使用Gemini 2.5 Flash模型（从四个候选模型的初步探索性测试中选出），并与健康研究人员团队的人工提取结果进行对比。
AI.result: Gemini 2.5 Flash表现最佳，Macro F1为0.91、Micro F1为0.98；对29份不同格式报告的主观验证（Likert量表）一致率为93.1%；在整体Macro F1上超过人工提取（0.91 vs. 0.72），并在4份报告中识别出人工遗漏或记录错误的信息。
AI.conclusion: LLM在Prompt Engineering指导下可达到与健康专业人员人工提取相当或更优的表现，具备作为专家辅助核查工具的潜力。

title: Architecture-aware Robustness Evaluation of Explainable Deep Learning for Breast Cancer Diagnosis
summary: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) has become essential in medical image analysis to ensure transparency of deep learning (DL)-based diagnostic systems. However, selecting appropriate XAI techniques for breast cancer recognition remains largely ad hoc, with limited systematic evaluation across different DL architectures. This study presents a systematic architecture-aware evaluation protocol to assess the effectiveness of nine widely used XAI techniques across four categories of DL models: very deep, lightweight, transformer-based and hybrid neural networks. The evaluation is conducted on a breast ultrasound dataset comprising 780 images using clinically aligned spatial metrics, including Pointing Game, Intersection over Union and Mean Coverage, to quantify agreement between generated explanations and expert-annotated lesion regions. Results indicate that explanation quality is primarily influenced by the interaction between model architecture and XAI method, rather than any single technique consistently outperforming others. Hybrid architectures produce more spatially coherent explanations, while lightweight and transformer-based models exhibit greater variability across methods. The findings show that no single technique generalises across architectures and evaluation criteria, emphasising the need for joint selection of DL models and XAI techniques. Explainability depends on both model design and explanation strategy and should not be considered independently. This work provides a structured evaluation protocol and practical guidance for selecting XAI techniques in breast cancer diagnosis, supporting more transparent clinical decision-support systems. \textcolor{blue}{Code is publicly available at https://github.com/Nishan-Charlie/Explainable-AI}

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种架构感知的系统评估协议，对九种XAI技术在四类DL模型（超深、轻量、Transformer、混合）上的乳腺超声诊断表现进行评估，发现解释质量主要取决于架构与XAI方法的交互，而非单一技术。
AI.motivation: XAI在医学影像分析中至关重要，但XAI技术的选择多为经验性（ad hoc），缺乏跨不同DL架构的系统评估，尤其在乳腺癌识别领域。
AI.method: 在含780张图像的乳腺超声数据集上，系统评估九种XAI技术（分四类）与四类DL架构（超深、轻量、Transformer、混合）的组合；采用临床对齐的空间指标（Pointing Game、IoU、Mean Coverage）量化解释与专家标注病灶区域的一致性。
AI.result: 解释质量主要受模型架构与XAI方法交互影响，而非某单一技术始终最优。混合架构生成的空间解释更连贯，轻量和Transformer模型在不同方法间变异性更大。无单一技术能在所有架构和评价标准下通用。
AI.conclusion: 可解释性同时取决于模型设计与解释策略，不应独立考量；需联合选择DL模型与XAI技术。本研究提供了结构化评估协议及乳腺癌诊断中XAI选择的实用指南，支持更透明的临床决策支持系统，代码已公开。

title: Choir: An Open Protocol for Distributed Multi-Agent Autoformalization
summary: AI agents can now formalize entire textbooks and major theorems in proof assistants such as Lean, but current efforts are typically centralized: a single team runs all agents and bears the full computational cost. We introduce Choir, an open protocol for distributed formalization. Choir decomposes a project into tasks that can be completed by independent contributors, each running their own agent with their own LLM subscription, while coordinating entirely through the project's GitHub repository. To support open participation, every contribution is checked by a deterministic gate before merge. Choir supports Lean 4, Isabelle, and Rocq, and is open source and modular, allowing projects to replace individual components or extend the protocol.

AI.tldr: Choir 是一个开放协议，用于分布式形式化数学，允许独立贡献者各自运行AI代理，通过GitHub仓库协作完成教科书和定理的形式化。
AI.motivation: 当前AI代理在Lean等证明助手中形式化教科书和定理通常由单一团队集中完成，承担全部计算成本，缺乏开放、分布式参与机制。
AI.method: Choir将项目分解为可独立贡献的任务，各贡献者使用自己的LLM订阅和代理，完全通过项目的GitHub仓库协调；每个贡献在合并前经过确定性关卡检查。支持Lean 4、Isabelle和Rocq。
AI.result: 提出了支持多证明助手（Lean 4、Isabelle、Rocq）的开放协议，采用模块化设计和开源实现，项目可替换组件或扩展协议。
AI.conclusion: Choir 提供了分布式形式化的开放协作框架，降低集中式成本，促进更广泛的社区参与。

title: Resource-Aware Parameter-Efficient Model Adaptation for Onboard High-Dimensional Data
summary: Onboard satellite models often require frequent updates, but the weights adapted to earlier data distributions can quickly become outdated. However, updating large-scale model parameters in orbit presents significant challenges due to the limited uplink bandwidth of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite systems, particularly for hyperspectral satellite imagery, where high-dimensional spectral-spatial inputs lead to increased model size and update costs. Existing full fine-tuning methods are thus expensive to retrain and difficult to deploy under strict communication constraints. To address this challenge, we propose NE-LoRA, a parameter-efficient adaptation framework for bandwidth-constrained onboard hyperspectral model updates. NE-LoRA combines a primary low-rank branch with a nonlinear auxiliary branch to capture both global update trends and complex spectral-spatial variations. Additionally, we introduce a differentiated training strategy for multi-matrix adapters, motivated by the asymmetric initialization and gradient dynamics of different adapter matrices. Experiments on four hyperspectral datasets and three representative backbone models demonstrate that NE-LoRA consistently outperforms LoRA-based baselines and remains competitive with, and in several cases superior to, full fine-tuning. Across the evaluated settings, NE-LoRA updates only a small fraction of the total parameters on average while preserving low deployment overhead, offering a favorable accuracy-communication trade-off for onboard hyperspectral adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NE-LoRA，一种面向带宽受限星载高光谱模型更新的参数高效微调框架。
AI.motivation: 星载模型需频繁更新，但LEO卫星上行带宽有限，高光谱高维谱空输入导致模型大、更新成本高，全量微调难以部署。
AI.method: NE-LoRA结合主低秩分支与非线性辅助分支，同时捕捉全局更新趋势与复杂谱空变化；并针对多矩阵适配器引入差异化训练策略，基于不同适配矩阵的非对称初始化与梯度动态。
AI.result: 在四个高光谱数据集和三个代表性骨干模型上，NE-LoRA持续优于LoRA类基线，且与全量微调相当，部分情况下更优；平均仅更新少量参数并保持低部署开销。
AI.conclusion: NE-LoRA在精度与通信之间取得良好权衡，适用于星载高光谱模型的带宽受限适配更新。

title: Identical Runs, Different Results: Benchmarking AI Coding Agents on Open-Weight Models
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, 18 tables. Data and code: https://github.com/earino/identical-runs-different-results
summary: Repeated runs of the same coding agent are known to give different benchmark scores. We ask what that variation means for a team running an agent on its own task, by intensive replication on one machine-learning task: an agent improves the training code of an XGBoost classifier for airline delays, and a holdout it never sees scores the result. Across 584 runs, we compare six agents on six open-weight model endpoints, run six agent-model pairings 52 times each under fixed settings, and repeat three of them on a larger model from the same family. Identical runs of one pairing varied more than the pairings differed from one another, so comparisons of a few runs ranked them unreliably; resolving the agent differences we observed would take tens to more than a hundred runs of each. Runs on the larger model scored clearly higher, but by less than one run-to-run standard deviation, and the gap was more than twice as large with one agent as with the others. Fewer than one run in twenty broke the task's data rules, but those runs held the highest scores. Rejecting those runs first and keeping the best compliant result among a few attempts reliably improved the delivered model, even though a few runs could not rank the agents. On flights from a later year, the delivered models kept only a third of their gain over the starting code. At list prices, cost differed more than twentyfold between two agents on the same model, mostly through the prompt cache. Agents and models should be evaluated as pairings, over repeated attempts, with compliance reported beside quality. Data, code and every delivered program: https://github.com/earino/identical-runs-different-results

AI.tldr: 该论文通过对同一编码智能体在XGBoost任务上的584次密集重复运行，研究基准分数波动的实际意义，发现单次运行差异大于智能体间差异，建议以配对方式和重复尝试评估，并考虑合规性。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体重复运行同一任务会得到不同基准分数，团队需要理解这种波动对实际使用智能体的意义，以便可靠地评估和选择智能体。
AI.method: 在同一机器学习任务上密集复现：智能体改进XGBoost航空延误分类器训练代码，用未见的留出集评估。共584次运行，比较六个智能体与六个开放权重模型端点；对六个智能体-模型配对各固定设置运行52次，并在同系列更大模型上重复其中三个配对。
AI.result: 同一配对的相同运行差异大于配对间差异，少量运行无法可靠排名，区分差异需数十到上百次运行。更大模型得分明显更高，但小于一个运行间标准差，且不同智能体差距差异超过两倍。少于二十分之一的运行违反数据规则，但往往得分最高。先剔除违规运行并保留多次尝试中最佳合规结果能可靠改善交付模型。在后来年份航班上，交付模型仅保留起始代码增益的三分之一。同一模型下不同智能体成本相差二十倍以上，主要来自提示缓存。
AI.conclusion: 应当将智能体和模型作为配对、通过重复尝试进行评估，并在报告质量的同时报告合规性。

title: Toward Embedding-Based Psychometrics: Structural Modeling of Assessment-Item Semantics With Contextual Scores
summary: Contextual scores represent assessment items through their similarities to reference words in an external corpus. We examine the semantic structure of scores for 40 TIMSS mathematics scored units using a partially specified two-step factor procedure. A search across factor counts identifies a persistent seven-group structure under the featured construction. Subsequent comparisons consistently favor a general dimension alongside group associations, although individual group memberships remain sensitive to some specification choices. Item examples distinguish recurring, cross-domain, sensitive, and imposed associations. Simpler and unrestricted references clarify the contribution and limits of the anchored representation: it improves on a single factor but does not achieve the lowest working Bayesian information criterion (BIC). A separate response benchmark compares three initial Q constructions and their Hull-PVAF revisions under higher-order and saturated attribute distributions. Among these diagnostic models, BIC favors the official content framework and the Akaike information criterion (AIC) favors its direct four-factor augmentation, but a matched unidimensional two-parameter logistic model has lower AIC and BIC than all twelve conditions. These findings support a conditional semantic representation while limiting direct diagnostic interpretation. We discuss learned text-assisted response calibration as a prospective application requiring a larger calibrated item bank and independent evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文用两步因子分析检验40个TIMSS数学评分单元的情境得分语义结构，发现稳定的七组结构与一般维度，但直接诊断解释受限。
AI.motivation: 情境得分通过与外部语料参考词的相似度表征测评题目，但其语义结构是否稳定、能否直接用于诊断尚不清楚，需系统检验。
AI.method: 对40个TIMSS数学评分单元的情境得分，采用部分指定的两步因子程序，搜索因子数，并进行响应基准比较：三种初始Q构造及其Hull-PVAF修正，在高阶与饱和属性分布下对比BIC/AIC。
AI.result: 发现持续存在的七组结构；比较支持一般维度加组关联，但组归属对设定敏感。锚定表示优于单因子，但BIC非最低。诊断模型中BIC偏好官方内容框架，AIC偏好四因子扩展；但匹配的单维2PL模型AIC和BIC均低于全部十二种条件。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持条件性的语义表示，但限制直接诊断解释。学习型文本辅助响应校准是有前景的应用方向，需更大校准题库和独立评估。

title: Disentangle and Drop: Robust Universal Removal of Image Watermarks via Reconstructive Grayscale Residual Decomposition
summary: Invisible image watermarks are commonly evaluated against benign postprocessing operations such as compression, resizing, blur, and color changes. These tests leave out a different threat: a learned remover that preserves semantic image content while discarding residual evidence that carries the payload. We propose Disentangle and Drop (DnD), an attack that is agnostic to the watermark method and treats watermark removal as a representation routing problem. DnD decomposes a watermarked image into a semantic grayscale carrier and an auxiliary residual branch, and then suppresses the residual branch to reduce watermark evidence. The model is trained with latent spectral perturbations and low-strength diffusion exposure so that the drop operation remains stable under adaptive reconstruction. Experiments on seven representative watermark families show that one shared operating setting gives competitive removal with high visual fidelity. Operating scans and ablations separate usable attacks from image-damaging settings: stronger noise or diffusion can raise removal scores by damaging the image, while the practical regime comes from dropping the residual latent. These results argue for evaluating watermark robustness against learned removal at the representation level, not only against conventional image edits.

AI.tldr: 提出DnD攻击，将水印移除视为表征路由问题，把水印图像分解为语义灰度载体和辅助残差分支，抑制残差分支以去除水印，与具体水印方法无关，在七类水印上取得竞争性移除效果且保持高视觉保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有水印评估仅针对压缩、缩放、模糊、调色等良性后处理操作，忽略了学习型移除器的威胁：它能保留语义内容却丢弃携带载荷的残余证据。因此需要从表征层面评估水印鲁棒性。
AI.method: DnD将水印图像分解为语义灰度载体与辅助残差分支，通过抑制残差分支来削弱水印证据；训练时引入潜在频谱扰动和低强度扩散暴露，使丢弃操作在自适应重建下保持稳定。
AI.result: 在七种代表性水印家族上，单一共享设置即可实现竞争性移除并保持高视觉保真度；操作扫描与消融实验表明更强噪声或扩散会通过破坏图像来夸大移除分数，实际有效区间来自丢弃残差潜在。
AI.conclusion: 水印鲁棒性评估应针对表征层面的学习型移除，而不仅限于传统图像编辑操作。

title: EmailBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents on Enterprise Email and Productivity Tasks
summary: Enterprise email agents must combine information retrieval, structured state changes, temporal reasoning, and multi-step coordination. Recent agent benchmarks include productivity tasks, but few center on typed email workflows in a self-contained environment. We introduce EmailBench, a benchmark of 206 email and productivity scenarios across 16 task categories. The benchmark couples a typed email API specification with provider-neutral naming, a deterministic synthetic Enron-inspired corpus, and a scenario suite whose topic selection was informed by aggregate task-intent telemetry from an interactive prototype. Its hybrid evaluation protocol combines 258 executable static assertions with 211 LLM rubrics. We evaluate eight LM configurations on a fixed single-user corpus. The best-performing configuration passes only 33.5% of scenarios despite 99.7% of its tool calls completing without an observed API failure, with pass rates varying substantially across task categories. This gap shows that valid tool execution is not equivalent to task completion. EmailBench provides a self-contained environment for end-to-end email-agent evaluation, with broader tool coverage, multi-persona testing, and repeated-run evaluation as future work areas.

AI.tldr: 介绍 EmailBench，一个包含 206 个邮件与生产力场景、16 类任务的邮件智能体基准，采用类型化 API、合成语料与混合评估协议。
AI.motivation: 企业邮件智能体需结合检索、结构化状态变更、时序推理与多步协调，但现有智能体基准少有聚焦自包含环境下的类型化邮件工作流。
AI.method: 构建类型化邮件 API 规范（提供商中立命名）、确定性的 Enron 风格合成语料，以及由交互原型任务意图遥测指导选题的场景套件；评估采用 258 条可执行静态断言与 211 条 LLM 评分标准结合的混合协议，在固定单用户语料上评测八种语言模型配置。
AI.result: 最佳配置仅通过 33.5% 的场景，尽管其 99.7% 的工具调用无 API 失败；各类任务通过率差异显著。这表明工具调用有效执行不等同于任务完成。
AI.conclusion: EmailBench 为端到端邮件智能体评估提供自包含环境，未来工作包括扩展工具覆盖、多人设测试与重复运行评估。

title: Counterfactual Rollout Replay: Forkable Environments as Free Process Rewards for Software Engineering Agents
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Includes additional experiments and analysis
summary: Outcome-only reinforcement learning gives software engineering (SWE) agents a terminal success signal but little direct guidance about intermediate decisions. We introduce Counterfactual Rollout Replay (CRR), a training-time procedure that uses forkable executable environments to obtain step-level return contrasts. CRR selects a small set of decision points, restores each state, samples an alternative action, and rolls the branch forward under the policy. It retains the realised training trajectory and replaces the advantage at selected steps with the difference between its terminal return and the sampled counterfactual return. The method needs no human process labels or learned process reward model; free refers to those supervision costs, not replay compute. With a 14B policy, CRR improves pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Live, and SWE-rebench, and combines with process-reward and trajectory-search methods. On SWE-bench Verified, an equal-wall-clock comparison on the same hardware yields 41.7% versus 36.7% for extended outcome-only GRPO, a 5.0-point gain with fork overhead included. These results apply to environments with affordable, reliable state restoration; stochastic continuations and expensive or imperfect replay remain limitations.

AI.tldr: CRR通过可分支执行环境获取步级反事实回报，用反事实与真实回报差替换部分步骤优势，无需人工过程标签或过程奖励模型，在SWE-bench上提升pass@1，14B策略下相比GRPO获得5.0分提升。
AI.motivation: 仅用结果奖励的强化学习只提供终端成功信号，缺乏对中间决策的直接指导，SWE智能体训练效率受限。
AI.method: Counterfactual Rollout Replay：选取少量决策点，恢复状态、采样替代动作并向前展开；保留真实轨迹，将所选步骤的优势替换为终端回报与反事实回报之差。无需人工过程标注或学习式过程奖励模型。
AI.result: 14B策略在SWE-bench Verified、SWE-bench Live、SWE-rebench上pass@1提升，可与过程奖励与轨迹搜索方法结合；SWE-bench Verified等墙钟时间对比中41.7% vs 36.7%（GRPO），提升5.0分且含分支开销。
AI.conclusion: CRR在可低成本可靠恢复状态的环境中有效；随机连续过程、昂贵或不完美回放仍是局限。

title: Communication between Frozen Large Language Models via Prompt Optimization in a Referential Game
summary: We study communication between two frozen large language models from different providers, with different tokenizers, accessed through their API endpoints. The two play a referential game: one sees an object and describes it in a short fixed-length message over a small alphabet; the other must pick that object out of a candidate set. Neither model's weights are updated. Each agent's prompt is rewritten by an isolated prompt optimizer whose reflection model reads that agent's scored interactions. In the positional setting, optimized prompts carry a shared code that generalizes to held-out objects above a measured no-codebook baseline, including when the memory window is removed. In a second setting, independent per-letter blocks no longer fit within the message, although a whole-object place value code does. The base system fails to establish reliable communication: the sender struggles to retain an injective rule, and the receiver has too few confirmed examples in view. A sender collision penalty, retention of successful interactions, and sequential optimization enable successful place value communication in some runs. Outcomes vary across runs and reflection models. In successful runs, the protocol is written into the optimized prompts, where it can be read and audited directly.

AI.tldr: 两个冻结的异构大模型（不同厂商、不同分词器）通过API玩指称游戏，由隔离的提示优化器重写各自提示。位置设定下优化提示携带可泛化到新对象的共享代码；整体位值编码也能成功，但分字母编码受消息长度限制失败。基线系统无法可靠通信，加入发送方碰撞惩罚、保留成功交互与顺序优化后部分运行成功，且协议可写入提示中被直接审阅。
AI.motivation: 探索来自不同提供方、使用不同分词器的冻结大模型能否在权重不更新的前提下，仅通过各自API端点上的提示优化实现可靠的指称通信，即能否自发形成共享代码。
AI.method: 采用指称游戏：发送方看到对象并用小字母表、固定长度的短消息描述，接收方需从候选集中选出该对象，双方权重均不更新。每个智能体的提示由隔离的提示优化器重写，其反思模型读取该智能体带评分的交互记录。设置位置设定与第二种设定，并测试去掉记忆窗口、独立分字母块、整体位值编码等条件，以及发送方碰撞惩罚、成功交互保留、顺序优化等增强手段。
AI.result: 位置设定下优化提示携带可泛化到留出对象的共享代码，优于测得的无码本基线，且在移除记忆窗口时仍有效。第二种设定中独立分字母块无法放进消息，而整体对象的位值编码可行。基线系统通信不可靠：发送方难以保持单射规则，接收方可见的确认样本过少。加入碰撞惩罚、保留成功交互与顺序优化后，部分运行实现成功的位值通信，结果随运行与反思模型而变化。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的异构大模型可通过提示优化经API形成并承载可泛化、可审计的共享通信协议；成功与否依赖具体运行和反思模型，且成功时协议直接写在优化提示中可供读取审计。

title: RemTraceNet: Few-Shot Forensic Detection of Invisible Watermark Attacks
summary: Removing an invisible watermark and concealing the forensic evidence are distinct objectives: successfully disrupting the embedded watermark does not imply that the removal process is forensically undetectable. When verification fails, removal traces can provide complementary evidence for provenance and ownership verification, whereas their absence leaves the cause of the failure ambiguous. Existing methods are typically evaluated by watermark suppression and perceptual quality, while forensic stealth is rarely considered. We therefore study watermark-attack-specific few-shot forensics: for each known pipeline, a specialist can separate its outputs from paired clean and unattacked watermarked controls. Separate Attack-vs-Clean and Attack-vs-Watermarked evaluations prevent watermark-presence shortcuts. Image-aligned and prompt-matched controls are used for post-hoc and generator-integrated schemes, respectively. In this work, we introduce RemTraceNet, which fuses constrained residuals, local relations, FFT/Haar statistics, and block-DCT evidence at native resolution. Across 23 removal pipelines and 10 watermark configurations, we evaluate native 256 x 256 and 512 x 512 inputs. With 100 attacked training images per pipeline, the three-seed TPR@1%FPR, macro-averaged over attacks and watermark configurations, ranges from 82.75% to 88.17% across resolutions and control types. Under the condition of same labels and protocol, RemTraceNet outperforms retrained SRNet, ZhuNet, and SiaStegNet baselines by 10.80--15.68 percentage points. Extensive experimental results show that erasing a watermark and erasing evidence of its removal are distinct challenges, and that removal traces remain learnable under limited supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"水印攻击的取证隐蔽性"问题，提出RemTraceNet，通过融合残差、局部关系、FFT/Haar与block-DCT特征，在少样本条件下有效区分水印去除痕迹与干净/未攻击水印图像。
AI.motivation: 去除不可见水印与掩盖取证痕迹是两个不同目标：成功破坏水印并不意味着去除过程在取证上不可检测。当验证失败时，去除痕迹可为来源与所有权验证提供补充证据，其缺失会导致失败原因不明。现有方法多以水印抑制和感知质量评价，很少考虑取证隐蔽性。
AI.method: 研究面向水印攻击的少样本取证：针对每个已知流程，用成对的干净图像与未攻击水印图像作为对照，训练专家区分其输出。设置Attack-vs-Clean与Attack-vs-Watermarked两种评估以避免水印存在性捷径；对后处理方案采用图像对齐对照，对生成器集成方案采用提示匹配对照。提出RemTraceNet，在原生分辨率上融合受限残差、局部关系、FFT/Haar统计与block-DCT证据。
AI.result: 在23种去除流程与10种水印配置下，评估原生256×256和512×512输入。每条流程用100张受攻击训练图像，三随机种子TPR@1%FPR在攻击与水印配置上宏平均为82.75%–88.17%。在相同标签与协议下，RemTraceNet比重新训练的SRNet、ZhuNet和SiaStegNet基线高出10.80–15.68个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，消除水印与消除其去除证据是不同挑战，去除痕迹在有限监督下仍可学习。

title: Improving Medical Calculation of LLMs with Embedded Coding
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on medical examinations and question-answering benchmarks, but remain unreliable on medical calculation tasks that require exact numerical outputs. These calculations support high-stakes decisions such as medication dosing, organ-function assessment, and prognostic scoring, for which even small errors can have serious clinical consequences. We introduce MedCode, a framework that improves medical calculation by training LLMs to generate embedded executable code. Given a clinical context, the model identifies the relevant calculator, extracts its input variables, and produces a script that delegates arithmetic operations to a deterministic interpreter. Executing the script returns the calculated value together with an explanation and the appropriate unit. We construct supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and preference datasets from the MedCalc benchmark and additionally curate a dataset for calculation tasks in Intensive Care Unit (ICU) scenarios. We further propose weighted Direct Preference Optimization (wDPO), which adaptively emphasizes preference pairs that are difficult for the model to distinguish. Experiments with LLaMA3-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Mistral-7B show absolute accuracy gains of 20--30 percentage points, demonstrating the effectiveness of embedded code generation for medical calculation.

AI.tldr: 提出MedCode框架，让LLM生成嵌入式可执行代码来完成医疗计算任务，结合wDPO偏好优化，在多个模型上实现20-30个百分点准确率提升。
AI.motivation: LLM在医疗考试和问答基准上表现良好，但在需要精确数值输出的医疗计算任务上不可靠。而这类计算（药物剂量、器官功能评估、预后评分）涉及高风险决策，微小错误都可能造成严重临床后果。
AI.method: MedCode让模型在给定临床上下文时识别相关计算器、提取输入变量，并生成将算术运算委托给确定性解释器的脚本；执行脚本返回计算值及解释和单位。基于MedCalc基准构建SFT和偏好数据集，并额外整理ICU场景数据集；提出加权DPO（wDPO），自适应强调模型难以区分的偏好对。在LLaMA3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B上验证。
AI.result: 在LLaMA3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B上绝对准确率提升20-30个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入式代码生成结合wDPO可有效提升LLM在医疗计算任务上的准确性和可靠性，验证了该方法对高风险临床计算的有效性。

title: Green AI: Cost of LLM-Based Code Completion
summary: Code completion is one of the most widely used applications of large language models (LLMs) in software development. Open-weight LLMs are increasingly adopted for locally deployed code completion systems, partly due to privacy concerns. Despite advances in LLM accuracy, the energy cost of inference remains underexplored, particularly under large-context workloads and across programming languages. This study investigates the trade-off between accuracy and energy consumption in LLM-based code completion and how workload characteristics, context size, and model scale influence inference energy usage. We evaluate 25 open-weight LLMs on two workloads: repository-level next-line completion with varying context sizes on RepoBench, and fill-in-the-middle (FIM) code completion across Python, Java, and Rust on McEval. We analyze the influence of input tokens, output tokens, model size, and their interactions on energy consumption using correlation analysis and cluster-robust linear regression. Our findings show that the dominant drivers of energy consumption depend strongly on task structure. In RepoBench, energy consumption is primarily influenced by input context size and its interaction with model scale, whereas in McEval, output generation and its interaction with active parameter count dominate. Output generation is more energy-intensive per token than prompt processing. Across both benchmarks, smaller and heavily quantized models frequently achieve Pareto-optimal trade-offs, often providing accuracy comparable to larger FP16 models while consuming substantially less energy. Increasing model size or context length does not necessarily lead to proportionally better completion quality, while quantization can substantially improve energy efficiency with limited accuracy degradation. These findings support more energy-aware deployment strategies for sustainable AI-assisted software development.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估25个开源LLM在代码补全任务中的准确率与能耗权衡，发现能耗驱动因素依赖于任务结构，小模型与量化模型常达帕累托最优。
AI.motivation: 开源LLM在本地代码补全中应用增多，但推理能耗在大上下文和跨语言场景下研究不足。
AI.method: 在RepoBench（仓库级下一行补全，不同上下文）与McEval（Python/Java/Rust的FIM补全）上评估25个开源LLM，用相关分析和聚类稳健线性回归分析输入/输出token、模型规模及交互对能耗的影响。
AI.result: 能耗主因随任务结构变化：RepoBench中主要是输入上下文大小及其与模型规模的交互；McEval中输出生成及其与活跃参数量的交互占主导。输出生成每token比提示处理更耗能。小模型和重度量化模型常达帕累托最优，准确率接近大型FP16模型但能耗显著更低。
AI.conclusion: 增大模型或上下文不一定成比例提升补全质量，量化可显著提升能效且精度损失有限，支持更节能的代码补全部署策略。

title: Before the Rollout Ends: Early Terminal Reward Prediction for Long-horizon Coding Agents
summary: Long-horizon coding agents receive verifiable rewards only after completing expensive sequences of tool calls. This increases inference cost, amplifies early wrong hypotheses, and can lead to sparse terminal reward and unstable training. We introduce Contextual Early Reward (CER), which predicts terminal reward through behavioral evidence in a trajectory prefix. CER synthesizes adaptive rubrics specific to the current task and stage through experiences summarized from related historical tasks. In test-time scaling on SWE-bench Verified, CER improves RM@8 over the strongest baseline by 4.2 percentage points (pp) on Nemotron 3 Ultra and 2.0 pp on Qwen 3.6 27B; on Nemotron, it takes only 15.3% tokens to match the best baseline performance. In RL training experiments, CER exceeds full-rollout TMax by 1.9 pp while using 52.7% fewer online policy-and-judge tokens. Together, CER provides an interpretable, efficient, and dense evaluation method for long-horizon coding agents.

AI.tldr: 提出Contextual Early Reward (CER)，通过轨迹前缀中的行为证据并结合历史任务经验合成的自适应rubric来预测终端奖励，实现长时程编码智能体的高效稠密评估。
AI.motivation: 长时程编码智能体只有在完成昂贵的完整工具调用序列后才能获得可验证奖励，导致推理成本高、早期错误假设被放大，并引发稀疏终端奖励与训练不稳定问题。
AI.method: CER通过从相关历史任务中总结经验，为当前任务和阶段合成自适应评估准则（adaptive rubrics），并基于轨迹前缀中的行为证据预测终端奖励。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Verified测试时扩展中，CRM相比最强基线RM@8提升4.2 pp（Nemotron 3 Ultra）和2.0 pp（Qwen 3.6 27B）；在Nemotron上仅用15.3% tokens即达到最佳基线性能。RL训练中超过full-rollout TMax 1.9 pp，同时减少52.7%在线策略与评判tokens。
AI.conclusion: CER为长时程编码智能体提供了一种可解释、高效且稠密的评估方法。

title: Video Captioning in Low-Light Conditions through Efficient Uncertainty-Aware Caption Correction
summary: Low-light conditions can significantly degrade the ability of vision-language models (VLMs) to accurately describe human actions in videos. In this work, I propose an efficient uncertainty-aware representation correction framework for improving captions generated by VideoChat2 under real-world low-light conditions. Instead of fine-tuning the underlying VLM, the proposed framework introduces a lightweight sparse Gaussian process-based error estimation module between the projection layer and the language model to correct the intermediate representation. The correction module learns to estimate the residual between the original projected representation and a verified target representation, which is then adaptively scaled using a newly formulated uncertainty-aware coefficient and added to the original representation. To further improve residual estimation, I introduce a partitioned combined-kernel design. The correction model is trained separately using only 44 samples from the ARID dataset and requires only a small additional computational overhead during inference. The effectiveness of the proposed correction is evaluated through quantitative residual prediction and qualitative analysis of the generated captions. Although VideoChat2 is used in my experiments, the proposed framework is designed to be applicable to other compatible VLM architectures. \textbf{Code Availability: The implementation accompanying this work is publicly available at}:\href{https://github.com/areferezaee/Low-rank-SVGP-NP-update}{https://github.com/areferezaee/Low-rank-SVGP-NP-update}

AI.tldr: 提出一种不确定性感知的轻量级稀疏高斯过程校正框架，在投影层与语言模型之间修正VideoChat2在低光视频中的中间表示，无需微调底层VLM，仅用44个ARID样本训练即可提升字幕生成质量。
AI.motivation: 低光条件会显著降低视觉语言模型（VLM）准确描述视频中人类动作的能力。微调底层VLM成本高，因此需要一种高效、无需微调的表征校正方案。
AI.method: 在投影层与语言模型之间插入轻量级稀疏高斯过程误差估计模块，学习原始投影表示与已验证目标表示之间的残差；用新提出的不确定性感知系对残差自适应缩放并加回原表示；引入分区组合核设计以改进残差估计。该模块仅用ARID数据集44个样本单独训练，推理开销小。
AI.result: 通过定量残差预测与生成字幕的定性分析验证了校正效果。代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能高效提升低光条件下VLM的视频字幕质量，且设计上可推广至其他兼容的VLM架构，不局限于VideoChat2。

title: BioDyad: Synchronize Biomedical Discovery and Machine Learning Engineering
summary: Agentic biomedical machine learning (ML) draws on complementary advances in biomedical evidence acquisition and executable program search. Existing systems connect aspects of these capabilities, but coordinating them throughout program search remains challenging. New evidence must guide candidate construction, execution outcomes must inform subsequent discovery and reuse, and validation demands must fit the search budget. We introduce BioDyad, which couples biomedical discovery and ML engineering through two hierarchies within Monte Carlo graph search. Its scientific hierarchy combines prior biomedical guidance with iterative discovery, then links biomedical plans to execution outcomes in memory for reuse across candidates. Its engineering hierarchy moves candidate programs from smoke execution, through train/validation evaluation, to full-data retraining. We evaluate BioDyad on the 76-task BioXArena benchmark under a two-hour per-task budget with three matched LLM backends. It achieves the highest penalized all-task score and task success rate among four agent methods and a one-shot baseline under each backend. These results support coordinating biomedical discovery and ML engineering to integrate external knowledge into executable programs across heterogeneous biomedical tasks.

AI.tldr: BioDyad 通过蒙特卡洛图搜索中的两个层级协调生物医学发现与ML工程，在BioXArena基准上取得最佳成绩。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体生物医学ML系统虽能连接证据获取与程序搜索的部分能力，但在整个程序搜索过程中协调二者仍是难题：新证据需指导候选构建，执行结果需反馈后续发现与复用，且验证需求要匹配搜索预算。
AI.method: 提出BioDyad，在蒙特卡洛图搜索内以两个层级耦合生物医学发现与ML工程：科学层级结合先验生物医学指导与迭代发现，并将生物医学计划与执行结果关联存储以复用；工程层级使候选程序从冒烟测试、训练/验证评估逐步推进到全数据重训练。
AI.result: 在76任务的BioXArena基准上、每任务两小时预算、三种匹配LLM后端设置下，BioDyad在四种智能体方法和单次基线中获得最高惩罚性全任务得分与任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 协调生物医学发现与ML工程有助于将外部知识整合进可执行程序，适用于异构生物医学任务。

title: Maat: Independent Deterministic Contract-Based Governance for Multi-Agent LLM Workflows
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Benchmarks: https://github.com/Lorelys/maat-benchmarks ; CrewAI integration demo: https://github.com/Lorelys/maat-crewai-demo
summary: Large-language-model multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) introduce a characteristic reliability problem: an error produced by one agent can be accepted as context by downstream agents and propagate across the workflow. Many proposed safeguards rely on learned or LLM-based judges whose verdicts are themselves probabilistic; we ask whether a deterministic layer can instead stop contract-detectable handoff defects. We present Maat, a runtime governance layer that validates agent-to-agent handoffs against a versioned workflow contract, or anchor, with no language model in the validation or scoring path. We evaluate it in six controlled domain workflows (6-15 agents, 522 trials) with injected data-level defects and a deterministic seven-check rubric. Version 1 reported gains in all six workflows (2.9-26.5%). A post-publication audit found that three benchmark scorers credited any early halt as a prevented defect. On paired trials where the governed run completed or halted on a finding attributable to a verified defect, the rubric score changes by +7.7% to +29.1% in five workflows and is flat in software development; model-call cost falls 17-53% where attributable halts occur early. A hand review of all 94 governed-arm halts found 35 false alarms (37%), caused by validator defects rather than model behaviour; counting those halts as failed work, the governed arm scores below the ungoverned arm in four of six workflows. The results support deterministic handoff validation for contract-expressible defects and show that validator configuration and halt attribution must themselves be tested; they do not establish universal correctness, hallucination detection, or model-independent effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 提出确定性运行时治理层 Maat，用版本化工作流契约校验多智能体交接，以取代概率性 LLM 评判。审计后仅在可归因缺陷时仍有 +7.7%~+29.1% 提升，成本降 17-53%，但也暴露 37% 误报。
AI.motivation: LLM 多智能体系统中单个智能体的错误会被下游当作上下文接受并沿工作流传播。现有防护依赖学习型或 LLM 评判器，其判决本身是概率性的，因此作者追问能否用确定性层拦截契约可检测的交接缺陷。
AI.method: Maat：面向智能体间交接的运行时治理层，依据版本化工作流契约（anchor）校验，验证与评分路径中不含语言模型。在 6 个受控领域工作流（6-15 个智能体、522 次试验）中注入数据级缺陷，采用确定性七项检查评分标准评估。
AI.result: v1 报告 6 个工作流全部提升（2.9-26.5%）。发表后审计发现 3 个评分器把任何提前中止都计为已阻止缺陷。在配对试验（治理运行完成或中止于可验证缺陷）上，5 个工作流评分提升 +7.7%~+29.1%，软件开发持平；可归因早期中止处模型调用成本降 17-53%。人工复核全部 94 次治理臂中止，发现 35 次误报（37%），源于校验器缺陷而非模型行为；若将误报计为失败，则 6 个工作流中有 4 个治理臂低于未治理臂。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持对契约可表达的缺陷采用确定性交接校验，并表明校验器配置与中止归因本身必须被测试；不主张普适正确性、幻觉检测或模型无关的有效性。

title: Quantization Thresholds Replicate, Failure Modes Do Not: A Three-Model Study of Agentic Tool Use in Polish from 8-bit to 2-bit
comment: 34 pages, 1 figure, 21 tables. Code, tasks, trajectories and analysis scripts: https://github.com/JakubPrejzner/polagentbench
summary: We ask how GGUF quantization affects agentic tool use in Polish and whether the effects generalize across models. We introduce PolAgentBench, a deterministic benchmark with Polish prompts and English tool schemas: a 67-task main suite (15 adversarial probes, 52 hard-tier tasks) and a 46-task arithmetic isolation ladder. Three models span two axes of variation: Bielik-11B-v3.0 and its pruned, distilled child Bielik-Minitron-7B-v3.0 isolate model compression, and Llama-PLLuM-8B adds a change of pretraining family. Each is measured at six precisions, Q8_0 to Q2_K. Only the collapse threshold replicates. (1) All three models fall off a cliff between 3-bit and 2-bit (11B 0.716 to 0.045, 7B 0.463 to 0.149, PLLuM 0.224 to 0.015; paired McNemar p < 0.001 in each), across a fourfold capability spread and both axes. (2) Failure modes do not replicate: at 2-bit the 7B fails long (median 9.1k tokens, 4 steps) while the 11B mostly answers at the first step with a confabulated final answer (37 of 64 failures); PLLuM fails on content across precisions (71.8-92.0% of steps parse). (3) On the arithmetic ladder the unscaffolded rung is a floor, left standing by a rerun that states the no-tool rule; four explicit calls lift the 8-bit 11B from 1/10 to 9/10 and the 7B from 0/10 to 7/10 after format-only failures with the gold value are forgiven, an exploratory effect with eight distinct baseline inputs that does not survive multiplicity correction, while the order-trap arm separates the models at 8-bit (11B 6/6, 7B 0/6). (4) The Polish-versus-English gap is associated with degradation or with task family. We document four artifacts that shaped our conclusions (rounding-hostile gold values, strict answer typing, a no-tool rule the prompt never stated, priority-ordered failure labels), report affected results in strict and corrected form, and release the benchmark, trajectories and commit-stamped artifacts.

AI.tldr: 提出 PolAgentBench（波兰语提示 + 英语工具模式）基准，测量 GGUF 量化（Q8_0–Q2_K）对工具智能体能力的影响，跨三款模型验证。核心发现：只有"崩溃阈值"（3-bit 与 2-bit 之间）可复现，失败模式不可复现。
AI.motivation: 探究 GGUF 量化如何影响波兰语智能体的工具使用能力，以及这种影响是否能跨模型推广——即量化损伤中哪些是可复现的规律，哪些是模型特异的。
AI.method: 构建 PolAgentBench：确定性基准，含 67 题主套件（15 对抗探针、52 难题）与 46 题算术隔离阶梯。三模型覆盖两条变异轴：Bielik-11B-v3.0 与其剪枝蒸馏子模型 Bielik-Minitron-7B（压缩轴），加上 Llama-PLLuM-8B（预训练家族轴）。每模型测六种精度（Q8_0 到 Q2_K）。
AI.result: (1) 三模型均在 3-bit 与 2-bit 间断崖式崩溃（11B 0.716→0.045，7B 0.463→0.149，PLLuM 0.224→0.015，McNemar p<0.001）。(2) 失败模式不可复现：2-bit 下 7B 长时间失败（中位 9.1k tokens、4 步），11B 多首步即捏造答案（64 次失败中 37 次），PLLuM 全程内容性失败。(3) 算术阶梯上无脚手架层级为地板，显式四次调用可将 8-bit 11B 从 1/10 提至 9/10、7B 从 0/10 提至 7/10（探索性、未过多重校正）；顺序陷阱在 8-bit 区分模型（11B 6/6，7B 0/6）。(4) 波英差距与退化或任务族相关。
AI.conclusion: 量化损伤中仅"崩溃阈值"可跨模型复现，失败模式则依赖模型。同时记录四个影响结论的工件（不友好取整的黄金值、严格答案类型、提示未声明的无工具规则、优先级排序的失败标签），并以严格与校正两种形式报告受影响结果，公开基准、轨迹与带提交戳的工件。

title: RPA: Residual Patch-Token Adapter for Image Retrieval from EEG and MEG
summary: Most existing MEG and EEG (M/EEG) visual decoding methods align brain signals with a single global embedding extracted from a pretrained visual encoder, leaving open whether intermediate patch representations, which preserve richer and more granular rich visual information, can improve representation learning. To address this question, we introduce the Residual Patch Adapter (RPA), a lightweight, modular adapter that leverages all patch tokens from an intermediate layer of a ViT visual encoder for alignment. Through extensive ablation analyses, we first show that pooling or masking patch tokens degrades the learned representation, demonstrating that retaining the full set of patch tokens is important for EEG alignment, while the CLS token provides little unique information. We then use a series of six quantitative feature analyses to show that both higher-level semantics and lower-level visual features, including color and texture, are essential for this EEG-to-image alignment. Under current protocols, our system achieves Top-1 accuracies of 95.4\% within-subject and 35.5\% cross-subject on THINGS-EEG2, and 65.2\% and 6.7\%, respectively, on THINGS-MEG, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across both datasets. Evaluations with alternative brain encoders, including pretrained EEG foundation models, demonstrate that the approach extends beyond the projection-based EEG encoder. Furthermore, we provide a plug-and-play interface that allows RPA to be replaced by convolution, attention, or ConvNeXt alternatives. Together, these findings provide significant insight into M/EEG-to-image representation learning by establishing design principles for leveraging the latent space of visual encoders, and open new directions for brain--image alignment and non-invasive brain--computer interface (BCI).

AI.tldr: 本文提出Residual Patch Adapter (RPA)，利用ViT中间层全部patch token进行脑信号(EEG/MEG)与图像的细粒度对齐，在THINGS-EEG2/MEG上取得SOTA，并给出视觉编码器潜在空间的设计准则。
AI.motivation: 现有M/EEG视觉解码方法仅将脑信号与预训练视觉编码器的单一全局嵌入对齐，未探究保留更丰富细粒度信息的中间patch表示是否能提升表征学习效果。
AI.method: 提出轻量模块化的Residual Patch Adapter (RPA)，利用ViT中间层的全部patch token进行对齐；通过消融分析池化/掩码patch token的影响，并用六项定量特征分析验证高低层视觉特征的贡献；提供可插拔接口支持卷积、注意力或ConvNeXt替代方案。
AI.result: 消融显示池化或掩码patch token会降低表征质量，而CLS token独特信息很少；THINGS-EEG2上Top-1为95.4%(被试内)/35.5%(跨被试)，THINGS-MEG为65.2%/6.7%，均达SOTA；在预训练EEG基础模型等替代脑编码器上同样有效。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了利用视觉编码器潜在空间的设计准则，证明完整patch token对EEG对齐至关重要，为脑-图像对齐及非侵入式BCI开辟了新方向。

title: Symbolic Guidance for LLM Agents in Distributed Multiagent Coordination
comment: A preliminary version of this work was published as an extended abstract in the Proceedings of AAMAS 2026
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in multi-agent systems, yet their ability to reliably execute distributed coordination protocols remains poorly understood. While AgentsNet, a benchmark framework for distributed coordination among LLM agents, enables such coordination, granting full reasoning autonomy often leads to inconsistent or degraded performance in complex domains.
  We hypothesize that coordination can be improved by regulating agent autonomy through symbolic guidance derived from established algorithms. To investigate this, we introduce the \emph{Symbolic Guidance Taxonomy (SGT)}, which characterizes a spectrum of autonomy ranging from open-ended natural language reasoning to fully prescribed algorithmic execution, with intermediate levels providing partial pseudocode guidance. Our results show that intermediate autonomy levels consistently outperform both unguided agents and fully prescriptive specifications. These findings identify autonomy regulation as a key design principle for LLM-based distributed coordination.

AI.tldr: 通过符号引导分类法（SGT）调节LLM智能体的自主性，发现中等自主性（部分伪代码引导）在多智能体分布式协调中表现最佳。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多被用作多智能体系统中的自主智能体，但其执行分布式协调协议的可靠性仍不明确；给予完全推理自主权往往导致复杂任务中的性能不稳定或下降。
AI.method: 提出符号引导分类法（SGT），将自主性从开放式自然语言推理到完全规定的算法执行划分为一个谱系，中间层级提供部分伪代码引导。基于AgentsNet基准框架进行实验。
AI.result: 中间自主性水平始终优于无引导的智能体和完全规定式的规范。
AI.conclusion: 自主性调节是LLM驱动分布式协调的关键设计原则。

title: JET: Judge-Guided Evolution at Test Time for Agent Programs
summary: An agent's executable program governs how it uses tools, processes observations, and responds to failures. Evolving this program at test time can help adaptation, but deciding which changes to retain is difficult when true rewards are unavailable. Execution traces provide evidence of agent behavior, yet interpreting that evidence requires a judge that remains useful as tasks and candidate programs change. We introduce Judge-Guided Evolution at Test Time (JET), which evolves an executable judge on labeled source trajectories, then freezes and transfers it to guide target-side program evolution. The judge supplies scores and diagnostic feedback without target evaluator access or model-weight updates. On unseen WebShop tasks, JET achieves approximately 13% higher mean reward than fixed-rubric guidance when evolution begins from an unevolved program (cold start) and 4% higher when it begins from one already optimized on source tasks (warm start), with a 36% relative improvement in cold-start exact success. An exact-judge control on PushT, where the judge reconstructs the scoring rule from observations, shows that without judge error, program search becomes the bottleneck. Analyses identify useful reward-prediction logic in the evolved code and show that better final selection alone cannot explain the gains. These results support executable judge transfer for program adaptation under evaluator-preserving task shifts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JET方法，通过在源任务轨迹上进化可执行评判器并冻结迁移到目标任务，指导代理程序在测试时进化，无需真实奖励或模型权重更新。
AI.motivation: 测试时进化代理程序有助于适应新任务，但当真实奖励不可用时，难以决定保留哪些程序改动。执行轨迹虽提供行为证据，但解读证据需要一个在任务和候选程序变化时仍有效的评判器。
AI.method: JET先在带标签的源轨迹上进化一个可执行评判器，然后冻结并迁移该评判器来指导目标侧的程序进化。评判器提供评分和诊断反馈，无需访问目标评估器或更新模型权重。
AI.result: 在未见过的WebShop任务上，冷启动时JET平均奖励比固定评分标准指导高约13%，热启动高4%，冷启动精确成功率相对提升36%。在PushT上用精确评判器对照显示，无评判误差时程序搜索成为瓶颈。分析发现进化代码中含有有用的奖励预测逻辑，且更好的最终选择无法单独解释增益。
AI.conclusion: 可执行评判器迁移能有效支持在评估器保持不变的任务偏移下的程序适应。

title: mu-bench: A Multilingual Utterance Transcription Benchmark
comment: 5 pages, 7 tables. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/sierra-research/mu-bench . Code: https://github.com/sierra-research/mu-bench/tree/icassp-2027 . Leaderboard: https://research.sierra.ai/mubench/
summary: Voice agents depend on accurate automatic speech recognition (ASR) to act on what callers say, yet ASR is evaluated on read, English-centric speech with word error rate (WER), which penalizes surface rather than semantic differences. We introduce mu-bench, a dataset of 4,270 caller utterances from 250 phone calls to an AI banking agent in English, Spanish, Turkish, Vietnamese, and Mandarin, centered on form-field inputs such as names, email addresses, and confirmation codes. We release Utterance Error Rate (UER), an LLM judge of whether a transcript preserves meaning, calibrated against human raters, together with an LLM normalizer that makes WER comparable across providers' output formats. On 1,847 human-rated transcripts, UER agrees with annotators at $κ$ = 0.78, versus 0.53 for exact-match WER on normalized text. We rank six commercial providers on a public leaderboard; the best reaches 11.9% UER, and Mandarin is hardest for all six.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 mu-bench 数据集与 UER 指标，用 LLM 评判语音识别语义是否保留，并配有 WER 归一化器，在真实银行客服多语种电话上评测六家商用 ASR。
AI.motivation: 现有 ASR 评测基于朗读式、以英语为中心的语音和 WER，惩罚表面差异而非语义差异，与实际语音代理场景（多语种、表单字段输入）不符。
AI.method: 构建 mu-bench：来自 250 通 AI 银行代理电话的 4,270 条来电者话语，覆盖英语、西班牙语、土耳其语、越南语和中文，聚焦姓名、邮箱、确认码等表单字段；提出 Utterance Error Rate (UER)，用 LLM 判断转写是否保留语义，并对齐人工评分；同时发布 LLM 归一化器，使不同厂商输出格式下 WER 可比。
AI.result: 在 1,847 条人工标注转写上，UER 与标注者一致度 κ=0.78，归一化文本的精确匹配 WER 仅为 0.53。公开榜单对六家商用供应商排序，最优达 11.9% UER，中文对六家均为最难。
AI.conclusion: UER 比 WER 更能反映语义正确性，mu-bench 为多语种真实语音代理 ASR 提供更合理的评测基准与榜单。

title: Modernising the Compressed-Domain Video Captioner: A Controlled Study of SigLIP2 and GPT-2 Substitutions
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Code, configurations and the exact commit for every run: https://github.com/nepalashim/compressed-video-captioning-ablation-cocap-siglip2-gpt2
summary:
Compressed-domain video captioning avoids full video decoding by operating directly on I-frames, motion vectors and residuals, trading a small amount of accuracy for a large gain in inference speed. CoCap established this pipeline using a CLIP vision encoder and a shallow BERT-style multimodal decoder. Both components predate substantially stronger alternatives. We ask a narrow, controlled question: how much of CoCap's accuracy is limited by these two components, and which of the two is the binding constraint?
  We replace the CLIP I-frame encoder with SigLIP2 and the BERT-style decoder with GPT-2, and evaluate three configurations (the original pairing, the encoder substitution alone, and both substitutions together) under identical data, sampling budget and optimisation schedule. All comparisons are made against our own reproduction of CoCap rather than its published numbers, because we train on a 4,999-clip subset of VATEX at a reduced sampling budget; absolute values are therefore not comparable with the original work.
  Our reproduction tracks the published result closely: CIDEr and METEOR run slightly above it (54.9 against 52.7; 23.4 against 23.2), BLEU-4 and ROUGE-L slightly below (29.7 against 31.4; 48.9 against 49.4). We attribute the differences to our evaluation subset rather than to any improvement in either direction. We find the two substitutions pull in opposite directions: SigLIP2 alone improves every metric (+4.5 CIDEr), while adding GPT-2 on top erodes that gain, because a pretrained decoder overfits 4,999 clips within two epochs. We additionally report inference latency for each configuration, since speed is the property that motivates compressed-domain captioning in the first place, and an accuracy gain purchased at a latency cost should be reported as such.

AI.tldr: 用SigLIP2替换CLIP编码器可提升压缩域视频描述精度，但GPT-2解码器在小数据上过拟合反而侵蚀增益。
AI.motivation: CoCap的两个核心组件（CLIP视觉编码器与浅层BERT式解码器）已过时，作者想弄清精度受限的瓶颈究竟在编码器还是解码器。
AI.method: 在相同数据、采样预算与优化计划下，将CLIP替换为SigLIP2、BERT式解码器替换为GPT-2，评估三种配置（原组合、仅换编码器、两者都换），并与自复现的CoCap对比。
AI.result: 复现结果与原论文接近（CIDEr 54.9 vs 52.7，METEOR 23.4 vs 23.2，BLEU-4 29.7 vs 31.4，ROUGE-L 48.9 vs 49.4）；仅换SigLIP2各指标提升（CIDEr +4.5），再叠加GPT-2则增益被侵蚀，因预训练解码器在4,999条片段上两轮即过拟合；同时报告各配置推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: 编码器是主要瓶颈，SigLIP2替换即有效；预训练解码器在小数据下反而有害，精度提升需结合延迟成本一同评估。

title: Goal-Persistent Coding Agents as Scientific Performance Engineers: A Fixed-Radius Nearest-Neighbor Case Study
summary: Coding agents can pursue persistent objectives across many tool-use turns, but evidence that general-purpose agents can conduct rigorous scientific performance engineering remains limited. We present a repository-scale case study in which off-the-shelf Codex and Claude Code agents optimize fixed-radius nearest-neighbor (FRNN) search for particle tracking. Starting from a PyTorch-dependent CUDA implementation, the agents follow an executable goal that specifies exact-correctness tests, profiling requirements, and acceptance criteria without prescribing code transformations. In the primary sequential trajectory, they autonomously remove the PyTorch dependency and conduct hypothesis-driven optimization experiments. The resulting standalone C++/CUDA library exactly reproduces the targeted reference result. Its synchronous NumPy interface achieved 1.6-fold speedup over the original GPU-resident PyTorch interface, despite including host transfers. Similar speedups were observed across different GPU architectures and software stacks. An independent optimization rerun followed a different sequence of hypotheses and reached even better performance on the target workload. These results show that goal-persistent coding agents can act as experimental performance engineers, and that executable scientific contracts are needed both to guide and to validate their optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个仓库规模的案例研究，展示通用编码智能体（Codex、Claude Code）能在科学性能工程中自主完成优化任务。
AI.motivation: 通用编码智能体虽能长时间追求目标，但缺乏其能进行严谨科学性能工程的证据。作者希望验证智能体能否在无代码级指令下自主优化科学计算性能。
AI.method: 以FRNN粒子追踪搜索为任务，从依赖PyTorch的CUDA实现出发，给智能体设定可执行目标（含精确正确性测试、性能分析要求、验收标准），不规定具体代码变换。智能体自主去除PyTorch依赖并进行假设驱动的优化实验。
AI.result: 得到独立C++/CUDA库，精确复现参考结果；同步NumPy接口相比原始GPU驻留PyTorch接口提速1.6倍（含主机传输）。在不同GPU架构和软件栈上均观察到类似加速。独立重跑采用不同假设序列，性能更优。
AI.conclusion: 目标持久的编码智能体可作为实验型性能工程师，且需要可执行的科学契约来引导和验证其优化过程。

title: The Construction of an Empirical Dataset of Incomplete Software Changes from Open Source Projects
summary: During software development, a modification to a software component may propagate across the system, requiring precise identification and correct revision of all affected components. This is a complex task, and developers often (45.7%) miss related changes. To address this, several methods have been developed to extract co-change rules from files that are frequently changed together in the revision history. However, previous research evaluated the methods using artificially created incomplete changes, which may not be representative of real-world data. To solve this problem, we construct a dataset by mining incomplete changes from a collection of open-source software, using information about induced bugs and their respective fixes from an issue tracking platform. We also analyze the characteristics of incomplete changes using this constructed dataset and found that 89.4% of missed changes involved five or fewer files. Finally, we re-evaluate LCExtractor, an existing co-change rule extraction method, on our constructed dataset, and we identify the optimal sorting criterion and the impact of the number of used commits.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个来自真实开源软件的不完整变更数据集，用于改进共变更规则提取方法的评估。
AI.motivation: 开发者常（45.7%）漏掉相关变更，而现有共变更规则提取方法因依赖人工构造的不完整变更数据评估，可能无法反映真实情况。
AI.method: 从开源软件中挖掘不完整变更，利用问题跟踪平台中诱导缺陷及其修复信息构建数据集，并分析不完整变更特征；随后在该数据集上重新评估现有方法LCExtractor。
AI.result: 89.4%的漏改涉及五个或更少文件；识别出LCExtractor的最优排序准则及所使用提交数量的影响。
AI.conclusion: 真实不完整变更数据集能更准确地评估共变更规则提取方法，并为优化其排序准则和提交数量提供依据。

title: Using LMs to Model the Effects of Context and Coreference during Sentence Comprehension
summary: Language models (LMs) are often used as a tool to model human language processing. Recent studies suggest that severely restricting LMs' context window improves their fit to human psycholinguistic data by simulating human working memory constraints. However, it is possible that this strict memory-decay approach overlooks humans' reliance on long-range structural representations, such as discourse structre. In this work, we systematically vary the context window size of GPT-2 across four large-scale naturalistic English reading-time datasets and observe a U-shaped relationship: Although restricted contexts (< 20 tokens) successfully capture local memory limitations, expanded contexts (500--1,000 tokens) ultimately yield the highest overall psycholinguistic fit. To investigate the mechanism driving this benefit, we conduct a counterfactual inference-time experiment that disrupts cross-sentential entity chains by pronominalizing repeated discourse entities. Obscuring these structural linkages significantly degrades the predictive power of larger context windows by 20% to 40%. Our experiments demonstrate that tracking long-range coreference relations is one important factor for the alignment between LM surprisal and human reading behavior, and approximate the extent to which human comprehenders use global discourse relations during language processing.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统改变GPT-2上下文窗口大小，在四个英语阅读时间数据集上发现U型关系：受限上下文(<20 tokens)捕捉局部记忆限制，但扩展上下文(500-1000 tokens)整体拟合人类阅读行为最佳，且这种收益主要来自长距离指代/语篇结构追踪。
AI.motivation: 近期研究认为严重限制LM上下文窗口可更好拟合人类心理语言学数据(模拟工作记忆限制)，但这一严格记忆衰减视角可能忽视人类对长距离结构表征(如语篇结构)的依赖。
AI.method: 在四个大规模自然英语阅读时间数据集上系统改变GPT-2上下文窗口大小；并进行反事实推理实验：通过将重复出现的语篇实体代名化来破坏跨句实体链，检验长距离结构的作用。
AI.result: 上下文窗口与心理语言学拟合呈U型关系：受限上下文(<20 tokens)能捕捉局部记忆限制，但扩展上下文(500-1000 tokens)整体拟合最优。破坏跨句实体链会使大上下文窗口的预测能力显著下降20%-40%。
AI.conclusion: 追踪长距离共指关系是LM surprisal与人类阅读行为对齐的重要因素，并近似估计了人类理解者使用全局语篇关系的程度。

title: Integrated Deep Learning Framework Designed on Hybrid Optimization Strategies for Automated Health Detection and Analysis in Silkworms
summary: A Hybrid Residual Attention Network is proposed for accurately classifying silkworm images into six different classes, including healthy and diseased states. It uses residual blocks for deep feature extraction and attention to focus on disease related features. A novel Integrated Adaptive Momentum Optimizer was introduced to enhance convergence and improve training efficiency. The dataset of silkworm images underwent preprocessing techniques such as normalization, resizing, and noise reduction, along with augmentation strategies to improve data quality and diversity. It is optimized using IAMO, achieved an accuracy of 98.67%.The integration of spatial and channel wise attention mechanisms, coupled with IAMO, significantly enhanced the model ability to recognize subtle differences between classes. Results indicate that HRAN can be used to detect disease at an early stage in sericulture, and future work will enhance scalability and efficiency in different environments.

AI.tldr: 提出混合残差注意力网络(HRAN)结合新型自适应动量优化器(IAMO)，实现蚕图像六分类，准确率达98.67%。
AI.motivation: 蚕养殖中需要早期、准确地识别健康与患病蚕，以支持病害早期检测。现有方法对细微类别差异的识别能力不足，训练收敛效率有待提升。
AI.method: 采用残差块进行深层特征提取，并引入空间与通道双重注意力机制聚焦病害相关特征；提出集成自适应动量优化器(IAMO)提升收敛速度与训练效率。数据经归一化、缩放、降噪预处理及增强策略以提升质量与多样性。
AI.result: 结合HAMO优化后模型准确率达98.67%；空间与通道注意力的融合显著增强了对类间细微差异的识别能力。
AI.conclusion: HRAN可用于蚕养殖中的早期病害检测，未来将提升其在不同环境下的可扩展性与效率。

title: The Last Mile Is the File: OfficeEditBench for Preservation-Aware Office Editing
summary: A small Office edit creates two obligations: propagate every required update and leave protected state untouched. Updating too little leaves dependencies inconsistent; updating too much changes content the user did not authorize. We introduce OfficeEditBench, a 170-task benchmark for change-scoped maintenance of spreadsheets, presentations, and documents. Task contracts specify required updates, protected state, native structures, and applicable interaction requirements. Across 510 archived task-system outcomes from WorkBuddy, Doubao, and Codex, we distinguish file delivery, target completion, and verifier-defined acceptance. Hard package-valid delivery ranges from 92% to 100%, yet no selected output satisfies the complete contract. Case analysis highlights why local correctness is insufficient: an updated value can lose its generating formula, a revised rule can fail to reach related conclusions, and a new deadline can omit a retained prerequisite. These mechanisms connect artifact-level checks to the continued maintainability of Office files. We analyze maintenance failures while distinguishing frozen automatic verdicts from human acceptability. OfficeEditBench provides a testbed for completing required changes while preserving the logic and scope of existing work.

AI.tldr: 提出OfficeEditBench基准（170任务），评估Office文件变更范围维护：需完成必要更新且不破坏受保护状态。测试显示交付率高（92%-100%）但无输出满足完整契约。
AI.motivation: 小型Office编辑带来双重义务：传播所有必要更新，同时不触碰受保护状态。更新过少导致依赖不一致，更新过多则改动用户未授权内容。现有评估缺乏对变更范围维护的检验。
AI.method: 构建OfficeEditBench，含170个电子表格、演示文稿、文档任务，任务契约规定必要更新、受保护状态、原生结构及交互要求。基于WorkBuddy、Doubao、Codex的510个归档结果，区分文件交付、目标完成与验证器验收三类评估。
AI.result: 硬性包有效交付率为92%-100%，但无任何选中输出满足完整契约。案例分析显示局部正确不足：更新值丢失生成公式、修订规则未传导到相关结论、新截止日期遗漏保留前提。
AI.conclusion: OfficeEditBench为在保持现有工作逻辑与范围的前提下完成必要变更提供测试平台，连接工件级检查与Office文件的可维护性，并区分自动判定与人类可接受性。

title: Typed Decision Models: An Early Evidence Audit and Evaluation Checklist
comment: 25 pages, 8 tables. Corpus: 28 arXiv papers (19-24 September 2026); arXiv versions listed in Appendix A. Ancillary file: per-paper corpus sheet (versions and headline results)
summary: Typed decision models (TDMs) return probability distributions over caller-defined options without generating text. TypeSafe released Jev, a commercial typed decision model, on 15 September 2026, and a small body of evaluation and replication work appeared within days. We review 28 papers posted between 19 and 24 September and relate their findings to earlier work on label-probability classification, constrained decoding, reranking, calibration, and model cascades. In this early literature, the typed readout itself has not shown an independent accuracy advantage over comparable label-probability readouts. Jev's clearest gains are in latency and cost, while accuracy gaps remain on harder tasks. In practical deployments, confidence is often used to decide when to defer to a stronger model or a human. We use recurring weaknesses in these studies to derive a 14-item evaluation checklist for future TDM work. Because the evidence covers only the first nine days after the release of one hosted model, the review should be read as an early evidence map rather than a settled assessment of the model class.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了Jev发布后9天内（9月19-24日）的28篇论文，探讨类型化决策模型（TDMs）的早期证据，并据此提出14项评估清单。
AI.motivation: TypeSafe于2026年9月15日发布商业类型化决策模型Jev，数日内涌现大量评估与复现研究。作者希望梳理这些早期发现，并将其与标签概率分类、约束解码、重排序、校准及模型级联等既有工作相联系，同时为未来TDM研究建立规范的评估框架。
AI.method: 对9月19日至24日间发布的28篇论文进行文献综述，将各项发现与早期相关工作进行对照分析，并从这些研究中反复出现的弱点出发，提炼出14项评估清单。
AI.result: 综述显示，类型化读出本身相较可比的标签概率读出并未表现出独立的准确率优势。Jev最明显的提升体现在延迟和成本上，而在较难任务上仍存在准确率差距。实际部署中，置信度常被用于决定何时交由更强模型或人工处理。
AI.conclusion: 证据仅覆盖单一托管模型发布后的前九天，因此该综述应被视为早期证据地图，而非对该模型类别的定论。

title: CLC-YOLO: A Compact Channel-Gated Prototype Network for Real-Time Leakage-Aware Breast Ultrasound Lesion Segmentation
summary: Reliable breast ultrasound lesion segmentation requires accurate boundaries and evaluation that prevents patients or duplicate images from crossing data splits. We propose Channel Local Contrast (CLC), a compact refinement of the YOLO26 segmentation prototype head. CLC adds a fixed local high-pass residual controlled by 64 zero-initialized, bounded channel gates. Baseline and CLC were compared in five matched folds on each of four breast ultrasound datasets. BUS-BRA used patient-disjoint outer tests with separate inner validation. BUS-UCLM and BrEaST used patient-grouped validation folds; BUSI used duplicate-component groups because patient identifiers are unavailable. Group-macro Dice increased by 1.68, 3.11, 1.12, and 2.45 percentage points on BUS-BRA, BUS-UCLM, BUSI, and BrEaST, respectively. Only the BUS-BRA paired 95% confidence interval excluded zero. CLC adds 64 parameters and 0.0049 giga floating-point operations (GFLOPs). At 640 pixels, single-T4, batch-one, 16-bit floating-point (FP16) TensorRT graph times were 2.1478 ms for CLC and 2.0512 ms for baseline, excluding preprocessing and postprocessing. CLC increased group-macro Dice across all four datasets with a measured T4 forward-pass overhead of 0.0966 ms. Code: https://github.com/mfazrinizar/CLC-YOLO

AI.tldr: 提出通道局部对比(CLC)模块，对YOLO26分割头做轻量改进，用于乳腺超声病灶分割，在四个数据集上均提升Dice且几乎不增加开销。
AI.motivation: 乳腺超声病灶分割需要准确边界，且评估时必须防止患者或重复图像跨越数据划分（数据泄漏）。作者希望以极小代价增强分割头对局部边界的敏感度。
AI.method: CLC是对YOLO26分割原型头(prototype head)的紧凑改进：加入一个固定的局部高通残差，由64个零初始化、有界(bounded)的通道门控(channel gates)调节。评估在四个乳腺超声数据集上各做五折匹配对比：BUS-BRA用患者不相交的外层测试并单独内层验证；BUS-UCLM与BrEaST用患者分组的验证折；BUSI因缺患者标识改用重复成分分组。
AI.result: 组宏平均(group-macro)Dice分别提升1.68、3.11、1.12、2.45个百分点（BUS-BRA、BUS-UCLM、BUSI、BrEaST）。仅BUS-BRA的配对95%置信区间不包含零。CLC仅增加64个参数和0.0049 GFLOPs。640像素下，单T4、batch=1、FP16 TensorRT图时间：CLC为2.1478 ms，基线2.0512 ms（不含前/后处理），前向开销0.0966 ms。
AI.conclusion: CLC在四个数据集上均提升组宏平均Dice，T4前向开销仅约0.097 ms，是参数与算力代价极低的边界细化方案。

title: SenseAgent: An LLM Agent for Adaptive Cross-Domain IMU Sensing
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Plan to submit to SenSys Phase 2
summary: Deep learning has improved inertial measurement unit (IMU) sensing for mobile and wearable applications. However, an IMU model trained in one domain often becomes unreliable when it is used with a new user, device, or body position. Existing methods usually treat this problem as a static model-design task: they pretrain a stronger representation, add data augmentation, or select one adaptation method before deployment. In practice, the target domain is only gradually observed, labels are scarce, and different domain shifts require different sensing actions. This paper presents SenseAgent, an LLM-guided sensing agent for cross-domain IMU activity recognition. Instead of asking an LLM to classify raw IMU signals, SenseAgent uses the LLM as a runtime planner over sensing tools, source-domain experience memory, online target memory, and verifiers. The agent builds a label-free diagnosis report from the target stream and uses it to decide whether to keep raw inference or invoke specialized tools, including gravity-aware sensing, prototype transfer, and style normalization. Verifiers check source calibration, target-memory reliability, and no-harm criteria before accepting high-risk tool decisions. SenseAgent also supports scarce feedback without retraining the backbone or replacing the label-free route.
