This design converts cross-domain IMU sensing from a fixed inference pipeline into a closed-loop sensing process that diagnoses target shifts, selects suitable sensing actions, and rejects unsafe adaptations. We evaluate SenseAgent across multiple IMU datasets and deployment shifts. Results show that its verified route selection improves cross-domain sensing, especially under harder placement and compound shifts, and further benefits from limited user feedback.

AI.tldr: SenseAgent 是一个 LLM 引导的感知智能体，将跨域 IMU 活动识别从固定推理流程转变为闭环感知过程，通过诊断目标域偏移、选择合适感知工具并拒绝不安全适配来提升跨域性能。
AI.motivation: IMU 模型跨用户、设备、佩戴位置部署时常常失效。现有方法将跨域问题当作静态模型设计任务（预训练更强表征、数据增强、部署前选定一种适配方法），但实际中目标域只能逐步观测、标签稀缺，且不同域偏移需要不同的感知动作。
AI.method: 提出 SenseAgent：不让 LLM 直接分类原始 IMU 信号，而是将其作为运行时规划器，在感知工具、源域经验记忆、在线目标记忆和验证器之上运作。智能体从目标流构建无标签诊断报告，据此决定保留原始推理或调用专门工具（重力感知、原型迁移、风格归一化）；验证器在采纳高风险工具决策前检查源校准、目标记忆可靠性和无害准则。同时支持少量反馈，无需重训骨干或替换无标签路径。
AI.result: 在多个 IMU 数据集和部署偏移上评估，验证后的路由选择改善了跨域感知，尤其在更难的佩戴位置和复合偏移下表现更好，并从有限用户反馈中进一步获益。
AI.conclusion: SenseAgent 将跨域 IMU 感知从固定推理管道转化为闭环感知过程，能够诊断目标偏移、选择合适感知动作并拒绝不安全适配，为跨域 IMU 活动识别提供了动态、可验证的解决方案。

title: From Noisy Telemetry to Actionable Warnings: GPU Failure Prediction in Industrial Clusters
comment: GPU cluster, failure prediction, event-level evaluation, fault-specific modeling
summary: GPU clusters are critical infrastructure for AI services, but accurate and actionable GPU failure prediction remains a problem in production settings. We study ticket-linked telemetry from a ByteDance GPU cluster and identify three obstacles: workload-confounded telemetry, heterogeneous fault precursors, and the gap between window-level predictions and actionable alerts. These findings motivate Falcon, a fault-specific warning framework combining missingness-aware temporal and peer-relative features, fault-specific learner selection, and an event policy based on thresholding, persistence, and cooldown. On the test set, Falcon achieves the highest F1 among four baselines and reaches 70.6% F1 on the best-performing fault type. Detected cases provide median lead times of 17.34-35.57 hours. We further report a production deployment, where Falcon is calibrated toward high-precision alerts to reflect false-positive costs. Together, these results show that fault-specific modeling improves early warning from noisy production GPU telemetry.

AI.tldr: Falcon：面向生产GPU集群的故障特定预警框架，通过缺失感知与同伴相对特征、故障特定学习器选择及事件策略，实现高F1与长提前期。
AI.motivation: GPU集群是AI服务的关键基础设施，但生产环境中准确且可执行的GPU故障预测仍未被解决。作者基于ByteDance GPU集群的工单关联遥测数据，识别出三个障碍：工作负载混淆的遥测、异构的故障前兆，以及窗口级预测与可执行告警之间的差距。
AI.method: Falcon采用故障特定建模：结合缺失感知的时间特征与同伴相对特征、为不同故障类型选择特定学习器，并设计基于阈值、持续性与冷却时间的事件策略以生成可执行告警。
AI.result: 在测试集上，Falcon在四个基线中取得最高F1；表现最好的故障类型达到70.6% F1；检测案例的中位提前期为17.34-35.57小时。此外还报告了生产部署情况，Falcon被校准为高精度告警以反映误报成本。
AI.conclusion: 故障特定建模能够从嘈杂的生产GPU遥测中改善早期预警，并在真实生产部署中具备可行性。

title: ScopeIF: Improving Scope-Aware Precise Instruction-Following in Large Language Models via Graded Reward Modeling
summary: Precise instruction-following is a fundamental ability of large language models (LLMs), requiring their outputs to strictly satisfy objective constraints in input instructions. In complex application scenarios, these constraints often possess diverse scopes that govern specific response segments rather than the entire output. However, existing optimization methods often neglect constraint scope during data construction and rely on binary per-constraint rewards, yielding limited data diversity and sparse supervision for complex constraints. To this end, we propose ScopeIF, a novel training framework for scope-aware precise instruction-following. We first introduce a unified schema that factorizes objective constraints into three decoupled dimensions: Scope, Target, and Range. Grounded in this schema, we construct ScopeInstruct, a large-scale instruction dataset with diverse scope-aware constraints, and combine tool-grounded verification with graded reward modeling to quantify the violation degree of each constraint, providing dense supervision for policy optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ScopeIF consistently outperforms existing methods, particularly on complex scope-aware constraints, while preserving general capabilities. Notably, it enables optimized Qwen3-4B and 8B models to rival or surpass strong frontier models such as Gemini-2.5-Pro and DeepSeek-V3.2, establishing an effective paradigm for advancing scope-aware instruction-following. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/thu-coai/ScopeIF.

AI.tldr: 提出ScopeIF框架，将指令约束分解为Scope、Target、Range三维度，构建ScopeInstruct数据集并用分级奖励建模，实现范围感知的精确指令遵循。
AI.motivation: 现有优化方法在数据构建时忽视约束范围，且依赖二元奖励，导致数据多样性有限、对复杂约束监督稀疏。
AI.method: 引入统一schema将客观约束分解为Scope/Target/Range三维度；构建大规模ScopeInstruct数据集；结合工具验证与分级奖励建模量化违规程度，提供密集监督。
AI.result: ScopeIF持续超越现有方法，尤其在复杂范围约束上表现突出，同时保持通用能力；优化后的Qwen3-4B和8B可媲美或超越Gemini-2.5-Pro、DeepSeek-V3.2。
AI.conclusion: ScopeIF为推进范围感知的指令遵循建立了有效范式，代码与数据开源。

title: MDL-Calibrated Significance-Gain Pair Encoding: Replication-Aware Automatic Stopping for Subword Tokenization
comment: 15 pages, 3 tables, 1 algorithm. Source code available online
summary:
Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) constructs subword vocabularies through greedy pair merging, but conventional BPE requires the number of merges or target vocabulary size to be specified externally. Significance-Gain Pair Encoding (SG-BPE) replaces frequency-only selection with a statistical criterion based on how strongly an observed pair exceeds its expected co-occurrence under an independence model.
  This paper introduces MDL-Calibrated Significance-Gain Pair Encoding (MDL-SG), a three-stage procedure separating discovery, replication, and utility. Candidate pairs are ranked by Significance-Gain on a discovery partition, tested for replication on a separate partition using an exact one-sided hypergeometric test with per-iteration Benjamini-Hochberg correction, and then evaluated on a utility partition using a Minimum Description Length (MDL) criterion. Merging stops automatically when no replicated candidate yields positive held-out MDL gain.
  On WikiText-103, MDL-SG stops at 209, 433, and 847 merges for 120K, 250K, and 500K-character tokenizer-training samples, respectively. At 500K characters, it selects a stored vocabulary of 1,017 tokens without prescribing the vocabulary size in advance. In a compute-matched TinyGPT experiment with identical 2,024,448-parameter models and 500 optimizer updates per language model, MDL-SG achieves validation/test BPC of 3.2612/3.2436, compared with test BPC of 3.2894 for SG-BPE and 3.3493 for frequency BPE. Frequency BPE achieves stronger raw compression, while MDL-SG achieves lower BPC, showing that compression-oriented merge selection and language-model utility need not coincide.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MDL-SG，一种结合显著性增益统计准则与最小描述长度（MDL）自动停止的三阶段 BPE 改进方法，在无需预设词表大小的前提下提升了语言模型效用。
AI.motivation: 传统 BPE 依赖频率进行贪心合并，且需外部指定合并次数或目标词表大小；仅以压缩为导向的选择未必与语言模型效用一致。
AI.method: MDL-SG 分三阶段：在发现集上按 Significance-Gain 排序候选对；在复制集上用精确单侧超几何检验并做逐迭代 Benjamini-Hochberg 校正；在效用集上用 MDL 准则评估，当无复制候选产生正的留出 MDL 增益时自动停止合并。
AI.result: 在 WikiText-103 上，分别于 120K/250K/500K 字符训练样本下停在 209/433/847 次合并；500K 字符时自动选出 1,017 个 token 的词表。相同 2,024,448 参数 TinyGPT 实验下，验证/测试 BPC 为 3.2612/3.2436，优于 SG-BPE（测试 3.2894）和频率 BPE（测试 3.3493）。
AI.conclusion: 频率 BPE 原始压缩更强，但 MDL-SG 的 BPC 更低，说明压缩导向的合并选择与语言模型效用并不一致，MDL-SG 能在不预设词表大小下自动确定合并数。

title: What Does the Rank Buy? A Spectral and Distributional Analysis of Low-Rank Adaptation
summary: The rank $r$ in LoRA is widely treated as a capacity control: a smaller rank is assumed to yield a simpler model that generalizes better. We show that, under hard per-factor norm budgets---the idealization of the weight decay and norm control used in practice---this intuition breaks down. The reason is structural: under such budgets, the updates LoRA can reach are exactly the matrices of rank at most $r$ inside a nuclear-norm ball, and every complexity and displacement functional we analyze is maximized over this set by a rank-one update---so the rank cap never binds. The consequences follow directly. The linear-readout model class we study is identical for every $r \ge 1$, its Rademacher complexity carries no dependence on $r$, and the distance the adaptation can move the source distribution obeys a rank-independent upper bound that we show is sharp. If rank does not control capacity, where does it act? We identify two places. Statistically, replacing the per-factor budgets with a joint budget on the product restores a data-dependent, rank-sensitive complexity bound---though the gain appears only for well-spread feature distributions, and the worst case remains rank-free. Spectrally, rank sets the price of adaptation: canceling the leading singular directions of the pretrained weight requires both sufficient rank and sufficient budget. We bound the smallest rank achieving a desired source--target alignment, with upper and lower bounds that match under two-sided spectral decay. Together, these results recast rank as governing which updates are reachable and what cancellation costs---not how much capacity the model has.

AI.tldr: 本文指出LoRA中的秩r常被当作容量控制，但在硬性逐因子范数预算下该直觉失效：可达更新恰为核范数球内秩≤r的矩阵，而复杂度/位移泛函均被秩一更新最大化，因此秩上限从未生效；秩真正作用在于决定可达更新集合与取消主奇异方向的对齐代价。
AI.motivation: 社区普遍假设更小的LoRA秩意味着更简单、泛化更好的模型，即将秩视为容量控制。作者希望检验这一直觉在实践常用的权重衰减与范数控制（逐因子范数预算）下是否成立。
AI.method: 在硬性逐因子范数预算（实践范数控制的理想化）下，刻画LoRA可达更新集合为核范数球内秩≤r的矩阵；分析线性读出模型类的Rademacher复杂度与源分布位移泛函；并对比逐因子预算与对乘积的联合预算；再从谱角度研究取消预训练权重主奇异方向所需的最小秩与预算。
AI.result: 在逐因子预算下，模型类对所有r≥1完全相同，Rademacher复杂度不依赖r，源分布位移有秩无关且紧的上界；改为乘积联合预算可恢复数据依赖、秩敏感的复杂度界（但仅对良分布特征有效，最坏情形仍秩无关）；谱上，对齐源目标需同时具备足够秩与预算，给出最小秩的上/下界，并在双边谱衰减下相匹配。
AI.conclusion: 秩并非控制模型容量，而是决定哪些更新可达以及取消主奇异方向需付出多大代价。

title: CLAD: Constrained Abstract Domain for Neural Network Verification
summary: Neural network verification (NNV) formally verifies that a network satisfies a specified property for all inputs within a defined region. Modern NNV tools employ abstract domains to compute a sound over-approximation of the network's behavior from the given input region, thus the tightness of these abstractions essentially determines efficiency. A long line of increasingly precise domains has been developed, but they all describe the valid input region in the same restrictive way, e.g., an Lp-norm ball. A practical input region is rarely a simple Lp ball, but rather a combination Lp ball with additional constraints. Verifying a network over such a region with existing abstraction produces a loose over-approximation, which results in either failing to verify a property or spurious counterexamples. We introduce Constrained Lagrangian Abstract Domain (CLAD), a new abstract domain that computes a sound over-approximation of neural networks over input regions defined by a combination of convex constraints. CLAD propagates these constraints and tightens bounds over the true feasible region. However, bounding a neuron over the intersection of these constraints has no closed-form solution, so CLAD relaxes each constraint into the objective with a Lagrange multiplier and solves the resulting max-min problem with a projected primal-dual method, alternating a projected gradient step on the input with a multiplier update. CLAD supports any convex constraint with a subgradient, e.g., from automatic differentiation. We evaluate CLAD on 1,944 instances across four convolutional networks with motion-blur structured perturbations with halfspace or L2-ball constraints. On standard unconstrained Linf property, CLAD verifies as many instances as GCPCROWN at a similar runtime. On constrained properties, CLAD verifies 60\% more instances than GCPCROWN on L2-ball properties, and 22% more in total.

AI.tldr: 提出 CLAD 抽象域，可在由凸约束组合定义的输入区域内对神经网络进行可靠过近似验证。
AI.motivation: 现有 NNV 抽象域均将输入区域限制为简单的 Lp 范数球，难以处理实际中 Lp 球加额外约束的组合区域，导致过近似过松、验证失败或产生伪反例。
AI.method: CLAD 传播凸约束并收紧真实可行域上的边界；由于约束交集上的神经元边界无闭式解，将各约束以拉格朗日乘子松弛进目标，用投影原始-对偶方法交替进行输入上的投影梯度步与乘子更新来求解 max-min 问题；支持任何具有次梯度的凸约束（如自动微分获得）。
AI.result: 在 4 个卷积网络、运动模糊结构化扰动、半空间或 L2 球约束下的 1944 个实例上评估：标准无约束 Linf 性质上与 GCPCROWN 验证数量相当且耗时相近；约束性质上，L2 球性质比 GCPCROWN 多验证 60%，总数多 22%。
AI.conclusion: CLAD 是首个能处理凸约束组合输入区域的抽象域，在保持标准场景性能的同时显著提升约束场景下的验证能力。

title: The Judge Is Not Its Twin: Post-training makes a model's writing more predictable but barely moves its taste, as a judge, toward predictable writing
summary: Language models are now routinely graded by other language models. If post-training makes a model's own writing more predictable, it may also teach the same model, acting as a judge, to reward predictable writing, so that progress on creativity would be invisible to automated evaluation. We follow two open model families, OLMo-2 and Zephyr (7B parameters each), through their public training stages and measure every stage twice, as a writer of short stories and as a judge of pairs of stories. As writers, the models drift as feared: each family's fully trained model finds the stories of its base, supervised fine-tuned (SFT) and preference-trained (DPO) stages progressively more familiar, in all ten prompts, and a model from the other family finds the trained stories 7.0 to 9.2 percent (OLMo-2) and 24 to 25 percent (Zephyr) less surprising per token. As judges, they barely move toward predictable writing. Asked which story is better, a question every judge can use to tell a story from its own words in scrambled order, no trained judge's estimated tilt toward the more predictable story grows by as much as one point in the probability of picking it. A post hoc one-sided 95% upper bound on that growth is 2.7 points on an average pair, about the size of the untrained OLMo-2 judge's own tilt. Asked which is more creative, no trained judge's estimate favors the predictable story more than its base's does. Training instead strengthens a preference for longer stories when the question is creativity, and for one answer slot, and it breaks "more creative" as a question: trained judges asked it no longer reliably prefer a story to its scrambled words. A follow-up could not build pairs that differ in predictability but not in quality, because the routes that made this writer's stories less predictable also broke some of them, often enough to fail a quality floor set in advance.

AI.tldr: 研究追踪OLMo-2和Zephyr训练阶段，发现模型作为写作者确实变得更可预测，但作为评判者几乎未因此偏袒可预测文本。
AI.motivation: 担忧后训练使模型写作更可预测，进而使其作为评判者也奖励可预测写作，从而掩盖创造力的真实进步。
AI.method: 沿OLMo-2与Zephyr两族7B模型公开训练阶段，分别以短故事写作者和成对故事评判者身份测量每一阶段。
AI.result: 写作者：全训练模型认为base、SFT、DPO阶段故事越来越熟悉（十个提示全中）；跨族评判者认为训练后故事每token惊讶度降低7.0–9.2%（OLMo-2）和24–25%（Zephyr）。评判者：对可预测故事的偏好增长不足1个百分点，单侧95%上界2.7个百分点；问"更有创意"时无训练评判者比其base更偏袒可预测故事；训练反而强化了偏好更长故事、固定答案位置，并破坏"更有创意"作为问题的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 创造力进步的自动化评估风险未如担忧那样实现；但后续无法构造仅可预测性不同而质量相同的配对，因降低可预测性的手段也损害了部分故事质量。

title: Can't Find Waldo: Evaluating VLMs' Sensitivity to Image Resolution and Detail Level
summary: Visual Language Models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable success across diverse tasks, yet they struggle with high-resolution inputs where critical information resides in small regions or detailed, cluttered scenes. While several approaches address this limitation, a systematic understanding of why models fail at high resolutions is lacking. We introduce a controlled evaluation framework that disentangles resolution-related performance degradation from task difficulty through semantics-preserving transformations. We propose two simple metrics: Area Under the Scaling Curve (AUSC), which quantifies scaling robustness independent of baseline accuracy, and Prediction Variance Score (PVS), which measures resolution-induced prediction instability. Through comprehensive experiments across 5 model families and 5 benchmarks, we identify three primary failure modes: (1) information loss from downsampling at vision token limits, (2) tokenization artifacts from patch boundary shifts and positional encoding fragility under non-standard aspect ratios, and (3) attention dilution as token counts increase. Our analysis reveals that even state-of-the-art models suffer from performance drops when processing high-resolution images, with degradation patterns varying systematically by architectural family. We provide actionable insights for model architecture design and data augmentation strategies to mitigate these limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可控评测框架与两个指标（AUSC、PVS），系统性分析VLM在高分辨率输入下失败的原因，识别出三类主要失败模式。
AI.motivation: VLM在高分辨率输入（关键信息位于小区域或杂乱细节场景）表现不佳，现有方法虽多但缺乏对其失败原因的系统性理解。
AI.method: 提出通过语义保持变换解耦分辨率退化与任务难度的可控评估框架；定义AUSC（面积under缩放曲线，衡量缩放鲁棒性）与PVS（预测方差分数，衡量分辨率导致的预测不稳定）；在5个模型家族与5个基准上做综合实验。
AI.result: 识别三类主要失败模式：(1)视觉token上限下采样导致的信息丢失；(2)补丁边界偏移带来的token化伪影及非标准长宽比下位置编码脆弱；(3)token增多导致的注意力稀释。即使SOTA模型也出现性能下降，退化模式随架构家族系统性变化。
AI.conclusion: 为模型架构设计与数据增强策略提供可操作建议以缓解高分辨率局限。

title: Decentralized Master-Mind: Joint Action Refinement through Iterative Intent Denoising in Multi-Agent Pathfinding
summary: Decentralized multi-agent path finding (MAPF) with communication requires agents to reach individual goals without collisions under partial observability. Learnable policies trained on expert data provide an effective approach to this problem. However, when several coordinated joint actions are valid in the same context, independently sampling from per-agent distributions can recombine locally valid choices into incompatible joint actions. This failure can arise from the final sampling mechanism even when the per-agent action distributions are learned correctly. DMM (Decentralized Master-Mind) addresses this by replacing one-shot action sampling with discrete, iterative refinement of action intents across communication rounds, inspired by denoising in diffusion models. Agents initialize random action intents and refine them through local communication, coupling their choices before commitment. DMM is pretrained with imitation learning on expert MAPF solutions and further optimized with MICPO, a critic-free group-relative reinforcement-learning method designed for multi-agent, multi-round action refinement. DMM generally achieves higher success rates and lower solution costs than the evaluated learnable baselines. On 1,600 MovingAI tasks, DMM fine-tuned with MICPO solves 1,598, the highest coverage among the evaluated methods, while achieving solution costs close to those of the strongest baselines. DMM also scales to over one million simultaneously acting agents in obstacle-rich environments. These results show that round-level intent refinement can improve joint-action coordination while preserving decentralized execution.

AI.tldr: DMM提出用离散迭代式动作意图精炼替代一次性采样，解决去中心化多智能体路径规划中联合动作不兼容问题，在MovingAI任务和大规模场景上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 去中心化MAPF在部分可观测下需无碰撞到达各自目标。基于专家数据学习的策略虽有效，但当同一情境下存在多个协联联合动作时，独立从各智能体分布采样可能把局部有效选择重组为不兼容的联合动作——即使各智能体分布学习正确，最终采样机制本身仍会导致失败。
AI.method: DMM（去中心化Master-Mind）受扩散模型去噪启发，用离散、迭代式的动作意图精炼取代一次性采样：智能体初始化随机动作意图，通过多轮通信进行局部精炼，在最终承诺前耦合彼此选择。预训练采用专家MAPF解的模仿学习，随后用MICPO（一种面向多智能体多轮动作精炼的无critic组相对强化学习方法）进一步优化。
AI.result: DMM成功率更高、解成本更低。在1600个MovingAI任务上，经MICPO微调后解决1598个，覆盖率在所评估方法中最高，解成本接近最强基线。可扩展至障碍密集环境中超百万同时行动的智能体。
AI.conclusion: 轮级别的意图精炼能改善联合动作协调，同时保持去中心化执行。

title: Codoku: Renewable Program-Reasoning Challenges for Frontier Coding Agents
summary: Existing program-reasoning benchmarks ask large language models to predict a program's behavior on a given input. Coding agents break two assumptions on which these benchmarks rest: an agent can recover the answer by executing the program instead of reasoning about it, and fixed task sets drawn from existing programs are increasingly exposed to contamination, yet costly to renew. We introduce Codoku (code sudoku), a renewable benchmark in which a solver fills typed cells in a partial program to satisfy global static and dynamic constraints, such as a prescribed control-flow graph and execution path. Because a partial program cannot be executed and valid fillings are sparse in an exponentially large space of interdependent choices, neither tool use nor enumeration can substitute for program reasoning. Puzzles are synthesized from scratch via semantic reification, so fresh puzzles of controllable complexity can be generated on demand, each with a witness that guarantees solvability. We evaluate five frontier models on 300 puzzles through a coding agent free to use any tool within a fixed budget. Small puzzles already challenge open-weight models, whereas even proprietary models solve only about half of the large ones. Codoku thus offers a renewable testbed for program reasoning that can keep pace with rapidly improving coding agents. GitHub: https://github.com/connglli/Codoku.

AI.tldr: Codoku是一个可再生的程序推理基准，要求求解器填充部分程序中的类型化空格以满足全局静态与动态约束。它通过语义具化从头合成谜题，避免执行捷径和污染问题。
AI.motivation: 现有程序推理基准假设模型只能通过推理预测程序行为，但编码代理可通过执行程序直接得到答案，且固定的任务集容易被污染且更新成本高。这两个假设在编码代理时代不再成立。
AI.method: 提出Codoku（code sudoku）：求解器在部分程序中填充类型化空格，满足规定的控制流图和执行路径等全局静态与动态约束。部分程序无法被执行，且有效填法在指数级相互依赖的选择空间中极为稀疏，因此工具使用和枚举都无法替代程序推理。谜题通过语义具化从零合成，可动态生成复杂度可控的新谜题，并附带保证可解性的见证。
AI.result: 在300个谜题上评测五个前沿模型，编码代理可在固定预算内使用任意工具。小型谜题已能挑战开源权重模型，而即使是专有模型也仅能解出约一半的大型谜题。
AI.conclusion: Codoku为程序推理提供了一个可再生测试平台，能够跟上快速改进的编码代理的发展。代码已开源。

title: Generalization and Memorization along the Learning Trajectory of Neural Language Models: A Geometric Account of Categorization
comment: 5 figures in main text, 9 page main text
summary: We investigate how generalization and memorization develop along the learning trajectory of neural language models. Using controlled synthetic grammars, we examine both the geometry of representation space and model behaviour over training. We find that continuous regions of representation space not occupied by observed tokens become systematically structured from the earliest stages of learning, forming category-level geometric organization that supports generalization to unattested combinations. Generalization therefore emerges from the beginning of learning rather than only after extensive memorization. With prolonged training, larger models increasingly distinguish observed from unobserved grammatical combinations. At the same time, the continuous geometric structure supporting category-level generalization is gradually destructed. Together, these results suggest that neural language models initially learn through categorization-based generalization, followed by a gradual transition toward more exemplar-specific memorization.

AI.tldr: 神经语言模型的泛化能力从学习初期即已出现，随训练进行逐步从基于类别的泛化转向样例特定的记忆。
AI.motivation: 探究神经语言模型在学习过程中泛化与记忆如何发展，厘清二者是先后还是并行的关系。
AI.method: 使用受控的合成语法，考察训练过程中表示空间的几何结构与模型行为。
AI.result: 未被观测词元占据的表示空间连续区域从学习最早期即形成类别级几何组织，支持对未见组合的泛化；延长训练后大模型更能区分已见与未见语法组合，但此几何结构逐渐被破坏。
AI.conclusion: 模型初期通过基于类别的泛化学习，随后逐渐转变为更依赖样例的记忆。

title: Cross-Dataset Generalization of Bangladeshi Rice Leaf Disease Classifiers: Benchmark, Diagnosis, and Mitigation
summary: Cross-dataset transfer in rice leaf disease classification remains a significant challenge, with models trained on one image collection performing substantially worse when deployed on another. We conduct a systematic benchmark across three Bangladeshi rice leaf disease datasets (5,419 images, 6 transfer pairs, 3 CNN backbones, 3 random seeds) to characterize and diagnose this failure. Strong augmentation recovers a mean cross-dataset macro-F1 improvement of +0.070 (Wilcoxon p < 0.001, 15 of 18 transfer pairs positive). Removing non-leaf image content via segmentation shows directional benefit (mean +0.066, p = 0.062, n = 36 paired observations) that is consistent across two independent segmentation methods but does not reach conventional significance. A self-supervised ViT control (DINOv2 linear probe) exhibits equivalent cross-dataset collapse to CNNs, ruling out architecture inductive bias as the primary driver and pointing to acquisition-condition shift. Adaptive batch normalization uniformly harms transfer performance, with harm magnitude correlating with source-target label-prior divergence and model depth (Spearman rho = 0.621, p = 0.009). Grad-CAM attribution analysis on 12 sampled predictions does not distinguish correct from incorrect cross-domain predictions (p = 0.462), indicating that common attribution proxies are insufficient for diagnosing shift at practical sample sizes. We document all frozen results, prespecified analysis criteria, and reproducibility artifacts in a public repository with SHA-256 integrity verification. This work establishes a rigorous empirical baseline for understanding cross-dataset generalization in agricultural computer vision and identifies both effective (augmentation) and ineffective (AdaBN) adaptation strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文对孟加拉国水稻叶病分类的跨数据集迁移进行系统基准测试（5,419张图像、6组迁移对、3种CNN骨干、3个随机种子），刻画并诊断性能崩溃，识别有效（强增强）与无效（AdaBN）的适应策略。
AI.motivation: 跨数据集迁移在水稻叶病分类中表现很差，模型在一个采集数据上训练后在另一数据集上性能显著下降，其失败机制尚不清楚，缺乏严格的经验基准与诊断。
AI.method: 构建三类孟加拉水稻叶病数据集的系统性基准（6组迁移对、3种CNN骨干、3个随机种子）；评估强增强、分割去除非叶片内容（两种独立方法）、DINOv2自监督ViT线性探针对照、自适应批归一化（AdaBN）、Grad-CAM归因分析；采用Wilcoxon检验、Spearman相关；公开冻结结果、预设分析标准与SHA-256校验的可复现工件。
AI.result: 强增强平均提升跨数据集macro-F1 +0.070（p<0.001，18对中15对为正）；分割有方向性收益（+0.066，p=0.062，n=36），两种方法一致但未达显著；DINOv2线性探针与CNN同样崩溃，排除架构归纳偏置为主因，指向采集条件偏移；AdaBN一致损害迁移，损害幅度与源-目标标签先验差异及模型深度相关（ρ=0.621，p=0.009）；Grad-CAM在12个样本上无法区分正确与错误跨域预测（p=0.462）。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为农业计算机视觉跨数据集泛化建立了严格的实证基线，表明强增强是有效适应策略，AdaBN无效，采集条件偏移而非架构是主因，常用归因代理不足以诊断小样本下的偏移。

title: A Benchmark for LLM's Understanding of Middle School and High School Science Topics
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into educational settings, yet educators lack robust, standards-aligned tools to evaluate their effectiveness in K-12 science contexts. Existing benchmarks predominantly assess general language or advanced scientific reasoning, leaving a critical gap in understanding LLMs' performance on content directly relevant to secondary science curricula. To address this gap, we developed a comprehensive NGSS-aligned benchmark for both middle and high school science using a rigorous synthetic data pipeline, multi-judge validation, and item-level psychometric analysis. Nine open-weight LLMs were systematically evaluated using this benchmark, indicating that several smaller, locally deployable models achieved high accuracy across diverse science domains and question types. Our findings indicate that model size did not consistently predict performance, emphasizing the importance of intentional model selection for educational deployment. We then incorporated a human reviewer into the loop, reviewing the items generated by the LLMs for alignment with NGSS standards. The human review indicated that synthetically generated items were not in perfect alignment with the NGSS standards, indicating the benefits of human-in-the-loop item development, the need to explore the intersection of content and pedagogical knowledge, and the need to extend benchmarks to evaluate LLMs' capacity for interactive, evidence-based feedback in educational scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文针对K-12科学教育缺乏标准对齐的LLM评测工具，构建了NGSS对齐的初高中科学基准，对9个开源权重LLM进行系统评估，发现小模型也能高准确率，模型大小不能预测性能；人工复核显示合成题目与NGSS标准未完全对齐，强调人机协同与拓展交互式反馈评测的必要性。
AI.motivation: LLM increasingly used in K-12 science education, but educators lack robust, standards-aligned evaluation tools. Existing benchmarks focus on general language or advanced scientific reasoning, missing content directly relevant to secondary science curricula.
AI.method: Developed a comprehensive NGSS-aligned benchmark for middle and high school science using a rigorous synthetic data pipeline, multi-judge validation, and item-level psychometric analysis. Systematically evaluated nine open-weight LLMs, then added human-in-the-loop review of LLM-generated items for NGSS alignment.
AI.result: Several smaller, locally deployable models achieved high accuracy across diverse science domains and question types; model size did not consistently predict performance. Human review revealed synthetically generated items were not in perfect alignment with NGSS standards.
AI.conclusion: Findings emphasize intentional model selection for educational deployment and the benefits of human-in-the-loop item development. Future work should explore the intersection of content and pedagogical knowledge and extend benchmarks to evaluate LLMs' capacity for interactive, evidence-based feedback in educational scenarios.

title: When Ambiguity Meets Atypicality: Dual-Perspective Test Input Prioritization for DNNs
summary: While Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have achieved remarkable progress in cutting-edge domains, their inherent brittleness has become a growing concern. To ensure the reliability and safety of DNN-enabled software, DNN testing has emerged as an indispensable practice. Within this context, test input prioritization is essential for early fault detection and reducing labeling costs. However, it remains challenging to accurately identify failure-inducing inputs. Although decision ambiguity and distributional atypicality are two widely adopted perspectives for characterizing inter-class competition and intra-class typicality respectively, relying on either perspective in isolation inevitably introduces blind spots. In this paper, we propose DuFP (Dual perspective Feature space Prioritization), a KNN density-based test input prioritization approach for DNNs that jointly incorporates both inter-class and intra-class perspectives. The prioritization framework of DuFP is built upon class-conditional density estimation. Based on the estimation results, prediction correctness is characterized by an ambiguity score and an atypicality score, with the former reflecting decision ambiguity and the latter quantifying distributional atypicality. A hybrid uncertainty score is then constructed by integrating both scores to guide the final prioritization. We evaluate DuFP on prioritization and selection tasks across image and text datasets under clean, corrupted, and adversarial scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate that DuFP effectively and efficiently prioritizes fault-inducing inputs and outperforms state-of-the-art approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出DuFP，一种基于KNN密度、融合类间与类内双视角的DNN测试输入优先级排序方法。
AI.motivation: DNN脆弱性带来安全隐患，测试输入优先级排序可助早期发现错误、降低标注成本，但准确识别导致失败的输入仍具挑战；仅用决策模糊性或分布非典型性单一视角存在盲区。
AI.method: 基于类条件密度估计构建排序框架，由估计结果计算模糊性得分（反映类间竞争）与非典型性得分（反映类内典型性），融合成混合不确定性得分指导最终排序。
AI.result: 在图像与文本数据集上，于干净、损坏和对抗场景下开展优先级排序与选择任务评估，DuFP高效且有效地优先发现故障输入，性能优于现有最优方法。
AI.conclusion: 联合类间与类内双视角可更准确识别故障输入，DuFP为DNN测试输入优先级排序提供了有效且高效的解决方案。

title: A model of rational interlocutors: Unification of comprehension and production
comment: A computational model of partner modeling in language comprehension and production. 62 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables, including supplementary materials
summary: Who we communicate with influences both our interpretation of their utterances and the design of our own. Such adjustment to the conversational partner is studied as speaker modeling in comprehension and as audience design in production, with the two literatures having developed largely separately. We argue that both adjustments express one rational computation and propose the rational interlocutor (RI) model, a computational account unifying comprehension and production. An interlocutor maintains a model of their partner, defined by three parameters: an identity parameter Π sets the messages and forms expected from the partner; a fidelity parameter Φ sets how reliably messages and utterances map onto each other for them; a knowledge parameter Λ sets how knowledgeable the partner is believed to be. Comprehension and production are thus mirror-image modes of one computation over the partner model. Comprehension chooses the message the partner most likely intends to convey, weighing how well each candidate fits the utterance against how likely this partner is to mean it. Production chooses the utterance from which the partner will best recover the message, weighed against the effort of saying it. This explains why comprehenders appear to rely less on the forms produced by a linguistically less competent speaker, while producers tend to invest more effort in designing forms for them. We conjecture that perceived linguistic competence decomposes into two of these quantities: fidelity and knowledge. Their contrasting profiles across second-language (L2) adults, children, and artificial partners produce distinct and testable predictions.

AI.tldr: 提出理性对话者(RI)模型，用统一的计算框架解释理解中的说话者建模与产出中的受众设计。
AI.motivation: 理解与产出领域各自研究对话者调整（说话者建模 vs. 受众设计），但两条文献长期分离，缺乏统一解释。
AI.method: RI模型为对话者建立由三参数组成的伙伴模型：身份参数Π（设定预期信息与形式）、保真度参数Φ（消息与话语映射的可靠性）、知识参数Λ（伙伴的知识水平）；理解与产出是同一计算的两个镜像模式。
AI.result: 理解选择伙伴最可能意图传达的消息，权衡候选与话语的契合度；产出选择能让伙伴最好复原消息的话语，并权衡表达努力。这解释了为何对语言能力较弱的说话者，听者更少依赖其形式，而说话者反而投入更多精力设计形式。
AI.conclusion: 推测感知语言能力可分解为保真度与知识两个量，其在二语成人、儿童和人工伙伴上的不同表现可产生可检验的预测。

title: Statistical Testing for Multiple Instance Learning via Selective Inference with Applications to Computational Pathology
summary: Multiple instance learning (MIL) is widely used in computational pathology because it enables weakly supervised analysis of whole-slide images (WSIs) without requiring patch-level annotations. In attention-based MIL, instances with high attention scores are often interpreted as diagnostically important regions and used as visual explanations. However, attention scores alone cannot determine whether selected high-attention instances are significantly different from normal instances, limiting the reliability of attention-based explanations. In this paper, we formulate the evaluation of high-attention instances as a statistical hypothesis testing problem. Specifically, we assess whether a selected high-attention instance significantly deviates from a representative normal reference instance selected based on feature similarity. A major challenge is that both the target instance and the reference instance are selected through data-dependent procedures, rendering standard hypothesis testing invalid. To address this issue, we introduce a selective inference (SI) framework that explicitly accounts for the selection events induced by attention-based instance selection and adaptive reference selection, thereby enabling the computation of valid selective $p$-values conditional on these events. Experiments demonstrate Type-I error control on synthetic and MNIST-based data and practical applicability to pathological WSIs, with higher statistical power than the conventional over-conditioning approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用选择性推断框架评估注意力MIL中高注意力实例是否显著偏离正常参考实例，解决了双重数据依赖选择导致的假设检验失效问题。
AI.motivation: 注意力MIL中高注意力实例常被当作诊断重要区域作为可解释性依据，但仅凭注意力分数无法判断这些实例是否显著异于正常实例，限制了可解释性的可靠性。
AI.method: 将高注意力实例的评估建模为统计假设检验问题，检验目标实例是否显著偏离基于特征相似度选出的代表性正常参考实例；针对目标与参考实例均经数据依赖过程选出、标准检验失效的难题，引入选择性推断框架，显式刻画注意力实例选择与自适应参考选择带来的选择事件，从而计算条件于这些事件的有效选择性p值。
AI.result: 在合成数据和MNIST数据上实现了Type-I错误控制，并在病理WSI上验证了实用性，统计功效高于传统over-conditioning方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将选择性推断引入注意力MIL可解释性评估，为高注意力实例提供了有统计保证的显著性检验，提升了病理图像视觉解释的可靠性。

title: Reasoning Concentrates Errors, and Self-Consistency Never Notices
summary: Self-consistency assumes that independent samples disagree when a model is unsure, so agreement is evidence of correctness. Holding weights fixed and toggling only a reasoning mode, over five benchmarks and 74,944 samples, we show that reasoning concentrates a model's errors: the probability that two independently drawn wrong answers coincide rises in all ten dataset-scale comparisons (p = 0.00098), and in nine of nine after restricting both arms to the problems each gets wrong. Where the answer space is unbounded, reasoning cuts the distinct answers produced to 0.43-0.65 of the non-reasoning count; where it is bounded, both arms hold an identical option set and reasoning concentrates mass on it instead, which no positional prior can explain at fixed weights. The aggregate cost is smaller than the mechanism predicts, because reasoning also shrinks the set of problems where answer diversity can decide anything, in ten of ten cells and by 2.7x; normalized for available headroom, both arms convert a quarter of it in domain. Confidence weighting does not recover what is left. Across 280 method-dataset-model combinations on eight models and five benchmarks, not one beats plain majority voting after correction; weighted voting agrees with it on 98.5% of problem-method pairs and is right 56.3% of the time on the rest; and a signal's direction can invert within fixed weights, with answer log-probability predicting correctness when reasoning is off and error when it is on. A learned six-signal combination gains nothing out of domain. Confidence signals should be evaluated on decisions, not on discrimination.

AI.tldr: 论文挑战自一致性假设：在固定权重下仅切换推理模式，发现在五个基准、74,944样本上推理会集中模型错误，而非增强独立正确性，且置信度加权无法超越普通多数投票。
AI.motivation: 自一致性假设独立样本在模型不确定时会分歧，因此答案一致即为正确证据。论文旨在检验推理模式是否真能增强这种"一致性即正确"的信号，还是反而使错误更集中。
AI.method: 固定权重、仅切换推理模式（关/开），在5个基准、74,944个样本上对比；统计错误答案重合概率、不同答案数量、答案空间有界/无界情形、可用多样性空间；并在8个模型、5个基准、280个方法-数据集-模型组合上比较置信度加权与普通多数投票，含学习型六信号组合与域外测试。
AI.result: 推理在10/10数据集-规模比较中提高两个独立错误答案重合概率（p=0.00098），9/9问题级也如此。无界答案空间下，推理将不同答案数降至非推理的0.43-0.65；有界时两臂选项集相同但推理集中质量，位置先验在固定权重下无法解释。可用多样性空间在10/10单元缩小2.7倍，归一化后两臂仅转化四分之一headroom，置信度加权无法挽回。280个组合无一在校正后胜过普通多数投票；加权投票在98.5%问题-方法对上与之一致，其余仅56.3%正确；信号方向可在固定权重内反转（log-prob在推理关时预测正确、开时预测错误），学习型六信号组合域外无增益。
AI.conclusion: 推理并未增强自一致性所依赖的独立性，反而集中错误、压缩答案多样性空间。置信度信号应在决策层面评估而非区分度层面；固定权重下信号方向甚至可反转。

title: Multi-SWT-Bench: A Multilingual Benchmark for Reproduction Test Generation
summary: Reproduction test generation translates a natural-language issue description into executable tests that fail on the original code and pass after the issue is resolved, providing executable evidence for verifying candidate patches. Existing benchmarks are constructed for individual programming languages, preventing a unified evaluation across diverse programming ecosystems. To address this limitation, we introduce MULTI-SWT-BENCH, a multilingual benchmark for reproduction test generation consisting of 1,963 instances across eight programming languages: Python, Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Rust, C, and C++. Using this benchmark, we conduct an empirical study of state-of-the-art LLMs with four representative methods (MSWE-agent, MOpenHands, Codex, and Claude Code) and perform a failure analysis across programming languages. Our evaluation reveals a systematic language gap. Across every evaluated method and LLM, the success rate on Python exceeds the aggregate success rate across all languages, while C++ exhibits particularly low success rates. Our failure analysis identifies both language-specific challenges arising from repository testing conventions and cross-language challenges in inferring implicit setup requirements and preserving the target behavior through iterative revisions. These findings demonstrate the importance of multilingual evaluation and provide actionable directions for developing reproduction test generation methods that generalize across software ecosystems and reliably capture issue-specific behavior.

AI.tldr: 论文提出多语言复现测试生成基准 MULTI-SWT-BENCH，包含 8 种语言 1,963 个实例，揭示现有 LLM 方法存在系统性语言差距。
AI.motivation: 现有复现测试生成基准仅针对单一编程语言，无法跨生态统一评估，难以反映方法在多样语言环境下的泛化能力。
AI.method: 构建涵盖 Python、Java、TypeScript、JavaScript、Go、Rust、C、C++ 八种语言、共 1,963 个实例的 MULTI-SWT-BENCH 基准；对四种代表性方法（MSWE-agent、MOpenHands、Codex、Claude Code）与主流 LLM 进行实证研究与跨语言失败分析。
AI.result: 发现系统性语言差距：所有方法与 LLM 在 Python 上的成功率均高于总体平均，C++ 成功率尤其低。失败原因包括语言特定的仓库测试惯例，以及跨语言的隐式环境推断与迭代修订中保持目标行为的难题。
AI.conclusion: 多语言评估至关重要，为开发能跨软件生态泛化、可靠捕捉问题特定行为的复现测试生成方法提供了可行方向。

title: OptiArena: Can LLMs Improve Executable Algorithms under Fixed Resource Budgets?
summary: Static QA and code-generation benchmarks only partially capture the role that large language models (LLMs) now play as coding agents and research tools. We introduce OptiArena, a budget-controlled testbed for studying whether LLMs can improve executable game-playing algorithms through five rounds of code edits within a fixed minimal scaffold and under bounded evaluator feedback and fixed resource budgets. The testbed uses two optimization regimes, surface obfuscation controls, calibrated references, held-out/stress splits, and diagnostics for degradation and exceptional failures, with LLM API cost reported separately from local evaluator wall-clock. The empirical study asks three questions: whether models can close the calibrated gap between a designated weak starter and an editable competent baseline, whether they can refine editable competent baselines without damaging them, and whether gains survive surface obfuscation controls. Across twelve frontier LLMs and five games, models improve designated weak starters more consistently than they refine editable competent baselines, with substantial variation across games and models. OptiArena provides a practical testbed for measuring bounded-resource algorithm optimization within the five-edit, fixed-scaffold setting studied here. Code is available at https://github.com/WJ-Peng/OptiArena.

AI.tldr: 提出OptiArena，一个预算受控的测试平台，研究LLM能否在固定脚手架、有限反馈和五轮代码编辑下改进可执行的博弈算法。
AI.motivation: 静态QA和代码生成基准只能部分反映LLM作为编码智能体和研究工具的角色，需要更有界的、动态的评测手段。
AI.method: 构建OptiArena测试床：固定最小脚手架、限定评估反馈和资源预算、五轮代码编辑；设两种优化机制、表面混淆控制、校准参考、留出/压力集，以及退化与异常失败诊断；LLM API成本与本地评估墙钟时间分开报告。研究三个问题：能否缩小弱起点与可编辑强基线的校准差距、能否在不损害强基线的条件下改进它、增益能否经受表面混淆。共12个前沿LLM、5个游戏。
AI.result: 模型改进指定弱起点比精炼可编辑强基线更一致，且游戏与模型间差异显著。
AI.conclusion: OptiArena为在五轮编辑、固定脚手架场景下测量受限资源的算法优化提供了实用测试平台，代码已开源。

title: Agentic Video Understanding: A Survey
summary: As large language models (LLMs) become capable of processing increasingly diverse modalities and longer temporal contexts, an emerging line of work is moving beyond fixed video-language inference toward agentic systems that actively decide what information to inspect, retain, verify, and act upon. This survey reviews video understanding agents: systems that use video as the primary information source and solve understanding tasks through adaptive state construction and action selection. We first formalize an agent loop for video understanding, then address a central question: why do agents matter for video understanding? To answer this, we organize the literature through a challenge-to-design taxonomy, linking context bottlenecks to hierarchical evidence memory, evidence sparsity to active evidence acquisition, temporal causality to state and process tracking, and multimodal ambiguity to role-specialized coordination. We further review state space paradigms, learning paradigms, supervision signals, benchmarks, and evaluation protocols. Finally, we identify open directions toward agentic-native temporal modeling and video-native agents. Project page: https://github.com/DXY0711/Awesome-Agentic-Video-Understanding

AI.tldr: 本综述系统梳理了"视频理解智能体"这一新兴方向，通过挑战-设计分类法组织文献，涵盖状态空间、学习范式、监督信号与评测协议，并展望未来方向。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型能力增强，视频理解正从固定的视频-语言推理转向能主动决定检查、保留、验证和行动信息的智能体系统，亟需系统化综述。
AI.method: 先形式化视频理解的智能体循环，再通过"挑战-设计"分类法组织文献：将上下文瓶颈对应层级证据记忆、证据稀疏对应主动证据获取、时序因果对应状态与过程跟踪、多模态歧义对应角色专门化协作；并综述状态空间、学习范式、监督信号、基准与评测协议。
AI.result: 建立了统一的智能体循环框架与挑战-设计映射，系统归纳了现有方法的状态空间、学习范式和评估体系。
AI.conclusion: 提出面向智能体原生时序建模和视频原生智能体的开放研究方向，并维护项目页面以汇总资源。

title: Receiver-Conditioned Latent Communication gives 94% CacheBack
summary: Multi-agent systems distribute large contexts across agents that communicate to solve a task. Text messages are compact but require decoding and may omit evidence the receiving agent needs. Recent latent communication instead transfers KV caches. This avoids text generation and can improve accuracy and latency. However, a full KV cache grows linearly with both the context an individual agent processes, and the number of agents that coordinate together. This raises memory and context costs, often far exceeding available GPU resources and context window sizes. Our key observation is that agents need only send what the receiving agent requires for its local task -- which we call receiver-conditioned communication. The receiver agent passes the sender a small description of its information needs, which serves to filter and compress the sender agent's KV cache. CacheBack is a simple, robust, training-free instance of receiver conditioning based on the sender's attention weights. On FanOutQA, CacheBack with Qwen 3 removes 75% of the state the agent would otherwise receive, improving accuracy by 14.7 percentage points and reducing median task-completion latency by 3.2x relative to text communication. We show comparable improvements across model families that span dense Transformers, Mamba-attention hybrids, and sliding-window attention.

AI.tldr: 提出 CacheBack，一种免训练、基于接收方条件的 KV cache 压缩通信方法，通过接收方需求过滤发送方状态，显著降低多智能体系统的内存与延迟并提升精度。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统需跨智能体分布大上下文并通信。文本消息紧凑但需解码且可能丢失接收方所需证据；近期潜在通信直接传输 KV cache，可免去文本生成并提升精度与延迟。但完整 KV cache 随单智能体处理的上下文和协同智能体数量线性增长，导致内存与上下文开销远超 GPU 资源和上下文窗口限制。
AI.method: 核心观察：智能体只需发送接收方本地任务所需信息，即"接收方条件通信"。接收方将自身信息需求的小描述传给发送方，用于过滤和压缩发送方的 KV cache。CacheBack 是基于发送方注意力权重的简单、鲁棒、免训练的接收方条件实例。
AI.result: 在 FanOutQA 上，CacheBack 配合 Qwen 3 移除发送方原本会接收的 75% 状态，精度提升 14.7 个百分点，相比文本通信中位任务完成延迟降低 3.2 倍。在稠密 Transformer、Mamba-attention 混合及滑动窗口注意力等多种模型家族上均有可比改进。
AI.conclusion: 接收方条件通信能有效压缩 KV cache 通信，CacheBack 以简单免训练方式在多个模型架构上同时实现内存节省、精度提升和延迟降低，为多智能体潜在通信提供了实用方案。

title: TraceLib: System-Call Bitmap Feedback Mechanism for Language-Agnostic Web Fuzzing
summary:
Coverage feedback is an important source of guidance for fuzzing. However, obtaining such feedback normally requires application-level instrumentation that is specific to the language and runtime of the application. Given that modern web applications span multiple languages and runtimes, this application-level instrumentation is costly to implement and maintain. Therefore, we present TraceLib, a system-call feedback mechanism for enabling language-agnostic web fuzzing. Our proposed approach observes the transitions of system calls, enriches selected transitions with bounded argument hashes, and converts them into a 65,536-position AFL-like bitmap. By using the generated bitmap, any web fuzzer can decide whether to retain requests that add previously unseen bitmap positions without consulting application code coverage.
  We integrate TraceLib into WebFuzz and evaluate it under five WebFuzz feedback modes: the two proposed TraceLib variants (one over every traced system call and one projected onto monitored file paths and recognized SQL buffers), the N-gram comparator adapted from Xiao et al. representing the most recent work to our knowledge, WebFuzz's Native grey-box feedback, and black-box fuzzing without feedback. We evaluate TraceLib on sixteen web applications under test (WUTs): eight PHP applications and eight further applications spanning Node.js, Ruby, Java, Go, and Python to demonstrate platform portability. The results show that our proposed TraceLib projected exceeds black-box on all eight PHP WUTs while exceeding Native on four: Joomla, Drupal, PrestaShop, and Bagisto. In addition, measured on an identical replayed request workload, the tracer costs approximately one millisecond of server-side latency per request. These results indicate that compact system-call feedback is a useful runtime-independent proxy for coverage guidance.

AI.tldr: TraceLib 提出基于系统调用反馈的语言无关 Web 模糊测试机制，将系统调用转换扩充为 AFL 式位图，集成到 WebFuzz 后在多个 Web 应用上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 覆盖反馈依赖应用级插桩，而现代 Web 应用跨多语言和运行时，插桩成本高且难维护，因此需要语言无关的反馈机制。
AI.method: 观察系统调用的转换，对选定转换加入有界参数哈希，转换为 65,536 位的 AFL 式位图；任何 Web 模糊器据此判断是否保留产生新位图位置的请求。集成到 WebFuzz，并设计两个 TraceLib 变体（一个覆盖所有追踪系统调用，一个投影到监控文件路径与识别的 SQL 缓冲区）。
AI.result: 在 16 个 Web 应用（8 个 PHP 及 Node.js、Ruby、Java、Go、Python 等 8 个）上评估五种反馈模式。TraceLib projected 在全部 8 个 PHP 应用上优于黑盒，在 Joomla、Drupal、PrestaShop、Bagisto 上优于 Native。相同重放请求负载下追踪器每请求约 1 毫秒服务端延迟。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的系统调用反馈可作为运行时无关的覆盖引导代理，具有实用价值。

title: KinyaMed: Seeds, Not Rows -- What a Corpus Requirement Written in the Wrong Unit Fails to Constrain
comment: 34 pages, 10 tables, 1 figure. Negative-results and methodology paper; no model performance claims are made
summary: Triage decides who is seen first. Building an urgency classifier for patient-voice Kinyarwanda, we found our specification could be met without producing anything it was meant to secure. We report that, and the instruments that detect it, instead of a classifier. Designed for the four languages a Rwandan health centre receives, with every instrument per-language: sentences are authored in all four arms and rows generate in one, because the frame slots those three need do not exist. Our requirement asked for one million examples; generation produced them in 130 seconds. It fails four of the nine quality gates in that specification, six when rows are attributed to their source sentence. The binding gate counts distinct authored seed phrases, not rows: at our 165, no corpus passes at any row count. Two shortfalls follow and differ: 2,835 further sentences to pass the seed-count gate, 19,835 to reach the stated million rows, because a separate gate caps a seed at 50 rows. Rows come from a machine at 7,700 per second; seeds from clinicians. A row count constrains the cheap quantity, leaves the expensive one free, and so does not constrain quality at all. Two further negatives follow. An evaluation set of 17,942 rows built from nine distinct sentences supports no verdict: our gate, which counts distinct sentences, refuses 38 of its cells and reports nothing. A model trained on a corpus of uniform surface form changes its predicted urgency for 31.5% of inputs under capitalisation and 21.0% under a single typo, reported as measurement and not attribution. A model directory shipped without its tokenizer loads without error and answers its class prior on input it cannot read, with well-formed probabilities. No figure here is evidence of model quality; the contribution is the apparatus and the negative results it produced, reproducible from a clean clone except where marked NOT REPRODUCIBLE.

AI.tldr: 本文报告的是检测医疗分诊分类器规格缺陷的工具与负面结果，而非分类器本身：作者为卢旺达语等四种语言构建数据生成流程，发现行数达标不代表质量达标（受限于不同的种子短语数量），并揭示评估集、模型稳健性与部署的多个失效点。
AI.motivation: 为卢旺达某健康中心接收的四种语言构建患者语音分诊紧急度分类器，要求生成100万条样本。但作者发现规格可在"未产出其本应保障之物"的情况下被满足，因此转而报告这一现象及检测工具。
AI.method: 按语言分别设计工具：句子在四语种下撰写，但仅单语种生成数据行（因另三种语言所需框架槽位缺失）。用机器生成数据（每秒7,700行），并设置九项质量门控（含种子短语计数、每种子50行上限等）进行检验，同时构建评估集并测试模型对大小写、错字的稳健性及无tokenizer目录的加载行为。
AI.result: 130秒生成100万样本，但未通过9项门控中的4项（按来源句归属时6项）。约束门控统计的是不同撰写种子短语数（仅165），任何行数下语料均不合格。差距分化：需补2,835句过种子门控，补19,835句达百万行。由9句构成的17,942行评估集无效，门控拒绝其中38个单元。模型在大小写变化下31.5%输入改变预测，单处错字下21.0%。缺失tokenizer的模型目录无报错加载并输出无法读取输入上的类先验概率。
AI.conclusion: 行数约束的是廉价量（机器生成行），放开昂贵量（临床医生撰写种子），因此根本不约束质量。本文无任何数字能作为模型质量证据；贡献在于该检测装置及其产生的负面结果，除标注"NOT REPRODUCIBLE"处外均可从干净克隆复现。

title: OmniFysics-Captioner Technical Report: Grounding Omni-Modal Understanding in the Physical World for Better Captioning
summary: Building omni-modal models with physical intelligence requires fine-grained supervision that captures physical evidence such as contact, support, deformation, and state transitions. However, existing omni-modal captioners primarily model general audiovisual semantics and often overlook transient or spatially localized physical evidence. We present a unified framework for physics-aware audiovisual captioning spanning data construction, training, and evaluation. Firstly, we build a data construction pipeline that identifies physics-rich clips and leverages OmniFysics-Agent to coordinate audio, visual, and physical-perception tools for collecting spatiotemporally aligned and traceable cross-modal evidence; within the Agent, a physical perception model (PPM) fine-tuned on approximately 2M image-level samples serves as a dedicated tool for extracting object-interaction and state-change cues. Secondly, we build the Daily-Physics 50K dataset and introduce the evidence-driven OmniPhysCap (OPC) benchmark to evaluate the recovery of physical and cross-modal evidence from generated captions. Finally, we train OmniFysics-Captioner from the resulting data. Our Captioner matches Gemini 3.1 Pro on audiovisual captioning, achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple video-captioning benchmarks, and substantially outperforms other open-source models. Ablations show that PPM evidence improves physical coverage and produces finer-grained, more reliable cross-modal descriptions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个物理感知的音视频字幕统一框架，涵盖数据构建、训练与评估，训练出可与Gemini 3.1 Pro媲美的OmniFysics-Captioner。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态字幕模型主要建模通用视听语义，忽略了接触、支撑、形变、状态转移等细微或局部化的物理证据，难以支撑具有物理智能的全模态模型。
AI.method: 构建物理丰富片段识别与数据构建流水线，通过OmniFysics-Agent协调音频、视觉与物理感知工具采集时空对齐、可追溯的跨模态证据；其中物理感知模型(PPM)基于约200万图像级样本微调，用于提取物体交互与状态变化线索；并引入Daily-Physics 50K数据集与证据驱动的OmniPhysCap(OPC)基准。
AI.result: Captioner在音视频字幕任务上比肩Gemini 3.1 Pro，在多个视频字幕基准上取得SOTA，显著优于其他开源模型；消融表明PPM证据提升了物理覆盖度，生成更细粒度、更可靠的跨模态描述。
AI.conclusion: 统一的物理感知字幕框架与证据驱动评估能有效提升跨模态描述的物理覆盖与可靠性，为具身/物理智能提供更细粒度的监督信号。

title: EngramRAG: Dynamic Usage-Weighted Topology and Synaptic Consolidation for Multi-Hop Agentic Memory
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Code and reproduction suite: https://github.com/bpoti001/epigraph
summary: As autonomous LLM agents are deployed across multi-session environments, conventional memory architectures suffer from Associative Blindness (inability to traverse multi-hop relational dependencies), Scaffolding Amnesia (temporal decay evicting core persona invariants), and Static Topology Stagnation (immutable graphs ignoring usage dynamics). Grounded in Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) principles, we propose EngramRAG, an adaptive memory architecture coupling a low-latency Waking State reflex with an asynchronous background Dreaming State consolidation cycle. EngramRAG introduces: (1) Usage-Modulated Personalized PageRank (U-PPR), where transition probabilities adapt via Hebbian plasticity to promote persistent entities into high-centrality Epistemic Macro-Hubs; (2) Consolidation-Activated Topology Decay (CATD), which scales retention half-life by topological load-bearing weight rather than wall-clock recency, protected by a cold-start grace period (N_grace >= 4); (3) Directed SUPERSEDES DAG filtering to suppress obsolete state during fact mutations; and (4) Triple-source hybrid retrieval fusing dense vectors, BM25, and U-PPR via dynamic Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF). Evaluating on all 1,982 QA pairs across 10 long-term conversations in the LoCoMo benchmark, EngramRAG achieves +38.9% relative improvement in Recall@5 (53.21% vs. 38.29%, p < 0.001) and +43.1% in MRR (0.4203 vs. 0.2937) over dense vector RAG, significantly outperforming Okapi BM25 (48.66%) and isolated static graph retrieval (8.50%). On temporal reasoning, EngramRAG reaches 62.33% Recall@5 (+16.67 points over dense vectors). In controlled mutation tests, SUPERSEDES suppresses split-brain hallucinations from 70.0% to 0.0%, while 90-day simulations show 100.0% scaffolding retention under a 26.21ms interactive retrieval reflex.

AI.tldr: EngramRAG 是一种基于互补学习系统原理的自适应记忆架构，通过"清醒反射+梦境巩固"双状态机制解决 LLM 智能体多轮会话中的记忆问题，在 LoCoMo 基准上显著超越现有 RAG 方法。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体记忆架构存在三大缺陷：关联盲区（无法遍历多跳关系依赖）、遗忘核心（时间衰减驱逐人格不变量）、静态拓扑停滞（图结构忽视使用动态）。
AI.method: 提出 EngramRAG，耦合低延迟清醒反射与异步梦境巩固。含四项创新：(1) 使用度调制个性化 PageRank（U-PPR），转移概率经 Hebbian 可塑性自适应；(2) 巩固激活拓扑衰减（CATD），按拓扑承重而非时间决定保留半衰期，并设冷启动宽限期；(3) 有向 SUPERSEDES DAG 过滤抑制过时状态；(4) 三源混合检索融合稠密向量、BM25 与 U-PPR 的动态 RRF。
AI.result: 在 LoCoMo 全部 1,982 个 QA 对、10 段长期对话上：Recall@5 相对提升 +38.9%（53.21% vs 38.29%，p<0.001），MRR +43.1%（0.4203 vs 0.2937）；超越 BM25（48.66%）与静态图检索（8.50%）。时序推理 Recall@5 达 62.33%。突变测试中 SUPERSEDES 将分裂脑幻觉从 70.0% 降至 0.0%；90 天模拟实现 100% 脚手架保留，交互检索延迟 26.21ms。
AI.conclusion: EngramRAG 通过 CLS 启发的双状态自适应记忆架构，有效解决多会话环境下的关联、遗忘与拓扑停滞问题，在检索准确率、时序推理、事实突变鲁棒性及长期记忆保持上均显著优于稠密向量 RAG、BM25 与静态图方法。

title: Certified Compilation in the TELEPERM XS Nuclear Safety I&C Platform
summary: The large safety instrumentation & control (I&C) systems in civil nuclear power plants (NPPs) are mainly safe-shutdown systems (reactor protection) or limitation and control systems. Framatome's established TELEPERM XS (TXS Core) product family is a digital I&C system platform to cover all these applications. We illustrate the role of verification in the different stages of the software production toolchain, focus on the formal compilation process, and discuss the contribution of the CompCert certified compiler to the safety case of the product. Scrutinizing the object code produced by this compiler has exhibited suboptimal run-time performance in a certain simple but recurring generated code pattern. We explain how formal methods allow us to address this issue in the compiler while simultaneously reducing its trusted computing base (TCB), thereby strengthening the safety case rather than merely preserving it.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍Framatome核电站数字仪控平台TXS中形式化验证的作用，重点讨论CompCert认证编译器在安全论证中的贡献及通过形式化方法优化其生成代码性能、同时缩减可信计算基。
AI.motivation: 大型安全仪控系统对软件可靠性要求极高，需要形式化验证支撑安全论证；而CompCert编译生成的代码在某种常见模式下运行性能不佳，需在保证安全性的同时进行改进。
AI.method: 阐述软件生产工具链各阶段验证的作用，聚焦形式化编译过程；分析CompCert认证编译器对安全案例的贡献，并利用形式化方法针对性能欠佳的代码模式进行编译器改进。
AI.result: 通过形式化方法解决了CompCert生成代码的性能问题，同时缩小了可信计算基（TCB）。
AI.conclusion: 形式化方法不仅能修复编译器性能缺陷，还能增强而非仅仅维持产品的安全论证。

title: Solving Every Step Is Not Enough: Milestone Oracles Reveal a Composition Gap in LLM Math Reasoning
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). 47 pages. Code and data: https://github.com/slark-prime/OracleLadder
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can solve every intermediate step of a multi-step math problem on its own and still fail the full problem, even when given a roadmap of the steps and all of their answers. We introduce OracleLadder, a diagnostic evaluation that locates where LLM math reasoning fails by giving the model increasing levels of oracle help. For each problem, a teacher model writes a fixed roadmap of intermediate sub-goals (milestones), and a deterministic symbolic verifier grades every answer. Testing the model with no help, with the roadmap, with the roadmap plus the milestone answers, and on each milestone alone sorts each failure into one of five reasoning gaps. On 354 NuminaMath problems and six models from 8B to 671B parameters (Qwen3, gpt-oss, Llama 3.3, DeepSeek-V3.1), the largest gap for every model is the composition gap, a stricter form of the compositionality gap. It covers 33-48% of problems, and 24-37% after removing problems that an LLM review flags as grading errors. Accuracy and milestone-help recovery rank the two strongest models differently, and two RLVR runs with similar accuracy gains move problems differently. The roadmap effect replicates on MATH500 and AIME 2024/25, per-problem recovery agrees for 83-87% of problems under an independent second teacher, and the help ladder carries over to code generation. We release the data, roadmaps, prompts, and code at https://github.com/slark-prime/OracleLadder.

AI.tldr: 提出 OracleLadder 诊断评估，通过递进的 oracle 帮助定位 LLM 数学推理失败环节，发现"组合缺口"是各模型最大短板。
AI.motivation: LLM 即使能解出多步数学题的每个中间步骤，也能在给定步骤路线图和答案的情况下仍做错整题，需定位失败究竟发生在何处。
AI.method: 教师模型写出固定子目标（milestone）路线图，确定性符号验证器判分；以无帮助、仅路线图、路线图+答案、单步四种条件测试模型，将失败归为五类推理缺口。
AI.result: 在 354 道 NuminaMath 题、6 个 8B–671B 模型（Qwen3、gpt-oss、Llama 3.3、DeepSeek-V3.1）上，最大缺口为组合缺口，占 33–48%（剔除误判后 24–37%）；准确率与帮助恢复排名两强模型不一致；两次 RLVR 移动的问题不同。结论在 MATH500、AIME 2024/25 复现，83–87% 问题在第二教师下恢复一致，并迁移到代码生成。
AI.conclusion: 组合缺口是 LLM 数学推理的核心缺陷，需区别于准确率的新诊断指标；OracleLadder 数据、路线图、提示与代码已开源。

title: Fysiverse-3D-SimReady Technical Report: Agentic Physical Simulation for Pragmatic 3D World Reconstruction
summary: Agentic recognition requires visual perception to move beyond static scene understanding and produce structured scene representations that support the perception--reasoning--action loop. Existing single-image 3D generation methods, however, mainly produce visually plausible object assets rather than simulation-ready scene states. When independently generated meshes are composed in a shared space, they may fail to align with the input camera, violate gravity, interpenetrate nearby objects, or become unstable under physics simulation. We present Fysiverse-3D-SimReady, a grounded refinement framework for reconstructing simulation-ready multi-object scenes from a single RGB image with instance and ground prompts. The method places generated object meshes into a shared gravity-aligned scene, refines their camera-space poses through differentiable rendering, and corrects scene-level supports and contacts for stable physical execution. The scene is then used by an agentic simulation workflow, which converts a scene-specific task goal into an executable physics rollout rendered from the original camera view. Experiments show that Fysiverse-3D-SimReady improves input-view alignment, contact plausibility, and physical stability over existing single-image reconstruction and scene generation baselines, while enabling goal-conditioned physical interactions from a single image.

AI.tldr: 提出 Fysiverse-3D-SimReady 框架，从单张 RGB 图像重建可用于物理仿真的多物体 3D 场景，支持感知-推理-行动闭环。
AI.motivation: 现有单图像 3D 生成方法主要产出视觉上合理的物体资产，而非仿真就绪的场景状态；独立生成的网格组合后会出现与相机不对齐、违反重力、物体穿插或仿真不稳定等问题。
AI.method: 在重力对齐的共享场景中放置生成的物体网格，通过可微渲染细化其相机空间位姿，并修正场景级的支撑与接触关系以保证稳定物理执行；随后由智能体仿真流程将任务目标转化为可执行的物理仿真，并从原相机视角渲染。
AI.result: 在输入视角对齐、接触合理性、物理稳定性上优于现有单图像重建与场景生成基线，并实现从单张图像出发的目标条件物理交互。
AI.conclusion: 该方法实现了从单张 RGB 图像到仿真就绪场景的生成，为智能体视觉感知与物理交互提供了可行路径。

title: Contract monitoring: governing AI via separation of powers
summary: We propose an AI safety framework that binds worker agents to contracts specifying their permitted actions. We show how these contracts can be enforced and specified by assigning distinct responsibilities to monitor agents and judges, and asymmetric computational resources to monitors and workers. Our framework allows us to empirically measure statistical safety guarantees. The framework applies to a wide range of settings, including code security and escape-the-box scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出一种AI安全框架，通过合约约束worker agent的行为，并由monitor和judge分工执行，实现可度量的统计安全保证。
AI.motivation: AI agent能力增强后需要可靠的手段来约束其行为，防止越权或逃逸等风险。
AI.method: 将worker agent绑定到规定其允许动作的合约上；通过给monitor agent和judge分配不同职责、并给monitor与worker分配不对称的计算资源来执行和规约合约。
AI.result: 框架能够经验性地测量统计安全保证，适用于代码安全和escape-the-box等多种场景。
AI.conclusion: 合约+分工执行+资源不对称的设计为AI安全提供了一种可度量、通用性强的方案。

title: Verifying Graceful Degradation in a Distributed Malware-Detection System with SPIN
summary: Modern endpoint malware detection is distributed: a lightweight agent on each endpoint collects features from a scanned file or process, sends them to a remote server for analysis, and then enforces the returned verdict locally by blocking, quarantining, or disinfecting. Because the endpoint acts on the verdict, the distributed machinery surrounding detection must never turn a transient server failure into a wrong action. We present a formal model, in Promela, of the endpoint decision pipeline of such a system, abstracted from a production architecture at Bitdefender. The model captures the system's graceful-degradation fallback chain: when the primary analysis server times out, the endpoint falls back to an older legacy-protocol server, and failing that to a reduced-signature local scan, before enforcing a verdict. Assuming detection signatures are sound, we specify six safety and liveness properties in linear temporal logic (LTL) and verify them exhaustively with the SPIN model checker. We prove that the fallback machinery never causes a false positive (an enforcement action against a benign file), commits to exactly one verdict per scan even when timed-out responses arrive late, weakens detection strength only in an explicit and ordered way, and always terminates in an enforcement decision, so the pipeline is deadlock-free. Each property is checked to hold non-vacuously, and we report how the state space grows with concurrent scans and endpoints. The work shows how model checking can give strong correctness guarantees for the failure-handling logic of a production security system, a layer that has received little direct formal attention.

AI.tldr: 用 Promela 对 Bitdefender 端点恶意软件检测流水线建模，并以 SPIN 穷举验证六条 LTL 安全与活性性质。
AI.motivation: 分布式端点检测中，端点需依据服务器返回的判决执行阻断/隔离等操作，因此故障处理逻辑绝不能把瞬时服务器故障变成错误动作。而这一层很少受到形式化关注。
AI.method: 从生产架构抽象出端点决策流水线，用 Promela 建模其优雅降级回退链（主服务器超时→旧协议服务器→本地缩减签名扫描→执行判决），在假设签名可靠的前提下用 LTL 描述六条安全与活性性质，并用 SPIN 模型检查器穷举验证。
AI.result: 证明回退机制不会导致误报；即使超时响应迟到，每次扫描也只提交唯一判决；检测强度仅以显式且有序的方式削弱；总能终止于执行决策，故无死锁。每条性质均非空成立，并报告了状态空间随并发扫描与端点数增长的情况。
AI.conclusion: 表明模型检查可为生产安全系统的故障处理逻辑提供强正确性保证，填补了该层次缺乏直接形式化研究的空白。

title: LANTERN: Illuminating Hidden Mathematical Knowledge in Language Models
summary: Language models can now prove theorems, but people still decide which problems to pursue. We ask whether a model's internal representations can help identify promising mathematical connections. We develop LANTERN, a fast, cost-efficient pipeline that uses a classifier over pretrained-model activations to rank candidate relations, followed by staged filtering, hypothesis generation, executable verification, and analytical checking. Applied to the On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences (OEIS), LANTERN ranked 50 million pairs among 10,000 frequently referenced sequences and produced 62 verified relations between pairs without an existing OEIS cross-reference. A content screen retained 13 relations worth presenting; nine of these are informative or insightful, including four which are entirely novel to the best of our knowledge: none appears in the OEIS or in our targeted literature search. The entire end-to-end process including classifier training, candidate ranking, filtering and verification took under 8 hours.

AI.tldr: LANTERN利用预训练模型激活的分类器，快速筛选并验证OEIS中序列间的新关系，8小时内发现4个全新数学联系。
AI.motivation: 语言模型虽能证明定理，但研究方向仍由人决定。作者想探究模型内部表示能否帮助识别有潜力的数学联系。
AI.method: 提出LANTERN流程：基于预训练模型激活的分类器对候选关系排序，再经分阶段过滤、假设生成、可执行验证与分析性检查。
AI.result: 在OEIS的1万条高频序列中排序5000万对，产出62个尚无交叉引用的已验证关系；内容筛选保留13个值得展示的关系，其中9个有信息量或洞见，4个为完全新颖（OEIS及定向文献检索均未见）。
AI.conclusion: 模型内部表示可辅助发现数学联系，整个端到端流程（含训练、排序、过滤与验证）耗时不到8小时，高效且低成本。

title: PanOVOcc: Panoramic Embodied Open-Vocabulary Occupancy Mapping with Long-term Spatial Voxel Memory
comment: The source code and the established benchmarks will be available at https://github.com/bakereet/PanOVOcc
summary: Persistent semantic occupancy mapping is essential for embodied scene understanding. However, perspective-based systems provide limited spatial coverage, while existing panoramic methods primarily predict local volumes from single observations. We introduce PanOVOcc, a training-free framework for persistent open-vocabulary semantic occupancy mapping from panoramic sequences. PanOVOcc unifies panoramic SLAM, open-vocabulary perception, and long-term spatial voxel memory within an online architecture, continuously integrating geometric and semantic evidence into a global, language-queryable map. To facilitate systematic evaluation of this setting, we establish Pan-Replica and Pan-Holo360D, two benchmarks pairing continuous panoramic RGB-D sequences with scene-level semantic occupancy ground truth across synthetic and real-world scenes. Compared with the strongest evaluated baseline for each metric, PanOVOcc improves occupancy IoU and semantic mIoU by absolute +20.03 and +7.06 on Pan-Replica, and by +43.26 and +20.16 on Pan-Holo360D, respectively. The source code and the established benchmarks will be available at https://github.com/bakereet/PanOVOcc.

AI.tldr: PanOVOcc是首个免训练的全景开放词汇语义占据建图框架，统一全景SLAM、开放词汇感知与长期体素记忆。
AI.motivation: 实体场景理解需要持久语义占据建图，但透视系统空间覆盖有限，现有全景方法仅从单次观测预测局部体素。
AI.method: 提出免训练PanOVOcc框架，在线统一全景SLAM、开放词汇感知与长期空间体素记忆，将几何与语义证据持续融合进全局可语言查询地图；并建立Pan-Replica与Pan-Holo360D两个基准。
AI.result: 相比最强基线，PanOVOcc在Pan-Replica上占据IoU与语义mIoU分别绝对提升+20.03与+7.06；在Pan-Holo360D上分别提升+43.26与+20.16。
AI.conclusion: PanOVOcc实现持久开放词汇全景语义占据建图，性能显著优于现有方法，代码与基准将开源。

title: Toward Interactive Understanding of Code APIs
summary: Empowered by advances in Language Model agents, systems have made substantial strides in code generation and understanding. However, these approaches often rely on read access to the relevant code, an assumption which does not hold when dealing with external APIs. In this work, we introduce the PAU (Python API Understanding) benchmark, where we provide models with black-box, API-level access to code snippets. Models must query the API with exploratory inputs and draw insights from the resulting outputs, with the goal of describing the snippet's true functionality. By treating the code snippets as external tools that must be understood via interaction alone, PAU studies the more general problem of unsupervised tool understanding, specifically for tools implemented as Python methods. Despite recent progress in coding agents, even frontier models struggle to achieve high performance on PAU, with the best model (Claude-4-Opus) failing to understand over 45% of the PAU test set. An investigation into the common error modes reveals that models are overconfident; they often overrate the quality of their current hypothesis, leading to insufficient exploration and premature termination. Finally, we take inspiration from the Asymmetric Actor Critic (AAC) paradigm, frequently used in robot learning, to post-train models for interactive code understanding. Models trained with AAC conduct more active exploration of the APIs, with an AAC-tuned Qwen3-8B model matching the performance of GPT-5-mini.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAU基准，测试模型在黑盒API访问下理解Python代码片段功能的能力，发现即使前沿模型也表现不佳，主要因过度自信导致探索不足，并用非对称Actor-Critic方法改进。
AI.motivation: 现有代码生成/理解方法依赖对相关代码的读取权限，当面对外部API时这一假设不成立，因此需要研究仅通过交互理解黑盒工具的问题。
AI.method: 构建PAU基准：提供API级黑盒访问，模型需用探索性输入查询API并从输出推断代码片段真实功能。此外受机器人学习中Asymmetric Actor Critic (AAC)范式启发，对模型进行交互式代码理解的后训练。
AI.result: 即使前沿模型在PAU上仍困难，最佳模型Claude-4-Opus在测试集上超过45%的样本无法理解。错误分析显示模型过度自信，高估当前假设质量，导致探索不足和过早终止。AAC训练使模型更主动探索，AAC调优的Qwen3-8B可达到GPT-5-mini水平。
AI.conclusion: 黑盒交互式工具理解仍是难题，过度自信是关键障碍，AAC后训练能提升探索行为并显著改善性能，为无监督工具理解提供方向。

title: SmartMemory: Detecting On-chain-off-chain Communication Inconsistency for Smart Contract via Memory-based Agent
summary:
Smart contracts underpin decentralized finance, where growing demand for on-chain/off-chain communication(OFC) has driven diverse applications such as cross-chain bridges, real-world asset tokenization, and fiat-backed stablecoins. TheOFC-related security incidents in these applications are increasingly frequent, but prior studies address separate vulnerability categories within OFC applications rather than providing a unified view, causing vulnerabilities outside known patterns to be missed.In this paper, we identify OFC inconsistency (OFCI) as a root cause of OFC vulnerabilities, which arises from business-logic flaw and ultimately breaks the equivalence between the on-chain and off-chain asset representations to induce inconsistency.Automatically detecting OFCIs faces two challenges including (1)locating heterogeneous business logic, and (2) transferring existing vulnerability knowledge to identify unseen OFCI instances.
  To this end, we propose SmartMemory, the first framework to leverage a memory-based agent for OFCI detection. To address heterogeneity, SmartMemory maps diverse implementations ofOFC contracts into a canonical business-semantic representation to locate the business logic for OFCI inspection. For knowledge reuse, SmartMemory integrates a memory-based agent to distill vulnerability knowledge from features into patterns and detection rules, enabling knowledge transfer across cases to identify unseenOFCIs. Lastly, SmartMemory performs taint analysis to verify the reachability, type, and impact of each candidate OFCI. We construct the first real-world OFCI dataset comprising 48 DApps with 81 OFCIs for evaluation, on which SmartMemory achieves80.68% precision and 87.65% recall. In addition, through an analysis of 325 real-world OFC applications, SmartMemory detects 36 previously unknown OFCIs, all of which have been confirmed and fixed by corresponding parties.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SmartMemory，首个利用记忆型智能体检测链上/链下通信不一致（OFCI）的框架，在自建真实数据集上达到80.68%精确率和87.65%召回率，并发现36个此前未知漏洞。
AI.motivation: 链上/链下通信（OFC）应用（跨链桥、RWA代币化、稳定币等）安全事件频发，但已有研究仅针对分散的漏洞类别，缺乏统一视角，导致已知模式之外的漏洞被遗漏。作者将 OFC 不一致（OFCI）识别为这类漏洞的根本原因，源于业务逻辑缺陷，破坏链上链下资产表示的等价性。
AI.method: SmartMemory 框架：1）将异构 OFC 合约映射为规范化业务语义表示，以定位业务逻辑；2）集成记忆型智能体，从特征中提炼漏洞知识为模式与检测规则，实现跨案例知识迁移以识别未见过的 OFCI；3）通过污点分析验证每个候选 OFCI 的可达性、类型与影响。
AI.result: 构建首个真实世界 OFCI 数据集（48个 DApp、81个 OFCI）。SmartMemory 精确率80.68%、召回率87.65%。在325个真实 OFC 应用中检测出36个此前未知的 OFCI，均已被相关方确认并修复。
AI.conclusion: SmartMemory 首次以统一视角将 OFCI 作为 OFC 漏洞根因，结合业务语义规范化与记忆型智能体实现知识迁移，展示了在真实场景中检测已知与未知 OFCI 的有效性。

title: Before Answering: Evidence Sufficiency under Size-Matched Memory Construction
summary: Agents that answer questions from compressed or retrieved memory must recognize when the evidence a query needs is no longer in memory. Benchmarks for this task usually create insufficient-evidence examples by deleting supporting passages. We show that this construction leaks the label through memory size: on MuSiQue, a classifier that only counts paragraphs reaches an area under the ROC curve (AUROC) of $0.979$ for detecting unsafe memory, higher than the lexical estimator we initially evaluated. We propose a size-matched construction that provably removes this shortcut, and use it to study MemSafe, an estimator that cross-encodes the query with each memory unit and aggregates the units with a set transformer. Across three multi-hop question answering datasets and five seeds, MemSafe reaches $0.968$ and $0.983$ AUROC on MuSiQue and HotpotQA, $0.26$ to $0.39$ above a lexical baseline, while the third dataset, 2WikiMultiHopQA, is saturated. A frozen pretrained cross-encoder with a logistic head already closes $41\%$ of the MuSiQue gap between the lexical baseline and MemSafe. At the same time, MemSafe degrades more than a weak baseline on the unanswerable questions released with MuSiQue, reaches only $0.639$ AUROC on SQuAD~2.0, and needs several thousand clinical training examples before it outperforms a feature-based estimator. Used as a gate for a 7B reader, it reduces the error rate on answered questions from $0.850$ to $0.631$ at $5\%$ coverage, outperforming both reader confidence and, on average, the ground-truth integrity label, although a 7B LLM judge is the better gate at $10\%$ coverage. These results indicate that the way insufficient evidence is constructed matters as much as the estimator that detects it.

AI.tldr: 论文指出不足证据基准通过删除段落构造会经"记忆大小"泄漏标签（MuSiQue上仅数段落的分类器AUROC达0.979），提出规模匹配构造消除该捷径，并据此研究MemSafe估计器，其AUROC显著超词汇基线但存在跨数据集/领域局限。
AI.motivation: 回答压缩或检索记忆问题的智能体需识别所需证据是否已不在记忆中，但现有基准通过删除支撑段落构造"证据不足"样本，可能引入偏置捷径，导致评估不可靠。
AI.method: 提出可证明消除"记忆大小"捷径的规模匹配构造；据此评估MemSafe——将查询与各记忆单元交叉编码，再用set transformer聚合；与词汇基线、冻结交叉编码器+逻辑头对比，并在三数据集五种子、SQuAD 2.0及临床数据上测试，还作为7B读者的门控。
AI.result: MuSiQue/HotpotQA上AUROC为0.968/0.983，超词汇基线0.26–0.39，2WikiMultiHopQA饱和；冻结交叉编码器已缩小41%差距；但在MuSiQue不可答问题上比弱基线退化更多，SQuAD 2.0仅0.639 AUROC，临床需数千样本；作为门控在5%覆盖下将错误率0.850降至0.631，优于读者置信度，但10%覆盖时7B LLM judge更优。
AI.conclusion: 不足证据的构造方式与检测估计器同样重要；规模匹配构造揭示了此前被捷径掩盖的真实性能差异，也暴露了MemSafe的泛化与领域局限。

title: PanoFuse: Panorama-Enhanced Vision-Language-Action Learning with Decoupled Semantic-Geometric Routing
comment: Code and data will be released publicly at https://xux-hnu.github.io/PanoFuse
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have shown promising performance in language-conditioned robotic manipulation. However, most existing VLA systems rely on conventional perspective cameras with limited fields of view, often missing global scene context and leading to unreliable manipulation under visual occlusions, distractors, and unseen environments. In this work, we propose PanoFuse, a panorama-enhanced VLA framework that complements local manipulation observations with global panoramic perception. PanoFuse introduces a dedicated panoramic branch that leverages a pretrained panoramic foundation model to extract complementary semantic and geometric representations from omnidirectional observations. Rather than directly mixing these heterogeneous features, we introduce Decoupled Semantic-Geometric Routing (DSGR), which maintains semantic and geometric representations as separate context streams and selectively routes both to downstream state and action representations through structured block-wise attention. This design provides the action expert with global spatial context while preserving task-relevant semantic information from the pretrained VLA backbone. We further develop a synchronized data collection pipeline and construct a new real-world manipulation dataset containing panoramic RGB observations, wrist-view images, language instructions, robot states, and actions. Across seven evaluation settings, PanoFuse achieves an average success rate of 52.9%, outperforming the evaluated baselines and achieving consistent gains under novel-object, unseen-background, and distractor-rich settings. Code and data will be released publicly at https://xux-hnu.github.io/PanoFuse.

AI.tldr: 提出PanoFuse，用全景感知增强VLA策略，通过解耦语义-几何路由融合全局上下文，在真实操作任务中取得52.9%平均成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略多依赖视野有限的透视相机，缺乏全局场景上下文，在视觉遮挡、干扰物和未见环境下操作不可靠。
AI.method: 引入专门的全景分支，利用预训练全景基础模型从全向观测中提取互补的语义与几何表征；提出解耦语义-几何路由（DSGR），将语义和几何表示为独立上下文流，通过结构化分块注意力选择性路由至下游状态与动作表示；并构建同步数据采集流程和含全景RGB、腕部视图、语言指令、机器人状态与动作的真实操作数据集。
AI.result: 在七种评估设置中平均成功率达52.9%，优于所评估的基线，并在新物体、未见背景和干扰物丰富场景下取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 全景感知与解耦语义-几何路由能有效增强VLA操作策略的鲁棒性与泛化能力，代码与数据将公开。

title: Memory as Middleware for Self-Improving AI Agents
comment: Conditionally accepted to Middleware 2026. Extended version
summary:
AI agents are stateless across sessions by default and therefore operationally amnesic: each session begins with little durable knowledge of prior failures, repairs, preferences, or successful strategies. As a result, agents repeat the same mistakes and discard hard-won experience. The dominant fix is \emph{bespoke memory}---retrieval, persistence, and learning logic hand-wired into one agent and bound to one storage engine. This creates a fragmented landscape where memory cannot be swapped, shared, isolated, or reasoned about independently of the agent that owns it. We argue that this is a middleware problem: agent memory deserves a first-class, pluggable layer, just as data access, messaging, and persistence each became middleware concerns.
  We develop this vision through six systems challenges: two-sided pluggability, host-native interposition, multi-tenant isolation, write-path consistency, federated sharing with provenance, and lifecycle governance. We present ALTK-Evolve, a reference implementation of memory middleware for self-improving agents, and use it to motivate a broader research agenda for future memory middleware.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将 AI 智能体的记忆视为中间件问题，主张构建一等公民、可插拔的记忆层。作者通过六大系统挑战阐述愿景，并给出参考实现 ALTK-Evolve。
AI.motivation: AI 智能体默认跨会话无状态，导致操作性失忆：每次会话缺乏对先前失败、修复、偏好和成功策略的持久知识，从而重复犯错、丢弃宝贵经验。现有主流方案是定制化记忆，将检索、持久化和学习逻辑硬编码于单一智能体并绑定单一存储引擎，造成记忆无法替换、共享、隔离或独立推理的碎片化格局。
AI.method: 作者将智能体记忆类比数据访问、消息传递和持久化等已成中间件的关注点，通过六个系统挑战展开愿景：双向可插拔性、宿主原生介入、多租户隔离、写路径一致性、带来源的联邦共享、生命周期治理。并提出 ALTK-Evolve 作为面向自改进智能体的记忆中间件参考实现。
AI.result: 论文以 ALTK-Evolve 验证其记忆中间件构想，并借此引出未来记忆中间件的更广泛研究议程。
AI.conclusion: 智能体记忆应被重新定位为独立的中间件问题，而非智能体的附属功能，这将推动可插拔、可共享、可隔离、可治理的记忆层研究。

title: Making the Invisible Visible: A Framework for Reflective AI Use in Software Engineering Education
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 37th Annual Conference of the Australasian Association for Engineering Education (AAEE 2026)
summary: Generative AI (GenAI) is increasingly embedded in software engineering education, supporting activities such as requirements development, design exploration, documentation, and prototyping. However, educators often have visibility only into final artefacts, with limited insight into how students evaluate, verify, and refine AI-generated outputs during the learning process. This creates challenges for assessing evaluative judgement and responsible AI-assisted practice. This paper introduces the AI Journal, a structured reflection framework designed to make student-GenAI interaction visible in first-year software engineering education. The framework combines execution tracking, which records prompts, outputs, intent, and interaction context, with cognitive auditing, which captures verification strategies, intervention decisions, confidence judgements, critical learning moments, and reflections on AI-supported work.
