Our findings argue for measuring and optimizing the vessel surface, not the volume it overlaps. Code

AI.tldr: 提出基于表面匹配的冠状动脉分割评估指标与可微表面损失，揭示Dice指标掩盖远端血管缺失问题，并在三个主干网络与两个数据集上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 冠状动脉CCTA分割对诊断冠心病至关重要。然而传统Dice指标对细长管状结构不敏感：多数体素属于少数粗大近端血管，缺失一条远端分支对Dice影响甚微，却严重破坏临床所需的血管连通性。Dice的对称性也无法区分假阳性（多余分支）与假阴性（缺失分支）。
AI.method: 提出一种表面度量，在局部血管半径容差下通过二分图匹配预测点与参考表面点，分别报告精度、召回率与F1，并解耦假阳性与假阴性。基于该度量进一步设计可微表面损失，同时抑制冗余结构并恢复缺失结构，并在nnU-Net、SwinUNETR、NexToU三个主干网络上通过微调验证。
AI.result: 强Dice基线实际遗漏的血管表面远多于其虚构部分，而这种不对称被高Dice掩盖。实验在Image-CAS与ASOCA两个公开基准上，相比等轮数对照，表面损失在Dice相当的情况下通过恢复缺失远端血管显著提升表面F1。
AI.conclusion: 血管分割应关注并优化血管表面而非其体积重叠，呼吁以表面度量替代或补充Dice进行评估与训练。

title: Fracast-0: Fractal Weight Sharing for a Time Series Foundation Model with Only 85K Parameters
summary: Time series foundation models must preserve multi-domain breadth, probabilistic output, and multiple temporal scales, but parameter count grows when each scale receives a separate representation. We introduce Fracast-0, a probabilistic forecasting foundation model that exploits temporal self-similarity to reuse one operator across scales. A parameter-free detector extracts significant seasonal structure. The encoder applies a shared local block along a geometric dilation ladder with scale conditioning, while the decoder combines context-gathered states with an explicit seasonal future state and reuses a second block along another ladder before emitting nine quantiles. Pretraining across six corpora preserves multi-domain breadth within 85,001 parameters. On 97 GIFT-Eval configurations without per-dataset fine-tuning, Fracast-0 is the smallest of 28 evaluated checkpoints and remains non-dominated in the aggregate parameter-accuracy plane with MASE 0.808 and WQL 0.564. It uses 42.0% fewer parameters than TinyCast, whose MASE and WQL are 4.2% and 3.3% lower. These results support cross-scale weight reuse as a practical route to further time series foundation model compression.

AI.tldr: Fracast-0是一个利用时间自相似性复用单一算子跨尺度建模的概率时间序列基础模型，仅用85,001参数即在GIFT-Eval上取得有竞争力的精度。
AI.motivation: 时间序列基础模型需同时具备多领域广度、概率输出和多时间尺度能力，但为每个尺度单独设置表示会导致参数量膨胀，亟需压缩方案。
AI.method: 本文提出Fracast-0：用无参数检测器提取显著季节结构；编码器沿几何膨胀阶梯应用共享局部块并进行尺度条件化；解码器结合上下文汇聚状态与显式季节未来状态，沿另一阶梯复用第二个块，最终输出九个分位数。
AI.result: 在六个语料库上预训练，85,001参数内保持多领域广度。在97个GIFT-Eval配置上（无逐数据集微调），Fracast-0是28个评估checkpoint中最小者，在参数-精度聚合平面上保持非支配，MASE 0.808、WQL 0.564，参数量比TinyCast少42.0%，而TinyCast的MASE和WQL仅低4.2%和3.3%。
AI.conclusion: 跨尺度权重复用是进一步压缩时间序列基础模型的实用路径。

title: SWE-MILE: Asynchronous Potential-Induced Milestone Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon Software Engineering Agents
summary: Long-horizon software engineering (SWE) agents trained with reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically receive only terminal outcome supervision, making it difficult to distinguish productive actions from redundant exploration or functional regressions. We propose SWE-MILE, an asynchronous potential-induced milestone credit assignment framework that derives fine-grained process supervision from workflow runtime, without auxiliary reward models or external evaluators. SWE-MILE quantifies task-relevant file exposure and test-state alignment as navigation and verification potentials, respectively. Differences in these potentials attribute milestone progress and regressions to individual actions, while discounted backward credit propagates supervision to preceding steps. To efficiently acquire intermediate verification states, SWE-MILE further introduces asynchronous shadow probing, which replays repository-changing actions in an isolated sandbox and runs verification in parallel with the agent's primary interaction, largely hiding verification latency. The resulting process credit augments terminal outcome advantages and provides informative learning signals. Experiments on two representative long-horizon SWE tasks demonstrate substantial improvements in agent performance, highlighting workflow runtime signals as a practical source of process supervision for long-horizon SWE agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 SWE-MILE，一种异步势能诱导里程碑信用分配框架，从工作流运行时提取细粒度过程监督，提升长时程 SWE 智能体性能。
AI.motivation: 长时程 SWE 智能体用带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）训练时仅有终局结果监督，难以区分有效动作与冗余探索或功能回归，缺乏细粒度过程信号。
AI.method: 用任务相关文件曝光度作为导航势能、测试状态对齐作为验证势能；通过势能差将里程碑进展与回归归因到单个动作，并用折扣反向信用传播到前序步骤；引入异步影子探测，在隔离沙箱重放改仓库动作并与主交互并行验证，隐藏验证延迟；所得过程信用增强终局优势。
AI.result: 在两个代表性长时程 SWE 任务上，智能体性能获得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 工作流运行时信号可作为长时程 SWE 智能体过程监督的实用来源，无需辅助奖励模型或外部评估器。

title: Self-Reports Do Not Identify Self-Models: An Identifiability Test for Counterfactual Reports
summary: Language-model self-reports are evidence about behavior in a prompt environment, not by themselves evidence of a self-model. We investigate counterfactual reports about affect-like states under activation interventions and ask whether the report remains bound to the named intervention when the demonstration environment changes. Across three open instruction models, wrong-source demonstrations move reports toward the source answer family, while explicit mechanism binding reduces this pull. Self-report benchmarks should include environment-shift invariance tests under fixed intervention before treating accuracy as evidence for an autonomous report mechanism.

AI.tldr: 语言模型的自述只是特定提示环境下的行为证据，而非自我模型的证据；本文通过激活干预下的反事实情绪报告实验，检验报告是否真正绑定于所声称的干预机制。
AI.motivation: 现有自述基准常把报告准确率当作自主报告机制的证据，但报告可能只是对提示环境的反应，而非对自身内部状态的读取。因此需要检验报告在环境变化下是否仍绑定于被指定的干预来源。
AI.method: 在三个开源指令模型上，对类情绪状态进行激活干预并收集反事实自述；操纵演示环境，引入错误来源演示，并测试显式机制绑定是否能抑制报告向来源答案族漂移。
AI.result: 错误来源演示使报告向来源答案族偏移；显式机制绑定可减弱这种拉拽效应。
AI.conclusion: 将自述准确率视为自主报告机制的证据之前，自述基准应包含固定干预下的环境迁移不变性测试。

title: PEEL-DDPM: Physics-Enabled Evidential Learning for the Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model
summary:
Normal-inverse-gamma (NIG) regression is not identifiable from its marginal Student-t likelihood: three combinations of four NIG parameters are determined, leaving one degree of freedom. We introduce PEEL-DDPM, a physics-enabled evidential learning framework for denoising diffusion probabilistic models. A measurement-conditioned DDPM is first trained with epsilon-MSE and then frozen. Its complete reverse trajectory produces a reconstruction, whose residual from the known training object is modeled by a final-image evidential network. The network learns only the identifiable Student-t coordinates, while repeated scanner-noise realizations and repeated diffusion trajectories provide a nested Monte Carlo estimate of final-image aleatoric variance, separated into scanner-induced and sampler-induced components. This measured variance resolves the remaining NIG ambiguity and yields a decomposition of predictive uncertainty into measurement, diffusion, and epistemic terms.
  The method uses sequential training without a cross-loss weighting coefficient. In a feasibility study on eight held-out objects, empirical central-interval coverages were 49.3%, 80.3%, 90.1%, and 95.6% for nominal 50%, 80%, 90%, and 95% intervals. The mean squared residual was 0.967 times the mean predicted variance, and a single-image aleatoric head achieved pooled Spearman correlation 0.785 against an independent nested reference. Across five dose levels, scanner-induced variance showed a log-log dose slope of -1.15, whereas sampler-induced variance remained nearly dose independent with slope -0.01. These results support PEEL-DDPM as a practical route to identifiable and physically interpretable uncertainty quantification in diffusion-based image reconstruction.

AI.tldr: PEEL-DDPM 提出一种物理启发的证据学习框架，通过嵌套蒙特卡洛估计的扫描仪噪声方差解决 NIG 回归的可识别性问题，实现扩散模型图像重建中的可解释不确定性量化。
AI.motivation: NIG 回归的边际 Student-t 似然不可识别：四个 NIG 参数只有三个组合被确定，存在一个自由度。作者希望借此解决不确定性量化中不可识别的问题，并区分不同来源的不确定性（测量、扩散、认知）。
AI.method: 先以 epsilon-MSE 训练一个条件于测量的 DDPM 并冻结；其完整逆向轨迹生成重建图像。用最终图像证据网络对重建与训练对象之间的残差建模，仅学习可识别的 Student-t 坐标。通过重复的扫描仪噪声实现与重复扩散轨迹，进行嵌套蒙特卡洛估计，将最终图像的偶然方差分解为扫描仪诱导与采样器诱导两部分，用以消解 NIG 剩余歧义。采用无需交叉损失权重的顺序训练。
AI.result: 在 8 个留出对象的可行性研究中，中心区间覆盖率分别为 49.3%、80.3%、90.1%、95.6%（对应名义 50%、80%、90%、95%）。均方残差为预测方差均值的 0.967 倍；单图像偶然头部对独立嵌套参考的合并 Spearman 相关为 0.785。五个剂量水平下，扫描仪诱导方差的对数-对数剂量斜率为 -1.15，采样器诱导方差近乎剂量无关，斜率为 -0.01。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明 PEEL-DDPM 是扩散图像重建中实现可识别且具物理可解释性不确定性量化的实用途径。

title: A bilingual AI audiologist built through rubric-guided playbook induction outperforms human audiologists in a blinded evaluation of simulated cases
comment: 75 pages, including 51 pages of Supplementary Information
summary: Audiology consultation requires structured history-taking, audiometric interpretation and patient-centred communication, yet real-world case material is scarce. We present a bilingual AI audiologist pairing a general-purpose large language model with rubric-guided playbook induction, multimodal audiogram interpretation and retrieval-augmented grounding, without fine-tuning the language-model backbone. Using a 21-item rubric and an AI patient simulator, we induced a 19-rule consultation policy from 73 training cases (43 English, 30 Chinese) and evaluated the system on 58 independent simulated cases (30 Chinese, 28 English) in a pre-specified, source-blinded comparison with 17 practising audiologists. The AI audiologist outperformed human audiologists on every case (58/58; mean paired $Δ$ = +1.35 on a 5-point composite, Cohen's d = 1.84, $P = 4.5 \times 10^{-20}$), on 20 of 21 rubric items and in both languages. Component ablation identified the playbook as the largest contributor, offering a practical route to specialist consultation agents in low-data medical domains.

AI.tldr: 提出双语AI听力学家，无需微调大模型主干，结合评分标准引导的策略归纳、多模态听力图解读与检索增强。在58个模拟病例上与17名听力学家对比全面胜出。
AI.motivation: 真实听力学会诊案例稀缺，而会诊需要结构化病史采集、听力图解读与以患者为中心的沟通，需要可规模化的AI专家会诊方案。
AI.method: 将通用大语言模型与评分标准引导的playbook归纳、多模态听力图解读、检索增强接地结合，不微调模型主干；用21项评分标准和AI患者模拟器，从73个训练案例（43英文、30中文）归纳出19条会诊策略，在58个独立模拟案例（30中文、28英文）上与17名执业听力学家进行预设、来源盲法对比，并做组件消融。
AI.result: AI听力学家在每个病例上均优于人类听力学家（58/58；5分制综合分平均配对Δ=+1.35，Cohen's d=1.84，P=4.5×10⁻²⁰），在21项评分标准中的20项及两种语言上均领先；消融显示playbook贡献最大。
AI.conclusion: 表明通过策略归纳与多模态、检索增强组合可在低数据医学领域构建专家会诊智能体，为专科会诊代理提供实用路径。

title: The Decomposition Tax: LLM Pipelines Lose Up to 40 Accuracy Points at Their Own Interfaces
summary: A four-stage LLM pipeline gives up as much as 40.5 accuracy points at its own interfaces (gemma-3-12B on MATH-500, Holm-corrected p = 1.66e-19; the largest tax in the primary family). We hold model, problem, stages, stage prompts and completion budget fixed, vary only whether each stage can still see the original problem, and call the accuracy difference the decomposition tax. Across 21 open-weight models from nine organisations, on GSM-Hard and MATH-500 at n = 200 paired items per cell, 70 of 118 primary-family tests survive Benjamini-Hochberg correction and 54 survive Holm. On GSM-Hard, a placebo recovers nothing: it carries at least 60% of the extra tokens and at most one word of the problem. Builders design a pipeline one stage at a time, and its bill arrives at the interfaces between stages. Rewriting one stage's instruction moves gemma-3-12B's tax from 4.5 to 36.5 points, and adding "every relationship stated between them" to a stage that lists the numerical quantities lowers the tax on 9 of 9 models on MATH-500. Re-grounding, which shows a stage the original problem again, belongs after the loss. With one lossy interface, re-grounding the stage after it beats re-grounding the stage before it on 7 of 7 models on both benchmarks; on MATH-500 the earlier repair is worse than none on 7 of 7. Newer models still pay: gemma-4-12B gives up 37.0 points, and the repair holds on all three of the newest models we test. A sealed held-out test refuted a stronger rule we registered, which predicted the paying stage from the interface and receiver types, so we locate the tax by measuring one stage at a time. The prescription has two parts: re-ground the stage after the lossy interface, and if a stage must list the quantities, tell it to keep the relationships.

AI.tldr: 四阶段LLM流水线在其阶段接口处损失高达40.5个准确率点，作者将此差异命名为"分解税"(decomposition tax)，并提出在损失接口之后重新注入原问题可缓解该损失。
AI.motivation: 流水线被逐阶段依次构建，但代价却出现在阶段之间的接口处。作者希望量化并定位这种因阶段看不到原始问题而产生的"分解税"，并给出可操作的修复处方。
AI.method: 固定模型、问题、阶段数、阶段提示与补全预算，仅改变各阶段是否仍能看到原始问题；在GSM-Hard与MATH-500上对21个开源模型进行n=200配对的逐阶段测量，使用Benjamini-Hochberg与Holm校正，并设置"安慰剂"对照（携带至少60%额外token但至多含一个原问题词）。
AI.result: 118项主族检验中70项通过BH校正、54项通过Holm校正；gemma-3-12B在MATH-500上损失40.5点(p=1.66e-19)。改写单一阶段指令可使税从4.5变到36.5点；添加"保持数值间关系"的指令在MATH-500上9/9模型降税。在一个有损接口后重新接地，在两个基准上7/7模型优于在前一阶段接地；MATH-500上前一阶段修复甚至比不修复更差。新模型仍缴税：gemma-4-12B损失37.0点。被封存的留出测试推翻了作者注册的更强规则。
AI.conclusion: 处方分两部分：在有损接口之后重新接地该阶段；若某阶段必须列举数值量，则指示其保留数值间的关系。由于预测"付费阶段"的规则被留出测试推翻，作者通过逐阶段测量来定位税。

title: What Should the Reflector See? An Empirical Study of Evidence in Reflective Prompt Optimization
summary: Reflective prompt optimization revises instructions using examples of a model's behavior, but which evidence the reflector should receive remains unclear. We study evidence composition, visibility of examples, candidate selection and domain-knowledge policy within a single-parent Pareto-guided search. Using Qwen3.5-9B as both task model and reflector, we evaluate nine reflection strategies on five datasets. From these experiments, we find three distinct patterns. For performance improvement, Failures-only produces the largest mean test gain (+8.0 percentage points), while Balanced-mix and No-examples+Val share the best mean performance rank. For reflection effectiveness, No-examples achieves the best rank for improving sampled parents, yet yields only a 1.4-point mean test gain: local reflection success does not necessarily produce a stronger final prompt. For overfitting assessment, Failures-only and Balanced-mix share the lowest mean calibration-gap rank, while larger gaps on GPQA and IFBench show that calibration gains can overstate held-out improvement. This gap is a descriptive indicator, not a direct measure of overfitting. Together, these results show why reflection strategies should be assessed separately on final performance, parent improvement and calibration-to-test transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文研究反思式提示优化中"证据构成"的影响，用Qwen3.5-9B在5个数据集上比较9种反思策略，发现仅失败样本对最终性能提升最大，但局部反思成功不等同于更强的最终提示。
AI.motivation: 反思式提示优化利用模型行为示例来修订指令，但反思器应接收哪些证据尚不清楚，需要系统研究证据构成、示例可见性、候选选择与领域知识策略的影响。
AI.method: 在单亲Pareto引导搜索框架下，以Qwen3.5-9B同时作为任务模型和反思器，在5个数据集上评估9种反思策略，涵盖证据构成、示例可见性、候选选择和领域知识策略，并从最终性能、父代改进和校准到测试的迁移三个维度分析。
AI.result: 仅失败样本（Failures-only）取得最大的平均测试增益（+8.0个百分点）；平衡混合（Balanced-mix）和无示例+验证（No-examples+Val）在平均性能排名上并列最佳。无示例（No-examples）在改进被采样父代上排名最佳，但平均测试增益仅1.4个百分点。仅失败样本和平衡混合在校准差距排名上并列最低，而GPQA和IFBench上更大的差距表明校准增益可能夸大留出集改进。
AI.conclusion: 反思策略应在最终性能、父代改进和校准到测试迁移方面分别评估；局部反思成功不一定带来更强的最终提示，校准差距是描述性指标而非过拟合的直接度量。

title: VisionPsy-Nano: Improving Accuracy, Efficiency, and Reliability in On-Device Vision-Language Models
summary: Sub-billion-parameter Vision-Language Models are increasingly viable for on-device deployment, yet compact model size alone does not guarantee usability. On a phone, such a model can still require more than two minutes to produce its first token. On-device usability depends on three axes: accuracy, efficiency, and behavioral reliability; standard benchmarks miss the third, with answers too short to expose doom loops and prompts too benign to probe adversarial safety. We introduce a diagnosis-driven post-training recipe in which a teacher VLM stress-tests the student, uncovers failure modes beyond human priors, and converts them into targeted supervision and preference alignment, supplementing generic data scaling with failure-driven optimization. Coupled with two visual-token policies, the recipe yields two accuracy-efficiency variants with improved behavioral reliability. \textbf{\NanoFull} attains a 62.3 normalized average over 17 benchmarks, the highest among openly released $\sim$0.5B models, +7.4 over its base at identical architecture and token budget, with doom-loop rates at or below the strongest baseline's. \textbf{\FlashFull} retains 61.4 while cutting warm time-to-first-token on a Pixel 9 from 138\,s to 6.1\,s (23$\times$). By jointly addressing all three axes, we move compact VLMs toward practical on-device usability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种诊断驱动的后训练方法，让教师VLM对学生模型进行压力测试、发现失败模式并转化为针对性监督与偏好对齐，配合视觉token策略得到两个精度-效率变体（NanoFull与FlashFull），提升端侧紧凑VLM的可用性。
AI.motivation: 亚十亿参数VLM虽可用于端侧，但紧凑尺寸并不保证可用性：手机上首个token可能需两分钟以上。端侧可用性取决于精度、效率和行为可靠性三轴，而标准基准忽略了可靠性（答案过短无法暴露doom loop，提示过温和无法测试对抗安全）。
AI.method: 诊断驱动的后训练配方：教师VLM对学生进行压力测试，发现超出人类先验的失败模式，转化为针对性监督与偏好对齐，以失败驱动优化补充通用数据扩展；并结合两种视觉token策略。
AI.result: NanoFull在17个基准上达到62.3归一化均值，为公开约0.5B模型最高，在同架构同token预算下比基座高7.4，doom-loop率不高于最强基线；FlashFull保持61.4，并将Pixel 9上热启动TTFT从138s降至6.1s（23倍）。
AI.conclusion: 通过同时解决精度、效率、可靠性三轴，推动紧凑VLM走向实际端侧可用性。

title: RAO-Nav: Probing Omni-Language Models for Zero-shot Semantic Audio-Visual Navigation
summary: We explore whether Omni-Language Models (OLMs) can be directly applied to zero-shot Semantic Audio-Visual Navigation (SAVN). Recent work demonstrates that even state-of-the-art specialized models still struggle to achieve generalist multimodal navigation, despite extensive task-specific training. In this paper, we introduce RAO-Nav, short for Reasoning All-in-One OLM, a deployment pipeline for zero-shot SAVN. By leveraging the rich implicit audio-visual knowledge encoded in OLMs, the embodied agent is enabled to ``hear'', ``see'', ``reason'', and ``act'' in the environment. To further elicit the built-in thinking ability of OLMs, we propose a test-time Latent Navigation Reasoning (LNR) module that can be seamlessly integrated into the decoding space. LNR encourages the model to retrieve more target-relevant observations and make effective navigation decisions. Through comprehensive experiments, we show that our framework surpasses existing state-of-the-art baselines on public SAVN benchmarks without using any training data. Moreover, we introduce a new \emph{Global Navigation Instruction} setting to further evaluate the ability of OLMs to serve as embodied navigation agents. Code: https://github.com/rikeilong/OmniAV\_Nav.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RAO-Nav，一个用于零样本语义视听导航（SAVN）的 Omni-Language Model 部署框架，并结合测试时 Latent Navigation Reasoning 模块，无需训练数据即可在公开基准上超越现有 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有专用模型即便经过大量任务训练，仍难以实现通用多模态导航。作者希望探索能否直接利用 Omni-Language Model 中丰富的隐式视听知识，实现零样本 SAVN，让智能体同时“听、看、推理、行动”。
AI.method: 提出 RAO-Nav 部署流程，直接调用 OLM 进行零样本 SAVN；并设计测试时 Latent Navigation Reasoning（LNR）模块，可无缝集成到解码空间，引导模型检索更多与目标相关的观测并做出有效导航决策。同时引入 Global Navigation Instruction 新设置。
AI.result: 在公开 SAVN 基准上，无需任何训练数据即超过现有 SOTA 基线；并在新提出的 Global Navigation Instruction 设置下进一步评估 OLM 作为具身导航智能体的能力。
AI.conclusion: OLM 结合部署流程与测试时推理模块，可有效胜任零样本语义视听导航，展现出作为通用具身导航智能体的潜力，代码已开源。

title: Relic: From Multi-Agent Collaboration to Persistent Organizational Capability
summary: Multiple agents may often conflict in an organization: for example, one coding agent changes an interface in a repository, but another continues to develop on the old version where existing tests become stale. A conversation can resolve the episode, but when the participants change, what makes the lesson continue to govern the team? We introduce Relic, which turns recurring collaboration failures into organization-owned, executable protocols. Members reflect on visible work, propose rules, and govern their adoption. Adopted protocols bind triggers, responsibilities, required evidence, and execution consequences to the runtime, while remaining open to revision and retirement. In one traced case, repeated integration friction produces an interface-review rule that governs later pull requests and is revised as work continues. Across 360 controlled runs over ten software workloads and three models, Relic raises complete-contract delivery from 14.06% to 19.76% (+5.71 percentage points) over a matched structured team without the protocol lifecycle, improving all four verified production endpoints in every model stratum. Under fresh-member transfer, behavioral correctness is 25.4% with no inherited protocol, 34.6% with the same rules provided as readable text, and 41.2% with executable bindings, a +6.5-point advantage over text alone. On the full CooperBench benchmark, after excluding broken benchmark pairs, Relic achieves 367/477 (76.9%), establishing the best reported result among peer-structured systems. On the fixed 48-pair same-model subset, Relic also exceeds Solo (29/48 vs. 26/48), reversing the coordination loss exhibited by the official peer baseline. Together, these results show how collaboration experience can become persistent organizational state that remains useful beyond the members who created it.

AI.tldr: Relic将多智能体协作中反复出现的失败转化为组织拥有、可执行、可修订的协议，显著提升交付成功率与知识跨成员传承效果。
AI.motivation: 多智能体协作常因成员更替而无法保留经验教训：当参与者变化时，一次对话中解决冲突的经验难以继续约束团队；且仅以文本形式传递规则效果有限。因此需要一种机制，让协作经验成为持久、可执行的组织状态，超越创造它的成员而持续生效。
AI.method: Relic将反复出现的协作失败转化为组织拥有的可执行协议：成员对可见工作进行反思、提出规则并治理其采纳。被采纳的协议把触发器、责任、所需证据和执行后果绑定到运行时，同时保持可修订、可退役。实验涵盖十个软件负载、三种模型、360次受控运行，并设置无协议生命周期的匹配结构化团队作对照；还进行新成员迁移测试（无继承协议 vs. 文本规则 vs. 可执行绑定）以及在CooperBench基准上的评估。
AI.result: 完整合同交付从14.06%提升至19.76%（+5.71个百分点），在每个模型分层都改善了全部四个已验证生产端点。新成员迁移下行为正确率：无继承协议25.4%，文本规则34.6%，可执行绑定41.2%（比纯文本高6.5个百分点）。在CooperBench上（排除损坏对后）达到367/477（76.9%），为同类结构化系统中的最佳报告结果；在固定48对同模型子集上（29/48）还超过了Solo（26/48），逆转了官方对照基线表现出的协调损失。
AI.conclusion: 协作经验可以转化为持久的组织状态，并能在创造它的成员离开后继续发挥作用，说明可执行协议是解决多智能体组织知识传承问题的有效路径。

title: Streamlined Reflective Evolution for Task-Adaptive Self-Refinement Pipelines
summary: Reflective prompt optimization improves large language model (LLM) systems without updating model weights, but fixed architectures constrain how self-refinement is organized. We introduce Workflow-Designing Agents (WDA), a framework for streamlined reflective evolution of task-adaptive self-refinement pipelines. Starting from a minimal prompt, WDA jointly evolves stage instructions and their sequential structure. During evolution, we find that repeated revisions can accumulate redundant instructions in a single prompt. In WDA, we propose to address this problem with SPLIT, which redistributes these instructions across specialized stages. Three-example reflection and local screening guide selective search, while calibration scores guide Pareto admission and rollback of unhelpful trailing updates. The resulting pipelines are task-adaptive: their instructions and depth are learned from task data, then fixed for all test inputs within that task. We evaluate WDA on five benchmarks spanning knowledge, mathematical reasoning, multi-hop question answering, and instruction following. On Qwen3.5-9B, WDA achieves an average score of 51.24%, improving over the initial solver by 8.63 percentage points and the variant without SPLIT by 2.60 points. On GPT-4.1-mini, it achieves 49.00%, with corresponding gains of 5.62 and 3.69 points. These results support task-adaptive self-refinement as a complementary direction to broader agentic workflow search.

AI.tldr: 提出WDA框架，通过联合进化阶段指令与顺序结构实现任务自适应的自细化流水线，并用SPLIT缓解冗余指令问题。
AI.motivation: 反思式提示优化无需更新模型权重即可提升LLM系统，但固定架构限制了自细化的组织方式。
AI.method: 从最小提示出发，联合进化各阶段指令及其顺序结构；用SPLIT将冗余指令重分配到专门阶段；借助三示例反思与局部筛选进行选择性搜索，用校准分数指导Pareto准入与回滚。
AI.result: 在覆盖知识、数学推理、多跳问答和指令遵循的五个基准上，Qwen3.5-9B平均51.24%（较初始解+8.63，较无SPLIT+2.60）；GPT-4.1-mini为49.00%（+5.62、+3.69）。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持任务自适应自细化作为更广泛智能体工作流搜索的互补方向。

title: The Earth in One Gaze: Training-Free Active Focus for UHR Remote Sensing Understanding
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) must balance local detail against scene context when interpreting ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing (RS) imagery within a limited visual-input budget. Existing selection-based methods either prune tokens and select patches through relevance scoring, or crop actively through repeated inspection. Neither strategy directly redistributes pixels within a continuous full-scene view: the first retains selected tokens or patches, and the second re-encodes a crop detached from its surroundings. Our pilot study finds that a frozen MLLM already produces useful question-guided spatial requests, yet crop-based inspection of the selected regions does not consistently improve its answers. We therefore formulate UHR understanding as a question of where to spend a fixed pixel budget. Based on this, we introduce GazeEarth, a simple-yet-effective training-free framework that couples question-guided region selection with full-scene foveated observation. The MLLM selects evidence cells from an indexed overview; a deterministic, topology-preserving warp resamples the original image onto a fixed-size canvas, enlarging their shared neighborhood while compressing the periphery; the same frozen model answers from this focused view, using at most two MLLM calls and no external selector or iterative search. Across three UHR remote sensing benchmarks and four frozen backbones, GazeEarth improves benchmark-averaged accuracy by 4.6 to 9.4 percentage points over direct answering and 3.4 to 4.3 over overview answering, outperforming task-trained methods. Our analyses show that existing MLLMs can guide where to look in UHR images on their own, and that what they can infer from the selected evidence depends on how that evidence is presented.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GazeEarth，一种免训练的MLLM框架，通过问题引导的区域选择与全场景中央凹式观察，在固定像素预算下提升超高分辨率遥感图像理解，无需外部选择器或迭代搜索。
AI.motivation: MLLM在有限视觉输入预算下解读超高分辨率遥感图像时，需平衡局部细节与场景上下文。现有基于选择的方法要么剪枝/选块而丢失全局，要么裁剪后再编码、脱离周边环境，均未能在连续全场景视图中重新分配像素。
AI.method: GazeEarth将UHR理解形式化为“如何在固定像素预算下花费像素”的问题。流程为：MLLM从索引概览中选择证据单元；确定性、拓扑保持的warp将原图重采样到固定尺寸画布，放大所选区域共享邻域并压缩外围；同一冻结模型从该聚焦视图作答。全程最多两次MLLM调用，无需外部选择器或迭代搜索，且免训练。
AI.result: 在三个UHR遥感基准和四个冻结骨干上，GazeEarth相比直接回答平均准确率提升4.6–9.4个百分点，相比概览回答提升3.4–4.3个百分点，并优于任务训练方法。
AI.conclusion: 分析表明，现有MLLM自身即可引导在UHR图像中“看哪里”，而“能从所选证据推断出什么”取决于证据的呈现方式。

title: Certifying Interventional Agreement Among Observationally Equivalent Causal Models
summary: Observationally equivalent causal models can still disagree about what happens under intervention, because interventions create inputs that never occur in observational data. We introduce Interventional Separation Selection (ISS), which repeatedly queries the true system with an admissible intervention on which the surviving candidate models disagree, discards the candidates the outcome contradicts, and stops once no intervention within a cost bound separates the survivors. If the true system is among the candidates, this stopping condition certifies that every survivor agrees with it on every admissible intervention within the bound, a guarantee that no observational learner can give, however much data it sees. The stopping condition depends only on the survivors, so it can be checked without knowing the truth. For continuous variables the candidates form an infinite version space, and mixed-integer linear programs decide the stopping condition exactly over all of it, with agreement holding up to a tolerance. On a three-digit colored MNIST causal abstraction task in which ink hue tracks digit size, plain convolutional networks trained on examples reach zero held-out error, yet disagree with shape-based labels on 26% of single-digit edits, as often as hue-based labels do. Auditing the causal abstractions of networks observed only on such images, ISS certifies what each network perceives with 13.6 interventions per image on average, and each certificate, checked against every admissible intervention, holds whenever the network's true abstraction is among the candidates. When a network bypasses a unit that every candidate abstraction relies on, certificates covering interventions on that unit can be silently void, and twenty random validation interventions refute 69% of them.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Interventional Separation Selection (ISS)，通过对真实系统施加可允许干预来区分观察等价的因果模型，无需知道真值即可验证幸存模型在所有代价界限内干预上的一致性；在连续变量上用混合整数线性规划精确判定停止条件，并在彩色MNIST因果抽象任务中审计网络的因果抽象。
AI.motivation: 观察等价的因果模型在干预下可能给出不同结果，因为干预会产生观测数据中从未出现的输入；纯观察学习无法保证模型在干预下与真实系统一致，因此需要基于干预的模型选择方法。
AI.method: ISS反复对真实系统施加可允许干预，选择幸存候选模型意见不一致的干预，丢弃与结果矛盾的候选，直到代价界限内没有干预能区分幸存者为止；停止条件只依赖幸存者，可无需真值检查；对连续变量，用混合整数线性规划在无限版本空间上精确判定停止条件（一致性保持到某容差）。
AI.result: 在三位数字彩色MNIST因果抽象任务中，普通卷积网络在留出示例上零误差，但在单数字编辑上与基于形状的标签有26%不一致，与基于色相的标签一样频繁；ISS平均每张图像13.6次干预即可认证网络感知，且证书在真实抽象属于候选时对所有可允许干预成立；当网络绕过所有候选抽象依赖的单元时，证书可能静默失效，20个随机验证干预可反驳69%的此类证书。
AI.conclusion: ISS提供了观察学习无法给出的干预一致性保证，能有效审计网络的因果抽象；但需警惕网络绕过关键单元导致证书静默失效的问题。

title: SRE-Marathon: A Continuous, Change-Driven Benchmark for Autonomous Site Reliability Agents
summary: Benchmarks for site reliability engineering (SRE) agents are typically episodic: one fault is injected, the agent receives an incident task, and its response is scored. Production operation is not. Incidents surface through noisy alerts, overlap in time, and often originate from code or configuration changes. We present SRE-Marathon, a benchmark for long-horizon, continuous SRE operation. An agent is invoked at a fixed cadence with cumulative alert history and a persistent workspace while operating a live two-zone Kubernetes deployment as a fault orchestrator injects overlapping faults according to a seeded, production-calibrated schedule. Curated code and configuration changes deployed through the same build pipeline available for repair. Each run is recorded into a sealed bundle and scored offline: Marathon-Score credits each injected fault for ordered progress through correlation, localization, and repair, with all metrics computed deterministically from recorded system evidence. Across three applications and about sixty faults per run, the best of 10 methods reaches only 41.3 out of 100. Agents often correlate and localize faults, but almost never complete repairs while the faults remain active.

AI.tldr: SRE-Marathon 是一个长时程、连续 SRE 运维基准，模拟重叠故障与持续告警环境。最佳方法仅得 41.3/100，智能体能关联与定位故障但几乎无法在故障活跃时完成修复。
AI.motivation: 现有 SRE 智能体基准多为单次情景式（注入单一故障、评一次响应），与真实生产运维不符。真实场景中告警嘈杂、故障在时间上重叠，且常源于代码或配置变更，因此需要长时程连续运维的评测基准。
AI.method: 提出 SRE-Marathon 基准：智能体按固定节奏被调用，接收累积告警历史与持久工作区，操作双区 Kubernetes 实时部署；由故障编排器按带种子的、生产校准的计划注入重叠故障。预置的代码与配置变更通过与修复相同的构建流水线部署。每次运行录制成密封包并离线评分，Marathon-Score 对每个注入故障按关联、定位、修复的有序进展计分，所有指标由记录的系统证据确定性计算。
AI.result: 在三个应用、每次约六十个故障的设定下，十种方法中最优者仅得 41.3/100。智能体常能关联与定位故障，但当故障仍处于活跃状态时几乎无法完成修复。
AI.conclusion: 该基准揭示了现有 SRE 智能体在长时程连续运维中的显著不足，尤其修复环节在故障持续活跃情况下难以完成，为未来研究指明方向。

title: AdaTutoRank: Learning to Rerank Document Sets via Adaptive Tutoring Optimization for RAG and Deep Research
summary: Document rerankers determine what evidence reaches the downstream model in RAG and deep research, yet mainstream rerankers select by relevance matching, and individually relevant documents rarely constitute the complete, complementary, non-redundant set a complex information need demands. Prior work rewards a set by its aggregate rubric score, shifting the objective from ranking documents to composing sets. Yet that score is one scalar shared by every document in the set, so the supervision is sparse: a redundant document is rewarded with the rest whenever the set scores well, and a decisive one penalized with the rest whenever it does not; credit assignment leaves contributors indistinguishable from free riders. On-policy distillation could densify this supervision, but existing methods give every rollout the same fixed guidance, too prescriptive for strong rollouts and too abstract for weak ones. We therefore propose AdaTutoRank, a setwise reranker trained with Adaptive Tutoring Optimization (ATO) under a three-level hierarchy of nine rubric dimensions, which supplies silver labels for the cold start, rewards for reinforcement learning, and hints for distillation. ATO draws three hint forms of increasing specificity from the policy's own frozen snapshot: the rubrics alone, a self-selector's sibling-set chosen under rubrics, and a self-reflector's reflection contrasting the rollout with that sibling-set; each rollout receives the form matched to its quality. Re-scoring that rollout under the hint-conditioned frozen teacher and the hint-free snapshot distills the hint's effect into a token-level advantage that complements the group-relative outcome advantage. Across ten benchmarks spanning RAG, deep research, and setwise evaluation, AdaTutoRank attains the best overall performance while issuing fewer retrieval calls.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaTutoRank集合式重排器与自适应辅导优化(ATO)，用难度匹配的分层提示蒸馏监督信号，解决集合级奖励分配稀疏问题，在十个基准上取得最优综合表现。
AI.motivation: 主流重排器基于相关性匹配，但复杂信息需求需一组互补、非冗余的文档，单独相关难以满足。既往用集合级聚合评分奖励，其单一标量使监督稀疏：冗余文档随好集合被奖励，关键文档随差集合被惩罚，无法区分贡献者与搭便车者。在线策略蒸馏本可加密监督，但现有方法对所有 rollout 给同一固定指导，对强 rollout 过于规定、对弱 rollout 过于抽象。
AI.method: 提出AdaTutoRank集合式重排器，采用自适应辅导优化(ATO)，基于九维评分标准的三级层次结构提供冷启动银标签、强化学习奖励与蒸馏提示。ATO从策略自身冻结快照中取三种递增具体度的提示：仅评分标准；自选择器在评分标准下选出的兄弟集合；自反思器对 rollout 与该兄弟集合的对比反思；按 rollout 质量匹配相应形式。在提示条件冻结教师与无提示快照下重打分该 rollout，将提示效果蒸馏为 token 级优势，与组相对结果优势互补。
AI.result: 在涵盖RAG、深度研究与集合式评估的十个基准上，AdaTutoRank取得最佳综合性能，同时检索调用次数更少。
AI.conclusion: 通过自适应、难度匹配的分层提示将集合级稀疏奖励稠密化为token级优势，AdaTutoRank有效训练集合式重排器，提升复杂信息需求下的证据集合质量并降低检索开销。

title: Fusion Under Component Failure: Negative Results and Failure Modes in Ensemble AI-Generated Image Detection
summary:
We built an ordinary stacking ensemble for AI-generated image detection -- three open detectors producing five scores, fused by a gradient-boosted meta-learner that treats a detector's failure as missing data -- deployed it, and then evaluated it against three controls it should have faced first. This paper reports what the controls found, including where they overturned our own earlier conclusions.
  Fusion is worth its cost only when refitted on the target domain. The shipped meta-learner, fitted on a separate corpus, does not beat its best single member on 2000 StyleGAN faces (AUC 0.9896 vs 0.9961; McNemar p = 1.000). But a stacker refitted in-domain beats that member plus a post-hoc calibrator (Delta-AUC = +0.0025, [+0.0014, +0.0038]; p = 3.4e-4). An earlier draft claimed the calibrated single detector won outright; that comparison mixed regimes and we correct it here.
  One corpus is not an evaluation. On 80 screenshots every model's AUC interval contains 0.5. We can say nothing stronger: the difference between the ensemble's drop and its best member's is [-0.185, +0.115].
  Abstention is real, correlated, and mishandled. With four of five detectors silent and the survivor reporting "real", the system returns P(AI) = 0.9985, because an all-NaN input scores 0.9995 in a learner never fitted with missingness. The three AIDE checkpoints fail together, sharing one preprocessing path. A quorum rule requiring two distinct architectures prevents both failures with no retraining.
  We also find Corpus A carries a class-conditional JPEG bias severe enough to separate the classes from the header alone, which limits every in-domain number we report. Code, harness, hash-identified artifacts and all corrections are released.

AI.tldr: 本文对一个已部署的AI生成图像检测堆叠集成进行了对照评估，并纠正了此前的结论。
AI.motivation: 作者意识到自己的集成系统未先经过应有的对照检验，需要检验融合是否真的有价值、单语料评测是否充分、以及弃权行为是否被正确处理。
AI.method: 用三个开放检测器产生五个分数，由梯度提升元学习器融合（把检测器失败视为缺失数据）；并设置三组对照：目标域重拟合、多语料评测、弃权/缺失性处理与quorum规则。
AI.result: 外域拟合的元学习器不敌最佳单模型（AUC 0.9896 vs 0.9961，p=1.000），而域内重拟合则超过校准后的单模型（Delta-AUC=+0.0025，p=3.4e-4）；80张截图上所有模型AUC区间含0.5；五检测器四静默时系统仍给出P(AI)=0.9985；三个AIDE检查点因共享预处理而共同失败；quorum规则可避免此问题；Corpus A存在严重的类别条件JPEG偏置。
AI.conclusion: 融合只有在目标域重拟合时才值得成本；单语料不足以评测；弃权是真实且相关的但被错误处理；Corpus A的JPEG偏置限制了所有域内结果。代码、工具、哈希标识工件和全部更正已公开。

title: Why Directly Learning Periodic Trajectories Can Fail
summary: Operator learning of periodic solutions requires deciding how simulation data should be recorded and represented. A natural choice is to integrate long enough for transients to decay and record a window wide enough to contain at least one full period of all trajectories. We find that these conservative choices can make the resulting trajectories difficult to learn, even when the underlying periodic orbits vary regularly with system parameters. Unaligned trajectories generalize poorly even within the training distribution. Phase alignment substantially improves in-distribution generalization, but models trained on a fixed physical-time window still have large errors on trajectories with periods outside the training range. We explain both failures through a common mechanism: frequency differences accumulate over time, so the target phase varies rapidly with the parameters. Predictors that cannot track this variation incur a population MSE floor in both settings; for fixed window prediction, we also derive a per-sample lower bound. We then study one of the simplest representations that escape these floors: learning an aligned, normalized waveform and its period separately. We establish regularity of the decoupled targets under ODE assumptions and show experimentally that this approach avoids both failures in ODE systems and a PDE case study.

AI.tldr: 本文分析周期解算子学习中数据表示的影响，揭示相位对齐和固定时间窗导致的泛化失败机制，并提出解耦学习归一化波形与周期的方法来克服这些问题。
AI.motivation: 周期解算子学习中，常用的保守数据采样策略（长时间积分消除瞬态、记录足够宽的窗口包含完整周期）会导致轨迹难以学习，即使周期轨道随参数规律变化。作者希望理解这些失败的根源并找到解决方案。
AI.method: 通过理论分析揭示共同机制：频率差异随时间累积导致目标相位随参数快速变化，无法追踪此变化的预测器会产生群体MSE下限（固定窗预测还有逐样本下界）。随后研究一种简单表示：分别学习对齐归一化的波形和其周期，并在ODE假设下建立解耦目标的规律性。
AI.result: 未对齐轨迹即使在训练分布内泛化也很差；相位对齐能显著改善分布内泛化，但固定物理时间窗训练的模型对超出训练范围的周期轨迹仍有大误差。解耦波形与周期的方法在ODE系统和PDE案例中均避免了上述两种失败。
AI.conclusion: 周期解算子学习的关键在于数据表示：应分别学习相位对齐的归一化波形和周期，以避免频率差异累积导致的泛化下限，该方法在ODE和PDE任务中均有效。

title: Compositional Safety Failures in Harness Evolution: Identification and Runtime Monitoring
summary: Self-evolving agent harnesses continually update persistent components such as memory, prompts, skills, and tools. We call this process harness evolution. However, such evolution could introduce unexpected safety risks. Existing work studies harness misevolution and validates candidate harnesses or attributed individual component updates, leaving safety analysis of cross-component update interactions largely unexamined. To address this gap, we study compositional safety failures in harness evolution, where interactions among individually safe and utility-preserving component updates can produce undesirable or unsafe agent behavior, revealing a safety risk intrinsic to harness evolution. Across three safety-related benchmarks, we identify 43 pairwise and 18 irreducible 3-way compositional safety failures. Conventional solution incurs combinatorial complexity in validating cross-component interactions, leaving the safety checking impractical as the harness evolves. To solve this, we introduced a typed hypergraph that represents component states as nodes and safety-relevant higher-order interactions as hyperedges. When the harness changes, the hypergraph updates only the interaction neighborhood of the changed states rather than reconstructing the global composition space. Building on that, we develop a hypergraph-guided runtime monitoring mechanism. Experiments show that our method effectively mitigates compositional safety risks while preserving task utility and reducing interaction-checking costs, and further reveal an empirical safety-utility-cost trade-off across different safety mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自演化agent harness中的"组合性安全失效"，提出用类型化超图表示组件组合并实现运行时监控，有效缓解风险并降低成本。
AI.motivation: 现有工作仅研究harness误演化或单独验证候选harness及归因的单个组件更新，未考察跨组件更新交互的安全分析，存在研究空白。作者发现单独安全且保持效用不降的组件更新之间交互可能产生不安全agent行为，这是harness演化内在的安全风险。
AI.method: 在三个安全基准上识别出43个两两组合性安全失效和18个不可约的三元组合性安全失效。由于传统方案验证跨组件交互面临组合爆炸，提出类型化超图：以组件状态为节点、安全相关高阶交互为超边；harness变化时仅更新变化状态的交互邻域，而非重建全局组合空间。基于此开发超图引导的运行时监控机制。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法有效缓解组合性安全风险，同时保持任务效用、降低交互检查成本；并揭示不同安全机制间存在经验性的安全-效用-成本权衡。
AI.conclusion: 组合性安全失效是harness演化的内在风险，类型化超图与运行时监控为可扩展的安全保障提供可行方案，并揭示安全、效用与成本之间的权衡关系。

title: PC-SubMax: Efficient Prompt Compression via Regularized Submodular Maximization
summary: While large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in long-context scenarios, lengthy prompts can increase inference costs and latency and exacerbate the ``lost-in-the-middle'' phenomenon. Selective prompt compression offers a model-agnostic approach to alleviating these issues. However, methods based on fixed token- or sentence-level importance scores may overlook how content contributions change with the selected subset, limiting their ability to account for inter-sentence redundancy. Compression procedures that rely on autoregressive LLM scoring can also introduce substantial overhead. We propose PC-SubMax, a theoretically grounded framework that formulates selective prompt compression as regularized monotone submodular maximization under a knapsack constraint. The objective is $U(S)-\ell(S)$, where the monotone submodular utility $U$ combines information coverage, query relevance, and log-determinant diversity, and the non-negative modular penalty $\ell$ captures token cost. Through diminishing marginal returns, the objective evaluates each sentence's contribution relative to the selected content. To optimize this objective, we develop the Regularized Greedy+Max (RGM) algorithm, which deterministically returns a feasible set $Q$ satisfying $U(Q)-\ell(Q)\geq \frac{1}{2}U(O)-\ell(O)$, where $O$ is an optimal feasible solution to the regularized problem. RGM uses $O(nκ)$ value-oracle queries, where $n$ is the number of candidate sentences and $κ$ is the maximum feasible subset size. PC-SubMax uses encoder representations and avoids autoregressive LLM scoring during compression. Experiments across seven diverse benchmarks demonstrate competitive downstream performance with low compression overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出PC-SubMax，将选择性提示压缩建模为背包约束下的正则化单调子模最大化，用RGM算法高效求解，兼顾性能与低开销。
AI.motivation: 长上下文LLM推理成本高、延迟大，且存在"迷失在中间"问题。现有基于固定token或句子重要性分数的压缩方法忽视内容贡献随所选子集变化，难以处理句子间冗余；依赖自回归LLM打分的压缩流程开销也很大。
AI.method: 将选择性提示压缩形式化为背包约束下的正则化单调子模最大化，目标为U(S)−ℓ(S)：单调子模效用U融合信息覆盖、查询相关性和对数行列式多样性，模块化惩罚ℓ表示token成本。提出RGM（Regularized Greedy+Max）算法进行优化，使用编码器表示，压缩过程无需自回归LLM打分。
AI.result: RGM确定性返回可行集Q，满足U(Q)−ℓ(Q)≥½U(O)−ℓ(O)（O为最优解），使用O(nκ)次价值预言机查询（n为候选句数，κ为最大可行子集大小）。在七个多样基准上实现有竞争力的下游性能且压缩开销低。
AI.conclusion: PC-SubMax为提示压缩提供了有理论保证、模型无关且高效的框架，通过子模最大化的边际收益递减机制动态评估句子贡献，在多种任务上兼顾效果与效率。

title: Dimension-Specific Imbalance and an Adaptive Hybrid Label Strategy for Multi-Task Affective State Recognition in Classroom Video
summary: Recognition of student affective states from classroom video is constrained by a class imbalance problem whose true nature is, we argue, under-analyzed. We show that on DAiSEE -- the de facto benchmark for this task -- class imbalance is fundamentally a dimension-specific phenomenon: raw imbalance ratios reach as high as approximately 79:1 (Frustration), and the structure of imbalance -- not only its magnitude -- varies across dimensions, so uniform algorithmic treatments (aggressive class reweighting, focal loss, uniform binary simplification) fail in dimension-dependent ways. We propose the Adaptive Hybrid Label Strategy (AHLS), which assigns four-level classification to dimensions with manageable imbalance and binary classification to severely long-tailed dimensions, coupled with a null-class placeholder mechanism that stabilizes multi-task optimization by compressing the maximum effective inverse-frequency weight ratio from as high as ~79$\times$ to at most ~8.5$\times$ across the four dimensions. Validated on a lightweight FERShuffleNetV2 + LTCN architecture (0.39 M parameters, 0.07 G FLOPs), the strategy attains the highest mean Macro-F1 of 47.70% across all four affective dimensions among 11 compared methods, including five state-of-the-art deep models (up to 167$\times$ larger) and five traditional machine-learning baselines. A cross-model behavioral analysis on DAiSEE indicates that, in this setting, classification strategy may influence minority-state recognition more strongly than further backbone scaling alone. We also report evidence of an annotation-density limitation of DAiSEE on minority affective states, which suggests that benchmark design may bound future progress as much as algorithmic refinement. Index Terms Affective computing, classroom video analysis, class imbalance, multi-task learning, lightweight deep learning, DAiSEE, engagement recognition.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出DAiSEE基准上的类别不平衡本质是"维度特定"现象，并提出自适应混合标签策略(AHLS)以缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 课堂视频中学生情感状态识别受类别不平衡困扰，而这一问题的真实性质此前分析不足。作者发现DAiSEE上的不平衡是维度特定的：原始不平衡比高达约79:1，且不平衡的结构（不仅是幅度）在不同维度间不同，导致统一算法处理(如重加权、focal loss、二元简化)以维度相关的方式失效。
AI.method: 提出自适应混合标签策略(AHLS)：对不平衡可控的维度采用四级分类，对严重长尾维度采用二元分类；并引入空类占位机制(null-class placeholder)稳定多任务优化，将最大有效逆频权重比从约79倍压缩至最多约8.5倍。基于轻量级FERShuffleNetV2+LTCN架构(0.39M参数,0.07 G FLOPs)验证。
AI.result: 在四个情感维度上取得最高平均Macro-F1为47.70%，优于11种对比方法（含5个SOTA深度模型，最大达167倍参数量，及5个传统机器学习基线）。跨模型行为分析表明，在此设定下分类策略对少数类识别的影响可能强于进一步扩大骨干网络。同时报告了DAiSEE在少数情感状态上的标注密度局限。
AI.conclusion: DAiSEE的类别不平衡是维度特定现象，需针对性策略而非统一处理；AHLS有效提升性能且分类策略比骨干扩展更关键。基准设计的标注密度局限可能像算法改进一样限制未来进展。

title: Clarify the User or Verify the World? Uncertainty Routing for Proactive Agents
summary: Tool-using LLM agents must decide not only whether additional information is needed, but also which source can resolve the uncertainty. Existing proactive approaches often specialize in either user clarification or environment verification, without explicitly determining the appropriate information source for each decision. We formulate this problem as uncertainty routing among ACT, CLARIFY, and VERIFY, and propose PROUR, a proactive uncertainty routing framework. PROUR decomposes action uncertainty into disagreement across plausible user-goal interpretations, which signals user-side ambiguity, and the entropy remaining within each interpretation, which signals missing world-side evidence. To acquire information from the routed source, a query generator is trained with a mode-conditioned information-gain reward, targeting user-goal identification under CLARIFY and next-action identification under VERIFY. On $τ$-bench, PROUR achieves 28.17% average success rate across retail and airline, outperforming the strongest prior method by 4.57% while using 2.17 fewer interaction steps. The learned policy further generalizes to stronger task agents and transactional domains of $τ^3$-bench without retraining, demonstrating the benefit of source-aligned uncertainty resolution for proactive agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PROUR框架，将工具使用型LLM智能体的主动信息获取问题形式化为ACT/CLARIFY/VERIFY之间的不确定性路由，并通过对不确定性来源（用户侧歧义vs世界侧证据缺失）的分解实现来源对齐的信息获取。
AI.motivation: 现有主动方法通常只专注于用户澄清或环境验证之一，未能显式判断每个决策应使用哪种信息来源，因此难以在需要信息时选对来源。
AI.method: 将动作不确定性分解为：不同用户目标解释间的分歧（信号用户侧歧义，路由到CLARIFY）与单一解释内残留熵（信号世界侧证据缺失，路由到VERIFY）；并用模式条件的信息增益奖励训练查询生成器，CLARIFY下目标为用户目标识别，VERIFY下目标为下一动作识别。
AI.result: 在τ-bench上，零售与航空任务平均成功率达28.17%，比最强基线高4.57%，交互步数少2.17步；学习到的策略无需再训练即可泛化到更强的任务智能体及τ³-bench的事务性领域。
AI.conclusion: 来源对齐的不确定性解决能有效提升主动式智能体性能，表明显式进行不确定性路由是构建主动工具使用智能体的有益方向。

title: On Device Agentic Operation Caches -- Classifier-Centric NL-to-Action Generation
summary:
Agentic AI is increasingly being embedded in software applications to provide natural language interfaces to features and functionality. In most cases these agents are powered by enterprise (100+ billion parameter) or frontier class large language models that require substantial computational resources run and depend on cloud hosted inference to handle the task of transforming natural language inputs into actionable software operations. This reliance on cloud-hosted inference introduces substantial network latency on top of LLM inference times, creates data privacy concerns, and, given the costs of running these models, can rapidly escalate expenses associated with supporting agentic features.
  This paper introduces a novel means of converting the NL-to-Action problem from a generative one into a classification-centric formulation via on-device operation caches. These caches allow an agentic system to handle frequently occurring classes of actions completely on-device -- reducing latency, enhancing privacy, and lowering operational costs. We show that for a classic NL-to-Formula task, generating Excel Formula in response to user requests, this approach reduces total inference cost by 56% when compared to cloud-only model-routing based inference and, on cache hits, reduces the latency to response latency by 5x.

AI.tldr: 论文提出通过端侧操作缓存将自然语言到动作(NL-to-Action)任务从生成式问题转化为分类式问题，可在设备上处理高频动作类别，显著降低延迟、增强隐私并降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 现有智能代理依赖云端大规模语言模型(百亿至前沿级)进行推理，带来三大问题：网络延迟叠加LLM推理时间、数据隐私担忧，以及高昂的运营成本，尤其在支持代理功能时费用迅速攀升。
AI.method: 引入端侧操作缓存，将NL-to-Action从生成式建模重构为分类中心化的公式。缓存使代理系统能完全在设备端处理高频出现的动作类别，仅在未命中缓存时才回退到云端模型。
AI.result: 在经典的NL-to-Formula任务(根据用户请求生成Excel公式)上，该方法相比纯云端路由式推理将总推理成本降低56%，且在缓存命中时将延迟降至响应延迟的1/5(提速5倍)。
AI.conclusion: 将NL-to-Action转化为分类问题并结合端侧缓存，是一种有效降低延迟、成本和提升隐私的实用方案，特别适用于高频动作场景。

title: Explaining Textual Entailment with Lexical Entailments: Using LLMs to Supply Lexical Relations for Formal Proofs
comment: Accepted at the 11th Workshop on Automated Knowledge Base Construction (AKBC 2026)
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are highly capable of natural language reasoning and appear to store a great deal of lexical knowledge, but it is still unclear how much of this knowledge they actually use when reasoning, and whether they use it in the right way. On the other hand, logic-based Natural Language Inference (NLI) systems provide transparent and formally grounded reasoning, but they need to be supplied with rich lexical knowledge to prove inferences beyond purely logical ones. In this paper, we evaluate whether LLMs can identify all lexical knowledge needed to solve NLI problems and how much this knowledge contributes to proof search in a logic-based NLI system. Our research focuses exclusively on structured lexical entailments (e.g., chinchilla$\sqsubseteq$small animal) as a proxy for structured explanations for NLI problems with an entailment label. First, we curate a dataset for a new task of explaining sentential entailments with a set of lexical entailments. The dataset is used to intrinsically evaluate LLMs on generating structured lexical explanations. Then, we use NLI as an extrinsic evaluation in a simple neuro-symbolic setting, assessing whether LLMs can supply sufficient lexical relations to LangPro, a natural-logic theorem prover for natural language. The results show that the proposed task remains challenging even for hosted proprietary LLMs, and that their contribution to theorem proving is moderate: generated relations are often only partially sound and may be tailored to the specific NLI problem rather than representing generally valid lexical knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文评估LLMs能否识别求解NLI所需的全部词汇知识，以及这些知识对逻辑化NLI系统证明搜索的贡献，聚焦于结构化词汇蕴含关系。
AI.motivation: LLMs擅长自然语言推理且存储大量词汇知识，但不确定其在推理时实际使用了多少知识、使用方式是否正确；而逻辑化NLI系统虽透明、形式化，却需要丰富的词汇知识来证明超出纯逻辑的推理。因此需要评估LLMs识别结构化词汇蕴含关系的能力及其对逻辑化NLI系统的贡献。
AI.method: 首先构建一个新任务的数据集，即用一组词汇蕴含关系来解释句子级蕴含，用于内在评估LLMs生成结构化词汇解释的能力；然后在简单神经符号设置中，用NLI作为外在评估，考察LLMs能否为自然逻辑定理证明器LangPro提供充分的词汇关系。
AI.result: 所提任务即使对托管的专有LLMs也仍具挑战性；生成的关系对定理证明的贡献有限，往往仅部分合理，且可能针对特定NLI问题定制，而非代表普遍有效的词汇知识。
AI.conclusion: LLMs在识别求解NLI所需的结构化词汇知识方面能力有限，其生成的关系对逻辑化NLI系统的证明搜索贡献中等，且质量和通用性存在不足。

title: EgoTSR++: Egocentric Spatiotemporal Reasoning for Task Progress Understanding
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have advanced rapidly in static visual understanding, yet remain unreliable when judging how an egocentric task is progressing. Given a task instruction and two visual observations, a model should determine which state is closer to the goal by analyzing task-relevant object configurations and spatial relations, rather than relying on timestamps or presentation order. This distinction is critical in manipulation, where retries, corrective actions, and temporary regressions make progress inherently non-monotonic. We introduce EgoTSR, a unified framework for diagnosing and improving order-robust task-progress understanding. First, SpatialLogic-Bench evaluates each physical state pair in both original and order-swapped presentations across short- and long-horizon settings, exposing whether a model follows task-state evidence or chronological shortcuts. Second, our data construction pipeline converts successful, approximately monotonic manipulation and first-person trajectories into bidirectional supervision; LongTag further preserves intermediate subtask structure for long-horizon comparison, while failure-aware data extend learning to regressions and recoveries. Third, a progressive CoT-to-Tag curriculum first supervises evidence-grounded interpretation of task-relevant state changes and then consolidates the comparison rule through scalable label-only training. Experiments reveal substantial input-order bias in representative VLMs. EgoTSR achieves 92.4% long-horizon accuracy with a 0.1-point forward-inverse Gap. Failure-aware supervision further improves accuracy on non-monotonic trajectories by 11.8 points and Recovery Accuracy by 11.2 points, while maintaining broad visual and spatial capabilities. These results establish goal-conditioned state comparison as an explicit formulation of egocentric spatiotemporal reasoning for task-progress understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出EgoTSR框架，通过SpatialLogic-Bench诊断VLM输入顺序偏差，并用数据构造与CoT-to-Tag课程学习提升自我中心任务进度理解。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在静态视觉理解上进步迅速，但在判断自我中心任务进展时不可靠，容易依赖时间戳或呈现顺序而非任务状态证据。操纵任务中存在重试、纠正与暂时回退，使进展非单调，这一问题尤为关键。
AI.method: EgoTSR统一框架包含三部分：(1) SpatialLogic-Bench在原始与顺序交换两种呈现下评估短/长时域状态对，揭示模型是否依赖时间捷径；(2) 数据构造流水线将近似单调的成功操纵与第一人称轨迹转为双向监督，LongTag保留中间子任务结构，失败感知数据覆盖回退与恢复；(3) 渐进式CoT-to-Tag课程先监督基于证据的状态变化解释，再通过可扩展的仅标签训练巩固比较规则。
AI.result: 代表性VLM存在显著输入顺序偏差。EgoTSR取得92.4%长时域准确率，正向-逆向差距仅0.1点；失败感知监督使非单调轨迹准确率提升11.8点，恢复准确率提升11.2点，并保持广泛的视觉与空间能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将目标条件状态比较确立为自我中心时空推理用于任务进度理解的显式形式化，有效缓解顺序偏差并提升非单调任务进展判断。

title: LAM: Efficient Lossy Agent Memory Framework With A Retrieval-Score Error Bound
summary: Agent memory grows as agents read inputs, reason, and call tools. Longer histories increase inference cost and eventually exceed the context window. LLM-based summarization reduces this history but adds latency and provides no explicit bound on information loss. We propose LAM, a Lossy Agent Memory system with three components: a deterministic deduplication rule with a substitution bound on retrieval scores - a bound on score perturbation, not a certificate of unchanged ranking; a memory manager that preserves the cached prefix and overlaps compaction with inference; and a performance model that estimates compaction costs before deployment. On 600 agent trajectories, LAM removes 22.47% of observation tokens while retaining 99.984% of the measured gold-patch evidence. At a fixed deletion set, the performance model predicts a 71.4x-91.6x end-to-end speedup from removing records before prefill instead of deleting them from a prefilled context. That benefit comes from the schedule rather than the rule and applies to any prefix-preserving test.

AI.tldr: 提出LAM，一种有损Agent记忆系统，通过确定性去重、保留前缀的记忆管理和性能模型，在去除冗余token的同时保持证据完整性并大幅提升速度。
AI.motivation: Agent记忆随读取输入、推理和工具调用不断增长，导致推理成本上升并最终超出上下文窗口。LLM摘要虽能压缩历史，但增加延迟且无法对信息损失给出显式边界。
AI.method: LAM包含三部分：1）确定性去重规则，带检索分数替换界限（即分数扰动界限，而非排名不变的保证）；2）记忆管理器，保留缓存前缀并将压缩与推理重叠；3）性能模型，在部署前估计压缩成本。
AI.result: 在600条Agent轨迹上，LAM去除22.47%的观察token，同时保留99.984%的测量金标patch证据。在固定删除集下，性能模型预测：在prefill前移除记录相比从已prefill上下文中删除，可实现71.4x-91.6x的端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: 该加速收益来自调度策略而非去重规则本身，且适用于任何前缀保持的测试。

title: EngIntervene: Benchmarking Multimodal Engineering State Understanding and Design Intervention Reasoning
summary: Multimodal engineering benchmarks largely evaluate static understanding, such as recognizing components, interpreting diagrams, or answering technical questions. This leaves a missing middle between engineering perception and full design generation: whether a model can use an understood system state to reason about relations, constraints, and the consequences of design changes. We introduce \textsc{EngIntervene}, a benchmark for this capability. It contains 3,229 questions across seven engineering domains and organizes evaluation into four levels: state grounding (T1), relational and mechanistic reasoning (T2), constraint-aware diagnosis (T3), and intervention reasoning (T4), which asks whether a proposed modification achieves its target while preserving required constraints. The tasks instantiate a unified engineering state representation spanning objects, relations, constraints, and design objectives, and T2--T4 are scored against structured reference answers with atomic criteria. Across open- and closed-weight multimodal models, stronger grounding does not reliably translate into better diagnosis or intervention, and the best open-weight model trails the best closed model by 14.7 percentage points on the T2--T4 average. Removing or shuffling visual evidence consistently degrades performance, while benchmark-specific supervised fine-tuning improves T1 but not T2--T4. T4 further exposes a large gap between satisfying individual revision criteria and producing a fully valid intervention. Engineering reasoning thus requires not only recovering the current state, but also reliably using it to reason about constraints and post-intervention consequences. Code and benchmark artifacts are available at https://github.com/changcv2021/EngIntervene

AI.tldr: 提出EngIntervene基准，评估多模态模型在工程感知与设计生成之间的"干预推理"能力，含3229题、七领域、四层级，发现模型接地能力与诊断/干预能力脱节。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态工程基准多评估静态理解（识别组件、解读图、答技术题），缺失"理解系统状态后推理关系、约束及设计变更后果"这一中间能力。
AI.method: 构建EngIntervene基准，3229题跨7个工程领域，分四级：T1状态接地、T2关系与机制推理、T3约束诊断、T4干预推理。采用统一工程状态表示（对象、关系、约束、设计目标），T2–T4用结构化参考答案+原子准则评分。
AI.result: 开放/闭源多模态模型上：更强的接地并不带来更好的诊断或干预；开源最佳模型在T2–T4平均上落后闭源最佳14.7个百分点。移除/打乱视觉证据持续降低性能；基准专用SFT提升T1但无益于T2–T4。T4暴露满足单项修正准则与产出完整有效干预间的巨大差距。
AI.conclusion: 工程推理不仅需恢复当前状态，还需可靠地用它推理约束及干预后后果。

title: Locally Sound, Globally Insufficient: The Local-Global Gap in Multi-Hop Reasoning
summary: Reliable multi-hop reasoning requires more than locally supported steps: a trace can be sound at every reasoning step yet still fail to answer the question as a whole. We call this failure regime the local-global gap (LGG), in which the trace is locally sound yet globally insufficient. Local soundness requires each step to be supported by the available evidence and preceding steps, whereas global sufficiency requires the reasoning trace to align with the question and establish the submitted answer. In a human-adjudicated diagnostic of 2,598 responses across three multi-hop QA benchmarks and three models, we find that the LGG occurs in every benchmark-model combination and accounts for nearly half of globally insufficient responses overall. However, conventional faithfulness verifiers that check claims against the evidence largely miss these failures: at thresholds retaining at least 95% of reliable traces, recall for LGG cases is substantially lower than that for locally unsound traces. To address these failures, we formalize three dependencies for reliable reasoning: evidence-to-step support, question-to-trace alignment, and trace-to-answer closure. Instead of post-hoc diagnosis, we introduce E-Closure to supervise these dependencies during training, combining generation supervision on supported original and counterfactual responses with bidirectional switching constraints. Averaged over three benchmarks and three backbones, existing fine-tuning baselines improve accuracy and local soundness over the base models, but at the cost of global sufficiency. E-Closure improves both: among all fine-tuned methods, it achieves the highest average accuracy (92.8%) and trace reliability (89.0%) while yielding the lowest LGG rate (6.2%).

AI.tldr: 论文提出"局部-全局鸿沟"(LGG)概念：推理每步局部可靠但整体不足以回答问题，发现该失败普遍存在且传统忠实性验证器难以捕捉，进而提出E-Closure在训练中监督三类依赖关系。
AI.motivation: 多跳推理中，推理链可能在每一步都有证据支持(局部可靠)，但整体仍然无法回答问题(全局不足)。现有忠实性验证器只检验声明与证据的一致性，会遗漏这类失败。作者希望通过人工程度诊断量化LGG的普遍性，并提出解决方法。
AI.method: 先对3个多跳QA基准、3个模型共2,598条回答进行人工裁定以诊断LGG。随后形式化可靠推理的三类依赖：证据到步骤的支持、问题到推理链的对齐、推理链到答案的闭合。提出E-Closure，在训练时监督这些依赖，结合对原始与反事实回答的生成监督以及双向切换约束。
AI.result: LGG在所有基准-模型组合中均出现，占全局不足回答近一半。传统忠实性验证器在保留至少95%可靠推理链的阈值下，对LGG的召回率明显低于局部不可靠案例。E-Closure在3基准3骨干上平均准确率92.8%、推理链可靠性89.0%，LGG率仅6.2%，优于所有微调基线。
AI.conclusion: 现有微调基线提升准确率与局部可靠性但牺牲全局充分性；E-Closure能同时改善准确率、推理链可靠性与全局充分性，有效缓解局部-全局鸿沟。

title: Calibration-Free Surface Normals Estimation in Vision-Based Tactile Sensing using Universal Photometric Stereo
summary: Vision-based tactile sensors are a popular solution for capturing rich contact surface geometry. However, to obtain high-detail contact surface normals and depth, it is necessary to calibrate the sensor by physically pressing a probe with known geometry against the sensor elastomer and mapping tactile images onto the ground truth probe's shape. This approach does not scale across different tactile sensors, and the calibration effort can be complex depending on the sensor shape and optical system. Instead, we propose a calibration-free procedure for the estimation of contact surface normals using Universal Photometric Stereo neural networks. In a series of real-world experiments, we evaluate our approach on 3 sensors with different optical systems, demonstrating that universal methods are a suitable approach for estimating surface normals at the contact patch from tactile images, thereby alleviating the need for tactile sensor calibration. Controlled experiments with a metal ball show that universal methods match the calibrated method, with a mean angular error of $6.56^{\Large\circ}$. We show that the proposed framework recovers high-frequency surface details of objects with natural textures, achieving an overall mean angular error of $10.66^{\Large\circ}$. Universal method robustly recovers the contact surface normals captured with dome-shaped Digit 360, achieving a low angular discrepancy of $10.18^{\Large\circ}$ relative to the calibrated baseline. This experiment demonstrates that with sufficient illumination settings surface normals could be estimated using a model trained solely on synthetic data. By providing a unified representation of contact surfaces across different vision-based tactile sensor designs, Universal Photometric Stereo neural networks lay the foundation for transferable tactile perception across sensors.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免标定方法，利用通用光度立体网络从触觉图像估计接触表面法线，在多传感器上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 基于视觉的触觉传感器需通过物理按压已知几何探针来标定，才能获得高精度接触表面法线与深度；该方法难以扩展到不同传感器，且标定复杂度取决于传感器形状与光学系统。
AI.method: 采用通用光度立体（Universal Photometric Stereo）神经网络，无需标定即可从触觉图像估计接触表面法线。
AI.result: 在3种不同光学系统的传感器上开展实验：金属球对照实验平均角度误差6.56°；自然纹理物体高频细节恢复整体平均角度误差10.66°；Digit 360圆顶传感器相对标定基线角度差异10.18°。
AI.conclusion: 通用方法可替代触觉传感器标定，提供跨传感器设计的统一接触表面表示，为可迁移触觉感知奠定基础。

title: Prefill-Free Cross-Family KV Cache Transfer for Heterogeneous Multi-Agent LLMs
summary: Recent multi-agent LLM systems increasingly combine heterogeneous models for specialized agent roles. However, text-based communication requires each receiver to prefill shared context already processed by the sender. Reusing the sender's key-value (KV) cache avoids this redundancy, but prefill-free transfer across model families must handle differences in tokenization, model depth, and KV representations. To address these issues, we propose \textit{HeteroFold}, a prefill-free cross-family KV cache transfer method that keeps both the sender and receiver frozen. HeteroFold aligns model structures, maps the sender cache into the receiver space, and calibrates it to preserve receiver behavior. Across six transfer directions, HeteroFold achieves the best cache-transfer performance on all four long-context benchmarks and most short-context settings. It also matches text-based communication on the multi-agent benchmark. At 32K context length, Llama-3.1-8B$\rightarrow$Ministral-3-14B transfer is $10.7\times$ faster than Native Prefill and $1.18$--$1.47\times$ faster than the state-of-the-art prefill-free baselines, Dense Latent and KV Ridge. These results show that HeteroFold enables efficient cross-family KV reuse without receiver prefill.

AI.tldr: 提出HeteroFold，一种无需预填的跨模型家族KV缓存传输方法，在保持收发双方冻结的前提下实现高效复用。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM系统组合异构模型，但基于文本的通信要求接收方重新预填发送方已处理的共享上下文，造成冗余。直接复用发送方KV缓存虽可避免冗余，但跨模型家族传输需解决tokenization、模型深度和KV表示差异。
AI.method: HeteroFold对齐模型结构，将发送方缓存映射到接收方空间，并进行校准以保持接收方行为，收发双方均保持冻结。
AI.result: 在六个传输方向上，于四个长上下文基准上取得最佳缓存传输性能，多数短上下文设置亦领先；在多智能体基准上匹配文本通信效果。32K上下文下，Llama-3.1-8B→Ministral-3-14B传输比Native Prefill快10.7倍，比最先进的无预填基线Dense Latent和KV Ridge快1.18–1.47倍。
AI.conclusion: HeteroFold实现了高效的跨家族KV复用，无需接收方预填。

title: InfoEdit: Probing Global Layout Reasoning in Infographic Editing
summary: Multimodal foundation models edit natural photographs at production quality, yet the same models struggle with structured visual content such as infographics. Unlike photographs, infographics encode information through logical relations; editing one element often requires surrounding elements to be adapted. We refer to this global layout reasoning capability as reflow. Existing image-editing benchmarks neither provide a dedicated setting for structured visual content nor evaluate the reflow capability. We introduce InfoEdit, a novel benchmark of 1,000 infographics across eight logical-relation families, paired with 4,000 editing instructions across four editing tasks, and a reflow-aware evaluation protocol. Across eight frontier editors, only GPT-Image-2 clears 60% average success rate; most models fall below 7%, and no editor exceeds 36% on the Swap-Block task even with perfect target localization. We further show that code-level editing can match the strongest pixel-level editor, revealing complementary strengths across tasks. InfoEdit identifies reflow as a central challenge in structured visual content editing and provides a diagnostic benchmark to facilitate future progress.

AI.tldr: 现有图像编辑基准缺乏针对结构化视觉内容（信息图）的评测，本文提出 InfoEdit 基准，包含 1000 张信息图、4000 条编辑指令与具备 reflow 意识的评测协议，揭示主流编辑模型在全局布局推理上的显著不足。
AI.motivation: 多模态基础模型在自然照片编辑上已达生产级质量，但在信息图等结构化视觉内容上表现不佳。信息图通过逻辑关系编码信息，编辑单个元素往往需要联动调整周边元素（即 reflow 全局布局推理），而现有基准既无专门设定也未评测该能力。
AI.method: 构建 InfoEdit 基准：涵盖八大逻辑关系族、共 1000 张信息图，配套四类编辑任务下的 4000 条编辑指令，并设计 reflow 感知的评测协议；对八个前沿编辑器进行评测，同时对比代码级编辑与像素级编辑的表现。
AI.result: 仅 GPT-Image-2 平均成功率超过 60%，多数模型低于 7%；即使目标定位完美，Swap-Block 任务上也无编辑器超过 36%。代码级编辑可媲美最强像素级编辑器，两者在不同任务上优势互补。
AI.conclusion: InfoEdit 将 reflow 确认为结构化视觉内容编辑的核心挑战，并提供一个诊断性基准，以推动该方向的后续研究进展。

title: Learning an Anchored Prompt Space for Continual Adaptation of Large Language Models
summary: Continually adapting large language models requires acquiring new knowledge while preserving previously learned capabilities. Jointly adapting model parameters and task-specific soft prompts offers a promising solution, but faces two key limitations: historical prompts may become less effective as the model evolves, while their transferable cross-task relationships are not explicitly learned. We propose Learning an Anchored Prompt Space (LAPS), which preserves historical prompt effectiveness and learns relationships among task-specific soft prompts to facilitate positive transfer. LAPS first aligns historical prompts with the updated model through self-distillation. LAPS then constructs an anchored prompt space whose vertices correspond to learned task-specific soft prompts and whose intermediate geometry is shaped by learnable Bézier control prompts. Once this anchored prompt space is learned, LAPS identifies the best-performing prompt for each task on its validation set, allowing the optimized prompt to draw on knowledge acquired from observed tasks. Experiments on the TRACE benchmark across three Qwen3 model scales show that LAPS consistently outperforms distillation-based, prompt-based, and joint prompt--parameter adaptation baselines, improving average performance while reducing forgetting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LAPS（Learning an Anchored Prompt Space），通过自蒸馏对齐历史提示、构建锚定提示空间并学习任务软提示间的几何关系，实现大语言模型持续适应的正向迁移。
AI.motivation: 持续适应大语言模型需在获取新知识的同时保留旧能力。联合调整模型参数与任务软提示是有前景的方案，但存在两个问题：一是历史提示随模型演化而失效；二是提示间可迁移的跨任务关系未被显式学习。
AI.method: LAPS首先通过自蒸馏将历史提示与更新后的模型对齐；然后构建锚定提示空间，其顶点对应已学习的任务软提示，中间几何由可学习的贝塞尔控制提示塑造；空间学好后，在验证集上为每个任务选择表现最佳的提示，使优化提示能利用已观测任务的知识。
AI.result: 在TRACE基准上，三个Qwen3模型规模均显示LAPS持续优于基于蒸馏、基于提示以及提示-参数联合适应基线，提升平均性能的同时减少遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 通过对齐历史提示并显式建模提示间的跨任务关系，LAPS有效兼顾新旧能力，提升了持续学习中的平均表现并缓解遗忘。

title: Gauge-Equivariant Attention for Rotation-Stable $360^\circ$ Scene Understanding
comment: 23 pages. Accepted to ACM Transactions on Graphics (SIGGRAPH Asia 2026)
summary: Panoramic $360^\circ$ scene understanding increasingly relies on icosphere transformers, but a state-of-the-art spherical model loses more than half of its segmentation accuracy when the camera rotates by $90^\circ$, and controlled ablations identify gauge dependence in its relative-position bias as a major contributor. We propose gauge-equivariant relative position encoding (GE-RPE): a parameter-free Reynolds average of the bias over a finite cyclic subgroup $C_n\!\subset\!\mathrm{SO}(2)$ of gauge rotations. Plugged into a SphereUFormer backbone the change is invisible at deployment---zero added parameters and $1.5$--$4.4\%$ forward latency---and the matched three-seed GE-RPE model records a $1.3\%$ drop; the published SphereUFormer checkpoint records $53\%$ under the same stress protocol but a different training recipe. Once the gauge defect is removed and a teacher-token permutation $π_R$ aligns the SSL views to the rotated student frame, iBOT$+$MAE pretraining stops being a liability and becomes a clean low-label lever: the full framework EquiSSL (GE-RPE $+$ $π_R$ $+$ iBOT$+$MAE) tightens the drop to $0.8\%$ at $68.30\%$ val mIoU and lifts $1\%$-label fine-tuning by $+2.39$ mIoU on the $N{=}373$ test split (and by $+4.10$ on the smaller $N{=}40$ val split); the same fix carries over to monocular depth and to zero-shot Structured3D segmentation. The construction is provably $C_n$-invariant and $\mathcal{O}(n^{-2})$-close to the continuous $\mathrm{SO}(2)$ average, making the resulting model a usable $360^\circ$ visual-computing primitive across panoramic relighting, immersive video, and cross-dataset transfer. Code is available at https://github.com/Jaywalk18/equissl-release.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了球面全景模型（如SphereUFormer）存在"规范依赖性"缺陷，提出无参数的规范等变相对位置编码（GE-RPE）及教师token置换π_R，并构建EquiSSL框架，显著提升旋转鲁棒性与低标签微调性能。
AI.motivation: 全景360°场景理解 increasingly 依赖icosphere transformer，但SOTA球面模型在相机旋转90°时丢失过半分割精度。受控消融实验定位到相对位置偏置中的规范依赖性（gauge dependence）是主要病因，需从根源上解决旋转等变性问题。
AI.method: 提出GE-RPE：对偏置在规范旋转的有限循环子群C_n⊂SO(2)上取参数自由的Reynolds平均；并引入教师token置换π_R将SSL视图对齐到旋转后的学生帧；将GE-RPE+π_R+iBOT+MAE组合成EquiSSL完整框架。
AI.result: GE-RPE零新增参数、仅增1.5–4.4%前向延迟；三seed匹配模型旋转下仅掉1.3%，而原始SphereUFormer掉53%。EquiSSL将掉落收紧至0.8%，val mIoU达68.30%；1%标签微调在N=373测试集上提升+2.39 mIoU（N=40验证集+4.10）。方法可迁移至单目深度与Structured3D零样本分割。
AI.conclusion: 该构造可证明具有C_n不变性，且以O(n^-2)逼近连续SO(2)平均，使模型成为可用于全景重光照、沉浸式视频与跨数据集迁移的实用360°视觉计算原语。代码开源。

title: When Does a Skill Add Value? Task-Conditional Gain Prediction for Selective Skill Use
summary: Agent skills are expected to improve task performance. Yet we find that they often provide no benefit, and can even hurt performance while incurring additional token costs. Can we predict whether a skill will help before the agent acts? We introduce SkillDelta, a framework for predicting task-conditional skill gains from paired executions of the same agent with and without the skill. A local predictor transfers these historical gains to new tasks without retraining the agent. Under explicit transfer assumptions, our analysis links support coverage, representation mismatch, and execution noise to prediction error and decision regret. Across five benchmarks and three target agents, paired history improves observed-gain ranking over skill-assisted outcomes alone in 12 of 15 settings. At matched expected skill-use rates, SkillDelta improves success over random activation in all 15 settings, with an average absolute gain of 4.3%. Most of this advantage comes from allocation across task groups. Evidence for additional within-group selection value is strongest on ToolQA and weaker elsewhere. Code is available at https://github.com/TankTechnology/skilldelta.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SkillDelta 框架，利用同一智能体在有/无技能下的配对执行历史，预测任务条件下的技能增益，从而在行动前决定是否启用技能。
AI.motivation: 智能体技能本应提升任务表现，但实际常无收益甚至损害表现，还带来额外 token 成本；因此需要在智能体行动前预测技能是否有帮助。
AI.method: 通过对同一智能体在有技能和无技能条件下的配对执行，学习任务条件化的技能增益；使用局部预测器将历史增益迁移到新任务，无需重训练智能体；并在显式迁移假设下分析支持覆盖、表示不匹配与执行噪声对预测误差和决策遗憾的影响。
AI.result: 在 5 个基准和 3 个目标智能体上，配对历史在 15 个设置中的 12 个改善了已观察增益排序；在匹配期望技能使用率下，SkillDelta 在全部 15 个设置中优于随机激活，平均绝对成功率提升 4.3%；优势主要来自任务组间分配，组内选择价值在 ToolQA 上最强、其他场景较弱。
AI.conclusion: SkillDelta 表明可基于配对历史预测技能增益，并有效提升技能激活决策；但其收益主要来自任务组间分配，组内细粒度选择价值有限。

title: MetaBench-Harness: Unlocking End-to-End Optimization of Benchmark Harnesses
summary: Rapid progress in Large Language Models (LLMs) is saturating static benchmarks faster than they can be designed. While existing automated evolution frameworks attempt to generate harder questions by perturbing individual tasks, they remain constrained by rigid, hard-coded generation rules. Moving beyond the evolution of isolated tasks, we propose to optimize the benchmark generation workflow itself end to end with MetaBench-Harness, a dual-loop search framework. Specifically, the inner loop utilizes a benchmark harness to generate a new benchmark in each round, while the outer meta-harness orchestration layer iteratively refines and searches over harness implementations based on historical evolution trajectories. By applying MetaBench-Harness to the competitive programming CodeContests and Olympiad mathematics AIME-2024 datasets, we demonstrate that the evolved benchmarks are challenging and discriminative for frontier models. Trajectory and quality analyses verify that MetaBench-Harness enables multi-dimensional evolution, steadily improving evolution reasonableness, benchmark competency, and evaluator robustness across successive rounds. Furthermore, case studies reveal its effective utilization of diverse difficulty levers to reframe problems and elevate required capabilities. Ultimately, this work provides a solution to the pressing challenge of benchmark saturation.

AI.tldr: 提出MetaBench-Harness双环搜索框架，端到端优化基准生成工作流本身，以应对LLM使静态基准快速饱和的问题。
AI.motivation: LLM进步速度超过静态基准设计速度，现有自动演化框架仅扰动单个任务，受限于硬编码生成规则，难以持续生成高难度问题。
AI.method: 双环框架：内环用benchmark harness每轮生成新基准；外环meta-harness编排层基于历史演化轨迹迭代精炼并搜索harness实现。
AI.result: 在CodeContests编程与AIME-2024数学数据集上，演化出的基准对前沿模型具有挑战性与区分度；轨迹与质量分析显示多维度演化持续提升演化合理性、基准竞争力和评估器鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 案例研究显示其有效利用多样难度杠杆重构问题并提升所需能力，为基准饱和难题提供了解决方案。

title: When Users Change Their Minds: Measuring and Repairing Intent Drift in LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents often operate over multi-turn interactions in which user intent changes before execution. We study intent drift: the failure mode in which superseded parts of the user's intent continue to influence the final answer or tool action. We introduce IntentFlux, an executable benchmark that converts verifiable tasks into dialogues with controlled intent changes while preserving their original graders. In a 627-case calibration, mean task score falls from 0.476 to 0.384 as dialogues contain more superseded and withdrawn information. Across eight models, the rate of fully correct solutions is significantly lower when the same final task must be recovered from an evolving dialogue rather than given directly in a single turn. We further introduce StateForge, which explicitly maintains the active requirements before generation. On General-Test, it improves mean task score from 0.367 to 0.467. Providing the ground-truth final state improves performance further but still does not recover single-turn performance, indicating that state-estimation errors explain only part of the gap. These results establish intent drift as a measurable multi-turn failure mode and explicit state maintenance as a partial mitigation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"意图漂移"这一多轮对话失败模式，并构建可执行基准IntentFlux量化该问题，同时提出StateForge方法维护活跃需求以部分缓解。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体常需多轮交互，而用户意图在执行前会发生变化。然而被取代或撤回的旧意图仍会持续影响最终回答或工具调用，导致失败。作者希望将这一现象定义并量化为可测量的失败模式。
AI.method: 提出IntentFlux基准：将可验证任务转化为带有受控意图变化的对话，并保留原有评分器。通过627个案例的校准实验，跨8个模型对比"单轮直接给出"与"从演化对话中恢复最终任务"的表现。进一步提出StateForge，在生成前显式维护活跃需求。
AI.result: 627案例校准中，随着对话包含更多被取代和撤回信息，平均任务得分从0.476降至0.384。8个模型中，从演化对话恢复最终任务的完全正确率显著低于单轮直接给出。StateForge在General-Test上将平均得分从0.367提升至0.467。提供真实最终状态可进一步提升，但仍无法恢复到单轮水平。
AI.conclusion: 意图漂移是可测量的多轮失败模式，显式状态维护是部分缓解手段。但状态估计误差仅解释差距的一部分，说明还存在其他原因。

title: 3dgs-sc: a controlled static screen-content benchmark for 3d gaussian splatting
summary: Does high image fidelity imply readable screen content in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)? We introduce 3DGS-SC, a controlled static screen-content dataset and benchmark for examining this mismatch. Ten procedural scenes provide fixed multi-view splits, exact cameras, screen masks, text boxes, and transcripts. The protocol separates whole-image fidelity, screen-region fidelity, OCR readability, and edge preservation. In the reported five-method comparison, LightGaussian exceeds Mip-Splatting in screen PSNR by only 0.08 dB, yet trails it in OCR accuracy by 12.7 percentage points. Across all ten method pairs, screen-PSNR and OCR orderings disagree in seven cases. These aggregate results expose a method-selection failure of fidelity-only evaluation. Complementing prior text-aware 3DGS research, 3DGS-SC targets controlled monitor interfaces and exact annotations; scene-wise robustness and acquisition effects remain open validation questions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 3DGS-SC 数据集与基准，揭示 3DGS 中高图像保真度并不等于屏幕内容可读。
AI.motivation: 高图像保真度是否意味着 3DGS 中屏幕内容可读？作者发现二者存在错配，用仅依赖保真度的评测会导致错误的方法选择。
AI.method: 构建 3DGS-SC：10 个程序化场景，固定多视角划分、精确相机、屏幕掩码、文本框与转录文本；评测协议分离整图保真度、屏幕区域保真度、OCR 可读性、边缘保持。
AI.result: 五方法对比中，LightGaussian 屏幕 PSNR 仅超 Mip-Splatting 0.08 dB，但 OCR 准确率落后 12.7 个百分点；10 组方法对中，屏幕 PSNR 与 OCR 排序有 7 组不一致。
AI.conclusion: 聚合结果暴露了仅用保真度评测的方法选择失效问题。3DGS-SC 补充现有文本感知 3DGS 研究，聚焦受控显示器界面与精确标注；逐场景鲁棒性与采集效应仍待验证。

title: GLIDE: Generalized Layer-wise Intrinsic Distributional Evaluation for Heterogeneous LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents require reliable step-level evaluation to compare candidate branches and allocate computation effectively. However, lightweight evaluation remains challenging. External verifiers introduce additional inference cost, while agent-produced confidence or self-evaluation scores can be miscalibrated, especially when candidates are generated by heterogeneous agents. We propose \textbf{G}eneralized \textbf{L}ayer-wise \textbf{I}ntrinsic \textbf{D}istributional \textbf{E}valuation (\textbf{GLIDE}) for LLM agents. \textsc{GLIDE} derives intrinsic step evidence from layer-wise residual coherence, which measures whether local residual updates consistently support the global residual change induced by a candidate step. It calibrates this evidence against the recent score distribution of the generating agent and converts it into a pessimistic reward that jointly accounts for absolute residual evidence and agent-relative standing. The reward provides a cross-agent value signal for MCTS branch selection, while normalized predictive uncertainty guides adaptive branching. Experiments on multi-hop reasoning, sequential decision making, and symbolic logic show that \textsc{GLIDE} improves task performance, step-level ranking quality, and computational efficiency without external verifiers or task-specific supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出GLIDE，利用LLM分层残差一致性作为内蕴步级评估信号，经校准后转为悲观奖励，用于MCTS分支选择，无需外部验证器或任务监督。
AI.motivation: LLM agent需可靠的步级评估来比较候选分支并高效分配算力，但外部验证器成本高，而agent自产置信度/自评分数易失准，尤其候选来自异构agent时。
AI.method: GLIDE从分层残差一致性中提取内蕴步级证据，衡量局部残差更新是否一致支持候选步骤引起的全局残差变化；针对生成agent近期分数分布进行校准，转为兼顾绝对残差证据与agent相对位置的悲观奖励，作为跨agent的价值信号用于MCTS分支选择，并用归一化预测不确定性指导自适应分支。
AI.result: 在多跳推理、序列决策和符号逻辑任务上，GLIDE提升了任务性能、步级排序质量与计算效率，且无需外部验证器或任务特定监督。
AI.conclusion: 分层残差一致性可作为一种高效、可跨agent校准的内蕴步级评估信号，替代外部验证器与自评分数。

title: SpecRead: A Benchmark for Measuring Whether Language Models Understand Hardware Specifications
comment: 13 pages. Benchmark data and code at https://github.com/EDGAhab/specread
summary: Existing benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) in hardware design evaluate downstream artifacts such as generated RTL, assertions, or testbenches. When a model fails such a benchmark, the failure is ambiguous: it may have misread the specification, or it may have understood the specification and failed to write the code. We present SpecRead, a benchmark that isolates specification comprehension from generation ability. SpecRead v2.1 contains 385 questions over 10 open-source OpenTitan IP blocks: exact retrieval, cross-section reasoning, contradiction detection in mutated specifications, and spec-RTL consistency checking, plus 82 controls (41 distractor, 41 consistent-RTL). Type-4 items are built from real RTL mutations; we retain only mutations that Icarus Verilog simulation shows to change observable behavior.
