A with-spec vs. without-spec ablation suggests the questions require the excerpt, not training recall alone (without-spec accuracy 3/20 on the t1/t2 subset), though memorization of the source text may still help spot mutations. As an initial characterization with a small model, Ministral-3B scores 33.2% overall (128/385; macro average 39.0%): 55.2% on retrieval, 51.7% on cross-section reasoning. On the two contradiction-focused types, the verdict-plus-location measure gives 48.0% (t3) and 63.3% (t4), with a 51.2% false-positive rate on distractors and 100% on consistent-RTL controls. Layered scoring shows the model locates contradictions well (78.9-81.6% location accuracy) but scores lower on their category (43.9-49.7%). A structured "rule-table" prompting intervention lowers accuracy on every question type except t2 (tied). SpecRead is automatically scorable by deterministic checks, with gray-zone cases counted wrong under the conservative main scoring. The benchmark is regenerable for type-3 items via mutation injection, and built exclusively from public sources.

AI.tldr: SpecRead是一个将规格理解能力与代码生成能力解耦的硬件设计LLM基准，含385题+82控制项，用小型模型初步评测显示整体准确率仅33.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有硬件设计LLM基准只评估下游产物（RTL、断言、测试平台），模型失败时无法区分是"误读规格"还是"理解规格但写不出代码"，因此需要隔离规格理解与生成能力的基准。
AI.method: SpecRead v2.1基于10个OpenTitan开源IP模块，设计4类题目：精确检索、跨章节推理、变异规格中的矛盾检测、规格-RTL一致性检查；含82个控制项（41干扰项、41一致RTL）。Type-4由真实RTL变异构建，仅保留Icarus Verilog仿真显示改变可观测行为的变异。采用确定性自动评分，灰区保守判错；并进行有无规格消融实验与规则表提示干预。
AI.result: 无规格消融准确率仅3/20，说明题目依赖原文而非仅靠训练记忆。Ministral-3B整体33.2%（128/385，宏平均39.0%）：检索55.2%、跨章节推理51.7%；矛盾类verdict+location为t3 48.0%、t4 63.3%，干扰项假阳性率51.2%，一致RTL控制项100%。分层评分显示定位能力强（78.9-81.6%）但类别判断弱（43.9-49.7%）。规则表提示干预除t2持平外均降低准确率。
AI.conclusion: SpecRead提供了可自动评分、可再生成（type-3通过变异注入）、基于公开来源的规格理解基准，填补了硬件设计LLM评测中理解能力被混淆的空白，并揭示了当前模型在矛盾类别判断上的明显短板。

title: Language as an Independent Information Layer: A Conceptual Model of Communication, Cognition and Decision-Making
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure. Accepted for publication in the proceedigns of ISBM 2026 (Springer LNNS)
summary: Based on an analysis of the role of language in thought and communication, this article proposes a new concept for designing corporate knowledge bases. The concept integrates the probabilistic vector space of a corporate vocabulary, reflect-ing industry specifics, subject focus, terminology, and culture, with traditional ontological modeling. This combination enables the efficient extraction of knowledge from accumulated corporate documents while strictly accounting for specific business processes. Consequently, this concept bridges statistical and semantic (cause-and-effect) methodologies. Furthermore, analyzing the projec-tions of probabilistic spaces and causal relationships can help identify bottlenecks in business logic. As a dynamic system, language functions as a separate, inde-pendent layer within the overall information architecture. Introducing a dynamic component into the probabilistic space of word distribution allows it to be mod-eled as a multidimensional solution space for various problem formulations. In this context, input data defining the problem conditions serve as control parame-ters for dynamic transformations.

AI.tldr: 本文基于语言在思维与交流中的作用分析，提出一种融合概率向量空间与本体建模的企业知识库设计新概念。
AI.motivation: 企业积累了大量文档，但现有方法难以同时兼顾统计规律与语义（因果）关系，也难以严格对应具体业务流程。
AI.method: 将反映行业特征、主题、术语与文化的企业词汇概率向量空间，与传统本体建模相结合，并引入动态成分，使词分布概率空间成为多维解空间；输入数据作为动态变换的控制参数。语言作为信息架构中独立层。
AI.result: 该概念可在严格考虑业务流程的前提下高效提取知识，弥合统计方法与语义（因果）方法之间的鸿沟；通过分析概率空间投影与因果关系，可识别业务逻辑中的瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 语言作为动态系统可独立建模，概率向量空间与本体建模的融合为企业知识库设计提供了统一统计与语义的新框架，并有助于诊断业务流程瓶颈。

title: HGPTrans: Hierarchical Graph-Pooling Transolver for Automotive Aerodynamic Drag Coefficient Prediction
summary: Accurate and rapid prediction of the aerodynamic drag coefficient ($C_D$) is essential for vehicle design, particularly during early-stage styling iterations where a large number of candidate geometries must be evaluated. Although computational fluid dynamics (CFD) provides reliable aerodynamic estimates, its high computational cost, typically requiring hours to days for a single configuration, limits its use in large-scale design exploration. This paper proposes HGPTrans, a hierarchical graph-pooling network with Transolver-based attention, to directly predict $C_D$ from vehicle surface meshes. Motivated by the fact that vehicle aerodynamics depends on both local geometric features and long-range interactions among spatially distant surface regions, HGPTrans integrates three complementary components. Graph isomorphism convolutions encode discriminative local geometry, physics-aware slice attention captures global interactions with linear computational complexity, and information-redundancy-aware hierarchical pooling progressively removes redundant nodes while preserving informative geometric structures. The model is trained and evaluated on the large-scale DrivAerNet and DrivAerNet++ datasets, where it achieves the lowest mean absolute error and mean squared error among the evaluated baselines. Its generalization capability is further assessed through transfer learning on a real-vehicle dataset containing both sedans and SUVs, achieving relative $L_1$ errors of 1.56% (sedans) and 2.12% (SUVs) with an inference time of approximately $0.293$ s per vehicle. This corresponds to an acceleration of several orders of magnitude relative to high-fidelity CFD while keeping the predicted drag coefficients within a few percent of the CFD reference. Ablation studies confirm each component's contribution and reveal the effects of depth and pooling ratio.

AI.tldr: 提出HGPTrans，用分层图池化+Transolver注意力直接从车身网格预测风阻系数，在DrivAerNet上达到最低误差，推理约0.29s，比CFD快数个量级。
AI.motivation: 早期造型迭代需评估大量候选几何，而高保真CFD单次需数小时至数天，无法支撑大规模设计探索，因此需要快速且准确的C_D预测方法。
AI.method: HGPTrans由三部分组成：图同构卷积编码局部几何特征；物理感知切片注意力以线性复杂度捕获全局长程交互；信息冗余感知分层池化逐步去除冗余节点并保留有信息结构。直接从车身表面网格预测C_D。
AI.result: 在DrivAerNet和DrivAerNet++上取得对比基线中最低MAE和MSE；真实车辆数据集迁移学习中轿车相对L1误差1.56%、SUV 2.12%，单车间推理约0.293s，比高保真CFD快数个量级。消融实验验证各组件贡献及深度与池化比例的影响。
AI.conclusion: HGPTrans兼顾局部与全局几何建模，实现了高效且精度接近CFD的风阻预测，适用于车辆大规模设计探索。

title: Agentsensus: Consensus-Compressed Shared Memory for Multi-Agent Story Worlds
summary: A agentic story world is a dynamic system simulating who learned what, when, and from whom -- yet the standard design gives each character a private memory stream. A shared event is therefore stored once per witness, large duplication will be incurred in terms of storage. We present Agentsensus, a story-world simulation framework in which there is an unified long-term memory. Records of the same event merge into one owned by all its witnesses, and semantically relevant memory records are linked. We evaluate on four worlds -- two classical Chinese novels, Hamlet, and a real-world conflict timeline -- run for 40 to 80 rounds against three per-character memory designs under an equal-granularity protocol. Agentsensus writes 22-44% fewer entries than the closest baseline and is the only design whose memory becomes shared (14-28% of records held by more than one character, some by 10) and linked (94-99%), at judged simulation quality indistinguishable or even better than the baselines. An ablation attributes this to the merge itself: disabling it multiplies the store by 3.1x and takes sharing to exactly zero. Sharing also compounds with the horizon rather than saturating early, rising 6% to 9% to 14% as one world is re-run at 10, 20 and 40 rounds.

AI.tldr: Agentsensus 提出统一长期记忆的故事世界仿真框架，通过合并同一事件记录并链接语义相关记忆，减少存储冗余并实现记忆共享。
AI.motivation: 标准设计给每个角色独立记忆流，导致共享事件按目击者重复存储，产生大量存储冗余。
AI.method: 采用统一长期记忆：同一事件记录合并为目击者共有的单条记录，并链接语义相关记忆；在四个世界（两部中国古典小说、哈姆雷特、真实冲突时间线）以等粒度协议运行40-80轮，对比三种按角色记忆设计。
AI.result: 相比最接近基线写入条目少22-44%；唯一实现记忆共享（14-28%记录被多人持有，部分达10人）和链接（94-99%）；仿真质量不逊或更好。消融显示禁用合并使存储扩大3.1倍且共享降为0；共享随轮数由10轮的6%升至20轮9%、40轮14%。
AI.conclusion: 统一记忆合并机制是减少冗余和实现记忆共享的关键，且共享效果随仿真时长持续增长而非早期饱和。

title: Towards Certificate-Driven Software Porting: A Self-Improving Agentic Harness for Scientific Program Optimization
summary: The upgrade and rewriting of large scientific codebases has traditionally been a major challenge. While evolutionary search with large language models (LLMs) can port and accelerate legacy code, repair feedback in prompts alone does not prevent subsequent candidates from repeating the same errors. We introduce Certificate-Driven Evolutionary Search (CDES), which extends evolutionary search with enforceable restrictions derived from failed candidates, recorded as certificates of assumptions, checker evidence, and justified restrictions. Its control logic enforces these restrictions through rejection, backtracking, and targeted repair while preserving compatible edits. We apply CDES to CPU-to-GPU translation of two particle-simulation functions from the Geant4 toolkit, evaluated with a harness that goes beyond unit tests to combine formal checks, numerical comparisons, physics checks, and GPU safety tests. Generated implementations achieve 13.78x and 23.54x function-level speedups over CPU code, including data conversion and transfers; for one function, GPU throughput exceeds an expert implementation by 14.9%, reaching 16.1% when complementary components are combined. In an ablation over execution settings, certificate feedback increases the fraction of candidates passing required correctness checks from 55% to 90%.

AI.tldr: 提出证书驱动进化搜索(CDES)框架，用失败候选产生的可执行限制(证书)引导LLM进化搜索，实现Geant4两个粒子模拟函数CPU到GPU的移植，加速达13.78x和23.54x。
AI.motivation: 大型科学代码库的升级重写是重大挑战。现有基于LLM的进化搜索虽可移植加速遗留代码，但仅在提示中提供修复反馈无法阻止后续候选重复相同错误。
AI.method: CDES在进化搜索基础上引入从失败候选中提取的可执行限制，记录为假设证书、检查器证据与合理化限制；控制逻辑通过拒绝、回溯和定向修复强制这些限制，同时保留兼容编辑。应用于Geant4两个粒子模拟函数的CPU-to-GPU翻译，用结合形式化检查、数值对比、物理检查与GPU安全测试的评测框架评估。
AI.result: 生成实现相比CPU代码实现函数级加速13.78x和23.54x（含数据转换与传输）；一个函数的GPU吞吐量超专家实现14.9%，结合互补组件后达16.1%。消融实验显示证书反馈使通过必需正确性检查的候选比例从55%提升至90%。
AI.conclusion: 证书驱动的限制机制有效防止错误重复，显著提升LLM进化搜索在科学代码移植中的正确性与性能。

title: How to Reduce Whisper Hallucination
summary: Whisper is still what runs in production: one permissively licensed checkpoint, 99 languages, no per-language tuning. But it writes sentences nobody said. On 42 clips of pure room tone, whisper-large-v3 emits words on 61.9% of them and emits something on 100%. The usual response is to distil a student from Whisper pseudo-labels, filtering the hallucinations out of the corpus first, which deletes the evidence while leaving the behaviour in place: the student is fitted to the subset where the teacher was right, and inherits a failure mode absent from its own training data. The second response, adding non-speech audio so the model learns to stay quiet, already ships and works, but teaches suppression without discrimination. The checkpoint best on every non-speech arm here is also the one that recovers the fewest genuinely spoken phrases and deletes 58% of repeated speech. The teacher has to be fixed, with both halves of the signal. Our benchmark scores both at once: 11,852 clips over eight arms, 6,267 synthetic positives, 8,296 clips of real audio that made a production model fail, and FLEURS in 58 languages. We collect 40,891 hallucination phrases in 100 languages, choose a text-to-speech system by measurement, and synthesise those phrases as positives, so the model meets the same text both as something to suppress and as something to transcribe. Across 33 matched pairs of fine-tunes differing only by those positives, adding them lowers word emission on real voice-free audio in 31 pairs and raises phrase recovery in 32; among the 30 pairs that hold English accuracy it is 30 out of 30. The best checkpoint takes hallucination on silence from 61.9% to 2.4% and words over real voice-free audio from 99.9% to 47.8%, while raising phrase recovery from 69.8% to 82.7%. The benchmark, lexicon and synthetic corpus are released at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Scicom-intl/Whisper-Hallucination

AI.tldr: Whisper在生产中广泛使用但会凭空输出文字（纯静音片段上61.9%产生词语）；作者主张必须同时修复教师模型的"抑制"和"识别"两半信号，构建了双目标基准并用TTS合成幻觉短语作为正样本微调，将静音幻觉从61.9%降至2.4%同时提升短语召回率。
AI.motivation: Whisper（whisper-large-v3）在有许可、99种语言、无需逐语言调优的情况下仍是生产首选，但会产生严重幻觉：42个纯房间噪声片段中61.9%输出词语，100%输出非空内容。现有两种应对都有缺陷：从伪标签蒸馏学生模型会先滤掉幻觉，导致学生只在教师正确的子集上拟合、继承了训练数据中不存在的失败模式；加入非语音音频虽已实用，但只教"抑制"而不教"区分"，最好的非语音检查点同时召回真实语音短语最少、删除了58%的重复语音。因此教师必须同时用信号的两半来修复。
AI.method: 构建同时评估两方面的基准：8个测试臂共11,852片段，含6,267个合成正样本、8,296个曾让生产模型失败的真实音频片段，以及58种语言的FLEURS。收集100种语言、40,891条幻觉短语，通过测量选择TTS系统，将这些短语合成为正样本，使模型把相同文本同时作为"应抑制内容"和"应转录内容"来学习。通过33对仅在这些正样本上有差异的匹配微调实验进行验证。
AI.result: 在33对匹配微调中，加入正样本使31对降低了真实无语音音频上的词语输出，32对提升了短语召回；在30对保持英语准确率的配对中，30/30全部满足。最佳检查点将静音幻觉从61.9%降至2.4%，真实无语音音频上的词语输出从99.9%降至47.8%，同时短语召回率从69.8%提升至82.7%。基准、词表和合成语料已开源发布。
AI.conclusion: 单纯过滤或单纯压制都无法解决Whisper幻觉，需要在训练中同时提供"抑制"和"识别"两种信号（即让相同文本既作为负例也作为正例）。该双目标方法在显著降低幻觉的同时提升真实语音识别能力，且已公开基准、词表与合成语料以推动后续研究。

title: UNMATCH: Selective Unbalanced Token-Patch Matching for Forensic Image-Claim Verification
summary: Contextual image misuse pairs an image with a misleading claim. We study image-claim correspondence in fact-checked pairs containing out-of-context reuse, visual manipulation, or both. Existing pair-based detectors often compress the two modalities into a global compatibility score or learn a highly flexible interaction module, which can obscure a decisive local mismatch. We introduce directional multiscale coverage, a compact representation that summarizes local image-claim affinity in both directions and at three spatial scales. At each scale, each direction is summarized by its mean, lower quartile, and two thresholded support ratios; the signed difference between directional means completes a nine-dimensional scale descriptor. Concatenating the three scales yields a compact local representation for a lightweight global-local classifier. Under leakage-aware three-fold, three-seed evaluation on the Snopes subset of the Fauxtography benchmark, UNMATCH achieves 69.82 Macro-F1 and 71.05 balanced accuracy, exceeding the MCOT adaptation by 2.60 and 2.16 points. A matched-reassigned intervention shows that breaking the observed pairing lowers coverage and increases both discrepancy and false-pair probability.

AI.tldr: 提出方向性多尺度覆盖表示，用于检测上下文图像误用中的图文不匹配对。
AI.motivation: 现有配对检测器将两模态压缩为全局兼容性分数或采用高度灵活交互模块，容易掩盖决定性局部错配。
AI.method: 在三个空间尺度上双向总结图文局部亲和度；每尺度每方向用均值、下四分位数、两个阈值支持率概括，并用方向均值带符号差构成9维描述符，拼接后输入轻量全局-局部分类器。
AI.result: 在Fauxtography的Snopes子集上，泄漏感知三折三种子评估中，UNMATCH达69.82 Macro-F1和71.05平衡准确率，超过MCOT适配2.60和2.16点。匹配重分配干预显示破坏配对会降低覆盖并提高差异与假配对概率。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的方向多尺度局部覆盖表示能有效捕捉局部错配，提升图像-主张对应检测性能。

title: Train4Merge: A Controlled Single-Teacher Study of RL vs. SFT Teachers for OPD-Based Model Merging
summary: Domain experts trained from a shared checkpoint can be merged into one model through on-policy distillation (OPD), where they act as teachers supervising a student on its own trajectories. One upstream choice is rarely examined: whether to build each expert with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or reinforcement learning (RL). Yet equally strong teachers need not be equally good teachers. We probe this choice through controlled single-teacher OPD, a building block of multi-teacher OPD: in Agentic, Reasoning, and Perception, comparably performing SFT and RL teachers are trained from Qwen3.5-9B, each guiding a student initialized from it. At their best checkpoints, RL-guided students outperform SFT-guided students by 4.27, 1.50, and 0.86 percentage points in Agentic, Reasoning, and Perception, respectively, and recover more of their teachers' performance gains over the base model. The contrast is clearest in Agentic, where the best SFT-guided student recovers only 44.44% of its teacher's gain, whereas the best RL-guided student recovers 115.00%, surpassing its teacher. Our analysis points to an explanation: RL teachers stay much closer to the shared initialization in parameter space than SFT teachers and are therefore easier for their students to follow.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在on-policy蒸馏(OPD)中，用SFT还是RL构建教师模型的差异：RL教师在指导学生时效果更好。
AI.motivation: 多教师OPD中，领域专家可从共享检查点经不同方式训练。但一个关键上游选择——用SFT还是RL构建每个专家——很少被考察。同等强的教师未必是同等好的教师。
AI.method: 通过受控的单教师OPD实验（多教师OPD的基本单元）：在Agentic、Reasoning、Perception三个领域，从Qwen3.5-9B训练性能相当的SFT和RL教师，各自指导学生（同样从该检查点初始化）。
AI.result: 最佳检查点下，RL指导的学生在三个领域分别比SFT指导的学生高4.27、1.50、0.86个百分点，并恢复更多教师相对基座的增益。Agentic最为明显：SFT指导的学生仅恢复44.44%增益，RL指导的学生恢复115.00%，超越教师。
AI.conclusion: 分析表明原因在于：RL教师在参数空间上更接近共享初始化，因此学生更容易跟随，是更优的教师选择。

title: Maintaining Benchmarks Against Increasingly Capable Agents: Detection and Remediation of Unearned Passes
summary: Agentic benchmarks guide model selection and training. Yet an agent can pass a task without demonstrating the intended capability. Such outcomes constitute unearned passes; their proportion among all passes defines the integrity gap. As agents improve, benchmark surfaces that once seemed harmless can become exploitable, making benchmark validity an ongoing maintenance problem. We introduce a process-verification framework that audits passing trajectories, distinguishes evidenced reward hacking from verifier weakness, and localizes exploitable surfaces for repair. Across 3,810 passing trajectories from 29 model-benchmark cohorts, confirmed violations often increase with model generation but not monotonically. On SWEBench Pro V1.0, confirmed violation rates rise from 24% to 73% between Opus 4.7 and Fable 5 on matched tasks; later cohorts fall to 11% for Fable 5.1 and 0% for GPT-6 Astra. These comparisons are descriptive: configurations were not normalized, and the latest models also pass fewer exploitable tasks. Violations concentrate around a small set of recurring surfaces, especially unintended access to reference solutions through git history. Three repair case studies across two benchmarks show why blocking a recorded exploit is insufficient: the same protected information can remain accessible through another route. Therefore, we combine minimal patches with exploit replay and fresh agent evaluation, auditing new passes under the original standard. No evaluated attempt against the final patches reached the protected channel, and every post-patch pass was judged legitimate. Benchmark integrity requires ongoing maintenance: audit passing behavior, repair the enabling surface, and re-evaluate both exploit access and legitimate solvability.

AI.tldr: 提出过程验证框架审计通过轨迹，识别"非实至名归的通过"，并强调基准完整性需持续维护。
AI.motivation: Agent可通过非预期能力（如奖励黑客）通过任务，导致"非实至名归的通过"，且随模型提升，原本无害的基准表面可能变为可利用，基准有效性成为持续的维护问题。
AI.method: 过程验证框架：审计通过轨迹，区分有证据的奖励黑客与验证器缺陷，定位可利用表面；结合最小补丁、漏洞重放与新agent评估，按原始标准审计新通过。
AI.result: 在29个模型-基准队列的3810条通过轨迹中，确认违规常随模型代际增加但非单调。SWEBench Pro V1.0上，Opus 4.7到Fable 5违规率从24%升至73%，后续队列降至Fable 5.1的11%和GPT-6 Astra的0%。违规集中于少数反复出现的表面（如通过git历史意外获取参考解）。三项修复案例表明仅阻断已记录的漏洞不够。
AI.conclusion: 基准完整性需持续维护：审计通过行为、修复使能表面、重新评估漏洞可访问性与合法可解性。对最终补丁的评估中无人到达受保护通道，所有补丁后通过均判定为合法。

title: Groupwise Agentic Grading and Advantage Redistribution for Code Agent RL
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for code agents often uses executable tests to provide binary rewards. With these rewards, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) assigns identical advantages to test-passing trajectories within each rollout group, overlooking differences in implementation quality and adherence to task requirements. This leaves the policy without a learning signal that favors clean, targeted implementations over those containing unnecessary or out-of-scope changes. We introduce GAGAR, a framework for quality-aware credit redistribution in code agent RL. Built on dynamic sampling that retains groups containing both passing and failing trajectories, GAGAR places all trajectories from each group in a shared workspace, where an SFT-trained agentic grader jointly inspects them and ranks the test-passing candidates. Based on this ranking, we downweight lower-ranked trajectories and proportionally rescale the advantages of all test-passing trajectories to restore their original sum. This sum-preserving redistribution retains the relative weights established by quality-based downweighting while shifting credit toward higher-quality implementations. We evaluate GAGAR at industrial scale using pre-RL SFT checkpoints of MiMo-V2.6-Flash (310B total parameters) and MiMo-V2.6-Pro (1.02T total parameters). Controlled code-only Flash experiments show improved code agent performance, reduced trajectory-length growth, and more stable training. We further apply GAGAR in large-scale mixed-task RL with both Flash and Pro. Our results support combining test-based verification with groupwise agentic grading to improve the quality and stability of code agent RL.

AI.tldr: 提出GAGAR框架，通过智能体评分器对通过测试的轨迹进行质量排序并重分配优势，实现代码智能体RL的质量感知信用分配。
AI.motivation: 现有代码智能体RL用可执行测试给出二元奖励，GRPO对同组内通过测试的轨迹赋相同优势，忽略了实现质量差异，缺少偏好简洁、聚焦实现的信号。
AI.method: 基于动态采样保留同时包含通过与失败轨迹的组；将每组轨迹放入共享工作区，由SFT训练的智能体评分器联合检查并排序通过测试的候选；据此降低低排名轨迹的权重，并按比例重缩放所有通过轨迹的优势以保持总和不变（保和重分配）。
AI.result: 在MiMo-V2.6-Flash（310B）和MiMo-V2.6-Pro（1.02T）上进行工业规模评估。纯代码Flash实验中代码智能体性能提升、轨迹长度增长降低、训练更稳定；并在两者的大规模混合任务RL中应用。
AI.conclusion: 将基于测试的验证与组内智能体评分相结合，可提升代码智能体RL的质量与稳定性。

title: Panoptic Scene Program Diffusion Transformer
summary: Modern text-to-image models produce high-fidelity images but still struggle with compositional prompts that require instance identity, attribute ownership, counting, spatial ordering, and role-sensitive relations. We introduce Panoptic Scene Program Diffusion Transformer (PSP-DiT), a diffusion-transformer architecture that treats a panoptic scene program as a first-class latent variable rather than an external control signal or post-hoc parse. PSP-DiT jointly denoises image latents and scene-program latents through coupled transformer streams, while panoptic grounding and cycle-consistency objectives tie object instances, attributes, relations, and counts to visual support in the generated image. Under matched training and inference settings, PSP-DiT improves over a strong flat-text baseline across GenEval 2, SANEval-Simple, PSG-Score, and DetailMaster, with the largest gains on counting, attribute binding, role-sensitive relations, and long structured prompts. The method preserves image quality, adds modest inference overhead, and remains robust to imperfect scene programs.

AI.tldr: 提出PSP-DiT，将全景场景程序作为一等潜变量，通过耦合Transformer流联合去噪图像与场景程序潜变量，提升组合式文生图的计数、属性绑定与关系建模能力。
AI.motivation: 现代文生图模型图像质量高，但在需要实例身份、属性归属、计数、空间顺序和角色敏感关系的组合式提示上仍表现不足，且现有方法多将场景结构视为外部控制信号或事后解析。
AI.method: 提出PSP-DiT的扩散Transformer架构，将全景场景程序作为一等潜变量；通过耦合的Transformer流联合去噪图像潜变量与场景程序潜变量，并引入全景接地与循环一致性目标，将对象实例、属性、关系与计数绑定到生成图像的视觉证据上。
AI.result: 在匹配的训练与推理设置下，PSP-DiT在GenEval 2、SANEval-Simple、PSG-Score和DetailMaster上均优于强扁平文本基线，在计数、属性绑定、角色敏感关系及长结构化提示上增益最大；同时保持图像质量，推理开销适度，并对不完美场景程序具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将全景场景程序作为一等潜变量并与图像联合去噪，是提升组合式文生图的有效途径，兼顾质量与鲁棒性。

title: PhiFold: Towards Dynamic Protein Design with Physics-Structured Covariance Modeling
summary: Protein design is moving beyond structural correctness toward function-aware design, yet existing generative models typically treat dynamics as a downstream property estimated through simulation or prediction after structure generation. Using MD trajectories as a generative target is also undesirable because stochastic, path-dependent trajectories over-specify the underlying equilibrium ensemble. We introduce PhiFold, a framework for jointly generating protein backbones and their second-order dynamics, represented by residue-displacement covariance. Rather than predicting the quadratically sized full covariance, PhiFold decomposes dynamics into three interpretable components: local flexibility, a low-rank collective-motion representation, and residue-wise collective participation. These components are assembled into a positive-definite covariance matrix with exact marginal consistency, yielding a compact and physically constrained representation of equilibrium dynamics. Across generated proteins, PhiFold improves recovery of local fluctuations and long-range residue coupling while remaining competitive on dominant collective-motion subspaces. It further enables bidirectional control of residue flexibility while preserving backbone designability. By unifying structure generation with an explicit representation of equilibrium dynamics, PhiFold lays a foundation for designing proteins not only by how they look, but also by how they move.

AI.tldr: PhiFold提出一个联合生成蛋白质骨架与其二阶动力学（残基位移协方差）的框架，通过分解动力学为可解释组件实现物理约束的紧凑表示。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型将动力学视为结构生成后的下游属性，依赖模拟或预测；而直接用MD轨迹作为生成目标又过度指定了平衡系综。因此需要一种将结构与平衡动力学统一建模的方法。
AI.method: PhiFold联合生成蛋白质骨架和其残基位移协方差表示的二阶动力学。不预测完整协方差，而是分解为三个可解释组件：局部柔性、低秩集体运动表示和残基级集体参与度，并组装成具有精确边际一致性的正定协方差矩阵。
AI.result: 在生成的蛋白质上，PhiFold改善了局部涨落和长程残基耦合的恢复，同时在主导集体运动子空间上保持竞争力；还实现了残基柔性的双向控制，并保持骨架可设计性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将结构生成与平衡动力学的显式表示统一，PhiFold为不仅按"外观"、还按"运动方式"设计蛋白质奠定了基础。

title: ControlScope: Workflow Revision and Reliability in LLM Agents
summary: How much of a running workflow should a language model agent revise? ControlScope compares continuing generated code, editing the next tool call's data arguments, and replacing the unfinished workflow from the same public execution state. The nested permissions separate available repairs from the actions an agent selects. We evaluate one-time and repeated reviews across filesystem tasks, ALFWorld, and AppWorld. Across two source programs per task and three reasoning-reviewer draws on 20 filesystem tasks, FULL completes 15-16 tasks versus 13 for KEEP; across four fast draws it completes 10-13 versus 13. Fresh student-record confirmation reproduces a batch-read repair. ALFWorld fast panels yield KEEP/ARG/FULL scores of 85/86/87 on 87 tasks across 52 scenes and 134/134/127 on 134 tasks across four scenes; reasoning on the 87-task cohort also yields 85/86/87 with substantial review cost. An AppWorld V1 official-test panel of 585 task instances from 195 scenario templates shows small net differences. Frozen replays expose viable agent-written replacements interrupted by later revision in two failed file-organization runs. An offline source-trajectory midpoint comparison shows later reviews completing an insufficient repair. Five-call protection saves 19.4% of logged model output and loses one success across 20 fresh source runs. An argument-only shortcut shows that the broader sampled policy can overlook a cheaper successful edit available in both operation sets. These outcomes tie repair access to actual choices and subsequent execution.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ControlScope 框架，研究工作流中语言模型智能体应修改多少代码，比较三种修复权限（继续生成、编辑下一工具调用参数、替换未完成工作流）在一系列基准任务上的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体在运行工作流时，其可修复范围（repair access）与实际采取的行动往往未加区分，需要明确"能修多少"与"选择修多少"之间的差异对任务成败的影响。
AI.method: ControlScope 在同一公开执行状态上比较三种策略：KEEP（继续生成代码）、ARG（编辑下一工具调用的数据参数）、FULL（替换未完成工作流），并区分可用修复与智能体实际选择的行动。在文件系统任务、ALFWorld 和 AppWorld 上进行单次与重复评审评估，包含冻结回放与离线轨迹中点比较。
AI.result: 20 个文件系统任务上，FULL 完成 15-16 个 vs KEEP 13 个（推理评审）；快速抽取下则为 10-13 vs 13。ALFWorld 快速面板 KEEP/ARG/FULL 得分为 85/86/87（87 任务）和 134/134/127（134 任务）；AppWorld V1 官方测试 585 实例差异很小。五调用保护节省 19.4% 输出但损失一次成功。
AI.conclusion: 修复权限的广度须与实际行动选择及后续执行挂钩；更广的策略未必更优，可能忽视更便宜的可行编辑。

title: HERO-MoE: Historical Expert Routing with Scale-Preserving Fusion
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have become a standard way to scale model capacity while keeping computation sparse, yet routing remains a key determinant of MoE quality and training behavior. Prior empirical studies suggest that MoE routing reflects input semantics and upstream computation across depth, but standard routers do not explicitly use the routing distributions produced by preceding layers. We propose HERO-MoE, Historical Expert ROuting with Scale-Preserving Fusion, a routing framework that injects historical routing priors into MoE routers by reusing detached, dense routing distributions collected from preceding MoE layers. The key idea is simple: HERO-MoE preserves the original token-conditioned routing branch and adds a residual historical routing contribution before the standard softmax and top-$k$ dispatch. To stabilize this historical signal, HERO-MoE introduces a scale-preserving fusion mechanism that matches the magnitude of historical routing memory to the current hidden representation and accounts for the number of visible historical layers, without introducing an auxiliary routing loss or a fusion-specific tuning parameter. By reusing routing distributions already computed by preceding MoE layers, HERO-MoE improves training-loss reduction with modest end-to-end overhead. The resulting router remains compatible with standard sparse dispatch, including top-$k$ and group-limited routing, and can be inserted into existing MoE backbones with minimal architectural changes. Experiments on an approximately 8B-parameter MoE model with 0.5B active parameters, trained from scratch on 100B tokens, show that HERO-MoE reduces the final loss from 1.6393 to 1.6184, while peak memory and FLOPs increase by only 0.44\% and 0.64\%, respectively.

AI.tldr: HERO-MoE通过复用前层路由分布构建历史路由先验，以尺度保持融合机制注入路由器，稳定训练且开销极小。
AI.motivation: MoE路由决定模型质量与训练行为，已有研究显示路由反映输入语义与上游计算，但标准路由器未显式利用前层路由分布。
AI.method: 保留原始token条件路由分支，在softmax与top-k前加入残差历史路由项；复用前层detached的稠密路由分布；引入尺度保持融合，将历史路由记忆幅度对齐当前隐表示并考虑可见历史层数，无需辅助损失或调参。
AI.result: 在约8B参数（0.5B激活）、100B token从零训练的MoE上，最终loss从1.6393降至1.6184，峰值内存与FLOPs仅增加0.44%和0.64%。
AI.conclusion: 历史路由先验可有效提升MoE训练，方法兼容top-k与组限制路由，可低成本插入现有MoE骨干。

title: SelfCue: Making a 3D CT Report Generator Say What It Already Knows
summary: Progress in 3D CT report generation is usually sought in increasingly sophisticated architectures and larger pools of training data. We find instead that a 3D CT report generator already holds what its report leaves out, and loses it when the hidden state becomes tokens. Over the 18 CT-RATE abnormalities, this hidden-to-report surfacing gap is reflected by a drop in macro AUROC from 0.848 in the hidden states to 0.739 in the generated report. We propose SelfCue based on contrastive decoding. It promotes what the hidden state already supports and suppresses what it does not. It raises clinical efficacy F1 to 0.481 and the LLM-judged GREEN score to 0.510. Distilling that behaviour into the weights gives SelfCue-KD, a student that keeps most of the gain, needs nothing extra at inference, and drops into any pipeline already serving the baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/renjie-liang/SelfCue-CT.

AI.tldr: 3D CT报告生成模型的隐藏状态已包含诊断信息，但转为文本时丢失；提出SelfCue对比解码方法恢复并蒸馏为学生模型。
AI.motivation: 现有3D CT报告生成多追求更复杂架构和更大数据，但作者发现模型隐藏状态本身已包含报告未输出的信息，而当隐藏状态被转为token时这种信息丢失（macro AUROC从隐藏态的0.848降至生成报告的0.739）。
AI.method: 提出基于对比解码的SelfCue，强化隐藏状态已支持的内容、抑制不支持的内容；再将其行为蒸馏进权重，得到SelfCue-KD学生模型。
AI.result: SelfCue将临床有效性F1提升至0.481，LLM评判的GREEN分数提升至0.510；SelfCue-KD保留大部分增益，推理时无需额外开销。
AI.conclusion: 无需新架构或更大数据，通过利用隐藏状态信息即可显著提升CT报告生成质量，且可无缝替换现有基线管线。

title: Delayed Supervision for Test-Time Language Models
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. Equal contribution by both authors. Work done at MIT CSAIL
summary:
Test-time language models adapt a compact memory while processing the input sequence. This
  perspective encompasses nonlinear fast-weight learning in LaCT, associative delta-rule
  updates in DeltaNet, and generalized delta-rule state updates in RWKV-7. Training these
  models to predict the next token does not explicitly require a fact to remain accessible
  after many subsequent memory updates. We study delayed supervision for this test-time memory:
  during post-training, ask a simulator-grounded question only after a long interval of
  unrelated events, and supervise its answer alongside ordinary next-token prediction.
  Questions are evaluated on disposable branches, so their answers never enter the continuing
  event stream. The construction distinguishes retention from revision: a retained fact must
  remain valid throughout the delay, whereas a revised fact must be answered with its latest
  value. We evaluate this approach on LaCT-760M and plain DeltaNet-1.3B using TextWorld
  training trajectories and shared BABILong and RULER evaluation panels, and include a
  separately reported RWKV-7 comparison. Relative to event-only training, delayed QA improves
  BABILong by 5.48 percentage points for LaCT and 1.32 points for DeltaNet, and single-needle
  RULER by 1.45 and 3.27 points, respectively. The RWKV-7 comparison reports gains of 4.60 and
  7.00 points on its own panels. These results support delayed semantic supervision as a
  practical outer training objective for usable test-time memory, while leaving open how much
  of the benefit derives specifically from delay rather than general question-answering and
  answer-termination supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出延迟监督（delayed supervision）作为测试时语言模型记忆的外部训练目标：在无关事件长间隔后再提问并监督答案，区分“保持”与“更新”事实，在LaCT、DeltaNet与RWKV-7上均带来BABILong与RULER提升。
AI.motivation: 测试时记忆模型（如LaCT、DeltaNet、RWKV-7）以紧凑记忆处理输入并进行快速权重/增量更新，但仅用下一词预测训练，并不显式要求某事实在经过多次记忆更新后仍可被检索，导致长程保持能力不足。
AI.method: 在post-training阶段引入延迟监督：先经历大量无关事件，之后才提出由模拟器支撑的问题，并将其答案与普通下一词预测联合监督；问题在一次性分支上评估，答案不进入后续事件流。该设置区分保持（事实须始终有效）与修订（须回答最新值）。在LaCT-760M与DeltaNet-1.3B上用TextWorld轨迹训练，BABILong与RULER评估，并单独报告RWKV-7对比。
AI.result: 相比仅事件训练：LaCT的BABILong提升5.48个百分点，DeltaNet提升1.32；单针RULER分别提升1.45与3.27。RWKV-7在其面板上分别提升4.60和7.00个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 延迟语义监督可作为提升测试时记忆可用性的实用外部训练目标；但尚不确定收益在多大程度上来自“延迟”本身，而非一般问答与答案终止监督。

title: After the Fix: How Corrected Agent Histories Transfer to Related Tasks
summary: Does repairing an episode make its experience a better memory for the next task? We transfer the same failed source before and after accepted repair to a fixed target, alongside independent execution. Our 3,300 runs cover 100 ThinkingBox pairs and the same 100 APEX pairs with and without source-state inheritance, under eleven conditions. ThinkingBox's Full/Skill/Hybrid correction gains are 44/29/32 percentage points, with corrected performance 25/22/18 points above independence; inference weakens at the task-family level. Yet 12 of Full's 15-point larger correction gap over Skill come from worse uncorrected performance, not better corrected memory. Moreover, 22 of Full's 46 upward transitions restore observed baseline success. Neither APEX regime establishes comparable aggregate correction benefits. Action evidence connects workflow gains with reusable obligations and convention conflicts with source-local choices. Text APEX's accepted execution reaches 52% versus its summary's 40%, without robust global/group-level superiority or an estab- lished advantage over independence. Smaller handoffs reduce input but increase calls. The value of repairing experience is therefore distinct from the value of reusing it: memory updates require both a previous-version reference and a fresh-start reference.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了修复后的失败经验是否能成为更好的记忆用于后续任务，通过3300次运行在ThinkingBox和APEX上对比修复前后迁移效果，发现修复经验的价值与复用价值是不同的，记忆更新需要同时参照旧版本和全新起点。
AI.motivation: 核心动机是探讨"修复一个经验片段是否能让它成为更好的记忆"这一问题，即区分修复经验（repairing experience）的价值与复用经验（reusing experience）的价值，检验修复后的失败轨迹迁移到新任务是否真的更优。
AI.method: 将同一失败源任务在接受修复前后分别迁移到固定目标任务，并设独立执行作为对照。共3300次运行，覆盖100个ThinkingBox配对和100个APEX配对，含源状态继承与非继承两种设定，共11种条件，并区分Full/Skill/Hybrid三种纠正方式。
AI.result: ThinkingBox的Full/Skill/Hybrid纠正增益为44/29/32个百分点，纠正后性能高出独立性25/22/18点，但推理优势在任务族层面减弱。Full相对Skill的15点纠正优势中有12点来自更差的未纠正表现而非更好的记忆；Full的46次上升转变中22次仅恢复基线成功率。APEX两种设定均未建立可比的聚合纠正收益。文本APEX接受执行达52%对摘要40%，但无稳健的全局/组级优势。
AI.conclusion: 修复经验的价值不同于复用经验的价值：记忆更新既需要先前版本参照，也需要全新起点参照，单纯的修复收益多来自基线恢复而非真正优越的记忆质量。

title: KV-Lingo: Learning KV-Cache Translators with Distillation
summary: Large language models represent context with a key-value (KV) cache. Caches are model-specific: for the same text, models with different architectures or weights produce incompatible representations. This makes it costly to switch models over a shared context: although the context has already been processed by one model, the incoming model must process it again to build its own cache. We introduce KV-Lingo, a method for translating the KV cache of a source model into one that can be read by a target model. KV-Lingo consists of a collection of linear maps, typically one per layer of the target model, that are applied independently on all tokens' key and value representations. We train these maps using distillation, minimising the divergence between the target model's predictions from its native cache and those from the translated cache. We consider several model pairs spanning multiple sizes and architectures, training one translator per pair on a generic text corpus. The resulting translators preserve strong downstream performance in both small-to-large and large-to-small transfers. Since a switch then costs a linear map and a single decoding step instead of a prefill, replacing re-prefill with cache translation reduces the time to first token after a model switch by 9.6x already on a 64-token prompt for Qwen models on an Apple M3 Ultra, and by up to 29x at 32k context length on an H100. These gains make KV-Lingo particularly useful for dynamic model routing: a context can be processed by one model and handed off to another only when needed, without re-prefilling the shared prefix. We finally show that KV-Lingo can be used for seamless model switching, staying close to re-prefill across repeated switches in our multi-turn evaluations.

AI.tldr: KV-Lingo 通过线性映射将源模型的 KV cache 翻译为目标模型可读的 cache，避免切换模型时重新 prefill，大幅降低首 token 延迟。
AI.motivation: KV cache 是模型特定的：相同文本在不同架构或权重的模型上产生不兼容的表示。因此切换模型时，即使上下文已被处理过，目标模型仍需重新处理以构建自己的 cache，代价高昂。
AI.method: KV-Lingo 由一组线性映射构成（通常目标模型每层一个），独立作用于所有 token 的 key/value 表示。通过蒸馏训练这些映射，最小化目标模型原生 cache 与翻译 cache 预测之间的散度。针对多个不同规模与架构的模型对，用通用语料为每对训练一个翻译器。
AI.result: 翻译器在 small-to-large 和 large-to-small 迁移中都保持较强的下游性能。切换成本从 prefill 降为一次线性映射加单步解码：在 Apple M3 Ultra 上 Qwen 模型 64-token prompt 时首 token 时间降低 9.6x，在 H100 上 32k 上下文时最高降低 29x。
AI.conclusion: KV-Lingo 适用于动态模型路由：上下文可先由一个模型处理，需要时再交给另一模型而无需重新 prefill，并支持无缝模型切换，在多轮评测中重复切换时表现接近 re-prefill。

title: Rate-Adaptive One-Step Diffusion Compression for AIGC Images
summary: We describe our entry to the LoViF 2026 AIGC Image Compression Challenge, a benchmark for ultra-low-bitrate coding of AI-generated images under a strict global rate budget of 0.025 bits per pixel (BPP). Generated imagery poses a distinct challenge for compression: it frequently contains rendered typography, synthetic edges, repeated motifs, UI-like layout, and stylized micro-texture that conventional distortion-oriented codecs erase at this rate, while unconstrained generative decoders can restore plausible-looking detail that no longer matches the source geometry or symbols. We treat this as a rate-perception allocation problem. Our system fine-tunes four rate-specialized checkpoints of the AEIC one-step diffusion codec, generates per-image candidates from all four, including one latent refined through encoder-side test-time optimization (TTO) with periodic entropy-conditioning refresh, entropy-codes every candidate with practical rANS coding, and selects exactly one bitstream per image with an exact multiple-choice knapsack solved over true coded file sizes. A fixed, zero-additional-bit residual restoration network is applied at decode time. Every submitted bitstream is independently decodable by the shipped decoder, which uses no source image or external side information. We report the full pipeline, an ablation history spanning 77 logged experiments, and a set of negative results, including why PSNR could not be pushed to parity with rate-distortion-oriented competitors under this architecture, useful to future participants. This is a challenge report: our entry scored 31.527739 (PSNR 27.02 dB, MS-SSIM 0.9176, LPIPS 0.0778, DISTS 0.0390 at 0.02495 BPP), the second-best DISTS on the leaderboard, ranking 5th on the final test-phase leaderboard announced August 4, 2026.

AI.tldr: 本文是 LoViF 2026 AIGC 图像压缩挑战赛的技术报告，在 0.025 BPP 极低码率约束下，基于 AEIC 一步扩散编解码器构建了一套率-感知分配系统，最终以 31.527739 分排名第 5。
AI.motivation: AIGC 生成图像在极低码率下难以压缩：它包含渲染文字、合成边缘、重复图案、类 UI 布局与风格化微纹理，传统失真导向编解码器在此码率下会将其抹除，而无约束生成解码器又会"幻觉"出与源几何或符号不符的细节。因此需要把问题重新定义为码率-感知分配问题。
AI.method: 微调 AEIC 一步扩散编解码器的四个码率专用检查点；对每张图从全部检查点生成候选，其中一个隐变量经过编码端测试时优化（TTO）并周期性刷新熵条件；用实用 rANS 对每个候选做熵编码；以真实编码文件大小求解精确多选背包问题，每张图只选一个比特流；解码时额外施加零比特的残差修复网络。无需源图或外部边信息，可独立解码。
AI.result: 得分 31.527739（0.02495 BPP 下 PSNR 27.02 dB、MS-SSIM 0.9176、LPIPS 0.0778、DISTS 0.0390），DISTS 为榜单第二，最终测试阶段排名第 5（2026 年 8 月 4 日公布）。
AI.conclusion: 报告了完整流水线、77 次记录的消融实验及负面结果，并指出在该架构下 PSNR 无法与率失真导向的对手持平，供后续参赛者参考。

title: RLHarness: Co-evolving Procedural Skills with Reinforcement Learning for Long-horizon Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Multimodal reasoning requires models to preserve visual evidence through long decision chains while selecting appropriate procedures across diverse scenarios and rules. When learning is guided only by terminal verifiers, reinforcement learning (RL) reveals whether a final answer is correct but not how it should be produced. The policy must therefore discover reusable reasoning procedures while learning to execute them, creating a program cold-start problem. Skills can externalize successful procedures, reduce repeated exploration, and provide inspectable guidance. However, a fixed Skill Bank assumes that this guidance remains compatible with an evolving policy, while updating Skills alone can leave their triggers, execution protocols, and demonstrations stale or mutually inconsistent. We introduce RLHARNESS, which organizes Skills, selection and execution protocols, few-shot demonstrations, and task contracts into a unified, versioned Harness and alternates Harness evolution with policy learning. An Exploration-Distillation Harness builds the initial Harness and version-aligned verified traces for SFT and DAPO I. After the first RL block, a Post-RL Reconstruction Harness rebuilds Skills, protocols, and demonstrations from fresh success-failure rollouts, and DAPO II adapts the policy to the reconstructed program. RLHARNESS improves Accuracy from 16.25%/27.50% to 62.00%/50.00% on MetroMap/TravelMap and raises F1 score from 37.13%/45.50% to 65.81%/65.51% on Fee-VL/Cancel-VL. All four tasks achieve their best results only after reconstruction and DAPO II, showing that an evolving Harness complements RL by continually updating the external program that the policy learns to execute.

AI.tldr: 提出 RLHARNESS，通过可演化的 Harness（整合 Skills、协议、示例与任务契约）与策略学习交替进行，解决多模态推理的程序冷启动问题，在四个任务上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 多模态推理需在长决策链中保留视觉证据并选择合适流程。仅用终端验证器引导 RL 只能判断答案对错，无法指导推理过程，导致策略必须同时发现并执行可复用推理程序，形成"程序冷启动"问题。固定 Skill Bank 假设指导始终与演化中的策略兼容，单独更新 Skill 会使其触发条件、执行协议和演示过时或不一致。
AI.method: RLHARNESS 将 Skills、选择与执行协议、few-shot 演示和任务契约组织为统一、带版本的 Harness，与策略学习交替进行。先由 Exploration-Distillation Harness 构建初始 Harness 及版本对齐的验证轨迹用于 SFT 与 DAPO I；首个 RL 块后，Post-RL Reconstruction Harness 依据新的成功/失败 rollout 重建 Skills、协议和演示，再由 DAPO II 使策略适配重建后的程序。
AI.result: MetroMap/TravelMap 准确率从 16.25%/27.50% 提升至 62.00%/50.00%；Fee-VL/Cancel-VL F1 从 37.13%/45.50% 提升至 65.81%/65.51%。四个任务均仅在重建与 DAPO II 后取得最佳结果。
AI.conclusion: 可演化的 Harness 通过持续更新策略所执行的外部程序，与 RL 形成互补，有效缓解程序冷启动问题。

title: Fewer Assumptions by Design: A Reusable Skill for LLM-Assisted Verus Verification
summary: LLM-assisted Verus verification is a less tedious method to verify Rust implementations, but paired with self-referential structures, e.g., Doubly Linked Lists (DLLs)—notoriously difficult to formalise for verification—it becomes a substantially more demanding verification task.    Moreover, a specification weakness can arise when verification relies on unproven or invalidated assumptions, such as axiomatic lemmas and assume statements. We investigate whether LLM agents can synthesize strong DLL specifications while minimizing these trusted base. The analysis follows three different approaches: manual verification, property-specific verification, and a defined skill for the specific case of DLLs and certain properties of this type of data structure. The skill encodes domain knowledge and a task-decomposition strategy. We show that an LLM agent equipped with a carefully designed verification skill can generate strong, low-trust specifications for DLLs in Verus.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM代理能否为Rust中的双向链表（DLL）生成强规范并最小化可信基（axiom/assume），通过手动验证、属性特定验证和针对DLL的专用技能三种方法进行对比。
AI.motivation: LLM辅助Verus验证可减轻Rust验证负担，但自引用结构（如双向链表）难以形式化，且验证常依赖未证明的假设（公理引理、assume语句）导致规范薄弱。作者希望探究LLM代理能否生成强DLL规范同时减少可信基。
AI.method: 采用三种方法：1）手动验证；2）属性特定验证；3）为DLL及特定属性定义的专用技能，该技能编码领域知识与任务分解策略。
AI.result: 实验表明，配备精心设计的验证技能的LLM代理能够为Verus中的DLL生成强且低可信基的规范。
AI.conclusion: LLM代理结合领域知识技能可有效应对DLL验证难题，实现强规范与最小化可信基。

title: The Alignment Paradox: How Post-Training Amplifies Confident Hallucinations in Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can produce factually incorrect answers with high confidence, undermining their reliability and limiting the effectiveness of uncertainty-based error detection. While prior research attributes confident hallucinations to factors such as missing knowledge in training data, reasoning errors, or stochastic decoding, we uncover that post-training alignment itself is a primary driver of these errors, a phenomenon we call the \textbf{Alignment Paradox}. Across five model families evaluated on factual benchmarks, unaligned base models produce few high-confidence errors on long-tail factual queries, whereas instruction-tuned models multiply high-confidence errors ($p \ge 0.95$) by more than an order of magnitude (10$\times$ to 35$\times$). Layer-wise probing with the Logit Lens reveals that this overconfidence emerges in late layers, where wrong-answer margins expand past 4.0 points after remaining near zero across early and intermediate layers. These findings motivate limiting margin growth during post-training. We implement this principle through an entropy-dependent margin bound in direct preference optimization (DPO). In multi-epoch experiments with Mistral-7B, the bounded objective reduces high-confidence errors by up to 35.3\% relative to standard DPO while maintaining performance on evaluated general reasoning benchmarks. These results show that bounded margins mitigate confident hallucinations during post-training.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现后训练对齐本身会诱发高置信度幻觉（"对齐悖论"）：未对齐基座模型在长尾事实上几乎不产生高置信错误，而指令微调模型将高置信错误放大10×–35×；作者提出在DPO中引入熵相关的margin上界来抑制该问题。
AI.motivation: LLM常以高置信度输出事实错误答案，损害可靠性并削弱基于不确定性的错误检测；已有解释（训练数据缺知识、推理错误、随机解码）不足，作者旨在揭示后训练对齐是主因。
AI.method: 在五个模型家族、事实类基准上对比未对齐基座与指令微调模型的高置信错误率；用Logit Lens逐层探测错误答案margin演变；提出熵相关的margin bound，并将其嵌入DPO目标（在有界margin约束下做多轮训练，基于Mistral-7B）。
AI.result: 指令微调使高置信错误(p≥0.95)较基座模型增加10×–35×；过度自信出现在后层，错误答案margin从早/中层接近0骤增至>4.0；Mistral-7B多轮实验中，所提方法相比标准DPO将高置信错误最多降低35.3%，同时保持通用推理基准性能。
AI.conclusion: 后训练对齐过程中的margin增长是自信幻觉的关键来源，限制margin增长（如有界DPO目标）可有效缓解高置信幻觉，同时不牺牲通用推理能力。

title: A Surgical Foundation Model Reveals Task-Dependent Label Efficiency
summary:
Developing label-efficient models is a central challenge in surgical AI due to the high cost and scarcity of expert annotation. While self-supervised foundation models adapt well to new tasks with minimal data, how label efficiency varies across different surgical tasks remains largely unexplored.
  Here, we introduce SURGE, a surgical foundation model trained on SurgSpectrum-30M+, the largest pretraining dataset comprising over 30 million frames, with checkpoints released to enable further research. We systematically evaluate label efficiency across 5 task categories and 15 benchmarks. These range from temporal and spatial scene understanding to fine-grained reasoning tied to instrument-anatomy interactions and safety-critical maneuvers.
  SURGE outperforms prior state-of-the-art on all benchmarks, even surpassing task-specific models on complex reasoning tasks. Crucially, we reveal a task-dependent scaling behavior: while scene understanding tasks saturate with minimal supervision, fine-grained reasoning tasks continue improving with substantially larger annotation budgets, providing a blueprint for allocating expert effort in complex domains.
  Code: https://github.com/CAMMA-public/SURGE

AI.tldr: SURGE是一个基于SurgSpectrum-30M+（3000万+帧）预训练的手术基础模型，在5类任务、15个基准上系统评估标签效率，全面超越SOTA，并揭示任务相关的缩放规律。
AI.motivation: 手术AI中专家标注成本高、数量稀缺，开发标签高效模型是核心挑战。自监督基础模型虽能用少量数据适应新任务，但标签效率在不同手术任务间的差异尚未被探索。
AI.method: 构建最大规模预训练数据集SurgSpectrum-30M+（3000万+帧），训练手术基础模型SURGE并公开checkpoint；在5类任务、15个基准上系统评测标签效率，任务涵盖时序与空间场景理解、器械-解剖交互的细粒度推理及安全关键操作。
AI.result: SURGE在所有基准上超越先前SOTA，在复杂推理任务上甚至超过任务专用模型；发现任务相关的缩放行为：场景理解任务在极少监督下即饱和，而细粒度推理任务需更大标注预算才能持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 研究为复杂领域中专家人力投入的分配提供了指导蓝图，并发布代码与checkpoint以支持后续研究。

title: HyperReCo: Retrieving and Connecting Evidence with Hypergraph Neural Networks for LLM Multi-hop Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities, with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) supporting complex multi-hop reasoning by retrieving evidence distributed across documents. Graph-based approaches exploit connections among evidence, and hypergraph-based retrieval further preserves higher-order entity associations within documents and connects documents through shared entities. However, existing hypergraph retrievers often rely on predefined structural expansion or diffusion, which may miss query-dependent interactions needed to identify relevant evidence. They also leave connections among retrieved evidence implicit, requiring LLMs to reconstruct these connections before reasoning. Therefore, we propose HyperReCo, a framework for retrieving and connecting evidence with a hypergraph neural network (HyperGNN). We represent each document as a hyperedge over its extracted entities, with shared entities connecting the hyperedges. Through hypergraph message passing with joint supervision over documents and entities, the HyperGNN learns query-dependent interactions to retrieve complementary evidence. We further introduce Gradient-Guided Hyper-Path Decoding (GGHD), which uses gradient attribution to interpret the learned interactions and translate them into explicit hyper-paths that help LLMs combine complementary facts for multi-hop reasoning. Experiments on six benchmarks show that HyperReCo achieves the best retrieval performance among the compared methods on all three multi-hop QA datasets, together with strong downstream QA performance. Case studies and further analyses demonstrate the utility of decoded hyper-paths for connecting retrieved evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出HyperReCo框架，利用超图神经网络实现查询相关的证据检索与显式连接，提升多跳问答性能。
AI.motivation: 现有超图检索方法依赖预定义的结构扩展或扩散，可能遗漏查询相关的交互，难以识别相关证据；且检索到的证据间连接是隐式的，需LLM自行重建才能推理。
AI.method: 将每篇文档表示为其抽取实体上的超边，共享实体连接超边；通过超图消息传递并对文档和实体联合监督，使HyperGNN学习查询相关交互以检索互补证据；提出梯度引导超路径解码(GGHD)，用梯度归因解释学到的交互并转化为显式超路径。
AI.result: 在六个基准上实验，三个多跳QA数据集上的检索性能均优于对比方法，并具强下游QA表现；案例研究与分析验证了解码超路径连接检索证据的有效性。
AI.conclusion: HyperReCo通过超图建模与显式超路径连接，有效提升多跳推理的证据检索与连接质量。

title: When Valid Tool Calls Change Meaning: Formation-Consistent Dispatch for LLM Agents
summary: Tool-enabled agents form calls from model-visible interfaces, while hosts later select their implementation. Standard dispatch omits the descriptor-handler relation. An unchanged and schema-valid call can therefore acquire a different security effect during rollout, reconnect, or delayed approval. We call this failure schema-epoch drift. We present formation-consistent dispatch (FCD), which connects implementation analysis to execution authority. Reviewed profiles produce provenance-bound over-approximations of declared in-scope effects from official source. Under a closed-target approval policy, a verifier applies each formed call to a summary and captures a successor only when its effects fit the call's security contract. Atomic admission and a final-hop fence preserve this decision to the effect. The exact source retains priority, and the captured successor becomes eligible only after source retirement. Stock releases and deployment changes reproduced the failure. Four profiles covered 32 official releases: 29 required no release-specific change and three escalated. A frozen 16-release expansion matched a separate source oracle. In a preregistered stock comparison, FCD completed all three pending calls whose effect remained private and blocked all three whose omission became public. Exact pinning and release-wide denial stopped all six calls, while release-wide approval completed all six but produced three public effects. A separate lifecycle experiment carried a formation-captured certificate across source retirement. The same safe certificate installed later governed new formations without expanding the pending call's authority.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"schema-epoch drift"失效（同一schema合法调用在实现选择不同时获得不同安全效果），并给出formation-consistent dispatch (FCD)通过provenance-bound过近似、监管者校验与原子准入来绑定调用与效果。
AI.motivation: 工具调用的标准分发忽略了描述符与处理器之间的关系，导致未变更且schema合法的调用在rollout/reconnect/delayed approval时可能改变安全效果。
AI.method: FCD将实现分析连接到执行权威：用审查过的profile从官方源生成provenance-bound的声明范围内效果过近似；在closed-target审批策略下，验证器将形成的调用应用到摘要，仅当效果符合调用安全契约时捕获后继；并用原子准入与末跳fence保持决策到效果，源优先，源退休后捕获后继才可用。
AI.result: stock发布与部署变更复现了失败。4个profile覆盖32个官方release：29个无需release特定改动，3个升级。冻结的16-release扩展与独立oracle一致。预注册stock对比中FCD完成3个效果保持私有的pending调用并阻止3个遗漏公开的调用；exact pinning与release-wide denial阻止全部6个，release-wide approval完成全部6个但产生3个公开效果。另一生命周期实验让formation-captured certificate跨源退休携带。
AI.conclusion: FCD能防止schema-epoch drift，且同一安全证书在后续安装后治理新formation而不扩大pending调用的权限。

title: Does CoT-Pass@k Really Check the CoT? A Multilingual Mathematical Audit
comment: Accepted at MRL@EMNLP 2026 (Workshop on Multilingual Representation Learning). 24 pages, 13 figures, 6 tables
summary: Pass@k measures whether a model reaches a correct answer under repeated sampling, but never how: a lucky guess counts the same as sound reasoning. CoT-Pass@k was proposed to close that gap, adding an LLM-as-judge that must assess a solution's reasoning chain before it counts. Its value rests entirely on one assumption: that the judge catches flawed reasoning. That assumption has never been tested inside the metric that depends on it, and never outside English, though the metric's claims concern models used in many languages. We report the first audit of that verification step, run under the metric's own protocol on a multilingual suite of five mathematical benchmarks in English, Turkish and Portuguese, two of them natively written. We corrupt correct solutions with deterministic edits that damage the chain and the final answer separately. We observe that all three judges accept corrupted chains almost as often as clean ones. V4-Flash and Qwen3.6 reject a solution sharply only when its final answer is wrong and accept a wrong answer more readily when the chain agrees with it; the metric's own judge accepts most wrong answers as well. Our study shows that chain-answer agreement dominates the two larger judges' verdicts and that all three fail to reliably detect the tested reasoning errors. Consequently the difference Pass@k - CoT-Pass@k averages 19.7 points on an earlier solver generation but only 4.1 on the current one. What little remains depends on the token budgets on both sides and on the generation mode; raising the generation budget moves Pass@64 by more than fifty points while the difference stays at zero. We close with two checks any judged reasoning metric should pass before its numbers are read as evidence about reasoning.

AI.tldr: 首次审计CoT-Pass@k的LLM评判环节：在多语言数学基准上，三个评判器几乎无法区分受损推理链与干净推理链，链-答一致性主导判决，导致Pass@k与CoT-Pass@k差距从19.7分缩至4.1分。
AI.motivation: Pass@k只看结果对错，幸运猜中与正确推理等同；CoT-Pass@k引入LLM评判检查推理链来弥补，但其价值完全依赖"评判器能识别错误推理"这一从未被验证、也从未在英语之外检验的假设。
AI.method: 在度量自身协议下，用英、土、葡三语（含两个母语撰写）的五个数学基准构建多语言测试集，对正确解答做确定性破坏编辑，分别损害推理链与最终答案，再观察评判器对损坏链与干净链的接受情况。
AI.result: 三个评判器接受损坏链的比例几乎与干净链相当；V4-Flash与Qwen3.6只在最终答案错误时明显拒绝，且当链与错误答案一致时更易接受错误答案，度量自带评判器也接受多数错误答案。链-答一致性主导两个较大评判器的判决，三者均无法可靠检测所测推理错误。
AI.conclusion: Pass@k与CoT-Pass@k的差距在旧求解器代上平均19.7分，当前代仅4.1分；剩余差距取决于双方token预算与生成模式，文中给出任何评判式推理度量在数字被当作推理证据前应通过的两项检验。

title: SynDORBench: Evaluating LVLM Perceptual Robustness Under Physically Constrained Visibility Conditions
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance on multimodal reasoning benchmarks, yet their perceptual reliability under physically constrained imaging conditions remains poorly understood. Existing evaluations predominantly assume ideal visual inputs and therefore fail to characterize how camera distance, illumination, viewpoint, and pixel density fundamentally affect semantic recoverability. We introduce SynDORBench, the first physically grounded benchmark for evaluating LVLM perceptual robustness under DORI-calibrated conditions aligned with human visual capability standards. SynDORBench comprises over 54k question--answer pairs generated through a controllable synthetic pipeline that systematically varies viewing distance, lighting, camera geometry, and action pose according to physically interpretable pixel-density regimes. To support scalable low-visibility supervision, we further propose a discernibility annotation framework that propagates human perceptual labels using mask-conditioned statistical features and ensemble learning. We evaluate 16 open-source LVLMs, a commercial LVLM baseline, and YOLO11x across human-presence classification and action recognition tasks under progressively degraded visibility conditions. Our results reveal that perceptual failure in LVLMs is strongly governed by pixel density and physical imaging constraints rather than model scale alone. Surprisingly, several compact open-source LVLMs outperform larger commercial baselines and substantially exceed YOLO11x robustness under long-range and low-light conditions. SynDORBench establishes a new benchmark paradigm for physically grounded multimodal evaluation, enabling systematic analysis of LVLM reliability under real-world perceptual constraints and direct comparison against human visibility thresholds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SynDORBench，首个基于DORI物理标定、对齐人类视觉能力标准的LVLM感知鲁棒性基准，含54k+问答对，并揭示感知失败主要由像素密度与成像约束而非模型规模决定。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLM评估多假设理想输入，未刻画相机距离、光照、视角、像素密度等物理成像条件对语义可恢复性的影响，感知可靠性理解不足。
AI.method: 构建可控合成流水线，按物理可解释的像素密度区间系统性变化观察距离、光照、相机几何与动作姿态，生成54k+问答对；并提出基于掩码条件统计特征与集成学习的可辨识性标注框架传播人类感知标签。
AI.result: 在16个开源LVLM、1个商用LVLM及YOLO11x上评估人存在分类与动作识别任务。结果显示感知失败受像素密度与物理成像约束主导；若干紧凑开源LVLM优于更大商用基线，并在远距离低光下显著超YOLO11x。
AI.conclusion: SynDORBench建立了物理落地的多模态评估新范式，支持在真实感知约束下系统分析LVLM可靠性，并与人类可见度阈值直接对比。

title: Enabling Timely Guidance before Skill Retrieval: Retaining Helpful Warm Tips in Agent Context
summary: Reusable skills help LLM-based agents solve complex tasks, but the agent must receive guidance before it commits to an ineffective approach. Existing skill mechanisms often expose only metadata and load full content on demand, leaving useful guidance unavailable until the agent decides to retrieve it. General memory methods can incur substantial maintenance overhead, while keeping guidance in conversation context risks repeatedly exposing the agent to irrelevant or harmful advice. We propose TipsWarm, a mechanism that complements existing skill mechanisms by maintaining a budgeted pool of skill-derived keypoints, or \textit{warm tips}, for selective injection into the context of every message turn. By separating event-triggered LLM assessment from inexpensive per-turn screening, it makes transferable skill guidance readily available while controlling maintenance costs. In three coding and iterative task-execution benchmarks, TipsWarm achieves the highest task success rate while remaining time-efficient, compared to recent skill and general memory baselines.

AI.tldr: TipsWarm通过维护有预算的技能关键点池,在每轮消息中按需注入"温提示",让LLM代理在执行前即可获得可复用技能指导,同时控制维护成本。
AI.motivation: 可复用技能能帮助LLM代理解决复杂任务,但代理必须在投入无效方案前获得指导。现有技能机制只暴露元数据、按需加载完整内容,导致有用指导在代理决定检索前不可用;通用记忆方法维护开销大,而将指导保留在对话上下文中又可能反复暴露无关或有害建议。
AI.method: 提出TipsWarm机制,补充现有技能机制:维护一个有预算限制的技能衍生关键点池(warm tips),选择性地注入到每轮消息的上下文中。通过将事件触发的LLM评估与低成本的逐轮筛选分离,使可迁移的技能指导随时可用,同时控制维护成本。
AI.result: 在三个编程与迭代任务执行基准上,TipsWarm相比近期技能与通用记忆基线取得了最高任务成功率,并保持时间高效。
AI.conclusion: TipsWarm在保证时间效率的前提下提升了任务成功率,为LLM代理提供了一种低成本、可选择性注入技能指导的解决方案。

title: From Migration to Calibration: Preserving Agent Capabilities across Models, Jurisdictions, and Scale
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures. Methodological proposal: three-layer agent calibration framework; no empirical results reported
summary: Agents need calibration when deployment conditions change: replacing a driving model, including a foundation-to-post-trained transition; crossing jurisdictions; or scaling across heterogeneous markets and sources. Interface compatibility alone does not establish capability retention or target-contract satisfaction. We formulate agent calibration as constrained behavioral adaptation across three interacting layers: information preservation, harness adaptation, and user acceptance; the layers apply to every scenario, not one-to-one to the three. The basic objective is non-degradation on prespecified capability measures while satisfying target requirements; aggregate improvement is stronger. Information calibration preserves independently validated source content still applicable to the target task. Harness calibration aligns observable artifacts at semantic checkpoints and repairs them through iteration, tool substitution, or local replanning within explicit budgets. User calibration enforces recipient-specific output contracts: templates, schemas, and section-level preferences. A global e-commerce example shows how shared standards coexist with site- and market-specific adapters and validation. We distinguish trainable policies from frozen-backbone configuration or controller optimization, and evidence verification from relative judgment and DPO/GRPO optimization. Recent harness-transfer and judge-validity studies motivate target-native execution records, separate audits of task validity and near-tie ranking, and matched target-native optimization controls. We propose held-out evaluations for model changes, cross-border adaptation, and scale, including a factorial test of source evidence and checkpoint repair and group-level reporting to prevent aggregate gains from masking local failures. This is a methodological proposal; implementation and empirical validation remain future work.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"智能体校准"框架，将部署条件变化时的行为适配分为信息保持、工具链适配、用户接受三层，并给出评估方法论建议。
AI.motivation: 部署条件变化（换模型、跨法域、多市场扩展）时，仅接口兼容无法保证能力保持与目标契约满足，需要系统性的校准与验证方法。
AI.method: 将智能体校准形式化为三层交互的约束行为适配：信息校准（保留独立验证过的源内容）、工具链校准（语义检查点对齐并用迭代、工具替换或局部重规划修复）、用户校准（模板、schema、章节级偏好等输出契约）。区分可训练策略与冻结骨干配置/控制器优化，区分证据验证与相对判断及DPO/GRPO优化。
AI.result: 以全球电商为例说明共享标准与站点/市场专用适配器及验证可共存；提出需目标原生执行记录、任务有效性与近似平局排序的分离审计、目标原生优化匹配对照，以及留出评估（模型变更、跨境适配、规模）和因子实验设计。
AI.conclusion: 本文为方法论提案，目标是在满足目标要求下实现预设能力指标不退化（提升更佳），以分组报告防止聚合收益掩盖局部失败；具体实现与实证验证留待未来工作。

title: MixDetect: Word-Level Localization and Quantification of AI Editing
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to edit human-written text rather than generate entire texts from scratch. Conventional AI-text detectors mainly distinguish human-written from fully AI-generated text, while recent methods for AI-edited text typically provide only a text-level label or editing-degree score. We introduce MixDetect, a word-level framework for localizing and quantifying AI editing. MixDetect separately predicts whether each word has been edited and, conditional on editing, how substantial the edit is, allowing editing scope and editing intensity to be estimated separately. During training, source--edited pairs are aligned to construct word-level supervision, while inference requires only the input text. Experiments show that MixDetect accurately localizes AI-edited words, reflects differences in editing intensity, and reveals different scope--intensity patterns across editing degrees and operations. The overall AI editing magnitude increases under additional AI editing, decreases when AI-generated text is edited by humans, and remains nearly unchanged under ordinary human-to-human editing. The aggregated text-level predictions also perform well on binary and ternary AI-text classification and remain effective under domain and generator shifts. These results show that AI editing can be analyzed beyond a single authorship label or editing-degree score by identifying both where AI editing occurs and how substantial the edits are.

AI.tldr: 提出 MixDetect，一个词级框架，可分别定位并量化文本中的 AI 编辑位置与编辑强度。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 文本检测器多区分人工文本与完全 AI 生成文本，而针对 AI 编辑文本的方法通常只给出文本级标签或编辑程度分数，缺乏对"何处被编辑、编辑多大"的细粒度刻画。
AI.method: MixDetect 分别预测每个词是否被编辑，并在编辑前提下预测编辑幅度，从而分离编辑范围与编辑强度。训练时通过源文本—编辑文本对齐构建词级监督，推理时仅需输入文本。
AI.result: 实验表明 MixDetect 能准确定位 AI 编辑词、反映编辑强度差异，并揭示不同编辑程度与操作下的范围—强度模式：额外 AI 编辑使总体编辑幅度上升，人类编辑 AI 生成文本使其下降，普通人际编辑则几乎不变；聚合后的文本级预测在二分类与三分类任务上表现良好，且在领域与生成器偏移下仍有效。
AI.conclusion: AI 编辑分析可以超越单一作者身份标签或编辑程度分数，通过同时识别 AI 编辑发生的位置及其幅度来实现更细粒度的理解。

title: CueKFS: Agentic Cue-Driven Keyframe Selection for Long Video Understanding
summary: Keyframe selection (KFS) has long produced compact video summaries for browsing and retrieval, and representative frames for thumbnails. More recently, when conditioned on a question, KFS provides an alternative to uniform sampling for long-video question answering by selecting frames that are more relevant to the question. Most methods rank frames by similarity to the question. Yet a relevant frame may score poorly when the question combines subjects or moments that no single frame shows, or requires implicit information absent from its wording. Other methods try to break down the question into subqueries, but suffer from inaccurate decomposition due to their static initial context. Therefore, we propose CueKFS, a training-free method that reformulates question--frame matching as comparing frames against a set of dynamically generated visual cues. From an initial set of salient frames, we decompose the question into cues. Each cue concurrently probes the video to navigate to its own evidence. A reasoning VLM then agentically revises the cue set against its evidence to re-explore the video. CueKFS then allocates the budget across the surviving cues. Across three benchmarks, CueKFS establishes state-of-the-art results in all 27 evaluated settings with available prior results, achieving budget-averaged gains of up to +4.54% over the previous baseline and a median of only two VLM calls. We further provide a detailed behavioral analysis of CueKFS, showing that agentic cue refinement drives active re-exploration of the video, yielding relative similarity gains of up to 92% over the initial context.

AI.tldr: CueKFS：一种无需训练的关键帧选择方法，将问题-帧匹配重构为帧与动态生成视觉线索的比对，通过智能体式线索修正实现视频主动重探索，在27个评测设置中取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有基于相似度排序的关键帧选择方法在问题融合多个主体、时刻或含隐式信息时，单帧得分会偏低；而将问题分解为子查询的方法因静态初始上下文导致分解不准确。
AI.method: CueKFS为免训练方法：从初始显著帧出发将问题分解为一组视觉线索；每个线索并行探测视频以定位自身证据；推理VLM据此证据智能体式地修正线索集并重新探索视频；最后在存活的线索间分配预算。
AI.result: 在三个基准、全部27个有先前结果的评测设置中达到SOTA，较此前基线预算平均提升最高+4.54%，VLM调用中位数仅为2次；行为分析显示智能体式线索修正驱动视频主动重探索，相较初始上下文相似度相对提升最高达92%。
AI.conclusion: 通过动态视觉线索与智能体式修正，CueKFS在不训练、极少VLM调用下显著提升长视频问答的关键帧选择效果。

title: ALLOT: Budgeted Hybrid-Memory Routing for Knowledge Updates in LLMs
summary: For large language models (LLMs), parametric adaptation is costly when retrieval already suffices. We introduce ALLOT, a hybrid-memory routing framework that separates learned write priority from a hard parametric budget. A memory-aware router combines frozen text representations, retrieval confidence, and relation metadata; a single ranking supports multiple write budgets while preserving all facts in external memory. On CounterFact with Qwen3-4B, ALLOT reaches 0.760 accuracy at a 20% parametric-write budget and recovers 78.4% of the budget-matched oracle gain, with 80% fewer parametric writes than dual-writing every fact. At this budget, jointly adding retrieval and relation features to text improves normalized oracle gain by 6.2 percentage points. Complementary Qwen3-0.6B shared-store results achieve dual-write-level accuracy with 6-14.5% parametric writes, and cross-benchmark transfer retains approximately 88% of in-domain gain. These results support allocating adaptation capacity according to its incremental value rather than treating every factual update as an equally valuable training target.

AI.tldr: ALLOT是一个混合记忆路由框架，将学习到的写入优先级与硬性参数预算分离，在检索足够时降低参数适配成本。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的参数化适配代价高昂，而当检索已足够时这种适配往往不必要，需要按增量价值分配适配容量。
AI.method: 采用记忆感知路由器，结合冻结文本表示、检索置信度和关系元数据；单一排序支持多种写入预算，并将所有事实保留在外部记忆中。
AI.result: 在CounterFact与Qwen3-4B上，20%参数写入预算下达到0.760准确率，恢复78.4%的预算匹配oracle增益，参数写入比全量双写减少80%；联合加入检索与关系特征提升归一化oracle增益6.2个百分点；Qwen3-0.6B以6-14.5%参数写入达到双写水平；跨基准迁移保留约88%域内增益。
AI.conclusion: 应根据增量价值分配适配容量，而非将每个事实更新视为同等价值的训练目标。

title: ExpVoyager: Direct Experience Navigation for Dynamic Agent Skill Synthesis
summary: Learning from experience in LLM agents has become a key paradigm for developing self-evolving agents that continuously learn and expand their capabilities. Within this paradigm, synthesizing the agent skill has emerged as a promising solution for transforming accumulated experience into reusable procedural knowledge, serving as an important layer for the harness system that supplies agents at runtime. Despite its potential, existing approaches largely abstract past experience into fixed procedural knowledge before downstream demands are known, which risks discarding knowledge that later becomes critical while retaining instance-specific details irrelevant to future tasks. In this paper, we reframe agent skill synthesis as a dynamic navigation problem over past experience, where agents actively explore accumulated trajectories on demand for the current task with targeted and fine-grained access to experience knowledge. To this end, we propose ExpVoyager, a novel framework in which a skill curator navigates raw experience across different views and resolutions, continually identifying reusable procedural knowledge from what it observes while tracking remaining knowledge needs that guide where to navigate next. Extensive experiments demonstrate both the effectiveness and versatility of ExpVoyager, showing consistent improvements in downstream task performance, continual gains as the experience space scales, and practical compatibility with existing skills under efficient experience access.

AI.tldr: 本文将LLM智能体的技能合成重新定义为对过去经验的动态导航问题，提出ExpVoyager框架，按需、细粒度地从累积轨迹中提炼可复用程序性知识，实验证明下游任务性能提升且可随经验规模持续获益。
AI.motivation: 现有经验学习范式多为在未知下游需求前就将经验抽象为固定的程序性知识，容易丢弃后续变得关键的知识，同时保留对未来任务无关的实例细节。
AI.method: 将智能体技能合成视为动态导航问题：引入技能策展器(skill curator)，在不同视图与分辨率下导航原始经验，边观察边识别可复用的程序性知识，并追踪剩余知识需求以指导下一步导航方向。
AI.result: 大量实验表明ExpVoyager兼具有效性与通用性：下游任务性能一致提升，随经验空间扩大持续获益，并在高效经验访问下与现有技能良好兼容。
AI.conclusion: 按需、动态地从经验中导航并合成技能，优于预设固定知识的做法，为自进化LLM智能体的运行时技能供给提供了可行方案。

title: Auditing Quality Filters for Long-Tail Human Data Curation
summary: Robots on construction sites must detect workers who are kneeling or bending, which we call low poses. These workers can be lost from training datasets during automatic labeling. We study a pipeline that detects people, estimates their body joints using NLF, and groups similar poses. Low poses account for only about 2 percent of the retained examples. This low share may partly reflect the pipeline's quality filter, which rejects examples with low detection confidence or uncertain joint estimates. We examine this filtering using four alternative pose clues: bounding-box shape, vertical body span, pose grouping aligned to the scene's vertical direction, and image appearance. All four suggest that low poses are rejected by the filter more often. Separately, controlled simulated scenes show that a person detector fine-tuned on a public construction dataset misses more workers in these poses even when we correct their bounding box height is matched to that of standing workers. These findings suggest that low poses are scarce and hard to find, and we cannot rely on bounding boxes or poses for long-tail human data curation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究工作场景中"低姿态"（跪姿/弯腰）工人检测问题，发现低姿态在数据集中极少且更易被质量过滤掉，无法依赖边界框或姿态进行长尾数据整理。
AI.motivation: 建筑工地机器人需检测跪姿或弯腰的工人（低姿态），但这类样本在自动标注的训练数据集中容易丢失，存在长尾数据问题。
AI.method: 构建检测人-用NLF估计关节点-相似姿态分组的流水线；用四种姿态线索（边界框形状、垂直身体跨度、对齐场景垂直方向的姿态分组、图像外观）检验质量过滤的影响；并在受控模拟场景中测试微调后的人体检测器。
AI.result: 低姿态仅占保留样本约2%；四种线索均表明低姿态更常被过滤器拒绝；即使将边界框高度校正为与站立工人一致，检测器仍漏检更多此类姿态的工人。
AI.conclusion: 低姿态样本稀缺且难以发现，不能依赖边界框或姿态进行长尾人体数据的整理与筛选。

title: From Trajectories to Grounded Preferences: Process Preference Synthesis via Interaction Element Graphs for Web PRMs
summary: Comparative Process Reward Models (PRMs) provide critical step-level guidance for autonomous web agents by evaluating state-conditioned preferences between candidate actions. However, existing preference training data synthesized via multi-policy sampling suffers from a severe scarcity of Grounded Minimal Contrastive Pairs (GMCPs)-where competing candidates target genuine on-page elements with identical action types. In representative baselines preference data (namely, WebArbiter), GMCPs account for merely 24.19%, biasing PRMs during training to rely on shallow shortcuts (such as element hallucinations and action type mismatches) rather than acquiring genuine contextual decision semantics. To address these challenges, we propose SURFPRM, a graph-guided process preference synthesis framework for comparative Web PRMs. SURFPRM structures web demonstrations into a persistent Interaction Element Graph that acts as an environment-grounded negative action proposal mechanism, systematically synthesizing contrastive negative actions across spatial, temporal, and spatiotemporal confusion axes. This elevates the GMCP proportion from 24.19% to 74.60%, producing the curated SURFPRM-DATA dataset. Across six open-source backbones (3B to 9B parameters), PRMs trained on SURFPRM-DATA outperform baseline-trained models on average on WEBPRMBENCH and rival leading proprietary LLMs. In downstream reward-guided trajectory search on WEBARENA-LITE, SURFPRM provides step-level guidance for both GPT-4o (+14.21%) and GPT-4o-mini (+12.83%) policies, yielding substantial improvements in complex web task success rates.

AI.tldr: 提出SURFPRM框架，通过图引导合成对比偏好数据，缓解Web代理PRM训练中的捷径偏差问题。
AI.motivation: 现有对比式过程奖励模型（PRM）依赖多策略采样合成偏好数据，但严重缺乏"Grounded Minimal Contrastive Pairs (GMCPs)"——即竞争候选针对真实页面元素且动作类型相同的样本。基线数据WebArbiter中GMCP仅占24.19%，导致PRM训练偏向浅层捷径（如元素幻觉、动作类型不匹配），而非真正的上下文决策语义。
AI.method: SURFPRM将Web演示构建为持久化的"交互元素图(Interaction Element Graph)"，作为环境锚定的负动作提议机制，沿空间、时间、时空混淆轴系统合成对比负动作，从而生成高质量GMCP数据（SURFPRM-DATA）。
AI.result: GMCP比例从24.19%提升至74.60%。在6个开源骨干（3B–9B）上训练的PRM在WEBPRMBENCH上平均超越基线模型并可媲美专有LLM。在WEBARENA-LITE的奖励引导轨迹搜索中，为GPT-4o(+14.21%)和GPT-4o-mini(+12.83%)提供步级指导，显著提升复杂Web任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 通过图引导的偏好数据合成提升GMCP质量，可显著改善Web代理的对比式过程奖励模型训练效果与下游任务表现。

title: From Knowing to Abstaining: Bridging the Representation-Action Gap in Vision-Language Models
summary: The ability of vision-language models (VLMs) to abstain from unanswerable questions is as important as their ability to answer answerable ones accurately. Recently, several benchmarks have emerged to evaluate and improve VLM abstention, but they have substantial limitations. First, samples often contain shortcut cues in images or questions that reveal answerability, while an explicit "unanswerable" option further prevents accurate assessment of spontaneous abstention. Second, as training data, they generally provide only binary labels without fine-grained explanations for deeper supervision. To address these limitations, we introduce Visual Answerability Diagnosis with Rationales (VAD-R), a benchmark constructed through a two-stage pipeline of shortcut filtering and quality verification to prevent answerability leakage. Each example is annotated with step-by-step rationales and causal evidence-gap labels. Evaluation of state-of-the-art open- and closed-source VLMs on VAD-R reveals limited spontaneous abstention, with average recall rates of only 11.4% and 16.3%, respectively. Probing analyses show that hidden-state representations in certain layers can effectively distinguish answerability, yet this distinction fails to manifest in final responses. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Rep2Act, a representation-to-action alignment method that translates latent answerability awareness into explicit abstention decisions. Rep2Act improves action accuracy on VAD-R from 56.67% to 86.33% for Qwen2.5-VL-3B and from 59.33% to 88.67% for Qwen2.5-VL-7B. On the out-of-distribution TUBench, Rep2Act achieves an average F1 score of 53.3% with only a 3B model, surpassing the closed-source GPT-4 Turbo and GPT-4o by 16.2% and 1.1%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VAD-R基准（通过shortcut过滤与质量验证消除可答性泄漏，并标注步骤级理由与因果证据缺口标签）来评估VLM的自发弃答能力，发现现有模型表现很差；据此提出Rep2Act，将对齐隐状态中的可答性意识转化为显式弃答决策，大幅提升弃答准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有评估VLM弃答能力的基准存在两大缺陷：(1)样本中图像或问题含shortcut线索泄漏可答性，且显式"unanswerable"选项阻碍对自发弃答的准确评估；(2)训练数据多为二元标签，缺乏细粒度解释以提供深层监督。因此需要一个无泄漏、带理由标注的基准，并探索模型隐层意识与最终回答之间的脱节问题。
AI.method: 1) 构建VAD-R基准：两阶段流水线（shortcut过滤 + 质量验证）防止可答性泄漏，每个样本标注逐步理由和因果证据缺口标签；2) 对开闭源VLM评估并做probing分析，发现某些层的隐状态能区分可答性但未体现在最终响应；3) 提出Rep2Act表示-动作对齐方法，将潜在可答性意识翻译为显式弃答决策。
AI.result: SOTA模型自发弃答能力有限，平均recall仅11.4%（开源）和16.3%（闭源）。Rep2Act将VAD-R上的action accuracy从56.67%提升至86.33%（Qwen2.5-VL-3B），从59.33%提升至88.67%（Qwen2.5-VL-7B）。在分布外TUBench上，仅3B模型即取得53.3%平均F1，超过GPT-4 Turbo（16.2%）和GPT-4o（1.1%）。
AI.conclusion: VAD-R揭示了当前VLM自发弃答能力严重不足及表示-行动脱节问题，Rep2Act有效弥合这一鸿沟，在分布内和分布外任务上均显著优于现有乃至更大规模闭源模型。

title: Enhancing Visual Reasoning in Chest X-Ray Report Generation Using Reinforcement Learning
summary: Medical report generation has made significant progress with the rise of modern vision-language models and the growing availability of large-scale medical datasets. However, hallucinations remain a major challenge, largely due to the limitations of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which prioritizes lexical similarity to reference reports rather than clinical correctness. While reinforcement learning has shown strong performance in domains with verifiable rewards such as mathematics and code generation, its application to open-ended medical tasks remains limited. Existing work focuses on evaluating final answers, overlooking the model's reasoning, despite evidence that flawed reasoning can degrade overall performance. In this study, we propose a framework that verifies the model's reasoning process by integrating anatomical regions, bounding boxes, and region-level textual descriptions. We design spatial and factual reward mechanisms to ensure that the model's reasoning is both visually grounded and factually accurate. Starting from Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct as our base model, we adapt it to the medical domain using supervised fine-tuning, introduce reasoning capability through a cold-start SFT stage, and refine it with reinforcement learning. We find that RL provides performance gains beyond those achievable through SFT alone, and that jointly verifying both reasoning steps and final outputs yields larger improvements than verifying either in isolation. We further identify multiple modes of reward hacking in the RL stage. Finally, the model's structured think traces enhance interpretability, making its outputs easier to audit for clinical use.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种用于医学报告生成的强化学习框架，通过整合解剖区域、边界框和区域级文本描述来验证模型的推理过程，并设计空间与事实奖励机制，使推理既具视觉基础又符合事实。
AI.motivation: 医学报告生成虽随视觉语言模型和大规模医学数据集发展取得进展，但仍存在幻觉问题。根本原因在于监督微调（SFT）更关注与参考报告的词汇相似度而非临床正确性。强化学习在数学、代码等可验证奖励领域表现优异，但在开放式医学任务中应用有限，且现有工作仅评估最终答案、忽视推理过程，而有证据表明错误推理会降低整体性能。
AI.method: 以 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 为基础模型，先用监督微调适配医学领域，再通过冷启动 SFT 引入推理能力，最后用强化学习精调。提出融合解剖区域、边界框和区域级文本描述的推理验证框架，并设计空间奖励和事实奖励机制。
AI.result: 强化学习带来超越单纯 SFT 的性能增益；同时验证推理步骤和最终输出比单独验证任一者获得更大提升；研究还识别出 RL 阶段中多种奖励黑客（reward hacking）模式。
AI.conclusion: 模型的结构化思维链增强了可解释性，使其输出更易在临床场景中审查，表明推理过程验证对医学报告生成具有重要价值。

title: AuthorityLens: Rethinking LLM-Based Agent Systems Through the Lens of Authority
summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed with authority over consequential resources and decisions in real systems. These agents often operate alongside human and LLM-based participants who hold different forms of authority. Yet workflow roles, permission settings, and review mechanisms do not necessarily reflect the authority realized in practice. We introduce AuthorityLens, a framework for measuring a system's authority structure. Starting from an authority portfolio, we evaluate a system along three dimensions: what the system is authorized to do (System Authority), how much joint participation is required to exercise that authority (Authority Separation), and how much authority each participant holds (Principal Authority).
