AI.method: 先对目标图像拟合2D高斯的参数，再用密钥选取部分参数进行微调以嵌入8位消息；嵌入通过三类高斯参数实现：log-anisotropy、不透明度、颜色亮度。对比了随机选择与选择“扰动最小”的编辑方式，并在9次拟合的缩减设置中移除颜色亮度，使参数类型由3类减为2类（减少33.3%），同时保留256个高斯。
AI.result: 三张合成图上30次拟合：正确密钥可无误差恢复消息，错误密钥BER为0.543（接近随机猜测）；选择最小扰动编辑比随机选择更可靠（单侧p=0.031），平均PSNR代价仅0.091 dB。扩展到112张256×256自然图、4096个高斯：正确密钥BER=0.000，错误密钥BER=0.520。缩减设置中正确密钥仍无误差恢复，但错误密钥BER由0.514升至0.571，更偏离随机猜测。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明可在2D高斯参数中实现有效的隐写：正确密钥下消息可靠无误差恢复，且视觉质量损失极小；错误密钥解码接近随机猜测。同时，参数类型减少（如移除颜色亮度）会削弱错误密钥下的随机猜测性，提示参数选择与类型设计对安全性有影响。

title: From Latents to Wires: Surgical Post-Editing on Large Language Models
summary: Given a large language model (LLM), can whoever holds the weights name a semantic target (e.g., the model's identity), locate the model components that produce it, and edit them so that the target no longer appears while other capability is preserved? We call such an edit on a trained model a post-edit. We present L2W (latents to wires), a framework that performs surgical post-edits for named semantic targets. For localization, L2W uses Jacobian lens (J-lens) attribution to score components against the semantic target. For surgical removal, because LLM mechanisms are redundant (i.e., a semantic target may have multiple components producing it), L2W runs Counterexample-Guided Causal Cut (CGCC) until the target no longer appears. CGCC first cumulatively closes model components, treating each surviving expression of the target as a counterexample that exposes the next components to close, and then reopens some of them to preserve capability. In a controlled experiment with an implanted behavioural watermark, L2W removes the watermark, and its localization lands on the model region the implant changed. Across three model configurations, L2W removes model-metadata (e.g., identity) self-claims in all nine runs, and adult-content refusal in all three, with no held-out target residual. L2W further composes two post-edits on a text-to-image model: one removes the refusal of requested nudity, and a second removes the nude rendering the first exposes. The results support post-editing as a complement to post-training: post-training installs preferred behaviours, and post-editing removes named unwanted ones.

AI.tldr: L2W框架通过Jacobian透镜归因定位语义目标相关组件，并用反例引导因果切割（CGCC）进行外科式编辑，移除命名的不期望行为同时保持能力。
AI.motivation: 探究能否在已训练LLM中定位并编辑产生特定语义目标的组件，使其消失且保留其他能力，作为后训练的补充手段。
AI.method: L2W：用J-lens归因定位组件；因机制冗余，用CGCC迭代累积关闭组件（每次目标再现作为反例暴露下一个需关闭的组件），再重开部分组件以保留能力。
AI.result: 植入行为水印实验中成功移除水印且定位命中植入改变的区域；三种模型配置下9次运行全部移除元数据自述，3次全部移除成人内容拒答，无残留；在文生图模型上组合两次后编辑，先移除拒答再移除暴露的裸体渲染。
AI.conclusion: 后编辑可作为后训练的补充：后训练安装偏好行为，后编辑移除命名的不想要行为。

title: Reading Too Much into Context: Passive Exposure Can Steer LLM Decisions
summary: Large language model (LLM) assistants can now search the web and consult external sources while completing user requests. These sources can provide useful evidence, but they can also introduce additional content into the model's context. Can such passive exposure steer a decision even when the added content provides no reason to change it? We examine the stability of model decisions on the same tasks with and without such external content. Across all open-weight and closed-weight models we test, exposure systematically shifts decisions, with effects reaching nearly 50 percentage points in closed-weight models. The same pattern appears with real-world online opinions. The influence also extends beyond subjective preferences. Such exposure can steer models toward choices that violate explicit user requirements and increase their acceptance of false claims. In short, what enters an LLM's context can influence its decision even when it should not determine it.

AI.tldr: LLM助手在搜索/引用外部内容时，即使这些内容不构成改变决策的理由，也会系统性地改变其决策，影响可达近50个百分点，甚至违背用户要求、接受错误信息。
AI.motivation: LLM助手能在完成任务时检索网页、查阅外部来源，这些来源既提供有用证据，也把额外内容引入模型上下文。作者想探究：当新增内容本不应改变决策时，这种被动暴露是否仍会左右模型选择。
AI.method: 在有无外部内容的相同任务上，对比测试多个开放权重与闭源权重模型的决策稳定性；并测试真实在线观点场景，以及外部内容是否会引导模型违反用户明确要求、提高对虚假主张的接受度。
AI.result: 所有被测模型均出现系统性决策偏移，闭源模型效应近50个百分点；真实在线观点下同样出现该模式；影响超出主观偏好，会促使模型违反用户明确要求并更易接受错误主张。
AI.conclusion: 进入LLM上下文的内容会影响其决策，即使这些内容本不应决定决策；外部检索的被动暴露会破坏模型决策稳定性。

title: CausalDriveBench: Evaluating Causal Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving produce natural-language reasoning alongside predicted trajectories, but whether this reasoning reflects the causal structure of the scene remains untested. We introduce CausalDriveBench, an evaluation framework grounded in Pearl's Causal Hierarchy (PCH) that tests causal reasoning in driving-specific VLAs through structured visual question answering (QA) and alternative-trajectory prediction. To this end, we construct causal scene graphs over nuScenes that distinguish causally active, dormant, and distractor entities, separating perceptual salience from causal relevance. The benchmark spans all four rungs of PCH (association, intervention, and counterfactual along with causal discovery) for QA generation. For the higher rungs, we additionally provide reference trajectories under specified scene modifications, enabling action-level verification that complements reasoning-level evaluation. In total, the benchmark contains 7,285 verified causal QA pairs and 1,000 counterfactual trajectories derived from nuScenes. We evaluate 10 driving-specific VLAs and 3 general-purpose VLMs, and report three findings. First, the best model reaches only 70.6% QA accuracy, and 4 of 13 models score below random chance. Second, comparing each driving VLA to the general-purpose VLM that shares its language backbone, the cost of driving fine-tuning ranges from 2 to 34 percentage points on causal QA, with post-training design explaining the spread. Third, causal QA and trajectory accuracy are statistically uncorrelated across models: under counterfactual prompts, predicted trajectories either over-react or collapse onto the observed-scene baseline. Taken together, these results show that neither fluent rationales nor accurate observed-scene trajectories constitute evidence of causal understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CausalDriveBench，基于 Pearl 因果层级（PCH）评估自动驾驶 VLA 模型的因果推理能力，发现现有模型因果理解普遍不足，且推理与轨迹预测能力不相关。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶 VLA 模型虽能生成自然语言推理和轨迹预测，但其推理是否反映场景的真实因果结构尚未被验证，需要专门的因果评估框架。
AI.method: 构建 CausalDriveBench：在 nuScenes 上建立因果场景图，区分因果活跃、休眠与干扰实体；覆盖 PCH 四个层级（关联、干预、反事实、因果发现）生成 QA，并为高层级提供场景修改下的参考轨迹，实现推理级与动作级双重验证。
AI.result: 包含 7,285 个验证过的因果 QA 对和 1,000 条反事实轨迹；评估 10 个驾驶专用 VLA 与 3 个通用 VLM，最佳模型 QA 准确率仅 70.6%，13 个模型中 4 个低于随机；驾驶微调带来 2–34 个百分点的因果 QA 代价；因果 QA 与轨迹准确率统计上不相关。
AI.conclusion: 流畅的推理文本与观测场景下的准确轨迹都不能作为模型具备因果理解的证据，揭示当前 VLA 在因果推理上的根本局限。

title: Controllable GNN Explanations via Multi-Metric Preference Selection
summary: Mechanisms for generating GNN explanations are crucial for building trust and mitigating biases in Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), especially in high-stakes scenarios. Most current methods optimize only for fidelity under the sparsity constraint. However, this discounts the need for interpretable explanations (those that consist of familiar motif patterns) and stable explanations (those that remain unchanged under structural perturbations). We propose a novel approach that optimizes GNN explanations across these metrics, exposing their relative weighing as a control. Experiments on various real-world datasets, including MUTAG, BA-2Motif, BAMultiShapes, and PROTEINS, suggest that our method produces higher-fidelity explanations than a state-of-the-art baseline on MUTAG and PROTEINS across all evaluated budgets, and on BA-2Motif at larger budgets, while being faster in the regime of small explanation budgets. We also explore how, given an input motif library containing standard motifs for the corresponding domain, the method can be used to determine the relative importance of those motifs in generating the explanations, and how this information can be used to further improve the quality of the output explanations. We also examine the relationship between different metrics through their induced tradeoff surface, and explore its dependence on the nature of the motif library.

AI.tldr: 提出一种同时优化GNN解释的保真度、可解释性（motif模式）与稳定性（结构扰动下不变）的方法，通过调节各指标相对权重实现控制，并探索motif库对指标权衡的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有GNN解释方法大多仅在稀疏约束下优化保真度，忽视了可解释性（含熟悉motif模式）和稳定性（结构扰动下保持不变）的需求，而在高风险场景下这些特性对建立信任、缓解偏见至关重要。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖方法，跨多个指标优化GNN解释，并将各指标的相对权重暴露为可控参数；利用含领域标准motif的motif库确定各motif在生成解释中的相对重要性，并据此改进解释质量；通过诱导的权衡曲面分析各指标间关系及其对motif库性质的依赖。
AI.result: 在MUTAG、BA-2Motif、BAMultiShapes、PROTEINS等真实数据集上，方法在MUTAG和PROTEINS的所有评测预算下、BA-2Motif在较大预算下均比SOTA基线产生更高保真度的解释，且在小解释预算下速度更快。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合优化保真度、可解释性与稳定性，并引入motif库指导，可提升GNN解释质量；各指标间存在权衡关系，且受motif库性质影响，为可控、可信的GNN解释提供了新思路。

title: OneSign: Unifying Sign Language Understanding Tasks with One Model
summary: SLU encompasses a diverse set of tasks, including ISLR, CSLR, and SLT. Although these tasks share basic semantic and linguistic foundations, they are typically addressed with task-specific architectures and training pipelines, which hinders knowledge sharing and requires costly pretraining and finetuning for each task. In this paper, we focus on two aspects of SLU tasks: (1) training and inference pipelines are highly fragmented: most methods rely on pretraining on large-scale SL datasets followed by task- or dataset-specific finetuning, which leads to multiple specialized models rather than a single checkpoint. (2) current LLM-based methods may overlook the inherent modality discrepancy between sign and text tokens, simply concatenating them and processing both modalities with the same decoder layers. In this paper, we present OneSign, a unified framework that addresses multiple SLU tasks within a single model and a single checkpoint. OneSign reformulates ISLR, CSLR, and SLT under a single training paradigm. To accommodate the heterogeneous characteristics of sign and text representations, we introduce a Modality-Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts (MA-MoE) architecture, consisting of a shared expert and modality-specific experts for sign and text tokens. A modality router dynamically activates the corresponding experts, and their outputs are aggregated to form the final token representations. By enabling modality-dependent expert specialization while preserving a shared expert path, MA-MoE can effectively model the modality differences between continuous sign representations and discrete text tokens. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that OneSign achieves competitive or state-of-the-art performance on several benchmarks, highlighting its effectiveness as a unified SLU model. Datasets are available at : https://github.com/gswycf/OneSign.

AI.tldr: OneSign 提出统一框架，用单一模型和单一 checkpoint 处理 ISLR、CSLR 和 SLT 三类手语理解任务，并通过 Modality-Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts (MA-MoE) 处理手语与文本模态差异。
AI.motivation: 现有 SLU 任务通常采用任务专属架构和训练流程，知识难以共享，且每个任务都需昂贵的预训练与微调；此外，当前基于 LLM 的方法忽略手语与文本 token 间的模态差异，简单拼接并用同一解码层处理。
AI.method: OneSign 将 ISLR、CSLR 和 SLT 重构到统一训练范式下；提出 MA-MoE 架构，包含共享专家和针对手语、文本 token 的模态专属专家，通过模态路由器动态激活对应专家并聚合输出，实现模态依赖的专家特化同时保留共享路径。
AI.result: 在多个 benchmark 上，OneSign 取得了有竞争力或 state-of-the-art 的性能，验证了其作为统一 SLU 模型的有效性。
AI.conclusion: OneSign 通过单一模型和 checkpoint 统一多种 SLU 任务，并利用 MA-MoE 有效建模手语连续表示与离散文本 token 的差异，为统一手语理解提供了有效方案。

title: PruneForget: Joint Unlearning and Pruning of Vision Models
summary: Machine unlearning and model pruning are increasingly coupled in the real world. Models must support unlearning requests, e.g., for safety concerns, while also meeting requirements in latency and memory budget. Until recently, existing works have studied each aspect as an independent problem, e.g., running unlearning and pruning sequentially. In this work, we show that unlearning and pruning are naturally aligned and should be solved jointly to be made aware of each other. Intuitively, parameters that encode information of the unlearned samples are natural pruning targets, as unlearning and pruning both call for the "deletion" of such parameters. We propose PruneForget, a method that uses the unlearn set as a guide for pruning, so that unlearning and pruning mutually benefit each other. Extensive experiments on image classifiers and generative models show that PruneForget removes the influence of the unlearned samples while producing a more compact model with reduced inference cost. It achieves a negligible performance gap relative to an oracle that retrains from scratch for unlearning and then prunes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PruneForget，将机器遗忘与模型剪枝联合求解，用遗忘集指导剪枝，实现两者互利。
AI.motivation: 现实中模型既需支持遗忘请求（如安全考虑），又需满足延迟与内存预算。现有工作将遗忘与剪枝视为独立问题、顺序处理，未利用两者的内在关联。
AI.method: 发现遗忘与剪枝天然一致：编码被遗忘样本信息的参数正是自然的剪枝目标，两者都要求"删除"此类参数。据此提出 PruneForget，以遗忘集作为剪枝的引导，使遗忘与剪枝相互受益。
AI.result: 在图像分类器与生成模型上的大量实验表明，PruneForget 能消除被遗忘样本的影响，同时得到更紧凑、推理成本更低的模型；其性能与"从头重训练再剪枝"的 oracle 差距可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 遗忘与剪枝应联合求解以实现相互感知，PruneForget 验证了联合方法的有效性与接近最优的性能。

title: ForkLeft: Entropy-First Rollouts for Prefix-Aligned Autoregressive-to-Diffusion Distillation
summary: Autoregressive Next-Token Prediction (NTP) has enabled strong reasoning capabilities in language models, while Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) offer flexible token orders and parallel generation. We ask whether DLMs can acquire NTP-style reasoning through distillation without giving up their native generation process. Direct distillation, however, faces a fundamental mismatch: an autoregressive teacher predicts from a left prefix, whereas a DLM can condition on tokens on both sides. We introduce ForkLeft, a distillation framework that resolves this mismatch by separating the student's rollout from teacher supervision. During training, the student first performs entropy-first rollouts that commit uncertain positions and expose potential forks. We then fix the resulting student prefix and distill an NTP teacher under the same context, with answer correctness determining the supervision source. At inference, the student returns to its native confidence-first parallel decoding. With Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base, ForkLeft improves Efficient-DLM-4B on all ten benchmarks, raising MATH500 from 72.60% to 79.60% and consistently outperforming three alternative designs. The gains scale with teacher strength and generalize to SDAR-4B with only $500$ updates. At matched scale, the distilled 4B and 8B students exceed the published SDAR-Chat and OPDLM models on seven benchmarks, showing that DLMs can learn NTP-style reasoning without sacrificing native parallel generation. Code and datasets will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ForkLeft 蒸馏框架，使扩散语言模型（DLM）在不放弃原生并行生成的前提下，习得自回归式推理能力。
AI.motivation: DLM 具备灵活 token 顺序与并行生成优势，但缺乏 NTP 式推理能力。直接蒸馏存在根本性错配：自回归教师基于左侧前缀预测，而 DLM 可同时依赖两侧上下文。
AI.method: ForkLeft 将学生 rollout 与教师监督解耦：训练时学生先进行熵优先（entropy-first）rollout，锁定不确定位置并暴露分叉；随后固定学生前缀，在同一上下文下蒸馏 NTP 教师，并由答案正确性决定监督来源。推理时学生恢复其原生置信度优先的并行解码。
AI.result: 以 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base 为教师，ForkLeft 在全部十个基准上提升 Efficient-DLM-4B，MATH500 从 72.60% 升至 79.60%，并优于三种替代设计；增益随教师增强而扩大，仅 500 次更新即可泛化至 SDAR-4B。同规模下，蒸馏的 4B/8B 学生在七个基准上超过 SDAR-Chat 与 OPDLM。
AI.conclusion: DLM 可习得 NTP 式推理而不牺牲原生并行生成能力。

title: MedRouter: Demystifying Knowledge Differences Across Medical LLMs for Routing-Based Reasoning
summary: Medical question answering spans diverse specialties and modalities, and individual medical large language models (LLMs) exhibit distinct strengths across tasks and domains. This heterogeneity suggests that combining specialists may enable broader coverage of medical questions than relying on any single model. However, existing LLM routing methods primarily seek to balance answer quality and inference cost, leaving open how to exploit differences in specialist competence to improve medical reasoning. In this paper, we introduce MedRouter, an agentic system that uses an embedding-based multi-label router to select and query specialist LLMs, then passes their responses to a generator to produce the final answer. We further propose SCALE (Specialist Competence-Aware Learning), a two-stage training framework that first trains the Router with specialist correctness supervision and then optimizes its selections through reinforcement learning. The second stage uses a Performance Gain Reward (PGR) that measures how specialist information affects the generator's answer correctness relative to answering without that information. Experiments on eight text-based and multimodal medical QA benchmarks show that MedRouter outperforms the strongest routing baseline by 8% in average accuracy. Our analysis of specialist outputs further reveals distinct strengths and complementary question-level coverage, motivating learned routing to combine these capabilities for more comprehensive medical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出MedRouter，一个基于智能体路由的医疗问答系统，通过嵌入多标签路由器选择专科LLM并由生成器整合答案，配合两阶段训练框架SCALE提升医疗推理。
AI.motivation: 医疗问答涉及多专科多模态，单个医疗LLM在不同任务和领域表现各异，这种异质性意味着组合多个专科模型可比单一模型覆盖更广。然而现有LLM路由方法主要平衡答案质量与推理成本，未探索如何利用专科模型能力差异来提升医疗推理。
AI.method: MedRouter使用基于嵌入的多标签路由器选择并查询专科LLM，再将其响应传给生成器产生最终答案。SCALE两阶段训练：第一阶段用专科正确性监督训练路由器；第二阶段通过强化学习优化选择，采用性能增益奖励（PGR），衡量专科信息相对于无该信息时对生成器答案正确性的影响。
AI.result: 在八个文本及多模态医疗QA基准上，MedRouter平均准确率超过最强路由基线8%。对专科输出的分析揭示了各模型的独特优势及问题级别的互补覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的路由能有效整合多个专科LLM的互补能力，实现更全面的医疗推理，验证了利用专科能力差异进行路由的价值。

title: PQR3D: Progressive Query Refinement over Reference-Conditioned Temporal Windows for Multi-View 3D Object Detection
summary: Temporal context is essential for camera-only multi-view 3D object detection. Existing streaming detectors maintain and propagate query states from one frame to the next, requiring sequence-aware training and chronological inference. We propose PQR3D, which performs progressive query refinement within referenceconditioned temporal windows. This design enables random frame sampling and independent inference without persistent query memory. Within each window, PQR3D progressively transfers motion-aligned high-confidence queries from earlier timestamps toward the target frame. We further introduce masked selfattention to regulate interactions among regular, propagated, and denoising queries while keeping denoising supervision isolated from detection queries. In addition, a stage-decoupled anchor embedding injects position before self-attention and size, orientation, and velocity afterward, reducing interference from temporally inconsistent attributes. With a ViT-L backbone, PQR3D sets a new state of the art on the nuScenes test set, achieving 71.6 NDS and 64.9 mAP. Source code is available at https://github.com/huiyegit/PQR3D

AI.tldr: PQR3D提出在参考条件时间窗口内进行渐进式查询精炼，无需序列训练和时序推理，即可实现随机采样和独立推理，基于ViT-L在nuScenes测试集达到71.6 NDS和64.9 mAP。
AI.motivation: 时间上下文对纯视觉多视角3D检测至关重要，但现有流式检测器需维护并传播查询状态，依赖序列化训练和按时间顺序推理，灵活性差。
AI.method: 在参考条件时间窗口内渐进式精炼查询；将运动对齐的高置信度查询从早期时间戳传递至目标帧；引入掩码自注意力调节常规、传播和去噪查询交互，隔离去噪监督与检测查询；采用阶段解耦锚点嵌入，自注意力前注入位置，之后注入尺寸、朝向和速度。
AI.result: 基于ViT-L骨干网络，在nuScenes测试集上取得71.6 NDS和64.9 mAP，达到新的SOTA。
AI.conclusion: PQR3D通过时间窗口内渐进查询精炼，摆脱了持久查询记忆依赖，在保持随机帧采样与独立推理灵活性的同时实现了领先性能。

title: PULSE: Identifying Demonstration-Utility Features with Sparse Autoencoders
summary: In-context learning is highly sensitive to demonstration choice, yet most methods select demonstrations using external query-demonstration similarity. Such criteria can miss model-specific signals: Similar demonstrations may activate different internal features and downstream behaviors. We introduce PULSE (Paired Utility Localization over Sparse Encodings), an SAE-based framework for identifying model-internal features associated with demonstration utility and using them for demonstration selection. Using a small labeled discovery set, PULSE samples candidate demonstration sets, measures their zero-shot-relative utility under the target model, and scores SAE features by how their activation differences align with utility differences. The top positive and negative coordinates form a sparse utility-localization vector. We use this vector in two complementary ways: as a signed score for controlled complete-set ranking, and as PULSE-Retriever, which converts its magnitude into a feature-relevance mask for scalable pool-scale retrieval. Across classification, generation, and reasoning benchmarks, PULSE-Retriever improves over the strongest baseline by 2-3 accuracy points, 0.6-0.9 BLEU-4, and 3.2 exact-match points, respectively, while controlled ranking validates the identified features encode a predictive set-level utility signal. Feature inspection and cross-dataset experiments suggest that the identified features capture task-relevant, dataset-conditioned patterns, yet retain utility signals that partially transfer across datasets. Our code is available at https://github.com/aohenuo/PULSE.

AI.tldr: PULSE 是一个基于 SAE 的框架，通过识别模型内部与示例效用相关的特征来进行上下文学习中的示例选择。
AI.motivation: 现有示例选择方法多依赖外部查询-示例相似度，可能忽略模型特有的内部信号：相似示例可能激活不同的内部特征和行为。
AI.method: 利用小型标注发现集采样候选示例集，测量其在目标模型下的零样本相对效用，并按 SAE 特征激活差异与效用差异的对齐度打分，取顶端正负坐标构成稀疏效用定位向量；用于完整集排序的带符号评分，以及 PULSE-Retriever 通过幅度转成特征相关性掩码实现大规模检索。
AI.result: 在分类、生成和推理基准上，PULSE-Retriever 分别比最强基线提升 2-3 个准确率点、0.6-0.9 BLEU-4 和 3.2 个精确匹配点；受控排序验证了所识别特征编码了可预测的集合级效用信号。
AI.conclusion: 特征检查与跨数据集实验表明，识别出的特征捕获任务相关且受数据集条件影响的模式，同时保留可部分跨数据集迁移的效用信号。代码已开源。

title: Classifying Dominant Temporal Orientation without Pretrained Text Embeddings: A Novel Morphosyntactic Inventory Vector Approach
summary: Computational methods have consistently struggled to determine the dominant temporal orientation of a sentence. This difficulty is especially pronounced when a sentence contains multiple embedded clauses with competing tense and aspectual information. To address this difficulty, we propose an alternative approach for identifying a sentence's past, present, or future global reference interval. Our method does not use any form of pretrained embeddings. We rather encode sentences using fixed-length inventory vectors that are comprised of part-of-speech counts, dependency relation counts, and explicit futurate pattern counts. We term this inventory vector of a sentence a "Morphosyntacton". The method does not use any padding, sequence models, or large language models. Evaluation on 1,799 syntactically complex English sentences, annotated as past, present or future, shows balanced and high accuracy multiclass classification, achieving an overall multi-class accuracy of 92%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Morphosyntacton"方法，用固定长度清单向量（词性计数、依存关系计数、显式将来时模式计数）识别句子的全局时间参考区间，在1799个复杂英语句子上达到92%的多类准确率。
AI.motivation: 计算方法在确定句子的主导时间取向方面一直存在困难，当句子包含多个嵌套从句且带有相互竞争的时态和体信息时尤为明显。
AI.method: 不使用任何预训练嵌入、填充、序列模型或大语言模型；而是用固定长度的清单向量编码句子，向量由词性计数、依存关系计数和显式将来时模式计数构成，称为"Morphosyntacton"。
AI.result: 在1799个句法复杂的英语句子上（标注为过去、现在或未来）评估，实现了均衡且高精度的多类分类，总体多类准确率达92%。
AI.conclusion: 基于简单清单向量的方法无需预训练嵌入或大模型，即可高效识别句子的全局时间参考区间，在复杂句子上取得高准确率。

title: OneFixer: High-Quality and Consistent One-Step Autoregressive 3DGS Refinement for Driving Scenes
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion is a promising render-time fixer for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) in autonomous-driving simulation, but deployment demands high visual quality and temporal consistency at low latency. This is especially hard for one-step causal generation, where each imperfect prediction immediately becomes context for subsequent frames. Existing approaches stabilize rollouts through staged training with multiple modules and rollout-aware regularization, yet one-step quality still falls short of what deployment requires. We introduce OneFixer, a one-step autoregressive video-diffusion fixer trained in a single task-specific adaptation stage. Our key idea is a deployment-matched shared rollout: the model's own one-step predictions serve as the causal context for flow matching, exposing training to deployment-time errors, while the same rollout receives direct pixel-space perceptual supervision to preserve fine detail. Because the predictions optimized for current-frame quality are exactly those reused as future context, fidelity and autoregressive robustness are learned jointly, without bidirectional-to-causal conversion or teacher-student distillation. OneFixer further exploits cues that driving simulation readily provides, lane geometry and dynamic-agent states, to improve geometric fidelity. On Waymo and proprietary driving scenes with 900-frame rollouts, OneFixer achieves the lowest FVD, LPIPS, and DISTS among all baselines at one step, with temporal consistency matching or exceeding multi-stage DMD pipelines. Under identical backbone and conditioning, it matches a multi-stage DMD-with-Self-Forcing pipeline in under half the GPU-hours and keeps improving beyond its plateau. In closed-loop simulation with a driving policy, OneFixer reduces the collision rate by a third relative to raw 3DGS rendering. Project page: https://onefixer-web.vercel.app/

AI.tldr: OneFixer：单阶段训练的一步自回归视频扩散修复器，通过“部署匹配的共享 rollout”联合学习保真度与自回归鲁棒性，用于3DGS自动驾驶仿真，低延迟下质量与一致性优于多阶段方法。
AI.motivation: 3DGS在自动驾驶仿真中需高画质、时序一致且低延迟的视频修复。一步因果生成难度大：每个不完美预测立即成为后续帧上下文。现有方法用多模块分阶段训练与rollout正则稳定生成，但一步质量仍不足。
AI.method: OneFixer在单一任务适配阶段训练：采用部署匹配的共享rollout，让模型自身一步预测作为flow matching的因果上下文，暴露部署时误差；同一rollout接受像素空间感知监督以保细节。当前帧质量优化所用预测即未来上下文，故保真与自回归鲁棒性联合学习，无需双向转因果或师生蒸馏。并利用车道几何与动态智能体状态提升几何保真度。
AI.result: 在Waymo及私有驾驶场景900帧rollout上，OneFixer一步生成取得最低FVD、LPIPS、DISTS，时序一致性匹配或超过多阶段DMD管线；相同骨干与条件下，GPU小时不足多阶段DMD+Self-Forcing一半，且超过其平台期继续提升。闭环仿真中相较原始3DGS渲染碰撞率降低三分之一。
AI.conclusion: OneFixer以单阶段训练实现高质量一步自回归视频修复，兼顾保真度与鲁棒性，效率显著优于多阶段方案，并提升闭环驾驶仿真安全性。

title: Knowing Is Not Choosing: What Explicit Verification Adds Beyond Generative Preference
summary: Generating a correct answer does not mean that a language model will select it. We separate factual recall into three steps: generating a correct candidate, ranking the available candidates, and selecting the final answer. Pre-generation readouts predict factual recall and which questions sampling will cover across three model families, but say little about whether an available correct answer will ultimately be selected. Explicit verification with $P(\mathrm{True})$ improves within-question ranking over mean log-likelihood in Gemma, Qwen3, and Llama, with AUROC gains of $0.08$--$0.12$. In a prospectively defined Gemma cohort, verification raises plurality accuracy by about $5$ points, and still gains about $2$ points over chat-template likelihood, a stronger generative baseline. The advantage is strongest for relations with common-answer priors and depends on access to the entity; masking the entity removes the ranking advantage in larger Qwen models. Finally, the measured benefit depends on how correctness is defined: recall-oriented reference matching can credit option lists favored by likelihood and substantially understate the improvement seen under human semantic judgments.

AI.tldr: 论文将事实回忆拆分为生成候选、排序候选和选择答案三步，发现生成正确答案不等于能选出它，显式验证（P(True)）能提升排序与准确率。
AI.motivation: 区分"生成正确答案"与"最终选择正确答案"是关键：模型可能生成了正确候选，却因排序不佳而未选中，现有方法对此关注不足。
AI.method: 将事实回忆分解为三步；比较预生成读出（pre-generation readouts）与显式验证 P(True)；在 Gemma、Qwen3、Llama 上对比 mean log-likelihood 与 chat-template likelihood；通过实体掩码实验及前瞻性 Gemma 队列验证。
AI.result: 预生成读出可预测事实回忆及采样覆盖，但难以预测正确答案是否被选中；P(True) 验证在三个模型族上较 mean log-likelihood 提升排序 AUROC 0.08–0.12；在 Gemma 队列中多数学准确率提升约 5 点，较 chat-template likelihood 仍高约 2 点；优势在有常见答案先验的关系上最强，且依赖对实体的访问，掩码实体后大 Qwen 模型排序优势消失。
AI.conclusion: 正确答案的生成与选择应区分对待，显式验证能显著改善排序与准确率，但其收益受关系类型、实体可访问性及正确性定义方式（参考匹配 vs 人类语义判断）影响。

title: Federated 3D Gaussian Splatting for Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction at Wireless Edge
comment: 16 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables. Accepted for publication
summary: Three-dimensional (3D) Gaussian splatting (3D-GS) has emerged as a promising technique for large-scale scene reconstruction due to its high rendering efficiency and fidelity. However, the training of large-scale 3D-GS models at wireless edge faces various technical challenges including the limited communication, computation, and graphics processing unit (GPU) memory resources at edge devices, the structural inconsistency issue across local models hindering their effective aggregation, as well as privacy leakage risks associated with raw visual content and camera parameters. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel resource-efficient federated learning framework for efficiently training 3D-GS models of large scenes under severe resource constraints. First, we propose an on-device model lightweighting mechanism that adaptively selects and prunes Gaussian points to balance the rendering quality and training efficiency. In this mechanism, we quantitatively evaluate the importance of different Gaussian points at each device to facilitate the pruning, and use a novel importance-to-latency ratio criterion to determine the number of pruned Gaussian points under GPU memory and computation/communication latency constraints. Furthermore, we develop a 3D-GS model recovery mechanism that restores structural consistency across local 3D-GS models without accessing private camera parameters, enabling their effective aggregation towards a global model. Finally, extensive experiments show that our approach significantly accelerates convergence, maintains high rendering quality, and reduces training latency compared to state-of-the-art federated 3D-GS baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出面向大规模3D-GS的资源高效联邦学习框架，通过高斯点轻量化与模型恢复机制应对边缘资源受限与隐私问题。
AI.motivation: 大规模3D-GS训练在无线边缘面临通信/计算/GPU显存受限、本地模型结构不一致难以聚合、以及原始视觉内容与相机参数泄露的隐私风险等挑战。
AI.method: 1) 端上模型轻量化机制：量化各设备上高斯点重要性，自适应选择与剪枝，并用"重要性-时延比"准则在显存与计算/通信时延约束下确定剪枝数量；2) 3D-GS模型恢复机制：在无需访问私有相机参数的情况下恢复本地模型间结构一致性，实现有效聚合。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，相比最先进的联邦3D-GS基线，方法显著加速收敛、保持高渲染质量并降低训练时延。
AI.conclusion: 该联邦学习框架可在严重资源约束下高效训练大规模3D-GS模型，兼顾渲染质量、训练效率与隐私保护。

title: From Outcomes to Strategies: Learning Strategy Utility for Mathematical Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has substantially improved mathematical reasoning. However, terminal correctness alone provides limited insight into the quality of high-level strategies, such as theorem selection and subgoal decomposition, when considered separately from their subsequent execution. This paper studies strategy utility, which is defined as the likelihood that a strategy supports a correct downstream solution under a given executor. We introduce SURE, a framework for learning and leveraging relative strategy utility. In this framework, high-level strategies are separated from their detailed reasoning. Based on the pairwise preferences constructed from strategy-conditioned rollouts and teacher-generated contrasts, a Strategy Reward Model is learned to estimate relative strategy utility. During reinforcement learning, the frozen reward model reads only the extracted strategy, whose score is combined with the correctness and format rewards in a sequence-level GRPO objective. Compared with outcome-and-format GRPO baselines, experiments show that SURE improves average pass@1 by 1.87%, 2.64%, and 2.93% across three policy backbones. Our method also achieves competitive or better accuracy than stronger reward baselines while requiring substantially lower GRPO-stage compute.

AI.tldr: SURE框架通过策略奖励模型学习策略相对效用，将其与GRPO结合提升数学推理pass@1。
AI.motivation: 仅凭最终正确性无法反映高层策略（如定理选择、子目标分解）本身的优劣，因为策略质量与其后续执行效果混在一起。
AI.method: 将高层策略与详细推理分离，基于策略条件化rollout和教师对比构建成对偏好，训练策略奖励模型估计相对策略效用；RL时冻结奖励模型只读策略，其分数与正确性、格式奖励在序列级GRPO目标中结合。
AI.result: 相比outcome-and-format GRPO，在三个策略主干上平均pass@1分别提升1.87%、2.64%、2.93%；精度与更强奖励基线相当或更优，且GRPO阶段计算量显著更低。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模和奖励策略效用可在较低计算成本下改善数学推理性能。

title: CAME: Company-Aware Evidence-Memory Experts for Interpretable Quarter-Ahead Revenue Forecasting
summary: Quarter-ahead revenue forecasting requires company-scale numerical accuracy, strict temporal validity, and company-specific interpretation of narrative disclosures. LLMs can distill textual evidence but can produce scale-misaligned forecasts, whereas history-based anchors are stable but miss forecast-time signals such as product transitions, supply constraints, and management guidance. We introduce CAME (Company-Aware Evidence-Memory Experts), a residual-forecasting framework that refines a no-leakage statistical anchor when current semantic evidence and prior error patterns justify an adjustment. On a development-inclusive rolling backtest of 336 company-quarters from 12 large public technology and platform firms, CAME achieves the lowest aggregate point-estimate error among the reported methods, with statistically supported macro-sMAPE gains over the matched Statistical Anchor, and outperforms History + Guidance on all six aggregate metrics. CAME also links adjustments to source-linked evidence cards and guarded memory traces, supporting forecast inspection, provenance, and failure localization.

AI.tldr: CAME：一种公司感知的证据记忆专家残差预测框架，用于季度营收预测，在无泄露统计锚点基础上结合语义证据与历史误差模式进行调整，提升预测精度并提供可追溯性。
AI.motivation: 季度营收预测需兼顾公司规模的数值精度、严格时间有效性和针对公司的文本解读。LLM虽能提炼文本证据，但预测尺度易错位；基于历史的锚点稳定，却忽略产品转型、供应约束、管理层指引等预测时信号。
AI.method: 提出CAME（Company-Aware Evidence-Memory Experts）残差预测框架：以无泄露统计锚点为基础，当当前语义证据与历史误差模式支持调整时，对其进行修正，融合证据记忆与实时的文本语义信号。
AI.result: 在12家大型科技与平台公司、336个公司-季度的滚动回测中，CAME在报告方法中取得最低总体点估计误差，相对匹配统计锚点的宏观sMAPE提升具有统计显著性，并在全部六项聚合指标上优于“History + Guidance”。
AI.conclusion: CAME将预测调整与来源链接的证据卡和受保护记忆轨迹关联，支持预测审查、来源追溯与失败定位，实现高精度且可解释的季度营收预测。

title: Binaural Audio-Visual Instance Segmentation
summary: Audio-visual segmentation (AVS) aims to segment sounding objects at the pixel level by integrating auditory and visual cues. However, existing methods are predominantly developed under the monaural setting and primarily rely on cross-modal semantic correspondence, which limits their ability to distinguish visually similar instances of the same semantic class. In contrast, humans naturally exploit binaural hearing, where interaural differences and direction-dependent acoustic filtering introduced by the head and pinnae provide physically grounded spatial cues for accurate sound source localization. Motivated by this observation, we introduce binaural audio-visual instance segmentation (BiAVIS), a new task that leverages synchronized binaural audio and video frames to segment sounding instances. To advance research on this task, we establish two benchmarks by manually annotating an existing binaural audio-visual dataset and collecting a new real-world dataset, BiAVIS-Bench, in more challenging and diverse scenarios. We further propose a BiAVIS model, which leverages an audio-only sound source localization network to learn spatial and semantic priors for sounding instances from binaural audio. A query-level audio-visual fusion strategy is subsequently introduced to inject these informative priors into the instance segmentation decoder. Extensive experiments conducted on the two proposed benchmarks demonstrate the superior performance of the BiAVIS model over previous monaural AVS methods, especially in resolving instance-level intra-class ambiguity. On the more challenging BiAVIS-Bench, the proposed BiAVIS model outperforms the best-performing monaural baselines by 17.22\% in mAP and 7.71\% in FSLA, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双耳视听实例分割(BiAVIS)新任务，利用双耳音频的空间线索实现发声实例的像素级分割，并构建两个基准数据集与相应模型。
AI.motivation: 现有AVS方法基于单声道设置，主要依赖跨模态语义对应，难以区分同一语义类别中视觉相似的实例。人类利用双耳听觉的耳间差异及头部/耳廓的方向相关滤波提供空间线索来精确定位声源，受此启发引入双耳信息。
AI.method: 提出BiAVIS任务，利用同步双耳音频与视频帧分割发声实例；通过人工标注现有双耳视听数据集并采集新数据集BiAVIS-Bench建立两个基准；提出BiAVIS模型，用纯音频声源定位网络从双耳音频学习空间与语义先验，并通过查询级视听融合策略将先验注入实例分割解码器。
AI.result: 在两个基准上实验表明BiAVIS模型优于单声道AVS方法，尤其能解决实例级类内歧义。在BiAVIS-Bench上，较最佳单声道基线mAP提升17.22%，FSLA提升7.71%。
AI.conclusion: 双耳空间线索能有效提升视听实例分割的性能，验证了利用双耳音频进行实例级分割的优越性，为该方向提供了新任务、基准和方法。

title: Separating Diagnosis from Disease Representation: Dual-View EEG Learning with Neural-Dynamics-Guided Deformation
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG)-based closed-loop neuromodulation calls for a subject-specific structured state, as opposed to a single disease probability, specifying which brain regions are deviant, at which frequencies, and at which lags. Sensor-space models keep the strongest diagnostic evidence without anatomy, source-space models give anatomy at a loss of predictive signal, and post-hoc attributions stay outside the prediction. We separate the two instead of forcing them into one representation, and propose DMD-EEG (Dual-view Multiscale Deformation for EEG), which keeps a fixed scalp spectral expert for diagnosis and models the source-space disease-related representation as a low-rank, sparse, iterative deformation of a healthy neural-dynamics prior in a $46$-region-of-interest (ROI) $\times$ $5$-frequency $\times$ $4$-lag (autocorrelation-timescale) space. The two experts meet only at a fixed decision level, so the source state is architecturally separate from the scalp expert. Across major depressive disorder (MDD), first-episode psychosis (FEP), and Parkinson's disease (PD), decision-level fusion matches the strongest single expert on MDD and FEP and exceeds the source branch on PD. On FEP the source expert is the strongest branch, the task where the deformation contributes most. The source state is an explicit ROI-frequency-lag attribution defined in a shared source coordinate system across montages, which we treat as an anatomically-coordinated predictive representation whose coordinates are directly readable and hypothesis-generating. The highest-saliency coordinates align with established disease circuitry (fronto-limbic-temporal regions in MDD, motor-cortex beta in PD), and the MDD state transfers by rank to an unseen cohort recorded with a different montage.

AI.tldr: 提出DMD-EEG双视角多尺度形变框架，分别保留头皮诊断专家和源空间疾病表征，在MDD、FEP、PD上实现可读的ROI-频率-滞后归因。
AI.motivation: EEG闭环神经调控需要被试特异的结构化状态（哪些脑区异常、在何频率、何滞后），而非单一疾病概率。头皮模型保留最强诊断证据但无解剖信息，源空间模型提供解剖却损失预测信号，事后归因又游离于预测之外，因此需将两者分离而非强行融合。
AI.method: DMD-EEG保留固定的头皮谱专家用于诊断，并将源空间疾病表征建模为健康神经动力学先验在46 ROI×5频率×4滞后（自相关时间尺度）空间中的低秩、稀疏、迭代形变。两个专家仅在固定决策层汇合，源状态在架构上与头皮专家分离。
AI.result: 在MDD、FEP、PD上，决策级融合在MDD和FEP上匹配最强单专家，在PD上超过源分支。FEP中源专家为最强分支（形变贡献最大）。源状态为跨导联共享坐标下的显式ROI-频率-滞后归因，高显著坐标与已知疾病环路一致（MDD额-边缘-颞区，PD运动皮层beta），且MDD状态可按秩迁移至不同导联的未见队列。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在不牺牲诊断性能的前提下，提供解剖协调、可直接读取且可生成假设的预测性源表征，支持跨队列的疾病状态迁移。

title: Generalization Dynamics of LM Pre-training
summary: People typically assume that LMs stably mature from pattern-matching parrots to generalizable intelligence during pre-training. We build a toy eval suite and show this mental model is wrong: throughout pre-training, LMs frequently and suddenly hop between parrot-like and intelligence-like computations. We call this mode-hopping. Across our suite, LMs suddenly latch onto memorized or in-context patterns instead of in-context learning, use System 1 instead of System 2 thinking, pick up what sounds true instead of what is true, fail at multi-hop persona QA, out-of-context reasoning, and emergent misalignment -- then just as suddenly revert and generalize. Mode-hopping is not explained by standard optimization dynamics: it is locally stable and cannot be fixed by checkpoint averaging. We instead think of it as a capacity allocation problem: in a capacity-bounded model, generalizable circuits must compete with the shallow ones learned early in training, and the data in each pre-training window may decide which circuits win. Our suite provides a new efficient lens on generalization. We demonstrate two concrete applications: (i) select intermediate pre-training checkpoints that strongly generalize reasoning and alignment, better than the final pre- or mid-training checkpoints, and (ii) select pre-training data that controls and stabilizes generalization dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"mode-hopping"现象：预训练中LM会在"鹦鹉式"与"智能式"计算间频繁突变，推翻其稳定成熟的假设，并给出应对应用。
AI.motivation: 人们普遍假设LM在预训练中从模式匹配的"鹦鹉"稳定成熟为可泛化的智能。作者认为这一心智模型是错误的，希望揭示预训练动态的真实特征。
AI.method: 构建一个玩具评测套件（toy eval suite），覆盖ICL、System 1/2、真假判断、多跳persona QA、上下文外推理和涌现错位等任务，追踪预训练全过程的模型行为，并分析优化动态与容量分配。
AI.result: 发现LM频繁且突然地在鹦鹉式与智能式计算间跳变（mode-hopping）；该现象局部稳定且无法通过checkpoint平均消除。其被解释为容量受限模型中可泛化回路与早期浅层回路的竞争，由各预训练窗口数据决定胜负。
AI.conclusion: 该套件为泛化研究提供高效新视角，可应用于：(i) 选取泛化推理与对齐更强的中间checkpoint，优于最终checkpoint；(ii) 选取可控并稳定泛化动态的预训练数据。

title: KeyRec: Bounded Visual Memory for Streaming and Long-Video Understanding
summary: Vision-language models are increasingly used to understand long videos and continuous streams. However, dense visual tokens accumulate with video duration, making long-context inference prohibitively expensive. Existing training-free visual-token selection methods reduce this cost by retaining informative tokens, but may lose coherent event evidence and fail to distinguish detailed recent observations from long-range history. We propose \textbf{KeyRec}, a training-free framework for constructing bounded visual memory. During query-agnostic writing, KeyRec preserves fine-grained recent observations in a visual cache and organizes historical evidence into a structured event bank. Candidate events are proposed according to their novelty relative to previously stored events and maintained through an online add--merge--evict update. When a question arrives, a text-only router adaptively allocates a fixed readout budget between recent and event memory, without reprocessing historical frames. KeyRec operates on model-facing visual embeddings and supports both modular encoder--projector VLMs and the encoder- and projector-free NEO-ov architecture. Across four streaming and long-video benchmarks and three VLM backbones, KeyRec achieves the best compressed performance in 13 of 15 settings using only 10\% of the dense decoder-facing visual-token budget. It outperforms the strongest compressed baseline by 2.21--18.37 points on real-time questions, achieves the best compressed result in five of six long-video settings, and performs best in every NEO-ov 2B setting.

AI.tldr: 提出 KeyRec，一个免训练的有界视觉记忆框架，通过区分近期细节缓存与结构化事件库，并用文本路由器自适应分配读取预算，在仅用10%视觉token的情况下实现长视频/流式推理的最优压缩性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型处理长视频时，密集视觉token随视频时长累积，导致长上下文推理代价过高。现有免训练token选择方法虽降低成本，但会丢失连贯的事件证据，且无法区分近期细节观测与长期历史。
AI.method: KeyRec 在查询无关的写入阶段，将细粒度近期观测保存在视觉缓存中，并把历史证据组织为结构化事件库；依据新事件相对已存事件的新颖性提出候选事件，通过在线 add-merge-evict 更新维护。查询到来时，用纯文本路由器在近期记忆与事件记忆间自适应分配固定读取预算，无需重新处理历史帧。方法作用于模型侧视觉嵌入，同时支持模块化 encoder-projector VLM 与无 encoder/projector 的 NEO-ov 架构。
AI.result: 在4个流式与长视频基准、3个VLM骨干上，KeyRec 在15个设置中的13个取得最佳压缩性能，仅使用10%的密集解码器侧视觉token预算。实时问题上比最强压缩基线高2.21–18.37分，在6个长视频设置中5个最优，并在所有 NEO-ov 2B 设置中表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: KeyRec 通过有界视觉记忆与自适应读写机制，在极低token预算下有效兼顾近期细节与长程事件，显著优于现有压缩基线。

title: Towards Scalable Data Diversification for Language Model Pretraining via Leverage Score Sampling
summary: Data selection for language model pretraining faces a fundamental tension between quality and diversity. While quality filtering is empirically effective, it often induces diversity collapse: by favoring texts similar to high-quality reference corpora (e.g., educational or QA-style data), it systematically excludes valuable data from underrepresented domains. In contrast, diversified selection preserves domain balance and encourages robust downstream performance, yet existing methods either focus on coverage-oriented objectives that indirectly enhance diversity, or directly optimize for diversity via costly covariance matrix recomputation that limits scalability. To address these issues, we introduce \textbf{Leverage Score Sampling (Lev)}, which iteratively selects samples that maximally expand the determinantal volume of the embedded data via leverage scores, a computationally efficient criterion that eliminates matrix recomputation and enables scalable selection. Empirically, Lev delivers up to $72\times$ speedup and improves dataset diversity, measured by the Vendi score, by $9.2\%$ over the strong diversification baseline \textbf{DiSF}. On CommonCrawl (CC) web data selection, Lev improves accuracy across seven downstream tasks by up to $1.31\%$ over existing baselines. For domains where robust quality criteria are inherently difficult to define (e.g., code), Lev serves as an effective unsupervised curation alternative: on StarCoderData, the selected subset reduces bits-per-byte by $3.08\%$ over DiSF. Notably, we uncover a cross-domain collapse of quality filtering: CC data filtered by DCLM-fastText fail to retain sufficient code-related content, yielding inferior code performance relative to Lev-selected data. These findings advocate for integrating diversity-aware practices into quality filtering for more effective data curation in language model pretraining.

AI.tldr: 提出 Leverage Score Sampling (Lev)，利用杠杆分数迭代扩充嵌入数据的行列式体积来选样，兼顾质量与多样性，最高72倍加速、Vendi多样性提升9.2%，下游任务与代码数据表现均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 语言模型预训练的数据选择存在质量与多样性的根本矛盾：质量过滤虽有效，但因偏好与高质量参考语料相似的文本而导致多样性崩塌，系统性排除欠代表领域的数据；而现有多样化选择方法要么仅以覆盖为导向间接提升多样性，要么因需反复重算协方差矩阵而难以扩展。
AI.method: 提出 Leverage Score Sampling (Lev)：迭代选择能最大程度扩充嵌入数据行列式体积（determinantal volume）的样本，使用杠杆分数这一计算高效的准则，避免矩阵重算，实现可扩展的多样化选样。在CommonCrawl与StarCoderData上进行评估。
AI.result: 相比强多样化基线DiSF，最高72倍加速，Vendi多样性提升9.2%；在CC数据上七个下游任务准确率最高提升1.31%；在StarCoderData上bits-per-byte降低3.08%。并发现质量过滤的跨领域崩塌现象：经DCLM-fastText过滤的CC数据无法保留足够代码相关内容，代码表现劣于Lev所选数据。
AI.conclusion: 倡导在质量过滤中融入多样性感知实践，以实现更有效的语言模型预训练数据治理。

title: Where Do Test-Time Scaling and Training Fall Short in Individual Stance Prediction?
summary: Test-time scaling and post-training have improved LLM performance in coding and mathematical reasoning, but their effectiveness for individual stance prediction remains unclear. We study this question by predicting a person's stance in a new discussion from their history. We evaluate widely used test-time scaling strategies and post-training methods, such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, and identify four failure modes across generation, selection, and learning: (1) incorrect consensus, where repeated samples agree on the wrong stance; (2) selection failure, where generation covers the observed stance but selection misses it; (3) response overfitting, where supervised fine-tuning improves imitation but harms prediction; and (4) early plateau, where reinforcement learning shows modest initial gains followed by limited further improvement. We expose these failures using STANCE-BENCH, which contains 2499 prediction tasks from 500 Hacker News users. Guided by this analysis, we explore a simple approach that combines direct scores for all candidate stances with explicit assessments of support from the individual's history. On the 781-task test set, this approach achieves 21.83 discussion-specific Macro F1 with Qwen3-8B, compared with 19.27 for direct scoring. Our results motivate evaluating candidate generation, final selection, and person-specific evidence use separately.

AI.tldr: 本文研究测试时扩展与后训练方法在个体立场预测中的效果，识别出四种失败模式，并提出结合直接打分与历史支持评估的简单方法提升性能。
AI.motivation: 测试时扩展与后训练在编码和数学推理上提升了LLM表现，但其对个体立场预测是否有效尚不清楚，作者希望探究这一问题。
AI.method: 从用户历史预测其在新讨论中的立场，评估常见测试时扩展策略与后训练方法（监督微调、强化学习），并构建STANCE-BENCH基准（2499个预测任务，来自500名Hacker News用户）；进而提出结合所有候选立场直接打分与显式评估历史支持的方法。
AI.result: 识别出四种失败模式：错误共识、选择失败、响应过拟合、早期平台期。在781任务测试集上，该方法以Qwen3-8B达到21.83讨论特定Macro F1，对比直接打分的19.27。
AI.conclusion: 应分别评估候选生成、最终选择与个体特定证据使用；所提方法验证了该分析思路的有效性。

title: Scalable In-Domain Self-Supervised Foundation Model for Dense Representation Transfer in High-Resolution Plant Imaging
summary: High-resolution plant imaging enables detailed characterization of plant morphology, but dense scientific analysis remains limited by costly pixel-level annotations, large image pixel dimensions, and substantial variation in imaging conditions. This work proposes a scalable in-domain self-supervised pretrained foundation model for high-resolution, high-pixel-dimension multi-species plant imagery. A masked autoencoder with a ViT backbone is pretrained on more than 10 million multi-view plant image tiles using distributed training. Following scalable pretraining, the learned foundation-model representations are comprehensively benchmarked across fine-grained dense prediction and coarse global feature recognition, with particular emphasis on limited supervision and realistic downstream imaging conditions. This work focuses on the domain gap of existing foundation models in dense feature representation and transfer. Through extensive experiments involving limited annotations, cross-view variation, and resolution degradation, the in-domain FM achieves a Mean Dice of 0.8686 and a Pooled Dice of 0.8959, outperforming an MAE counterpart pretrained on large-scale natural-image data by 0.0694 and 0.0613, respectively. The results further indicate that increasing pretraining scale produces consistent improvements in dense feature transfer. Overall, these findings suggest that scaling in-domain self-supervised pretraining can reduce the domain gap and improve transferable dense representations for high-pixel-dimension scientific imaging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向高分辨率多物种植物图像的域内自监督预训练基础模型，用MAE+ViT在千万级图像块上预训练，显著提升密集预测的迁移表现。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率植物成像分析受限于昂贵的像素级标注、超大图像尺寸及成像条件差异；现有基础模型在密集特征表示上存在域间差距。
AI.method: 以ViT为骨干的掩码自编码器（MAE），在多视角植物图像块（超1000万）上进行分布式大规模域内自监督预训练，并在细粒度密集预测与粗粒度全局识别任务上全面评测，重点考察有限监督与真实下游成像条件。
AI.result: 域内基础模型达到Mean Dice 0.8686、Pooled Dice 0.8959，分别比大规模自然图像预训练的MAE高出0.0694和0.0613；扩大预训练规模可持续提升密集特征迁移效果。
AI.conclusion: 扩大域内自监督预训练可缩小域间差距，为高像素科学成像提供更具迁移性的密集表示。

title: When Helpful Text Hurts: Option-Redirecting Bias in Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026 (ACM MM 2026). 25 pages, 16 figures. This arXiv version includes supplementary material
summary: In tri-modal visual question answering (VQA), auxiliary text is commonly used to complement visual and textual inputs, yet its reliability is often uncontrolled. While prior work studies modality conflicts in general, it remains unclear how different types of unreliable auxiliary text affect answer selection under fixed image-question-option contexts. In this work, we show that the most harmful auxiliary text is not necessarily the most factually incorrect, but the one that aligns with the question while contradicting the image and favoring a specific distractor, leading to systematic redirection of model predictions. To isolate this effect, we introduce the Textual Reliability Ladder, a controlled diagnostic protocol that decomposes auxiliary text along three axes: image consistency, question relevance, and option support. Across multiple datasets (ScienceQA, VCR, A-OKVQA, Causal-VidQA) and recent VLMs, we find that such distractor-supporting text induces the largest accuracy drops (up to 53.1%) and concentrates errors on specific incorrect options. To mitigate this failure mode, we propose a training-free inference-time intervention that explicitly counteracts this redirection effect via noise-stability steering and dynamic grounding, reducing redirected errors while largely preserving performance under faithful text. Our results highlight that auxiliary-text reliability must be understood at the decision level, rather than solely through factual correctness, and provide a practical pathway toward more robust tri-modal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究三模态VQA中不可靠辅助文本对答案选择的影响，发现最有害的并非事实最错误的文本，而是"支持干扰项"的文本，并提出一种免训练推理干预方法来缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 三模态VQA中辅助文本常被用来补充视觉和文本输入，但其可靠性往往不受控制。以往工作研究了一般性的模态冲突，但在固定的图文-选项上下文下，不同类型的不可靠辅助文本如何影响答案选择仍不清楚。作者希望揭示辅助文本可靠性应在决策层面而非仅事实正确性层面来理解。
AI.method: 提出"文本可靠性阶梯"（Textual Reliability Ladder）控制性诊断协议，将辅助文本沿三个轴分解：图像一致性、问题相关性、选项支持度。在ScienceQA、VCR、A-OKVQA、Causal-VidQA多个数据集和近期VLM上评估，并提出一种免训练的推理时干预方法，通过噪声稳定性引导（noise-stability steering）和动态接地（dynamic grounding）来抵消预测重定向效应。
AI.result: 支持干扰项的文本造成最大准确率下降（最高达53.1%），并将错误集中在特定的错误选项上，这一现象普遍的模态冲突更严重。所提干预方法在忠实文本下基本保持性能，同时减少被重定向的错误。
AI.conclusion: 辅助文本的可靠性必须从决策层面理解，而不仅仅通过事实正确性；这为更稳健的三模态推理提供了实用途径。

title: Scoring the Wrong Question: Readout Failures in Constrained-Option Evaluation
summary: Constrained-option scoring reads a model's probabilities for a fixed set of permitted answers, so it returns a score even when the model is about to write something else. We study a prompt that quotes a multiple-choice item, ending in the item's own answer instruction, and asks for a forecast of whether a reader model given only a short note will answer it correctly. The model can begin answering the quoted item: on three Qwen3 checkpoints an answer letter is the most probable token on nearly every passage, and the forecast ranks the reader's correctness indistinguishably from chance. Beyond prior work's argmax check and prefill repair, we contribute a label-free diagnostic of the declared options' support, their first-token mass in context; a deletion test tracing the Qwen3 answer-letter start to the quoted instruction; and rendering and tokenisation checks for dropped separators and coinciding first tokens. Prefilling an answer stem lifts the median option mass from below to above one half on all nine checkpoints scored with this prompt and, with options and renormalisation unchanged, raises the Qwen3-averaged AUC from 0.4929 to 0.6152. lm-polygraph's default P(True) estimator shows a related failure: it reads True where Qwen3 without thinking favours an answer letter (MMLU) or the prompt's (A)/(B) label (TriviaQA), and its Qwen3-averaged AUROC is indistinguishable from chance on MMLU and below chance on TriviaQA. Scoring and renormalising the (A)/(B) labels after an answer stem raises it to 0.632 and 0.868, renormalising True against False in place reaches 0.660 and 0.860, and on TriviaQA both exceed all fourteen default single-answer library estimators. The original forecast is renormalised too, yet stays indistinguishable from chance: option mass flags low support in both settings without labels, and only checking the intended target shows which score still ranks.

AI.tldr: 受限选项打分（constrained-option scoring）在模型即将输出其他内容时仍返回分数，本文诊断其在"预测读者模型是否正确"提示下的失效，并提出无标签诊断与修复方法。
AI.motivation: 研究一个提示：引用多选题并以其答案指令结尾，要求预测仅获简短提示的读者模型能否答对。发现模型可直接回答被引用的题目，且预测与随机无异，需诊断该失效根源并修复。
AI.method: 在argmax检查与prefill修复之外，提出：声明选项支持度的无标签诊断（首token在上下文中的概率质量）；追踪Qwen3答案字母起始的删除测试；渲染与分词检查（分隔符丢失、首token重合）；用答案词干预填（prefill）修复。
AI.result: 答案词干预填使九个检查点的中位选项质量从低于半数升至高于半数；Qwen3平均AUC由0.4929升至0.6152。lm-polygraph默认P(True)估计器也出现相关失效；对(A)/(B)标签打分重归一化后提升至0.632和0.868，True/False重归一化达0.660和0.860，TriviaQA上双双超过全部14个默认单答案库估计器。
AI.conclusion: 原始预测即使重归一化仍与随机无异：选项质量可无标签标记低支持，但只有检查预期目标才能判断哪个分数仍具排序能力。

title: Contamination, Prior, or Evidence? Decomposing and Training Evidence Use in Whole-Slide Vision-Language Models
summary: Pathology vision-language models (VLMs) are conventionally evaluated by accuracy, but accuracy alone does not measure evidence use: it may conflate dataset contamination, prior knowledge, and image evidence. In a motivating study of lymph-node metastasis prediction, we found that most public pathology VLMs showed minimal differences when changing from feeding the models with whole-slide images, an annotated lesion, or no image at all. To better understand the specific features leveraged by these models, this paper presents two contributions aimed at disentangling these factors. First, we present CleanSlide, a TCGA-based VQA benchmark designed to eliminate image- and question-side contamination. It contains 149K audited multiple-choice questions over 9,985 slides, with patient- and tissue-source-disjoint splits. Every question is audited for option shortcuts, stem leakage, cross-split duplication, and blind solvability. Second, we propose Pair-DPO, a preference loss over counterfactual slide pairs from the same question and source. By controlling for shared confounding factors, Pair-DPO cancels out the question-attributable signal and leaves image evidence as the source of preference. Specifically, each pair consists of two real slides with opposite, verified findings, introducing neither editing artifacts nor unverified labels for diffuse or graded features such as invasion, necrosis, and tumor grade. Experiments show that our method gains 15.29% from image evidence on the CleanSlide, compared with 2.81% for the best published model. On the external CPTAC and BCNB cohorts, our method achieves accuracies of 57.6% and 59.0%, outperforming all other evaluated models by 9.7% and 3.4%, respectively. We will release the benchmark and code.

AI.tldr: 提出CleanSlide基准与Pair-DPO方法，分离病理VLM中的图像证据与其他混淆因素，显著提升图像证据利用率。
AI.motivation: 现有病理VLM仅用准确率评估，无法衡量是否真正利用图像证据，可能混淆数据污染、先验知识等因素。研究中发现模型在有/无图像时表现差异极小。
AI.method: 1) CleanSlide：基于TCGA的VQA基准，149K审计多选题，9985张切片，患者与组织来源分离，审计选项捷径/题干泄漏/跨集重复/盲解；2) Pair-DPO：对同一问题与来源的反事实切片对做偏好损失，控制共享混淆因素，图像证据成为偏好来源。
AI.result: CleanSlide上图像证据增益15.29%，最佳已发表模型仅2.81%；外部CPTAC和BCNB准确率57.6%和59.0%，分别领先9.7%和3.4%。
AI.conclusion: 通过基准与方法将图像证据与混淆因素分离，显著提升证据利用与外部泛化能力，将公开基准与代码。

title: RepoMAS: Solving Progressively Specified Tasks with Issue-Driven Multi-Agent Systems
summary:
LLM-based multi-agent systems (MASs) have shown strong potential for solving complex tasks, but most assume that task requirements are sufficiently specified before execution. In practice, user requests are often incomplete, and additional requirements may only become clear during reasoning, tool use, or execution. We refer to such problems as progressively specified tasks.
  To systematically study this setting, we introduce ProgSpec, a benchmark that evaluates final outputs against requirements explicitly stated in the initial request and additional requirements supported by the available task evidence. We further propose RepoMAS, an issue-driven multi-agent framework inspired by open-source project management. RepoMAS records newly discovered requirements, conflicts, and failures as structured Issues and uses them to revise the task specification and execution structure during problem solving.
  Across ProgSpec and five existing benchmarks, RepoMAS achieves the best performance. Further analyses show that its issue-driven revision and repository maintenance mechanisms consistently contribute to performance. These results highlight the importance of allowing MASs to revise not only how a task is solved, but also revise their explicit representation of task requirements during execution.

AI.tldr: 论文提出渐进指定任务问题，即用户请求初始不完整，需求在推理和执行中逐步明确。作者构建ProgSpec基准并设计RepoMAS多智能体框架，用结构化Issue记录新需求、冲突和失败，动态修订任务规范。在ProgSpec及五个现有基准上取得最佳表现。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM多智能体系统大多假设任务需求在执行前已充分指定，但真实场景中用户请求常不完整，额外需求只在推理、工具使用或执行过程中才逐渐清晰（渐进指定任务）。
AI.method: 提出ProgSpec基准，按初始请求中明确需求及任务证据支持的新增需求评估最终输出；提出RepoMAS框架，受开源项目管理启发，以Issue驱动方式记录新发现的需求、冲突和失败，并据此在求解过程中修订任务规范与执行结构。
AI.result: 在ProgSpec及五个现有基准上，RepoMAS均取得最佳性能；分析表明其Issue驱动修订和仓库维护机制持续带来性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 应允许多智能体系统在执行过程中不仅修订"如何解决任务"，还修订对任务需求的显式表示，这对处理渐进指定任务至关重要。

title: Identifying Temporal Features within Transcoders for Time Sensitive Factual Recall
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) suffer from temporal misalignment, often due to the contradictory nature of their training corpora. While current mitigation strategies rely on computationally expensive fine-tuning or context-heavy retrieval augmented generation (RAG), the internal mechanisms governing time-sensitive recall remain under-explored. Unlike prior studies that identify temporal components such as attention heads and MLP layers, we provide the first feature-level map of temporal recall by isolating individual MLP features via transcoder circuit tracing. We identify three node categories (common temporal, common to the year, and chrono-semantic) which interact to generate a temporal filter during factual recall. By analysing Gemma 2 2B, LLaMA 3.2 1B, and Qwen3-4B, we show that these features do not follow a simple linear pipeline but represent time through a parallel and mixed syntactic-semantic interplay across layers. We additionally discover a class of higher-layer temporal components invisible to existing EAP-IG methods, establishing transcoders as a more complete lens for temporal interpretability in time-sensitive factual recall. These findings present MLP components for potential targeted interventions in time-sensitive factual recall

AI.tldr: 该论文首次在特征层面绘制了大语言模型时间回忆的图谱，通过transcoder电路追踪隔离单个MLP特征，揭示时间过滤机制的并行语义-句法交互结构。
AI.motivation: LLM存在时间错位问题，源于训练语料的矛盾性。现有缓解方法依赖昂贵的微调或上下文繁重的RAG，而控制时间敏感回忆的内部机制尚未被充分探索。已有研究虽识别了注意力头和MLP层等时间组件，但缺乏特征级别的细粒度理解。
AI.method: 通过transcoder电路追踪（transcoder circuit tracing）隔离单个MLP特征，分析Gemma 2 2B、LLaMA 3.2 1B和Qwen3-4B三个模型，识别时间回忆中的节点类别及其跨层交互模式。
AI.result: 识别出三类节点：常见时间节点（common temporal）、年份共有节点（common to the year）和时间语义节点（chrono-semantic），它们交互生成事实回忆中的时间过滤器。这些特征并非简单线性流水线，而是在层间呈现并行且混合的句法-语义交互。此外发现了一类现有EAP-IG方法无法察觉的高层时间组件。
AI.conclusion: transcoder是时间可解释性更完整的视角，揭示了MLP组件可用于时间敏感事实回忆的定向干预，为缓解LLM时间错位提供了新的机制性基础。

title: Presence Is Not Faithfulness: Figurative Vehicle Intrusion in Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image (TTI) models increasingly generate high-quality images from natural-language prompts, yet figurative language exposes a failure: a vehicle that should guide the depiction of a tenor may instead be rendered as a visible object. We call this failure Figurative Vehicle Intrusion: the intruding content is textually licensed, but it is assigned the wrong visual role, showing that visual presence is not always faithfulness and that presence-oriented evaluation can miss such errors. To study it systematically, we introduce Vehicle Intrusion and Semantic Tenor Assessment (VISTA), a multilingual benchmark of figurative prompts organized by Figurative Form and Mapping Mechanism. We further propose V-Score, a diagnostic question-answering metric that evaluates role-aware figurative faithfulness in generated images. Evaluations on recent high-performing TTI models show that vehicle intrusion persists across languages and figurative categories. As a lightweight mitigation, we introduce VISTA-Guard, which partially reduces vehicle intrusion and suggests a practical path toward more figuratively faithful TTI generation. All resources will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示文生图模型的"喻体侵入"失败：本应引导本体描绘的喻体被错误渲染为可见物体，提出VISTA基准与V-Score指标来系统诊断该问题。
AI.motivation: 文生图模型虽能根据自然语言生成高质量图像，但比喻性语言暴露其缺陷：喻体可能被当作可见对象绘制，说明"视觉存在"不等于"忠实"，而现有以存在性为导向的评估会漏检此类错误。
AI.method: 提出VISTA多语言比喻提示基准（按比喻形式与映射机制组织）；提出V-Score，一种基于诊断性问答、评估角色感知比喻忠实度的指标；并给出轻量缓解方案VISTA-Guard。
AI.result: 在近期高性能文生图模型上的评测显示，喻体侵入跨语言、跨比喻类别持续存在；VISTA-Guard可部分减少喻体侵入。
AI.conclusion: 视觉存在并非比喻忠实，需角色感知的评估；VISTA与V-Score为此提供系统化诊断，VISTA-Guard指明更忠实生成的实际路径，所有资源将公开。

title: Beyond Prompt or Skill? Attribution-Guided Optimization of Modular LLM Programs
summary: Large language models can solve increasingly diverse reasoning tasks, yet their performance remains highly sensitive to task prompts, intermediate instructions, and the way reusable problem-solving knowledge is incorporated. Existing optimization methods usually focus on only one part of this design space: they either optimize a monolithic prompt, or separately induce and refine skills from model traces. As a result, they lack a principled mechanism for deciding which component should be updated when failures occur, and they rarely optimize prompts, skills, and skill-use policies in a unified framework. We propose SPARO (Skill, Prompt, And Routing Optimization), a framework that jointly optimizes task instructions, reusable skill blocks, and routing rules. It performs controlled counterfactual evaluations, converts examples' effects into a probabilistic responsibility distribution over prompt, skill, and routing components, samples one component from that distribution, and applies the corresponding targeted mutation. This design moves language-program optimization beyond global prompt rewriting toward structured, reusable, and selectively activated task knowledge. Across five benchmarks and five worker models, SPARO consistently outperforms both prompt-centered and skill-centered optimization baselines. These results suggest that effective language-program optimization depends not only on discovering useful task knowledge, but also on deciding where that knowledge should be stored and when it should be activated.

AI.tldr: 提出SPARO框架，联合优化任务指令、可复用技能块与路由规则，通过反事实评估将失败归因到概率责任分布并针对性变异，在5个基准和5个模型上优于仅优化提示或技能的基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM优化方法通常只关注设计空间的一部分：要么优化单一整体提示，要么单独从模型轨迹中归纳和精炼技能。缺乏在失败时决定"该更新哪个组件"的原则性机制，也很少将提示、技能和技能使用策略统一优化。
AI.method: SPARO（Skill, Prompt, And Routing Optimization）联合优化任务指令、可复用技能块和路由规则。方法包括：进行受控反事实评估，将示例的影响转化为对提示、技能、路由组件的概率责任分布，从该分布中采样一个组件并施加相应的针对性变异。
AI.result: 在5个基准和5个worker模型上，SPARO持续优于以提示为中心和以技能为中心的优化基线。
AI.conclusion: 有效的语言程序优化不仅取决于发现有用的任务知识，还取决于决定该知识应存储在哪里以及何时被激活。使优化超越全局提示重写，走向结构化、可复用、选择性激活的任务知识。

title: Turning Speech Language Models into Multilingual Listeners
summary: Speech Language Models (SLMs) that understand spoken language questions support only a few high-resource languages, limiting access to millions of people worldwide. This gap stems from the scarcity of multilingual speech instruction-tuning datasets. We present MULTISPEECHQA, a large-scale, synthetically generated and human-verified dataset comprising 9200 hours of 10.8 million spoken question-answer pairs in 23 typologically diverse languages. Using MULTISPEECHQA, we also introduce MULTISPEECH-BENCH, a multi-task benchmark for evaluating SLM performance on 23 languages. We compare the performance of a cascading system to open-weight and closed SLMs on MULTISPEECH-BENCH and find that the cascading system outperforms open-weight SLMs but not all closed SLMs. We use MULTISPEECHQA to finetune Qwen 2.5-Omni, which improves its performance on our benchmark. Our findings show that high-quality synthetic datasets offer a cheap solution to improving the multilingual capabilities of SLMs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MULTISPEECHQA多语言语音指令数据集（9200小时、1080万问答对、23种语言），并构建MULTISPEECH-BENCH基准，用于评测和提升语音语言模型的多语言能力。
AI.motivation: 现有语音语言模型仅支持少数高资源语言，主要瓶颈在于缺乏多语言语音指令微调数据，导致全球数百万用户难以使用。
AI.method: 合成生成并经人工校验构建MULTISPEECHQA数据集；基于该数据构建覆盖23种语言的MULTISPEECH-BENCH多任务基准；对比级联系统与开源/闭源SLM，并用该数据微调Qwen 2.5-Omni。
AI.result: 级联系统优于开源SLM，但未超过全部闭源SLM；微调Qwen 2.5-Omni后在基准上性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 高质量合成数据集是提升语音语言模型多语言能力的一种低成本有效方案。

title: Evaluating Single and Multi-Omics Based Explainable Artificial Intelligence (MOXAI) for Molecular Subclass Classification of Adult-Type Diffuse Gliomas
summary: DNA methylation (DNAM) profiling has emerged as a powerful diagnostic tool for classifying brain and solid tumors. However, existing computational models typically analyze methylation and copy number variation (CNV) data separately, failing to capture the complementary information their integration could provide. Moreover, current classification models lack mechanisms for within-class risk assessment analogous to traditional tumor grading, and no established explainability method can attribute classification decisions to specific genomic loci. In this paper, we present MOXAI (Multi-Omics Based Explainable AI), a deep learning framework that integrates DNA methylation and copy number data from methylation arrays to classify molecular subtypes of adult-type diffuse gliomas, alongside single-modality variants for comparison. Using a cohort from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), we trained ResNet50, DINOv2, and Graph Attention Network (GAT) models on methylation data alone, copy number data alone, and combined multimodal data. We further developed explainable AI (XAI) methods based on class activation maps (CAMs) and gradient-weighted CAM (Grad-CAM) to identify the specific CpG sites, genes, and chromosomal regions most relevant to each classification decision. The multimodal model achieved up to 92.98% cross-validation accuracy, outperforming models trained on CNV data alone. DINOv2 showed the strongest generalization, reaching 94.25% accuracy (confidence >0.9) on independent validation sets. XAI results aligned with established molecular features of adult-type diffuse glioma subtypes, confirming the biological interpretability of the framework.

AI.tldr: MOXAI是一个整合DNA甲基化与拷贝数变异的可解释深度学习框架，用于成人型弥漫性胶质瘤分子亚型分类，多模态模型交叉验证准确率达92.98%，DINOv2在独立验证集上达94.25%。
AI.motivation: 现有DNA甲基化分析方法通常将甲基化与CNV数据分开处理，无法利用两者互补信息；同时缺乏类似肿瘤分级的类内风险评估机制，也缺少能将分类决策归因到具体基因组位点的可解释方法。
AI.method: 基于TCGA队列，整合甲基化阵列的DNA甲基化和拷贝数数据，同时构建单模态对照；训练ResNet50、DINOv2和GAT模型；基于CAM和Grad-CAM开发可解释AI方法，定位与分类决策最相关的CpG位点、基因和染色体区域。
AI.result: 多模态模型交叉验证准确率最高达92.98%，优于仅用CNV的模型；DINOv2泛化能力最强，在独立验证集上达到94.25%准确率（置信度>0.9）；XAI结果与已知的成人型弥漫性胶质瘤分子特征一致。
AI.conclusion: MOXAI证明了多组学整合在胶质瘤分子分型中的优势，并实现了生物学可解释的决策归因，为肿瘤诊断提供了可解释的多模态框架。

title: DAAF: From Failure Localization to Editable System Assets in LLM Agents
summary: Deployed LLM agents increasingly rely on persistent, versioned system assets such as routing rules, knowledge segments, prompt instructions, and reusable skills. Failure-localization methods can identify where an error manifests in an agent or execution trace, but repair requires a different decision: which editable system asset should be changed, and is that change expected to improve the task outcome? We study this gap through component-attribute failure attribution, where diagnosis targets versioned, addressable items rather than execution locations. We propose the Detection-Aware Attribution Framework (DAAF), which learns the effects of valid attribute replacements and amortizes this intervention evidence into deployment-time diagnosis. DAAF combines sparse and noisy failure signals to decide whether intervention is warranted, learns component-type-conditioned replacement effects from controlled replays evaluated by executable task outcomes, and shares supervision across requests with compatible intervention responses. At diagnosis time, DAAF uses only the observed execution, registered candidates, and available failure signals; it requires neither counterfactual replay nor task reward and returns no_change, a repair target, or an unresolved decision when evidence is insufficient. On held-out tau^2-bench Telecom tasks, DAAF achieves 80.72% attribute Hit@1, recovers 62.65% of failed executions while limiting clean-task regression to 3.23%, and reaches 71.93% overall task success. These results show that intervention-grounded attribute attribution can connect failure localization to executable system repair.

AI.tldr: 论文提出DAAF框架，将LLM智能体的失败诊断从"执行位置"转向"可编辑的版本化组件属性"，在部署时无需反事实重放或任务奖励即可给出修复目标。
AI.motivation: 现有失败定位方法能指出错误在何处显现，但无法回答"应修改哪个可编辑系统资产、该修改能否改善任务结果"，即定位与可执行修复之间存在决策鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出Detection-Aware Attribution Framework（DAAF）：将问题建模为组件-属性失败归因，目标为版本化、可寻址条目。框架融合稀疏且有噪声的失败信号判断是否需要干预，通过受控重放（以可执行任务结果评估）学习按组件类型条件的替换效应，并在响应兼容的请求间共享监督。诊断时仅用已观测执行、注册候选与可用失败信号。
AI.result: 在held-out tau^2-bench Telecom任务上，达到80.72%属性Hit@1，恢复62.65%的失败执行，干净任务回归仅3.23%，整体任务成功率71.93%。
AI.conclusion: 基于干预的属性归因可将失败定位与可执行系统修复相连接，为部署期智能体自修复提供可行路径。

title: Beyond Calibration: Do a Typed-Decision Model's Probabilities Obey the Probability Axioms?
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Code and data at https://github.com/bro789/typed-decision-coherence
summary: Typed-decision models such as TypeSafe's Jev answer a declared yes/no or multiple-choice question about a state with a probability instead of text, and their evaluations report accuracy and calibration. Neither requires that the probabilities a model gives to logically related questions fit together item by item, which is what a system that acts on those probabilities needs. We test this property, coherence, with a battery of logically linked questions that needs no labels. For 160 items from ChaosNLI and PubMedQA, each with three mutually exclusive labels, we ask whether the label is X, whether it is not X, whether it is one of the other two labels, and which label applies. On 480 negation pairs, Jev's probabilities for "the label is X" and "the label is not X" miss summing to one by 0.064 on average (95% CI 0.055 to 0.072). Qwen3.8-27B, run from its official BF16 weights, misses by 0.293 with first-token probabilities and by 0.122 with verbalized probabilities. The gap to the first-token readout persists on pairs where both systems give similar probabilities, without double-negation labels, and after averaging Jev's repeated calls. Jev is not coherent either: its violations are about five times its repeat noise, and it over-endorses statements about single labels, so that its three single-label probabilities sum to 1.14 on average. The two systems also fail differently. Qwen3.8-27B's first-token readout under-endorses the complement of a label whether or not the question contains "not", rejecting both a statement and its negation in 196 of 480 pairs, and it does not become more coherent where it is more confident, whereas Jev's violations concentrate where its answer is uncertain. Because the checks need no labels, they expose biases that appear only when question forms are compared, and inconsistencies within items.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并测试类型化决策模型（如Jev）的"一致性"（coherence）属性，即相关逻辑问题的概率是否逐项自洽，用无需标签的逻辑关联问题集在ChaosNLI和PubMedQA上检验，发现Jev与Qwen3.8-27B均不满足一致性，且失败模式不同。
AI.motivation: 类型化决策模型输出概率而非文本，现有评估只报告准确率和校准度，但二者都不要求模型对逻辑相关问题给出的概率逐项吻合，而真正基于这些概率行动的系统需要这种一致性。
AI.method: 构建无需标签的逻辑关联问题集，从ChaosNLI和PubMedQA取160个样本（每个3个互斥标签），就四种问题形式提问：标签是否为X、是否非X、是否为另外两个标签之一、以及具体是哪个标签；在480对否定对上比较"是X"与"非X"的概率之和是否等于1，并对照Qwen3.8-27B的官方BF16权重（首token概率与言语化概率两种读法）。
AI.result: Jev的否定对概率平均偏离1达0.064（95% CI 0.055–0.072）；Qwen3.8-27B首token读法偏离0.293，言语化概率偏离0.122。差距在两者概率相近、无双重否定标签及对Jev重复调用取平均后依然存在。Jev的违反约为其重复噪声的5倍，并过度认可单标签陈述，三个单标签概率平均和为1.14。Qwen3.8-27B的首token读法在是否含"not"时都低估标签的补集，480对中有196对同时拒绝陈述及其否定，且置信度更高时并未更一致；Jev的违反则集中于其不确定处。
AI.conclusion: 因检查无需标签，这些方法能暴露仅在比较问题形式时才出现的偏差以及条目内部的不一致；类型化决策模型的概率并非逻辑自洽，且不同系统失败方式各异。

title: Devol-ONE: One Autoregressive Mixture of Transformers to Unify Vision-Language-Action and Latent World Modeling
summary: Vision Language Action (VLA) models condition actions directly on current visual and language context, without an explicit account of how the scene evolves under candidate actions. World Action Models (WAM) attempt to address this limitation by predicting future states, but existing designs keep prediction and policy learning architecturally separate, connecting them only through the predicted output, whether through pixel space video generation or a latent forecasting module trained independently of the policy. We present Devol-ONE, a Mixture of Transformers architecture that unifies vision language understanding, latent world dynamics prediction, and action generation within a single autoregressive framework. Instead of encoding vision language tokens once and feeding them to the action expert, Devol-ONE runs autoregressive prediction jointly across a vision language stream and a V-JEPA pretrained dynamics stream, attending to the vision language key-value cache at every layer to forecast future latent states under language guidance. The action expert is in turn shaped continuously by semantic reasoning and predicted physical dynamics rather than by a fixed representation computed in advance. Extensive experiments are conducted on LIBERO, LIBERO-PLUS, RoboTwin2.0 along with real-world evaluation on Flexiv single-arm and dual-arm setups. Ablation studies show the effectiveness of dynamic stream prediction and layer-wise unified attention to validate our model architectural coherency.

AI.tldr: 提出Devol-ONE，用Mixture of Transformers将视觉语言理解、潜在世界动态预测与动作生成统一在一个自回归框架中，实验验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型直接基于当前视觉语言上下文生成动作，未显式建模场景在候选动作下的演化；而现有世界动作模型将预测与策略学习在架构上分离，仅通过预测输出（像素视频生成或独立训练的潜在预测模块）连接，缺乏协同。
AI.method: Devol-ONE采用Mixture of Transformers架构，在单一自回归框架内联合视觉语言流与V-JEPA预训练动态流进行自回归预测；每一层都关注视觉语言KV缓存，在语言引导下预测未来潜在状态；动作专家持续受语义推理与预测的物理动态塑造，而非依赖预先计算的固定表示。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-PLUS、RoboTwin2.0仿真基准及Flexiv单臂、双臂真实场景中进行了大量实验；消融研究验证了动态流预测与逐层统一注意力的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Devol-ONE通过架构上的统一实现了视觉语言理解、世界动态预测与动作生成的协同，消融验证了模型架构的一致性。

title: TreeRef-BFN: Equivariance-Free De Novo Molecule Generation based on 2D Topology and Internal 3D Geometry
summary: De novo 3D molecular generation jointly models molecular size, topology, and geometry. Most methods pre-sample molecular size and generate Cartesian coordinates, limiting variable-size conditional tasks such as fragment completion and scaffold decoration while often relying on equivariant architectures. Internal-coordinate methods avoid rigid-body redundancy but typically require a known molecular graph or autoregressive construction, which may accumulate errors. We propose TreeRef, a tree-based molecular representation that assigns molecular topology and topology-dependent local 3D geometry to a naturally variable-size tree. RingRef nodes encode ring closures while preserving the tree structure, while Null nodes allow molecular size to emerge directly from node occupancy. Based on TreeRef, we develop TreeRef-BFN, a Bayesian Flow Network with a standard Transformer backbone that globally couples these locally defined variables and jointly generates discrete molecular variables and continuous local geometry. A single pretrained TreeRef-BFN supports unconditional generation and variable-size structure-conditioned 3D generation through masking alone, without retraining. Empirical studies demonstrate strong chemical validity, molecular stability, and diversity, accurate local geometric distributions, fast sampling, and competitive property-conditioned generation, establishing TreeRef-BFN as an efficient and flexible framework for 3D molecular generation.

AI.tldr: 提出TreeRef树状分子表示及TreeRef-BFN生成框架，实现单一预训练模型通过掩码支持变尺寸3D分子生成。
AI.motivation: 现有方法预先采样分子尺寸并生成笛卡尔坐标，限制了变尺寸条件任务（如片段补全、骨架修饰），且常依赖等变架构；内部坐标方法虽避免刚体冗余，但通常需已知分子图或自回归构建，易累积误差。
AI.method: TreeRef将分子拓扑及依赖拓扑的局部3D几何分配到一个自然变尺寸的树上；RingRef节点编码环闭合同时保持树结构，Null节点使分子尺寸直接由节点占用涌现。基于TreeRef构建TreeRef-BFN，即采用标准Transformer骨干的贝叶斯流网络，全局耦合局部变量，联合生成离散分子变量与连续局部几何。
AI.result: 在化学有效性、分子稳定性与多样性、局部几何分布准确性、采样速度及性质条件生成方面均有良好表现；单个预训练模型无需重训练即可支持无条件生成和变尺寸结构条件3D生成。
AI.conclusion: TreeRef-BFN是一个高效灵活的3D分子生成框架。

title: CoLMbo-SV: A Grounded Language Model for Explainable Speaker Verification
summary: Speaker verification systems achieve high accuracy but provide little account of the acoustic evidence behind their judgments. Making these systems inspectable requires exposing interpretable evidence while retaining the richer information on which their decisions depend. We present \textbf{CoLMbo-SV}, a speaker language model that combines strong speaker discrimination with structured, acoustically grounded comparison reports. By connecting a pretrained speaker encoder to a language model and supplying explicit acoustic measurements, CoLMbo-SV makes voice comparisons inspectable without restricting verification to the evidence verbalized in its reports. We additionally introduce \textbf{VoxReason}, paired recordings with measured acoustic properties and comparison reports filtered through numerical and qualitative checks, providing supervision for this combined capability. We also develop an evaluation framework that separates what acoustic information a speaker representation encodes, what influences the verification score, and what the generated report discusses. On VoxCeleb1-O, CoLMbo-SV achieves 0.99\% EER, reducing verification error by approximately 80\% relative to the strongest audio-language baseline fine-tuned on VoxReason, while attaining a numerical-grounding score of 0.82. Our analysis further demonstrates that acoustic correctness and decision relevance are distinct properties of an explanation, exposing a gap that numerical-grounding metrics miss. Together, these contributions substantially advance audio-language speaker verification, bring its accuracy toward that of dedicated speaker encoders while adding checkable acoustic reporting, and establish an empirical framework for connecting natural-language explanations to the decisions they explain.

AI.tldr: CoLMbo-SV将预训练说话人编码器与大语言模型结合，在保持强验证性能（VoxCeleb1-O 0.99% EER）的同时生成结构化、有声学依据的对比报告，并提出VoxReason数据集与评估框架。
AI.motivation: 现有说话人验证系统准确率高，但无法提供其判断背后的声学证据，可解释性差；需要在不牺牲验证准确度的前提下暴露可检查的声学证据。此外，声学正确性与决策相关性可能是不同属性，但缺乏相应评估框架。
AI.method: 将预训练说话人编码器连接到语言模型，并注入显式声学测量，构建说话人语言模型CoLMbo-SV，使语音对比可检查且不将验证限制在报告所述证据内。同时构建VoxReason数据集（配对录音+实测声学属性+经数值与定性校验的对比报告），并设计评估框架，区分表示编码的声学信息、影响验证分数的因素以及生成报告讨论的内容。
AI.result: 在VoxCeleb1-O上达到0.99% EER，相比在VoxReason微调的最强音频-语言基线降低约80%验证错误，数值接轨得分0.82。分析表明声学正确性与决策相关性是解释的两种不同属性，揭示数值接轨指标忽略的差距。
AI.conclusion: 该工作推进了音频-语言说话人验证，使其准确率接近专用说话人编码器，同时增加可核验的声学报告，并建立了连接自然语言解释与其所解释决策的实证框架。

title: Kernel-Based Steering of CLIP with Vision-Language Model Preferences
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) can judge visual similarity, but their judgments are not directly available as compact image embeddings for efficient comparison. We study how to transfer these preferences into CLIP while retaining its image--text capabilities. We introduce ASK, a kernel-based steering method that learns from elicited pairwise judgments without accessing teacher embeddings or collecting new human similarity annotations.
