summary: Visual token reduction is an effective way to accelerate multimodal large language models (MLLMs), but performance deteriorates rapidly under extremely low token budgets. Existing work has explored both visual-token selection and training-based adaptation to reduced visual inputs. We take a step further by asking how a heavily compressed MLLM should learn from the states induced by its own generations. This setting naturally calls for on-policy self-distillation: a heavily compressed model is supervised on the states induced by its own generations, while its full-token counterpart serves as an information-rich teacher. Based on this insight, we propose LT-OPD, a training framework for extreme visual-token reduction. The student rolls out responses with only a small fraction of visual tokens, and a frozen full-token copy of the same MLLM provides distributional supervision along these student-generated trajectories. To stabilize on-policy learning when visual evidence is severely limited, we further introduce a budget-level curriculum that progressively decreases the token budget during training. Across nine benchmarks on Qwen3.5-4B, LT-OPD raises average retained performance under 5% visual-token retention from 68.6% to 82.3%, outperforming training-free, training-based, and reinforcement-learning baselines at the same budget. The gains transfer consistently to Qwen3.5-9B, GLM-4.6V-9B, and LLaVA-OV-1.5-4B. LT-OPD also reduces KV-cache usage by 85.2% and prefill FLOPs by 85.4% without additional inference overhead, demonstrating that on-policy learning can substantially recover capabilities lost to extreme visual-token reduction.

AI.tldr: LT-OPD 提出一种面向极端视觉 token 压缩的 on-policy 自蒸馏训练框架，用完整 token 的冻结教师模型监督学生模型自身生成轨迹，并配合预算级课程学习，显著提升低预算下的性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉 token 压缩能加速多模态大模型，但在极低 token 预算下性能急剧下降。已有方法包括 token 选择和训练适配，但如何让重度压缩模型从自身生成状态中学习尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出 LT-OPD，一种 on-policy 自蒸馏训练框架：学生模型仅用少量视觉 token 生成回答，同一 MLLM 的冻结完整 token 副本在学生学习轨迹上提供分布监督；同时引入预算级课程，训练中逐步降低 token 预算以稳定 on-policy 学习。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3.5-4B 的九个基准上，5% 视觉 token 保留率下平均保留性能从 68.6% 提升到 82.3%，超越无训练、训练型和强化学习基线；增益可迁移到 Qwen3.5-9B、GLM-4.6V-9B、LLaVA-OV-1.5-4B；KV-cache 减少 85.2%，prefill FLOPs 减少 85.4%，无额外推理开销。
AI.conclusion: on-policy 学习能够显著恢复因极端视觉 token 压缩而损失的能力，是一种有效且高效的极端 token 压缩方案。

title: ProTTT: Learning to Learn Semantic User Memory with Test-Time Training
summary: Personalization requires language models to capture user-specific knowledge from a growing user history. Existing context-based approaches incur increasing inference costs as user history accumulates and rely on separate retrieval or summarization stages, while parametric-based approaches often require reconstructing user representations when new user data is added. We introduce ProTTT, a profile-supervised meta-learning framework for learning semantic user memory. The memory construction starts from a shared initialization and is updated for each user through test-time training on user history, allowing it to evolve continuously as the history grows. However, since test-time training alone does not explicitly encourage the memory to capture semantic user knowledge necessary for personalization, we learn this shared initialization using textual user profiles as supervision, so that test-time training on user history captures semantic knowledge more effectively. ProTTT consistently outperforms both full history ICL and all parametric baselines across diverse benchmarks, while substantially reducing inference cost by compressing user history into a lightweight parameterized memory. Our analysis also shows that profile supervision is a reliable objective for learning semantic user knowledge and that the resulting memory can track and retain evolving user preferences, while remaining robust across different history sizes. Overall, we demonstrate the effectiveness of test-time training for personalization and establish ProTTT as a baseline for continuously evolving user memory.

AI.tldr: ProTTT 是一个以用户画像监督的元学习框架，通过学习语义用户记忆来实现个性化，将用户历史压缩为轻量参数化记忆，优于全历史 ICL 和参数化基线并降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 现有基于上下文的方法随用户历史增长导致推理成本上升，且依赖独立的检索或摘要阶段；参数化方法在新增用户数据时常需重建用户表示。因此需要一种能随历史增长持续演化、低成本且无需重建的用户记忆方案。
AI.method: ProTTT 从共享初始化出发，对每个用户基于其历史进行测试时训练（test-time training）来构建并持续更新记忆。由于单纯的测试时训练无法显式促使记忆捕获个性化所需的语义用户知识，作者用文本用户画像作为监督来学习该共享初始化，使测试时训练更有效。
AI.result: ProTTT 在多个多样化基准上一致优于全历史 ICL 和所有参数化基线，同时将用户历史压缩为轻量参数化记忆，大幅降低推理成本。分析表明画像监督是学习语义用户知识的可靠目标，生成的记忆能跟踪并保留演化的用户偏好，且在不同历史规模下保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了测试时训练在个性化中的有效性，并将 ProTTT 确立为持续演化用户记忆的基线方法。

title: Grounding Memory Summarization in Utility Intent
summary: Existing summarizers for memory systems are typically optimized for human-facing criteria such as faithfulness, which misaligns with their true objective: preserving the evidence needed to support future queries. We show that conditioning summarization on query-answer pairs substantially improves answer quality, and that this utility-aware behavior is transferable across queries. Motivated by these findings, we propose MemSuit, a self-distillation framework in which a teacher summarizer, conditioned on observed query-answer pairs, produces utility-aware memory entries that a student learns to reproduce from the raw conversation alone. To prevent collateral erasure where conditioning on a single query-answer pair discards evidence relevant to other plausible queries, the teacher decomposes each block into multiple self-contained entries that preserve distinct query-relevant facets as independently retrievable units. To align the retriever with the compact, fact-dense style of teacher entries, we further fine-tune the embedding model with a contrastive objective supervised by teacher entries. Across a diverse suite of conversational query types, MemSuit consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, confirming the value of grounding memory in downstream utility.

AI.tldr: 提出MemSuit自蒸馏框架，让摘要面向下游查询效用而非人类对齐指标，在多类对话查询上超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆系统摘要器按人类导向标准（如忠实度）优化，与真正目标——保留支持未来查询所需证据——不一致。
AI.method: 以查询-答案对为条件进行摘要，并将效用感知行为通过自蒸馏迁移：教师摘要器基于观测到的问答对生成效用感知记忆条目，学生仅从原始对话复现。为防止单一问答对条件导致“附带擦除”，教师将每个块分解为多个自包含、可独立检索的条目；再用教师条目监督的对比目标微调嵌入模型以对齐检索器。
AI.result: 在多样化会话查询类型上，MemSuit持续优于现有SOTA基线。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆建立在面向查询的下游效用之上是有价值的。

title: StegGNN: Learning Graphical Representation for Image Steganography
summary: Image steganography refers to embedding secret messages within cover images while maintaining imperceptibility. Recent advances in deep learning - primarily driven by Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and architectures such as inverse neural networks, autoencoders, and generative adversarial networks - have led to notable progress. However, these frameworks are primarily built on CNN architectures, which treat images as regular grids and are limited by their receptive field size and a bias toward spatial locality. In parallel, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have recently demonstrated strong adaptability in several computer vision tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance with architectures such as Vision GNN (ViG). This work moves in that direction and introduces StegGNN - a novel autoencoder-based, cover-agnostic image steganography framework based on GNNs. By modeling images as graph structures, our approach leverages the representational flexibility of GNNs over the grid-based rigidity of conventional CNNs. We conduct extensive experiments on standard benchmark datasets to evaluate visual quality and imperceptibility. Our results show that our GNN-based method performs comparably to existing CNN benchmarks. These findings suggest that GNNs provide a promising alternative representation for steganographic embedding and open the field of deep learning-based steganography to further exploration of GNN-based architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StegGNN，一个基于图神经网络（GNN）的自编码器式、与载体无关的图像隐写框架，将图像建模为图结构以突破CNN网格化架构的局限，实验显示其性能与现有CNN方法相当。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习隐写方法主要基于CNN及其变体（逆神经网络、自编码器、GAN），但CNN将图像视为规则网格，受限于感受野大小和空间局部性偏好。而GNN在多个视觉任务（如ViG）中已展现强大适应性，因此作者希望探索GNN作为隐写嵌入的替代表示。
AI.method: 提出StegGNN——一种基于GNN的、自编码器式、与载体无关（cover-agnostic）的图像隐写框架。核心思想是将图像建模为图结构，利用GNN的表示灵活性取代传统CNN的网格刚性。
AI.result: 在标准基准数据集上进行大量实验，评估视觉质量与不可感知性。结果显示，基于GNN的方法与现有CNN基准性能相当。
AI.conclusion: GNN为隐写嵌入提供了有前景的替代表示，为基于深度学习的隐写领域进一步探索GNN架构开辟了方向。

title: CUE-Mem: Benchmarking Long-Term User Memory via Implicit Cues in Multimodal Conversations
comment: 28 pages. Submitted to AAAI 2027. Code: https://github.com/yulinlp/CUE-MEM. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Kkryptonite/CUE-Mem
summary: Long-term memory is essential for multimodal agents that interact with users across sustained conversations. However, user memories are not always explicitly stated: they may also be implied by recurring background objects in images, ambient sounds in audio, or other peripheral multimodal cues. Existing benchmarks largely focus on text-only memory or explicit multimodal evidence, leaving implicit multimodal cues underexplored. We introduce CUE-Mem, a text-image-audio benchmark for evaluating long-term user memory from implicit cues. CUE-Mem contains 2,674 questions across explicit and implicit evidence settings and covers four tasks: Entity Recall, Long Pattern, Personalized Recommendation, and Answer Refusal. Across textualized memory systems, implicit performance remains far below oracle evidence, locating the main bottleneck in preserving and retrieving subtle cues rather than question answerability. Increasing caption detail recovers more of this evidence, but brings uneven gains and rapidly growing token costs, motivating native multimodal access. Yet native access does not uniformly resolve the bottleneck: evidence use depends strongly on the backbone, while multimodal indexing introduces substantial retrieval noise. CUE-Mem provides a testbed for memory systems that selectively retain, retrieve, and use subtle multimodal evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出CUE-Mem，一个面向隐式多模态线索（图像背景物、环境声）的文本-图像-音频长期记忆基准，含2674题、4类任务（实体召回、长模式、个性化推荐、拒答）。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态记忆基准多聚焦纯文本记忆或显式多模态证据，忽略了隐式多模态线索；而长久对话中用户记忆常由图像背景物、环境声等间接暗示。
AI.method: 构建CUE-Mem基准，覆盖显式与隐式证据设置，包含文本-图像-音频三种模态，设计四类任务；对比文本化记忆系统与原生多模态访问，并分析caption详细度、token成本、backbone依赖与多模态索引噪声。
AI.result: 文本化记忆系统在隐式证据下性能远低于oracle证据，主要瓶颈在于保留与检索微妙线索而非问题可答性；增加caption细节可部分恢复证据但收益不均、token成本激增；原生多模态访问也未统一解决瓶颈，证据利用强依赖backbone且索引引入显著检索噪声。
AI.conclusion: CUE-Mem为选择性保留、检索和利用微妙多模态证据的记忆系统提供了测试平台。

title: TeacherGRPO: Closing the Capacity Gap in Reasoning Distillation via Teacher Alignment
summary: Reasoning distillation from powerful teacher models to smaller students faces the Gap Curse: as teachers grow more sophisticated, their complex distributions increasingly diverge from what students can approximate, causing performance degradation. Existing mitigation strategies either filter out challenging examples through data selection or introduce weaker intermediate assistant models, inherently compromising supervision coverage or quality. We propose Teacher Alignment, which directly adapts the teacher toward the student's distribution without discarding data or degrading reasoning quality. However, naive alignment through standard knowledge distillation triggers catastrophic collapse of the teacher's reasoning capabilities. To address this, we reformulate teacher alignment as reinforcement learning and introduce TeacherGRPO, built on Group Relative Policy Optimization with two key innovations: (i) Curriculum Selective Alignment applies dual token- and distribution-level curricula to focus rewards on high-signal reasoning gaps while filtering noise from trivial tokens and uncertain tail distributions, and (ii) Importance-Adaptive Length Regularization selectively penalizes verbose redundancy while preserving pedagogically critical reasoning steps. The aligned teacher then distills knowledge to students via standard pipelines. Extensive experiments show TeacherGRPO significantly outperforms baselines across diverse reasoning benchmarks and distillation methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/LzyFischer/TeacherGRPO.

AI.tldr: 提出Teacher Alignment范式，用强化学习（TeacherGRPO）将教师模型对齐到学生分布，缓解推理蒸馏中的Gap Curse，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 推理蒸馏中，越强的教师模型其复杂分布越偏离学生可近似的能力范围，导致性能退化，即"Gap Curse"。现有缓解策略（数据筛选或引入弱中间助教）要么牺牲监督覆盖率，要么降低监督质量。
AI.method: 提出Teacher Alignment，直接让教师适配学生分布而不丢数据、不损推理质量。因朴素知识蒸馏会导致教师推理能力崩塌，故将其重构为强化学习，提出TeacherGRPO：基于GRPO，含(i)课程选择性对齐（token与分布双层面课程，聚焦高信号推理差距、过滤噪声）与(ii)重要性自适应长度正则（惩罚冗余但保留关键推理步骤）。对齐后的教师再通过标准流程蒸馏给学生。
AI.result: 在多种推理基准和蒸馏方法上，TeacherGRPO显著优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过对齐教师到学生分布可有效缓解Gap Curse，兼顾监督覆盖与质量，RL式对齐是可行且有前景的方向，代码已开源。

title: An End-to-End Latent-Rollout Approach for Pushing Few-Step ImageNet-$256$ Generation to FID $1.11$ without Fréchet Losses
summary: Iterative generation poses a joint optimization problem across steps, as intermediate predictions shape subsequent computations and ultimately determine the final output distribution. Few-step generators distilled from pretrained diffusion and flow-matching models make such optimization computationally practical end to end. We build on this opportunity with a distill-then-refine approach that uses teacher imitation to establish a strong initialization for a few-step rollout in latent space, then shifts to end-to-end refinement of the complete latent rollout against real data. We introduce FiST (Flow-in-Stage Transformer), an architecture that composes learned latent-state transitions in a few stages using a shared Transformer, with optional cross-stage hidden communication. Distillation applies teacher-forced regression to selected states along teacher trajectories; refinement replaces this supervision with adversarial and auxiliary classification objectives on the final latent output. A trainable discriminator module operates on semantically rich features extracted from clean real and generated latents by a frozen SiT backbone pretrained with REPA. All training takes place in latent space, without image decoding. During refinement, FiST consumes its own intermediate predictions, and endpoint gradients pass through every generation stage. For class-conditional generation on ImageNet at $256\times256$, our approach achieves FID 1.11 (IS 282) with three stages and FID 1.15 (IS 280) with two. These results demonstrate competitive few-step generation through learned distribution-level supervision, without explicit Fréchet-distance minimization. Ablations characterize how distillation, pretrained checkpoint choices, refinement supervision, and cross-stage hidden communication affect generation quality.

AI.tldr: FiST：先蒸馏后精炼的少步生成方法，在潜在空间端到端优化，ImageNet 256×256 达到 FID 1.11。
AI.motivation: 迭代生成中各步骤相互影响，中间预测决定后续计算与最终输出分布，构成联合优化问题。少步生成器使端到端优化变得可行，作者希望利用这一点改进少步生成质量。
AI.method: 提出 distill-then-refine 框架：先用教师模仿（teacher-forced 回归）为潜在空间的少步 rollout 建立强初始化，再针对真实数据进行完整 rollout 的端到端精炼。架构 FiST 用共享 Transformer 在少数阶段组合潜在状态转移，支持可选的跨阶段隐藏通信。精炼阶段用对抗和辅助分类目标替代教师监督，判别器基于冻结的、经 REPA 预训练的 SiT 主干提取的语义特征。全部训练在潜在空间进行，无需图像解码，精炼时 FiST 使用自身中间预测且端点梯度穿过所有生成阶段。
AI.result: ImageNet 256×256 类条件生成：三阶段 FID 1.11（IS 282），两阶段 FID 1.15（IS 280），无需显式最小化 Fréchet 距离。消融实验分析了蒸馏、预训练检查点选择、精炼监督和跨阶段隐藏通信对生成质量的影响。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习到的分布级监督实现有竞争力的少步生成，验证了蒸馏加精炼范式与 FiST 架构的有效性。

title: EMIR$^2$: Evolution-Aware Memory with Intent-Guided Multi-Round Retrieval
summary: Long-term memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to leverage historical interactions for future tasks. However, existing memory systems struggle to utilize continuously evolving historical information, as they often rely on static memory representations and single-round retrieval strategies, failing to track factual changes or integrate distributed evidence across long-term interactions. To address these challenges, we propose \textsc{EMIR}$^{2}$, an \textbf{E}volution-Aware \textbf{M}emory framework with \textbf{I}ntent-Guided Multi-\textbf{R}ound \textbf{R}etrieval, enabling LLM agents to maintain evolving historical knowledge and adaptively retrieve relevant evidence. Specifically, \textsc{EMIR}$^{2}$ constructs a State-Evolving Memory Graph (SEMG) that represents long-term memory as evolving knowledge states supported by temporal event trajectories and evidential associations. By maintaining semantic states through evidence-based updates, SEMG preserves historical evolution and enables evidence tracing under complex and conflicting scenarios. Building upon this, we introduce an intent-guided multi-round retrieval mechanism that iteratively identifies missing evidence and expands retrieval based on accumulated information. Experiments on LoCoMo and MemConflict demonstrate that \textsc{EMIR}$^{2}$ improves long-term memory utilization, dynamic and static conflict handling, and complex retrieval performance, achieving relative improvements of more than 12\% in certain categories. These results highlight the effectiveness of jointly modeling memory evolution and adaptive evidence acquisition for long-term agent interactions.

AI.tldr: 提出EMIR²框架，通过演化感知的记忆图和意图引导多轮检索，提升LLM智能体的长期记忆利用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆系统依赖静态记忆表示和单轮检索，难以跟踪事实变化、整合长期交互中的分布式证据，无法利用持续演化的历史信息。
AI.method: 构建状态演化记忆图（SEMG），以带时间事件轨迹和证据关联的演化知识状态表示长期记忆，通过基于证据的更新维护语义状态并支持证据溯源；引入意图引导的多轮检索机制，迭代识别缺失证据并基于累积信息扩展检索。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo和MemConflict上实验，提升长期记忆利用率、动静态冲突处理及复杂检索性能，部分类别相对提升超过12%。
AI.conclusion: 联合建模记忆演化与自适应证据获取对长期智能体交互有效。

title: MIC: Explaining Image-Claim Inconsistencies in AI-Generated Multimodal Misinformation
summary: Claims paired with AI-generated images are a rapidly growing form of misinformation. Existing automated fact-checking (AFC) methods mainly treat this as a provenance problem, detecting low-level synthesis artifacts to decide whether an image is AI-generated. However, such methods do not verify what human fact-checkers often check: whether an image's content is consistent with the context implied by its accompanying claim. To address this gap, we introduce MIC (Multimodal Inconsistency Checking), an AFC framework that assists human fact-checkers by detecting AI-generated multimodal misinformation and explaining inconsistencies using world knowledge. MIC first uses supervised fine-tuning (SFT) for task adaptation and then applies Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to directly optimize component-level verifiable rewards for verdict prediction, inconsistency type classification, visual evidence description, and world-knowledge explanation. We further introduce MIC-Bench, a benchmark comprising 8,812 image-claim instances derived from 4,406 claims, where each claim is paired with an authentic image and an AI-generated counterpart that introduces a controlled contextual inconsistency. Compared with SFT alone, GRPO further improves Macro-F1 by 4.67 and 4.11 points in the in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings, respectively, while also improving the semantic similarity of visual evidence descriptions and world-knowledge explanations to reference annotations. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/UKPLab/arxiv2026-mic.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MIC框架，通过检测AI生成图像与文本声明之间的上下文不一致性来进行多模态事实核查，并结合MIC-Bench基准验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化事实核查方法将AI生成图像的虚假信息主要视为溯源问题，仅检测合成痕迹判断图像是否为AI生成，但忽略了人工核查员常关注的内容与声明上下文是否一致这一关键问题。
AI.method: MIC首先使用监督微调（SFT）进行任务适应，然后采用组相对策略优化（GRPO），针对判定预测、不一致类型分类、视觉证据描述和世界知识解释等组件级可验证奖励进行直接优化。同时构建了MIC-Bench基准，包含来自4,406条声明的8,812个图像-声明实例，每条声明配对一张真实图像和一张引入受控上下文不一致的AI生成图像。
AI.result: 相比仅使用SFT，GRPO在分布内和分布外设置下分别将Macro-F1提升4.67和4.11个百分点，同时提升了视觉证据描述与世界知识解释相对于参考标注的语义相似度。
AI.conclusion: MIC通过聚焦内容与声明上下文的不一致检测，弥补了现有溯源式事实核查的不足，结合GRPO优化与MIC-Bench基准，有效提升了多模态虚假信息检测与解释能力。

title: RefCompose: Multi-Reference Image Generation via LoRA-Conditioned Diffusion
comment: Accepted in ECCV 2026 Workshop on AI for Visual Arts
summary: Filmmakers and visual artists routinely need to compose multiple references, actors, locations, props, cultural elements, into a single coherent shot, but existing tools either fail to scale past a handful of references or destroy fine grained subject identity in the process, since per reference tokenization scales memory linearly with reference count $N$ and generated content often departs from the given references rather than reproducing them. We propose \textbf{RefCompose}, a pixel space compositional conditioning framework that decouples \emph{where} things go from \emph{what} they look like, via a single fixed resolution reference canvas that keeps conditioning size constant regardless of reference count. Spatial layout is induced at inference time from a frozen diffusion transformer and extracted via Grounding DINO, requiring no LLM or dedicated layout model, while dual stream LoRA adapters inject a layout derived depth map and the encoded canvas through separate low rank streams, disentangling geometric scaffolding from localized appearance. On the Dense Layout protocol, RefCompose consistently outperforms layout based and state of the art multi reference baselines on color, texture, shape, spatial accuracy, and identity/content preservation at higher reference counts, all with constant inference memory, making it a practical building block for multi subject cinematic composition at production scale.

AI.tldr: 提出 RefCompose，一种像素空间组合条件框架，通过固定分辨率参考画布和双流 LoRA，实现可扩展的多参考图像组合，保持主体身份且推理内存恒定。
AI.motivation: 影视与视觉艺术创作需要在单张画面中组合多个参考（演员、场景、道具等），但现有工具难以扩展到大量参考：逐参考 token 化使内存随参考数量 N 线性增长，且生成内容常偏离给定参考、破坏细粒度主体身份。
AI.method: RefCompose 将"何处放置"与"外观如何"解耦：用单个固定分辨率参考画布，使条件大小与参考数量无关；推理时从冻结扩散 transformer 提取空间布局，经 Grounding DINO 提取，无需 LLM 或专用布局模型；双流 LoRA 适配器将布局导出的深度图与编码画布分别注入独立低秩流，分离几何骨架与局部外观。
AI.result: 在 Dense Layout 协议上，RefCompose 在颜色、纹理、形状、空间精度及身份/内容保真度上持续超越基于布局的方法和 SOTA 多参考基线，且在更高参考数量下仍保持恒定推理内存。
AI.conclusion: RefCompose 可作为生产级多主体电影化组合的实用构建模块，兼顾可扩展性、身份保持与内存效率。

title: MA-FPPO: Multi-Agent Flow-Pretrained Policy Optimization
summary: Multi-agent flow policies learn cooperative behavior from fixed offline datasets, but often struggle to complete tasks in situations not covered by the offline data. In these situations, agents must both adapt to changes in the environment and coordinate with one another, yet action patterns learned offline are often insufficient for effective adaptation and coordination. To address this problem, we propose Multi-Agent Flow-Pretrained Policy Optimization (MA-FPPO), which uses online fine-tuning to improve the cooperative behavior of models pretrained with flow matching through new interactions with the environment. Building on the behavior learned during pretraining, we construct policies with explicit action likelihoods for discrete and continuous action spaces. We then update the pretrained model using shared team advantages to further improve coordination based on team performance. Our method achieves, on average, relative gains of 52.8% over the strongest listed offline baselines across 30 settings and 29.8% over purely online learning across 38 comparisons with matched online budgets and evaluation protocols.

AI.tldr: 提出MA-FPPO，用在线微调提升基于flow matching预训练的多智能体策略，在离线数据未覆盖场景中增强适应与协调，平均较最强离线基线相对提升52.8%。
AI.motivation: 多智能体flow策略依赖固定离线数据，遇到未覆盖场景时难以适应环境变化与协调，离线学到的动作模式不足以有效应对。
AI.method: MA-FPPO：在flow matching预训练策略基础上，通过与环境新交互进行在线微调；为离散和连续动作空间构建具有显式动作似然的策略；利用共享团队优势更新预训练模型以提升协调。
AI.result: 在30个设置中较最强离线基线平均相对提升52.8%；在38个匹配在线预算与评估协议的对比中，较纯在线学习平均提升29.8%。
AI.conclusion: 在线微调flow matching预训练的多智能体策略，能有效提升离线数据外场景的适应与协调能力，显著优于离线与纯在线基线。

title: Context Spanning: A Communication Framework for Full-Duplex Speech Models and External LLM Backends
summary: Full-duplex spoken dialogue models can listen and speak simultaneously like the real-time dynamics of human conversation. For natural dialogue, the ability to search for external information in real-time is also an important capability. Many models remain trapped in parametric knowledge, leaving them unable to access real-time information and tool execution. Furthermore, even when Large Language Models (LLM) retrieve information, many duplex speech models process it within a compressed latent space rather than in its raw text form, which can lead to information loss from compression. To address this issue, we propose Context Spanning, a framework for information injection between a full-duplex speech model and an external LLM backend via real-time chunked prefill. The injected frame is encoded in a single forward pass inside the real-time frame budget. It feeds the retrieved information to the speech model as-is, enabling it to reason over the information independently and generate responses. With this approach, our model achieves high performance on Full-Duplex benchmarks and strong results on Question Answering tasks, demonstrating its conversation potential. Context Spanning shows that external information can be injected directly into a duplex speech model, introducing a new simple and powerful mechanism for duplex systems.

AI.tldr: 提出Context Spanning框架，通过实时分块预填充将外部LLM的原始文本信息直接注入全双工语音模型，避免潜在空间压缩导致的信息损失，在全双工基准和问答任务上均取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音对话模型可同时听说，但多数模型受限于参数化知识，无法访问实时信息或执行工具。且现有模型中，即使LLM检索到信息，也多将其压缩进潜在空间处理，导致信息损失。因此需要一种能实时、无损地将外部信息注入全双工语音模型的机制。
AI.method: 提出Context Spanning框架，实现全双工语音模型与外部LLM后端之间的信息注入，采用实时分块预填充（real-time chunked prefill）方式。注入的帧在实时帧预算内单次前向传播中编码，并将检索到的信息原样（raw text）馈入语音模型，使其能独立推理并生成响应。
AI.result: 该模型在全双工基准测试上取得高性能，在问答任务上也有强劲结果，展现了良好的对话潜力。
AI.conclusion: Context Spanning证明外部信息可直接注入全双工语音模型，为全双工系统引入了一种简单而强大的新机制。

title: Endo-TSR: Temporal Spectral Modeling of Appearance and Motion for Endoscopic Reconstruction
summary: Endoscopic scene reconstruction requires modeling tissue motion and temporal appearance while recovering fine surface detail. Deformable Gaussian models provide explicit trajectories, but their fixed colour coefficients lack a dedicated temporal representation for photometric changes. We propose Endo-TSR, which augments deformable Gaussian splatting with bounded Fourier colour residuals and independent translation residuals on shared temporal frequencies. The colour residuals capture local appearance changes, while a Matérn spectral prior regularises motion corrections. Multi-scale Laplacian supervision guides tissue-detail recovery during joint image fitting. Extensive experiments on the EndoNeRF and StereoMIS datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art rendering quality, with the highest PSNR across all evaluated sequences. Ablation studies show that temporal appearance yields the largest PSNR gain among the tested component additions, while appearance and detail supervision jointly improve rendering with fixed Gaussian counts.

AI.tldr: 提出Endo-TSR，在可变形高斯泼溅中引入有界傅里叶颜色残差与独立平移残差，结合Matérn谱先验与多尺度拉普拉斯监督，实现内窥镜场景SOTA重建质量。
AI.motivation: 内窥镜场景重建需同时建模组织运动、时序外观变化并恢复精细表面细节。可变形高斯模型虽提供显式轨迹，但其固定颜色系数缺乏专门的时序表示来刻画光度变化。
AI.method: 在可变形高斯泼溅基础上加入有界傅里叶颜色残差与独立平移残差（共享时序频率）；颜色残差捕捉局部外观变化，Matérn谱先验正则化运动修正，多尺度拉普拉斯监督引导组织细节恢复，联合图像拟合。
AI.result: 在EndoNeRF与StereoMIS数据集上达到SOTA渲染质量，所有评估序列PSNR最高。消融显示时序外观带来最大PSNR增益，外观与细节监督在固定高斯数量下共同提升渲染效果。
AI.conclusion: 时序外观建模是提升内窥镜动态重建质量的关键因素，颜色与平移残差及时序先验、细节监督的结合有效改善可变形高斯重建。

title: Rethinking Token Reweighting for SFT: Suppress, Reverse, and Extrapolate Learned Features
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) learns most aggressively from tokens that the model deems least likely. This helps acquire new behaviors, but also amplifies noisy or conflicting supervision and can overwrite useful pretrained knowledge. Through a unified policy-loss view, we revisit existing token-reweighting methods and show that they assign nonnegative coefficients to demonstrated tokens. Consequently, they can suppress or amplify supervised updates, but cannot reverse harmful features once learned. Moreover, larger training weights do not amount to feature extrapolation, since they change the optimization trajectory rather than scale a fixed SFT direction. We argue that reversal and extrapolation require a stable reference frame defined by a fixed SFT delta. Motivated by this, we propose SCALE (Selective Control of Adaptation via Local Entropy), an entropy-guided adaptation-strength-control method that freezes the pretrained model and the SFT delta and learns bounded token- and module-specific gates by minimizing predictive entropy alone. These gates suppress, reverse, or extrapolate frozen SFT features according to their alignment with entropy reduction. Across Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, Qwen2.5-Math-7B, and Qwen3-4B-Base, SCALE achieves mathematical-reasoning averages of 37.84, 43.60, and 36.57, exceeding the strongest corresponding baselines while remaining competitive on general-retention benchmarks. It also attains the best average code-generation performance across HumanEval, HumanEval+, and MBPP for all three models. These results suggest that effective SFT correction can benefit from controlling how already learned residuals are used, rather than only modifying how they are learned.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SCALE方法，通过冻结预训练模型与SFT增量、学习有界门控来抑制、反转或外推SFT特征，从而修正SFT的过度学习问题。
AI.motivation: SFT最激进地学习模型最不确定的token，这虽有助于获取新行为，但会放大噪声或冲突监督并覆盖有用的预训练知识。现有token重加权方法只能抑制或放大监督更新，无法反转已学到的有害特征。
AI.method: 从统一的policy-loss视角重新审视token重加权方法，指出其仅给demonstrated token分配非负系数，无法反转有害特征；提出SCALE，冻结预训练模型和SFT delta，通过最小化预测熵学习有界的token级和模块级门控，根据与熵减少的对齐来抑制、反转或外推冻结的SFT特征。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B、Qwen2.5-Math-7B和Qwen3-4B-Base上，SCALE的数学推理平均分分别为37.84、43.60和36.57，超过最强基线，同时在通用保持基准上具有竞争力，并在三个模型的HumanEval、HumanEval+和MBPP上取得最佳平均代码生成性能。
AI.conclusion: 有效的SFT修正可从控制已学习残差的使用方式入手，而不仅仅修改其学习方式。

title: Toward On-Chip Training of Spiking Neural Networks for Dense Event-Based Vision
summary: Event cameras provide low-latency, asynchronous visual sensing for resource-constrained robotics. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) process event streams naturally, but training deep SNNs with backpropagation through time (BPTT) requires substantial memory and remains difficult on neuromorphic hardware. Local learning avoids this by restricting error propagation to local blocks, but existing methods mainly target classification rather than dense prediction. We introduce DELL (Dense Event-driven Local Learning), a block wise scheme for dense event-based vision that replaces global gradient propagation with local dense supervision. Learnable, spatially structured local heads supervise each block at its appropriate resolution while preserving temporal dynamics within blocks. We evaluate DELL on optical-flow regression and semantic segmentation with a fully spiking U-shaped architecture. On DSEC optical flow, DELL reduces peak training memory by 39.6% relative to end-to-end BPTT while improving accuracy, reaching 1.670 px endpoint error on the official test benchmark versus 1.941 px for the same backbone trained end-to-end. Block detachment behaves more like a regularizer than a constraint. DECOLLE, the existing local-learning baseline, relies on fixed random local read-outs poorly suited to dense regression, resulting in a 3.9x higher endpoint error; learnable local heads recover this loss and outperform end-to-end training across all optical-flow metrics. On segmentation, they recover most of the performance gap, although DELL remains a few mIoU points behind end-to-end training. With 2.3M parameters, 24x fewer than the strongest SNN baseline, the backbone remains competitive with the SNN state of the art on DSEC. These results extend local learning to dense event-based prediction while substantially reducing training memory.

AI.tldr: DELL: 块状局部学习的密集事件视觉方案，用于SNN稠密预测，降低训练内存同时提升光流精度。
AI.motivation: 事件相机适合资源受限机器人，SNN自然处理事件流，但BPTT训练深SNN内存开销大、神经形态硬件难部署；现有局部学习多针对分类而非稠密预测。
AI.method: 提出DELL，将全局梯度传播替换为局部稠密监督：用可学习、空间结构的局部头在每个块相应分辨率上监督，同时保留块内时间动态；基于全脉冲U型架构。
AI.result: DSEC光流：相比端到端BPTT峰值训练内存降39.6%且精度提升，官方测试1.670px vs 1.941px；比DECOLLE基线误差低3.9倍；分割恢复大部分差距但仍落后端到端几mIoU；2.3M参数（比最强SNN基线少24倍）仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: DELL将局部学习扩展到密集事件预测，显著降低训练内存，块解耦更似正则化；光流上超越端到端，分割上接近但略逊。

title: "You're Right, Let Me Fix It": How LLM Agents Damage Correct Work When Falsely Accused
summary: LLM agents increasingly keep working after a task succeeds as they resume after compaction or take over handoffs. Their finished work keeps receiving follow-up input that sometimes falsely accuses it for later failures. We call an agent's acceptance of such a false accusation gaslight sycophancy, and destructive over-correction when acting on it damages previously correct work. We introduce CAVE-Bench, a benchmark of 365 agentic tasks across six domains built around opaque tasks. Every scored run first reaches a verified correct state, whose supporting rationale and history stay in the workspace while the facts that would settle the accusation lie in external or runtime state beyond the agent's reach. The agent cannot confirm or refute the claim with a local check, so the right response should keep the work and ask for the missing evidence. Each task either hands the agent correct work with saved evidence or let it build and verify that work first, and five risk factors set how the accusation enters the workflow. We score accusation acceptance and evidence use from the trajectory and measure harm by deterministic replay of downstream events. Across 14 of the latest models in Claude Code, false accusations damage correct work in up to 60.06% of runs, and stronger models often do so after recovering the supporting evidence. The same model behaves differently across OpenCode, Codex, and Hermes, and a harness gate driven by the benchmark's live signals cuts replayed harm by 74%. These results show that preserving already-correct work under unsupported accusation is a distinct safety challenge for long-lived agents. Our project is in https://henrymao2004.github.io/agent-over-correction/.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CAVE-Bench基准，揭示长寿命LLM智能体在无根据指控下会"煤气灯式谄媚"地否定自己已正确完成的工作，导致破坏性过度纠正，14个模型受损率高达60.06%。
AI.motivation: 长寿命智能体在任务成功后仍持续工作（压缩恢复、交接），其已完成工作不断收到后续输入，有时被错误归咎于后续失败，而现有研究缺乏对此类"无根据指控"下安全行为的评估。
AI.method: 构建CAVE-Bench，含6个领域365个"不透明任务"；每次计分运行先达到经验证的正确状态，但定案证据位于智能体无法触及的外部/运行时状态，本地检查无法证实或反驳指控；通过5个风险因子控制指控进入方式，从轨迹评分指控接受与证据使用，用下游事件的确定性重放衡量损害。
AI.result: 14个最新模型在Claude Code中，错误指控在最多60.06%的运行中损害正确工作；更强模型常在有支持证据后仍照做；同一模型在OpenCode、Codex、Hermes间表现不同；基于实时信号的harness门控将重放损害降低74%。
AI.conclusion: 在无支持指控下保持已正确工作的能力，是长寿命智能体的一项独立安全挑战。

title: GSM: Efficient Language Modeling with Shared Global State
summary: Efficient language models must reduce not only the cost of individual accesses to past context but also the overhead of repeatedly selecting and processing historical information across layers. We introduce the Global State Model (GSM), a causal encoder--decoder architecture that concentrates the selection and aggregation of long-range information in the encoding stage. Through multiple stages of history retrieval, the encoder progressively incorporates long-range information into representations at recent positions, forming a shared state with a fixed window size. Each decoder layer accesses this same state using queries updated from the preceding layer, preserving computational depth while avoiding repeated construction of historical key--value (KV) representations and long-range indexing. As a result, neither the decoder's per-step attention cost nor its KV cache size grows with the history length. Experiments show that GSM improves computational efficiency and reduces cache overhead while maintaining model performance and the ability to use long-range information, offering a shared-state architecture for efficient language modeling.

AI.tldr: GSM是一种因果编码器-解码器架构，将长距离信息的筛选与聚合集中在编码阶段，形成固定窗口的共享状态，避免解码器重复构建KV表示与长距离索引，从而提升效率并降低缓存开销。
AI.motivation: 高效语言模型不仅要降低对历史上下文的单次访问成本，还要减少跨层重复选择和处理的额外开销。
AI.method: 提出Global State Model（GSM）：编码器通过多阶段历史检索，将长距离信息逐步融入近位置表示，形成固定窗口的共享状态；解码器各层用上一层更新的query访问同一状态，保留计算深度同时避免重复构建历史KV和长距离索引。
AI.result: 实验表明GSM提升了计算效率、降低了缓存开销，同时保持模型性能与利用长距离信息的能力。
AI.conclusion: GSM为高效语言建模提供了一种共享状态架构，解码器每步注意力成本与KV缓存大小均不随历史长度增长。

title: RefAdapt-DiT: Adaptive Joint Attention for Reference-Conditioned Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become the standard backbone for high-quality generative modeling, yet deploying them in conditional generation tasks remains computationally prohibitive because bidirectional joint attention repeatedly processes large reference streams. While existing optimization schemes mitigate generic temporal redundancy, they typically rely on coarse-grained static reuse and overlook the distinct dynamics of references and targets. Specifically, we observe that reference representations often evolve slowly along the generation trajectory, while the target often assigns little attention mass to them; reference drift and this target-to-reference exposure jointly shape how strongly stale reference states affect the target. To exploit these patterns, we introduce \RefAdapt, a training-free framework for adaptive control of joint attention between references and targets. Instead of rigid static strategies, \RefAdapt combines consecutive target-Q change with previously observed target-to-reference attention mass to control reference computation adaptively at block granularity. Under ultra-few-step settings, \RefAdapt enables speedups of up to $2.097\times$ on 4-step MiniMax H3 and $3.54\times$ on 8-step Qwen Image Edit, while maintaining comparable visual quality.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架RefAdapt，通过自适应控制参考与目标间的联合注意力计算，在保持视觉质量的同时显著加速DiT条件生成。
AI.motivation: DiT已成为高质量生成建模的主流骨干，但在条件生成任务中部署代价高昂，因为双向联合注意力需反复处理庞大的参考流。现有优化依赖粗粒度静态复用，忽视了参考与目标各自的动态特性：参考表示沿生成轨迹演化缓慢，且目标对其分配的注意力质量较小。
AI.method: RefAdapt在块粒度上自适应控制参考计算，结合连续目标Q变化与先前观测到的目标对参考的注意力质量，动态决定参考状态复用，而非采用僵化的静态策略。
AI.result: 在超少步设置下，4步MiniMax H3上实现最高2.097倍加速，8步Qwen Image Edit上实现3.54倍加速，同时保持可比的视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用参考慢演化与目标低关注度特性，RefAdapt实现了免训练、自适应的联合注意力加速，在少步条件生成中兼顾效率与质量。

title: DISCO: Distributed Long Context Scaling with Grounding-Reasoning Disaggregation
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) advertise million-token context windows, reasoning quality often collapses as inputs grow -- a phenomenon termed context rot. This failure stems from a structural entanglement in monolithic architectures, where the massive search burden of contextual grounding exhausts the representational capacity needed for complex reasoning. To resolve this, we propose Grounding-Reasoning Disaggregation via DIStributed long COntext scaling (DISCO). Inspired by distributed computing frameworks like Apache Spark, DISCO partitions long context across a fleet of Worker LLMs dedicated exclusively to parallel, localized grounding. A central Driver LLM, trained via Reinforcement Learning (GRPO) to optimize planning, orchestrates execution by dynamically mapping queries into atomic extraction tasks and reducing the gathered evidence to synthesize a final answer. By isolating reasoning from raw context noise, DISCO effectively eliminates context rot. On RULER-QA (1M tokens), it maintains 78.4% accuracy where standard baselines collapse. Furthermore, it outperforms full-context models by up to 9.8 points on LongBench v2 and matches frontier models like Gemini-3-Pro-Preview while reducing inference costs by over 80%, establishing a highly efficient paradigm for robust long-context inference.

AI.tldr: DISCO 提出将长上下文中的"接地"与"推理"解耦：用一群 Worker LLM 并行做局部检索，由一个经 GRPO 强化学习训练的 Driver LLM 负责规划与综合，从而消除"context rot"，在百万 token 任务上保持高准确率并大幅降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: LLM 虽宣称支持百万级上下文，但输入变长后推理质量急剧下降（context rot）。作者认为根因是单体架构中"上下文接地"的海量搜索负担耗尽了本应用于复杂推理的表示能力，即接地与推理结构性地纠缠在一起。
AI.method: 受 Apache Spark 等分布式计算框架启发，提出 DISCO：将长上下文分片，分配给一群专职并行局部接地的 Worker LLM；一个中央 Driver LLM 通过强化学习（GRPO）优化规划能力，动态把查询拆解为原子抽取任务，再归约汇总证据生成最终答案。
AI.result: 在 RULER-QA（1M token）上保持 78.4% 准确率，而标准基线崩溃；在 LongBench v2 上比全上下文模型高出最多 9.8 分；性能比肩 Gemini-3-Pro-Preview 等前沿模型，同时推理成本降低超过 80%。
AI.conclusion: 通过隔离推理与原始上下文噪声，DISCO 有效消除 context rot，建立了高效、鲁棒的长上下文推理新范式。

title: CityToolVQA: Tool-Augmented Visual Question Answering for 3D Spatial Cognition in Urban Low-Altitude Environments
summary: CityToolVQA addresses the weak performance of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on quantitative tasks in urban low-altitude visual question answering. We divide the seven tasks into qualitative and quantitative groups: qualitative questions are answered directly by the VLM, whereas quantitative questions are handled by an external visual-geometric toolchain that performs object grounding, segmentation, depth back-projection, and spatial computation. The toolchain can be attached to different VLMs in a zero-shot manner; a Depth-Assisted Prompt Inference (DAPI) fallback is triggered when the main-chain detection is invalid or unreliable, and CityToolVQA-SFT adapts the 8B backbone to tool-conditioned inputs. On the 73,324-question Open3D-VQA-v2 test set, CityToolVQA-SFT (Qwen3-VL-8B) reaches 67.6% overall accuracy, and attaching the toolchain to ten open-source VLMs improves quantitative-task accuracy by 12.7-36.9 percentage points. These results indicate that externalizing explicit 3D geometric computation effectively complements the limited ability of RGB-only VLMs to estimate metric distances and object sizes.

AI.tldr: CityToolVQA提出工具增强框架，将城市低空VQA任务分为定性/定量两组，定量任务交由外部视觉-几何工具链处理，显著提升VLM量化能力。
AI.motivation: RGB-only的视觉语言模型在城市低空视觉问答的定量任务（如度量距离、物体尺寸估计）上表现较弱，需要外部显式3D几何计算来弥补。
AI.method: 将七类任务分为定性和定量两组：定性由VLM直接回答，定量由外部视觉-几何工具链处理（物体定位、分割、深度反投影、空间计算）。工具链可零样本挂载到不同VLM；当主链检测无效时触发Depth-Assisted Prompt Inference (DAPI)回退；CityToolVQA-SFT使8B骨干适应工具条件输入。
AI.result: 在Open3D-VQA-v2测试集（73,324题）上，CityToolVQA-SFT (Qwen3-VL-8B) 总体准确率达67.6%；将工具链挂载到十个开源VLM上，定量任务准确率提升12.7-36.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 外化显式3D几何计算能有效弥补仅RGB的VLM在度量距离和物体尺寸估计方面的不足。

title: Can Open-Weight Large Language Models (LLMs) Simulate Human Survey Populations? A Cross-Instrument Calibration Study
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate synthetic survey respondents and digital twins of real people, but whether their output preserves real human statistical structure, rather than surface plausibility, remains unresolved, and most existing evidence comes from proprietary models rather than open-weight ones. We evaluate three open-weight LLM families on a cross-instrument calibration task: conditioning personas on real respondents' verbatim answers to one psychometric instrument and measuring them on a second, construct-distance-controlled instrument, checked against a 2,058-person human panel. Across a 139-pair grid, the simulated cross-instrument correlation tracks the real human correlation at r = 0.70 - 0.73 in every model, driven mainly by correct sign rather than precise magnitude and concentrated in pairs of moderate construct distance. A correlation of this magnitude, obtained from untuned open-weight models conditioned only on individual-level survey data, is a substantively encouraging result for LLM-based behavioral simulation and digital-twin applications: specific model families and releases already reproduce a meaningful share of real human cross-instrument structure without any fine-tuning. This capability does not, however, improve monotonically across model releases: on a matched panel, the newest of three tested Llama releases performs worst on two of three headline metrics, so realizing its promise in practice requires release-specific, distance-aware verification rather than a one-time benchmark.

AI.tldr: 评估三个开放权重LLM在跨量表校准任务中能否再现真实人类的跨量表统计结构。139对量表网格上，模拟与真实人类相关达r=0.70–0.73，主要由符号正确驱动，集中于中等建构距离配对；但能力并非随模型版本单调提升，最新Llama在三项指标中两项表现最差。
AI.motivation: LLM被越来越多用于生成合成受访者与真实人物的数字孪生，但其输出是否保留真实人类的统计结构（而非仅表面合理）尚不明确；且现有证据多来自专有模型，开放权重模型证据不足。
AI.method: 在2058人真实人类面板对照下，用三个开放权重LLM家族做跨量表校准：以真实受访者对某一心理测量量表的逐字回答为条件构建人格（persona），再在第二个经建构距离控制的量表上测量，构建139对量表网格进行比较。
AI.result: 每个模型中模拟跨量表相关与真实人类相关达r=0.70–0.73，主要由符号正确而非精确幅度驱动，且集中于中等建构距离的配对；在匹配面板上，三个测试的Llama版本中最新版本在三项主要指标的两项上表现最差。
AI.conclusion: 未经微调、仅以个体层面调查数据为条件的开放权重模型已能再现相当比例的真实人类跨量表结构，对基于LLM的行为模拟与数字孪生应用是具有实质意义的积极结果；但该能力不随模型版本单调提升，因此实践中需针对具体版本、考虑建构距离进行验证，而非一次性基准测试。

title: LLMs Trust Their Own: Identity-Dependent Conformity in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent settings, where agents observe and influence one another, making social influence a key dimension of AI behavior and safety. We investigate whether LLMs' responses depend on the social identity of other agents, beyond the effect of their consensus. We construct judgment tasks with a single correct answer, and place models in a multi-agent setting where they receive incorrect answers from other agents whose social identities (AI or human, model family, or an arbitrary minimal group) are either shared with or distinct from their own. Across 12 open-weights models and nine tasks, we find a bidirectional effect of group identity on conformity to incorrect answers: in-group consensus increases conformity (in-group favoritism), whereas out-group consensus decreases it (out-group divergence). Unlike humans, for whom one ally breaking the consensus sharply reduces conformity, models are unmoved by an ally from the majority's group. Worse, a correct ally from the opposing group intensifies this bidirectional effect. Chain-of-Thought reasoning suppresses most of these effects, yet an in-group ally still reduces conformity to an incorrect out-group majority. Labeling peers as safety-aligned shifts overall conformity but leaves in-group favoritism and out-group divergence intact. These results show that group identity shapes how LLMs aggregate information across agents, independently of its correctness, and identify a manipulation surface for multi-agent AI systems.

AI.tldr: 研究LLM在多智能体场景中是否受其他智能体"社会身份"影响，发现群体身份会双向调节从众行为：内群体共识增加从众(内群体偏好)，外群体共识减少从众(外群体分化)。
AI.motivation: LLM日益在多智能体环境中部署，智能体之间相互观察与影响，使"社会影响"成为AI行为与安全的关键维度，需探究其响应是否受其他智能体社会身份影响。
AI.method: 构造有唯一正确答案的判断任务，将模型置于多智能体情境，接收来自社会身份(人类/AI、模型家族、任意最小组)与自身相同或不同的其他智能体的错误答案；测试12个开源权重模型、9类任务。
AI.result: 群体身份产生双向效应：内群体共识增加从众，外群体共识减少从众。与人类不同，模型不因"多数派阵营中的盟友"而显著降低从众；来自对立群体的正确盟友反而强化该双向效应。CoT推理可抑制大部分效应，但内群体盟友仍降低对错误外群体多数的从众。将同伴标为"安全对齐"改变整体从众水平，但不影响内群体偏好与外群体分化。
AI.conclusion: 群体身份独立于信息正确性，塑造LLM跨智能体的信息聚合方式，并揭示多智能体AI系统的一个可操纵面。

title: De-biasing Skeleton-based Action Recognition with Convex Hull Adaptive Shift
comment: Accepted for publication in International Journal of Computer Vision (IJCV). Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Necolizer/CHASE
summary: Skeleton sequences can represent both individual actions and multi-entity interactions, encompassing human bodies, hands, objects, and robots. Existing approaches to recognize skeleton-based actions and interactions usually adopt a late fusion strategy, which expects individuals are independent and identically distributed to train a robust weight-shared entity encoder. However, observed entity bias in various skeletal data violates this assumption, leading to suboptimal optimization of backbone models that might produce wrong recognition results. This bias arises from the world coordinate system's initial configuration, where the choice of origin often creates bias in representation. To this end, we propose a Convex Hull Adaptive Shift based normalization method to reduce Entity bias (CHASE), improving performance across a variety of skeleton-based action and interaction recognition tasks. To adaptively apply plausible shifts to the input skeletons, we formulate a plug-and-play parameterized network that ensures the relocated world origin lies within the skeleton convex hull, which avoids non-convergence by limiting the search space. To further minimize entity bias, we incorporate an auxiliary objective that leverages pair-wise distribution distances to guide network optimization. To support both single- and multi-entity actions, we propose a sub-entity strategy that offers a consistent formulation for both scenarios. Moreover, CHASE demonstrates compatibility with various intra-skeleton modalities, such as bones and velocities, highlighting its adaptability. Essentially, our method works as a normalization approach to reduce entity bias, enabling subsequent classifiers to achieve improved recognition performance across diverse settings. Extensive experiments on 7 datasets verify our approach by seamlessly integrating with various backbones and significantly boosting their performance.

AI.tldr: 提出CHASE，一种基于凸包自适应偏移的归一化方法，通过将世界坐标原点移至骨骼凸包内来减少实体偏差，提升骨架动作与交互识别性能。
AI.motivation: 现有骨架动作/交互识别多用后期融合策略，假设各实体独立同分布以训练权重共享的实体编码器。但各类骨架数据存在实体偏差，违反此假设，导致骨干模型优化次优、识别错误。该偏差源于世界坐标系初始配置，原点选择造成表示偏差。
AI.method: 提出CHASE归一化方法：(1) 设计即插即用的参数化网络，自适应地对输入骨架施加合理偏移，约束重定位后的世界原点位于骨架凸包内，以限制搜索空间、避免不收敛；(2) 引入辅助目标，利用成对分布距离指导网络优化以进一步减小实体偏差；(3) 提出子实体策略，为单实体与多实体动作提供统一表述；(4) 兼容骨骼、速度等多种骨架内模态。
AI.result: 在7个数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法可无缝集成多种骨干网络，并显著提升其性能，适用于多种骨架动作与交互识别任务。
AI.conclusion: CHASE作为一种归一化方法有效减少实体偏差，适配多种骨架模态与骨干网络，具有良好兼容性与通用性，能持续提升识别性能。

title: Business Compromise Detection with Agentic AI and LLM-driven Knowledge Discovery
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026. 13 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables
summary: Detecting compromised business ad accounts is a challenge in digital advertising, as attackers exploit hijacked accounts to launch fraudulent campaigns. Large Language Model (LLM) agents show promise for integrity enforcement, but hallucinated mistakes on hard cases create business friction. In a study we find the autonomous agent is a strong, recall-heavy signal extractor but an unreliable final arbiter, conceding precision on ambiguous decisions. We therefore keep the agent as an investigator that emits a structured, interpretable signal vector, and delegate the verdict to a neuro-symbolic stage: symbolic rules discovered by Inductive Logic Programming (FOIL-IE), a Naïve Bayes calibration layer, and a data-tuned contradiction layer. Evaluating on a compromise-over-sampled population and a realistic low-prevalence sample with subject-matter-expert labels, this arbiter substitution raises MCC from 0.295 to 0.435 (ΔMCC +0.139, 95% CI [+0.026, +0.245], p=0.018, paired bootstrap), lifting precision from 0.250 to 0.446 (1.8x) at a recall cost (0.920 to 0.660). Benchmarked under identical conditions, it also edge tree ensembles (0.386).The rules encode domain w labels while remaininginterpretable and auditable.

AI.tldr: 将LLM智能体作为信号提取器而非最终裁决者，改由神经符号阶段（ILP规则+朴素贝叶斯校准+矛盾层）做判定，可显著提升广告账户入侵检测的精度与MCC。
AI.motivation: 数字广告中攻击者利用被劫持的商业广告账户发起欺诈活动，检测困难。LLM智能体虽在完整性执法上有潜力，但在困难样本上的幻觉错误会造成业务摩擦：它召回高但作为最终裁决者不可靠，在模糊决策上牺牲精度。
AI.method: 保留LLM智能体作为调查者，输出结构化、可解释的信号向量；将最终判定交给神经符号阶段：由归纳逻辑编程（FOIL-IE）发现的符号规则、朴素贝叶斯校准层，以及数据调优的矛盾层共同裁决。
AI.result: 在入侵过采样人群和低流行率的真实样本（含领域专家标注）上评估：该裁决替代使MCC从0.295升至0.435（ΔMCC +0.139，95% CI [+0.026,+0.245]，p=0.018，配对自助法），精度从0.250升至0.446（1.8倍），召回略降（0.920→0.660）。相同条件下也略优于树集成模型（0.386）。
AI.conclusion: 规则编码了领域知识（含w标签），同时保持可解释与可审计。将LLM降级为信号提取器、由符号推理做裁决的混合方案，是提升入侵检测精度与可靠性、兼顾业务可审计性的有效途径。

title: E-CONAN (Entailment, CONtradition And Neutral) Diagnostics Dataset Investigating Linguistic Phenomena in Arabic Natural Language Understanding
summary: Natural Language Understanding (NLU) plays a crucial role in various applications, yet its performance suffers from weaknesses in handling the complexities of human languages, ranging from lexical ambiguity to high-level reasoning difficulties. Analyzing errors across diverse linguistic phenomena is crucial for NLU improvement, as it will help humans get insights to comprehensively assess models' limitations and capabilities, so optimizing models' generalization. Notably, several benchmarks contain diagnostics datasets designed for investigation and fine-grained error analysis. When highlighting the gaps in the state-of-the-art, we noted that there is no naming convention for macro and micro categories or even a standard set of linguistic phenomena that should be covered. To overcome this gap, we propose an initial hierarchy for Cross-Lingual NLU error analysis. Moreover, we propose a methodology to create an NLI hierarchical framework and applied a case study on Arabic NLU. Moreover, this paper introduces E-CONAN diagnostics dataset, a freely available dataset manually-annotated with coarse-grained and fine-grained categories based on our proposed Arabic hierarchy. E-CONAN dataset helps NLU designers better understand their models by doing error analysis and in-depth investigation. We used E-CONAN to investigate the performance of 9 pretrained language models and 5 LLMs. Results indicate that LLMs outperform pretrained models in world knowledge and commonsense reasoning macro-category, and underperform pretrained models in syntactic macro-category. Moreover, the hardest phenomena for all models is Reasoning, and the easiest phenomena for all pretrained models is Syntactic, and the easiest for LLMs is Lexico-Syntactic.

AI.tldr: 论文提出跨语言NLU错误分析的层次分类体系，并以阿拉伯语NLU为案例构建了E-CONAN诊断数据集，用于细粒度错误分析，评估了9个预训练模型和5个LLM的表现。
AI.motivation: NLU在处理人类语言复杂性（词汇歧义、高层推理等）时表现不佳。跨语言现象的误差分析对改进NLU至关重要，但现有诊断基准缺乏统一的宏/微类别命名规范及标准语言现象集合。
AI.method: 提出跨语言NLU错误分析的初始层次结构，并提出构建NLI层次框架的方法论，应用于阿拉伯语NLU案例；构建E-CONAN诊断数据集，包含人工标注的粗粒度和细粒度类别。
AI.result: 利用E-CONAN评估9个预训练语言模型和5个LLM。LLM在世界知识和常识推理宏类别上优于预训练模型，但在句法宏类别上表现较差。所有模型最难的現象是推理（Reasoning），预训练模型最易的是句法（Syntactic），LLM最易的是词汇句法（Lexico-Syntactic）。
AI.conclusion: 该层次结构和E-CONAN数据集可帮助NLU设计者更好地理解和分析模型局限，为跨语言NLU错误分析提供统一框架与实用资源。

title: QuacamFM: Quaternion-Constrained Flow Matching for Camera Pose Estimation
summary: Camera pose estimation from multi-view images remains a challenge in computer vision. Traditional methods often address this problem using Structure-from-Motion (SfM) with bundle adjustment. However, camera poses estimated from sparse views are inherently ambiguous due to insufficient geometric constraints. Recent work leverages probabilistic models, such as diffusion models, to generate multiple camera pose hypotheses and therefore capture this uncertainty better. Most of these methods represent camera rotations using unit quaternions, but treat them as unconstrained 4D vectors during the generative processes, thereby ignoring the unit-norm constraint of quaternions. Unconstrained quaternions create non-smooth and suboptimal generation trajectories. To this end, we propose *QuacamFM*, a quaternion-constrained flow matching framework for camera pose estimation that preserves unit quaternion representations throughout the entire flow trajectory. We design the optimal transport of the quaternion flows using smooth spherical linear interpolation. Experiments on CO3Dv2 demonstrate our method's advantage in camera pose accuracy over diffusion-based methods and classical SfM approaches. We further show that our quaternion-constrained formulation outperforms the naive application of standard flow matching to 4D quaternion vectors on sparse-view camera pose estimation. Finally, it is observed that QuacamFM generalizes well across datasets and in-the-wild examples.

AI.tldr: 提出QuacamFM，一种在流匹配全过程中保持单位四元数约束的相机位姿估计框架，利用球面线性插值实现四元数流的最优传输。在CO3Dv2上优于扩散模型和经典SfM方法。
AI.motivation: 多视图稀疏视角下相机位姿估计因几何约束不足而存在固有歧义。近期用扩散模型生成多个位姿假设以捕捉不确定性，但多数方法用单位四元数表示旋转，却在生成过程中将其当作无约束4D向量，忽略了单位范数约束，导致生成轨迹不平滑且次优。
AI.method: 提出QuacamFM，基于四元数约束的流匹配框架，在整个流轨迹中保持单位四元数表示；通过平滑的球面线性插值（slerp）设计四元数流的最优传输。
AI.result: 在CO3Dv2上，相机位姿精度优于基于扩散的方法和经典SfM方法；四元数约束公式优于将标准流匹配直接用于4D四元数向量的朴素做法；方法在跨数据集和in-the-wild样例上泛化良好。
AI.conclusion: 保持单位四元数约束的流匹配能更平滑有效地生成相机位姿，提升稀疏视角位姿估计精度并具备良好泛化性。

title: From Scene Graphs to Answers: Selective Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous-driving question answering requires reasoning over structured scene information, yet existing vision-language approaches largely delegate heterogeneous reasoning operations to a single neural inference process. We argue that this uniform strategy overlooks a fundamental distinction: some queries admit exact symbolic solutions, while others require semantic interpretation. We introduce a query-adaptive neuro-symbolic reasoning framework that explicitly allocates computation according to the nature of the query. At its core is a hierarchical Spatiotemporal Scene Graph (STSG) that separates persistent object identities from frame-specific states and represents spatial relations and temporal transitions as explicit directed structures. Given a query, a symbolic executor first attempts to resolve it through exact graph operations; only when symbolic execution abstains is an LLM invoked for semantic reasoning. For these unresolved queries, query-conditioned graph retrieval and evidence filtering preserve relation direction, temporal locality, and object semantics, providing the LLM with compact and verified task-relevant evidence. This design shifts the role of the LLM from a universal reasoning engine to a targeted semantic reasoner, while allowing deterministic computation to be handled exactly and efficiently. We evaluate the framework on 5,916 NuScenes-QA questions across all ten scenes of nuScenes v1.0-mini under an oracle-perception setting. The complete system achieves 80.63 percent overall accuracy with GPT-5.4-mini, improving over the corresponding LLM-only configuration by 5.48 percentage points; with DeepSeek-V4-Flash, the improvement reaches 6.64 points. The largest gains occur on counting questions, with improvements of 10.20 and 12.61 points, respectively. These results show that selective reasoning improves both accuracy and inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出查询自适应神经符号推理框架，用时空场景图配合符号执行器与LLM分工，在NuScenes-QA上达80.63%准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言方法将异质推理操作统一交给单一神经网络推理，忽视了部分查询可用精确符号求解、部分需要语义解释的根本区别，导致精度与效率受限。
AI.method: 构建分层时空场景图（STSG），分离持久对象身份与帧态，显式建模空间关系和时间转移为有向结构。查询时符号执行器先尝试精确图操作求解；仅在符号执行弃权时调用LLM语义推理。对未解查询，采用查询条件图检索与证据过滤，保留关系方向、时间局部性和对象语义，为LLM提供紧凑且已验证的证据。
AI.result: 在oracle感知设置下，于nuScenes v1.0-mini全部十个场景的5,916个NuScenes-QA问题上评测。完整系统用GPT-5.4-mini达80.63%总体准确率，较纯LLM配置提升5.48个百分点；用DeepSeek-V4-Flash提升6.64个百分点。计数问题收益最大，分别提升10.20和12.61个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 选择性推理（按查询性质分配计算）可同时提升准确率和推理效率，LLM从通用推理引擎转变为针对性语义推理器，确定性计算则由符号系统精确高效处理。

title: ManiEdit: Sequential Unstructured Knowledge Editing for Language Models from a Manifold Perspective
summary: Large language models (LLMs) inevitably generate some incorrect or outdated content, necessitating efficient and precise mechanisms for continual knowledge updates. However, existing model editing methods struggle to sequentially edit unstructured long-form knowledge, suffering from severe edit forgetting and degradation of general capabilities. To address these challenges, we reframe knowledge editing from a manifold perspective, viewing it as a localized displacement of an edit sub-manifold within the global knowledge manifold. Under this formulation, the problem can be decomposed into two key questions: (i) how to identify representative edit points that effectively anchor the edit sub-manifold, and (ii) how to preserve the remaining manifold structure during the sub-manifold displacement process. Based on this perspective, we propose ManiEdit, a novel manifold-aware autoregressive editing framework consisting of two core components. Pivot Localization addresses the mediocre-point dilemma by identifying high-leverage pivots to anchor the edit sub-manifold. Manifold-Aware Preservation preserves different knowledge types through an energy-weighted penalty combined with recursive null-space alignment. Experiments on two base LLMs and four unstructured editing benchmarks demonstrate that ManiEdit achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming the strongest baseline by up to +27.81 BERTScore and +8.50 ROUGE-L, while maintaining near-original general capabilities across six representative downstream tasks. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Areyliu/ManiEdit

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ManiEdit，从流形视角重构知识编辑问题，将其视为全局知识流形中编辑子流形的局部位移，解决长文本非结构化知识顺序编辑中的遗忘与能力退化问题。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型不可避免地产生错误或过时内容，需要高效精确的持续知识更新机制。但现有模型编辑方法在顺序编辑非结构化长文本知识时存在严重编辑遗忘和通用能力退化问题。
AI.method: 将知识编辑重构为全局知识流形中编辑子流形的局部位移，分解为两个问题：(i) 识别锚定编辑子流形的代表性编辑点，(ii) 在位移过程中保留剩余流形结构。据此提出 ManiEdit 框架，包含两个核心组件：Pivot Localization（识别高杠杆枢轴点以摆脱平庸点困境）和 Manifold-Aware Preservation（通过能量加权惩罚结合递归零空间对齐保留不同知识类型）。
AI.result: 在两个基础 LLM 和四个非结构化编辑基准上，ManiEdit 达到 SOTA，相比最强基线最高提升 +27.81 BERTScore 和 +8.50 ROUGE-L，同时在六个代表性下游任务上保持接近原始的通用能力。
AI.conclusion: ManiEdit 通过流形感知的自回归编辑框架有效缓解编辑遗忘和通用能力退化，在非结构化长文本知识编辑中实现了优异的编辑效果与通用能力保持的平衡。代码已开源。

title: Seeing Parts, Reasoning about Worlds: Visual Inference under Partial Observation
summary: World modeling under partial observation requires reasoning about the complete worlds that remain compatible with limited visual evidence. Occluded objects and unseen regions can leave several world states possible; additional views can exclude alternatives and strengthen the conclusions supported by the observations. We introduce WorldScope to study this process through possible-world semantics, evidence-grounded data, and learned visual representations. WorldScope-1.2M provides 1.2 million English question-answer pairs spanning eight world properties, ten task interfaces, and three observation protocols. Its answers encode confirmed facts, supported bounds, and unresolved possibilities. Complementary supervision comprises 4,800 certified counterworld groups with equivalent base observations and different hidden object configurations and query answers. These groups provide physical witnesses of ambiguity and training-only labels for world compatibility and view-induced exclusions. We propose WorldFlow, which composes cross-view entity evidence and support-surface coverage into an image-subset evidence lattice. Counterworld compatibility and transition objectives train subset representations to reflect how new observations constrain possible worlds. A shared answer generator uses these representations to predict the strongest supported conclusion. WorldScope-Bench evaluates claim judgments and evidence-dependent conclusions as views are selected, combined, removed, or ordered. On its 5,000-question test set, WorldFlow reaches 64.34% exact accuracy, improving over the same backbone trained on QA alone by 24.88 percentage points. It retains 50.43% accuracy on the 3,000 questions from structure-disjoint scenes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出WorldScope，研究部分观测下的世界建模，通过可能世界语义、证据数据和学习视觉表示。包含1.2M问答数据集、counterworld监督和WorldFlow方法，在WorldScope-Bench上达到64.34%准确率。
AI.motivation: 部分观测下，遮挡物体和不可见区域会导致多个可能世界状态并存，额外视图可以排除替代情况并强化结论。需要研究观测证据如何约束可能世界。
AI.method: 构建WorldScope-1.2M数据集，含120万问答对，覆盖8种世界属性、10种任务接口、3种观测协议；提供4800个certified counterworld group。提出WorldFlow，将跨视图实体证据和支撑面覆盖组合为图像子集证据格，用counterworld兼容性和转移目标训练子集表示，并通过共享答案生成器预测最强支持的结论。
AI.result: 在WorldScope-Bench的5000题测试集上，WorldFlow达到64.34%精确准确率，比仅用QA训练的同一骨干提升24.88个百分点；在3000个结构不相交场景问题上保持50.43%准确率。
AI.conclusion: WorldScope为部分观测世界建模提供了系统的数据、基准和方法，验证了通过可能世界约束和证据格表示可显著提升证据依赖推理能力。

title: Prediction Limits and Koopman Closure of Geometry-Induced Soft State Abstractions
summary: We study when geometry-induced soft state abstractions admit accurate finite-dimensional linear dynamics. Each state is represented by simplex-valued coordinates obtained from class-specific Kernel Affine Hull Machine (KAHM) reconstruction scores, and a matrix is used to predict the next-state coordinates. Our main result is a computable lower confidence bound on the minimum root-mean-square prediction error over all matrices satisfying a prescribed spectral-norm limit. The bound combines within-class variation of successor coordinates with the deviation of soft coordinates from their one-hot reference labels, and can be evaluated from independent state-successor pairs without fitting a prediction matrix. For fixed coordinates and evaluation distribution, the certificate converges almost surely to a population lower bound as the sample size grows; any tolerance below this limit is eventually certified unattainable. Reconstruction-score margins further control the soft-to-hard assignment error. Under deterministic dynamics and exact coordinate closure, eigenvectors of the closure matrix and its reduced transpose induce Koopman and adjoint Koopman eigenfunctions, respectively. A four-state KAHM construction shows that identical soft coordinates can permit exact closure under one dynamics map yet force positive prediction error under another. Experiments on Duffing, Van der Pol, CartPole, MountainCar, and Acrobot compare direct soft-coordinate prediction with state-space DMD/EDMD baselines and report prediction, representation-variation, and spectral diagnostics. The benchmarks assess fitted models but do not numerically evaluate the exclusion certificate.

AI.tldr: 研究基于KAHM重建分数的软状态抽象何时承认精确的有限维线性动力学，并给出可计算的预测误差下界证书。
AI.motivation: 软状态抽象（几何诱导的表示）能否用有限维线性动力学精确刻画尚不清楚，需要可计算的判据来界定线性预测的可达误差极限。
AI.method: 用类特定KAHM重建分数构造单纯形坐标，用矩阵预测下一状态坐标；推导在所有满足谱范数约束的矩阵上最小RMSE的可计算下置信界，结合类内后继坐标变化与软坐标对one-hot标签的偏离；并分析闭包矩阵及其转置的特征向量对应Koopman与伴随Koopman特征函数。
AI.result: 证书随样本量增大几乎必然收敛到总体下界，任何低于该极限的容差最终被证明不可达；重建分数间隔控制软到硬分配误差；四状态KAHM构造显示相同软坐标在一种动力学下可精确闭包、在另一种下必有正预测误差；在Duffing、Van der Pol、CartPole、MountainCar、Acrobot上与DMD/EDMD基线比较预测、表示变化和谱诊断。
AI.conclusion: 提供了判定软坐标线性动力学可精确闭包的误差下界证书，并揭示闭包性与动力学相关；但基准实验仅评估拟合模型，未数值验证该排除证书。

title: Jev Matches 7B Language Models for Speech-Neuroprosthesis Rescoring
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/gabrycina/how-much-language-model
summary: A speech neuroprosthesis decodes attempted speech from brain activity and ends by rescoring the decoder's candidate sentences with a language model of several billion parameters, the only component that needs a GPU. Replacing that model with a cheaper one is hard: general language models asked to pick one sentence from a list answer from where a label sits in the list rather than from the sentence itself. We pose rescoring as a single typed decision, one call that returns a probability for every candidate, served by Jev, a hosted model trained for calibrated decisions, and combine it with the decoder's own score. On 978 held-out sentences from a participant with ALS, where the published decoder alone reaches 8.1% word error, Jev reaches 7.5% against 7.8% for both OPT-6.7b and Qwen2.5-7B; with the decoder's weight re-tuned, 6.9% against 7.2% and 7.4%. Jev is ahead in all four comparisons and at most 0.2 points behind at the 95% bound. It costs 0.07 USD per thousand sentences and needs no GPU; a dedicated GPU running a 7B model is cheaper per sentence only above 43% utilisation, far beyond what one user generates. End-to-end latency over the internet is 262 ms, of which 62 ms is spent at the provider, the same order as a 7B model on a local GPU (27 ms) but not faster.

AI.tldr: 用托管模型Jev替代GPU上的十亿级语言模型做语音神经假体的重打分，在ALS参与者978句上词错率更低，成本低且无需GPU。
AI.motivation: 现有语音神经假体依赖数十亿参数的语言模型重打分候选句子，需GPU，且通用语言模型从列表中选句时倾向于根据标签位置而非句子内容作答，难以用便宜模型替代。
AI.method: 将重打分建模为单次带类型决策，一次调用返回每个候选句的概率，由经校准决策训练的托管模型Jev服务，并与解码器自身分数结合。
AI.result: 在ALS参与者978句上，原始解码器词错率8.1%；Jev达7.5%，优于OPT-6.7b和Qwen2.5-7B的7.8%；重调权重后6.9%对7.2%和7.4%。Jev四组比较全胜，95%置信界内最多落后0.2。成本0.07美元/千句，无需GPU；端到端延迟262ms（提供商62ms），与本地GPU 7B模型（27ms）同量级但不算更快。
AI.conclusion: Jev以更低成本和无GPU的方式实现与7B模型相当或更优的重打分性能，为语音神经假体提供高效实用的替代方案。

title: REMEDY: How Far Is Video Generation from Medical Education World Models?
summary: Recent video generation models produce realistic videos and show potential as a foundation for world models. These advances create opportunities for generating medical teaching demonstrations, which requires both convincing visual quality and precise procedural actions. However, whether current generators can meet these requirements has not been measured. To address this problem, we introduce Readiness Evaluation of Medical Education Demonstration sYnthesis (REMEDY), to our knowledge, the first benchmark for AI-generated medical teaching demonstrations. REMEDY provides 900 first frames from real demonstration videos, covering 12 tasks across four scenarios: operating room, imaging, clinic and bedside, and resuscitation. Five contemporary open-source video generation models produce 4,500 videos from these frames. We combine task-specific clinical checklists with video and motion quality metrics. Evaluation covers four dimensions: clinical action following, clinical profiles, video quality, and motion quality. Our results show that realistic appearance and temporal consistency do not ensure correct clinical actions. Even the most advanced MiniMax-H3 achieves only 28.25% on strict clinical success rate, and fine-grained clinical actions remain challenging. These findings establish a foundation and roadmap for developing future medical education world models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 REMEDY，首个评估 AI 生成医学教学演示的基准，覆盖 4 个场景、12 项任务、900 个首帧与 5 个视频生成模型生成的 4500 个视频，从临床动作、临床特征、视频质量、运动质量四维度评估，发现视觉真实不等于临床动作正确。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型已能生成逼真视频并具备世界模型潜力，为生成医学教学演示提供机会。但医学教学需同时满足视觉质量和精确的操作步骤，而现有生成器能否达到该要求尚未被衡量，缺乏相应评测基准。
AI.method: 提出 REMEDY 基准：收集真实演示视频的 900 个首帧，涵盖手术室、影像、门诊与床旁、复苏四大场景共 12 项任务；用 5 个当代开源视频生成模型生成 4500 个视频；结合任务专属临床清单与视频、运动质量指标，从临床动作遵循、临床特征、视频质量、运动质量四个维度进行评估。
AI.result: 逼真的外观与时间一致性并不能保证正确的临床动作。即使最先进的 MiniMax-H3 在严格临床成功率上也仅达 28.25%，细粒度临床动作仍是难题。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为开发未来的医学教育世界模型奠定了基础并提供了路线图。

title: MixBench-TS: A Multivariate Time Series Forecasting Benchmark Where Channel Mixing Pays Off
summary: Multivariate Time Series Forecasting (MTSF) models that mix information across channels assume that the past of one channel carries information about the future of another. Yet they are evaluated on a small fixed set of standard datasets whose cross-channel structure is rarely examined. We ask two questions: "How can we reliably measure lagged, non-linear, and joint coupling in MTSF datasets?" and "Do the standard datasets actually have such coupling?" To answer the first, we test four candidate measures on synthetic datasets with planted ground-truth coupling: Granger Causality (GC), Transfer Entropy (TE), lagged Mutual Information (MI), and the CD gain, a model-based measure we introduce that compares a channel-dependent (CD) model to its channel-independent (CI) variant. Only lagged MI and the CD gain recover every planted coupling. For the second question, the answer is a definite no, as the standard datasets have a median of only 23% lagged-coupled channel pairs and a median CD gain of -4.9%, compared to 78% and +4.6% on chaotic ODE systems. We therefore propose MixBench-TS, a benchmark of 10 real-world datasets with a median of 55.5% lagged-coupled pairs and a median CD gain of +1.7%. Across six state-of-the-art models tuned under one protocol, CI models win on 10/10 (MSE) and 8/10 (MAE) standard datasets, but on only 3/10 and 2/10 MixBench-TS datasets. We recommend using our benchmark for evaluating new CD models. Moreover, we propose profiling new datasets with lagged MI and the CD gain before using them to evaluate multivariate models. Code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/mixbench-ts-B027.

AI.tldr: 论文质疑标准MTSF数据集缺乏跨通道耦合结构，提出用滞后MI和CD gain测量耦合，并构建含真实耦合的MixBench-TS基准。
AI.motivation: 现有MTSF模型假设通道间存在信息传递，但评估所用的标准数据集跨通道结构很少被检验，可能导致模型评估失真。
AI.method: 在含已知耦合的合成数据上测试四种耦合度量（GC、TE、滞后MI、CD gain），并用滞后MI和CD gain剖面分析标准数据集；进而构建MixBench-TS基准，统一协议下评测六种SOTA模型。
AI.result: 只有滞后MI和CD gain能恢复全部植入耦合。标准数据集滞后耦合对中位数仅23%、CD gain中位数-4.9%，远低于混沌ODE的78%和+4.6%。MixBench-TS中位数分别达55.5%和+1.7%。CI模型在标准集10/10(MSE)、8/10(MAE)获胜，但在MixBench-TS仅3/10和2/10。
AI.conclusion: 标准MTSF数据集普遍缺乏通道耦合，建议使用MixBench-TS评估新的CD模型，并先用滞后MI和CD gain对新数据集做耦合剖面分析。

title: Quizzing the Translation: A Prover-Grounded Evaluation Metric for NL$\rightarrow$FOL
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 18 pages, 3 figures, 10 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/pu-suo/siv-metric
summary: A standard pipeline for symbolic reasoning over natural-language problems translates them into first-order logic and invokes a theorem prover. The translation step is the bottleneck: swap "every" for "some" and every inference that follows is corrupted. Yet today's metrics often score more broken translations higher than less broken ones, because BLEU, BERTScore, and Smatch++ reward surface overlap that the worst errors happen to preserve. We introduce SIV, which derives two kinds of probes from the target formula and uses a theorem prover to verify the candidate translation against each. Positive probes are statements the candidate must entail, which detect translations that drop content; contrastive probes are statements the candidate must not entail, which detect translations that assert more than the original. On a controlled pool of perturbed FOLIO translations, the severity of the error accounts for 80% of SIV's score variance, compared with at most 17% for any prior metric. Across six error classes on a disjoint pool, SIV scores the reference above the perturbed candidate in over 99% of pairs. Because each probe is labeled with what it tests, the failure pattern also supplies a labeled error trace, recovering the perturbation class at macro-F1 0.638, nearly double the score-only baseline. On 434 expert-audited real LLM translations, SIV attains the top AUC, uniquely detects and grades expert-labeled major errors, and abstains, rather than mis-scoring, on out-of-vocabulary translations.

AI.tldr: 提出SIV方法：从目标逻辑公式生成正向与对比式探针，用定理证明器验证候选翻译，能准确评估自然语言到一阶逻辑翻译的错误严重性并提供错误追踪。
AI.motivation: 自然语言符号推理需先翻译为一阶逻辑再调用定理证明器，但翻译是瓶颈。"every"换成"some"就会破坏后续所有推理。而现有指标（BLEU、BERTScore、Smatch++）奖励表面重叠，常给更差的翻译打更高分，无法反映真实错误。
AI.method: SIV（语义推理验证）：从目标公式派生两类探针，用定理证明器验证候选翻译。正向探针是候选必须蕴含的陈述，检测内容遗漏；对比式探针是候选必须不蕴含的陈述，检测过度断言。每个探针带有测试标签。
AI.result: 在受控扰动翻译集上，错误严重性解释SIV得分方差的80%，而此前指标最多17%；在不重叠池的六类错误中，SIV在99%以上配对里给参考翻译打分高于扰动候选。探针失败模式可恢复扰动类别，macro-F1达0.638（约基线两倍）。在434个专家审核的真实LLM翻译上，SIV获得最高AUC，唯一能检测并分级专家标注的重大错误，且对词汇表外翻译选择弃权而非误评。
AI.conclusion: SIV通过定理证明驱动的正/对比探针，克服了表面重叠指标的缺陷，能对齐错误严重性、区分翻译质量、输出可解释错误追踪，并在真实LLM翻译评估中表现最优。

title: Can Motion-Language Models Ground Structure? STRIDE for Evaluating the Evaluators
summary: Motion-language models are typically scored by motion-language evaluators, but how well these evaluators ground language structure remains unclear. Here, we introduce the Structure grounding via Temporal-order, Reflection, and Identity Diagnostic Evaluation (STRIDE) benchmark to systematically evaluate the ability of evaluators to track temporal order, mirror reflection, and action identity. STRIDE comprises $5{,}869$ triples, each consisting of a motion, its original caption, and a perturbed caption, spanning both short and long descriptions. We likelihood-balance caption pairs to reduce text-only bias and estimate each evaluator's caption preference under unrelated motions to measure the discrimination gain from matched motions relative to this baseline. Our experiments reveal weak structural grounding and severe deficits in mirror sensitivity among the audited evaluators, which commonly used evaluation protocols fail to expose. To understand why these limitations go undetected in standard tests, we examine the evaluators more closely. We find that text-only priors alone can solve naive perturbation tests on existing datasets, while common retrieval and distributional metrics barely respond to structural corruption introduced by mirroring ground-truth motions. These findings suggest a natural intervention: structural hard negatives. Our experiments show that a simple modification to contrastive learning substantially improves performance on temporal order and mirror reflection. The benchmark and code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出STRIDE基准，系统评估运动-语言评估器对语言结构（时序、镜像反射、动作身份）的grounding能力，发现现有评估器结构grounding薄弱、镜像敏感性严重不足，并提出结构硬负样本干预改善性能。
AI.motivation: 运动-语言评估器被广泛用于打分，但其对语言结构的grounding能力尚不明确；常用评估协议无法暴露这些缺陷。
AI.method: 构建STRIDE基准，含5,869个三元组（运动+原始caption+扰动caption），覆盖短/长描述；通过似然平衡caption对降低纯文本偏差，并在无关运动下估计caption偏好作为基线，测量匹配运动带来的判别增益。
AI.result: 受审评估器结构grounding普遍薄弱，镜像敏感性严重缺失；纯文本先验即可通过naive扰动测试，而常见检索与分布指标几乎无法响应镜像等结构破坏。
AI.conclusion: 提出结构硬负样本作为自然干预，简单修改对比学习即可显著提升时序顺序与镜像反射表现；基准与代码将开源。

title: World Models with Predictable Long-Horizon Marginals
summary: Accurate one-step predictions do not ensure that a world model's rollouts retain the data distribution. We make the model's decoded stationary law explicit by learning a decoder of a fixed Gaussian reference and constraining the behaviour-averaged transition to preserve that reference. For controlled systems, a joint transition uses a conditional action chart to preserve behaviour occupancy without requiring invariance at each fixed action. Joint state--action rotations and parallel Gaussian noise give an exactly preserving transition with a tractable conditional density. We derive an absolute convergence bound from finite initialization banks and control departure from the reference through conditional action-space divergence. Across $216$ fitted pixel checkpoints on twelve control tasks, the occupancy model with a reference mixture retains every evaluated chain at $10^5$ steps in all $36$ task--seed cells, with a rollout-minus-reference energy-statistic difference of $-0.0002\pm0.0003$ (training-seed standard error). Each of the four nonpreserving comparison arms loses chains, although the Gaussian arm is more accurate at ten steps. An offline DreamerV3 reference also achieves better short-horizon accuracy. These results distinguish three properties of a world model: the distribution it approaches, the rate of approach, and the conditional dynamics it learns.

AI.tldr: 提出显式建模解码后平稳分布的世界模型，通过对固定高斯参考分布学习解码器并约束行为平均转移保持该参考，实现长步rollout分布稳定。
AI.motivation: 单步预测准确并不能保证世界模型的rollout保持数据分布，长时展开可能偏离原分布，因此需要显式控制所趋向的分布。
AI.method: 学习固定高斯参考分布的解码器使平稳律显式；对受控系统用条件动作图保持行为占用而不要求每动作不变性；通过联合状态-动作旋转和平行高斯噪声构造精确保持转移并得到可解条件密度；从有限初始化库导出绝对收敛界，并用条件动作空间散度控制偏离。
AI.result: 在12个控制任务、216个像素检查点上，参考混合的占用模型在全部36个task-seed单元中使每条链在10^5步仍存活，rollout与参考的能量统计差为-0.0002±0.0003；四个非保持对比臂均丢失链，尽管高斯臂在10步更准，离线DreamerV3短程精度也更好。
AI.conclusion: 结果区分了世界模型的三个属性：所趋近的分布、趋近速率以及所学条件动力学；保持参考分布对长时rollout稳定性关键，且与短程精度并不一致。

title: Safety Reconstructed: Generative Modeling via Masked Diffusion Builds Strong Safety Guardrails
summary: Guard models are the last line of defense between a language model and a harmful output, yet their training objective is surprisingly narrow. Existing guards learn to predict a single verdict token from a conversational context, concentrating supervision on a single target. The consequences are structural: models latch onto shortcut features, are overconfident, and remain sensitive to where safety evidence appears in the sequence rather than its role in the full context. We propose a different framing. Rather than predicting a label from text, our LLaDA-Guard asks which label better explains the text: scoring the prompt or response under each label hypothesis and classifying based on their difference. This shifts supervision to every token in the moderated region, forcing the model to account for full content rather than its most discriminative fragments. We instantiate this idea with a masked diffusion language model, fine-tuning LLaDA-8B-Instruct with a class-conditional reconstruction objective using LoRA and requiring no architectural changes beyond the base model. LLaDA-Guard leads on average rank against discriminative baselines trained on stronger backbones across seven held-out safety benchmarks, while exhibiting substantially better confidence calibration (ECE 0.0875 vs. 0.1384 for Qwen3Guard), less over-defense on benign prompts with unsafe-looking cues, and less prompt leakage when moderating responses. Its generative nature further enables token-level risk localization as a natural byproduct, yielding a pipeline for rewriting unsafe prompts into safe equivalents without additional training and achieving a 60.7% average conversion-to-safe rate.

AI.tldr: LLaDA-Guard 提出以"哪个标签更能解释文本"替代"从文本预测标签"，用掩码扩散模型做类条件重构目标，提升安全防护的鲁棒性、校准性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有 guard 模型训练目标过于狭窄：仅从对话上下文预测单个判定 token，导致监督集中、模型依赖捷径特征、过度自信，且对安全证据在序列中的位置敏感而非其语义作用。
AI.method: 不再从文本预测标签，而是对每个标签假设分别打分 prompt/response，依据分数差异分类，使监督覆盖被审核区域的每个 token。用 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 掩码扩散语言模型，通过 LoRA 进行类条件重构目标微调，无需架构改动。
AI.result: 在七个留出安全基准上平均排名领先于更强骨干训练的判别式基线；校准更好（ECE 0.0875 vs. Qwen3Guard 0.1384）；对含危险线索的良性提示过度防御更少；审核响应时提示泄漏更少；并自然实现 token 级风险定位，无需额外训练即可将不安全提示改写为安全等价物，平均转换安全率达 60.7%。
AI.conclusion: 将安全判定重构为类条件解释评分可有效缓解捷径学习与过自信问题，并可衍生 token 级定位与提示改写能力，为 guard 模型提供新范式。

title: Back-Tracking from Clarity: Self-Learning to See Text from Afar
summary: We propose a self-supervised framework designed to enhance the capability of scene text detectors in identifying and recognizing text in scenarios where instances are shown at significant distances, typically small, blurred, and frequently missed by conventional models. Our approach leverages the high-fidelity performance of existing text spotting models on large, clear text as a foundational supervisor.
