By temporally back-tracking these high-confidence detections through video sequences, we automatically synthesize pseudo-labels for preceding frames where the distant text is still visually degraded or undersized. These pseudo-labels enable training a student model specialized for early text detection, without requiring any manual annotation. The success of this approach depends on accurate pseudo-label generation, for which we develop a dedicated scene text tracker capable of maintaining consistent text identities across challenging video sequences. In addition, we propose SceneText50, a diverse multilingual outdoor dataset to facilitate training and evaluation. Experiments show that our framework significantly improves early detection accuracy and robustness across varied scenes and languages. Code and data are at \href{https://github.com/trid2912/BackTrackingText}{https://github.com/trid2912/BackTrackingText}.

AI.tldr: 提出自监督框架，通过反向追踪视频中高质量检测生成伪标签，提升远景/模糊文本的早期检测能力，并发布SceneText50数据集。
AI.motivation: 传统文本检测器对远距离、小尺寸、模糊的文本实例识别效果差，容易漏检，且缺乏人工标注数据。
AI.method: 利用现有文本检测模型对清晰大字的高置信检测结果，通过视频时序反向追踪，自动为早期远景文本生成伪标签，训练专门的早期检测学生模型；并开发专用的场景文本追踪器保持文本身份一致性。
AI.result: 实验表明该框架显著提升了多种场景和语言下的早期检测准确率与鲁棒性；同时提出多语言户外数据集SceneText50用于训练和评估。
AI.conclusion: 无需人工标注即可有效增强文本检测器对远距离退化文本的检测能力，代码和数据已开源。

title: Contract Memory Compiler: Resolve, Then Traverse
summary: External memory lets language-model agents answer questions about histories too long for the answer model's context window. Updates create a harder problem than retrieving a recent fact: changing one relation can redirect a multi-hop question to records about an entity absent from the question. We study this update-dependent evidence selection problem and introduce the Contract Memory Compiler (CMC). Before seeing a question, CMC uses a language model to identify relations in the history and record where each one was stated. It applies later updates to determine the current relations, follows them from entities named in the question, and passes the corresponding original records to the answer model in one call. Thus the current state determines which evidence is read, rather than merely refreshing values in a previously selected context. To the best of our knowledge, CMC achieves state-of-the-art multi-hop accuracy on FactConsolidation, reaching 78.25% overall and 61.0% at 262K. With the extracted relations and answer model held fixed, selecting evidence before resolving updates reduces multi-hop accuracy to 21.50%. We also introduce MQuAKE-MemStream, a derived dataset of ordered memory streams built from MQuAKE-Remastered counterfactual cases.

AI.tldr: 提出Contract Memory Compiler (CMC)，通过先解析历史关系再应用更新来确定当前状态，从而解决更新依赖的证据选择问题，在FactConsolidation多跳任务上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 外部记忆帮助语言模型智能体回答超长历史的问答，但更新带来比"检索最近事实"更难的问题：改变一个关系可能将多跳问题重定向到问题中未提及实体的记录。这被定义为"更新依赖的证据选择"问题。
AI.method: CMC在见到问题前，用语言模型识别历史中的关系并记录每条关系的陈述位置；应用后续更新确定当前关系；从问题中的实体出发沿关系追踪，将对应的原始记录一次性传给答案模型。即由当前状态决定读取哪些证据，而非仅在已选上下文中刷新数值。
AI.result: 在FactConsolidation上取得SOTA多跳准确率：总体78.25%，262K长度下61.0%。在固定提取关系和答案模型的情况下，若在解析更新前选择证据，多跳准确率降至21.50%。同时构建了MQuAKE-MemStream数据集。
AI.conclusion: 证据选择必须先于更新解析进行，才能保证多跳问答正确；CMC验证了该"当前状态决定证据"范式的有效性，并提供了新的有序记忆流数据集。

title: Learning to Learn from Context: Synthetic Training from Perturbed Public Documents
summary: Real-world tasks often require large language models (LLMs) to learn from complex task-specific context rather than pretrained parametric knowledge. This capability remains a weakness of LLMs, while human annotation for such task contexts is expensive and difficult to scale. Public high-quality documents are an abundant alternative, but much of the public web has already been consumed during pretraining: training on such documents naively would reward memorization rather than context learning. In this work, we attempt to make use of high-quality public documents with small perturbations and empirically find that LLMs can successfully generate context-dependent reasoning traces and answers, which are then used to train a student model. Specifically, we construct a synthesis pipeline that (i) rewrites source documents to reduce memorization risk, (ii) generates questions and rubrics that require reasoning over the document, (iii) answers the questions with the document as context, and (iv) admits only samples that genuinely depend on the document. Without any human annotators, our pipeline generates about 10k samples from 3.5k documents, and the resulting student model substantially improves the performance on CL-bench. SFT raises a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B student from 13.7% to 22.8%, and a subsequent rubric-reward RL stage reaches 24.6%, on CL-bench comparable with a frontier model of over a trillion parameters, Qwen3.8-2.4T (23.9%). We also observe a broad transfer of improvements to long-context understanding, instruction following, and reasoning, while code generation and knowledge remain mostly flat. We hope this work provides a reproducible and scalable way to improve the ability of LLMs to learn from context, and to facilitate further research on context-grounded reasoning.

AI.tldr: 利用公开高质量文档做小扰动合成数据，无需人工标注即可让LLM学会从上下文中学习，学生模型在CL-bench上接近万亿参数前沿模型。
AI.motivation: LLM从任务特定上下文学习的能力较弱，而人工标注上下文代价高、难扩展。公开网络文档虽多但已被预训练消费，直接训练会导致记忆而非上下文学习。
AI.method: 构建合成流水线：(i)重写源文档降低记忆风险；(ii)生成需推理文档的问答与评分标准(rubric)；(iii)以文档为上下文作答；(iv)只保留真正依赖文档的样本。再用SFT与rubric-reward RL训练学生模型。
AI.result: 无人工标注下从3.5k文档生成约1万样本。Qwen3.6-35B-A3B学生经SFT从13.7%升至22.8%，RL后达24.6%，接近超万亿参数的Qwen3.8-2.4T(23.9%)。提升可迁移到长上下文理解、指令遵循与推理，代码生成与知识基本持平。
AI.conclusion: 提供可复现、可扩展的途径提升LLM从上下文学习的能力，促进上下文接地推理的后续研究。

title: JEPA Learns What the Mask Leaves Unrecoverable
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures are unusually sensitive to how the input is masked: block masks work, scattered masks do not, and the explanations are empirical. We give a measurement account. A mask is a linear measurement, and in a compactly supported wavelet basis every atom whose support lies inside the hidden region falls in the measurement's null space and leaves no trace in the data. The JEPA loss asks only that the encoded context suffice for the target, so a target that a low-level prior can recover admits a shortcut, one the moving-average target encoder can make self-consistent. What removes the shortcut is the coarse-scale content the mask leaves unrecoverable, provided enough context stays within reach of each target. We score that content before training and test the account's distinctive predictions in 151 pre-training runs. On ImageNet-100, strip masks match blocks in area and contiguity yet are recoverable, and they land at 40.3% linear top-1, beside random masks at 40.8%, against 64.3% for blocks; within one geometry family, the placements that leave the least unrecoverable content lose 6.5 points to those that leave the most, over five seed pairs; pixel targets span 7 points where latent targets span 25; and against a frozen target the gap between random and block masks, 19 points on the same kind of GPU, closes to 1.5, so the geometry acts through the target the encoder produces for itself. On UCF101 the masking ratio decides which condition, content or reach, binds; removing whole frames, unrecoverable in space but recoverable from neighbouring frames, is worst at both ratios; and on V-JEPA's own masks, batching them intact instead of truncated changes little (36.0% against 35.1%), whereas making 100 target tokens inside the blocks visible lifts them to 48.7% and hiding 100 context tokens outside the blocks does not (33.7%).

AI.tldr: 该论文从"线性测量"角度解释JEPA对掩码几何敏感性：掩码在紧支撑小波基下的零空间决定不可恢复内容，是训练成效的关键，并在151次预训练中验证。
AI.motivation: JEPA对掩码方式异常敏感（块状有效、散点无效），但此前只有经验性解释，缺乏理论机制。作者希望给出可量化的测量论解释。
AI.method: 将掩码视为线性测量；在紧支撑小波基下，支撑落在隐藏区内的原子进入零空间而无迹可循。JEPA损失只要求编码上下文足以预测目标，若目标可被低层先验恢复则产生捷径，且移动平均目标编码器可使其自洽。去除捷径的是掩码留下的不可恢复粗尺度内容（需保证每个目标有足够上下文可达）。作者在训练前对该内容打分，并在151次预训练中检验预测。
AI.result: ImageNet-100：条带掩码与块状面积连续性相同但可恢复，线性top-1为40.3%，接近随机掩码40.8%，远低于块状64.3%；同一几何族内不可恢复内容最少的放置比最多的低6.5分（5对种子）；像素目标跨7分，潜在目标跨25分；对冻结目标，随机与块状差距从19分缩到1.5分，说明几何通过自生成目标起作用。UCF101：掩码比例决定内容与可达性哪个约束起主导；整帧移除在两种比例下都最差；V-JEPA掩码中整批不截断变化小（36.0% vs 35.1%），使块内100个目标token可见提升至48.7%，隐藏块外100个上下文token无改善（33.7%）。
AI.conclusion: 掩码几何通过零空间与不可恢复粗尺度内容决定JEPA学习效果，理论预测在151次预训练中得到系统验证。

title: Learning from a Thoughtful Teacher: Adaptive On-Policy Self-Distillation for Mathematical Reasoning
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a question-only student with token-level feedback from a teacher given training-only privileged information (PI). OPSD therefore provides dense, on-policy supervision, and is free of a larger external teacher, but its effectiveness rests on how PI is designed and utilized. Our preliminary diagnostics suggest a significant gap between teacher utility and student learnability, where a small fraction of high-disagreement tokens dominate the distillation signal, and short teacher continuations at these positions further expose more explicit PI leakage than transferable correction cues, indicating a strong intent on injecting PI-conditioned shortcuts. We propose Adaptive On-Policy Self-Distillation (AOPSD), which adapts what information the teacher receives and how strongly its feedback influences learning. AOPSD encodes each solution as a reasoning DAG, orders problems by the student's evolving capability, and reveals only the affordable subgraph and its next frontier as PI. For high-disagreement tokens, AOPSD utilizes short teacher continuations as probes to encourage useful guidance while mitigating PI-conditioned shortcuts among teacher supervisions. On HMMT25, AIME24, AIME25, and BRUMo25, AOPSD achieves 72.5% Pass@8, which is 6.7 percentage points above OPSD and 4.2 above the strongest competing baseline while reducing 15 percentage points of training time at lower cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应在线策略自蒸馏（AOPSD），通过自适应设计特权信息（PI）的揭示方式与教师反馈强度，缓解教师可用性与学生可学习性之间的差距，在多个数学推理基准上显著超越OPSD与最强基线。
AI.motivation: 在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）依赖特权信息（PI）的设计与利用，但诊断发现教师可用性与学生可学习性存在显著差距：少数高分歧token主导蒸馏信号，且短教师续写暴露了更多PI泄漏的捷径而非可迁移的纠正线索。
AI.method: 提出AOPSD：（1）将每个解编码为推理DAG，按学生演变能力对问题排序，仅揭示可负担子图及其下一前沿作为PI；（2）对高分歧token使用短教师续写作为探针，鼓励有用引导同时缓解PI条件捷径。
AI.result: 在HMMT25、AIME24、AIME25、BRUMo25上，AOPSD取得72.5% Pass@8，比OPSD高6.7个百分点，比最强竞争基线高4.2个百分点，同时减少15个百分点训练时间且成本更低。
AI.conclusion: 通过自适应调整PI揭示内容与教师反馈强度，AOPSD有效缩小教师可用性与学生可学习性差距，实现更高效、更强性能的在线策略自蒸馏。

title: Tsubame: Tree Replay for Diffusion-Based Speculative Decoding
summary: Context-aware dynamic trees allocate the speculative decoding budget according to draft path probabilities, adapting their depth and branching to the current context. Under stochastic decoding, however, we find that this structural advantage does not always compensate for the acceptance gains of random sampling paired with advanced verification, and such dynamic trees can fall behind sampled chains in some settings. These trees grow their topology from the candidates themselves, so the tokens submitted for verification are typically the deterministic high-score tokens selected during construction. This coupling is not inherent: once the topology is fixed, its nodes can be repopulated by sampling, allowing dynamic trees to retain their structural advantage while also benefiting from random sampling and advanced verification. Diffusion-based drafters make this practical, as their parallel outputs or lightweight conditional corrections allow candidates to be regenerated cheaply after the complete topology is known. We introduce Tsubame, a two-pass tree speculative decoding framework for diffusion-based drafters. The first pass plans and freezes a context-aware topology using draft path scores; the second replays the fixed topology, sampling the tokens that populate its nodes to form the candidate tree for verification. We prove that Tsubame is lossless under compatible sampling and verification strategies. Experiments across three diffusion-based drafters, six datasets, and multiple candidate budgets show that Tsubame improves acceptance length and throughput over deterministic trees, including settings where it reverses their disadvantage against sampled chains.

AI.tldr: 提出Tsubame：两阶段树式推测解码框架，先冻结树结构，再用采样重填节点，结合扩散草稿器优势，无损且提升吞吐。
AI.motivation: 上下文感知动态树虽能依据草稿路径概率调整深度分支，但在随机解码下，其结构优势不一定抵消随机采样加高级验证的接受增益，甚至落后于采样链。问题根源在于动态树的拓扑由候选自发生成，提交验证的多为构建时选定的确定性高分token，结构优势与采样验证优势被耦合。
AI.method: 提出两阶段（two-pass）树式推测解码框架Tsubame，面向扩散式草稿器。第一遍用草稿路径分数规划并冻结上下文感知拓扑；第二遍在固定拓扑上通过采样填充节点token，形成候选树用于验证。借助扩散草稿器的并行输出或轻量条件修正，可在拓扑确定后低成本重新生成候选。
AI.result: 在三种扩散草稿器、六个数据集和多种候选预算下，Tsubame接受长度与吞吐均优于确定性树，并在部分设置中逆转了动态树相对采样链的劣势。作者证明其在兼容采样与验证策略下是无损的。
AI.conclusion: 解耦树拓扑与节点token生成可同时保留动态树的上下文感知结构优势与随机采样加高级验证的接受增益，为扩散草稿器提供实用且无损的推测解码方案。

title: GeoCR: Learning a Generalist Cloud Removal Prior from Heterogeneous Observations
summary: Cloud removal methods are typically specialized to individual datasets and input configurations, limiting reuse across sensors, spectral bands, and observation settings. We introduce GeoCR, a generalist model that unifies RGB-only-based CR and multispectral-based CR from single- or multi-temporal cloudy observations, with optional SAR guidance, within a single network. To accommodate different spectral and sensing domains, compact input and output stems extend a pretrained RGB autoencoder while keeping its encoder and decoder trunks frozen. This shared latent interface enables a single flow transformer to jointly model clean RGB and non-RGB latents, conditioned on separate cloudy-observation streams and optional SAR tokens. Through joint pretraining on the training splits of ten datasets comprising 883,331 cloud-free target images, GeoCR learns a shared cloud removal prior across these heterogeneous configurations. The same pretrained checkpoint supports direct inference without dataset-specific fine-tuning and efficient adaptation through low-rank adaptation (LoRA). We evaluate GeoCR against general image restoration and cloud removal methods on test splits of the contributing datasets under full-band and RGB-only settings. GeoCR achieves the best FID and DISTS on full-band SEN12MS-CR and Sen2_MTC_New and RGB-only CUHK-CR2, outperforming existing models and demonstrating the effectiveness of a reusable generative model across diverse settings.

AI.tldr: 提出通用云去除模型GeoCR，统一RGB与多光谱、单/多时相、可选SAR的多种配置，通过冻结预训练RGB自编码器主干+流变换器实现跨数据集复用。
AI.motivation: 现有云去除方法通常针对特定数据集和输入配置专门化，难以跨传感器、光谱波段和观测设置复用。
AI.method: 在冻结的预训练RGB自编码器编码器/解码器主干上添加紧凑的输入输出stem，构建共享潜空间接口；用单一流变换器联合建模干净RGB与非RGB潜变量，以分离的含云观测流和可选SAR token为条件；在10个数据集训练集（883,331张无云目标图）上联合预训练；支持直接推理及LoRA高效微调。
AI.result: 在全波段SEN12MS-CR与Sen2_MTC_New以及RGB-only CUHK-CR2上取得最佳FID和DISTS，优于现有模型。
AI.conclusion: GeoCR证明可复用的生成模型能在异构云去除配置中有效工作，无需数据集特定微调。

title: Refinement Symmetry in Multimodal Transformers
summary: Attention weights depend on token counts, which change with the representation of a signal. We study refinement symmetry: splitting a representation while preserving content, position, visible context, and total mass should preserve its contribution. Building on proportional and quadrature attention, we show that split invariance forces the local mass factor to be linear for any fixed positive attention kernel, provided that factor is nondecreasing. For changed representations, a physical coupling bounds attention error by separating feature change from weight reallocation. In Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, duplicating half the visual tokens threefold changes 255 of 3,586 MVBench answers under standard attention; measure weighting preserves every answer under matched visibility. Under natural frame resampling, it reduces distributional drift. At twofold merging of a frozen video encoding, a five-seed evaluation shows an all-partition-correct accuracy gain of 1.04 percentage points over global count weighting (average group mass) and 0.93 points over standard attention. The advantage over global count also holds on WorldSense but depends on the compression budget. The result is a representation principle with a measured benefit in robustness across partitions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"精炼对称性"原则：将表示拆分而保持内容、位置、可见上下文与总质量不变时，其贡献也应保持不变。基于比例与正交注意力，证明该不变性要求质量因子对任意正核为线性。以"测度加权"实现，在Qwen2.5-Omni-7B的MVBench等任务上验证了鲁棒性提升。
AI.motivation: 注意力权重依赖token数量，而token数量随信号表示方式变化，导致同一内容在不同拆分/重采样下贡献不一致，影响模型鲁棒性。作者希望找到一种表示不变性原则来约束注意力加权。
AI.method: 提出"精炼对称性"（split invariance），在比例注意力与正交注意力基础上，证明：对任意固定正注意力核，若局部质量因子非递减，则拆分不变性强制该因子为线性。对表示变化的情形，用物理耦合将注意力误差分解为特征变化与权重重分配两部分。据此实现"测度加权"（measure weighting）。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-Omni-7B上，将一半视觉token三倍复制，标准注意力下3586个MVBench答案中255个改变，而测度加权在匹配可见性下保持所有答案不变；自然帧重采样下分布漂移减小。冻结视频编码二倍合并时，五种子评估显示全分区正确率比全局计数加权（平均组质量）高1.04个百分点，比标准注意力高0.93个百分点。对全局计数的优势在WorldSense上同样成立，但依赖压缩预算。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将注意力加权提炼为一个表示原则，并在分区鲁棒性上取得可测量的收益，表明测度加权优于标准注意力与全局计数加权。

title: One Model Is Not a Crowd: Multi-LLM and Aspect-Conditioned Diverse Comment Generation
summary: Human communication on the internet is shaped by diverse perspectives, most visibly expressed in online comment spaces. As large language model (LLM)based AI agents begin to inhabit these spaces, a key question arises: whether synthetic comment threads can capture the diversity inherent in human discourse. This concern is increasingly important, as the growing presence of homogenized AI-generated content risks reducing diversity over time, potentially leading to model collapse and degrading the richness of digital communication. Inspired by the plurality of human crowds and the aspect-driven nature of discourse, we hypothesize that comment diversity is better approximated by combining multiple LLMs with aspect-conditioned generation. We formalize and evaluate this approach using models from different providers and introduce a framework that characterizes diversity across semantic, linguistic, and socio-pragmatic features along three axes: dispersion, coverage, and alignment. Using this framework, we conduct a large-scale study on over 2 million YouTube comments across multiple domains. Our results reveal that multi-LLM and aspect-conditioned generation better align with human comment distributions and such data remains viable under pretraining style curation and is effective for downstream tasks. Yet, human diversity remains unmatched. Overall, our findings provide a practical foundation for generating more diverse and socially grounded discourse in AI-mediated environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究LLM生成的评论线程能否捕捉人类话语的多样性，提出用多LLM结合方面条件生成来近似评论多样性，并通过大规模YouTube评论研究验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM驱动的AI代理进入在线评论空间，合成评论线程可能因内容同质化而降低多样性，导致模型崩塌并削弱数字交流的丰富性，因此需要评估和提升AI生成评论的多样性。
AI.method: 受人类群体多元性和话语的方面驱动特性启发，提出结合多个不同提供商的LLM进行方面条件生成；构建框架，从语义、语言和社会语用特征三个维度刻画多样性，并沿离散度、覆盖度和对齐度三个轴进行评估；在超200万条多领域YouTube评论上进行大规模研究。
AI.result: 多LLM和方面条件生成能更好地对齐人类评论分布，此类数据在预训练式筛选下仍可用，并对下游任务有效；但人类多样性仍未被超越。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为在AI介导环境中生成更多样、更具社会根基的话语提供了实践基础。

title: Cross-Domain Few-Shot Writer Adaptation for Real-World Handwritten Mathematical Expression Recognition
comment: Accepted at the 32nd IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP 2026)
summary: Handwritten mathematical expression recognition (HMER) refers to the task of recognizing and converting handwritten mathematics into a parsable markup language, usually LaTeX. No current state-of-the-art-competitive system adjusts to the way a specific person writes, and the domain gap between training images (usually digital or perfectly binarized) and images physically taken with a camera used in inference has received fairly little attention for this specific problem. We characterize this domain gap through fragmentation and stroke-width analyses of the images as well as introduce a writer-adaptive fine-tuning pipeline to MFH-CoMER in an attempt to address it. We further introduce sample author-specific datasets, consisting of five handwriting category subsets from two authors, and evaluate using a McNemar's test and permutation tests adapted to limited data. Results suggest an increase in expression recognition rate and a decrease in CER for digital handwriting but more varied results for physical handwriting, with the model struggling for handwriting articles that the base model can already evaluate well. Nonetheless, adapted models were found to have improved results for four out of five subsets. Statistical testing results suggest a consistency in improvement for two of the tested author-specific subsets. Our results point towards the potential feasibility of writer adaptation for the HMER task.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对手写数学表达式识别（HMER）中的域差距问题，分析图像碎片化与笔画宽度差异，并提出面向MFH-CoMER的书写者自适应微调流程。作者构建了两个作者的5个笔迹子集，用适配小样本的McNemar检验与置换检验评估。结果显示数字笔迹识别率提升、CER下降；物理笔迹结果不一，但5个子集中4个有改善，2个具统计显著性，表明书写者自适应在HMER中具有一定可行性。
AI.motivation: 现有HMER最优系统无法适应特定人的书写风格，且训练图像（数字或理想二值化）与推理中用相机拍摄图像之间存在域差距，该问题此前关注较少。
AI.method: 通过碎片化和笔画宽度分析刻画域差距；提出面向MFH-CoMER的书写者自适应微调流程；构建两个作者、5类笔迹子集的样本数据集；采用适配有限数据的McNemar检验与置换检验进行评估。
AI.result: 数字手写方面表达式识别率提升、CER下降；物理手写结果较不一致，模型对基模型原本表现良好的笔迹类别仍较吃力。总体5个子集中4个经自适应后有所改善，2个子集在统计检验上表现出一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: 书写者自适应微调对HMER任务具有潜在可行性，可缩小书写风格与成像域差距，但在物理手写场景仍需进一步研究。

title: What Would Falsify It? A Variable Specific Evidence Standard for Mechanistic Claims About Self Explanation
summary:
When a language model explains an answer it has already given, does it reuse the computation that produced the answer or reconstruct a story from the answer alone? Attribution, transportability and recoverability are each compatible with causal use without establishing it. We propose an evidence standard: pair each positive statistic with a variable specific null that removes the tested variable's identity while matching relevant nuisance dimensions as far as possible, and audit unmatched dimensions.
  We apply this standard to a known cause. A cue naming a wrong option raises the rate of choosing that option by 64 to 68 percentage points across three models. Explanations mention the cue in 1.8 percent of items or fewer in three of four models tested. Three estimator classes yield favorable statistics, but none establishes causal sensitivity to the cue contrast under its own control in the three-model analysis. In the strongest case, a recovered cue direction reaches $R^2$ of 0.95 and exceeds a geometry matched random direction in all three seeds, while a direction fitted by the same pipeline with cue labels scrambled reproduces 61 to 76 percent of its effect at comparable realized edit magnitude. A fourth model passes one interchange endpoint, but unequal edit magnitudes and a contrast that changes both cue identity and cue-answer agreement limit its interpretation.
  These experiments leave causal access unresolved. They establish an evidentiary requirement: favorable mechanistic statistics must survive controls for variable identity and nuisance structure. Reusable controls separate generic from identity specific transport effects, fit null directions with scrambled labels, and audit realized intervention magnitudes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套证据标准（变量特异性零假设+干扰维度匹配+未匹配维度审计）来检验语言模型解释是否真正因果性地复用了产生答案的计算，而非仅从答案重构叙事。以"错误选项线索"作为已知因果进行审计：该线索使选择率提升64–68个百分点，但解释很少提及它，且三类估计器的有利统计量在自身对照下无一确立因果敏感性，最终结论为因果访问仍未解决。
AI.motivation: 归因、可迁移性与可恢复性等统计证据各自都与"因果使用"相容，但都无法真正建立因果性。作者希望建立一个更严格的证据标准，以区分"解释真正复用产生答案的计算"与"仅根据答案重构故事"。
AI.method: 提出证据标准：为每个正向统计量配对一个变量特异性零假设（去除被测变量的身份，同时在最大程度上匹配相关干扰维度），并审计未匹配的维度。将该标准应用于一个已知因果关系——命名错误选项的线索，跨三个/四个模型测量其选择率影响、解释提及率，并用三类估计器及打乱标签的对照方向进行检验。
AI.result: 线索使错误选项选择率提高64–68个百分点；但在四个模型中的三个，解释提及该线索的比例≤1.8%。三类估计器均给出有利统计量，但在三模型分析中，其自身对照下无一能确立对该线索对比的因果敏感性。最强情形下恢复的线索方向达到R²=0.95，三个随机种子均超过几何匹配的随机方向；然而用打乱标签的同一流程拟合的方向在相近编辑幅度下仍复现了61–76%的效应，说明信号部分来自通用结构而非线索身份。第四个模型仅通过一个交换端点，且编辑幅度不等、对比同时改变线索身份与线索-答案一致性，限制了其解释力。
AI.conclusion: 这些实验未能解决因果访问问题，但确立了一项证据要求：有利的机制性统计量必须能经受变量身份与干扰结构的控制。可复用控制手段包括：区分通用与身份特异性迁移效应、用打乱标签拟合零方向、审计实际干预幅度。

title: Closing the Cross-Dialect Gap: Query Plans as a Portable Interface in Text-to-SQL
comment: Accepted at Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Text-to-SQL systems are typically trained and evaluated on a single dialect (SQLite), yet production deployments span PostgreSQL, MySQL, ClickHouse, and beyond. We show that this single-dialect assumption leads to a substantial drop in cross-dialect accuracy for every model we tested. The drop persists across scale, architecture, and even purpose-built text-to-SQL systems. We argue that the fix is to change the generation target: instead of asking an LLM to emit dialect-specific SQL, we have it emit a dialect-agnostic relational algebra query plan, which a deterministic compiler then renders into SQL for any supported backend. Across thirteen models from 3B to frontier scale, this restores cross-dialect portability nearly uniformly, at a small cost in peak accuracy on the model's home dialect for capable prompted models and none once fine-tuned on plans; under matched fine-tuning, plan supervision yields a stronger model than SQL supervision. We also introduce MetricName, a question-aware result-set comparator needed to evaluate fairly across dialects, where existing metrics confound semantic errors with benign cross-dialect variation. More broadly, the result is a reminder that a generation target chosen for execution is not necessarily the one that maximizes generation quality.

AI.tldr: 论文指出Text-to-SQL模型在单方言(SQLite)上训练/评测，跨方言部署时精度大幅下降；提出让LLM生成方言无关的关系代数查询计划，再由确定性编译器渲染为目标方言SQL，从而在13个模型上近乎一致地恢复跨方言可移植性，并提出MetricName评测指标。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL系统通常只针对单一方言(SQLite)训练与评测，但生产环境需要支持PostgreSQL、MySQL、ClickHouse等多种后端。这种单方言假设导致所有测试模型在跨方言场景下精度显著下降，且该问题跨越模型规模、架构乃至专用Text-to-SQL系统普遍存在。作者认为根本问题在于"生成目标"的选择不当。
AI.method: 改变生成目标：不再让LLM直接输出方言相关的SQL，而是输出方言无关的关系代数查询计划，再由确定性编译器将其渲染为任意支持后端的SQL。此外提出MetricName——一个感知问题的结果集比较器，用于跨方言公平评测，避免现有指标将语义错误与良性的跨方言差异混淆。
AI.result: 在13个从3B到前沿规模的模型上，该方法几乎一致地恢复了跨方言可移植性；对能力较强、使用提示的模型，仅在母语方言的峰值精度上有小幅损失，而在计划上微调后则无损失。在同等微调条件下，计划监督比SQL监督得到更强的模型。
AI.conclusion: 一个为执行而选择的生成目标，未必是能最大化生成质量的目标；结果表明将生成目标改为方言无关的查询计划可有效解决跨方言问题，并提示生成目标的选择本身对生成质量有重要影响。

title: UnStep: Training-Free Acceleration of Causal Video Diffusion with Fewer Steps Than Distillation
summary: Distilling bidirectional multi-step video diffusion transformers into few-step causal models has become a common approach for streaming video generation. While these few-step students are significantly faster than the teachers they are distilled from, they remain slow for real-time generation. In this work we present UnStep, a training-free wrapper that accelerates few-step causal video models at inference by running them with fewer diffusion transformer (DiT) steps than during distillation and limiting the temporal window retained in the attention KV cache. We propose two inference-only mechanisms to recover quality lost by step reduction and attention windowing: renoising the generated latent frames to a near-clean level and reusing the existing clean-cache pass to refine them, and applying truncated SVD to the DiT attention value and output projections. We also accelerate inference with a quality-preserving runtime stack for the DiT and VAE decoder, including more efficient attention calls and KV indexing, fused Triton RoPE with cached coefficients, and VAE decoding with optimized memory layout, precision, and convolution kernels. By reducing computation and optimizing the runtime stack, UnStep sets a new throughput regime for causal video diffusion, by running substantially faster than current methods, reaching 50 FPS on a single H100 without quality loss, and 77 FPS on GB200, all without retraining.

AI.tldr: UnStep是一种免训练推理加速方案，通过减少DiT步数、限制注意力KV缓存窗口，并配合两种质量恢复机制与运行时优化，在单卡H100上达成50 FPS、GB200上77 FPS的因果视频扩散生成。
AI.motivation: 少步因果视频扩散模型虽比教师模型快，但仍难以满足实时生成需求。现有加速通常依赖重训练，成本高且不通用。
AI.method: 提出免训练推理封装：（1）用比蒸馏时更少的DiT步数运行，并限制注意力KV缓存的时间窗口；（2）质量恢复机制——对生成潜帧加噪至近干净水平，复用干净缓存轮进行精修，以及对DiT注意力的value/output投影做截断SVD；（3）质量保持的运行时优化栈：更高效的注意力调用与KV索引、融合Triton RoPE（缓存系数）、以及优化内存布局/精度/卷积核的VAE解码。
AI.result: 大幅减少计算并优化运行时后，实现新的吞吐量水平：单张H100上50 FPS，GB200上77 FPS，且无质量损失，无需重训练。
AI.conclusion: UnStep证明在不重训练的情况下，通过推理层面的步数削减、KV窗口限制、质量恢复与运行时优化，可将少步因果视频扩散模型推进到实时甚至更高吞吐，为流式视频生成建立新性能区间。

title: Expected Reasoning-Step Return Unifies On-Policy Learning from Rewards and Teachers
summary: On-policy reasoning models can learn from task rewards or teacher signals, but these sources differ in form and can favor conflicting updates, leaving unclear which should guide a given reasoning action. We introduce \textbf{Expected Reasoning-Step Return (ERSR)}, which treats semantic reasoning steps as macro-actions and uses Monte Carlo student-policy rollouts to estimate the expected final task reward of student-generated and teacher-proposed actions in a common return space for step-level comparison. ERSR analysis reveals an outcome-dependent asymmetry: student actions are more beneficial than teacher replacements on successful trajectories, whereas teacher replacements become more beneficial on failed trajectories. We further show that student answer-probe gains track student-step ERSR utility and distinguish beneficial from harmful reasoning steps. Based on these findings, we propose \textbf{Return-Referenced On-Policy Learning (R$^2$OPL)}, which reinforces student reasoning on successful trajectories and distills teacher signals on failed ones, while using group success rate for difficulty scaling and student-probe gains for step-level modulation. Experiments across reasoning benchmarks and teacher--student configurations show that R$^2$OPL consistently outperforms strong baselines. ERSR training dynamics further show that R$^2$OPL jointly exploits substantial utility from both reward- and teacher-side signals, whereas existing hybrids often leave substantial residual utility in one branch.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ERSR指标，将推理步骤视为宏动作，用学生策略蒙特卡洛采样在统一回报空间比较学生动作与教师信号的价值，并据此设计R²OPL训练方法：成功轨迹强化学生推理，失败轨迹蒸馏教师信号，实验表明其持续优于基线。
AI.motivation: 策略内推理模型可同时从任务奖励和教师信号学习，但二者形式不同且可能给出冲突更新，导致不清楚某一步推理该由哪个来源引导。
AI.method: 引入Expected Reasoning-Step Return（ERSR），把语义推理步骤当作宏动作，用学生策略的蒙特卡洛 rollout 估计学生生成动作与教师提议动作的期望最终任务奖励，在共同回报空间中做步骤级比较；据此提出Return-Referenced On-Policy Learning（R²OPL），成功轨迹强化学生推理、失败轨迹蒸馏教师信号，并用组成功率做难度缩放、用学生 answer-probe 增益做步骤级调制。
AI.result: ERSR揭示了结果依赖性非对称：成功轨迹上学生动作优于教师替换，失败轨迹上教师替换更优；学生 answer-probe 增益与学生步骤ERSR效用相关，可区分有益与有害推理步骤。R²OPL在多个推理基准和教师-学生配置上持续超过强基线，训练动态显示其能同时利用奖励侧和教师侧信号的大量效用，而现有混合方法常在一支上留有大量残余效用。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一回报空间进行步骤级信用比较，可有效协调任务奖励与教师信号，R²OPL验证了这一思路的优越性。

title: Reset Is Not Recovery: Evaluating Recoverability from False Conversational Context via Sycophancy Hysteresis
summary: Grounded language models are usually evaluated by adding relevant context, but multiturn dialogue also contains unsupported user claims that may contaminate later factual answers. We study post-pressure recoverability: whether a model returns to clean-context behavior after a user repeatedly advocates a wrong answer and then withdraws that pressure. We introduce a recovery-after-pressure protocol for multiple-choice factual dialogue and measure sycophancy hysteresis, the residual probability assigned to the user-advocated wrong answer relative to a clean-context counterfactual. Across seven instruction-tuned open-weight models and two factual benchmarks, ordinary reset often reduces but does not erase pressure-induced bias. History preserving repairs such as user retraction, system reset, and self-verification recover only 2-3/14 model-dataset pairs under the strict clean-restoration diagnostic, whereas operations that change the effective context are substantially more reliable; the two conditions that remove the pressure-bearing history entirely, fresh-context deletion and context truncation, recover 14/14. In an oracle trusted-evidence condition across fourteen model-dataset pairs, preserving the pressure-bearing history while adding benchmark-derived trusted evidence increases accuracy from 0.368 to 0.929, while wrong-answer following falls from 41.2% to 4.3%. Controls show that the effect is not explained by dialogue length, repeated confidence, plausible distractors, mere false-answer mention, or option-label inertia. These results suggest that faithful grounded dialogue requires evaluating which prior context should be treated as evidence and which should be removed or quarantined before answering.

AI.tldr: 研究多轮对话中用户压力导致的模型偏差能否在压力撤回后恢复，发现保留历史的修复不可靠，只有移除/截断压力上下文才有效恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有grounded语言模型评估通常只关注添加相关上下文，但多轮对话中用户不支持的错误主张可能污染后续事实性回答。作者想研究"压力后恢复性"：用户反复倡导错误答案后再撤回压力，模型能否回到干净上下文时的行为。
AI.method: 提出"压力后恢复"协议，用于多选题事实对话，并测量"谄媚滞后"（sycophancy hysteresis），即相对于干净上下文反事实，模型对用户倡导错误答案的残余概率。测试7个指令微调开源模型和2个事实基准，对比多种修复操作：用户撤回、系统重置、自我验证、全新技术删除和上下文截断等。
AI.result: 普通重置可减少但无法消除压力诱导偏差。保留历史的修复（撤回、系统重置、自我验证）在严格清洁恢复诊断下仅2-3/14模型-数据集对恢复；改变有效上下文的操作更可靠——完全移除压力历史的两种条件（全新上下文删除、上下文截断）达14/14恢复。在可信证据条件下（14对），加入基准派生的可信证据可将准确率从0.368升至0.929，错误跟随率从41.2%降至4.3%。对照实验排除了对话长度、重复自信、合理干扰项、单纯提及错误答案、选项标签惯性等解释。
AI.conclusion: 忠实的grounded对话需要评估哪些先前上下文应被视为证据、哪些应在回答前被移除或隔离。

title: SetOPD: From Few Visual Exemplars to Multimodal Candidate Sets for Remote-Sensing Open-Prompt Detection
summary: Open-prompt detectors allow users to specify targets with text, visual exemplars, or both. We argue that existing designs underuse the visual modality in two ways. First, multiple exemplars are commonly compressed into a single class-level embedding. This textualizes visual prompting: the resulting vector plays the role of another class name, is often aligned to or injected into the text pathway, and may be suboptimal when only a few heterogeneous exemplars are available. Second, existing methods interact primarily in prompt or representation space, before modality-specific detection states are formed. We address both issues from a set perspective: \setopd preserves modality-specific decoding states from a shared prompt-conditioned initialization and performs explicit multimodal collaboration at the candidate-state level. For the first issue, we introduce \br prompting, which reads every boxed exemplar in its full scene context and decomposes the pooled support evidence into a Base anchor and a learned Residual correction; the resulting prompt has fixed capacity regardless of the number of examples and drives its own visual detection pathway. For the second, we recast text--visual collaboration from representation-level fusion into a candidate-set modeling problem. Paired-Query Arbitration (\pqa) then performs explicit cross-modal state arbitration only after modality-specific candidate states have been formed. The two readers share query initialization so their candidates are paired by index; a learned gate arbitrates within each pair, followed by a permutation-equivariant module that reasons over the fused set.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有开放提示检测器对视觉模态利用不足，提出集合视角的SetOPD方法，通过BR提示和PQA仲裁实现模态特定的候选状态级多模态协作。
AI.motivation: 现有开放提示检测器在两方面低估了视觉模态：一是多个示例被压缩为单一类别级嵌入，导致视觉提示被"文本化"，在仅有少量异构示例时表现欠佳；二是现有方法主要在提示或表示空间交互，早于模态特定检测状态的形成。
AI.method: 提出SetOPD，从集合视角出发保留模态特定的解码状态并共享提示条件初始化。引入BR提示，在完整场景上下文中读取每个框选示例，将池化支持证据分解为Base锚点和学习的Residual修正，容量固定且驱动独立的视觉检测路径。同时将文本-视觉协作重构为候选集建模问题，提出成对查询仲裁(PQA)：两读者共享查询初始化使候选按索引配对，学习门控在配对内仲裁，随后用置换等变模块对融合集合进行推理。
AI.result: 本摘要为方法性描述，未提供具体实验数值结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过BR提示保持视觉提示的固定容量与独立通路，并通过PQA在候选状态级实现显式跨模态仲裁，SetOPD从集合角度改进了视觉模态的利用与多模态协作。

title: When Better Gets Worse: Improvement Fidelity for Self-Improving Agents in Adaptive Worlds
summary: Self-improving agents increasingly rely on proxy verifiers to choose policy updates, yet deployment can change the world in which those updates are evaluated. An update that looks better to the verifier can therefore become worse after deployment even when the verifier ranks policies well overall. We formalize this gap as Improvement Fidelity, which asks whether proxy improvements preserve the sign and ordering of deployment improvements over the updates an improvement process actually proposes. We show that global policy accuracy need not guarantee update fidelity: operator shift and deployment response can create update-level errors, while candidate margins determine whether those errors change the replacement decision. We introduce PIVOT-KG, a paired, decision-aware validator that allocates scarce high-fidelity evaluation according to the expected reduction in selection regret per unit cost. Across 90 held-out roots in Leduc, Kuhn, and Melting Pot, proxy and deployment optimal sets are disjoint in 51 cases. In an eight-candidate HighwayEnv stress test, PIVOT-KG reduces mean improvement-selection regret from 0.0435 under the exact Uniform validation rule to 0.0055 at the primary budget. Together, these results show why reliable self-improvement should evaluate proposed improvements in the worlds they induce, while providing a practical rule for allocating scarce deployment evidence when it can affect the replacement decision.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"改进保真度"(Improvement Fidelity)概念，指出代理验证器在部署后可能排名失效，并提出 PIVOT-KG 验证器按选择后悔期望分配稀缺高保真评估。
AI.motivation: 自我改进智能体依赖代理验证器选择策略更新，但部署会改变评估环境，使得"验证器看似更好"的更新在部署后反而更差，全局策略准确率无法保证更新层面的保真度。
AI.method: 形式化 Improvement Fidelity，分析算子偏移与部署响应造成的更新级错误及候选边际对替换决策的影响；提出 PIVOT-KG——一种配对、决策感知的验证器，按单位成本的选择后悔期望减少量来分配高保真评估预算。
AI.result: 在 Leduc、Kuhn 和 Melting Pot 的 90 个留出根上，代理与部署最优集在 51 个案例中不相交；在八候选 HighwayEnv 压力测试中，PIVOT-KG 将平均改进选择后悔从精确 Uniform 规则的 0.0435 降至主预算下的 0.0055。
AI.conclusion: 可靠自我改进应在更新所诱导的世界中评估候选改进，并提供在部署证据能影响替换决策时如何分配稀缺评估资源的实用规则。

title: When Do Agents Help? Embedding, LLM and Agentic Alignment of Classical Texts and Their Translations
comment: Preprint. This manuscript has not yet been peer reviewed
summary: Classical texts aligned with their translations support machine translation, retrieval and computational research, but evidence comparing alignment workflows is scattered. This study compares seven systems on 452 texts in Pali, Sanskrit, Mishnaic Hebrew and Tibetan, comprising 9,833 human-aligned units: four embedding pipelines, a direct LLM call, an autonomous agent, and the agent revised by an independent auditor. Generative workflows recover 93-94% of reference correspondences, against at most 77% for embeddings. A ceiling analysis shows that sentence boundaries make some references unrepresentable by the embedding pipelines. Reference recovery is similar across generative workflows: the agent's advantage is 0.5 percentage points (95% CI -0.02 to 1.17), and auditing adds no established benefit. Agents nevertheless produce structurally valid output for all 452 texts, against 437 for direct calls. A blinded three-LLM panel assesses every generative mismatch against the source and human reference. Most mismatches are labelled defensible editorial variation; consensus major-error labels cover only 0.06-0.14% of units. The panel labels significantly fewer residual defects for agents than direct calls (0.7% versus 1.4%), suggesting that reference recovery alone understates alignment quality. On ten long Pali discourses taken as published online, agents and audited agents raise recovery from the direct call's 71% to 84% and 92%. Identical reference-located chunks bring all three to 93%. Agents thus improve structural reliability and reduce judged defects on short passages, while their large recovery advantage on long documents disappears after chunking. In this setting, independent auditing offers little measurable additional benefit on prepared passages.

AI.tldr: 对比七种古典文本对齐流程：生成式方法恢复93-94%对应，嵌入法最多77%；Agent结构可靠性更高、缺陷更少，但在长文档上优势经分块后消失，独立审计无显著增益。
AI.motivation: 古典文本与其译文的对齐支撑机器翻译、检索与计算研究，但不同对齐流程的证据零散，缺乏系统比较。
AI.method: 在巴利语、梵语、密西拿希伯来语、藏语共452篇文本、9833个人工对齐单元上比较七种系统：四种嵌入流程、直接LLM调用、自主Agent、经独立审计者修订的Agent。用上限分析考察句子边界的影响，并由三LLM盲评小组对每个生成式错配进行评级。
AI.result: 生成式流程恢复93-94%参考对应，嵌入法最多77%；句子边界使部分参考对嵌入流程不可表示。生成式流程间恢复率相近（Agent优势0.5个百分点，95%CI -0.02~1.17），审计无确立收益。Agent对全部452篇输出结构有效（直接调用437篇）。盲评显示多数错配为可辩护的编辑差异，共识重大错误仅占0.06-0.14%；Agent残余缺陷显著少于直接调用（0.7% vs 1.4%）。在10篇在线长巴利语论述上，Agent与审计Agent将恢复率从直接调用的71%提升至84%和92%；相同参考分块后三者均达93%。
AI.conclusion: Agent提升结构可靠性、减少短片段判定缺陷；其长文档恢复优势在分块后消失；独立审计在预处理片段上几乎无可测增益。

title: DepthBench: Measuring How Residual Connections Enable More Computational Depth
summary: Depth is a natural way to increase the computational capacity in Transformers, yet the contribution of deeper layers can diminish as depth grows larger. Recent approaches enhance normalization (\text{e.g.}, LayerNorm Scaling) or residual connections (\text{e.g.}, mHC, AttnRes) to enable better information flow and depth utilization. However, it remains unclear whether they truly translate increased architectural depth into effective computational depth, and whether their reported gains stem from better access to information across depth, or unaccounted-for confounding factors. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{DepthBench}, a controlled benchmark for studying computational depth across various architectures. We systematically vary the width--depth aspect ratio ($d_{\text{model}}/n_{\text{layer}}$) from shallow--wide to deep--narrow shapes, while keeping the model size and pre-training recipe fixed. Across 10 representative architectures, we find that the benefit of allocating more capacity to depth is strongly architecture-dependent. Standard Pre-LN and most of its norm- and scaling-based variants provide little benefit and can even degrade performance as models become deeper and narrower, whereas HC and Full AttnRes improve consistently even at extreme deep shapes. These gains extend beyond pre-training loss and consistently translate into improved domain-specific performance and effective computation. Controlled layer-level analyses further show that the gains of HC and Full AttnRes are associated with more effective utilization of additional layers, revealing distinct mechanisms of computational depth across architectures. Overall, our results identify residual connection design as a key determinant of whether depth can serve as a meaningful scaling axis by enabling additional architectural depth to translate into effective computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DepthBench 控制基准，系统研究 Transformer 中"计算深度"是否真正有效，发现残差连接设计（如 HC、Full AttnRes）是深度能否成为有效扩展轴的关键，而标准 Pre-LN 及其多数变体收益有限甚至退化。
AI.motivation: 深度是提升 Transformer 容量的自然方式，但深层贡献随深度增加而递减。近期方法通过改进归一化与残差连接促进信息流动，但仍不清楚这些收益是否真正转化为"有效计算深度"，还是源于混杂因素。
AI.method: 提出 DepthBench 控制基准，固定模型规模与预训练配方，系统改变宽度-深度比（d_model/n_layer），从浅宽到深窄形状，对比 10 种代表性架构，并进行受控的层级分析。
AI.result: 深度收益强烈依赖架构：标准 Pre-LN 及多数归一化/缩放变体在更深更窄时收益甚微甚至退化；HC 与 Full AttnRes 即使在极端深形状下仍持续改善，且增益超越预训练损失，转化为领域性能和有效计算的提升。
AI.conclusion: 残差连接设计是决定深度能否作为有意义扩展轴的关键因素，它使额外的架构深度能转化为有效计算；HC 与 Full AttnRes 通过更有效利用额外层体现不同机制。

title: PINNMorph: Evolving Online Adaptation Policies for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) provide a learning-based framework for solving partial differential equations (PDEs), yet their training behavior can change substantially throughout optimization. Residual distributions, gradient interactions, regional learning difficulty, and model-capacity requirements may evolve over time, while the network architecture and major training mechanisms are typically determined before training. We propose PINNMorph, an online PINN adaptation framework based on large language model (LLM)-guided policy evolution. PINNMorph maintains a population of state-conditioned adaptation policies that map execution diagnostics to controlled interventions over topology modification, additive representation augmentation, objective balancing, gradient handling, adaptive sampling, and optimizer-phase control. At each intervention opportunity, candidate programs are instantiated from the current policy population, selected according to the observed training state, and applied directly to the PINN under training. The resulting model inherits its existing parameters and training state and continues optimization along the same trajectory. Execution outcomes are subsequently used to evaluate interventions and evolve the policy population. Unlike pre-training architecture search or fixed adaptation rules, PINNMorph jointly adapts the current PINN and the policies governing its interventions using feedback from actual training. Experiments on 13 PDE benchmarks show that PINNMorph achieves lower solution errors than SA-PINN, ConFIG, RoPINN, HARMONIC, and PINNsAgent across all evaluated problems. Ablation studies further examine the effects of online adaptation, state-conditioned intervention selection, and execution-feedback-driven policy evolution.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PINNMorph，一种基于LLM引导策略进化的在线PINN自适应框架，在训练过程中动态调整网络结构和训练机制，在13个PDE基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: PINN的训练行为在优化过程中会显著变化（残差分布、梯度交互、区域学习难度、模型容量需求等随时间演化），但网络架构和主要训练机制通常在训练前就已固定，缺乏在线适应性。
AI.method: PINNMorph维护一个状态条件化的自适应策略种群，将执行诊断映射到受控干预（拓扑修改、加性表示增强、目标平衡、梯度处理、自适应采样、优化器阶段控制）。在每个干预时机，从当前策略种群实例化候选程序，根据训练状态选择并直接应用于训练中的PINN，模型继承已有参数和训练状态沿同一轨迹继续优化，执行结果用于评估干预并进化策略种群。
AI.result: 在13个PDE基准上，PINNMorph的解误差低于SA-PINN、ConFIG、RoPINN、HARMONIC和PINNsAgent。消融实验验证了在线自适应、状态条件化干预选择和执行反馈驱动策略进化的作用。
AI.conclusion: 不同于预训练架构搜索或固定自适应规则，PINNMorph联合自适应当前PINN及其干预策略，利用真实训练反馈进行在线演化，显著提升求解精度。

title: Understanding Confabulation and Rethinking Reconstruction in Activation Explanations
summary: Natural Language Autoencoders (NLAs) produce unsupervised text explanations of a model's activations: a verbalizer describes an activation and a reconstructor learns to recover it from this text. Under the established point-reconstruction NLA training recipe, explanations become more useful for predicting model behavior while also increasingly introducing unsupported details and exhibiting writing defects. To assess these changes separately, we introduce a standardized evaluation framework for unstructured NLA explanations, measuring information recoverable from explanations, contextual support for their claims, and writing quality. To address confabulation and writing defects, we move beyond predicting a single activation: explanations can distinguish distributions of possible activations even when their means and optimal point-reconstruction rewards are identical. We introduce Flow-NLA, which models the distribution of activations compatible with an explanation and trains the verbalizer using a diffusion likelihood bound. Across Qwen, Gemma, and Apertus, this richer signal retains the utility gains of point reconstruction while curbing the growth of confabulation and writing defects, opening up a direction for improving activation-derived training to encourage more informative, supported, and readable explanations. Code and evaluation prompts will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出评估框架与Flow-NLA方法，用分布级重建信号替代单点重建，减少自然语言自编码器解释中的虚构与写作缺陷。
AI.motivation: NLA用文本解释模型激活，但点重建训练会让解释在提升行为预测能力的同时，引入无支撑细节和写作缺陷，且这些变化缺乏分离评估。
AI.method: 引入标准化评估框架，从可恢复信息、主张的上下文支撑、写作质量三方面评估；提出Flow-NLA，对与解释兼容的激活分布建模，并用扩散似然界训练verbalizer。
AI.result: 在Qwen、Gemma和Apertus上，Flow-NLA保留点重建的效用增益，同时抑制虚构和写作缺陷的增长。
AI.conclusion: 分布级训练信号可提升激活解释的信息量、支撑性与可读性，为改进激活驱动训练提供新方向。

title: RIPE-MambaSpike: Resolution-Independent Spiking-State-Space Interfaces for Parameter-Efficient Event-Based Vision
summary: Spiking-Mamba hybrids reach strong accuracy on event-based vision, but existing designs often require tens of millions of parameters. Much of that cost comes from how the spiking front-end is connected to the state-space backbone rather than from the hybrid architecture itself. In a representative model, a single resolution-dependent projection accounts for 33.55M of 36.25M parameters. To that end, we introduce RIPE-MambaSpike (Resolution-Independent, Parameter-Efficient), which replaces that projection with a hierarchical multi-resolution bridge of fixed channel width. Its deployed footprint is 0.870M parameters, constant at fixed time steps and widths across a 43x range of input areas. Reparameterized spiking stages, temporal decoupled modulation, and a dynamic convex-hull-bounded dual-stream membrane-potential attention preserve accuracy under this compact design. Result-wise, RIPE-MambaSpike is pareto-optimal on CIFAR10-DVS, N-Caltech101, and DailyDVS-200. Notably, on the 200-class DailyDVS-200, a scaled 8.04M configuration achieves 45.7% top-1 accuracy, the best reported spiking result on that benchmark, and outperforms prior spiking methods with 3.0-15.1x fewer parameters than dense ANNs. Overall, our findings demonstrate that competitive event-based recognition does not require resolution-dependent parameter growth. Code is available at https://github.com/MuhiminOsim/RIPE-MambaSpike.

AI.tldr: RIPE-MambaSpike通过用固定通道宽度的层次多分辨率桥替换分辨率相关的投影层，将脉冲-Mamba混合模型参数量从36.25M降至0.870M，并在多个事件视觉基准上取得Pareto最优结果。
AI.motivation: 现有脉冲-Mamba混合模型虽精度高，但参数动辄数千万。分析表明，主要开销来自脉冲前端与状态空间主干之间的连接方式（单个分辨率相关投影层占了33.55M/36.25M参数），而非混合架构本身。作者希望证明竞争性的事件识别不需要分辨率相关的参数增长。
AI.method: 提出RIPE-MambaSpike，用固定通道宽度的层次多分辨率桥取代分辨率相关投影；并引入重参数化脉冲阶段、时间解耦调制、动态凸包约束的双流膜电位注意力，在紧凑设计下保持精度。
AI.result: 部署参数量0.870M，在43倍输入面积范围内保持恒定。在CIFAR10-DVS、N-Caltech101、DailyDVS-200上Pareto最优；在200类DailyDVS-200上，8.04M配置达45.7% top-1，为该基准最佳脉冲结果，且以比密集ANN少3.0-15.1倍的参数超越先前脉冲方法。
AI.conclusion: 竞争性的事件视觉识别不依赖分辨率相关的参数增长，紧凑的脉冲-Mamba混合设计即可实现高效且高精度的性能。

title: Dude, Where's My State? Execution Information Requirements for Stateful Agents
comment: 35 pages, 12 figures, 15 tables. Supplementary material included
summary: Long-running agents must preserve information that later steps depend on. We introduce the Execution Information Requirement (EIR), a lower bound on the information that must remain accessible for correct completion under specified task and access conditions. We develop LACUNA, a framework that generates tasks with known dependencies and varies information demand, retention, and recovery separately from the difficulty of individual operations. Across four models, restoring a missing result raises accuracy on affected recall steps to 100%, compared with 0% for equal-length irrelevant information. Sufficient storage alone does not ensure success: retention policies can discard required results, errors can propagate through later computations, and agents can stop before recovery is complete. We also introduce VESTIGE, which uses agent execution traces to construct semantic graphs and measure information demand for real tasks. Across 72,562 software-agent trajectories, VESTIGE reveals a steeper distance-related decline in solution-relevant rereading for failed runs (RR 0.951 per distance doubling), while adjusted peak demand alone is not associated with failure. Together, these contributions support evaluating whether agents preserve and recover the information their tasks require.

AI.tldr: 论文提出执行信息需求(EIR)概念与LACUNA、VESTIGE框架，评估长时程智能体能否保留并恢复任务所需信息。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体必须保留后续步骤依赖的信息，但现有评估未区分信息需求、保留与恢复同单个操作难度的关系。
AI.method: 提出EIR作为信息下限；设计LACUNA生成已知依赖任务，独立变化信息需求、保留与恢复；提出VESTIGE用执行轨迹构建语义图，测量真实任务的信息需求。
AI.result: 四模型中恢复缺失结果使受影响召回步骤准确率达100%（无关信息仅0%）；充足存储不足以保证成功。72,562条软件智能体轨迹显示失败运行中与距离相关的重读下降更陡（RR 0.951/距离倍增），调整后峰值需求单独与失败无关。
AI.conclusion: 两项贡献支持评估智能体是否保留并恢复任务所需信息。

title: From Granular Revision Operations to Meaningful Revision Units: Evaluating LLMs for Revision Boundary Detection
summary: Revision traces provide valuable evidence about students' writing processes, but their usefulness for learning analytics depends on how individual revisions are represented. Automated draft-comparison methods often produce granular edit operations that can fragment a single purposeful revision into multiple analytic units. This study evaluates whether LLMs can identify meaningful revision unit boundaries in structured revision operation data and whether they provide value beyond simple non-LLM baselines. Using 113 matched draft--revision pairs from undergraduate writing, expert annotation yielded 4,344 candidate boundaries. We compared zero- and few-shot GPT-5.5 and base Qwen3-32B, parameter-efficient fine-tuning of Qwen3-32B, and majority and proximity-based baselines. Despite receiving revision context and task instructions, no prompted LLM condition outperformed the proximity heuristic (macro-F1 = .825). In contrast, fine-tuned Qwen3-32B using the two context representation achieved the highest macro-F1 (.859), identifying more same-unit relationships while maintaining precision comparable to the heuristic. Deterministic post-processing substantially improved the prompted models but added little benefit to the strongest fine-tuned model. These findings suggest that LLMs can support revision boundary judgment when task-adapted, but general purpose prompting alone may not outperform transparent structural heuristics.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估LLM能否在结构化修订数据中识别有意义的修订单元边界，发现微调Qwen3-32B优于提示式LLM和启发式基线，而单纯提示不如简单邻近启发式。
AI.motivation: 修订轨迹对写作过程分析有价值，但自动草稿比对产生的细粒度编辑操作会把单一目的性修订拆分成多个分析单元，需要界定有意义的修订单元边界。
AI.method: 使用113对本科生写作草稿-修订配对，专家标注出4,344个候选边界。对比零样本/少样本GPT-5.5和基础Qwen3-32B、Qwen3-32B参数高效微调，以及多数投票和邻近启发式基线。
AI.result: 提示式LLM均未超过邻近启发式（macro-F1=.825）；微调Qwen3-32B（两种上下文表示）取得最高macro-F1（.859），识别更多同单元关系且精度与启发式相当。确定性后处理显著提升提示模型，但对最强微调模型增益有限。
AI.conclusion: 经任务适配的LLM可支持修订边界判断，但通用提示本身未必优于透明的结构启发式。

title: In-Flight KV Cache with Clean Anchors for Faster Autoregressive Video Diffusion
summary: Few-step autoregressive video diffusion generates a long video by splitting the video into temporal chunks and generating chunk-by-chunk, each through a short sequence of denoising stages. To memorize chunks that are already generated, previous methods reconstruct a clean or less-noisy key--value (KV) cache by additional forwards to build the cache without advancing an output latent. However, every denoising forward itself already computes the in-flight KV of the current chunk. We introduce FlashForward, which directly reuses this cache to avoid the heavy cache-update-only model forwards. After the current chunk completes one denoising stage, its stage-specific cache is already available for the next chunk. Assigning one GPU to each stage therefore lets different chunks occupy different stages concurrently. This early availability has a quality cost: the resulting stage-matched history is noisy, causing appearance and motion drift among chunks. To complement it, FlashForward produces sparse auxiliary clean anchor latents before the corresponding region is generated so the generation trajectories can be stabilized by this two-sided conditioning. The two memories operate at different temporal scales: sparse clean anchor KV supplies coarse, long-range two-sided structural guidance, while dense stage-matched history preserves fine, recent evolution. With up to four GPUs, FlashForward runs $1.16$--$1.69\times$ faster than HiAR and $1.42$--$2.92\times$ faster than Self-Forcing for 16 FPS videos of 20 seconds or longer across 1.3B and 14B backbone scales at 480p and 720p. On VBench, for the 1.3B model at 480p, it achieves higher scores and remains stable at longer durations, demonstrating that FlashForward generates high-quality and temporally consistent videos across durations of 20s, 35s and 65s at a much faster generation speed.

AI.tldr: FlashForward 通过复用去噪过程中已计算的 KV 缓存，避免额外的缓存更新前向，并提出稀疏干净锚点 KV 与稠密阶段匹配历史的两侧条件机制，实现高速、长时长、时序一致的自回归视频生成。
AI.motivation: 少步自回归视频扩散逐块生成视频：将视频切成时间块，每块通过短序列去噪生成。已有方法为记忆已生成块，需额外前向重建干净或低噪 KV 缓存而不推进输出潜变量，带来大量仅用于更新缓存的计算开销。作者发现每次去噪前向本身就计算了当前块的 KV，可被直接复用，从而消除这一开销。
AI.method: FlashForward 直接复用当前块去噪阶段计算得到的阶段专属 KV 缓存：当前块完成一个去噪阶段后，其缓存即可供下一块使用；每个阶段分配一个 GPU，使不同块可并发处于不同阶段。但这种早期可用性带来质量代价——阶段匹配的历史带噪，导致块间外观与运动漂移。为此方法在对应区域生成前先生成稀疏的辅助干净锚点潜变量，用两侧条件稳定生成轨迹。两种记忆在不同时间尺度上工作：稀疏干净锚点 KV 提供粗粒度、长程的两侧结构引导，稠密阶段匹配历史保留精细的近期演化。
AI.result: 在最多 4 个 GPU 上，对 16 FPS、20 秒及以上、1.3B 与 14B 骨干、480p 与 720p 的视频，FlashForward 比 HiAR 快 1.16–1.69×，比 Self-Forcing 快 1.42–2.92×。在 VBench 上，1.3B 模型 480p 取得更高分数，且在更长时长下保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: FlashForward 表明在 20s、35s、65s 等时长下均能生成高质量、时序一致且生成速度显著更快的视频，验证了复用阶段匹配 KV 缓存加稀疏干净锚点两侧条件的有效性。

title: World Agent: Can Language Models Keep a World Running?
summary: World models are moving from generating realistic frames to generating playable worlds, yet whether a delivered world can keep running is not tested anywhere. Existing evaluations stop at generation, at delivery, or at single-step transitions, and each stops at a different point along the way. Correct local state transitions or intermediate outcomes do not guarantee a correctly organized causal event flow. We propose the world agent task, which moves the evaluation point of world generation from the moment of delivery to the continued operation that follows. In this task, a model is not asked to generate a world. It is held responsible for keeping the world running, which requires coordinating events and carrying forward their consequences to constrain subsequent evolution. We instantiate the task in WorldAgent-Benchmark with two complementary tracks. In the maintenance track, the model must ground the events of a continuous narrative into correct transitions of the explicit world state while respecting causal, temporal, and concurrency constraints. In the deduction track, the model must predict how the world will evolve under partial observations and act toward a goal. The maintenance track combines LLM-assisted semantic judgments with programmatic validation and scoring, while the deduction track is evaluated entirely programmatically. Individual judgments are auditable against world states and execution logs, and scores can be recomputed from the saved judgments and execution records. Across 8 models, scores decline steadily as pre-built structure is removed from the world, and causal-relation checking is the weakest component for every model. The benchmark makes the continued operation of a world measurable and distinguishes local completion from failures in event organization. Code and dataset will be released on https://github.com/HCPLab-SYSU/WorldAgent-Benchmark.

AI.tldr: 提出WorldAgent任务与基准，将世界模型评测从"生成/交付/单步转移"转向"持续运行"，衡量事件协调与因果后果传递能力。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型评测止于生成、交付或单步转移，而局部状态转移正确不等于因果事件流组织正确，缺乏对世界能否持续运行的检验。
AI.method: 设计WorldAgent任务，模型负责维持世界运行、协调事件并传递后果。构建WorldAgent-Benchmark两个赛道：维护赛道（将连续叙事事件落地为显式世界状态的正确转移，满足因果、时序、并发约束，结合LLM语义判断与程序化验证评分）；推演赛道（部分观测下预测世界演化并向目标行动，全程序化评估）。判断可审计，分数可复算。
AI.result: 在8个模型上，随着预置结构被移除，分数持续下降；因果关检查是所有模型最薄弱的环节。
AI.conclusion: 该基准使"世界持续运行"可度量，并区分局部完成与事件组织层面的失败。

title: Shared Experience, Separate Learning: Companion Confidence Calibration for LLMs
summary: Reliable self-assessment is essential for large language models (LLMs), yet they often remain highly confident when their answers are wrong. We study \emph{concurrent confidence calibration}, where confidence is learned alongside capability improvement rather than calibrated only after training. Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides a natural setting for this paradigm, as it continuously produces responses paired with verifiable correctness feedback. Existing concurrent methods, however, learn both capability and confidence through reinforcement learning within shared policy parameters, potentially coupling two fundamentally different learning problems. We instead propose \emph{shared experience but separate learning}: capability and confidence learn from the same trajectories, but through separate optimization mechanisms and parameters. Based on this principle, we introduce \textbf{CoCal (Companion Confidence Calibration)}, which trains a lightweight companion from rollout hidden states and verifier-derived correctness supervision while leaving task optimization unchanged. Experiments on Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-14B show that CoCal improves confidence estimation without sacrificing task performance, outperforming both RL-based concurrent methods and matched post-hoc calibration. The learned companion further generalizes across domains and policy shifts, while the benefits of CoCal persist at both scales.

AI.tldr: 提出CoCal方法，通过"共享经验但独立学习"原则，在RLVR过程中用轻量companion模块从rollout隐藏状态学习置信度校准，不牺牲任务性能。
AI.motivation: LLM在答错时仍过度自信，需要可靠自评估。现有并发校准方法在同一策略参数内同时学习能力与置信度，可能耦合两个本质不同的学习问题。
AI.method: 基于"共享经验但独立学习"原则：能力与置信度从相同轨迹学习，但采用独立优化机制和参数。CoCal训练一个轻量companion，从rollout隐状态和验证器衍生的正确性监督中学习，任务优化保持不变。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-14B上，CoCal在不损失任务性能的前提下提升置信度估计，优于基于RL的并发方法和匹配的事后校准，且可跨域和策略漂移泛化。
AI.conclusion: CoCal证明将能力与置信度解耦学习是有效的并发校准范式，在多个规模上均获益，并能泛化到不同领域与策略变化。

title: Harnessing Coupled Stream Completion For Human-Object Ineraction Modeling
summary: Text-conditioned human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires body motion, object trajectories & rotations, and hand articulation to remain coordinated. These components differ in scale and dynamics, but must agree on contact, relative pose, and timing. A shared representation may limit the distinct structure of each stream, while independent generation prevents each stream from responding to changes in the others. Latent supervision alone also does not directly constrain contact after decoding. We propose TRACE, a continuous latent framework that keeps stream states separate and couples their updates. TRACE encodes body, object, and hand motion into separate latents and predicts each stream velocity from the complete current interaction state. Geometric losses on decoded motion further constrain contact and object-relative motion over time. The same model supports completion of any single absent stream from the other two. Frozen flow features also serve as input to a language model for HOI understanding. Experiments on InterAct, OMOMO, and BEHAVE show that joint completion training improves generation and that frozen flow features improve understanding over raw-motion encoding. On InterAct, TRACE achieves the highest contact precision, recall, and F1 among the compared methods.

AI.tldr: TRACE是一个连续潜在框架，通过分离身体、物体、手部的潜在状态并耦合其更新，实现文本条件的人-物交互生成与理解。
AI.motivation: 文本条件HOI生成需协调身体运动、物体轨迹旋转和手部关节，三者尺度与动力学不同但需在接触、相对位姿和时序上一致。共享表示会限制各流结构，独立生成又无法相互响应，且纯潜在监督无法直接约束解码后的接触。
AI.method: 将身体、物体、手部运动编码为独立潜在，并从完整交互状态预测各流速度以耦合更新；对解码运动施加几何损失约束接触与物体相对运动；同一模型支持由另两个流补全缺失流；冻结的流特征输入语言模型做HOI理解。
AI.result: 在InterAct、OMOMO、BEHAVE上，联合补全训练提升生成，冻结流特征优于原始运动编码用于理解；在InterAct上接触精确率、召回率和F1均最高。
AI.conclusion: TRACE通过分离且耦合的潜在表示与几何约束，有效提升HOI生成与理解，验证了联合补全训练的价值。

title: IGSD: Environment-Verified Hindsight Self-Distillation for Search Agents
summary: On-policy self-distillation densifies agent training without external teachers: a policy conditioned on privileged hindsight provides step-level guidance for its own unprivileged rollouts. For search agents, however, hindsight can make the teacher prefer a query that does not improve retrieval from the student's state. Existing methods either distill this preference directly or filter it with model-internal scores, but neither strategy verifies the query's executed retrieval consequence. We propose Information-Gain-Gated Self-Distillation (IGSD), which verifies on-policy token proposals with environment feedback before distilling them. Treating each query token as a micro-action, IGSD completes the teacher's token proposal and the student's sampled token into matched queries and executes both from the same failed state with the same retriever. Shared counterfactual controls account for query-conditioned shifts in answer likelihood, so their difference, the executed paired information gain, provides a relative utility contrast for the retrieved documents. IGSD uses this contrast as a positive-only soft weight for candidate-pair distillation, while leaving the GRPO objective unchanged and confining verification to training. Across seven single-hop and multi-hop QA benchmarks, IGSD reaches macro-average exact-match accuracies of 42.8% and 47.0% with 3B and 7B policies, respectively, without inference-time verification. These results support environment-verified hindsight as an effective approach to reliable action-level supervision for search agents.

AI.tldr: IGSD用环境反馈验证查询token的检索信息增益，作为自蒸馏权重，提升搜索智能体训练效果。
AI.motivation: on-policy自蒸馏中，hindsight教师可能偏好不改善检索的查询，现有方法直接蒸馏或用模型内部打分过滤，都未验证查询实际执行的检索后果。
AI.method: 将每个查询token视为微动作，把教师提议token与学生采样token补全为配对查询，在同一失败状态、同一检索器下执行；用共享反事实控制消除答案似然偏移，以配对信息增益之差作为正软权重用于候选对蒸馏，保持GRPO目标不变，验证仅在训练时进行。
AI.result: 在7个单跳和多跳QA基准上，3B和7B策略分别达到42.8%和47.0%的宏平均精确匹配准确率，且推理时无验证。
AI.conclusion: 环境验证的hindsight是搜索智能体可靠动作级监督的有效方法。

title: Yorùbá in Unicode: An Overview of a Problem
comment: To appear in Yorùbá Print Culture: A Handbook, Routledge
summary: There is a recurrent problem in the writing of Yorùbá on the internet and on the computer that has proven intractable over the years. The language, along with other African languages that depend on diacritics for disambiguation, requires a small set of precomposed characters that Unicode does not encode. This has forced writers and digital systems to rely on combining character sequences that behave inconsistently across platforms, corrupt under font substitution, and fail in search. This paper documents that failure across a range of real world contexts, from published books to web platforms to mobile keyboards, using personal and empirical evidence. It identifies Unicode's NFC normalization stability policy as the structural constraint that prevents a straightforward fix, arguing for direct intervention of the Consortium in solving the active problem, proposing a formal encoding request for the four core Yorùbá characters as the most durable path to resolution.

AI.tldr: 本文记录了约鲁巴语（Yorùbá）在网络与计算机书写中因缺少预组合字符而导致的长期技术困境，指出 Unicode 的 NFC 规范化稳定性政策是根本约束，并提议正式申请编码四个核心约鲁巴字符。
AI.motivation: 约鲁巴语及其他依赖变音符号消歧的非洲语言需要一小组 Unicode 未编码的预组合字符，导致书写者与数字系统只能依赖跨平台表现不一致、字体替换时损坏、搜索失效的组合字符序列。
AI.method: 作者结合个人经验与实证证据，在多种真实场景（从已出版书籍到网络平台再到手机键盘）中记录这一失败现象，并识别出 Unicode 的 NFC 规范化稳定性政策为阻止直接修复的结构性约束。
AI.result: 该失败在广泛真实语境中被系统性地记录与证实，表明问题根植于 Unicode 现行规范政策，无法通过简单修补解决。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张 Unicode 联盟应直接介入解决这一现实问题，并提出就四个核心约鲁巴字符提交正式编码申请，作为最持久的解决方案。

title: Feature Space Guidance for Breast Cancer Classification in DCE-MRI
summary: Dynamic contrast enhanced breast MRI (DCE-MRI) is a powerful clinical tool for breast cancer detection, providing high resolution anatomical detail together with rich temporal contrast information. However, high dimensional 4D inputs, small lesions, and heterogeneous acquisition protocols across clinical sites hinder robust automated classification of healthy, benign, and malignant cases. To address these challenges, we propose a framework that dynamically analyzes latent representations to adapt to protocol-specific characteristics. Spatial variability is mitigated by reducing confounding background uptake and compensating for misalignment caused by deformable soft tissue. Additionally, relationships in the latent space across phases are leveraged to select the most informative temporal features, improving robustness to protocol-specific temporal variability. Finally, task specific discriminative features are promoted through large scale supervised lesion segmentation pretraining, which substantially enhances downstream finetuning. Evaluated under leave-one-center-out validation on the ODELIA dataset and the held-out AMBL cohort, the proposed framework substantially outperforms finetuned radiology foundation models and prior methods, improving mean AUROC by nearly 8 points and balanced accuracy by 4 points over the strongest baseline. Additionally, our method achieved first place in the MICCAI ODELIA Breast MRI Challenge 2025, further demonstrating its effectiveness for robust breast cancer classification. We publicly release our codebase under https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/CURIAtor.

AI.tldr: 提出动态分析潜在表征的DCE-MRI乳腺癌分类框架，缓解4D输入、小病灶及协议异质性带来的挑战，在ODELIA和AMBL数据集上显著超越基线并获MICCAI 2025挑战赛第一。
AI.motivation: DCE-MRI是乳腺癌检测的有力工具，但高维4D输入、小病灶以及跨临床站点采集协议的异质性，阻碍了对健康、良性、恶性病例的稳健自动分类。
AI.method: 框架动态分析潜在表征以适应特定协议：通过减少混杂背景摄取并补偿软组织形变造成的错位来缓解空间变异；利用各时相潜在空间关系选择最有信息量的时间特征以提升时间鲁棒性；通过大规模监督病灶分割预训练促进任务相关的判别特征。
AI.result: 在ODELIA和AMBL队列的留一中心验证中，平均AUROC较最强基线提升近8点，平衡准确率提升4点，超越微调的放射学基础模型及先前方法；获MICCAI ODELIA Breast MRI Challenge 2025第一名。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能有效实现稳健的乳腺癌分类，代码已开源（https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/CURIAtor）。

title: Flat-Consensus Diffusion for Robust Data Reshaping under Noisy Evaluator
summary: Data shape determines how features are structured, how patterns are separated, and how distributions cover the underlying domain. Poor data shape can make models learn noise rather than generalizable structure. This paper studies robust feature-centric data reshaping: generating feature transformations that remain useful, stable, and reproducible under noisy evaluation and imperfect data conditions. We view reshaping operation sequence search as reward-guided diffusion generation, and robust reshaping as searching for regions in the latent reward landscape rather than isolated high-reward transformations. The key challenge is dual instability: noisy evaluators distort local reward guidance, while stochastic generative trajectories can converge to inconsistent solutions. We propose FCDiff, a flat-consensus diffusion framework that addresses both failures through a micro-macro decomposition. The micro layer replaces point-estimate reward guidance with Gaussian-smoothed, Monte Carlo averaged gradients, steering generation toward locally flat reward regions. The macro layer aggregates independently guided trajectories with a weighted Frechet-mean barycenter, selecting consensus-supported basins and filtering stochastic outliers. Across an 8-dataset headline cohort under heavy-tailed evaluator noise, FCDiff attains the best aggregate rank on lower-tail reliability and robustness against both search-based AutoFE and robustness-oriented generative baselines, with statistically significant accuracy gains over every generative baseline. Our results show that robust data reshaping requires searching for flat, consensus-supported regions rather than sharp single-trajectory optima.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FCDiff，一个扁平均识扩散框架，用于在噪声评估和不完美数据下进行鲁棒的特征中心数据重塑（自动特征工程）。
AI.motivation: 数据形状决定特征的 structuring 和模式分离效果，糟糕的数据形状会让模型学到噪声而非可泛化结构。现有重塑方法在噪声评估器与随机生成轨迹的双重不稳定下难以获得稳定、可复现的特征变换。
AI.method: 将重塑操作序列搜索视为奖励引导的扩散生成，把鲁棒重塑转化为在潜在奖励景观中搜索区域。采用 micro-macro 分解：micro层用高斯平滑、蒙特卡洛平均梯度替代点估计奖励引导，指向局部平坦奖励区域；macro层用加权 Fréchet 均值重心聚合独立引导轨迹，选择共识支撑的盆地并过滤随机离群。
AI.result: 在8个数据集的头条队列、重尾评估器噪声下，FCDiff在低尾可靠性和鲁棒性上取得最佳综合排名，优于搜索式AutoFE和鲁棒导向生成基线，且对所有生成基线有统计显著准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒数据重塑需要搜索平坦、共识支撑的区域，而非尖锐的单轨迹最优点。

title: The Effects of Incremental Instruction Delivery on Language-Model Creative Writing
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 13 tables. Code and data available at https://github.com/solusops/SISTER-2026-Team19
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as interactive writing tools, where users develop stories, revise ideas, and introduce new requirements across multiple turns rather than specifying a complete brief upfront. Yet most evidence on multi-turn instruction degradation comes from tasks with objectively verifiable outcomes, leaving unclear whether incremental interaction harms creative artifacts in ways that explicit requirement checks cannot capture. We study this question using 160 human-authored creative-writing tasks across six genres, presenting each intended specification either upfront or progressively over 5-9 turns to six distinct open-weight model families, yielding 960 matched pairs. Progressive delivery reduces explicit constraint adherence and produces its largest writing-quality degradation in structure/coherence. The structural gap persists among outputs with equal observed adherence, suggesting that measured requirement loss alone does not explain the observed structural difference. We define Creative Integrity as a compact measure of joint adherence and narrative structure; under incremental delivery, models retain 71.2% of FULL Creative Integrity (95% CI [68.2%, 74.3%]). A three-rater human study over 50 matched pairs independently recovers FULL advantages in structure/coherence, craft, and genre effectiveness, while automated scores remain positively associated with aggregated human ratings. These findings show that interactive creative-writing systems should be evaluated not only on whether requirements survive conversation, but also on whether evolving requirements remain coherently integrated into the final artifact. Our dataset, benchmarks, and source code are available at: https://github.com/solusops/SISTER-2026-Team19

AI.tldr: 研究多轮渐进式交互是否损害创意写作质量。用160个创意写作任务、6种文体、6个模型家族、960对匹配样本比较"一次性给出需求"与"分5-9轮给出需求"。发现渐进交付降低显式约束遵守度，并在结构/连贯性上造成最大质量下降；即使遵守度相同，结构差距仍存在，说明仅看需求遵守无法解释。提出Creative Integrity联合度量，渐进条件下仅保留71.2%；人类评审验证结构/连贯性、技艺、文体效果优势，且自动分数与人类评分正相关。
AI.motivation: 大模型日益作为交互式写作工具，用户是多轮渐进地提出与修改需求，而非一次给全。但多轮指令退化证据多来自可客观验证的任务，尚不清楚渐进交互是否以"显式需求检查"无法捕捉的方式损害创意产出。
AI.method: 构建160个人类撰写的创意写作任务，覆盖6种文体；对6个开源模型家族分别以"一次性 upfront"或"分5-9轮 progressive"方式给出同一需求，得到960对匹配样本。测量显式约束遵守度、写作质量（含结构/连贯性）、并提出Creative Integrity（遵守度与叙事结构的联合度量）。另做3名评审对50对样本的人类研究，并检验自动分数与人类评分的一致性。
AI.result: 渐进交付降低显式约束遵守度，并在结构/连贯性上产生最大的写作质量退化；结构差距在遵守度相同的输出中依然存在，表明需求损失无法单独解释结构差异。渐进交付下Creative Integrity仅保留71.2%（95% CI [68.2%, 74.3%]）。人类评审独立复现FULL在结构/连贯性、技艺、文体效果上的优势，自动分数与汇总人类评分正相关。
AI.conclusion: 交互式创意写作系统的评估不仅应关注需求是否在对话中"存活"，还应关注演进中的需求是否被连贯地整合进最终作品。数据、基准与代码已公开。

title: CFCH: Coarse-Fine Collaborative Hierarchical Learning for Anterior Segment Disease Analysis
summary: Accurate classification of anterior segment diseases is crucial for ophthalmic screening and diagnosis. However, slit-lamp image analysis remains challenging due to substantial variability in imaging conditions and the intrinsic anatomical-disease hierarchy of ocular pathologies. Existing methods typically formulate this task as a flat multi-class classification problem, ignoring the structured dependency between anatomical regions (e.g., cornea, conjunctiva, and lens) and disease manifestations.To address these limitations, we propose CFCH, a Coarse-Fine Collaborative Hierarchical learning framework that explicitly models anatomical context and disease semantics through a dual-branch architecture. To enable effective cross-granularity collaboration, CFCH introduces semantic and cross-granularity attention consistency constraints, encouraging aligned yet complementary feature learning across branches. In addition, we construct AS-9K, a large-scale anterior segment dataset with 8975 images covering 12 common disease categories. To the best of our knowledge, AS-9K is the largest publicly available dataset for anterior segment image classification. Extensive experiments on two anterior segment datasets demonstrate that CFCH outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Qualitative visualizations further show more focused and lesion-relevant activation responses, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework. Code will be available at https://github.com/ybupengwang/CFCH.

AI.tldr: 提出CFCH粗细协同层次学习框架及AS-9K大规模前节数据集，用于裂隙灯图像分类。
AI.motivation: 裂隙灯图像分析因成像条件多变和解剖-疾病固有层次结构而困难；现有方法将其视为扁平多分类，忽略了解剖区域（角膜、结膜、晶状体）与疾病表现间的结构化依赖。
AI.method: CFCH采用双分支架构显式建模解剖上下文与疾病语义，引入语义注意力一致性和跨粒度注意力一致性约束，促使两分支学习对齐且互补的特征；并构建AS-9K数据集（8975张图像，12类疾病）。
AI.result: 在两个前节数据集上CFCH优于现有最先进方法；定性可视化显示更聚焦、更与病灶相关的激活响应。
AI.conclusion: CFCH通过粗细协同层次学习有效提升前节疾病分类性能，AS-9K为目前最大公开前节图像分类数据集，代码将开源。

title: CAIRN: Dynamic Fact-Intent DAGs for Multi-Agent Exploration
summary: LLM-powered autonomous systems have demonstrated promising capabilities in mathematical reasoning, engineering, and cybersecurity. Yet how to organize these systems for effective, reliable, and sustained performance remains an open question. In this paper, we present CAIRN, a fact-intent-driven multi-agent paradigm for goal-directed exploration. CAIRN represents observations and planned investigations as a dynamic directed acyclic graph (DAG). A reasoner interprets facts to propose intents, which workers execute to produce new facts. Each intent references its supporting facts and defines a potential exploration branch. The persistent graph preserves goals, dependencies and findings across workers, supporting knowledge reuse and parallel exploration. The graph also makes execution trajectories traceable and auditable, providing a basis for human verification and intervention. We evaluate CAIRN across cybersecurity and mathematical reasoning tasks, examining task success, time to solution, and token consumption. DAG-based coordination can incur higher token costs with no observable performance gains on tasks that require little effort. However, on high-effort tasks (at least 1M tokens), we observe faster solutions in 76.5% of cases, with speedups of up to 3.08x. Moreover, as task effort increases, these time gains become more pronounced while relative token overhead declines, highlighting the potential of DAG-guided parallel exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出CAIRN，一种事实-意图驱动的多智能体范式，用动态DAG组织探索过程，在多智能体系统中平衡效率与可靠性。
AI.motivation: LLM自主系统在数学推理、工程和网络安全等任务表现优异，但如何组织这些系统以实现有效、可靠、可持续的性能仍是未解问题。
AI.method: CAIRN将观察和计划调查表示为动态有向无环图（DAG）。推理器解读事实提出意图，工作者执行意图产生新事实。每个意图引用支撑事实并定义潜在探索分支。持久图保留目标、依赖和发现，支持知识复用与并行探索，并使执行轨迹可追踪、可审计。
AI.result: 在网络安全和数学推理任务上评估任务成功率、求解时间和token消耗。DAG协调在低投入任务上token成本更高且无性能提升；但在高投入任务（≥1M tokens）中，76.5%的案例求解更快，加速最高达3.08倍。任务投入越大，时间收益越显著，相对token开销越低。
AI.conclusion: DAG引导的并行探索具有潜力，尤其在高投入任务中能显著加速并降低相对token开销，同时提供可追踪、可审计的探索基础。

title: Positions Are Not Facts: The Mismatch Between KV Caches and Memory
summary: When a fact changes, how should a language model update the history stored in its key-value (KV) cache? Hiding the old record is cheap, but it may still contain needed details or answer questions about the past. We compare hiding whole records, hiding only replaced values, and deleting old text and recomputing the cache. In a controlled quantity task, masking makes all eight models prefer the new value more strongly, yet six lose complete answers through unit errors or failure to stop; keeping the unit preserves all current answers. Later states also retain useful information from earlier records: on multi-hop updates, rebuilding these states at unchanged positions lowers historical accuracy by 20-41 percentage points, whereas moving the existing states has little effect. Keeping object dependencies and unchanged revision passages prevents many losses. Recognition is a separate challenge. Learned readouts recover distinctions missed by fixed cache similarities on synthetic record pairs. On natural text, text-detector-selected masks show no clear advantage over random masks at the same rate in 14 same-model detector-generator comparisons. Query-dependent access can avoid some losses, with additional storage or access costs. These findings identify what must be preserved beyond the replaced value when using a KV cache as updatable memory.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究语言模型KV缓存作为可更新记忆时如何正确更新历史事实，比较隐藏记录、仅隐藏被替换值和删除重算三种策略。
AI.motivation: 事实变化时，KV缓存中的历史记录如何更新尚无明确方案：直接隐藏旧记录虽便宜，但可能丢失有用细节或无法回答历史问题。
AI.method: 在受控数量任务和多跳更新任务中，比较隐藏整条记录、仅隐藏被替换值、删除旧文本并重算缓存三种方式，并测试掩码选择、学习式读出与查询相关访问。
AI.result: 掩码使8个模型更偏好新值，但6个因单位错误或未停止而丢失完整答案；保留单位可保住当前答案。多跳更新中，在未变位置重建状态使历史准确率降20-41个百分点，而移动既有状态影响很小；保留对象依赖和未变修订段落可减少损失。固定缓存相似度遗漏的区分可由学习式读出恢复；自然文本上文本检测器选择的掩码在14组同模型比较中不优于随机掩码。查询相关访问可避免部分损失，但增加存储或访问成本。
AI.conclusion: 使用KV缓存作为可更新记忆时，除替换值外还必须保留单位、对象依赖和未变段落等关键信息，才能兼顾当前与历史准确性。

title: Attribution Gaps in Zero-Training LLM+OVOD Pipelines: A Fine-Grained Analysis of the CAAP--SNAP Discrepancy
summary: LAOD and similar zero-training LLM+open-vocabulary-detector (OVOD) pipelines score two things separately: class-agnostic localization accuracy (CAAP) and semantic naming accuracy (SNAP). The two consistently diverge, and nobody has asked why. This paper asks why, on the full 5,000-image COCO-Val split (27,273 detections) rather than the small subset the original work evaluated on. Object visual complexity turns out not to be the driver -- small and occluded objects are, if anything, localized better than large ones. Vocabulary novelty is: once the LLM's wording falls outside the detector's native category set, localization accuracy falls from 80.9% to 31.6%. That drop is not spread evenly across unfamiliar phrasing, though. Almost all of it comes from cases where the novel wording actually names a different object than the one COCO annotated (true synonyms still score 89.3%; semantically unrelated "noise" labels score 12.0%). A closer look at a further failure subset tells a similar story: 78-88% of what looks like complete localization failure is really the model correctly finding a real object that COCO's non-exhaustive 80-category scheme simply never labeled, not hallucination. Swap the detector backbone (YOLO-World for Grounding DINO) or the LLM (Gemma-3 for Qwen2.5-VL) and both the effect and its rough size hold up, so this looks like a general property of the pipeline family rather than a quirk of one model pairing.
