In the simulation, 100.0% of clean and validation-stress episodes reached a staff-reviewable draft, compared with 68.6% of escalation challenge episodes, unsupported cases were blocked. Scenario-based savings were 149.7-165.5 seconds per case, not observed staff times. The findings support schema-grounded, validation-first healthcare administrative automation in which language-model components assist mapping but do not authorize unsupported or consequential actions.

AI.tldr: 提出并评估CLAIRE混合工作流，用于将医疗行政多源结构化信息自动填入动态表单，强调"模式约束+验证优先"的设计。
AI.motivation: 医疗行政人员需从电子病历、转诊、理赔、供方名册等系统手工转移结构化信息，易出错且低效；需在保证可靠性的前提下引入语言模型辅助。
AI.method: 将流程拆分为字段状态发现、源到字段映射、确定性验证、有界纠错、升级与审计追踪；在5个合成医疗行政schema、1000条源记录、4种界面变体、2个数据质量套件、6个对照系统上构建24000个基准episodes；另用Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B做严格输出审计，并基于trace进行6000 episodes的操作模拟。
AI.result: 完整CLAIRE在两个套件中均达1.000的episode成功率、字段准确率、必填项与依赖完成率；去掉验证后压力套件成功率降至0.500。模拟中清洁与验证压力episodes 100.0%生成可供员工复核的草稿，升级挑战类为68.6%，不支持情形被阻断。每案例节省149.7–165.5秒（场景推算，非实测员工时间）。
AI.conclusion: 支持"模式约束、验证优先"的医疗行政自动化：语言模型仅辅助映射，不授权无依据或高风险操作。

title: Opera: A Verbal Critic Framework for Long-horizon Coding Agents
summary: Long-horizon coding agents need timely corrections, yet feedback can be ineffective or even harmful when it misjudges ongoing work or fails to address the underlying problem. Existing critics focus on evaluating trajectories and generating feedback, but rarely track what happens after feedback is delivered. We present Opera, a verbal critic framework that treats each correction as a persistent note, followed until the diagnosed problem is resolved. Opera decides when to review through periodic and event-driven triggers, diagnoses issues with typed operators, audits feedback against visible evidence before delivery, and tracks the agent's subsequent actions to distinguish mere compliance from actual resolution. As a test-time critic, Opera improves the resolve rate of non-critic agents by up to 12.4, 15.0, and 8.9 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.1, a SWE-Bench Pro subset, and DeepSWE v1.1, respectively, across four policy models, and achieves the highest mean resolve rate among competitive critic baselines on all three benchmarks, and also improves policy models when the policy critiques itself. Beyond inference, Opera-guided rollouts provide approximately on-policy training data: fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on them improves its resolve rate on held-out SWE-Bench Pro repositories by 10.2 percentage points without a critic at inference time, matching fine-tuning on rollouts from a stronger model, while preserving its performance when switching harness, i.e., from Openhands to Terminus-2, which the latter substantially degrades.

AI.tldr: Opera是一个"口头批评者"框架，将每次纠正视为持久化笔记并跟踪至问题真正解决，在多个基准上提升智能体成功率，并能生成近似在策略的训练数据。
AI.motivation: 长时程编码智能体需要及时纠正，但反馈若误判进行中的工作或未触及根本问题，可能无效甚至有害。现有批评者只关注评估轨迹与生成反馈，很少跟踪反馈交付后发生了什么。
AI.method: Opera把每次纠正当作持久化笔记，持续跟踪直至诊断的问题被解决。它通过周期性及事件驱动触发器决定何时审查，用带类型的算子诊断问题，在交付前依据可见证据审核反馈，并跟踪智能体后续动作以区分"表面服从"与"实际解决"。
AI.result: 作为测试时批评者，Opera在四个策略模型上使非批评者智能体的解决率在Terminal-Bench 2.1、SWE-Bench Pro子集、DeepSWE v1.1上分别提升最高12.4、15.0、8.9个百分点，并在三个基准上取得竞争性批评基线中的最高平均解决率，也能在策略模型自我批评时提升性能。此外，Opera引导的rollout提供近似在策略的训练数据：用其微调Qwen3.5-9B，在留出的SWE-Bench Pro仓库上解决率提升10.2个百分点（推理时无需批评者），与用更强模型rollout微调相当，且在切换harness（Openhands→Terminus-2）时保持性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将反馈视为需持续跟踪的持久化笔记并区分服从与真正解决，Opera有效提升批评效果，并可作为在策略训练数据来源，兼具性能与稳健性。

title: Gradient-Guided Decoupled Adaptation for Geospatial Vision-Language Models
summary: Existing geospatial vision-language models (Geo-VLMs) typically optimize diverse geospatial tasks through a unified multi-task adaptation paradigm without explicitly accounting for the heterogeneous optimization characteristics. Our empirical observations reveal heterogeneous gradient characteristics across tasks, including vision-language differences, intra-branch gradient relationships, and task interference, which hinder effective multi-task optimization. Motivated by these observations, we propose Gradient-Guided Decoupled Adaptation (G2DA), a gradient-aware optimization framework for multi-task Geo-VLM learning. G2DA first partitions tasks into vision- and language-centric groups through gradient-guided cross-modal decoupling. It then constructs modality-specific curricula based on task gradient similarity and employs bidirectional rehearsal to mitigate the recency effects introduced by sequential optimization. We evaluate G2DA on three Geo-VLM benchmarks using six InternVL3 and Qwen3.5-VL variants, along with GeoChat and GeoLLaVA. Across all 24 benchmark-model combinations, G2DA consistently outperforms representative baselines, improving over the strongest competitor by 3.08, 4.30, and 2.81 percentage points on UrBench-MCQ, XLRS-Bench-Lite, and VRS-Bench-VQA, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of gradient-guided task organization for Geo-VLM adaptation.

AI.tldr: G2DA：一种梯度感知的解耦适配框架，通过跨模态解耦与课程学习改善多任务Geo-VLM优化。
AI.motivation: 现有多任务Geo-VLM统一适配未考虑任务间异质的优化特性，作者观察到视觉-语言差异、分支内梯度关系及任务干扰等问题。
AI.method: 先通过梯度引导的跨模态解耦将任务分为视觉与语言两组；再基于任务梯度相似度构建模态专属课程，并用双向排练缓解顺序优化的近因效应。
AI.result: 在三个Geo-VLM基准、六种InternVL3与Qwen3.5-VL变体及GeoChat、GeoLLaVA上，24个组合全部超越基线，在UrBench-MCQ、XLRS-Bench-Lite、VRS-Bench-VQA上分别领先最强对手3.08、4.30、2.81个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 梯度引导的任务组织对Geo-VLM适配有效。

title: $T^5$: Twin-Critic Training for Token-Level Thoughts in Reinforcement Mid-Training
summary: Reinforcement mid-training lets language models learn internal thoughts from unlabeled text, but efficient token-level credit assignment remains challenging. Existing group-relative methods require costly repeated generation. Learned critics offer single-rollout feedback, but accurate return prediction alone does not ensure reliable policy updates. Our analysis shows how training--inference mismatch and PPO clipping prevent a common offset in advantage estimates from cancelling out, introducing additional update drift. We propose \tfour{}, a twin-critic method that calibrates token-level advantages from a single generated trajectory. After warmup and held-out qualification, the critics provide two advantage estimates, combined using action-dependent weights learned through a conditional-moment saddle-point objective. This objective brings the average advantage at each prefix toward zero, while a signal-retention constraint prevents the correction from erasing the learning signal. Sharing information across text positions avoids repeated sampling of each prefix. Theoretically, we characterize optimal mixing under the signal-retention constraint and establish an upper bound on residual mean-induced drift. Experiments show that, compared with the state-of-the-art critic-free method, \tfour{} improves mean benchmark performance by 7.8\% and reduces mean training-step time by up to 63.4\%.

AI.tldr: 提出 twin-critic 方法 Calibrated(?) 校准 token 级优势，从单条轨迹高效进行 credit assignment，性能提升 7.8%，训练时间减少 63.4%。
AI.motivation: 强化中训练可从无标注文本学习内部思考，但 token 级 credit assignment 效率低：group-relative 方法需重复生成，learned critic 虽单 rollout 但准确回报预测不等于可靠策略更新；训练-推理不匹配与 PPO clipping 使优势估计的公共偏移无法抵消，导致额外更新漂移。
AI.method: twin-critic 方法：经 warmup 与 held-out 资格筛选后，两个 critic 从单条生成轨迹给出两个优势估计，通过 action-dependent 权重结合，权重以 conditional-moment saddle-point 目标学习，使每个前缀平均优势趋零；信号保留约束防止修正抹去学习信号；跨文本位置共享信息以避免重复采样前缀。
AI.result: 理论上刻画信号保留约束下的最优混合，并给出残差均值诱导漂移上界。实验相比 SOTA critic-free 方法，平均基准性能提升 7.8%，平均训练步时间最多减少 63.4%。
AI.conclusion: 单轨迹、双 critic 校准的 token 级优势方法在保持学习信号的同时抑制更新漂移，兼顾性能与效率。

title: RewardExplainer: Learning Reward Model Explanations from Counterfactual Preference Feedback
summary: Reward models (RMs) are a key component of large language model post-training, providing reward signals for subsequent reinforcement learning. However, conventional discriminative RMs typically output only scalar scores, making it difficult to identify the response behaviors associated with their scoring decisions. Existing interpretation methods often rely on predefined high-level attributes and require repeated counterfactual interventions for each response pair to validate candidate explanations, lacking a closed-loop mechanism that uses RMs' feedback to train a reusable explainer. To address this, we propose RewardExplainer, a framework that obtains feedback from the target reward model through counterfactual rewriting and uses this feedback to further optimize the explainer. RewardExplainer generates open-ended, atomic, and intervenable natural-language scoring mechanisms, making explanations more concrete, readable, and actionable. It further converts counterfactual feedback into preference supervision, enabling the explainer to more faithfully capture the target RM's scoring preferences and sensitive behaviors than single-pass generation. Extensive experiments across multiple target RMs and explainer backbones show consistent improvements. Beyond interpretation, we use the generated mechanisms to identify potential bias patterns and construct targeted debiasing data for fine-tuning the reward model, improving robustness on reward-hacking benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出RewardExplainer，通过反事实重写获取奖励模型反馈并训练可复用的解释器，生成可干预的自然语言评分机制，提升解释忠实度并可用于去偏。
AI.motivation: 传统判别式奖励模型仅输出标量分数，难以识别导致评分决策的响应行为；现有解释方法依赖预定义的高层属性，且需对每个响应对反复进行反事实干预来验证候选解释，缺少利用RM反馈训练可复用解释器的闭环机制。
AI.method: RewardExplainer通过反事实重写从目标奖励模型获取反馈，并用该反馈优化解释器；生成开放式、原子化、可干预的自然语言评分机制；将反事实反馈转化为偏好监督，使解释器更忠实地捕捉目标RM的评分偏好与敏感行为。
AI.result: 在多个目标奖励模型和解释器主干上进行的大量实验显示一致的改进；此外，利用生成的机制识别潜在偏差模式，构建针对性去偏数据微调奖励模型，在reward-hacking基准上提升了鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: RewardExplainer构建了基于RM反馈闭环优化的可复用解释器，提升了奖励模型解释的忠实性与可操作性，并展示了在偏差识别与去偏方面的实用价值。

title: AnesTRACE: Benchmarking Intraoperative Anesthesia from Multimodal Perception to Multi-step Decision-Making
summary: Intraoperative anesthesia requires systems to interpret evolving multimodal evidence, recommend timely management, and revise decisions as patient states change, yet existing benchmarks usually isolate perception or single-point reasoning. We introduce AnesTRACE, an evaluation suite comprising AnesTRACE-Bench and AnesTRACE-Eval. Built from public perioperative datasets with anesthesiologist annotation, AnesTRACE-Bench evaluates Intraoperative Perception, Single-point Anesthesia Decision-Making, and Multi-step Anesthesia Decision-Making. AnesTRACE-Eval assesses open-ended responses through anesthesiologist-defined criteria for Clinical Correctness, Evidence Grounding, Task Completeness, and Safety, with Temporal Consistency for multi-step decisions; its domain-specific evaluator is trained by supervised fine-tuning and preference alignment on expert-reviewed judgments. Across more than 30 models, fine-grained visual grounding and intervention selection remain difficult: the leading model reaches only 32.2 mIoU for TEE visual grounding and retains a 17.5\% Major/Critical Safety Error Rate in multi-step management. Evaluator alignment with anesthesiologists improves across both training stages, while the best decision quality is accompanied by a 74.3-second P95 Latency. These results show that aggregate performance alone does not establish safe, timely longitudinal decision-making. We release our code at https://github.com/zjuDBxAI/AnesTRACE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AnesTRACE，一个用于术中麻醉决策评估的基准与评测框架，涵盖感知、单步与多步决策任务，并揭示当前模型在安全性与时效性上的不足。
AI.motivation: 术中麻醉需要系统解读动态多模态证据、及时给出管理建议并随患者状态变化修正决策，但现有基准多聚焦于孤立感知或单点推理，无法评估纵向决策能力。
AI.method: 构建基于公开围术期数据并由麻醉医生标注的AnesTRACE-Bench（含术中感知、单步麻醉决策、多步麻醉决策三类任务）；同时提出AnesTRACE-Eval，依据麻醉医生定义的标准（临床正确性、证据支撑、任务完整性、安全性，以及多步决策的时间一致性）评估开放式回答，其领域评测器通过监督微调与偏好对齐在专家审核判断上训练。
AI.result: 在30余个模型上评测发现，细粒度视觉定位与干预选择仍很困难：最优模型TEE视觉定位仅达32.2 mIoU，多步管理中仍有17.5%的重大/严重安全错误率；评测器与麻醉医生的对齐随两阶段训练提升，最佳决策质量伴随74.3秒的P95延迟。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭总体性能无法保证安全、及时的纵向决策能力，需重视安全性、证据支撑与时序一致性等维度。

title: AgentHabit: Characterizing Distinct Behaviors of Agents on Everyday Tasks
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents assist users with everyday tasks that can be completed in many reasonable ways. Even when their answers are useful, how agents carry out these tasks may not match users' preferences and needs. For example, agents differ in whether they ask clarifying questions or search the web. We introduce HABIT, a taxonomy of 23 behavioral axes in five categories, which three authors and three LLMs derive bottom-up from 408 agent trajectories across 17 domains. On held-out tasks, HABIT distinguishes models more clearly than existing taxonomies of human values and agent actions while supporting comparably consistent annotation. Building on HABIT, we construct AgentHABIT, a benchmark that profiles each agent's behavioral tendencies from its trajectories on 86 everyday tasks. Profiling 18 models with AgentHABIT reveals a range of distinctive tendencies. For example, most GPT and Claude models state their assumptions and offer alternatives when requirements conflict, whereas Qwen and Google's models more often leave assumptions or changes to requirements unstated. These profiles remain recognizable even when built from entirely different sets of tasks, indicating that they reflect general tendencies rather than task-specific behavior. Prompting agents to adopt specific behaviors shifts some axes readily but barely changes others, while fine-tuning on another model's trajectories changes only part of a model's profile and leaves much of it intact. Overall, HABIT and AgentHABIT provide a systematic framework for characterizing how agents carry out everyday tasks beyond task success, offering insights to guide the development of agents whose behavior better fits users' needs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出HABIT（23个行为轴、5大类）和AgentHABIT基准，系统刻画LLM智能体在完成日常任务时的行为倾向，揭示不同模型具有可辨识、可迁移且难以完全改变的行为特征。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体完成日常任务时有多种合理方式，即便答案有用，其执行方式（如是否追问、是否联网搜索）可能不符合用户偏好与需求；现有价值观或动作分类法难以区分这些行为差异。
AI.method: 三位作者与三个LLM从17个领域、408条智能体轨迹中自下而上归纳出HABIT分类法（23个行为轴、5类）；据此构建AgentHABIT基准，用86个日常任务轨迹为18个模型生成行为画像，并验证跨任务稳定性、提示与微调对行为的影响。
AI.result: HABIT比现有分类法更能清晰区分模型且标注一致性相当；18个模型呈现不同倾向（如多数GPT和Claude模型会陈述假设并在需求冲突时提供替代方案，Qwen和Google模型更常不说明假设）；换用完全不同的任务集画像仍保持可辨识；提示可轻易改变部分行为轴但难改其他轴，微调他人轨迹只改变部分画像。
AI.conclusion: HABIT与AgentHABIT提供了超出任务成功率的系统框架，用于刻画智能体如何完成日常任务，可为开发更契合用户需求的智能体提供指导。

title: Faithful Activation Verbalization: Reducing Hallucinations in LLM Representation Interpretation
summary: Activation verbalization methods such as Activation Oracle and Natural Language Autoencoders decode hidden representations of large language models into human-readable natural language. However, existing methods can produce incomplete or hallucinated descriptions, making their activation verbalizations difficult to trust and use reliably in practice. To this end, we introduce AVPO, a two-stage framework that first reconstructs source text from a hidden activation and then evaluates the resulting text with a separate frozen question-answering model, yielding an explicit and inspectable intermediate readout. We further optimize the inverter with direct preference optimization (DPO), using rewards that capture both semantic recoverability and lexical fidelity. Across six text families, AVPO improves gist- and detail-level information recovery over the strongest baseline by up to 17.1 and 9.3 percentage points, respectively. Crucially, the gains arise from preference optimization rather than fine-tuning on selected reconstructions alone, enabling compact cross-model inverters to surpass donor-matched question-conditioned verbalizers while improving both semantic recoverability and lexical fidelity. Moreover, out-of-distribution case study shows that AVPO better recovers high-level semantics while fabricating fewer details.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AVPO，一个两阶段框架，先从隐藏激活重建源文本，再用冻结的问答模型评估重建结果，并通过DPO优化反演器以提升激活语言化的可信度。
AI.motivation: 现有激活语言化方法（如Activation Oracle、Natural Language Autoencoders）会产生不完整或幻觉的描述，导致其难以被信任和可靠使用。
AI.method: AVPO两阶段：第一阶段从隐藏激活重建源文本，第二阶段用独立的冻结QA模型评估重建文本，得到显式可检查的中间读出；并用DPO优化反演器，奖励同时捕捉语义可恢复性与词汇保真度。
AI.result: 在六个文本族上，AVPO相比最强基线在要点级和细节级信息恢复上分别提升最多17.1和9.3个百分点；增益来自偏好优化而非仅对选定重建的微调；紧凑的跨模型反演器超越了同源问题条件化的verbalizer，并改善语义可恢复性与词汇保真度；OOD案例显示AVPO更好恢复高层语义且编造更少细节。
AI.conclusion: AVPO通过两阶段评估与DPO偏好优化，实现了更可信、更可靠的激活语言化，在信息恢复与幻觉抑制上均优于现有方法。

title: LoCoVSR: Local Context Diffusion Posterior Sampling for Video Super-Resolution
summary: Video super-resolution (VSR) is an ill-posed inverse problem that aims to reconstruct a high-resolution (HR) video from a noisy, low-resolution (LR) version of it. We present LoCoVSR, a diffusion-based VSR framework that leverages pixel-space denoising diffusion probabilistic models. LoCoVSR integrates the Diffusion Posterior Sampling technique with spatio-temporal context learning, operating in a moving-average form. A localized window of adjacent LR frames is used for recovering each center frame, while applying a shared noise trajectory across all frames. The localized windowing enables processing of long videos without length limitations, supports parallel inference, and prevents error accumulation that may occur in recursive processing. Unlike prior methods, LoCoVSR offers a simple yet very effective VSR solution, avoiding explicit optical flow estimation, or information loss caused by latent space processing. Trained on the VFHQ face dataset, LoCoVSR achieves accurate, temporally consistent and high-quality upscaling with competitive results against recent diffusion-based VSR approaches.

AI.tldr: LoCoVSR是一个基于扩散后验采样与时空上下文学习的像素空间视频超分辨率框架，无需光流估计，可处理任意长度视频并避免误差累积。
AI.motivation: 视频超分辨率是病态逆问题，现有方法依赖光流估计（易出错）或潜空间处理（信息损失），且递归处理易导致误差累积、受视频长度限制。
AI.method: 采用像素空间去噪扩散概率模型，结合扩散后验采样与时空上下文学习，以移动平均形式运行：用局部相邻LR帧窗口恢复中心帧，并在所有帧间共享噪声轨迹。支持并行推理，避免光流估计与潜空间信息损失。
AI.result: 在VFHQ人脸数据集上训练，实现准确、时间一致且高质量的上采样，效果与近期基于扩散的VSR方法具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: LoCoVSR提供了一种简单而高效的VSR方案，可处理长视频、支持并行推理并防止误差累积，避免光流估计与潜空间信息损失。

title: PlanGuard: A Guardrail for Multi-Step Plan Safety in Embodied Agents
summary: Embodied task planners may produce multi-step plans whose subtask dependencies and interactions with the environment create physical risks during execution. Yet existing safeguards overlook such compositional risks, as general-purpose guardrails focus on semantic harm and embodied safety detectors assess subtasks in isolation. To address this gap, we introduce PlanGuard, the first pre-execution detector that evaluates the physical safety of a complete multi-step plan in its current environment. For training and evaluation, we construct a Multi-Step Plan Safety (MSP-Safe) dataset through paired task construction, plan generation using diverse planners, and safety annotation by three judges. Task-oriented SFT on MSP-Safe establishes fundamental plan-safety assessment capabilities, yet a substantial gap remains between compact models suitable for real-time deployment and stronger but costlier large models. Accordingly, we propose Strong-Teacher Adaptive Compensation for On-Policy Distillation (STAC-OPD), which provides compact models with adaptive strong-teacher supervision along their on-policy trajectories. It combines token-level distribution transfer from a fine-tuned strong teacher with probability-routed sequence-level compensation, retaining student-generated targets when the student favors the reference safety decision and using teacher-reconstructed targets otherwise. Across all test subsets, PlanGuard-2B achieves average 87.15% ACC and 87.21% F1, demonstrating effective whole-plan physical-risk detection at compact model scale. Code and dataset will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PlanGuard，首个在执行前评估完整多步计划物理安全性的检测器，并构建MSP-Safe数据集及STAC-OPD蒸馏方法，使紧凑模型达到87%+的检测性能。
AI.motivation: 具身任务规划器产生的多步计划中，子任务依赖与环境交互会带来组合性物理风险，而现有防护手段（通用护栏关注语义伤害、具身安全检测器孤立评估子任务）忽视了这类风险。
AI.method: 构建MSP-Safe数据集（配对任务构造、多规划器生成计划、三位评审标注）；用任务导向SFT赋予基础能力；提出STAC-OPD，通过token级分布迁移与概率路由的序列级补偿，在在线轨迹上提供自适应强教师监督。
AI.result: PlanGuard-2B在所有测试子集上平均达87.15% ACC和87.21% F1，在紧凑模型规模下实现有效的整计划物理风险检测。
AI.conclusion: STAC-OPD有效缩小紧凑模型与大型模型的安全评估能力差距，PlanGuard为多步计划物理安全提供了可实时部署的执行前检测方案，代码与数据集将公开。

title: Who Gets a Token, and What Does It Carry? Unequal Name Support and Concept Access in Large Language Models
summary: Names are personal identifiers, but they also carry social meaning and are widely used to evaluate how language models treat different people. Such evaluations typically assume that matched names are comparable model inputs. We show that this assumption often fails at the lexical interface: matched names are not necessarily matched inputs. Some names receive direct single-token access, while others are assembled from multiple subwords, creating unequal name-surface support. Across nearly half a million first names and 12 LLM-associated tokenizers, direct lexical access is highly selective, model dependent, and uneven across race- and gender-associated name metadata. We introduce NameTrace, a model-native, fine-grained, pre-behavioral framework for measuring whether unequal name-surface support remains a vocabulary property or becomes visible in task-relevant internal representations. NameTrace measures concept accessibility from the model's own probabilities over task-specific adjective axes with continuous task-aligned weights. On matched atomic and short-fragmented names within the same race/ethnicity--gender-associated strata, support predicts systematic differences in concept accessibility across fellowship, hiring, clinical assessment, and lending. These differences persist across all eight matched strata, extend across model families, and transfer to unseen names. Hidden-state interventions further show that the measured task directions have downstream leverage, shifting later constrained choices. Unequal lexical support is therefore demographically structured at the input and remains visible in task-relevant model computation. NameTrace makes lexical comparability measurable, supporting a broader principle: behavioral comparability begins with lexical comparability.

AI.tldr: 名字作为个人标识符存在词汇层面的不平等：部分名字可直接单token访问，部分需多subword拼装。NameTrace框架证明这种词汇支持不平等在近50万名字、12个分词器中具有种族/性别结构性，并影响任务相关内部表征与下游决策。
AI.motivation: 现有评估常假设"匹配的名字"是"匹配的模型输入"，但该假设在词汇接口层面常不成立：名字的token化方式不同会导致输入支持不平等，从而威胁基于名字的公平性评估的有效性。
AI.method: 提出NameTrace，一个模型原生、细粒度、行为前的框架。它用模型对任务特定形容词轴的连续任务对齐权重概率，衡量概念可及性；在同一种族/性别分组内比较匹配的"原子名"与"短碎片化名"，并结合隐藏状态干预验证任务方向的下游影响力。
AI.result: 在约50万名字、12个LLM分词器上，直接词汇访问高度选择性、依赖模型且随种族/性别元数据不均；在奖学金、招聘、临床评估与借贷四类任务中，词汇支持可预测概念可及性的系统性差异，且跨全部8个匹配分组、跨模型家族、并迁移到未见名字；隐藏状态干预显示该任务方向具有下游杠杆作用，能改变后续受约束的选择。
AI.conclusion: 词汇支持不平等在输入层即具有人口统计结构性，并持续体现在任务相关的模型计算中。NameTrace使词汇可比性可测量，支持一个更广泛的原则：行为可比性始于词汇可比性。

title: From Feed-Forward to Flow: Unifying Reconstruction and Generation Is Easier Than You Think
comment: 34 pages, including supplementary material. Haoru Wang and Qianfan Shen contributed equally
summary: Reconstruct where the images provide evidence, and generate where they do not: recent success of spatial world models such as Atlas (World Labs Team, 2026) highlights the value of unifying reconstruction and generation in one model. Yet the two have long lived in separate paradigms with distinctive failure modes: feed-forward reconstruction averages ambiguity into blur, while conditional generation invents plausible but scene-inconsistent detail. In this work, we present a unified flow-based formulation for reconstruction and generation, where a shared clean-target predictor performs direct reconstruction at its single-step endpoint and unfolds conditional generation through multi-step flow. A controlled toy study reveals the mechanism: with a single step, the predictor collapses to the conditional mean just like feed-forward methods, favoring consistency over diversity. With multi-step inference, the fidelity of generated details grows with context richness: closer observations reduce ambiguity and yield better-matched details. We further instantiate the formulation in appearance and geometry 3D tasks. JiT-LVSM improves perceptual and distributional quality in novel view synthesis, while JUSt3R retains competitive single-step geometry prediction with additional multi-step inference capabilities that reduces veil and flying-pixel artifacts, producing cleaner surface structure with greater test-time compute. Together, they show that reconstruction and generation can share both a formulation and a backbone, with their behavior governed by denoising configuration---making unification surprisingly simple.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的基于流的重建与生成框架，通过共享的清洁目标预测器，在单步端点实现直接重建、多步流实现条件生成，并实例化于3D外观与几何任务。
AI.motivation: 重建与生成长期分属不同范式且各有失败模式：前馈重建将歧义平均为模糊，条件生成则会产生貌似合理但与场景不一致的细节。受Atlas等空间世界模型启发，作者希望将两者统一到同一模型。
AI.method: 提出统一的flow-based公式，共享一个clean-target predictor：单步推理时执行直接重建，多步流展开条件生成。通过受控玩具实验揭示机制，并在3D外观与几何任务中实例化为JiT-LVSM（新视角合成）与JUSt3R（几何预测）。
AI.result: 玩具实验显示：单步时预测器坍缩到条件均值（偏一致性），多步时生成细节保真度随上下文丰富度提升。JiT-LVSM提升了新视角合成的感知与分布质量；JUSt3R在保持有竞争力的单步几何预测的同时，多步推理可减少veil与flying-pixel伪影，产生更干净表面。
AI.conclusion: 重建与生成可共享同一公式与骨干网络，其行为由去噪配置调节，表明二者的统一出乎意料地简单。

title: Re-derivability Decides What a Staged Agent Pipeline Recovers After an Upstream Fault
comment: 34 pages, 8 figures, 13 tables; preprint under review
summary: One variable sets what an upstream fault costs a staged pipeline of language-model agents: re-derivability, how much of what a stage needs it can rebuild from the original problem. Grounding an inspector agent in that problem is worth +0.608 [+0.517, +0.700] to +0.358 over a blind one on four open-weight backbones served with thinking disabled, and on the two Qwen backbones the blind inspector changes no item at all. That head-to-head is exploratory. One deterministic fault enters the first stage, and we re-expose the original problem to $k = 0,\dots,3$ of the downstream stages with agents, items, fault and topology held fixed, on 120 gsm_hard items per arm at temperature zero. Accuracy under fault rises on four of four backbones, from +0.233 to +0.392, the largest Holm-adjusted $p$ being $2.1\times10^{-6}$. A registered kill test rules out tokens. Blanking every word holds the word slots fixed, and retention tracks the visible fraction on four of four, climbing from 0.221 to 0.692 on the primary. Those two families are confirmatory and everything else here is exploratory. The interaction excludes zero on two of four backbones under the registered pipeline, four of four under a three-stage pipeline, and three of four under full message history, the primary at +0.317. On Llama-3.1-8B the fault carries no detectable cost at any dose, so the other three carry every claim about what a fault costs. Re-derivability also sets what the architecture costs, and no decomposition we measured reliably beats one direct call. With no fault injected the registered pipeline loses to that call by -0.267, -0.125 and -0.317, and on Phi-4 reads +0.058 at $p = 0.118$, which the test fails to separate from zero. The repair that works is cheap and front-loaded: the first re-grounded stage buys +0.394 of matched retention for +59.8 tokens per item on Qwen3-14B, and the stages after it buy nothing.

AI.tldr: 论文研究多阶段语言模型智能体流水线中上游故障的成本，核心变量是"可重构性"（下游阶段能从原始问题重建多少所需信息）。
AI.motivation: 上游故障对分阶段语言模型智能体流水线的成本取决于下游阶段能从原始问题重建多少内容（可重构性），论文旨在量化这一变量对故障成本、架构成本及修复效果的影响。
AI.method: 向首阶段注入一个确定性故障，对k=0…3个下游阶段重新暴露原始问题，保持智能体、项目、故障和拓扑不变，在120个gsm_hard项目、温度零下测试；包含注册式消杀测试（排除token数）、词语遮蔽实验、交互项检验，并对比直接单次调用的架构成本。
AI.result: 准确性在有故障时在四个骨干上均上升（+0.233至+0.392，最大Holm校正p=2.1e-6）；将检查智能体接地位于原始问题相对盲选提升+0.358至+0.608；词语可见比例与保留率同增（0.221→0.692）；交互项在注册流水线2/4、三阶段4/4、完整消息历史3/4骨干上排除零；无故障时注册流水线劣于单次直接调用（-0.267、-0.125、-0.317）；首个重接地阶段在Qwen3-14B上以每项+59.8 token换取+0.394匹配保留，后续阶段无增益。Llama-3.1-8B上故障无可检测成本。
AI.conclusion: 可重构性同时决定故障成本与架构成本，且无任何测得的分解能可靠优于单次直接调用；有效的修复廉价且前置（首个重接地阶段收益最大，后续阶段无增益）。

title: Evaluating Machine Unlearning in ASR
summary: Machine unlearning (MU) offers a path to compliance with "right to be forgotten" regulations. While MU has received increasing attention for speech tasks, it remains largely unexplored for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR). In this work, we investigate whether existing MU algorithms and evaluation tools are suitable for ASR. We apply several MU techniques to an ASR model, evaluating privacy-utility trade-offs for single-subject unlearning, then assess the best algorithm under sequential and simultaneous unlearning. Results show that gradient ascent-based algorithms achieve strong utility-privacy trade-offs, whereas more complex approaches over-unlearn samples, making them easier to identify as unlearned. This suggests standard privacy evaluations based on simple Membership Inference attacks are insufficient to reliably assess unlearning success, motivating improved evaluation methods for MU in ASR. Finally, we show that both sequential and simultaneous unlearning yield worse privacy and utility than single-subject unlearning, underscoring the need for unlearning constructions better suited to these settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究机器遗忘（MU）在自动语音识别（ASR）中的适用性，发现基于梯度上升的算法在隐私-效用权衡上表现最好，而复杂方法会过度遗忘；现有隐私评估方法不足以可靠衡量ASR遗忘效果，且顺序/同时遗忘均比单主体遗忘效果更差。
AI.motivation: MU在语音任务中受关注，但在ASR领域仍缺乏探索。作者希望验证现有MU算法和评估工具是否适用于ASR。
AI.method: 将多种MU技术应用于ASR模型，评估单主体遗忘的隐私-效用权衡，然后在顺序与同时遗忘设置下测试表现最佳的算法。
AI.result: 梯度上升类算法实现强隐私-效用权衡，而更复杂的方法会过度遗忘样本，使其更易被识别为已遗忘。基于简单成员推理攻击的隐私评估不足以可靠判断遗忘成功。顺序和同时遗忘的隐私与效用均差于单主体遗忘。
AI.conclusion: ASR领域的MU需要改进的评估方法和更适合顺序/同时遗忘场景的遗忘构造。

title: OmniMoE-VL: A Sparse Vision-Language Model with Coupled Visual-Depth Routing
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly use sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) to scale language-side computation, yet visual information is typically routed only after passing through a fixed cross-modal interface. This leaves an important decision unresolved: which intermediate visual representations should be exposed to language computation for a given question? We introduce OmniMoE-VL, a sparse VLM with a coupled visual-depth routed projector. For each image-prompt pair, the projector selects a sparse set of intermediate visual depths and reuses the resulting global preference to guide both local patch fusion and dynamic visual injection into the language model. This design enables question-dependent visual access while preserving the native visual-token sequence, and complements token-level expert routing in the vision and language stacks. Across eight image-based benchmarks, OmniMoE-VL achieves an average score of 85.9 with 28B total and 9B activated parameters. Controlled comparisons show that the routed visual interface provides the dominant architectural gain, while matched route and component controls, same-image route analysis, and route interventions further support the value of coupling and question-conditioned visual access.

AI.tldr: 提出OmniMoE-VL，一种稀疏VLM，用"耦合视觉深度路由投影器"按问题动态选择视觉中间层表征并注入语言模型，实现问题相关的视觉访问。
AI.motivation: 现有VLMs用稀疏MoE扩展语言侧计算，但视觉信息通常经由固定的跨模态接口后才被路由，遗留一个关键问题未解决：对给定问题应暴露哪些中间视觉表征给语言计算。
AI.method: 设计耦合视觉深度路由投影器：对每对图像-提示，选择稀疏的中间视觉深度集合，并复用所得全局偏好同时引导局部patch融合与向语言模型的动态视觉注入；保留原生视觉token序列，并与视觉、语言栈中的token级专家路由互补。
AI.result: 在8个图像基准上，28B总参数、9B激活参数下平均得分85.9。受控实验显示路由视觉接口是主导架构增益来源；路由匹配与组件对照、同图路由分析及路由干预进一步支持耦合与问题条件化视觉访问的价值。
AI.conclusion: 通过问题条件化的稀疏视觉深度路由，VLMs可实现动态、问题相关的视觉访问，与token级MoE路由互补，是提升稀疏VLM性能的关键架构设计。

title: Nutri-ATLAS: Embodied Agent for Tabulated Lookup and Assistance for Smarter nutrition
summary: Generative and Agentic IoT systems offer a promising foundation for digital healthcare applications that combine sensing, personalized reasoning, and autonomous interaction in real-world environments. Nutrition assistance is a natural use case, but existing Large Language Model (LLM)-based systems are often limited to passive text interaction and static context, making them unreliable when food descriptions are ambiguous or nutritional evidence is missing. We propose Nutri-ATLAS, an Embodied Agent for Tabulated Lookup and Assistance for smarter nutrition in the real world. It integrates graph-grounded nutrition reasoning, hardware-aware LLM selection, and robot-based evidence acquisition. Nutri-ATLAS builds a unified Food-Nutrient knowledge graph from USDA FoodData Central and FoodKG and learns 64-dimensional GATv2 food and recipe embeddings. A shared hybrid graph-text scoring mechanism supports food nutrition extraction, nutritional gap filling, substitute retrieval, and recipe-level meal composition, while an LLM-guided skill interface navigates landmarks, updates dietary-context and food-accessibility memory, and grounds recommendations in observed food availability. We evaluate Nutri-ATLAS across nutrient estimation, substitution retrieval, recipe recommendation, patient-profile adherence, edge deployment, and real-world embodied execution. On HealthyFoodSubs, the hybrid retriever achieves 37.9% MAP, 80.7% RR@5, and 90.1% RR@10. On NutriBench v2, Dense+GAT retrieval grounds nutrient estimation across nine quantized Qwen3.5-9B configurations. On PFoodReQ, Nutri-ATLAS reaches 78.8% MAP, 83.0% MAR, and 77.5% F1. A patient-profile study shows adherence to allergy and healthy-target constraints for all selected cases.

AI.tldr: Nutri-ATLAS是一个用于真实世界营养辅助的具身智能体（Embodied Agent），融合图接地营养推理、硬件感知LLM选择与机器人证据采集，在多个营养任务上取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的营养辅助系统多局限于被动文本交互与静态上下文，当食物描述模糊或营养证据缺失时不可靠。生成式与智能体IoT系统为结合感知、个性化推理与自主交互的数字医疗应用提供了契机，营养辅助是天然的应用场景。
AI.method: 构建统一的Food-Nutrient知识图谱（源自USDA FoodData Central与FoodKG），学习64维GATv2食物与食谱嵌入；采用共享的混合图-文本评分机制支持营养抽取、营养缺口填补、替代品检索与食谱级膳食组合；通过LLM引导的技能接口导航地标、更新饮食上下文与食物可及性记忆，并基于观测到的食物可用性进行推荐；同时集成硬件感知的LLM选择与机器人证据采集。
AI.result: 在HealthyFoodSubs上混合检索器达37.9% MAP、80.7% RR@5、90.1% RR@10；在NutriBench v2上Dense+GAT检索在九种量化Qwen3.5-9B配置下支撑营养估计；在PFoodReQ上达78.8% MAP、83.0% MAR、77.5% F1；患者档案研究表明对所有选定案例均满足过敏与健康目标约束。
AI.conclusion: Nutri-ATLAS验证了图接地推理与具身交互相结合在营养辅助中的有效性，在营养估计、替代检索、食谱推荐、患者依从性、边缘部署及真实世界具身执行等多维度均表现出色。

title: Unknown is not normal: separating language-model extraction from rule-based decision logic for clinical risk scores
comment: 14 pages (7 of main text), 5 figures, 2 tables, appendix included; full supplementary material in the code repository. Code: https://github.com/nicoveraz/calc-bounds (archived: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23004726)
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to compute clinical risk scores from free-text notes. Notes are often incomplete, and treating undocumented findings as normal can silently misclassify patients. We test whether separating three-state extraction (present, absent or unknown, by an LLM) from decision logic (deterministic code computing score bounds over unknown inputs) lets a system ask only questions that can change the decision. On 1,200 synthetic emergency cases across six calculators (HEART, CURB-65, qSOFA, PERC, Wells, Cockcroft-Gault), with a simulated clinician answering questions, we compared this bounds policy with asking for every missing input, a missing-equals-normal schema, and an end-to-end LLM agent (Claude Opus 5.5). With Claude Haiku 4.5 as extractor, the bounds policy matched ask-all accuracy (99.4% vs 99.4%) with half the questions (0.92 vs 1.78 per case) and no irrelevant ones. Treating missing as normal dropped accuracy to 91.2% and under-triaged 8.5% of patients (95% CI 7.1-10.2), and under-triage persisted under messy notes and a noisy clinician. The agent was equally accurate under ideal conditions (99.6%) but 9.5% of its questions were irrelevant; with a noisy clinician it was less accurate than the bounds policy (83.5% vs 87.0%, p<0.001) and committed prematurely in 2.7% of cases (bounds: 0%). A 9B local model as extractor reached oracle-level accuracy (99.8%). In 584 real case reports from MedCalc-Bench, only 52% contained enough information to determine the category (HEART 13%). Routing decisions through code that reasons explicitly about unknowns avoids premature commitment and irrelevant questions, halves the questions asked, and works with small local models.

AI.tldr: 将三态抽取（有/无/未知）与决策逻辑分离，用确定性代码在未知输入上计算分数边界，可只问能改变决策的问题，从而减半提问量、避免过早下结论，且能配合小模型使用。
AI.motivation: 临床自由文本常不完整，把未记录的发现当作"正常"会静默误分类患者；端到端 LLM 智能体也会过早下结论并问无关问题。
AI.method: 在 1200 个合成急诊病例、六个评分工具（HEART、CURB-65、qSOFA、PERC、Wells、Cockcroft-Gault）上，比较四种策略：边界策略（三态抽取+确定性代码算边界）、问所有缺失项、缺失即正常、端到端 LLM 智能体；模拟临床医生作答，并用 Claude Haiku 4.5 作抽取器、9B 本地模型测试。
AI.result: 边界策略与问所有缺失项准确率相同（99.4% vs 99.4%），但提问量减半（0.92 vs 1.78/例）且无无关提问；缺失即正常使准确率降至 91.2%、8.5% 患者被低分诊。智能体理想条件下准确率 99.6%，但 9.5% 提问无关，噪声医生下更差（83.5% vs 87.0%，p<0.001）、2.7% 过早下结论（边界为 0%）。9B 本地模型达 oracle 级 99.8%。584 份真实报告中仅 52% 信息足够定类（HEART 仅 13%）。
AI.conclusion: 让决策经由显式处理未知的代码，可避免过早下结论与无关提问、减半提问量，并可配合小型本地模型使用。

title: CT-OPD: Counterfactual Trace On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Vision-Language Models
summary: Diffusion vision-language models generate answers by gradually resolving masked tokens, making accurate conditional prediction in partially resolved states central to post-training. Masking completed answers yields coherent contexts and targets, but prescribed masks do not reflect the model's reveal decisions. Its trajectories capture these decisions, yet their provisional visible tokens can conflict with the target response. Outcome-based reinforcement learning follows these trajectories but provides only response-level feedback, which loses contrast when sampled rewards tie. To align coherent token-level supervision with the model's reveal decisions, we introduce Counterfactual Trace On-Policy Distillation (CT-OPD), which combines completed teacher responses with trajectory masks from the current student. CT-OPD retokenizes each teacher response in the student's vocabulary and extracts unresolved-position masks at successive stages of the student's reverse process. For each mask, it discards provisional rollout values and reconstructs the partial state from the teacher endpoint, so the supervised positions follow the current trajectory while the visible context and targets remain consistent with the same response. The student is trained on these reconstructed states with its native categorical loss, and trajectories are refreshed as the model evolves. Across dense and sparse diffusion architectures, CT-OPD consistently enhances multimodal understanding and reasoning capabilities, with gains of up to 9.80 points on the nine-benchmark average. On the unified understanding-and-generation architecture, it also improves both visual understanding and image generation, showing that the same principle transfers across architectures and modalities. Ablations further attribute these gains to coherent reconstruction and current-model trajectory masks.

AI.tldr: 提出CT-OPD方法，结合教师完整回答与当前学生模型轨迹掩码，训练扩散视觉语言模型，在多模态理解、推理及图像生成任务上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 扩散视觉语言模型通过逐步解掩码生成答案，其条件预测能力对后训练至关重要。但预设掩码无法反映模型的揭示决策，而基于结果的强化学习仅提供响应级反馈，奖励并列时失去对比信号。
AI.method: Counterfactual Trace On-Policy Distillation (CT-OPD)：结合教师完整回答与当前学生的轨迹掩码。将教师回答按学生词表重新分词，在学生反向过程各阶段提取未解决位置掩码；对每个掩码丢弃临时rollout值，从教师终点重建部分状态，使监督位置跟随当前轨迹而可见上下文与目标保持同一响应一致。用原生分类损失训练，并随模型演化刷新轨迹。
AI.result: 在密集与稀疏扩散架构上持续提升多模态理解与推理能力，九基准平均提升达9.80分；在统一理解-生成架构上同时改善视觉理解与图像生成，证明原理可跨架构与模态迁移。消融实验证实增益来自一致性重建与当前模型轨迹掩码。
AI.conclusion: CT-OPD通过将连贯的token级监督与模型自身的揭示决策对齐，有效提升扩散视觉语言模型的性能，具有良好的跨架构与跨模态通用性。

title: Decision-Sufficient State Representations: Measuring and Reducing Write-Time Regret
comment: 29 pages (10 main, 17 appendix), 12 figures (4 main, 8 appendix), 18 tables (2 main, 16 appendix)
summary: Long tasks produce more history than an LLM agent can hold in its context, and more than it uses reliably even when the history fits. A growing line of work therefore has agents carry a short written state instead: at every step a writer rewrites the state, and a reader acts from the state alone. Steps stay cheap, but anything the writer drops is lost before later decisions reveal that they need it. We quantify this loss and ask whether training can reduce it. Comparing the written state with the best state of the same size written in hindsight, we split the reader's loss into a budget loss, which any state of that size must incur, and a write-time regret, which comes from the writer's choices. In TextWorld cooking games where we control how long a fact must be carried before it is needed, a 128-token state holding the facts wins nearly every game, while prompted language-model writers win at most 17%. Almost all of the loss is write-time regret, and it grows with the delay. We then train the writer from the reader's own loss. DSSR (decision-sufficient state representations) scores candidate states by how well the reader acts after the writer carries them forward, and teaches the writer to prefer the better ones. This forward-rolled score predicts game outcomes ($ρ= 0.48$), whereas scoring a candidate as a fixed context, as hindsight methods usually do, does not ($ρ\leq 0.07$). On a pre-registered test split opened once, training adds +7.0 [+1.9, +12.2] points of success when facts are needed soon, bringing a plain summary writer to the level of belief- and slot-based memory prompts. The gain shrinks as the delay grows and is significant only at the shortest delay. We trace this limit to credit assignment: keeping a fact now pays off only if every later rewrite keeps it too, which a per-step score cannot see.

AI.tldr: 论文量化并试图减少"写入式状态"（written state）LLM智能体在长任务中的信息损失，提出通过读者自身损失训练写入者，但受限于延迟增长带来的信用分配问题。
AI.motivation: 长任务历史超出LLM上下文容量，即便能放入也难以可靠使用。因此需要智能体携带一个简短书面状态：写入者每步重写状态，读者仅凭状态行动。但写入者丢弃的信息之后可能需要，造成损失，本文量化该损失并探讨训练能否减少它。
AI.method: 将读者的损失分解为预算损失（同等大小状态下不可避免的部分）与写入时后悔（write-time regret，来自写入者选择）。在TextWorld烹饪游戏中控制事实需要被携带的时长进行实验。提出DSSR（decision-sufficient state representations）：用读者在写入者前推状态后的表现对候选状态打分，据此训练写入者偏好更优状态，并与将候选视为固定上下文的事后打分方法对比。
AI.result: 128-token含事实状态几乎必胜，而提示式语言模型写入者成功率至多17%，损失几乎全为写入时后悔且随延迟增大。前推打分预测游戏结果（ρ=0.48），而固定上下文式事后打分不能（ρ≤0.07）。在预注册测试集上，事实需要较早时训练带来+7.0 [+1.9, +12.2]点成功率提升，使普通摘要写入者达到信念/槽位记忆提示水平；但延迟增大后增益缩小。
AI.conclusion: 训练可减少写入时后悔，但受信用分配限制：当前保留某事实只有在后续每次重写都保留才有回报，而逐步打分无法捕捉这种长程依赖，因此增益随延迟增大而消失。

title: Understanding Clinical Cognitive Dialogues Using Large Language Models
summary: In-person cognitive assessment is both a test and an interaction. Clinicians explain tasks, repair misunderstandings, and adapt to patient responses, while patients may hesitate, seek clarification, or disengage. Yet clinical dialogue resources rarely label the interaction structure needed to study these behaviors at scale. We present an de-identified corpus of 33 cognitive assessment conversations with 8,250 utterances annotated for three speaker roles and 56 dialogue acts. We use this corpus to benchmark large language models on fine-grained dialogue-act classification and next-patient-utterance generation. We also test whether out-of-domain instruction data and explanation-augmented training transfer to this clinical setting. Instruction tuning produces the strongest patient-utterance reference matching and improves classification accuracy. Reasoning-aware fine-tuning produces the strongest classification results among the LLaMA-3.1-8B variants. However, even the best models struggle to separate closely related dialogue acts, showing that broad conversational intent is easier to recognize than fine-grained communicative function. The corpus and benchmark make interaction structure measurable in cognitive assessments and support follow-up work on conversational markers, clinician education, and carefully validated simulated patients. This work does not make diagnostic claims. Instead, it provides the data and evaluation framework needed to study these applications.

AI.tldr: 本文发布了一个包含33段认知评估对话、8,250条话语的脱敏语料库，标注了3种说话人角色和56种对话行为，并据此对LLM进行细粒度对话行为分类和下一句患者话语生成基准测试。
AI.motivation: 面对面认知评估既是测试也是互动，临床医生会解释任务、修复误解并适应患者反应，患者也会迟疑、寻求澄清或脱离互动。然而临床对话资源很少标注研究这些行为所需的互动结构，难以大规模研究。
AI.method: 构建脱敏语料库（33段对话、8,250条话语，标注3种说话人角色与56种对话行为）；用该语料库对LLM进行细粒度对话行为分类与下一句患者话语生成基准测试；测试域外指令数据和解释增强训练是否可迁移到该临床场景。
AI.result: 指令微调在患者话语参考匹配上表现最强并提升分类准确率；推理感知微调在LLaMA-3.1-8B各变体中分类结果最佳。但即便最佳模型也难以区分密切相关的对话行为，表明宽泛的会话意图比细粒度交际功能更易识别。
AI.conclusion: 该语料库与基准使认知评估中的互动结构可被测量，支持会话标记、临床医生教育及经验证模拟患者等后续研究。本工作不作出诊断性结论，仅提供研究这些应用所需的数据与评估框架。

title: Hierarchical Frequency-Domain Compression of Implicit Geometric Representations for Large-Scale Point Clouds
summary: Large-scale point cloud representations of complex geome tries incur prohibitive computational and memory costs, necessitating compressed implicit representations. To ad dress this, we propose a unified framework comprising im plicit geometric field representation, hierarchical frequency domain compression, and conditional high-frequency predic tion. Specifically, an unordered point cloud is mapped to an implicit field defined within its physical bounding box. A smooth Fourier pyramid is then constructed, where com pact low-frequency components capture the global geometry. Inter-scale high-frequency residuals are encoded to preserve the spatial information required for reconstructing fine geo metric details. To restore the high-frequency information lost during compression, we develop a hierarchical 3D neural net work. The reconstructed implicit field is converted back into a point cloud through isosurface extraction. Experiments on a complex-boundary point cloud with more than eight mil lion points demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a higher compression ratio than existing point cloud compres sion methods while maintaining comparable reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: 提出统一框架，通过隐式几何场、分层频域压缩与条件高频预测，实现大规模复杂几何点云的高压缩比表示与重建。
AI.motivation: 大规模复杂几何点云表示带来高昂的计算与内存开销，需要压缩的隐式表示来解决。
AI.method: 将无序点云映射到物理包围盒内的隐式场；构建平滑傅里叶金字塔，用紧致低频分量捕获全局几何，编码跨尺度高频残差以保留细节；设计分层3D神经网络恢复压缩中丢失的高频信息；再通过等值面提取将隐式场转回点云。
AI.result: 在超800万点的复杂边界点云上，压缩比高于现有点云压缩方法，同时保持相当的重建质量。
AI.conclusion: 该统一框架可有效压缩大规模点云，在高压缩比与重建质量间取得良好平衡。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Counterfactual Fragility and Demographic Bias in Clinical Evaluation of LLMs
summary: Clinical LLM evaluation often emphasizes answer accuracy; however, accuracy alone does not test counterfactual consistency or demographic robustness. We evaluated six LLMs on 150 MedQA USMLE questions using two automated perturbation tests to assess their performance. The counterfactual validity (CFV) test asked each model to make a minimal, plausible clinical change that would make a different answer correct. The demographic robustness test added six demographic prefixes to the same vignette and compared the answers and explanations with a no demographic baseline. Of the 900 CFV attempts, 228 (25.3 %) were valid and 672 were invalid. Across 5,400 demographic comparisons, 1,097 answers were changed (20.3%). Automated judging identified 3,128 stereotype evidence flags, including 1,932 in the broad Other category. MedGemma 27B achieved the highest accuracy (87.1%) and CFV (63.3%), lowest answer change rate (16.0%), and low mean Explanation Demographic Dissonance (EDD) score (0.169). However, its accuracy still exceeded its CFV, indicating that correct answers do not guarantee reliable performance on the counterfactual validity task. OpenBioLLM had the highest answer change rate and EDD, whereas GLM had the highest stereotype flag rate. These findings show that accuracy, CFV, answer stability, EDD, and stereotype evidence capture different evaluation aspects. Because all judgments were automated and no clinician validation was available, the results support safety screening but do not establish clinical deployability of the model.

AI.tldr: 该研究用反事实有效性(CFV)与人口统计稳健性两项扰动测试评估6个LLM在150道MedQA题上的表现，发现准确率并不能代表反事实一致性与人口统计稳健性，模型评价需多维度指标。
AI.motivation: 临床LLM评估常只强调答案准确率，但准确率无法检验反事实一致性或人口统计稳健性，可能导致对模型临床可靠性的误判。
AI.method: 在150道MedQA USMLE题上评测6个LLM，采用两种自动化扰动测试：1) CFV测试，要求模型做最小且合理的临床改动以使不同答案成立；2) 人口统计稳健性测试，在原题上加入6种人口统计前缀并与无人口统计基线比较答案与解释。共900次CFV尝试与5400次人口统计比较，全部判断为自动化。
AI.result: 900次CFV中仅228次(25.3%)有效，672次无效。5400次比较中1097次答案改变(20.3%)。自动判定产生3128个刻板印象证据标记，其中1932个属于宽泛的"其他"类别。MedGemma 27B准确率最高(87.1%)、CFV最高(63.3%)、答案改变率最低(16.0%)、解释人口统计失调(EDD)均值较低(0.169)，但其准确率仍高于CFV，说明正确答案不保证CFV任务可靠。OpenBioLLM答案改变率与EDD最高，GLM刻板印象标记率最高。
AI.conclusion: 准确率、CFV、答案稳定性、EDD与刻板印象证据反映不同评估维度，需综合使用。因全部判断自动化且无临床医生验证，结果仅支持安全筛查，尚不能确立模型的临床可部署性。

title: Word Similarity Datasets for Indian Languages: Annotation and Baseline Systems
summary: With the advent of word representations, word similarity tasks are becoming increasing popular as an evaluation metric for the quality of the representations. In this paper, we present manually annotated monolingual word similarity datasets of six Indian languages - Urdu, Telugu, Marathi, Punjabi, Tamil and Gujarati. These languages are most spoken Indian languages worldwide after Hindi and Bengali. For the construction of these datasets, our approach relies on translation and re-annotation of word similarity datasets of English. We also present baseline scores for word representation models using state-of-the-art techniques for Urdu, Telugu and Marathi by evaluating them on newly created word similarity datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了六种印度语言（乌尔都语、泰卢固语、马拉地语、旁遮普语、泰米尔语、古吉拉特语）的人工标注单语词相似度数据集，并给出了词表示模型的基线分数。
AI.motivation: 随着词表示的发展，词相似度任务成为评估表示质量的重要指标。然而，对于大多数印度语言而言，缺乏此类评估数据集，限制了这些语言词表示质量的评测。
AI.method: 通过对英语词相似度数据集进行翻译和重新标注，构建六种印度语言的单语词相似度数据集，并在新数据集上评估先进词表示模型（针对乌尔都语、泰卢固语、马拉地语）。
AI.result: 创建了六种印度语言的人工标注词相似度数据集，并为乌尔都语、泰卢固语和马拉地语提供了基于最新技术的词表示模型基线分数。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了主要印度语言词相似度评估资源的空白，为相关语言词表示质量的评测提供了基准数据。

title: Latent Space Is Not Flat: Rethinking Latent Structure for 3D Medical Image Synthesis
summary: Latent generative models make 3D medical image synthesis computationally practical by generating in a compressed space. However, we show that the common flat Euclidean assumption induced by $\ell_2$ objectives is imprecise: latent-space geometry is so strongly anisotropic that equal-magnitude errors can produce drastically different decoded distortions. We further find that this anisotropy has a clear feature: sensitive variation concentrates in a low-rank subspace. The dominant low-rank components capture the overall structure, encoding long-range, spatially coordinated variation while remaining resistant to local noise. Its orthogonal residual, in contrast, mainly captures local and image-specific variation. Motivated by this asymmetry, we introduce Latent Structure Flow (LSF). At each block, LSF decomposes the latent state into structure and residual, models structural changes with global context, and predicts residual variation locally while preserving a direct path for the input structure. LSF changes only the generator, leaving the frozen codec and pointwise training objective unchanged. Across cross-modality synthesis and tumor inpainting tasks, LSF outperforms all compared baselines on both global and tumor-specific metrics, demonstrating the benefit of explicitly modeling latent-space structure for 3D medical image synthesis.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示潜在生成模型中欧氏假设的局限，发现潜在空间几何呈强各向异性，敏感变化集中于低秩子空间。据此提出Latent Structure Flow (LSF)，在每块分解潜在状态为结构与残差，分别用全局上下文和局部方式建模，仅改进生成器。在多模态合成与肿瘤修复任务上均超越所有基线。
AI.motivation: 潜在生成模型在压缩空间生成3D医学图像虽高效，但其$\ell_2$目标隐含的平坦欧氏假设不准确：潜在空间几何高度各向异性，等幅误差会导致截然不同的解码失真。作者进一步发现该各向异性具有可被利用的结构——敏感变化集中于低秩子空间。
AI.method: 提出Latent Structure Flow (LSF)。在每个block将潜在状态分解为structure与residual：主导低秩成分编码长程、空间协调的整体结构，对局部噪声鲁棒；正交残差主要捕捉局部和图像特有变化。LSF用全局上下文建模结构变化，局部预测残差变化，同时为输入结构保留直接路径。仅改变生成器，冻结codec与逐点训练目标不变。
AI.result: 在跨模态合成和肿瘤修复任务中，LSF在全局指标与肿瘤特异性指标上均优于所有对比基线。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模潜在空间结构对3D医学图像合成有益，验证了利用潜在各向异性低秩特性的有效性。

title: Overwhelmed by Choice: Studying LLM Decision Making at Scale
comment: Accepted at TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation?, NeurIPS 2026 Workshop. 23 pages
summary: Multiple-choice and candidate-selection evaluations are widely used to assess LLM reasoning and decision-making, yet most benchmarks contain relatively small candidate sets. It remains unclear whether conclusions drawn from these settings remain valid as the candidate space scales. We systematically evaluate LLMs as the number of competing candidates increases and find substantial accuracy degradation across tasks, prompting strategies, and model scales. Controlled analyses show that standard long-context retrieval explanations cannot fully account for this degradation. Instead, we identify two systematic failure patterns. First, gold-margin collapse: the score gap between the correct answer and the strongest distractor progressively shrinks, driven primarily by weakening confidence in the correct answer. Second, earlier candidate preferences become increasingly difficult to overturn, with later candidates exerting progressively weaker influence on the final prediction. Motivated by these findings, we evaluate hierarchical partitioning and permutation-based inference, which improve accuracy by roughly 20 percentage points at $N=160$ on both HotpotQA and MIMIC. Overall, our results identify candidate-set scale as an important evaluation-protocol variable and show that strong small-option performance does not necessarily imply robust large-scale candidate comparison.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究候选集规模对LLM推理评估的影响，发现精度随候选数增加而显著下降，并提出两种失效模式及缓解方法。
AI.motivation: 多选与候选选择评估广泛用于衡量LLM推理，但现有基准候选集普遍较小，候选空间扩大后结论是否仍成立尚不明确。
AI.method: 系统评估LLM随竞争候选数增加的表现，跨任务、提示策略与模型规模分析；用受控实验排除长上下文检索解释；识别失效模式并评估层次划分与置换推断。
AI.result: 精度随候选数增加大幅下降；标准长上下文检索无法充分解释；发现“gold-margin collapse”（正确答案与最强干扰项分差缩小，主因是正确答案置信度减弱）和“早期候选偏好难以逆转”；层次划分与置换推断在N=160时于HotpotQA和MIMIC约提升20个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 候选集规模是重要评估协议变量；小选项上的强表现不代表大规模候选比较的稳健性。

title: Quantitative Measurement of Language Distance among Closely Related Indo-European Languages Using Pretrained Language Models: A Case Study on the North Germanic Branch
summary: Among closely related North Germanic languages, the quantification of language distance has traditionally relied on qualitative methods, lacking a unified multi-dimensional computational framework. Multilingual pretrained models based on the Transformer architecture can map texts from different languages into a shared vector space, enabling quantitative measurement of language distance. This paper focuses on the three North Germanic languages---Danish, Norwegian (Bokmål), and Swedish---and proposes a three-metric quantitative framework based on pretrained language models: (1)~sentence-level semantic distance, computed as cosine similarity between LaBSE and mBERT encodings of parallel sentences; (2)~orthographic fragmentation rate, measuring subword tokenization efficiency when cross-applying monolingual BERT vocabularies to parallel texts; (3)~MLM predictability, comparing prediction confidence and entropy in masked language modeling using mBERT across languages. Using 150 trilingual parallel sentence triplets from the Tatoeba corpus as controlled samples, we obtain consistent distance rankings on two independent models: LaBSE: da--no $0.012 < $ no--sv $0.016 < $ da--sv $0.020$; mBERT: da--no $0.016 < $ no--sv $0.045 \approx $ da--sv $0.046$. This ranking is consistent with the historical linguistic conclusion that ``400 years of Danish rule over Norway (1380--1814) led to highly cognate written languages.'' The three metrics---semantic, orthographic, and predictability---converge on the same conclusion, providing a reproducible computational framework for the quantitative study of distance among closely related languages, extensible in principle to more branches of the Indo-European language family, pending validation on additional language groups.

AI.tldr: 本文基于预训练语言模型（LaBSE、mBERT）提出三维度定量框架，测量丹麦语、挪威语（博克马尔）和瑞典语之间的语言距离，结果一致为 da–no < no–sv ≈ da–sv，印证了历史语言学结论。
AI.motivation: 北日耳曼语支语言间的距离量化传统依赖定性方法，缺乏统一的多维计算框架。
AI.method: 基于预训练模型提出三指标框架：(1) 句级语义距离（LaBSE/mBERT 平行句编码的余弦相似度）；(2) 拼写碎片化率（跨语言套用单语 BERT 词表衡量子词分词效率）；(3) MLM 可预测性（比较 mBERT 掩码语言建模的置信度与熵）。使用 Tatoeba 语料 150 组三语平行句作为样本。
AI.result: 两个模型上得出一致距离排序。LaBSE：da–no 0.012 < no–sv 0.016 < da–sv 0.020；mBERT：da–no 0.016 < no–sv 0.045 ≈ da–sv 0.046。
AI.conclusion: 语义、拼写、可预测性三个指标收敛于同一结论，与“丹麦统治挪威400年（1380–1814）致书面语高度同源”的历史语言学结论一致；提供可复现的近距离语言距离量化框架，原则上可扩展至印欧语系更多语支，尚需更多语族验证。

title: Progressive Risk Estimation for Accident Anticipation
summary: Accident anticipation aims to recognize anomalous driving cues before a crash while avoiding false alarms during normal driving. Existing approaches typically formulate this task as binary classification, focusing on whether an accident will occur rather than when it will occur. We propose PRE-ACT, a framework that models accident risk as a continuously evolving signal that increases as the crash approaches. By explicitly enforcing temporal ordering and distance-to-accident awareness, our method progressively raises risk while suppressing premature alarms, leading to significant improvements on MM-AU subsets and Nexar. We further introduce a Separation Score to evaluate the global behavior of predicted risk curves beyond local temporal windows. Code and visualizations are available at https://github.com/giddyyupp/PRE-ACT.

AI.tldr: PRE-ACT将事故预测建模为随时间演进、逐步上升的风险信号，强调"何时发生"而非仅"是否发生"，在MM-AU子集和Nexar上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有事故预测方法多将任务视为二分类，只关注事故是否发生，而忽略了事故发生的时间信息，容易产生误报。
AI.method: 提出PRE-ACT框架，将事故风险建模为随事故临近而连续增长的风险信号；通过显式约束时间顺序和距事故远近的感知，使风险逐步上升并抑制过早报警；并引入Separation Score评估预测风险曲线的全局行为。
AI.result: 在MM-AU子集和Nexar数据集上取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 将事故预测从二分类转为时间演进的风险信号建模，可有效提升预测性能并减少误报，代码与可视化已开源。

title: Right Answer, Wrong Reason: Accuracy, Consistency, and Consensus Are Misleading Indicators of LLM Faithfulness in Clinical Decision Support
comment: Accepted and received best paper award from ICETCI 2026 Conference, https://ietcint.com/
summary: Clinical Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong medical-exam accuracy; however, a correct answer does not guarantee that the explanation names the concepts that actually drove the decision. We introduce three lightweight, directly interpretable metrics for this faithfulness gap: the Explanation Stability Index (ESI), which measures reasoning consistency across repeated queries; the Causal Faithfulness Score (CFS), which tests whether cited concepts drive predictions via concept ablation; and the Perturbation Stability Score (PSS), which measures robustness to semantic-preserving paraphrases. By evaluating six LLMs on 150 MedQA-USMLE questions (900 model-question observations), we found that only 23.3% of the cited clinical concepts were causally necessary. Correct answers had lower CFS than incorrect answers (0.212 vs. 0.398), answer consistency negatively predicted CFS (Spearman r = -0.466), and model pairs could agree on answers while sharing only 8.8% of cited reasoning concepts. These results show that accuracy, consistency, and consensus are incomplete safety signals for clinical decision-making support. The evidence is behavioral rather than mechanistic: concept ablation tests counterfactual sensitivity of outputs, not internal circuits.

AI.tldr: 论文指出临床大语言模型的高考试准确率并不代表其解释忠实：仅23.3%的被引用临床概念具有因果必要性，准确率、一致性与共识都是不完整的安全信号。
AI.motivation: 现有临床LLM虽在医学考试上准确率很高，但"答案正确"不等于"解释中引用的概念真正驱动了决策"，即存在解释忠实性缺口，而缺乏轻量、可直接解释的度量工具。
AI.method: 提出三个可解释指标：解释稳定性指数(ESI，衡量重复查询下推理一致性)、因果忠实性分数(CFS，通过概念消融检验所引用概念是否驱动预测)、扰动稳定性分数(PSS，衡量对语义保持改写的鲁棒性)；在150道MedQA-USMLE题目上评估6个LLM，共900个模型-题目观测。
AI.result: 仅23.3%的被引用临床概念具有因果必要性；正确答案的CFS低于错误答案(0.212 vs. 0.398)；答案一致性与CFS负相关(Spearman r = -0.466)；不同模型可在答案上一致但仅共享8.8%的推理概念。
AI.conclusion: 准确率、一致性和共识不足以作为临床决策支持的安全信号。证据是行为层面的：概念消融检验的是输出的反事实敏感性，而非内部回路机制。

title: Toward a Graded Measure of Belief Stability in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate how people access and reason with information, yet factual reliability is usually evaluated one judgment at a time. We introduce graded belief stability, a relational measure of how well a belief persists within an LLM's broader belief system. Unlike individual belief probability, it asks whether support for a claim persists when that claim is considered alongside the model's other epistemic commitments. We operationalize this idea with a Direct Conditional estimator that uses internal model representations to estimate conditional belief probabilities. Across 12 LLMs and three domains, lower-stability beliefs exhibit greater mean behavioral movement under conversational challenge in 83.3% of model-domain settings after matching on individual belief probability. Graded belief stability therefore extends reliability assessment beyond how strongly an LLM supports a claim to how robustly that belief is supported within its broader system of beliefs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"分级信念稳定性"（graded belief stability），一种衡量LLM信念在其整体信念体系中持久性的关系型指标，并用"直接条件估计器"实现，发现低稳定性信念更易在对话挑战下发生行为改变。
AI.motivation: LLM日益成为人们获取和推理信息的媒介，但事实可靠性通常被逐个判断地评估，忽略了信念之间的关系结构。作者希望从"模型对某主张支持强度"转向"该信念在整体信念体系中是否稳固地被支撑"。
AI.method: 提出分级信念稳定性，作为信念在LLM信念系统内持久程度的关系型度量；不同于单个信念概率，它考察当该主张与模型其他认知承诺一起被考虑时支持是否仍存在。用"直接条件估计器"（Direct Conditional estimator）借助模型内部表示估计条件信念概率。
AI.result: 在12个LLM和三个领域上，在匹配单信念概率后，低稳定性信念在83.3%的模型-领域设置中表现出更大的对话挑战下平均行为变动。
AI.conclusion: 分级信念稳定性将可靠性评估从"LLM对主张的支持有多强"扩展到"该信念在更广泛信念体系中得到多稳固的支撑"。

title: USAI-Quant: A Quantitative Reasoning Benchmark for Vision-Language Models in Built Environments
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for urban and spatial AI. However, current state-of-the-art large VLMs still struggle with quantitative reasoning on remote sensing imagery. Existing benchmarks and algorithms are predominantly based on qualitative Visual Question Answering (VQA), providing limited insights into the quantitative reasoning capabilities of VLMs for built environment metrics. To address this gap, we develop Quantitative Urban and Spatial AI benchmark (USAI-Quant), the first benchmark designed to quantitatively evaluate VLM's reasoning capabilities on built environment metrics via remote sensing imagery. USAI-Quant is curated from the 335 largest U.S. cities, aligning high-resolution remote sensing images with quantitative built environment metrics. We then evaluate both general-purpose and remote sensing VLMs (RS-VLMs) by applying VQAs to tens of built environment metrics across three complexity levels. Our results reveal that current state-of-the-art models consistently fall short on numeric reasoning tasks. We further conduct in-depth analyses across models, question types, and geographic locations, uncovering insights into performance variability and task-specific challenges.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出USA I-Quant，首个用于定量评估视觉语言模型（VLM）在遥感影像上推理建成环境指标能力的基准，发现当前最先进模型在数值推理任务上普遍表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在城市与空间AI中表现强大，但在遥感影像的定量推理上仍有困难。现有基准和算法主要基于定性VQA，无法充分揭示VLM在建成环境指标上的定量推理能力。
AI.method: 构建USA I-Quant基准，从美国335个最大城市采集数据，将高分辨率遥感影像与定量建成环境指标对齐；对通用VLM和遥感专用VLM（RS-VLM）进行评测，围绕数十个建成环境指标设计三个复杂度层级的VQA任务。
AI.result: 当前最先进模型在数值推理任务上持续表现不足。论文进一步从模型、问题类型和地理位置等维度进行深入分析，揭示了性能差异和任务特定挑战。
AI.conclusion: USA I-Quant填补了定量评估VLM建成环境推理能力的基准空白，表明现有模型在定量遥感推理上仍有明显短板，为该方向后续研究提供了评测基础与洞察。

title: When Can First-Order Models of Fine-Tuning Bound Forgetting?
summary: Fine-tuning a language model on new data can make it forget facts that it should keep. We ask whether measurements taken at the start of a fine-tuning run can bound, for each protected fact, the probability that the run makes the model forget it. In LoRA fine-tuning with stochastic gradient descent on models from 0.6B to 14B parameters, a first-order response model estimated by finite-difference probes predicts changes of per-fact margins with correlation 0.974-0.998. Predictions of forgetting built on this model nevertheless failed, because forgetting requires parameter changes far outside the region in which the model was validated. The probes can, however, bound the probability that a margin first falls below a boundary near zero: we derive Freedman and Azuma first-passage bounds for a linear surrogate of the margin and test on new runs whether they hold for the model. The bounds contain a term R that measures how much the response coefficients change during the run. The simplified Freedman bound, which sets R = 0, certified most facts but was violated in 14 of 112 conditions, and every fact on which it was violated had R >= a, where a is the distance of the fact's margin to the boundary. The complete Freedman bound certifies only facts with R < a, and it held in every condition. On the violated facts, the spread of the margin across test runs was a median of 14.6 times the prediction of the response model, so the failures are breakdowns of the model, and in our data they occurred only where R >= a. We found this pattern post hoc and tested it in two preregistered confirmatory studies with 43 new conditions: the complete bound held in all of them, and the simplified bound failed there on only 3 facts, each with R >= a. First-order models of fine-tuning can thus bound forgetting on the facts whose response coefficients change by less than their distance to the boundary.

AI.tldr: 对0.6B-14B模型LoRA微调中，用有限差分探针估计一阶响应模型（相关性0.974-0.998），推导Freedman/Azuma首达界预测遗忘概率。完整Freedman界在所有条件（含43个预注册新条件）成立，仅当响应系数变化R小于到边界距离a时有效。
AI.motivation: 微调会使语言模型遗忘应保留的事实。作者探究能否在微调开始时对每个受保护事实预测其遗忘概率，为遗忘提供可认证的理论下界/上界。
AI.method: 在0.6B-14B模型的LoRA+SGD微调中，用有限差分探针估计一阶响应模型，预测逐事实margin变化。基于该模型推导Freedman和Azuma首达界（针对margin的线性代理），并引入R衡量响应系数变化。用两个预注册确认研究（43个新条件）检验。
AI.result: 一阶模型预测margin变化相关性0.974-0.998，但直接预测遗忘失败（遗忘需超出验证区域的参数变化）。简化Freedman界（R=0）认证多数事实但在112条件中14个被违反，所有违反处均有R>=a。完整Freedman界仅在R<a时认证，且在所有条件成立。违反处margin跨运行方差中位数为预测的14.6倍。43个新条件中完整界全部成立，简化界仅3个失败均R>=a。
AI.conclusion: 一阶微调模型可对响应系数变化小于其到边界距离（R<a）的事实给出遗忘概率界；当R>=a时模型崩溃，界限失效。该模式为事后发现并经预注册确认。

title: LLMs are not stochastic parrots: Evidence for meaning-mediated abstraction from conlang-like tasks
summary: The strong version of the stochastic parrot argument claims that, although large language models (LLMs) may exceed rote regurgitation, they cannot move beyond statistical pattern matching into abstraction or reasoning, remaining ontologically near the lower bound of pattern reuse despite producing alluringly fluent text. We test this hypothesis using conlang-like tasks. Several LLMs are given only natural-language descriptions of fictional languages that subvert prominent superficial patterns in training data by combining statistically uncommon and unattested features. Crucially, no example outputs are given. We argue that if the models exhibit rule-following behaviour, they cannot be relying solely on superficial statistical patterns; such patterns often work against the correct output. Instead, successful performance requires representations of the constraints specified in the prompt. Across three complementary task families, models systematically move in the meaning-predicted direction: they distinguish prompt exposure from instructed use, alter semantic relationships in response to novel constraints, and sometimes produce exact matches to complex translation answer keys. Although performance varies across the spectrum of models used, these results provide evidence for meaning-mediated abstraction in LLMs and refute the strong stochastic parrot hypothesis. Our work shows that, under appropriate architectural and contextual constraints, statistical learning can produce meaning-mediated abstractions, although generation remains strongly constrained by superficial plausibility. We discuss implications for model development and for understanding how increasingly abstract representations may emerge from plausible-text-generation objectives.

AI.tldr: 该论文用"人造语言"(conlang-like)任务测试大语言模型能否超越表层统计模式匹配。结果显示模型能遵循仅由自然语言描述的虚构语言规则，进行意义中介的抽象，从而反驳"强随机鹦鹉假说"。
AI.motivation: "强随机鹦鹉假说"认为LLM只能进行统计模式匹配，无法达到抽象或推理层面。作者希望严格检验这一假说，判断模型是否只是依赖表层统计规律。
AI.method: 给多个LLM仅提供虚构语言的自然语言描述，这些语言刻意组合了训练数据中罕见且未出现的特征，以对抗表层统计模式；且不提供任何示例输出。设计三个互补任务族，检验模型是否表现出规则遵循行为。
AI.result: 模型系统性地朝意义预测的方向移动：能区分"提示中的暴露"与"指令要求的使用"、依据新约束改变语义关系，有时还能精确匹配复杂的翻译答案。不同模型表现存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持LLM存在意义中介的抽象，反驳强随机鹦鹉假说；表明在适当架构与上下文约束下，统计学习可产生意义中介的抽象，但生成仍受表层合理性强烈限制。对模型开发及抽象表征如何从文本生成目标中涌现具有启示意义。

title: Unlocking Geodesic Gromov-Wasserstein Distances for 3D Modeling
summary: \textit{Gromov-Wasserstein Distances} (GWDs) provide quantitative ways of comparing probabilistic distributions defined on different metric spaces by applying techniques from the optimal transport theory. As such, GWD can be potentially useful in a large variety of applications ranging from graph matching problems to 3D object detection. However its practical use at scale is significantly limited by cubic time complexity computations involving dense intra-space distance matrices. Even though in the Euclidean metric spaces several techniques (e.g. involving scalable kernel methods) were proposed to address it, to the best of our knowledge, analogous techniques for general geodesic distances on manifolds, or shortest-path distance on graphs in their discretized variants, were not developed. In this paper, we present \textbf{E}fficient \textbf{G}eodesic \textbf{Gro}mov-\textbf{W}asserstein methods (EGGroW), a new class of efficient algorithms designed to calculate geodesic Gromov-Wasserstein distances with entropic Sinkhorn-like approaches, leveraging recently introduced \textit{GenusSink} methods \citep{genussink} and the theory of random features. We provide important downstream applications, namely: 3D pose estimation and 3D template detection. In the latter setting, we formulate a partial 3D template recovery as a staged problem: capacity-constrained scene selection is followed by semi-relaxed recovery of template visibility and correspondence. Our empirical findings show that EGGroW provides accurate solutions when standard Euclidean-based techniques fail and is characterized by light computational footprint, as our theoretical analysis predicts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EGGroW算法，利用随机特征和GenusSink方法高效计算流形/图上的测地Gromov-Wasserstein距离，打破立方复杂度瓶颈，并应用于3D姿态估计与模板检测。
AI.motivation: Gromov-Wasserstein距离可跨不同度量空间比较概率分布，应用潜力大（图匹配、3D目标检测等），但其涉及稠密空间内距离矩阵，立方时间复杂度限制了大规模实际使用。欧氏空间已有可扩展核方法，但一般流形上的测地距离或图的离散最短路距离尚无类似技术。
AI.method: 提出EGGroW（Efficient Geodesic Gromov-Wasserstein）算法族，结合近期提出的GenusSink方法与随机特征理论，用熵正则化Sinkhorn式方法高效计算测地Gromov-Wasserstein距离。对3D模板检测，将部分模板恢复建模为分阶段问题：容量约束的场景选择，随后半松弛地恢复模板可见性与对应关系。
AI.result: EGGroW在标准欧氏方法失效时仍能给出准确解，且计算开销轻，与理论分析预测一致；在3D姿态估计和3D模板检测任务上验证有效。
AI.conclusion: EGGroW为一般测地距离下的Gromov-Wasserstein计算提供了高效可扩展方案，拓展了其在大规模流形与图数据上的实际应用。

title: Rank Collapse Is Recoverable, Growing $|Q|$ Is Not: Out-of-Sample Early Warning for Value Divergence in High-UTD Soft Actor-Critic
summary: Raising the update-to-data (UTD) ratio breaks off-policy critics in two ways grouped as "plasticity loss": collapsing representations and growing value magnitude $|Q|$. We separate them in Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) with scaled critics (width 2048, no normalization). Collapse is survivable: at UTD ratio 16, HalfCheetah critics with most units dormant keep learning, and the training guard, which stops runs whose loss or $|Q|$ explodes, never flags them. Within one high-UTD SAC configuration, runs start close together, and how far a critic's $\log_{10}|Q|$ has climbed by step 15k, its early growth, ranks the runs by how soon the guard flags them. At 15k, a flagged run's $|Q|$ sits a median of over a hundredfold below its flag level, yet the climb's rate already orders the flags (Harrell's C and out-of-sample AUC 0.78 on Walker2d, 0.98 on Ant, at UTD ratio 4). Dormancy does not. Aborting on this rate saves about a tenth of held-out Walker2d compute and stays net-positive live. A LayerNorm critic lowers the rate, removes the flag on Walker2d at UTD ratio 4 and lowers the return.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究高UTD比下off-policy critic的"塑性损失"，将其拆分为表示坍缩与|Q|值膨胀两类，并发现|Q|的早期增长率可预测训练崩溃（guard flag）。
AI.motivation: 提高update-to-data (UTD)比率会使off-policy critic出现"塑性损失"，表现为两种问题：表示坍缩（collapsing representations）与值幅度|Q|膨胀。作者希望区分这两类失效机制，并找到可用于预警训练崩溃的早期信号。
AI.method: 在Soft Actor-Critic中采用scaled critics（宽度2048、无归一化）将两类问题分离。在不同UTD比率（4、16）下训练HalfCheetah、Walker2d、Ant等任务，观察critic的休眠单元比例与log10|Q|的早期增长速率，并与训练guard（因loss或|Q|爆炸而停止训练）的触发情况做关联分析，使用Harrell's C和out-of-sample AUC评估预测能力。
AI.result: 坍缩是可存活的：UTD=16时，多数单元休眠的HalfCheetah critic仍在学习，guard从不标记它们。在一个高UTD SAC配置中，各run起始接近，critic的log10|Q|在15k步的爬升幅度（早期增长率）可对各run被guard标记的早晚排序（UTD=4时Walker2d的C与AUC为0.78，Ant为0.98），而休眠程度则无此预测力。15k时被标记的run其|Q|中位数低于flag水平一百倍以上，但增长率已能预测。基于该速率提前中止可节省约十分之一的留出Walker2d计算且净收益为正。LayerNorm critic会降低该速率，在UTD=4时消除Walker2d的flag，但降低回报。
AI.conclusion: 高UTD下critic的两类塑性损失可被分离，其中|Q|早期增长速率是预测训练崩溃的有效、可操作的信号，且基于此的提前中止有净收益。LayerNorm虽能缓解崩溃flag但损害回报，说明简单归一化并非理想方案。

title: USA: Update-aware SAM for Cross-domain On-Policy Disitllation of Language Agents
summary: On-policy distillation instils multi-turn agentic reasoning through dense token-level supervision on the student's own trajectories, but a single domain saturates early, so further supervision has to be drawn from other domains. Multi-domain data mixing is the most direct way of incorporating them, at the cost of conflicts between their data distributions and of retraining the entire model whenever one domain is revised. Model merging avoids both by distilling every domain independently and fusing the resulting task vectors afterwards. We find instead that the benefit polarizes across domain pairs: on those exhibiting negative transfer, every merging operator we evaluate falls below the single-domain reference. We attribute this to cross-domain update coupling, where a substantial fraction of coordinates is updated comparably by both domains and a merge can therefore displace them by as much as their own updates. To overcome this limitation, we propose USA, which converts per-parameter update magnitudes measured during a brief warm-up into per-coordinate perturbation radii, reducing curvature precisely on the coordinates that carry most of the merging displacement. Experiments across mathematics, science and code at two student scales show USA strongest in all six transfer directions, ahead of the single-domain reference by more than four points on average, and reverse the negative transfer of the conflicting pairs.

AI.tldr: 提出USA方法，通过将每参数更新幅度转换为每坐标扰动半径，减小合并位移最大坐标上的曲率，解决多领域on-policy蒸馏中模型合并在负迁移领域对上失败的问题。
AI.motivation: 单领域on-policy蒸馏会早期饱和，需引入其他领域监督，但多领域数据混合存在分布冲突和改一个领域就需重训全模型的问题。模型合并虽能避免这两点，却因跨领域更新耦合（两领域相当程度地更新相同坐标）导致负迁移领域对上每类合并算子都不如单领域基线。
AI.method: USA将短预热期测得的每参数更新幅度转化为每坐标的扰动半径，从而在承载最多合并位移的坐标上降低曲率。
AI.result: 在数学、科学、代码三个领域、两种学生规模、全部六个迁移方向上，USA均表现最强，平均超过单领域基线4分以上，并逆转了冲突领域对的负迁移。
AI.conclusion: USA通过基于更新幅度的曲率调制，克服了模型合并中的跨领域更新耦合问题，为多领域on-policy蒸馏提供了一种有效且无需重训的合并方案。

title: VCRE-Fib: View-Conditioned Regional Evidence for Fine-Grained Ultrasound Grading of Schistosoma japonicum-Associated Liver Fibrosis
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, including appendices. Submitted to ICLR 2027. Code: https://github.com/StatXzy7/vcre-fib
summary: Accurate assessment of Schistosoma japonicum-associated liver fibrosis is essential for disease management and long-term follow-up in endemic regions. Ultrasound provides non-invasive imaging, but complex local echogenic patterns and anatomical structures make fine-grained grading challenging. Existing deep learning methods can predict fibrosis scores, yet directly incorporating acquisition views and regional cues into grading while retaining spatial information for inspection remains an open problem. Here we present VCRE-Fib, a view-conditioned regional evidence framework that integrates anatomical context, local information, and global image assessment for fine-grained ultrasound grading. The framework forms view-conditioned local grading evidence before spatial pooling, uses weak localization to guide its aggregation, and combines it with global predictions. Image-only inference jointly returns a fibrosis score, acquisition view, and candidate abnormal-region map. We developed and evaluated the method on a re-curated cohort of 108,709 ultrasound images from 6,373 patients across 35 centers. On a patient-disjoint test set of 4,107 images from 240 patients across four centers, VCRE-Fib reduced the prespecified composite grading risk by 7.115% relative to SFibAI trained and evaluated on the same data split. Image-level mean absolute error decreased from 0.391 to 0.378, alongside lower patient-max, patient-median, and center-balanced risks. The full model also achieved lower composite grading risk than variants that separately removed view conditioning or weak localization. These results support incorporating anatomical context and regional evidence into ultrasound grading while exposing spatial predictions for inspection alongside severity estimates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VCRE-Fib——一种视角条件化的区域证据框架，用于日本血吸虫相关肝纤维化的细粒度超声分级，在 10 万余张多中心图像上降低了分级风险。
AI.motivation: 血吸虫病相关肝纤维化的准确评估对疾病管理和随访至关重要。超声虽无创，但局部回声模式与解剖结构复杂，细粒度分级困难；现有深度学习方法难以同时融合采集视角与区域线索并保留空间信息供人工检查。
AI.method: VCRE-Fib 融合解剖上下文、局部信息与全局图像评估：在空间池化前形成视角条件化的局部分级证据，利用弱定位指导证据聚合，并与全局预测结合；仅图像推理即可同时输出纤维化评分、采集视角与候选异常区域图。
AI.result: 在 35 个中心、6,373 名患者的 108,709 张超声图像上开发与评估。在四中心 240 名患者、4,107 张图像的跨患者测试集上，复合分级风险较同数据划分训练的 SFibAI 降低 7.115%；图像级 MAE 由 0.391 降至 0.378，患者最大值、患者中位数及中心均衡风险均更低。完整模型优于去除视角条件化或弱定位的变体。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在超声分级中引入解剖上下文与区域证据，并同时输出可供检查的空间预测与严重度估计。

title: Routing Drift Alone Does Not Diagnose Failure in Merged MoE LLMs
summary: Model merging efficiently combines specialized large language models (LLMs) without joint retraining, but can substantially alter expert routing in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. Such \emph{routing drift} is often interpreted as routing failure, raising a fundamental question that remains unclear: \emph{does routing drift after MoE merging actually indicate routing failure, and what evidence should justify repair?} We investigate these questions across DeepSeekMoE, OLMoE, and Qwen3-MoE proposing a routing analysis toolkit for controlled counterfactual interventions and token-level analysis. By crossing source and merged router inputs and parameters, we attribute most expert reassignments to input shifts rather than parameter changes at the same layer. However, source-relative routing differences poorly predict next-token likelihood gains from source-route restoration, and different expert selections can produce directionally similar mixture outputs. We therefore operationalize routing failure as \textit{task loss recoverable under a specified routing intervention, with non-routing parameters fixed.} These tests detect recoverable loss under deliberate router corruption, whereas source-route restoration does not establish reliable task benefits in the evaluated merged models. Motivated by these, we propose \emph{Selective Router Repair (SRR)} as a case study, and find that source-specialist token-likelihood advantages do not reliably identify beneficial local corrections. Together, these findings show that \textbf{routing drift alone is insufficient evidence of routing failure}: source-informed corrections must be judged by their task-level intervention effects. The analysis toolkit and SRR code are released.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究MoE模型合并后的"路由漂移"是否真意味着路由失败，提出路由分析工具包和选择性路由修复(SRR)，结论是路由漂移本身不足以证明路由失败。
AI.motivation: 模型合并能高效组合专家LLM而无需联合重训练，但会显著改变MoE模型中的专家路由。路由漂移常被解读为路由失败，但这一问题尚不明确：漂移是否真的代表失败，以及需要什么证据才能证明修复的必要性。
AI.method: 在DeepSeekMoE、OLMoE、Qwen3-MoE上提出路由分析工具包，支持受控反事实干预和token级分析；通过交叉源与合并后的路由输入和参数进行归因分析；将路由失败操作化为"在非路由参数固定时，特定路由干预可恢复的任务损失"；并提出选择性路由修复(SRR)作为案例研究。
AI.result: 多数专家重分配归因于输入偏移而非同层参数变化；源相对路由差异难以预测恢复源路由带来的下一token似然增益；不同专家选择可产生方向相似的混合输出；在故意破坏路由时可检测到可恢复损失，但恢复源路由未能在所评估的合并模型中获得可靠任务收益；源专家token似然优势不能可靠识别有益的局部修正。
AI.conclusion: 路由漂移本身不足以作为路由失败的证据；基于源信息的修正必须通过任务级干预效果来评判，而非仅凭路由差异。

title: MAS-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Multi-agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) split a task across specialized roles and are promising on complex tasks, yet a prevailing approach relies on inference-time orchestration alone. General-purpose APIs are costly and hard to customize, while small models with role prompts rarely develop stable role competence or reliable collaboration, so post-training a MAS jointly is central. Most attempts use reinforcement learning, whose team-level reward leaves undetermined which step of which agent brought about the outcome, while local rewards need redesigning per task. On-policy distillation (OPD) gives token-level teacher supervision on trajectories the student samples, a denser signal needing no local reward, yet is underexplored for the interdependent agents of a MAS. Two difficulties arise: building complementary specialization from a judgement of which role a behavior belongs to while preserving the knowledge all roles need, and turning cross-agent collaborative information into supervision OPD can exploit. We present MAS-OPD, where Role-Advantage Specialization defines the role advantage as the difference between the teacher signals under target and non-target role conditions, and Privileged Attribution for Coordination attributes an interaction conflict to its source and supplies it to the teacher alone as privileged information.
