We study this decision through mechanistic analysis, framing hallucination as unsupported commitment: the model commits despite exhibiting signals of unanswerability. Using causal gating, we identify a Commit-Abstain Circuit (CAC), a sparse, causally localised subset of attention heads and MLP sublayers underlying this decision. Across ten LMs (3B-14B) from five families and three benchmarks, the CAC exhibits a recurring accumulate-yet-undercorrect pattern: commitment-promoting components build up commitment in earlier layers, while abstention-promoting components act later as corrective signals that are often insufficient to overturn the accumulated commitment. Building on this finding, a lightweight policy trained on CAC activations improves decision accuracy by 12.2 points over the model's intrinsic commit-abstain margin, reduces false abstentions by 2.5 times, transfers to unseen benchmarks, and extends to larger models (27B-35B). The CAC is both diagnostic, clarifying how models overcommit, and practical, enabling improved abstention decisions.

AI.tldr: 通过机制分析揭示语言模型"承诺-弃答"决策背后的电路，并提出轻量策略改进弃答。
AI.motivation: 语言模型常在有信心地作答与弃答之间选择作答，即便信息不足；已有工作多用检测/弃答机制缓解幻觉，但未揭示模型内部如何做出承诺或弃答的决策。
AI.method: 将幻觉视为"无支撑承诺"，用因果门控（causal gating）识别承诺-弃答电路（CAC）——一组稀疏、因果局部化的注意力头与MLP子层。在5个家族10个LM（3B–14B）和3个基准上分析，并基于CAC激活训练轻量策略。
AI.result: CAC呈现"累积却纠正不足"模式：早期层组件推高承诺，后期弃答组件作为纠正信号常不足以逆转。基于CAC激活的策略将决策准确率提升12.2点，假弃答减少2.5倍，可迁移到未见基准并扩展到更大模型（27B–35B）。
AI.conclusion: CAC既具诊断价值（解释模型为何过度承诺），又具实用性（改进弃答决策），为理解并缓解幻觉提供机制化路径。

title: Zero-Shot Cue-Grounded Topic Segmentation of Spoken Documents
summary: Topic segmentation structures spoken documents into coherent sections, facilitating navigation and downstream understanding. The appropriate granularity can vary substantially, ranging from broad thematic shifts to fine-grained subtopics. Existing LLM-based segmenters, however, often struggle to adapt to this variation, causing them to either merge distinct subtopics or over-segment coherent themes. To address this, we introduce Cue-Grounded Segmentation (CGS), a training-free framework that operates without any task-specific supervision. CGS first identifies phrases that explicitly signal the start of a new topic and uses their sentence positions as segment boundaries. When such cues are insufficient, it falls back to semantic segmentation, guided by the document structure inferred during cue extraction. Across six benchmarks and six LLM backbones, CGS consistently outperforms existing baselines, remains robust to noisy ASR transcripts, and achieves these gains with low API cost on proprietary models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Cue-Grounded Segmentation (CGS)，一个无需训练、无需任务监督的话题分割框架，通过显式话题起始短语+语义分割回退策略适应不同分割粒度，在六个基准和六个LLM骨干上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 话题分割需将口语文档结构化为连贯片段。合适的分割粒度差异很大，从宽泛主题转换到细粒度子话题。现有基于LLM的分割器难以适应这种变化，要么合并不同子话题，要么过度切分连贯主题。
AI.method: CGS是免训练框架。首先识别明确指示新话题开始的短语，用其句子位置作为分割边界；当线索不足时，回退到语义分割，并由线索提取阶段推断出的文档结构进行引导。
AI.result: 在六个基准和六个LLM骨干上，CGS持续优于现有基线，对噪声ASR转录保持鲁棒，并在专有模型上以低API成本实现上述收益。
AI.conclusion: CGS通过线索驱动的边界检测与结构引导的语义回退，实现了免训练、低成本且粒度自适应的话题分割，验证了其有效性与鲁棒性。

title: Certified Interface Aliases: Exact Collisions in Vision-Language Preprocessing, and When They Exist
summary: Vision-language verifiers and routers must distinguish errors repairable by more reasoning from those caused by visual evidence never reaching the language model. This distinction lacks ground truth because annotators see full-resolution images while models receive preprocessed tensors. We introduce AliasForge to create cases where the relevant fact is provably absent from the interface. Fixed-point resampling makes the pre-rounding resize an exact integer linear map that can send nonzero integer perturbations to zero. Hiding a label-flipping perturbation there produces images with opposite step-correctness labels but bit-identical interface states. Every verifier therefore has the same output law on both members, giving pair-balanced accuracy exactly one half and zero gain from language-side repair. We prove that every fixed-point downscaler has such null vectors and bound their smallest size at the most common ratios, which rules out an 8-bit fit whenever the bound exceeds 255. From the resize configuration alone, a lattice criterion supplies realizable collisions and certifies their absence within the specified construction family. It resolves all 20 screened configurations, 17 as constructible and 3 as non-constructible. We construct certified pairs across three architectures and certify four additional processors, with zero decision-logit gap on all 18 scored pairs and none of the 18 controls. The pairs also screen routers that waste computation on re-attention or further reasoning. On natural items, per-item routing headroom exists, but no tested interface-only router improves over stopping. Our fiber ceiling bounds the headroom recoverable from the interface. Code: https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/aliasforge.

AI.tldr: 提出 AliasForge，构造视觉事实在接口层可证缺失的样本对，证明定点重采样必然产生零化碰撞，从而给出验证器/路由器准确率上限并筛除仅靠界面信号的路由。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言验证器与路由器需区分「可修复的推理错误」与「视觉证据未到达语言模型」的错误，但缺乏真实标注：标注者看全分辨率图像，模型只收到预处理张量，二者信息不对称。
AI.method: 利用定点重采样使取整前的缩放成为整数线性映射，可将非零整数扰动映射为零（零向量）。在该处隐藏翻转标签的扰动，得到步骤正确性标签相反、接口状态逐位相同的图像对（AliasForge）；证明每个定点下采样器都存在此类零向量，并给出常见比例下最小规模上界，上界超 255 即排除 8-bit 拟合；用格判据从缩放配置直接给出可实现碰撞及可证不存在性。
AI.result: 20 个配置全部判定：17 个可构造、3 个不可构造；在三种架构上构造认证样本对，另认证四个处理器，18 个计分对决策 logit 差为零，18 个对照均无此现象；样本对可筛除在重注意/再推理上浪费算力的路由器；自然样本上存在逐项路由空间，但无纯接口路由器优于「直接停止」。
AI.conclusion: 接口信息缺失导致验证器在构造对上任一输出律相同、准确率恰为 1/2，语言端修复收益为零；fibre 上界界定了可从接口恢复的路由空间，说明仅靠界面信号无法突破停止基线。

title: AgentHop: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Agentic Multi-Hop Scientific Question Answering
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Evaluation and Datasets Track
summary: Agentic tasks require a large language model to interact with the world, navigating information and gathering evidence across multiple steps with restricted resources. Due to this complexity, agentic task failures arise from various sources, and pinpointing these failure causes is essential to diagnose and improve agentic systems. Existing benchmarks, however, tend to focus on a single leaderboard score, leaving the underlying failure modes opaque. To fill this gap, we introduce AgentHop, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,011 multiple-choice questions paired with a controlled seven-tool sandbox under fixed token, turn, and tool-call constraints. AgentHop reveals model vulnerabilities by dissecting a single accuracy score along four axes of agent operation: retrieval, synthesis, tool-call, and resource management. Across 19 models, we find that behavior clusters by model family, with tool-call signatures revealing distinct family fingerprints: GPT models commit early, Anthropic and GLM checkpoints verify before committing, DeepSeek and Kimi over-search, and Gemini-3 Pro stays balanced. Decomposed axes further expose within-family structure: Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 land within one accuracy point yet diverge on retrieval-versus-synthesis emphasis, with Opus retrieving more and Sonnet synthesizing better. We release the full benchmark set and the harness to support diagnostic agent benchmarking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgentHop，一个诊断性基准，包含1011道多选题与受控七工具沙盒，在固定token、轮次和工具调用约束下，从检索、综合、工具调用、资源管理四个维度拆解单个准确率分数，揭示19个模型的行为差异与失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多只报告单一排行榜分数，无法暴露智能体任务失败的具体原因；而智能体任务复杂，失败来源多样，诊断失败模式对改进系统至关重要。
AI.method: 构建AgentHop诊断基准：1011道多选题搭配七工具受控沙盒环境，设定固定的token、轮次与工具调用限制；将单一准确率拆解为检索、综合、工具调用和资源管理四个操作维度进行评估。
AI.result: 在19个模型上，行为按模型家族聚类，工具调用特征形成家族指纹：GPT模型倾向早提交，Anthropic和GLM先验证再提交，DeepSeek和Kimi过度检索，Gemini-3 Pro保持均衡；同家族内部也有差异，如Claude Opus 4.6与Sonnet 4.6准确率相差不到1分，但Opus检索更多、Sonnet综合更好。
AI.conclusion: AgentHop通过多维分解揭示了智能体失败模式与家族行为特征，并开源完整基准与测试框架，支持诊断式智能体评测。

title: Safety-Constrained Cascade Inference for Robust Malaria Cell Classification Under Field Corruptions
comment: 28 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Code available at https://github.com/josehagbe3/MalariaVision
summary: Automated malaria diagnosis from thin blood-smear microscopy could meaningfully reduce the burden on under-resourced laboratories, but a model that maximises accuracy on clean laboratory images fails badly the moment an inexpensive smartphone camera introduces sensor noise. This paper introduces MalariaCascade, a two-stage inference system in which a lightweight MobileNetV2 sentinel (2,225,153 parameters) makes confident classifications at low compute cost and escalates uncertain cases to an EfficientNet-B3 expert (10,697,769 parameters) that sees only clean, standardised images regardless of how corrupted the incoming frame is. Structural isolation of the expert stage, not learned robustness, is the mechanism. The sentinel is trained under a safety-score objective that places an explicit floor on Recall(Parasitised) (>=0.95) and Recall(Uninfected) (>=0.40) before precision is optimised, ensuring the checkpoint satisfies clinical safety constraints by construction. On the NIH Malaria Cell Images Dataset (27,558 cells), the cascade reaches Accuracy=0.9736, Recall(Parasitised)=0.9570, Precision(Parasitised)=0.9912, F1=0.9738, and AUROC=0.9955 on the clean test set. Under Gaussian sensor noise at full severity, cascade Recall(Parasitised) degrades by only 2.4 pp (0.9570 to 0.9329), while the flat single-model baseline collapses by 63.0 pp (0.9584 to 0.3281). McNemar's test confirms the cascade improvement is statistically significant (chi^2=11.14, p=0.00085). An ablation isolating the structural property shows that routing clean images to the expert is responsible for a 16.8 pp Recall(Parasitised) advantage under sensor noise relative to a cascade where the expert also sees corrupted inputs.

AI.tldr: 提出 MalariaCascade 两阶段级联推理系统，用轻量哨兵模型过滤、专家模型只看干净图像，实现抗噪鲁棒的疟疾自动诊断。
AI.motivation: 低成本智能手机摄像头会引入传感器噪声，使在干净实验室图像上训练的高精度模型性能急剧下降，而现有单模型方案在噪声下鲁棒性差，难以在资源匮乏地区实际部署。
AI.method: 两阶段级联：轻量 MobileNetV2 哨兵（约222万参数）低成本做自信分类，不确定样本升级给 EfficientNet-B3 专家（约1070万参数），且专家仅见干净标准化图像（结构隔离，而非学习鲁棒性）。哨兵用安全分数目标训练，先对 Recall(Parasitised)>=0.95 与 Recall(Uninfected)>=0.40 设下限，再优化精度。
AI.result: 在 NIH 数据集（27,558 细胞）上：干净测试集 Accuracy=0.9736、Recall(Parasitised)=0.9570、Precision=0.9912、F1=0.9738、AUROC=0.9955。满级高斯噪声下级联 Recall(Parasitised) 仅降 2.4pp，而单模型基线崩塌 63.0pp。McNemar 检验显著（chi^2=11.14, p=0.00085）。消融显示路由干净图像给专家带来 16.8pp 的召回优势。
AI.conclusion: 结构隔离专家阶段（而非学习鲁棒性）是抗噪关键机制，级联在噪声环境下显著优于单模型，具备临床安全约束且适合资源受限场景部署。

title: Certified Long-Horizon Code Agent Evolution via Validation-Gated Skill Optimization
summary:
Long horizon agent self-evolution without model weight updates is essential for enabling deployed agents to accumulate reusable skills and improve over time. Prior self-evolution work has focused primarily on short-horizon tasks, while repository-level software engineering remains unexplored despite being an ideal testbed for long-horizon adaptation. In this setting, agents are required to solve streams of sequential tasks, navigate complex dependencies with evolving repositories and persistently store and reuse experience. Text-based skill optimization offers an efficient, non-parametric approach for such adaptation. However, existing methods often suffer from unstable updates, performance drawdown, and agent collapse over extended deployments. In this paper, we formalize the concept of in-context self-evolution and introduce VALVE, a validated-gated framework for long-horizon skill optimization. We establish finite convergence, provide theoretical guarantees for future-task gain and drawdown, and derive the validation and evaluation holdout sizes required for a prescribed tolerance, with leading-order scaling
  Empirically, our pipeline, VALVE achieves stable self-improvement over evolution horizon spanning more than 1,000 SWE tasks, with average final and peak gains of $14.9$ and $16.5$ points across three frontier models (GPT-5.5, Claude-4.6 and MiniMax-M2.7). The validation gate reduces average drawdown by 75% and produces an 11x more compact skill bank than ungated evolution. We further present extensive ablations identifying the design choices most critical to long-horizon skill evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VALVE——一个基于验证门控的上下文自进化框架，用于长时程仓库级软件工程任务的技能优化。
AI.motivation: 已部署代理需在无权重更新下积累可复用技能并持续改进，但现有自进化工作多聚焦短时程任务，仓库级软件工程这一理想长时程适应场景尚未被探索；且现有文本技能优化方法存在更新不稳定、性能下降和代理崩溃等问题。
AI.method: 将"上下文自进化"形式化，提出VALVE验证门控框架进行长时程技能优化；建立有限收敛性，给出未来任务增益与性能下降的理论保证，并推导规定容忍度下所需的验证与评估留出集规模及主导阶缩放。
AI.result: 在超过1000个SWE任务的进化跨度上实现稳定自改进，三个前沿模型（GPT-5.5、Claude-4.6、MiniMax-M2.7）平均最终增益14.9分、峰值增益16.5分；验证门控将平均性能下降减少75%，技能库比无门控进化紧凑11倍；并通过消融实验识别长时程技能进化最关键的设计选择。
AI.conclusion: 验证门控机制可有效保障长时程技能自进化的稳定性，VALVE为仓库级软件工程场景下的上下文自进化提供了理论与实践支持。

title: Remember by Asking: Retrieval-Induced Memory Evolution for LLM Agents
summary: Long-term memory is essential for language agents to maintain coherent and effective behavior over extended, multi-session interactions. Existing memory systems mainly use retrieval at read time, while write-time memory formation still relies on direct extraction or compression. However, when future information needs are unknown, compressing an entire interaction in one pass can overlook locally important details that may matter later. To this end, we introduce RIME, a retrieval-induced memory framework that shifts memory construction from monolithic compression toward evidence-centered integration. RIME uses generic self-questions to retrieve focused dialogue evidence and grounds memory formation in both the retrieved evidence and relevant historical memories, which are jointly reconciled into an evolving memory bank with temporal and provenance information. At inference time, compressed memory serves as the primary rather than the sole source of evidence: when it cannot support an answer, RIME retrieves relevant source dialogue together with its local context to recover information omitted during memory formation, without resorting to full-history processing. Extensive experiments on LoCoMo with Qwen3-235B-A22B and GPT-5.6 Sol show that RIME consistently achieves the best performance across all three quality metrics among the compared methods, while requiring substantially fewer query-time LLM tokens.

AI.tldr: RIME提出一种"检索诱导"记忆框架，将长期记忆构建从单体压缩转向以证据为中心的整合，通过自问检索聚焦对话证据，并在推理时以压缩记忆为主、源对话补救为辅，在LoCoMo上取得最优表现且token消耗更低。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体在长期、多会话交互中需要长期记忆以保持连贯有效行为。现有记忆系统多在读取时检索，写入时仍依赖直接抽取或压缩；当未来信息需求未知时，一次性压缩整段交互会遗漏局部重要细节。
AI.method: RIME在写入端用通用自问题检索聚焦的对话证据，并将记忆构建同时基于检索到的证据与相关历史记忆，二者联合协调写入带时间与来源信息的演化记忆库。推理时，压缩记忆作为主要而非唯一证据源：当其不足以支持回答时，检索相关源对话及局部上下文，以恢复记忆形成时遗漏的信息，无需处理全历史。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo上使用Qwen3-235B-A22B与GPT-5.6 Sol的实验中，RIME在所有三项质量指标上均一致优于对比方法，同时查询时LLM token消耗大幅减少。
AI.conclusion: RIME通过证据中心化的记忆构建与"压缩为主、源对话补救"的推理机制，在提升长期记忆问答质量的同时显著降低推理token成本，为语言智能体长期记忆提供有效方案。

title: Residual Diffusion Implicit Models
comment: 38 pages, 17 figures. Implementation available at https://github.com/joaolcguerreiro/RDIM
summary: Diffusion models achieve state-of-the-art results across multiple tasks. However, in inverse problems, standard initialization from pure Gaussian noise misaligns the generative process with real-world degradations. More recent methods such as diffusion bridges impose strict endpoint constraints and often require long reverse processes that are prone to hallucinations. Alternative consistency models provide noise-invariant, one-step mappings but lack inherent variance modeling and can degrade under severe corruption. Hence, residual diffusion implicit models (RDIMs) are proposed, constituting a generalized framework that explicitly models the residuals between high-quality (HQ) and low-quality (LQ) images, aligning the forward process with the actual degradation. A non-Markovian implicit reverse sampler is derived, which can skip intermediate timesteps, enabling accurate few-step or even single-step reconstruction, while mitigating the hallucinations inherent to long diffusion chains. RDIM also introduces a controllable variance mechanism that interpolates between deterministic and stochastic sampling, balancing fidelity and diversity. Furthermore, it enables the straightforward use of perceptual losses, when needed. Experiments on denoising and super-resolution benchmarks demonstrate that RDIMs consistently outperforms the state of the art, including bridge and consistency models, in terms of PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, reducing hallucinations while requiring only a few sampling steps (often just one). The results position RDIMs as an efficient solution for a broad range of image restoration tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出残差扩散隐式模型(RDIM)，通过显式建模高低质量图像的残差并推导非马尔可夫隐式反向采样器，实现少步甚至单步图像复原。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在逆问题中从纯高斯噪声初始化，与真实退化过程不匹配；扩散桥受严格端点约束且反向过程长、易产生幻觉；一致性模型虽可一步映射但缺乏方差建模、在严重退化下性能下降。
AI.method: 提出RDIM通用框架，显式建模HQ与LQ图像之间的残差使前向过程对齐实际退化；推导可跳过中间时间步的非马尔可夫隐式反向采样器；引入可控方差机制在确定性与随机采样间插值；并支持感知损失的使用。
AI.result: 在去噪与超分辨率基准上，RDIM在PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS指标上一致优于桥模型与一致性模型等最新方法，同时减少幻觉，仅需极少量采样步数（常常仅一步）。
AI.conclusion: RDIM为广泛的图像复原任务提供了一种高效解决方案。

title: X-Tree: Tokenizing Reusable Experience for Efficient Agent Generalization
comment: Project in Progress. Homepage: https://sitaocheng.github.io/xtree/. Code: https://github.com/sitaocheng/X-Tree/
summary: Multi-step agents are trained on flat action streams: SFT and RLVR weight every token uniformly and ignore the sub-procedures that recur across tasks, the hierarchy that lets humans plan top-down from reusable routines. This structure sits unused, and flat training uses each scarce trajectory less fully than its content allows. Recent agents do use that structure, but only as LLM-written skills in context, never in the weights, so their gains do not generalize beyond retrieval. We instead recover this hierarchy from the data itself and train on it, with no LLM calls. Following text tokenizers, which build a vocabulary by counting alone, we score action spans by reusability and merge canonicalized actions into a reusable eXperience tree (X-Tree). Each X-Tree node captures how a frequent and success-bearing skill is composed from sub-skills, guiding efficient generalization. We integrate X-Tree into three training settings: offline RL, with each node as a training instance; online RLVR, with an adaptive skill bonus; and on-policy self-distillation, with X-Tree as the self-teacher's privileged context. Across WebArena, ScienceWorld, and WebShop at three model scales, X-Tree improves over standard recipes at matched data and budget by up to 4.5% SR on WebArena, 5.8% SR on ScienceWorld and 4.1% success on WebShop. Matched analyses attribute the gains to the X-Tree structure and the three integrations.

AI.tldr: 提出X-Tree，从数据中自动挖掘可复用技能层级结构并用于多步智能体训练，在WebArena等任务上提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有多步智能体训练把动作流当作扁平序列，SFT和RLVR对所有token均匀加权，忽略了跨任务复用的子过程和层级结构，导致稀缺轨迹利用不充分；而近期使用结构的智能体仅靠LLM写skills放进上下文，未进入权重，收益无法泛化。
AI.method: 模仿文本分词器仅靠计数构建词表，通过可复用性对动作span打分，将规范化动作合并为可复用经验树X-Tree，节点捕捉频繁且成功技能如何由子技能组成。将其集成到三种训练：离线RL（节点作训练实例）、在线RLVR（自适应技能奖励）、on-policy自蒸馏（X-Tree作为自教师特权上下文），全程无需LLM调用。
AI.result: 在WebArena、ScienceWorld、WebShop三个环境和三种模型规模上，相同数据和预算下超过标准方法：WebArena SR最高+4.5%，ScienceWorld SR+5.8%，WebShop成功+4.1%。消融分析表明增益来自X-Tree结构及三种集成方式。
AI.conclusion: 从数据本身恢复层级结构并纳入权重训练，可高效复用经验、提升智能体泛化与性能，且不依赖LLM调用生成技能。

title: Unbiased Top-$k$ Estimation for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) is becoming an important component of large language model (LLM) post-training for transferring the reasoning capability of a strong teacher LLM to a weaker student LLM. OPD trains the student by minimizing the reverse KL divergence between the teacher and the student via rollouts generated by the student's policy. However, estimating the gradient of the reverse KL divergence in OPD remains a challenge. Using only the sampled token from the student-generated rollout is computationally cheap but provides limited distributional supervision, which will degrade accuracy. In addition, using the full vocabulary provides complete distributional supervision but is computationally expensive. Therefore, recent works propose Top-$k$ OPD (TK-OPD) that use selected top-$k$ tokens, which provides richer distributional supervision than sampled-token estimation at substantially lower computational cost than full-vocabulary estimation. Unfortunately, using only the selected top-$k$ tokens induces bias, leading to accuracy degradation, as the probability mass outside the selected top-$k$ tokens is discarded. To address the bias of TK-OPD, we propose Tail-Corrected Top-$k$ On-Policy Distillation (TT-OPD). It preserves the advantages of TK-OPD, including rich distributional supervision and low computational cost, while providing an unbiased estimator of the gradient of the reverse KL divergence. The key insight of TT-OPD is to use not only the selected top-$k$ tokens, but also the sampled token from the student-generated rollout, thereby recovering the discarded probability mass in expectation, avoiding the bias. Experimental results demonstrate that TT-OPD significantly outperforms other tested OPD variants.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Tail-Corrected Top-k On-Policy Distillation (TT-OPD)，通过同时使用选定的 top-k token 和学生 rollout 采样 token，恢复被丢弃的概率质量，实现反向 KL 梯度无偏估计，性能显著优于其他 OPD 变体。
AI.motivation: On-policy distillation (OPD) 通过最小化师生间反向 KL 散度来迁移推理能力，但梯度估计困难：仅用学生采样 token 计算廉价但分布监督有限，降低准确率；用全词表监督完整但计算昂贵。Top-k OPD (TK-OPD) 折中使用 top-k token，但丢弃了 top-k 之外的概率质量，引入偏差，导致准确率下降。
AI.method: 提出 TT-OPD，关键洞见是在 top-k token 基础上额外使用学生 rollout 的采样 token，从期望上恢复被丢弃的概率质量，从而构建反向 KL 梯度的无偏估计器，同时保留 TK-OPD 的丰富分布监督与低计算成本优势。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，TT-OPD 显著优于其他测试的 OPD 变体。
AI.conclusion: TT-OPD 通过结合 top-k token 与采样 token，解决了 TK-OPD 的偏差问题，提供了无偏且高效的反向 KL 梯度估计，取得优异性能。

title: NutriVision: Ingredient-Conditioned Fusion and Prediction for Single-Image Food Nutrition Estimation
summary: Nutrition estimation is a fundamental task in consumer diet tracking, clinical dietetics, chronic disease management, sports and hospital nutrition, and broader food computing systems. The existing approaches have progressed along two largely separate axes, vision models that rely on calibrated RGB-depth captures and ingredient-aware methods that use textual cues but use limited multimodal fusion. We introduce NutriVision, an end-to-end framework that leverages visual geometry and ingredient semantics to estimate calories, mass, fat content, carbohydrates, and protein from a single RGB image and an optional ingredient list. It obtains the unavailable depth modality using DepthAnything-V3 and encodes ingredient descriptions using CLIP. It integrates three complementary mechanisms: (1) an \emph{Ingredient-Conditioned Frequency-Aligned Fusion Module (IC-FAFM)}, which uses textual guidance to reweight and align RGB-depth frequency components; (2) an \emph{Ingredient-Aware Mask-based Prediction Head (IA-MPH)}, whose gating and channel masks are conditioned on food identity; and (3) modality-specific \emph{Internal Semantic Modeling (ISM)} blocks. On the Nutrition5k dataset, NutriVision achieves a mean PMAE of $\mathbf{13.60\pm0.10\%}$, outperforming our IGSMNet implementation by $0.89$ percentage points and OmniFood8k by $2.90$ percentage points (both $p<0.001$). The module-level ablations identify the ingredient-aware prediction head as the primary architectural contributor, improving mean PMAE by $1.50\pm0.17$ percentage points ($p<0.001$). These results demonstrate that ingredient-conditioned prediction and frequency-aware RGB-depth fusion provide measurable gains for single-image nutrient estimation. More broadly, NutriVision offers a practical route toward nutrition-assessment systems that exploit geometric and semantic cues without requiring specialized depth-sensing hardware

AI.tldr: NutriVision是一个端到端框架，仅用单张RGB图像和可选配料表即可估计热量、质量、脂肪、碳水和蛋白质，通过深度估计与CLIP配料语义融合实现营养估算。
AI.motivation: 营养估计在饮食追踪、临床营养、慢病管理等场景中至关重要。现有方法分为两个相对独立的路线：依赖标定RGB-D的视觉模型，以及使用文本线索但多模态融合有限的配料感知方法。目标是无需专用深度硬件，仅用单张RGB图像即可利用几何与语义线索。
AI.method: 框架用DepthAnything-V3获取缺失的深度模态，用CLIP编码配料描述，并集成三种机制：(1) 配料条件频率对齐融合模块（IC-FAFM），用文本指导重加权并对齐RGB-深度频率分量；(2) 配料感知掩码预测头（IA-MPH），其门控与通道掩码以食物身份为条件；(3) 模态特定的内部语义建模块（ISM）。
AI.result: 在Nutrition5k上平均PMAE为13.60±0.10%，优于IGSMNet实现0.89个百分点、优于OmniFood8k 2.90个百分点（均p<0.001）。模块级消融显示配料感知预测头是主要架构贡献者，平均PMAE改善1.50±0.17个百分点（p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明配料条件预测与频率感知RGB-深度融合对单图营养估计有可测量增益。NutriVision为无需专用深度传感器、利用几何与语义线索的营养评估系统提供了一条实用路径。

title: Model-Aware Data Selection from In-and-Out Information Interplay
summary:
LLMs are effective representations that assimilate vast amounts of knowledge during pretraining, but post-training is necessary for models to reliably access this knowledge and "know what they know." We observe an interesting rank equilibrium between knowledge stored in the weights and the data stream passing through the model. Across all model layers, we find that the hidden states (data stream) follow a U-shaped pattern, showing substantial compression in early layers and a steep rise during the late-layer decoding phase. In contrast, the weight rank follows an inverted U-shaped pattern, with very low rank in the early and late layers and high rank in the middle. We interpret this as an in-and-out information interplay: intermediate activations do not need to carry content that the weights can supply later, so they primarily preserve what the weights cannot provide.
  Motivated by this observation, we propose a model-aware data selection method, CAP (Counterfactual Assimilation Profile), which can determine whether a data candidate contains information accessible to the current model by utilizing the divergence gap in early- and late-layer representations between model-generated and reference responses. Across math, code, and science domains, CAP delivers 35.4% greater average improvement over the base model than the strongest baseline under different selection budgets. With only 10% of the data pool, CAP surpasses or matches full-pool training on math and science. We further show that CAP transfers to multimodal data selection and is robust to response horizon and noise.

AI.tldr: 论文发现LLM权重与数据流的秩呈互补的U形/倒U形模式，提出模型感知的数据选择方法CAP，用早晚期层表示的发散差异判断数据候选是否含模型可获取信息，在多领域显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: LLM预训练吸收大量知识，但需后训练才能可靠访问并"知道自己知道什么"。作者观察到权重中的知识与流经模型的数据流之间存在秩平衡，据此希望设计模型感知的数据选择方法。
AI.method: 观察各层：隐藏状态（数据流）随层呈U形，早期压缩、晚期解码阶段陡升；权重秩呈倒U形，早晚期低、中层高。解释为"进出信息互作"：中间激活主要保留权重无法提供的部分。基于此提出CAP（Counterfactual Assimilation Profile），利用模型生成与参考响应的早晚期层表示之间的发散差异，判断候选数据是否含模型已可访问的信息。
AI.result: 在数学、代码、科学领域，不同选择预算下CAP比最强基线平均提升35.4%。仅用10%数据池即可在数学和科学上超过或匹配全池训练。CAP还可迁移到多模态数据选择，且对响应长度与噪声具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 权重秩与激活秩的互补性揭示了一种信息分配机制，据此构建的CAP是一种有效、通用、鲁棒的数据选择方法，能高效提升LLM后可训练效果。

title: When Words Fall Short: Iterative Synergy Between Verbalized Reasoning and Hidden Features for LLM Confidence Estimation
summary: Confidence estimation is crucial for developing trustworthy large language models (LLMs), with most methods following estimator-based or verbalization-based paradigms. While recent research increasingly focuses on improving verbalized self-reports of confidence, we challenge the prevailing view that this approach surpasses independent confidence estimators. Our empirical study shows that a dedicated confidence estimator can substantially outperform verbalized confidence, indicating that LLMs' internal representations contain richer confidence signals. Building on this finding, we propose Iterative Policy-Estimator Training (IPoET), a framework that synergizes the complementary strengths of verbalized reasoning traces and informative representations. IPoET alternates policy optimization with estimator updating, integrating estimator-derived confidence feedback into policy learning and refreshing the estimator on new policy rollouts. Experiments across diverse datasets and Qwen and Llama backbones demonstrate that, by iteratively exploiting richer hidden features and adapting to the evolving policy distribution, IPoET consistently outperforms both estimator- and verbalization-based baselines in-domain and achieves superior or comparable results across all out-of-domain metrics. For more details, refer to https://github.com/xyk829/ipoet.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战"言语化自信优于独立估计器"的主流观点，提出IPoET框架，将策略优化与置信度估计器更新交替进行，融合两者优势，在多个数据集和Qwen/Llama模型上取得优于基线的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM置信度估计多采用估计器范式或言语化范式，近期研究倾向认为言语化自信优于独立估计器。作者质疑这一观点，通过实证发现专用估计器能显著超越言语化自信，说明LLM内部表征包含更丰富的置信度信号，因此希望结合两者优势。
AI.method: 提出Iterative Policy-Estimator Training (IPoET)框架，将策略优化与估计器更新交替进行：把估计器导出的置信度反馈整合进策略学习，同时在新策略的采样结果上刷新估计器，从而迭代利用隐藏特征并适应演变的策略分布。
AI.result: 在多个数据集及Qwen、Llama主干模型上的实验表明，IPoET在域内持续优于基于估计器和基于言语化的基线，在所有域外指标上取得更优或相当的结果。
AI.conclusion: 言语化自信并不天然优于独立估计器，结合内部表征的估计器信号与言语化推理轨迹可显著提升置信度估计，IPoET通过迭代协同实现了更强的性能与泛化能力。

title: Parameter-Efficient 3D Segmentation of Liver and Liver tumors: Depthwise factorization Scales Better Than Dense Convolution with Spatial Dimensionality
summary: Three-dimensional dense convolutional networks are the strongest performers on volumetric medical image segmentation, but their parameter counts scale poorly: moving a dense k x k convolution to k x k x k multiplies its weights by k. We observe that depthwise separable factorization does not share this penalty. Because the cubic kernel term applies only to the depthwise stage while the pointwise projection, which dominates the parameter count, is unchanged, the same architecture grows by 5 % from 2D to 3D where a dense convolutional U-Net grows by 200 %. We exploit this asymmetry to build a 3D U-Net with 536,990 parameters, 24x fewer than an identical dense 3D U-Net. On MSD Task03 Liver (the Medical Segmentation Decathlon liver task, derived from LiTS), evaluated per case under five-fold cross-validation over all 131 public volumes, the model reaches a tumor Dice of 0.577 (95% CI [0.518, 0.633]) and a liver Dice of 0.947 (95% CI [0.941, 0.952]). Its liver Dice exceeds previously reported performance. Its tumor Dice exceeds their low-resolution configuration (0.4701) by 0.107 and their 2D configuration (0.5394), at approximately one twenty-fourth of the parameters and roughly half the in-plane resolution. Trained under identical conditions on a common held-out split, it exceeds a dense 3D U-Net on liver by +0.031 Dice (paired p = 0.006) and on tumor by +0.041 (95 % CI [+0.005, +0.081], paired p = 0.056), suggesting the factorization also acts as a regularizer in the small-data regime characteristic of medical imaging. We further show, on both LiTS and a 2D endoscopy benchmark, that a large fraction of the network's learnable spatial filters can be replaced by fixed shifts at no cost in accuracy, but that replacing all of them is measurably worse, the placement of spatial capacity matters more than its total amount.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用深度可分离分解构建3D U-Net，参数量仅53.7万（比稠密3D U-Net少24倍），在肝脏肿瘤分割上超越已报道性能，并发现固定位移可替代部分可学习空间滤波器。
AI.motivation: 3D稠密卷积网络在体积医学图像分割中性能最强，但参数量随卷积核从k×k扩展到k×k×k而急剧增长（权重乘k）。作者观察到深度可分离分解不受此惩罚，因为三次项只作用于depthwise阶段，而主导参数量的pointwise投影不变。
AI.method: 利用深度可分离分解的这一不对称性，构建仅536,990参数的3D U-Net。在MSD Task03 Liver（源自LiTS）上对所有131个公开体积做五折交叉验证、按病例评估。此外在LiTS和2D内窥镜基准上测试用固定位移替换可学习空间滤波器的效果。
AI.result: 肿瘤Dice 0.577（95% CI [0.518, 0.633]），肝脏Dice 0.947（95% CI [0.941, 0.952]）。肝脏Dice超过已报道性能；肿瘤Dice比其低分辨率配置（0.4701）高0.107，也超过其2D配置（0.5394），而参数量约为其1/24。相同条件下，比稠密3D U-Net肝脏高+0.031 Dice（p=0.006），肿瘤高+0.041（p=0.056）。大量可学习空间滤波可被固定位移替换而无精度损失，但全部替换则明显变差。
AI.conclusion: 深度可分离分解既能大幅压缩3D模型参数量，又在小数据医学图像场景下起到正则化作用。空间容量的放置位置比其总量更重要。

title: When Pair Count Is Not the Sample Size: What All-Pairs Agent Comparisons Estimate
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation?
summary: When an agent benchmark compares every pair of leaderboard entries, the number of comparisons can look much larger than the independent evidence behind them: A versus B and A versus C both reuse A. Whether this reuse affects inference depends on what the analysis is meant to describe. If the board and its outcomes are fixed, the all-pairs mean is an exact summary of those entries, and any interval must come from another declared source of randomness. If the entries are instead treated as iid draws from a population of future configurations and the pair rule is regular and nondegenerate, the same mean is an order-two U-statistic whose first-order uncertainty depends on the number of configurations, not the number of pairs. We use near ties as the running example, but the distinction extends to other symmetric pair summaries when their regularity conditions hold. We examine both interpretations using a fixed SWE-bench Verified snapshot and an exact binary model with known truth. On SWE-bench, intervals that accounted for shared configurations were more than twice as wide as a pair-iid reference that treated the pairs as independent. In the exact model, pair-iid coverage fell far below the nominal level when edges shared endpoints but remained near nominal for matched independent edges. Results on two other fixed leaderboards show that exact summaries also depend on which pairs are included and how they are weighted. An all-pairs analysis must therefore state what is fixed, what is sampled, and how it handles shared entries and pair aggregation.

AI.tldr: 比较智能体排行榜所有配对时，"A vs B"与"A vs C"复用同一配置A，配对数量远大于独立证据量。论文区分两种解释：若榜单与结果固定，则全配对均值是精确摘要，区间需另声明随机性来源；若将条目视为iid抽样且配对规则正则非退化，则该均值为二阶U统计量，其一阶不确定性取决于配置数而非配对数。以近似平局为例，结论可推广至其他正则对称配对摘要。
AI.motivation: 成对比较排行榜常把每对条目当成独立证据来构造区间，但同一配置在多个配对中被重复使用，导致比较次数虚高、独立证据被高估。论文旨在厘清：这种复用是否影响推断，取决于分析所描述的对象（固定榜单还是iid抽样的未来配置），而现有做法往往未加区分。
AI.method: 用"近似平局"作为运行示例，形式化两种解释：(1) 固定榜单与结果时，全配对均值是精确摘要，区间需来自另行声明的随机性；(2) 条目为iid抽样且配对规则正则、非退化时，该均值为二阶U统计量，其一阶不确定性由配置数决定。并在固定的SWE-bench Verified快照和一个已知真值的精确二元模型上进行实验，对比考虑共享配置的区间与配对iid参照，另在两个固定排行榜上检验精确摘要对配对选择与加权方式的依赖。
AI.result: SWE-bench上，考虑共享配置的区间宽度是配对iid参照的两倍以上。精确二元模型中，当边共享端点时，配对iid覆盖率远低于名义水平；而对匹配的独立边则接近名义水平。另两个固定排行榜的结果显示，精确摘要还取决于纳入哪些配对以及如何加权。
AI.conclusion: 全配对分析必须明确声明：什么是固定的、什么是抽样的、如何处理共享条目以及如何进行配对聚合。忽略共享配置会导致区间过窄和覆盖率不足。

title: RGDT-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Reasoning for Rule-Governed Decisions and Their Justifications
summary: We study reasoning in Rule-Governed Decision Tasks (RGDTs), where models apply external rules to case facts and justify decisions, as required in policy, contract, and compliance settings. Beyond the deductive capability emphasized by standard mathematical and logical reasoning tasks, RGDTs require interpreting rules and their applicability, assessing conditions from evidence, combining judgments under rules and exceptions, and providing checkable justifications. These demands motivate a benchmark assessing both decisions and their stated grounds. We introduce RGDT-Bench, providing 202.1K condition-level supervision slots across four task tracks and eight supported task-probe combinations that vary access to supporting information. Label-blind extraction and deterministic checks produce labels for warrant completeness: source-referenced coverage and consistency of stated decision grounds. The benchmark attributes failures to four process layers: rule use, condition, evidence, and aggregation, and checks the final outcome. Among evaluable correct responses, warrant incompleteness averages 40.2% across six evaluated LLMs and supported task-probe combinations. Such warrant incompleteness poses potential safety risks and remains difficult to detect: the best of seventeen existing evaluators reaches only 57.69% (random: 50%) task-averaged area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC). To address this difficulty, we train a simple reward model with warrant supervision. It achieves 69.24% task-averaged AUROC among correct answers, exceeding the matched outcome-supervised baseline by 10.37 pp (percentage points) and the best existing evaluator by 11.55 pp. Beyond completeness assessment, the model outperforms both outcome-supervised baselines across nearly all response-selection comparisons, supporting RGDT-Bench's warrant supervision for RGDT reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出RGDT-Bench基准，评估规则治理决策任务中模型的决策与论证依据，发现论证不完整普遍存在且难以检测，并训练奖励模型改善检测。
AI.motivation: 政策、合同、合规等场景要求模型应用外部规则于案件事实并论证决策，这比标准数学与逻辑推理任务要求的演绎能力更多：需解读规则及适用性、从证据评估条件、在规则与例外下组合判断，并提供可核查的论证依据。因此需要一个同时评估决策与其依据的基准。
AI.method: 引入RGDT-Bench，含202.1K条件级监督槽，覆盖四个任务轨道和八种任务-探针组合，变化支持信息的可获取性。通过标签盲抽取与确定性检查生成论证完整性的标签（来源引用覆盖、决策依据一致性）。基准将失败归因于四个过程层：规则使用、条件、证据、聚合，并检验最终结果。此外，训练一个带论证监督的简单奖励模型。
AI.result: 在可评估的正确回答中，六个评估LLM及支持的任务-探针组合的论证不完整平均为40.2%。十七个现有评估器中最佳者任务平均AUROC仅57.69%（随机为50%）。带论证监督的奖励模型在正确回答中达到69.24%任务平均AUROC，超过匹配的结果监督基线10.37个百分点，超过最佳现有评估器11.55个百分点，并在几乎所有响应选择比较中优于两个结果监督基线。
AI.conclusion: 论证不完整带来潜在安全风险且难以检测。RGDT-Bench的论证监督能有效支持RGDT推理，训练出的奖励模型在完整性评估与响应选择上均显著优于现有方法。

title: SemReward-VL: Semantic Reward-Guided Video-Language Adaptation for Developmental Behavior Assessment
summary: Developmental screening videos show how children perform specific behaviors, but clinical records usually contain outcomes rather than descriptions of what happened. We present SemReward-VL, which learns to describe item-specific behavior from these outcomes. A vision-language model generates a description, and a frozen language model scores its agreement with the clinical outcome, relevance to the item, abstention on unrelated video-item pairs, and clarity. Group relative policy optimization (GRPO) updates LoRA adapters using this semantic reward. On 13,379 videos covering 41 items, the method improves aggregate accuracy and the number of items with recall above 0.5. Errors remain in temporal direction, duration, and age-specific interpretations of behavior.

AI.tldr: SemReward-VL利用临床结果作为语义奖励，通过GRPO训练VLM从发育筛查视频中生成项目特异性行为描述。
AI.motivation: 临床记录通常只有筛查结果，缺少对儿童行为的描述，而发育筛查视频本身包含具体行为信息，需要从结果反推行为描述。
AI.method: VLM生成描述，冻结语言模型从与临床结果一致性、与项目相关性、无关配对弃权、清晰度四方面打分作为语义奖励，用GRPO更新LoRA适配器。
AI.result: 在13,379个视频、41个项目上提升了总体准确率以及召回率超过0.5的项目数量；错误仍存在于时间方向、时长和年龄特异性行为解读。
AI.conclusion: 以临床结果为语义奖励可有效训练VLM进行项目特异性行为描述，但时间与年龄相关理解仍待改进。

title: The Epistemics of Agent Memory: Measuring, and Governing, the Consolidation Decision in Long-Horizon LLM Agents
comment: 13 pages, 4 tables, no figures. A four-phase research program. Experiments executed and adversarially verified by PRIMA (arXiv:2605.24775); per-phase result files and preregistrations available to reviewers on request; certain mechanism internals held under controlled release (see Section 7)
summary:
Long-horizon LLM agents must convert accumulated experience into durable memory, deciding what to keep, compress, abstract into reusable skills and rules, or forget. We report a four-phase research program on this consolidation problem whose central finding is a shift in what is measured: from how much an agent remembers, to whether its consolidation decisions are any good, to whether those decisions can be trusted.
  Phase 1 learns episodic boundaries from agent traces by downstream utility; an honest near-miss (oracle correlation 0.691 vs a 0.70 bar) whose lasting output is a three-gate anti-leakage protocol. Phase 2 learns when to promote experience and to which abstraction level under a token budget, achieving a verified +22.7% task-success improvement with 7x compression, but exposing a degenerate-forgetting failure and a distribution-shift failure mode we name lambda-prevalence coupling. Phase 3 introduces ConsolidationBench, an oracle-by-construction benchmark that scores consolidation decisions against a known optimum on three non-circular axes; production retrieval systems retain information yet score zero on cross-level transfer. Phase 4 introduces governed consolidation: the decision wrapped in poison-resistance, reversibility, and auditability guarantees with a quality gate. Governance is statistically distinct from the quality score ($r^2 = 0.43$; partial $r = 0.27$; identical-quality policies differ threefold in governance), so the contribution survives independently of the metric's external validity. On that question we report a resolved negative: after a graded-reuse redesign removed a structural ceiling, a two-benchmark study with 2,532 real answer cells finds the quality score does not predict real transfer accuracy (pooled Spearman $ρ= -0.24$, n = 12, CI spanning zero). An adversarial self-critique pass cleared the final claim set with zero surviving overclaims.

AI.tldr: 该论文报告了一个关于长时程LLM智能体"记忆整合"问题的四阶段研究，核心发现是测量对象的转变：从"记住了多少"到"整合决策是否好"，再到"这些决策是否可信"。研究引入ConsolidationBench与"受治理整合"框架，并诚实报告了一个已解决的负面结果（质量分无法预测真实迁移准确率）。
AI.motivation: 长时程LLM智能体需要将累积的经验转化为持久记忆，决定保留、压缩、抽象为可复用技能/规则或遗忘。核心动机是重新定义该整合问题应测量什么，并验证整合决策的好坏与可信度。
AI.method: 四阶段研究：阶段1用下游效用学习情节边界（含三关卡防泄漏协议）；阶段2在token预算下学习何时提升经验及抽象层级；阶段3提出ConsolidationBench（构造式oracle基准，三非循环轴评分）；阶段4提出"受治理整合"（抗毒化、可逆性、可审计性+质量门）。并以双基准2532个真实答案单元做外部效度检验。
AI.result: 阶段1 oracle相关性0.691（未达0.70门槛）。阶段2实现+22.7%任务成功率且7倍压缩，但暴露退化遗忘与λ-流行度耦合的分布偏移失败。阶段3显示生产检索系统虽保留信息却在跨层级迁移上得零分。阶段4：治理与质量分统计上不同（r²=0.43；偏r=0.27），质量相同的策略在治理上相差三倍。负面结果：质量分不预测真实迁移准确率（合并Spearman ρ=-0.24，CI跨零）。
AI.conclusion: 治理贡献独立于质量指标的外部效度而成立。整体研究实现从"记忆量"到"决策质量"再到"决策可信度"的测量视角转变，并通过对抗性自我批判清除了过度主张，最终结论集无存留过度声明。

title: CARDAMOM: A Micro-Dialectal Arabic Speech Dataset for ASR
summary: We present Cardamom, a micro-dialectal Arabic speech dataset designed to support fine-grained evaluation and adaptation of automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems. Community-curated by native speakers familiar with the represented varieties, Cardamom contains approximately 40 hours of transcribed YouTube speech spanning 21 micro-dialects across Egypt, Jordan, Lebanon, Mauritania, Palestine, and Saudi Arabia. Each segment is annotated with one or more operational micro-dialect labels, code-switching information, and utterance-level perceived gender, enabling analysis of sub-country variation that is obscured by conventional country-level labels. We describe the collection and annotation process, motivate the micro-dialect inventory linguistically, and benchmark four multilingual ASR systems in zero-shot and adapted settings. The strongest zero-shot system obtains 43.47% aggregate WER, with particularly high error rates on Mauritanian and Lebanese varieties; adaptation on Cardamom reduces its WER to 35.21%. Audio-based identification experiments further show that the annotations provide a learnable prediction target, with a dedicated classifier reaching 85.57% accuracy on 21-way micro-dialect identification. Cardamom provides a resource for studying localized dialectal variation and developing Arabic speech systems with broader regional coverage.

AI.tldr: 卡多尔蒙（Cardamom）：由母语者社群共建的微方言阿拉伯语语音数据集，约40小时YouTube转录语音，覆盖6国21种微方言，支持ASR细粒度评估、自适应及微方言识别。
AI.motivation: 传统国别标签掩盖了阿拉伯语次国家级方言变异，缺乏细粒度资源来评估与适配ASR系统的微方言表现。
AI.method: 由熟悉相关变体的母语者社群策划，收集约40小时YouTube转录语音，涵盖埃及、约旦、黎巴嫩、毛里塔尼亚、巴勒斯坦、沙特21种微方言；每段标注一个或多个可操作微方言标签、语码转换信息及话语级感知性别；从语言学角度论证微方言清单，并基准测试四个多语种ASR系统的零样本与适配设置，另做基于音频的方言识别实验。
AI.result: 最强零样本系统总WER为43.47%，毛里塔尼亚与黎巴嫩变体错误率尤高；在Cardamom上适配后WER降至35.21%；专用分类器在21类微方言识别上达85.57%准确率。
AI.conclusion: Cardamom为研究局部方言变异、开发覆盖更广区域的阿拉伯语语音系统提供了资源。

title: dKFD: Phase-Structured Evidence Allocation for Fixed-Budget Localized Event Understanding
summary: Sparse video understanding often requires selecting a small set of visual evidence under a fixed frame budget. Most sparse selectors allocate this budget globally, allowing all frames to compete with one another. For temporally localized events, this can be a poor inductive bias: useful evidence is often distributed across pre-event context, the event itself, and post-event consequences. We study fixed-budget evidence allocation for localized event videos and show that globally competitive Top-$K$ selectors can preserve recognition and grounding while producing unstable event evidence. On DoTA Video Anomaly Recognition, Global Top-$K$ obtains competitive recognition and temporal grounding, but low selector-event alignment at $K=12$ (Frame AUC $51.5 \pm 10.8$). We propose dKFD, a phase-structured differentiable selector that reserves evidence capacity across pre-event, event, and post-event phases after full-sequence temporal encoding. Under matched-budget multi-seed evaluation, dKFD improves Frame AUC by $+30.97$ over a matched Global Top-$K$ selector at $K=12$ ($p<0.01$), while yielding modest but statistically significant recognition gains and comparable temporal grounding. Mechanism ablations show that phase supervision is load-bearing: removing it reduces Frame AUC to $41.1 \pm 12.0$ even when phase-partitioned budgets are retained. Downstream diagnostics on VRU-Accident show consistent gains over learned Global Top-$K$ across VLM families, while dense captioning reveals a boundary condition where uniform sampling remains competitive. These results support phase-structured allocation as a controlled fixed-budget approach for event-centric sparse evidence selection, not as a universal video summarization strategy.

AI.tldr: 论文研究固定预算下的事件视频证据选择问题，提出 dKFD——一种按事件前/事件中/事件后分阶段分配预算的可微选择器，显著提升选择器-事件对齐度，而非普遍的视频摘要方案。
AI.motivation: 多数稀疏选择器在全局范围内竞争固定帧预算。对于时间局部化事件，有用证据常分布在前景上下文、事件本身及事件后果三个阶段，全局 Top-K 的竞争归纳偏置不合适，导致事件证据不稳定。
AI.method: 提出 dKFD：在完成全序列时间编码后，为事件前、事件中、事件后三个阶段预留证据容量，采用相结构化的可微选择器；并通过机制消融验证阶段监督的必要性。
AI.result: 在 DoTA 视频异常识别上，K=12 时 Global Top-K 帧 AUC 仅 51.5±10.8；dKFD 将帧 AUC 提升 +30.97（p<0.01），识别率略有但显著提升，时间定位相当。移除阶段监督后帧 AUC 降至 41.1±12.0。VRU-Accident 下游诊断在不同 VLM 系列上一致优于学习的 Global Top-K；dense captioning 中均匀采样仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 相结构化分配是一种有效的受控固定预算方法，适用于事件中心的稀疏证据选择，而非通用的视频摘要策略。

title: Trust and Task Completion in the World of Consumer AI Agents
summary: Action agents do things for people. They send email, spend money, and call businesses while the user is busy with something else, so a mistake can turn into an action before anyone notices. They fail their users in two ways. They break trust when they do something the user never agreed to, or hold back after the user clearly said go. And they fall short on completion when they give up on errands that turn out to be hard. Both depend heavily on the harness around the model, meaning its instructions, tools, context, and guardrails. We built an evaluation that scores trust and completion on the same runs, in a simulated world of businesses with their own websites, inboxes, and phone lines, and of people who write back. A simulated user answers the assistant's questions. Trust means that nothing happens the user did not agree to. No email goes to someone they never approved, no private detail ends up on a group thread, no money is spent past their limit, no stranger's instructions are followed, and nothing is claimed without a source. Every trap has a matched control in which acting is the right call. We use the evaluation to measure Fo, Wajo's personal assistant, against a base model with basic instructions on three foundation models, and against the Fo harness with its guardrails switched off. Fo completes 71% of the errands and keeps the user's trust on 94% of the trap runs. The base models complete 50% to 64% and keep trust on 59% to 75%. On the matched controls, Fo goes ahead slightly less often. OpenClaw, a popular open-source assistant given the same access, completes 42% of the errands it shares with Fo, against 71%, and keeps the user's trust on 74% of the shared trap runs, against 94%. Measuring trust and completion together, on the whole system rather than the model alone, is how we think action agents become safe to hand real work to.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个同时评估行动代理（action agent）信任度与任务完成度的评测框架，在模拟商业世界中设置陷阱任务与匹配对照，测量整体系统（含harness、工具、护栏）而非仅模型。Wajo的个人助理Fo完成71%任务、陷阱场景保持94%信任，显著优于基础模型和关闭护栏版本，也优于开源助手OpenClaw。
AI.motivation: 行动代理代表用户发邮件、花钱、打电话，出错会在用户察觉前转化为真实行动。它们有两种失败：一是破坏信任（做了用户未同意的事，或该行动时退缩），二是完成度不足（遇到困难就放弃）。这两种失败高度依赖模型外围的harness（指令、工具、上下文、护栏），但现有评估往往只看模型本身，且很少把信任与完成度放在同一次运行中一起衡量。
AI.method: 构建一个评测，在同一次运行中同时对信任和完成度打分。环境是模拟世界，包含有各自网站、收件箱、电话线的商家，以及会回信的人；由模拟用户回答助手提问。信任定义为"没有发生用户未同意的事"：未获批者不发邮件、私密信息不进群聊、花费不超限额、不听从陌生人指令、无来源不主张。每个陷阱都有对应的匹配对照，其中"行动"才是正确选择。用该评测比较Fo（Wajo的个人助理）与三个基础模型加基础指令的基线，以及关闭护栏的Fo harness。
AI.result: Fo完成71%的任务，在94%的陷阱运行中保持信任。基础模型完成50%–64%，信任保持59%–75%。在匹配对照中，Fo略微更少地贸然行动。OpenClaw（热门开源助手，给予相同权限）仅完成与Fo共享任务的42%（Fo为71%），在共享陷阱运行中信任保持74%（Fo为94%）。
AI.conclusion: 在同一运行中、针对整个系统而非单个模型同时衡量信任与完成度，是让行动代理可以安全承接真实工作的关键路径。

title: Papers Without Code: Availability of GitHub Repositories Linked in *CL Publications
comment: Accepted for publication in Computational Linguistics. Author's final version (pre-MIT Press publication)
summary: Source code and data published at computational linguistics (*CL) venues are increasingly being shared via GitHub. While this generally is a favourable development for the accessibility and potential reusability of research artifacts in natural language processing (NLP), the long-term availability of such repositories has not been evaluated. In this squib, we discuss the availability of repositories linked in papers published in the Computational Linguistics (CL) journal as well as at ACL and its co-located events over the past ten years. Contrary to our expectations, we find that GitHub repositories linked in more recent ACL publications are unavailable at similar rates as in older publications, in parts due to an increase in empty and placeholder repositories. Similar trends hold for other *CL venues, but not for platforms other than GitHub.

AI.tldr: 该文研究了计算语言学领域论文所链接GitHub仓库的长期可用性，发现近年ACL论文的仓库失效比例与较早论文相近，部分原因是空仓库和占位仓库增多。
AI.motivation: CL/NLP领域论文越来越多通过GitHub共享源码和数据，这对可访问性和可复用性是利好；但其长期可用性此前未被评估，因此作者希望考察过去十年间相关仓库是否仍可访问。
AI.method: 对Computational Linguistics期刊以及ACL及其同期活动过去十年论文中的链接仓库进行可用性调查，并与其它*CL会议平台、非GitHub平台进行对比。
AI.result: 与预期相反，较新的ACL论文所链接GitHub仓库的失效比例与较旧论文相近，部分原因在于空仓库和占位仓库增加；类似趋势也出现在其它*CL会议，但非GitHub平台趋势不同。
AI.conclusion: CL领域通过GitHub共享研究制品的长期可用性存在问题，近年仓库失效并未明显改善，需引起对研究制品持久保存和可复用性的关注。

title: QSCP: Beyond Class-Name Prompts for Query-Guided Semantic Change Parsing
summary: Traditional change detection (CD) identifies changes between bi-temporal remote sensing images, while semantic change detection (SCD) assigns predefined land-cover classes. However, mapping all changes may not meet a user's specific needs. Referring change detection (RCD) enables selective retrieval through category prompts. However, existing category-prompted RCD uses the queried category to specify the destination of a change and returns only a binary mask of the corresponding regions. Users may instead request a particular transition and paired semantic maps to understand what changed into what. Such requests require explicit source and target reasoning beyond target-class localization. To address these needs, we propose query-guided semantic change parsing (QSCP), which supports category names, synonyms, and intent-bearing sentences and returns a query-specific mask with paired temporal semantic maps. QSCP parses requests into intents and semantic slots, composes bidirectional visual evidence, and predicts both temporal states with a query-conditioned decoder. On SECOND, QSCP outperforms RCDNet on synonym, sentence, and transition queries and improves end-to-end semantic prediction over evaluated semantic baselines. WHU-CDC experiments further assess cross-dataset transfer and consistency across equivalent expressions without target-domain training. Code is available at https://github.com/qianyuancs/QSCP

AI.tldr: 本文提出查询引导的语义变化解析（QSCP），支持类别名、同义词及意图句子查询，输出查询特定掩码和配对时序语义图，在SECOND和WHU-CDC上优于RCDNet及语义基线。
AI.motivation: 现有类别提示RCD只能用查询类别指定变化目的地并返回二值掩码，无法满足用户请求特定转换、理解"什么变成了什么"并获取配对语义图的需求。
AI.method: 将请求解析为意图与语义槽，构建双向视觉证据，并用查询条件解码器预测两个时序状态，从而返回查询特定的掩码和配对时间语义图。
AI.result: 在SECOND数据集上，QSCP在同义词、句子和转换查询上优于RCDNet，并在端到端语义预测上超过所评估的语义基线；WHU-CDC实验进一步验证了跨数据集迁移能力，以及在无目标域训练下对等价表达的一致性。
AI.conclusion: QSCP扩展了RCD范式，支持更灵活的查询形式与更丰富的语义输出，并展现了良好的跨数据集泛化与表达式一致性。

title: RoPE is Dead, Long Live RoPE: Towards Scalable Data-aware Positional Encodings
summary: Transformers process tokens without any inherent notion of order, making positional encoding a fundamental requirement rather than an architectural refinement. Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) has become the default positional encoding in modern language models, yet it is heavily biased toward nearby tokens. Existing alternatives have been evaluated under different settings, leaving the literature fragmented and without a clear replacement. We bring structure to this landscape by examining a specific weakness of RoPE: its slow frequency bands, whose wavelengths exceed the training context and expose models to unseen angles during extrapolation. We therefore introduce Data aware RoPE (DaRoPE), which preserves standard RoPE on the fast bands but replaces absolute position on the slow bands with bounded coordinates learned from contextual representations. Therefore, the slow-band geometry depends on the data rather than only on positional distance. We compare representative encodings under matched conditions across synthetic tasks, symbolic music, genomics, neural signals, and language models spanning 124M to 50B parameters. Across these experiments, DaRoPE leads on non-text benchmarks, mitigates recency bias, while remaining best or on par in language modeling and length extrapolation. Moreover, the learned coordinates also make the mechanism interpretable, revealing how attention layers leverage contextual information beyond token distance. Together, these results support DaRoPE as the best overall default among the evaluated methods, when there is no domain-specific reasons to prefer another.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DaRoPE：在RoPE的慢频段用从上下文表示学到的有界坐标替代绝对位置，保留快频段的RoPE。跨任务与124M–50B模型对比显示，DaRoPE在非文本任务最优、缓解近期偏差，在语言建模与长度外推上保持领先或相当。
AI.motivation: Transformer本身无顺序概念，位置编码是必需组件。RoPE是当前默认方案，但强烈偏向邻近token；其慢频段波长超过训练上下文，外推时暴露于未见角度。现有替代方案评测设置不一，缺乏清晰结论。
AI.method: 提出Data-aware RoPE (DaRoPE)：快频段保留标准RoPE，慢频段用从上下文表示学习的有界坐标替换绝对位置，使慢频段几何依赖于数据而非仅位置距离。并在合成任务、符号音乐、基因组学、神经信号与语言模型（124M–50B）上统一条件对比代表性编码方法。
AI.result: DaRoPE在非文本基准上领先，缓解近期偏差（recency bias），语言建模与长度外推保持最优或相当；学到的坐标还可解释注意力层如何利用超出token距离的上下文信息。
AI.conclusion: 在无领域特定偏好的情况下，DaRoPE可视为所评估方法中综合最优的默认位置编码方案。

title: Query, Align, and Distill: Navigation-Aware Cross-Modal Interaction for Efficient Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Recent large-scale Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) models deliver strong accuracy but remain costly to deploy due to their large parameter counts and computational requirements. We tackle efficient VLN in two steps. First, we build a high-performing teacher that makes navigation evidence selection explicit and compressible. The teacher introduces a small set of learnable query slots to extract global and local action-sufficient navigable evidence from panoramic observations via a Navigable Query Generator, then progressively grounds these evidence tokens to the instruction with an Instruction-Query Aligner for policy prediction. Second, using this explicit query bottleneck as a distillation interface, we train a compact student by transferring both where to attend and what to do. We distill the teacher's global and local navigable queries with a navigation-aware token-adaptive objective, then further match action distributions during fine-tuning. Experiments on standard VLN benchmarks demonstrate that our student nearly matches the teacher's navigation performance while reducing the number of parameters by 93.65% compared to the teacher.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两阶段高效VLN方法：先用可学习query slot构建高性能教师模型，再通过蒸馏训练紧凑学生模型，参数量减少93.65%且性能接近教师。
AI.motivation: 大规模VLN模型精度高但参数量大、计算成本高，难以部署，需要高效方案。
AI.method: 第一步构建教师：用Navigable Query Generator以少量可学习query slot从全景观测提取全局与局部可导航证据，再用Instruction-Query Aligner逐步将证据token与指令对齐做策略预测。第二步蒸馏：以该query瓶颈为接口，用导航感知的token自适应目标蒸馏全局/局部query，并在微调中匹配动作分布训练紧凑学生模型。
AI.result: 在标准VLN基准上，学生模型性能几乎匹敌教师，参数量相比教师减少93.65%。
AI.conclusion: 显式可压缩的query瓶颈可同时服务于证据选择与蒸馏，实现高性能且轻量的VLN部署。

title: Agent Safety From Within: Detecting Harmful Trajectories from LLM Internal States
summary: Language model agents can now perform sophisticated sequences of actions via tools and harnesses, which has increased the scope of the damage they can cause. Guard models, however, are mainly built for content moderation and thus are not well-suited to detecting this agentic risk. To address this, we proceed by first conducting a representational analysis, then use the resulting insights to build a solution. In our analysis, we focus on two types of trajectory-level agentic harms: harmful content, which is expressed directly, and unsafe tool use, which depends on whether an action is consistent with the interaction that produced it. We investigate how open-source guard models represent these two types of harm and find that they are linearly readable inside the model, even though guard models predict no better than chance on pairs that differ only in the called tool's schema. The two harm types also follow nearly orthogonal internal directions, and neither reliably serves as a proxy for the other. These results motivate reading trajectory safety directly from internal states. We introduce TACIT, a readout of a frozen backbone's internal states that decodes no tokens. Trained on six trajectory-safety benchmarks, a linear probe raises mean macro-F1 from 62.3 for the strongest open guard to 80.7, and refined readouts reach 86.2. With each benchmark held out of training entirely, the refined readouts still lead the strongest guard (65.7 vs. 61.1). With the same backbone, training data and test split, the frozen readout is on par with full safety fine-tuning, and it improves the fine-tuned model further when applied on top. The probe trains about one millionth as many parameters as full fine-tuning in about a sixth of the time, and TACIT has the lowest latency of the guards we evaluate.

AI.tldr: 现有安全护栏模型主要针对内容审核，难以检测智能体轨迹级风险。作者通过表征分析发现两类智能体危害在模型内部呈线性可读且近乎正交，据此提出TACIT——直接从冻结骨干网络内部状态读取安全性，性能大幅优于现有护栏模型。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体可通过工具执行复杂动作序列，扩大了潜在损害范围，但现有护栏模型多面向内容审核，无法有效检测这类智能体风险。
AI.method: 先对开源护栏模型进行表征分析，研究两类轨迹级危害（直接表达的有害内容、依赖动作与交互一致性的不安全工具使用）的内部表示；据此提出TACIT，对冻结骨干网络内部状态进行线性探测读出，无需解码token。
AI.result: 两类危害在内部线性可读，且沿近乎正交方向分布，互不可替代；仅工具schema不同的样本上护栏模型预测接近随机。TACIT在六个基准上把宏F1从最强护栏的62.3提升到80.7，精细读出达86.2；完全留出基准时仍领先（65.7 vs 61.1）；与全量安全微调相当，叠加后还能进一步提升，训练参数约百万分之一、时间约六分之一，延迟最低。
AI.conclusion: 从内部状态直接读取轨迹安全性是检测智能体风险的有效方案，TACIT以极低训练成本超越现有护栏模型，并可增强微调模型。

title: In-game Toxic Detection: Bi-directional Representations with Attention Residuals
summary: In-game toxic language has emerged as a critical concern in the gaming industry and community. While several frameworks and models for online game toxicity analysis have been proposed, detecting toxicity in player chat utterances remains a formidable challenge: stemming not only from the extremely short length of such utterances but also from the heavy reliance on game slang, abbreviations, and domain-specific jargon, which generic language models are poorly suited to recognize. This paper presents a shared task for in-game toxic language detection built upon real-world in-game chat data, and proposes the best-preforming model for the toxic language slot filling: Bi-directional Representations with Attention Residuals (BRAR). Experimental results demonstrate that BRAR effectively captures the global context and outperforms the existing baselines on slot filling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于真实游戏内聊天数据的游戏内有害语言检测共享任务，并提出BRAR模型用于有害语言槽填充，实验表明其优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 游戏内有害语言是游戏行业和社区的重要问题，但玩家聊天话语的毒性检测困难：一是话语极短，二是大量使用游戏俚语、缩写和领域术语，通用语言模型难以识别。
AI.method: 提出BRAR（Bi-directional Representations with Attention Residuals，带注意力残差的双向表示）模型，用于有害语言槽填充，并基于真实游戏聊天数据构建共享任务。
AI.result: BRAR能有效捕捉全局上下文，在槽填充任务上优于现有基线模型。
AI.conclusion: BRAR是游戏内有害语言槽填充的最佳模型，验证了注意力残差双向表示在该任务上的有效性。

title: Octree-based Video Representation
summary: Video models commonly use uniform grids even though visual complexity varies substantially across space and time. We introduce OctVideo, which approximates a video clip with an octree. This hierarchy recursively partitions a spatio-temporal volume into eight subvolumes, so that smooth regions remain coarse while detailed regions receive finer cells. Each leaf stores local RGB values and spatio-temporal gradients, supplemented by a lightweight learned residual. For reconstruction, a Conv1D VAE maps the serialized cells to a regular latent grid and selectively refines details during decoding. Our VAE achieves 36.12 dB PSNR with 38.2M parameters and 189.4 GFLOPs per clip on Kinetics-400 (K400). It also generalizes zero-shot to the high-resolution Densely Annotated VIdeo Segmentation (DAVIS) 2016 dataset with reconstruction quality comparable to the best evaluated models. On both datasets, it requires the fewest model FLOPs and achieves the fastest encoding and decoding among the evaluated models. OctVideo also supports video understanding, achieving competitive recognition performance with few input tokens when trained from scratch. By exploiting the redundancy already present in video signals and efficiently processing sparse structures, OctVideo provides an efficient representation for video.

AI.tldr: OctVideo用八叉树近似视频片段，将时空体递归划分为八个子体，平滑区域保留粗粒度、细节区域获得细粒度单元，实现高效视频表示。
AI.motivation: 视频模型通常采用均匀网格，但视觉复杂度在空间和时间上变化很大，均匀网格忽略了这种非均匀性，导致冗余计算。
AI.method: 用八叉树递归划分时空体；每个叶节点存储局部RGB值与时空中梯度，并辅以轻量学习的残差；重建时用Conv1D VAE将序列化单元映射到规则潜网格，并在解码时选择性细化细节。
AI.result: 在Kinetics-400上VAE达到36.12 dB PSNR，38.2M参数、每片段189.4 GFLOPs；零样本泛化到高分辨率DAVIS 2016，重建质量与最佳评测模型相当。两数据集上FLOPs最少，编解码最快，且用少量输入token即可在从头训练下取得有竞争力的识别性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用视频信号中已有的冗余并高效处理稀疏结构，OctVideo为视频提供了高效的表示方法。

title: BudgetVerify: Budget-Tiered Verification for Financial QA
summary: Financial question answering often requires precise numerical extraction, unit handling, and arithmetic over tables and text, but applying expensive verification uniformly wastes test-time compute. We propose BudgetVerify, a budget-tiered generator-verifier framework that routes each generated answer to one of three verification tiers: no verification, lightweight check-and-revise, or higher-cost solve-first-then-compare verification. The router is trained from offline correctness and token-cost outcomes and, at test time, selects a verification tier using information available before verification, including the question, context statistics, the generated answer, and associated generator metadata. The selected tier either returns the generated answer directly or invokes the corresponding verifier. Across six commercial and open-weight base models, BudgetVerify consistently produces more efficient accuracy-cost Pareto frontiers than fixed verification policies by selectively allocating stronger verification only when it is useful. Although absolute performance varies across models, these efficiency gains and the resulting qualitative frontier shape are consistent across generator models.

AI.tldr: 提出 BudgetVerify，一个分层预算的生成器-验证器框架，对每个生成答案动态选择三级验证策略，以在金融问答中更高效地提升准确率-成本权衡。
AI.motivation: 金融问答常需精确数值抽取、单位处理和表格与文本上的算术推理。对所有答案统一施加昂贵的验证会浪费测试时计算资源，因此需要按需分配验证预算。
AI.method: 路由器基于离线收集的正确性与token成本结果训练；测试时利用验证前可得的信息（问题、上下文统计、生成答案及生成器元数据）将答案分为三级：不验证、轻量检查并修订、高成本先求解再比较。所选层级直接返回答案或调用相应验证器。
AI.result: 在六个商用及开放权重基础模型上，BudgetVerify 相比固定验证策略持续产生更优的准确率-成本帕累托前沿，仅在有用时分配更强验证。虽然各模型绝对性能不同，但效率增益与前沿形状在各生成器间保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 按需、分层地分配验证计算可有效改善金融问答的准确率-成本权衡，且该优势在不同生成器模型上具有一致性。

title: The Model Knows When to Stop: Training-Free Early Stopping for Long-Context Reading
summary: Language models often process long inputs sequentially in chunks, but continuing to read after sufficient evidence has been acquired wastes computation. Existing stopping mechanisms either learn sufficiency from internal activations or train an exit gate, while a simpler alternative asks the model whether it has read enough. We introduce Answer-Convergence Stopping (ACS), a training-free stopping rule that measures rather than asks. After each chunk, it probes the frozen model's current answer state and stops when that state is both confident and stable. The rule requires only output-side generation and token log probabilities, has no trained components, and uses one shared configuration across models and benchmarks. Because a stopping policy can save computation simply by stopping too early, we evaluate the stopping decision itself using evidence position where available. On the full LongBench-v2 with two frontier models, ACS is the only stopping policy that matches or exceeds full-reading accuracy. Furthermore, across 250 S-NIAH questions, the premature stopping rate for ACS across five models from two families ranges from 0% to 12%, compared to 8.4% to 45.6% for the verbalized gate. Taken together, ACS reveals that by properly utilizing the output signals of frozen models, we can achieve favorable behaviors like adaptive stopping without the need for additional training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ACS（Answer-Convergence Stopping），一种无需训练的停止规则，通过探测冻结模型在当前分块后的答案状态（置信且稳定时停止），在长文本处理中实现自适应停止。在LongBench-v2上ACS是唯一匹配或超过全读准确率的停止策略，并在S-NIAH上将过早停止率降至0%–12%。
AI.motivation: 语言模型处理长输入时分块顺序读取，获取足够证据后继续读取会浪费计算。现有停止机制要么从内部激活学习充分性，要么训练退出门；而更简单的做法是直接询问模型是否读够了（verbalized gate），但这会导致过早停止率高。因此需要一种更可靠的停止方式。
AI.method: ACS是一种无需训练的停止规则：在每个分块后探测冻结模型当前的答案状态，当该状态既置信又稳定时停止。该方法仅需输出侧生成和token对数概率，无训练组件，且在所有模型和基准上使用同一共享配置。评估时利用证据位置来衡量停止决策本身（而不仅是节省计算）。
AI.result: 在完整LongBench-v2上，用两个前沿模型测试，ACS是唯一匹配或超过全读准确率的停止策略。在250个S-NIAH问题上，ACS在来自两个家族的五个模型上的过早停止率为0%–12%，而verbalized gate为8.4%–45.6%。
AI.conclusion: ACS表明，通过恰当利用冻结模型的输出信号，无需额外训练即可实现自适应停止等良好行为。

title: Toward Comprehensive 3D Grounding: Orientation Grounding through Vision-Language Models
summary: Grounding is a core capability of spatial vision-language models, yet most existing work focuses only on where a referred object is. Many 3D tasks also require knowing how it is oriented. Although existing 3D VLMs may predict oriented boxes, box pose does not explicitly capture object-centric orientation or symmetry-induced ambiguities. We introduce orientation grounding, a referring grounding task that predicts an object's 6D orientation and axial symmetry from a language or box query in single-view or multi-view scenes. To support this task, we construct ReferOri, with 331K multi-view and 387K single-view orientation-grounding queries obtained through scalable reconstruction, consistency checking, and human verification. We further present OG-VLM, which adapts a 3D VLM with structured box/orientation outputs, sign and symmetry tokens, and geometry-aware auxiliary losses. Across single-view and multi-view benchmarks, OG-VLM substantially outperforms orientation-aware VLM baselines and surpasses object-level orientation foundation models on scene-level referring benchmarks, showing that explicit orientation grounding is a distinct and learnable capability beyond localization. Downstream results validate its benefit for orientation-related spatial reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"朝向定位"(orientation grounding)新任务：从语言或框查询预测物体的6D朝向与轴对称性，构建ReferOri数据集(331K多视角+387K单视角)并提出OG-VLM模型，在单/多视角基准上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有空间视觉-语言模型的研究大多只关注"物体在哪里"，而许多3D任务还需要知道物体"如何朝向"。尽管现有3D VLM可预测有向框，但框的姿态无法显式表达以物体为中心的朝向及对称性带来的歧义。
AI.method: 1) 定义朝向定位任务：从语言或框查询预测物体6D朝向和轴向对称性，支持单视角/多视角场景。2) 构建ReferOri数据集，通过可扩展重建、一致性检查与人工验证，获得331K多视角与387K单视角查询。3) 提出OG-VLM：改造3D VLM，加入结构化框/朝向输出、符号与对称性token，以及几何感知辅助损失。
AI.result: 在单视角与多视角基准上，OG-VLM大幅超越具备朝向感知能力的VLM基线，并在场景级指代基准上超过物体级朝向基础模型。
AI.conclusion: 显式朝向定位是一种区别于定位的、可学习的新能力；下游结果验证其对朝向相关空间推理具有益处。

title: Large Language Models Substantially Compress Well-Being Inequality but Largely Preserve Its Socioeconomic Structure
summary: Research using large language models (LLMs) to generate synthetic populations has repeatedly shown that model outputs compress the diversity of human experience. This has raised doubts about whether LLM-generated data can capture meaningful differences within populations. We show that such compression does not necessarily erase the social structure of human heterogeneity. Using 93,901 respondents from 66 countries and territories in Wave 7 of the World Values Survey, we ask six LLMs to predict respondents' life satisfaction from demographic, socioeconomic, and attitudinal profiles. All six models substantially understate the overall dispersion of life satisfaction. Yet after normalizing for these differences in scale, they largely reproduce the human income gradient in well-being inequality: lower-income groups remain relatively more heterogeneous than higher-income groups. The pattern is robust to country fixed effects, equal-country weighting, WVS survey weights, and observed demographic composition, and it extends directionally to employment, education, and perceived control. Fidelity is weaker for extreme outcomes and country-specific gradients. These results show that the amount of heterogeneity preserved by an LLM and the way that heterogeneity is distributed across social groups are distinct properties. LLM-generated populations can therefore substantially compress human variation while retaining meaningful information about where that variation is concentrated.

AI.tldr: LLM生成的人口数据虽低估生活满意度总体离散度，但归一化后仍能复现"低收入群体福祉不平等更高"的社会结构。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明LLM生成的合成人口压缩了人类经验的多样性，引发质疑：LLM数据能否捕捉群体内有意义的差异？作者希望检验这种压缩是否必然抹去人类异质性的社会结构。
AI.method: 使用世界价值观调查（WVS）第7波66个国家和地区93,901名受访者数据，让6个LLM基于人口学、社会经济和态度特征预测受访者的生活满意度，并检验收入—福祉不平等梯度等模式。
AI.result: 6个模型均显著低估生活满意度的总体离散度；但归一化后大体复现了人类"收入—福祉不平等梯度"（低收入群体内部异质性更高）。该模式对国家固定效应、等权重、WVS权重、人口构成均稳健，并方向性延伸至就业、教育和感知控制。极端结果和国别特异梯度上保真度较弱。
AI.conclusion: LLM保留的异质性"总量"与其在群体间的"分布方式"是两个独立属性。LLM生成人口可大幅压缩人类变异，同时保留关于变异集中位置的有意义信息。

title: Rewarding Novel Deductions: Solver-guided Process Rewards for Logical Reasoning
summary: Logical reasoning remains a major challenge for large language models (LLMs), particularly on structured problems that require precise constraint tracking, consistency preservation, and multi-step deduction. This challenge is especially acute for small-scale LLMs, which are more prone to producing inconsistent, redundant, or brittle reasoning trajectories. Existing approaches for improving logical reasoning largely optimize for final-answer correctness, providing only weak supervision over the intermediate reasoning process. In this work, we propose SPRING: (Solver-guided Process Rewards for Novel LogIcal ReasoNing Step Generation). SPRING uses SMT solver as a training-time verifier of intermediate reasoning steps to provide process-level supervision. It introduces the notion of a novel reasoning step, namely, a step that is logically valid, consistent with the evolving reasoning state, and not already implied by previously accepted non-contradictory deductions. Based on this solver-based assessment, it designs process rewards that encourage novel inferential progress while penalizing contradictory and uninformative reasoning steps. Evaluation across three logical reasoning benchmarks, ZebraLogic, AR-LSAT, and Knights and Knaves, and four LLMs shows that SPRING consistently outperforms base LLMs, outcome-only reward baselines, and Logic-LM. On ZebraLogic, SPRING improves puzzle accuracy by up to 49.71 and 15.43 points over the base LLM and strongest outcome-only baseline, respectively. On AR-LSAT, it improves overall accuracy by up to 64.93 and 12.14 points, respectively. On Knights and Knaves, SPRING achieves up to 93.14 puzzle accuracy and 96.05 person accuracy.

AI.tldr: SPRING利用SMT求解器对中间推理步骤做过程级监督，通过奖励“新颖有效推理”来提升小规模LLM的逻辑推理能力。
AI.motivation: LLM在需要精确约束跟踪、一致性保持和多步演绎的结构化逻辑推理上表现不佳，小规模模型尤为严重。现有方法多只优化最终答案正确性，对中间推理过程监督较弱，导致推理轨迹不一致、冗余或脆弱。
AI.method: 提出SPRING框架，使用SMT求解器作为训练时的验证器，对中间推理步骤进行过程级监督。定义“新颖推理步骤”为逻辑有效、与演化推理状态一致、且未被已接受的非矛盾推理所蕴含的步骤。基于该评估设计过程奖励，鼓励新颖推理进展，惩罚矛盾和无信息步骤。
AI.result: 在ZebraLogic、AR-LSAT、Knights and Knaves三个基准和四个LLM上评估。ZebraLogic上谜题准确率较基础LLM和最强结果奖励基线分别提升至多49.71和15.43分；AR-LSAT整体准确率提升至多64.93和12.14分；Knights and Knaves达到至多93.14谜题准确率和96.05人物准确率。
AI.conclusion: SPRING通过SMT求解器提供的过程级奖励持续优于基础LLM、仅结果奖励基线和Logic-LM，证明了对中间推理步骤进行新颖性引导的过程监督能有效提升逻辑推理能力。

title: Train Together or Merge Later? Unifying VLA Experts via a Shared Action Interface
summary: Co-training offers a straightforward way to build a multi-task vision-language-action (VLA) policy, but can fall short of the performance achieved by training each task independently. The challenge is to retain these task-specific gains in a multi-task policy without joint post-training. Combining independently trained experts through model merging is a natural approach, yet strong individual experts do not necessarily yield a strong merged policy. We identify one source of this incompatibility: task-specific changes to the action interface, comprising action normalization and the action encoder and decoder. We propose PolicyWeave, combining merge-compatible post-training with context-guided sparse merging. During post-training, all experts retain the common base policy's action interface, while task adaptation is restricted to LoRA updates in the hidden layers of the action model. This makes the experts more compatible with existing model merging methods. However, merging all experts can still introduce interference from unrelated tasks at deployment. PolicyWeave scores each expert's LoRA updates using the initial visual-language context, determines the expert set through leave-one-layer-out ranking stability, and forms a sparse weighted merge of the selected updates that remains fixed for current task. We evaluate PolicyWeave with GR00T N1.5 on 18 RoboCasa365 tasks, using only 10% of the target-task demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Preserving the shared action interface raises the average success rate across four static merging methods from 17.0% to 52.8%. PolicyWeave achieves 64.7% success with these SFT experts and 74.1% after task-specific reinforcement learning (RL), compared with 60.7% for joint RL. Further evaluations on LIBERO-10 and an AgileX Piper arm support the deployment of independently learned skills in long-horizon and real-world manipulation.

AI.tldr: PolicyWeave通过保留共享动作接口的合并兼容后训练与上下文引导稀疏合并，将独立训练的多任务VLA专家有效融合，在多任务操作中超越联合训练。
AI.motivation: 多任务VLA策略的协同训练（co-training）往往不如各任务独立训练的性能。模型合并是自然方案，但强专家合并后不一定得到强策略。作者发现不兼容的一个来源：任务特定的动作接口改动（动作归一化及动作编码器/解码器）。
AI.method: 提出PolicyWeave，包含两部分：(1) 合并兼容后训练——所有专家保留共享基础策略的动作接口，任务适配仅限动作模型隐藏层的LoRA更新；(2) 上下文引导稀疏合并——用初始视觉-语言上下文对每个专家的LoRA更新打分，通过留一层的排序稳定性确定专家集合，对所选更新做稀疏加权合并，并在当前任务下保持固定。
AI.result: 在GR00T N1.5上评测18个RoboCasa365任务，仅用10%目标任务示范做SFT。保留共享动作接口使四种静态合并方法的平均成功率从17.0%提升到52.8%。PolicyWeave在SFT专家上达64.7%成功率，任务特定RL后达74.1%，而联合RL为60.7%。在LIBERO-10和AgileX Piper机械臂上的实验进一步支持独立学习技能在长时程与真实世界操作中的部署。
AI.conclusion: 保留共享动作接口可显著提升专家可合并性，配合上下文引导稀疏合并能有效抑制无关任务干扰，使独立训练的技能在长时程与真实操作中成功部署，优于联合训练方案。

title: LLM sequential decision making under uncertainty in biochemical domains
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to drive scientific discovery. Understanding how LLMs make decisions from new data and memory of the literature is vital before trusting them to design experiments under tight experimental budgets. However, their decision strategies are invisible in the current performance scores used to evaluate research agents. Here, we benchmark five frontier LLMs in a Bayesian Optimization setting against published statistical baselines on seven combinatorial datasets spanning protein engineering, reaction optimization, molecular design, peptide self-assembly, and catalysis. Performance is paired with direct measurements of model beliefs and actions, enabling highly resolved behavior analysis. A prompt ablation that progressively strips context separates memorization from chemical reasoning and from bare categorical optimization. Prior chemical knowledge helps in expectation, but with high variance and occasionally even harms performance. No configuration tested decisively beats a mean statistical baseline across domains. Belief-movement and Martingale diagnostics, corrected here for a measurement-noise bias that mislabels rational agents as irrational, show that models overreact to incoming data rather than entrenching on their priors in the contexts studied here. Interestingly, while LLM actions are exploitative, models sincerely intend to explore and consistently act on that intent. This failure is a competence gap arising from context-stickiness. Removing in-context history restores exploration, indicating that priors and data must be decoupled to achieve effective LLM-driven discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文在贝叶斯优化设置下基准测试五个前沿LLM与统计基线，发现LLM的探索意图与实际利用行为脱节，源于上下文粘性，需解耦先验与数据。
AI.motivation: LLM increasingly drive scientific discovery, but their decision strategies are invisible in current performance scores. Understanding how LLMs make decisions from new data and literature memory is vital before trusting them to design experiments under tight budgets.
AI.method: 在贝叶斯优化设置下，将五个前沿LLM与已发表统计基线在七个组合数据集（蛋白质工程、反应优化、分子设计、肽自组装、催化）上对比。通过直接测量模型信念与行动，并设计逐步剥离上下文的提示消融，分离记忆、化学推理与纯类别优化。使用信念移动和鞅诊断（校正测量噪声偏差）。
AI.result: 先验化学知识在期望上有帮助但方差大，偶尔有害；无配置决定性地击败均值统计基线。诊断显示模型对数据过度反应而非固守先验。LLM行为是探索性的却在行动上利用性，存在能力差距（context-stickiness）；移除上下文历史可恢复探索。
AI.conclusion: LLM驱动的科学发现中，其探索意图与利用行为脱节，源于上下文粘性。需解耦先验与数据才能实现有效的LLM驱动发现。

title: Fair Fact-Checking: Closing the Cross-Lingual Gap in LLM Factual Judgement with RoSh
summary: Misinformation on social media remains a critical problem, and more and more people settle it by asking a language model instead of a fact checker. Whether models judge such claims reliably is debated; whether they judge them equally well in every language people ask in has gone almost unasked. We test eight models from five families, 3B to 70B, on 1,500 encyclopedic factual claims that exist in identical form in eight languages. English is judged better than every other language on every model, and the gap is widest on the smallest ones, where Llama-3B on Arabic is no better than guessing. Existing remedies retrain on more multilingual data or fit an unconstrained map between language representations, and neither asks whether the model already holds the answer and simply fails to say it. It largely does: a linear probe recovers the truth from the very activations the model fails to express. We propose RoSh, a per-language shift and rotation of the residual stream, computed in closed form at three layers, with no training and no weight modified. It improves every model and closes 75% of the gap on average, helping most where the model was worst: Arabic on Llama-3B goes from chance to nearly the English level, and a fifth fewer of the claims answered correctly in English are lost in translation. What remains is no longer a read-out failure: afterwards the head recovers as much of what is encoded outside English as it does in English. An unconstrained map fitted on the same pairs falls below the untouched baseline, so the orthogonality constraint is doing the work, and every model clears a scrambled-correspondence control and ten further controls. On the two benchmarks of the closest inference-time method, latent-space intervention, run with its own data and metric code, RoSh's gains are five to thirteen times larger.

AI.tldr: 提出RoSh方法，通过对残差流做逐语言的闭式平移与旋转，在不训练、不改动权重的情况下显著缩小LLM多语言事实判断的英语-其他语言差距。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体虚假信息治理中越来越多人用语言模型代替事实核查，但模型判断的可靠性有争议，且其在不同语言中判断是否同样可靠几乎无人研究。现有补救手段（多语言数据重训、语言表示间无约束映射）未探究模型是否已具备答案却无法表达。
AI.method: 测试五个家族、3B至70B的八个模型，使用八种语言中形式完全一致的1500条百科事实声明。提出RoSh：在三个层面对残差流施加逐语言的平移与旋转，以闭式解计算，无需训练、不改权重。并用线性探针验证模型内部已编码真相。设置打乱对应关系等十一项对照。
AI.result: 每种模型英语判断均优于其他语言，模型越小差距越大（Llama-3B阿拉伯语仅相当于随机猜测）。RoSh改善所有模型，平均弥合75%差距，对最差情形帮助最大：Llama-3B阿拉伯语从随机提升至接近英语水平，英语正确但在翻译中丢失的声明减少五分之一。事后探针恢复能力在英语与非英语间趋于一致。无约束映射低于未处理基线，正交约束起关键作用，且通过所有对照。在潜在空间干预方法的两个基准上，RoSh增益为其5至13倍。
AI.conclusion: 多语言事实判断差距主因是读出失败而非编码缺失；简单的闭式正交变换即可大幅缓解，且远优于现有推理时干预方法。

title: DroneWAM: Efficient World Action Model for Drone Visual Navigation
summary: World-action models give visual navigation agents a way to anticipate how candidate actions will change future observations and to act from the predicted consequences. For drones, this capability must operate under tight accuracy and efficiency constraints. We present DroneWAM, an efficient world-action model for drone visual navigation. DroneWAM adopts a JEPA-based architecture to model future states directly in representation space, avoiding the cost of explicit future image generation. A pretrained Resampler further compresses dense encoder features into fewer latent tokens, reducing the computation repeated at each imagined step. We also introduce adaptive rollout, where a preference-trained Gate adaptively allocates prediction depth according to the current scene. To support learning under richer aerial motion, we construct DroneNav-6D, a simulated visual navigation dataset with synchronized RGB observations, 6-DoF flight trajectories, control commands, and randomized wind disturbances. On DroneNav-6D, DroneWAM achieves the best trajectory accuracy among the compared methods.
