AI.conclusion: 强感知并不保证可靠的物理解读，存在被答案级准确率掩盖的接地瓶颈，未来模型需更好地将识别到的视觉证据与其物理含义对齐。

title: Decide, Don't Generate: Competitive Dimensional ABSA with Jev's Typed Decisions
summary: Aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) has largely turned to text generation. We show that competitive dimensional ABSA does not need it. Using Jev, a frozen model that answers typed questions with rubric scores, label probabilities, and yes/no judgments, we decompose all three tasks of SemEval-2026 Task III Track A into such decisions and align them with the annotation scheme through 488 coefficients fitted on CPU, with no text generation and no backbone tuning. On valence-arousal regression over ten corpora in six languages, the system reaches 1.0645 RMSE, the lowest aggregate error of any participating system. On triplet and quadruplet extraction, it reaches 52.09 and 44.06 continuous F1, above fine-tuned Llama-3.3-70B and GPT-OSS-120B baselines. Analyses and ablations show where the accuracy comes from: supervised calibration roughly halves the raw regression error, exact valence-arousal would add only 4.5 F1 to extraction, and the learned combination of span-boundary evidence, not any single signal, carries the extraction systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出无需文本生成即可完成维度化ABSA：用冻结模型Jev回答类型化问题（评分、标签概率、yes/no），并通过488个CPU拟合系数对齐标注方案，在SemEval-2026 Task III Track A三个子任务上取得竞争性甚至领先结果。
AI.motivation: ABSA领域大量转向文本生成范式，作者质疑竞争性维度化ABSA是否真的需要文本生成，希望探索更轻量、更高效的替代方案。
AI.method: 使用冻结模型Jev，将Track A的三个任务分解为类型化问题回答（rubric分数、标签概率、yes/no判断），通过488个在CPU上拟合的系数将输出与标注方案对齐，全程不进行文本生成也不微调骨干模型。
AI.result: 在6种语言10个语料库的valence-arousal回归上达到1.0645 RMSE，为所有参赛系统最低聚合误差；三元组和四元组抽取达到52.09和44.06连续F1，高于微调Llama-3.3-70B和GPT-OSS-120B基线。消融显示监督校准将原始回归误差约减半，精确valence-arousal仅能为抽取增加4.5 F1，抽取系统的性能来自多种span边界证据的学习组合而非单一信号。
AI.conclusion: 竞争性维度化ABSA可以在无文本生成、无骨干微调的条件下实现，轻量级校准方案在回归与抽取任务上均具竞争力，且性能主要来源于多种证据的联合建模。

title: PulseQuant: Propagation-Guided Subspace Correction for 4-Bit Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Quantization errors in video diffusion transformers can be amplified or attenuated by subsequent denoising updates, making local reconstruction error an incomplete predictor of final impact. We introduce PulseQuant, a 4-bit post-training quantization method that combines trajectory sensitivity with activation geometry to guide offline calibration. Isolated block--step interventions estimate propagation risk, which prioritizes sensitive trajectory states during row-radius selection. With these radii fixed, response-subspace correction uses neighboring-code edits to reduce residual components along dominant activation directions. Both stages preserve the original 4-bit weight representation. Controlled interventions show that short-horizon propagated error predicts final latent error more reliably than immediate block-output error, supporting calibration beyond local reconstruction objectives. Evaluations on Wan models, Self Forcing, and MiniMax-H3 demonstrate improvements in key consistency and dense-reference metrics while remaining competitive on other attributes across model scales and generation paradigms.

AI.tldr: PulseQuant：一种4位训练后量化方法，结合轨迹敏感性与激活几何指导离线校准，改善视频扩散Transformer的量化效果。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散Transformer中量化误差会被后续去噪更新放大或衰减，导致局部重建误差无法可靠预测最终影响，因此需要超越局部重建目标的校准方法。
AI.method: 通过孤立的块-步干预估计传播风险，优先选择敏感轨迹状态进行行半径选择；固定半径后，用邻近码编辑的响应子空间校正，减少沿主导激活方向的残差分量。两阶段均保持原始4位权重表示。
AI.result: 受控干预表明短时域传播误差比即时块输出误差更能可靠预测最终潜变量误差；在Wan、Self Forcing和MiniMax-H3上，关键一致性与稠密参考指标均有提升，其他属性上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 将校准目标从局部重建扩展到轨迹传播风险是有效的，PulseQuant在多种模型规模与生成范式下优于局部重建导向的量化方法。

title: Agentic Multi-Turn Reasoning: A Fairness Approach
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled agentic systems capable of solving complex tasks through multi-turn planning, tool use, verification, and memory updates. However, learning agentic systems remains difficult due to two fundamental challenges, i.e., (1) long-horizon credit assignment, where supervision is available only at the final outcome, and (2) imbalanced data distributions, where dominant data patterns bias optimization and weaken adaptation to rare but informative reasoning behaviors. In this paper, we propose Fair Multi-Level Preference Optimization (Fair-MPO or $Φ$-MPO), a new preference optimization framework for agentic learning. We first show that Multi-Level Preference Optimization provides a principled and more computationally efficient framework for long-horizon reasoning. Then, we introduce a Fair Multi-Level Objective that addresses imbalance in agentic learning. We provide a comprehensive theoretical analysis demonstrating that our approach addresses both long-horizon reasoning and data imbalance. Our experiments on agentic reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves State-of-the-Art (SOTA) performance.

AI.tldr: 提出Fair Multi-Level Preference Optimization (Fair-MPO)框架，解决LLM智能体学习中的长时程信用分配和数据分布不平衡两大挑战，实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体系统虽能通过多轮规划、工具使用等解决复杂任务，但学习仍面临两大挑战：(1)长时程信用分配——监督信号仅来自最终结果；(2)数据分布不平衡——主导模式偏差优化，削弱对稀有但重要推理行为的适应能力。
AI.method: 提出Fair Multi-Level Preference Optimization (Fair-MPO / Φ-MPO)偏好优化框架。首先证明Multi-Level Preference Optimization为长时程推理提供原则性且计算更高效的框架；随后引入Fair Multi-Level Objective解决智能体学习中的不平衡问题；并给出理论分析。
AI.result: 在智能体推理基准测试中达到State-of-the-Art (SOTA)性能。
AI.conclusion: Fair-MPO通过多级偏好优化与公平目标设计，从理论上同时解决长时程推理与数据不平衡问题，实验证明其有效性。

title: Epistemic Policy Divergence in Multi-Turn LLM Contamination: A Protocol-Gradient Investigation
comment: 9 figures, 19 tables. Benchmark, code, and protocol definitions: https://github.com/fahrellgiovanny/epistemic-policy-divergence
summary: Large language models process conversation history as unverified context: false premises injected into prior turns can be adopted as fact, a failure mode we term session-level contamination. We introduce five contamination protocols arranged along a source-authority gradient, isolating distinct failure mechanisms while holding the false premise constant, and evaluate GPT-5.4 Mini, Gemini-3.1 Flash-Lite, and GLM-4.5-Air across ten knowledge domains at temperature zero (22,500 turns), using a dual-track automated judge validated against a human gold standard (Cohen's \k{appa} = 0.901). GPT-5.4 Mini showed zero adoptions across all 500 sessions, a content-independent policy at the session level; token-level probing shows the underlying margin, while large, is finite. Gemini-3.1 Flash-Lite followed a steep authority gradient: 0.1% adoption for self-attributed falsehoods, 23.5% for user-cited sources, 68.2% for system-injected authority, and 94.0% under instruction override. GLM-4.5-Air showed a shallower gradient (15.8% vs 84.2%), a 68-percentage-point dissociation confirming that authority deference and instruction compliance are distinct mechanisms within one architecture. Recovery also diverged: GLM recovered in 94.5% of affected sessions, whereas 26.1% of affected Gemini sessions never did, rising to 40.0% under instruction override. Conversation history is an untrusted attack surface requiring provenance-aware system design; the complete framework is released as an open-source benchmark.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"会话级污染"概念，通过5种污染协议沿来源权威梯度测试3个LLM在10领域22500轮对话中的假前提采纳行为，揭示权威遵从与指令服从是不同机制。
AI.motivation: LLM将对话历史当作未验证上下文，先前轮次注入的假前提可能被采信为事实，此失败模式（会话级污染）缺乏系统研究，且历史对话实为不可信的攻表面。
AI.method: 设计5种污染协议沿来源权威梯度排列，固定假前提以隔离不同失败机制；在temperature=0下评估GPT-5.4 Mini、Gemini-3.1 Flash-Lite、GLM-4.5-Air，跨10个知识域共22500轮；采用双轨自动评判并与人类金标准验证（Cohen's κ=0.901）。
AI.result: GPT-5.4 Mini零采纳（会话级内容无关策略），但token级探测显示边界虽大却有限；Gemini呈现陡峭权威梯度（自我归因0.1%→用户引用23.5%→系统注入68.2%→指令覆盖94.0%）；GLM梯度较缓（15.8%→84.2%），存在68个百分点解离；恢复性上GLM恢复94.5%，Gemini有26.1%永不恢复、指令覆盖下达40.0%。
AI.conclusion: 对话历史是不可信攻击面，需来源感知的系统设计；权威遵从与指令服从在同一架构内是不同机制；完整框架已作为开源基准发布。

title: SciGen-Verifier: A Multimodal Reasoner for Explainable Verification in Scientific Image Generation
summary: In realistic education, a solution is often expressed not only in words but in a drawing--a circuit, a geometric construction, a function plot--and a teacher must grade the drawing as carefully as the text. Recent advances in unified multimodal models have enabled scientific image generation, yet verifying the correctness of these specialized visual outputs remains a critical bottleneck: errors often arise from intricate domain knowledge, structural reasoning, and multi-step instruction rather than surface-level artifacts. Existing verifiers mainly target natural images and compress judgement into scalar scores, leaving scientific coverage and explainable feedback for error correction underexplored. To bridge this gap, we make three main contributions. (1) We construct SciGen-Verify, a benchmark dedicated to explainable verification of scientific image generation, spanning instruction following, multidisciplinary reasoning, and world knowledge domains. It contains a three-tier hierarchical protocol over the binary judgement, supporting explanation, and corrective editing instruction. (2) We develop SciGen-Verifier, a reasoning-driven multimodal verifier trained via cold-start supervised fine-tuning followed by a curriculum-based two-stage reinforcement learning pipeline. The rubric-guided process rewards first strengthen scientific reasoning exploration and outcome rewards subsequently align output with ground-truth annotation. (3) On SciGen-Verify, SciGen-Verifier achieves competitive performance against much larger proprietary models. It further serves as a practical online critic for iterative image rectification.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对科学图像生成验证瓶颈，构建了可解释验证基准SciGen-Verify并提出推理驱动的多模态验证器SciGen-Verifier。
AI.motivation: 真实教育中图形解答（电路、几何作图、函数图像）需像文字一样被仔细批改。现有多模态模型虽能生成科学图像，但验证其正确性仍是瓶颈：错误多源于专业领域知识、结构推理和多步指令，而非表面瑕疵。现有验证器主要面向自然图像，且仅输出标量分数，缺乏科学覆盖与可解释纠错反馈。
AI.method: (1) 构建SciGen-Verify基准，覆盖指令遵循、多学科推理与世界知识，包含二值判断、解释支持、纠错编辑指令的三层分级协议；(2) 开发SciGen-Verifier，采用冷启动监督微调，再经课程式两阶段强化学习训练；先通过评分标准引导的过程奖励增强科学推理探索，随后用结果奖励对齐真实标注。
AI.result: 在SciGen-Verify上，SciGen-Verifier性能可与远大于自身的专有模型竞争，并能作为实用的在线评论器用于迭代图像修正。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了科学图像生成可解释验证的空白，验证器兼具判断、解释与纠错能力，可作为在线反馈工具支持图像迭代优化。

title: ANTMAN: Adaptive Need Tracking for Multi-Agent Navigation in Large Information Spaces
summary: Information-seeking agents increasingly operate over information spaces that are too large to process exhaustively. Yet many multi-agent systems organize computation around static partitions of the available space, causing coordination to grow with how information is segmented rather than with what the query still requires. We introduce ANTMAN, an adaptive coordination framework that treats evolving unresolved information needs as the unit of runtime coordination. ANTMAN maintains a revisable Need Graph that tracks unresolved requirements, accumulated evidence, prior attempts, and search progress, and uses this state to control worker selection, routing, and task-local recovery as new evidence is discovered. By separating the coordination policy from substrate-specific search interfaces, the same need-conditioned mechanism can operate across different information spaces. Experiments across multi-document question answering, controlled long-context scaling, and realistic structured navigation show that ANTMAN remains effective across settings, including when execution is delegated to substantially smaller worker models. Under a 16x increase in searchable context, ANTMAN increases active coordination by only 1.23x, compared with more than 15x for partition-driven baselines, while preserving strong answer quality.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ANTMAN，一种以"未解决信息需求"为运行时协调单元的自适应多智能体协调框架，通过可修订的 Need Graph 动态控制 worker 选择、路由与恢复，跨多种信息空间验证其高效性与可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 现有信息检索型多智能体系统多围绕信息空间的静态分区组织计算，导致协调开销随信息被切分的方式增长，而非随查询尚未满足的需求增长。当信息空间过大无法穷举处理时，这种分区驱动的协调方式效率低下、扩展性差。
AI.method: 提出 ANTMAN 框架，将不断演化的"未解决信息需求"作为运行时协调单元。维护一个可修订的 Need Graph，跟踪未满足需求、累积证据、历史尝试与搜索进度；利用该状态控制 worker 选择、路由及任务本地恢复。协调策略与底层搜索接口解耦，使同一"需求条件化"机制可跨不同信息空间运行。
AI.result: 在多文档问答、受控长上下文扩展、真实结构化导航等实验中，ANTMAN 均保持有效，包括将执行委派给显著更小的 worker 模型时。搜索上下文扩大 16 倍时，ANTMAN 的活跃协调仅增加 1.23 倍，而分区驱动基线增加超过 15 倍，同时保持较强的答案质量。
AI.conclusion: 以未解决信息需求驱动的自适应协调，比静态分区策略更具可扩展性与效率，能在信息空间大幅扩大时显著抑制协调开销增长，并适用于多种信息空间与较小 worker 模型。

title: MemoReason: Evaluating the Effect of Parametric Memory on Contextual Reasoning in LLMs
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on reasoning benchmarks, but it remains unclear whether this reflects genuine contextual reasoning or reliance on facts memorized in their parameters. We investigate this by distinguishing two possibilities: a broad \textit{memorization bias}, where familiar content improves reasoning performance, and the \textit{Strong Parametric Shortcut Hypothesis}, where models skip reasoning entirely and recall stored answers. To test these effects, we introduce \textbf{MemoReason}, a human-curated benchmark that pairs factual reasoning tasks with structurally identical \fictitiousterm{} versions where real entities like people, companies, or dates are systematically replaced by \fictitiousterm{} ones of the same type. This \scorerevision{preserves task structure and specified reasoning operations} while varying the familiarity of the context, allowing controlled measurement of how the parametric memory affects reasoning. \revision{Our evaluation of recent LLMs reveals consistent and statistically significant performance drops of up to 15.7\% in the fictitious setting, demonstrating a clear memorization bias.} However, a targeted analysis of \revision{questions failed in the fictitious setting} shows that models rarely respond with the corresponding factual answer, indicating that direct parametric shortcuts are not the dominant failure mode. These findings suggest that parametric memory influences reasoning through mechanisms more complex than simple factual recall. \textbf{MemoReason} provides a controlled framework for studying these mechanisms and for extending paired factual-fictitious{} evaluation to broader reasoning settings.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MemoReason 基准，通过对比事实任务与结构相同的虚构版本，区分"记忆偏差"与"强参数捷径假说"，发现 LLM 存在显著记忆偏差但直接参数捷径并非主要失效模式。
AI.motivation: LLM 在推理基准上表现优异，但不清楚这反映真实的上下文推理还是依赖参数中记忆的事实。需区分两种可能：广泛的记忆偏差（熟悉内容提升推理表现）与强参数捷径假说（模型完全跳过推理直接回忆答案）。
AI.method: 构建 MemoReason 人工标注基准，将事实推理任务与结构完全相同的虚构版本配对，将真实实体（人物、公司、日期等）系统替换为同类型的虚构实体，从而在保持任务结构和推理操作不变的前提下改变上下文的熟悉度，实现参数记忆对推理影响的受控测量。
AI.result: 对近期 LLM 的评测显示，虚构设定下性能一致且统计显著下降，最高达 15.7%，表明存在明显的记忆偏差。但对虚构设定中失败问题的针对性分析表明，模型很少给出对应的真实答案，说明直接的参数捷径并非主要失效模式。
AI.conclusion: 参数记忆通过比简单事实回忆更复杂的机制影响推理。MemoReason 为研究这些机制及将配对的事实-虚构评测扩展到更广泛推理场景提供了受控框架。

title: Groupwise Selective State-Space Filtering for Accurate and Streaming Action Boundary Detection
summary: Action boundary detection partitions untrimmed video into intervals without assigning action classes. We present a boundary-detection adapter operating on pre-extracted video features, learning temporal representations via groupwise selective scans. Learned group fusion and temporal modeling convert these into transition scores, which are decoded into boundary timestamps. Trained with boundary-time supervision, the class-agnostic model is evaluated on Breakfast, GTEA, and 50Salads using temporal tolerances and bipartite matching, achieving boundary $F_1$ scores of 0.457, 0.622, and 0.611. A stateful variant enables feature-streaming inference with zero neural look-ahead, one-sample peak confirmation, and bounded memory. Downstream systems can subsequently assign s

AI.tldr: 提出一种在预提取视频特征上运行的边界检测适配器，通过分组选择性扫描与组融合进行时序建模，输出转移分数并解码为动作边界时间戳，在三个数据集上取得0.457/0.622/0.611的边界F1。
AI.motivation: 未裁剪视频的动作边界检测需将视频划分为区间但不分配动作类别，现有方法多依赖端到端特征提取，缺乏在预提取特征上进行高效时序建模并支持流式推理的方案。
AI.method: 边界检测适配器作用于预提取视频特征，利用分组选择性扫描（groupwise selective scans）学习时序表示；通过可学习的组融合与时序建模生成转移分数，再解码为边界时间戳；使用边界时间监督训练类别无关模型。另提供有状态变体实现特征流式推理，零神经前瞻、单样本峰值确认、内存有界。
AI.result: 在Breakfast、GTEA、50Salads上以时间容差和二分匹配评估，边界F1分别为0.457、0.622、0.611。
AI.conclusion: 该类别无关适配器在预提取特征上有效完成动作边界检测，并支持低延迟、有界的流式推理，便于下游系统进行动作类别分配。

title: Naturalness-guided Manifold Flow Matching for Sign Language Production
summary: Sign Language Production (SLP) aims to generate sign motions from text. Conditional Flow Matching methods have achieved strong performance in SLP by constructing conditional paths that transform a source distribution into a target distribution. However, existing methods construct these paths via linear interpolation, whereas the rotational geometry of human joints confines valid joint rotations to a manifold embedded in Euclidean space. Consequently, linear interpolation between two sign motions leaves this manifold and ignores the motion distribution on it. In this paper, we revisit SLP from the perspective of manifold transport and propose a Naturalness-guided Manifold Flow Matching framework, termed \textbf{SignNMFlow}, which constructs conditional paths directly on the motion manifold by jointly considering geometric efficiency and the motion distribution. Specifically, we exploit the intrinsic geometry of the manifold and introduce a motion naturalness measure to characterize the motion distribution. By minimizing the kinetic energy under this measure, we learn a naturalness-guided interpolation that couples a closed-form geodesic, which provides geometrically efficient transport, with a learnable deviation that incorporates the motion distribution, thereby significantly improving the fidelity of generated sign motions. Extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of this work.

AI.tldr: 本文针对手语生成(SLP)中现有Conditional Flow Matching使用线性插值、偏离人体关节旋转流形的问题，提出SignNMFlow框架，在运动流形上构建条件路径，结合几何效率与运动分布，显著提升生成手语动作的保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有SLP方法虽借助Conditional Flow Matching从源分布到目标分布构建条件路径取得良好效果，但路径通过线性插值构建；而人体关节的旋转几何将有效关节旋转限制在嵌入欧氏空间的流形上，线性插值会使中间动作离开该流形，并忽略流形上的动作分布，导致生成质量受限。
AI.method: 从流形运输视角重新审视SLP，提出自然度引导的流形Flow Matching框架SignNMFlow：直接在运动流形上构建条件路径，同时考虑几何效率与运动分布。具体地，利用流形的内在几何，引入运动自然度度量刻画动作分布；在该度量下最小化动能，学习一种自然度引导的插值，将提供几何高效运输的闭式测地线与融入运动分布的可学习偏差相耦合。
AI.result: 通过大量定性与定量评估验证了该方法的有效性，显著提升了生成手语动作的保真度。
AI.conclusion: 将SLP建模为流形上的运输问题，并在流形上构建兼顾几何效率与运动分布的条件路径，是一种有效提升手语生成保真度的方案。

title: From Input to Output: A Flexible Agent for Dual-End Interpretation of Sparse Autoencoder Features
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are an important tool for mechanistic interpretability, but interpreting their many features remains challenging. Existing methods characterize input-side activation patterns and output-side intervention effects, yet often leave their functional connection implicit, while input-side evidence collection typically relies on costly large-corpus scans. We introduce functional interpretation, which characterizes an SAE feature as a mapping from its activating input semantics to its output effects under intervention, and present Dual-End Agentic Feature Interpretation (DAFI), an agent that actively gathers evidence and refines input-side, output-side, and functional interpretations through component-specific feedback. Its short-context token probing enables on-demand activation evidence collection without a full corpus scan. On GemmaScope, DAFI improves Input score by 13.1 percentage points over SAGE and Output score by 38.9 points over Token Change, while being substantially more token-efficient than a general-purpose coding agent. Skills distilled from successful refinements raise the held-out joint pass rate from 58.0% to 92.0% and improve both interpretation quality and efficiency when transferred to a new model-SAE setting. Across features with reliable endpoint interpretations, 70.7% exhibit non-equivalent input and output semantics. On AxBench, DAFI also improves steering-feature selection over output-score filtering. Code is available at https://github.com/THUAIS-Lab/DAFI.

AI.tldr: 提出功能性解释概念与DAFI智能体，通过主动收集证据并联合优化输入/输出/功能三层解释，提升稀疏自编码器特征解释质量与效率。
AI.motivation: 稀疏自编码器(SAE)是机制可解释性的重要工具，但其特征难以解释。现有方法分别刻画输入侧激活模式与输出侧干预效果，然而二者之间的功能联系往往被忽略、保持隐式；同时输入侧证据收集通常依赖昂贵的大规模语料扫描。
AI.method: 提出"功能性解释"(functional interpretation)，将SAE特征刻画为从激活输入语义到干预下输出效果的映射。据此设计DAFI(Dual-End Agentic Feature Interpretation)智能体，主动收集证据，借助组件级反馈迭代精炼输入侧、输出侧与功能性解释；其短上下文token探测可在无需全语料扫描的情况下按需收集激活证据。
AI.result: 在GemmaScope上，DAFI的Input得分较SAGE提升13.1个百分点，Output得分较Token Change提升38.9个百分点，且token效率显著优于通用编码智能体。从成功精炼中蒸馏的技能将留出联合通过率从58.0%提升至92.0%，迁移到新模型-SAE设置时同时改善解释质量与效率。在具有可靠端点解释的特征中，70.7%呈现输入与输出语义非等价。AxBench上DAFI在引导特征选择上优于输出得分过滤。
AI.conclusion: DAFI通过统一输入侧与输出侧的功能性解释框架，实现了更高质量、更高效的SAE特征解释，并揭示了大量特征输入输出语义不一致的现象，为机制可解释性提供了实用工具与洞见。

title: VaME: Exploring Variational Latent Reasoning for Multimodal Embeddings
summary: Universal multimodal retrieval requires compact embeddings that preserve task-relevant semantic information across diverse modalities. Prior works have incorporated latent reasoning into multimodal embedding learning to refine this information before embedding extraction. However, most existing approaches remain confined to deterministic latent paths, without exploring alternative trajectories to discover better embeddings. Thus, we propose VaME (Variational Multimodal Embeddings), a framework that models latent reasoning as a learnable distribution over trajectories. Specifically, we first introduce Variational Latent Reasoning (VLR) to enable autoregressive exploration in latent space, guided by answer reconstruction through a lightweight decoder. Meanwhile, we augment the original embedding-token readout with a latent-fused embedding to facilitate exploration during subsequent reinforcement learning. Finally, we optimize latent reasoning over stochastic variational trajectories through reinforcement learning, using Semantic Decoding Reward (SDR) to favor semantically meaningful trajectories with interpretable decoded outcomes. On the 78-task MMEB-V2 benchmark, spanning image, video, and visual-document retrieval, VaME outperforms most explicit CoT-based models and all latent-reasoning baselines. VaME also demonstrates robust performance on reasoning-intensive benchmarks such as MRMR, with substantial gains after reinforcement learning. Importantly, VaME achieves these gains with at least a 4.25x inference speedup over the deterministic latent autoregressive baselines. The code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出VaME，将多模态嵌入的隐式推理建模为可学习的轨迹分布，通过变分潜在推理和强化学习探索更优嵌入，在MMEB-V2等基准上超越多数基线，并实现至少4.25倍推理加速。
AI.motivation: 现有将隐式推理引入多模态嵌入学习的方法局限于确定性潜在路径，无法探索替代轨迹以发现更优嵌入，因此需要建模推理轨迹的分布来进行探索。
AI.method: VaME框架：1) 变分潜在推理（VLR）在潜在空间自回归探索，由轻量解码器的答案重建引导；2) 在原始嵌入token读出基础上增加潜在融合嵌入以支持后续强化学习探索；3) 通过强化学习在随机变分轨迹上优化，并用语义解码奖励（SDR）偏好语义有意义且解码结果可解释的轨迹。
AI.result: 在覆盖图像、视频、视觉文档检索的78任务MMEB-V2基准上超过多数显式CoT模型和所有潜在推理基线；在MRMR等推理密集型基准上表现稳健，强化学习后显著提升；推理速度相比确定性潜在自回归基线至少快4.25倍。
AI.conclusion: 将隐式推理建模为变分轨迹分布并结合强化学习，能有效提升通用多模态检索嵌入质量，同时大幅提高推理效率，代码将公开。

title: QuPID: Quantum Parameter-Efficient Input-Dependent Retrieval Adaptation for Medical RAG
summary: Fidelity-based quantum retrieval ranks candidates by the fidelity between query and archive states. Applying a shared input-independent unitary after fixed state encoding leaves that fidelity unchanged, so training the circuit cannot alter the ranking. Quantum parameter-efficient input-dependent retrieval adaptation (QuPID) repairs this by making the circuit input-dependent through data re-uploading and by comparing measurement readouts, vectors of local Pauli expectations, rather than states. The result is a small readout for adapting frozen image features to a local archive with limited data: training simulates the circuit classically, and inference runs on a GPU with fixed learned parameters. We characterize the class as a structured factorization of input-modulated quadratic feature maps, bound the frequency support of its re-uploading channel, and give a parameter-count generalization bound that motivates its small budget. Under a shared frozen backbone and a label-free protocol, QuPID's 60 parameters give higher precision-at-5 (P@5) on ChestX-ray14 and MURA than frozen medical encoders, and than adapters and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with up to 5.25 million trainable parameters. On ChestX-ray14, the P@5 gain over the frozen encoder is +0.116, the lead over retuned adapters is widest at 512 adaptation examples (+0.040), and the full-budget margin over an equally compact classical rotation-plane head is +0.023 with a 95% interval excluding zero. Medical imaging is the primary testbed; the pattern recurs on two non-medical benchmarks, in report generation, and under simulated gate noise and finite-shot readout.

AI.tldr: QuPID 通过数据重上传和读出比较，使量子检索电路变为输入依赖，用仅 60 个参数即可高效适配冻结图像特征。
AI.motivation: 基于保真度的量子检索用查询态与档案态的保真度排序，但固定编码后的共享输入无关酉变换不改变保真度，导致训练电路无法调整排序。
AI.method: 通过数据重上传使电路输入依赖，并比较局域 Pauli 期望构成的测量读出向量；将电路类刻画为输入调制二次特征图的结构分解，界定重上传通道频率支撑，并给出参数计数泛化界。训练经典模拟，推理在 GPU 上使用固定学习参数。
AI.result: 共享冻结骨干、无标签协议下，60 参数 QuPID 在 ChestX-ray14 和 MURA 上 P@5 高于冻结医学编码器及最多 5.25M 参数的适配器和 LoRA；ChestX-ray14 上较冻结编码器 +0.116，领先重调适配器在 512 样本时 +0.040，较同等紧凑经典旋转平面头 +0.023 且 95% 区间不含零；模式也出现在两个非医学基准、报告生成和噪声/有限采样设置。
AI.conclusion: QuPID 以极小参数预算实现输入依赖的量子检索适配，在医学与非医学任务中均优于冻结编码器和更大参数适配方法。

title: Deep Learning Methods in Neuroscience: From Modeling Molecular Mechanisms to Classifying States of Consciousness
summary: A critical analysis of contemporary approaches to the study of conscious states. The review focuses on methods of classification, clustering, modeling of brain states under anesthesia and identification of measurable neurobiological characteristics of brain function. A comparative analysis was conducted in the following three major areas: automatic detection of states of consciousness using neural networks based on EEG and fMRI data; modeling of the structural-functional dynamics of the brain under the effects of anesthetics; and detection of neurophysiological indicators which correlate with the level of consciousness. The obtained conclusions demonstrate the growing effectiveness of deep neural models in the classification and prediction of brain states and the analysis of dynamic structural-functional connectivity. Nonetheless, significant limitations were also identified, including the limited interpretability of the models, the lack of standardized metrics, and the problem of the specificity of consciousness markers. Our findings support the need for developing hybrid, generalizible, physiologically grounded architectures. Furthermore, such approaches may improve the translational potential of computational models in clinical neuroscience. Diverse methods of machine and computational modeling have demonstrated their effectiveness in tasks of automatic clustering and classification of brain states, the development of multilevel models and the identification of connectivity patterns correlated with levels of consciousness. A larger-scale analysis and a larger dataset, as well as the implementation of model interpretability approaches are required for the practical application of the analyzed models. The models based on EEG and LFP are the most promising for clinical application due to their availability and the possibility of real-time monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文综述清醒/麻醉等意识状态的神经影像与建模研究，比较EEG/fMRI自动分类、麻醉下脑结构-功能动力学建模、意识水平相关神经生理指标三大方向，认为深度模型有效但存在可解释性差、缺乏标准指标、意识标记特异性不足等问题，呼吁发展混合、可泛化、具生理基础的架构。
AI.motivation: 意识状态的客观分类与意识水平的量化是神经科学与临床麻醉、脑损伤评估中的核心难题。现有方法分散在机器学习分类、计算建模与神经生理指标检测等方向，缺乏系统比较，因此需要批判性梳理当代研究路径的成效与局限。
AI.method: 采用批判性文献综述与比较分析，围绕三大领域展开：(1)基于EEG与fMRI数据、用神经网络自动检测意识状态；(2)麻醉作用下脑结构-功能动力学的建模；(3)与意识水平相关的神经生理指标检测。对比各方法的有效性、局限性与转化潜力。
AI.result: 深度神经模型在脑状态分类与预测、动态结构-功能连接分析中表现日益有效；但存在模型可解释性有限、评价指标缺乏标准化、意识标记特异性不足等显著局限。基于EEG与LFP的模型因易获取、支持实时监测，被认为最具临床应用前景。
AI.conclusion: 机器与计算建模方法在意识状态自动聚类、分类、多层级建模与连接模式识别上已被证明有效。但实际应用仍需更大规模数据与更深入分析，并引入模型可解释性方法。未来应发展混合式、可泛化、具生理基础的架构，以提升计算模型在临床神经科学中的转化价值。

title: Resolving State-Representation Mismatch: State-Space Visual Reasoning for Open-Loop VLA Planning
summary: Despite rapid progress in vision-language-action (VLA) models, existing reasoning paradigms still face a fundamental \emph{state-representation mismatch} in open-loop planning. Given only an initial observation, models must internally simulate action-conditioned state transitions, whereas text-, pixel-, and latent-space reasoning can suffer from lossy spatial compression, error-accumulating visual generation, and bypass of intermediate latent tokens, respectively, undermining reliable long-horizon planning. We propose \textbf{State-Space Visual Reasoning} (SSVR), which decouples static visual context, language constraints, and a recurrent latent state. SSVR encodes the initial image and instruction once, then conditions each action prediction on the latent state and updates it with an action-conditioned GRU. Using Qwen2.5-VL as the backbone, SSVR achieves 99.5/99.6, 96.3/98.0, and 83.9/90.6 EM/PR on FrozenLake, Maze, and MiniBehavior, substantially outperforming prior methods. Extensive experiments support the effectiveness of recurrent state modeling for VLA open-loop planning across input transformations and transfer settings. By reusing static visual-textual context and updating a compact recurrent state, SSVR supports efficient multi-step inference, achieving up to $98.58\times$ faster Maze decoding rollouts than the evaluated baselines with the prefix cache prebuilt.

AI.tldr: 提出State-Space Visual Reasoning (SSVR)，将静态视觉上下文、语言约束与循环隐状态解耦，通过action-conditioned GRU更新隐状态，在开放环规划中显著超越现有方法并大幅加速推理。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在开环规划中存在"状态表示不匹配"：仅凭初始观测需内部模拟动作条件状态转移，而文本/像素/隐空间推理分别面临有损空间压缩、误差累积的视觉生成、跳过中间隐token等问题，损害长时程规划可靠性。
AI.method: SSVR只编码一次初始图像与指令，将静态视觉上下文、语言约束和一个循环隐状态解耦；每个动作预测以隐状态为条件，并用action-conditioned GRU更新该隐状态。以Qwen2.5-VL为骨干。
AI.result: 在FrozenLake、Maze、MiniBehavior上分别取得99.5/99.6、96.3/98.0、83.9/90.6的EM/PR，大幅超越先前方法；在预建prefix cache下，Maze解码rollout比基线最快达98.58倍。
AI.conclusion: 循环状态建模对VLA开环规划有效，复现性强且对输入变换和迁移设置具鲁棒性；通过复用静态视觉-文本上下文并更新紧凑循环状态，实现高效多步推理。

title: Unmask the State: When Does State Adaptation Matter for Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models (MDMs) admit flexible generation orders, making the unmasking strategy an inference decision. Existing methods vary in how they prioritize positions, control parallelism, restrict selection regions, revise predictions, or plan future denoising, yet it remains unclear when these choices should change during generation. We study this question through strategy reversals, where an alternative action becomes preferable to a fixed choice. We organize MDM inference into five axes--score, cardinality, region, commitment, and planning--and define adaptation opportunity as the one-step utility advantage of the best candidate action over a validation-selected fixed action. This view shows that adaptation value depends on both the frequency and magnitude of such reversals. Across three MDMs and ten tasks, adaptation opportunities are highly heterogeneous, with some regimes exhibiting concentrated and predictable one-step gains. This motivates selective adaptation: lightweight detectors calibrated on validation prompts identify high-opportunity states, capturing, for example, 56.9 percent of the candidate-set oracle opportunity by adapting only the top 10 percent of states on LLaDA-8B constrained JSON filling. Our transition-level results suggest that state adaptation is most useful when applied selectively rather than uniformly.

AI.tldr: 研究MDM推理中unmasking策略何时应改变，提出adaptation opportunity概念与selective adaptation方法，实验表明状态自适应应选择性使用而非统一使用。
AI.motivation: MDM允许灵活生成顺序，unmasking策略成为推理决策。现有方法各有侧重，但不清楚这些选择何时应在生成过程中改变。作者通过strategy reversals研究这一问题。
AI.method: 将MDM推理分为五个轴（score、cardinality、region、commitment、planning），定义adaptation opportunity为最佳候选动作相对验证选择的固定动作的一步效用优势；提出selective adaptation：用验证prompt校准轻量检测器识别高机会状态。
AI.result: 在三个MDM和十个任务上，adaptation opportunity高度异质，部分情形存在集中且可预测的一步增益。在LLaDA-8B约束JSON填充任务上，仅对前10%状态自适应即可捕获56.9%的候选集oracle机会。
AI.conclusion: transition-level结果表明，状态自适应在选择性应用时最有用，而非统一应用。

title: How Well Can LLMs Simulate Real Learner Evaluations of Educational Feedback?
comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: While recent studies have explored human behavior and preference simulation using large language models (LLMs), it remains unclear how well LLMs can simulate subjective evaluations from real learners in educational settings. We investigate this question using real learner evaluation data on feedback for high-school biology questions at both the group and individual levels. We compare performance with and without learner-specific information, such as personality traits and evaluation examples, across six models. Our results show that LLMs still have a limited ability to simulate learner evaluations. Providing learner profiles and examples improves score calibration and individual-level simulation, but more often fails to improve group-level consistency. These findings highlight the need to investigate which learner information and adaptation strategies are effective for learner preference simulation.

AI.tldr: 研究检验大语言模型能否模拟真实学习者的主观评价，发现其能力仍然有限：学习者画像与示例能改善分数校准和个体级模拟，但常无法提升群体级一致性。
AI.motivation: 已有研究探索用LLM模拟人类行为与偏好，但在教育场景中LLM能否再现真实学习者的主观评价尚不清楚，因此需要实证考察。
AI.method: 使用高中生物问题的反馈评价数据，在群体和个体两个层面比较六种模型的表现，并对照有/无学习者特定信息（人格特质、评价示例）两种条件。
AI.result: LLM模拟学习者评价的能力仍有限；引入学习者画像与示例可改善分数校准与个体级模拟，但多数情况下无助于群体级一致性。
AI.conclusion: 需进一步探究哪些学习者信息与适应策略对学习者偏好模拟真正有效。

title: TTRSD: Test-Time Reinforcement Learning with Self-Distillation for Vision-Language Models
summary: Test-time reinforcement learning enables vision-language models (VLMs) to adapt using unlabeled inputs. However, repeated sampling under fixed visual conditions can reinforce shared perceptual errors, while sequence-level rewards fail to isolate visual perception the foundational bottleneck that anchors multimodal reasoning risking the degradation of pre-trained reasoning capabilities. We propose TTRSD, a test-time reinforcement learning framework combining multi-view answer-level self-distillation with visual contrastive token selection. A shared policy aggregates teacher predictions across original, cropped, and downsampled views into an answer distribution. Student trajectories generated from the original image receive rewards based on the support for their final answers in this distribution. To allocate this feedback precisely toward perceptual bottlenecks, we compare the log-probabilities of the same sampled tokens under original and visually ablated inputs while holding their textual prefixes fixed, selecting visually sensitive positions for policy-gradient updates. TTRSD separates update direction, determined by group-relative advantages, from update position, determined by visual sensitivity, without requiring ground-truth labels, external verifiers, or a separate teacher. With only 20 unlabeled adaptation samples, TTRSD improves performance across seven benchmarks and three VLMs, raising InternVL3-2B's MMMU accuracy from 35.79% to 49.32%(+13.53%), demonstrating cross-dataset generalization while preserving inherent reasoning integrity.

AI.tldr: 提出TTRSD测试时强化学习框架，通过多视角答案级自蒸馏和视觉对比token选择，无需真值标签提升VLM性能。
AI.motivation: 固定视觉条件下重复采样会强化共享感知错误，而序列级奖励无法定位视觉感知这一多模态推理的根本瓶颈，可能损害预训练推理能力。
AI.method: 结合多视角答案级自蒸馏与视觉对比token选择。共享策略聚合原始、裁剪、下采样视角的教师预测为答案分布；学生轨迹按最终答案在该分布中的支持度获奖励。通过比较原始与视觉消融输入下相同token的对数概率，选取视觉敏感位置进行策略梯度更新。分离更新方向（组相对优势）与更新位置（视觉敏感性）。
AI.result: 仅用20个无标签适配样本，在7个基准和3个VLM上提升性能，InternVL3-2B的MMMU准确率从35.79%升至49.32%（+13.53%），具跨数据集泛化性并保留推理完整性。
AI.conclusion: TTRSD无需真值标签、外部验证器或独立教师，有效针对视觉感知瓶颈，提升VLM测试时适应能力。

title: Long-Horizon Analog Design Bench: Benchmarking Agents on Hours-Long Analog and Mixed-Signal Circuit Design Tasks
summary: Coding agents now sustain hours-long, tool-driven loops, yet their ability to carry long-horizon analog and mixed-signal circuits to electrical specification remains unmeasured. We introduce Analog Design Bench, a long-horizon agentic benchmark of 50 transistor-level design tasks contributed by 17 chip designers. Agents work with an open-source simulator, while an isolated verifier evaluates the submitted circuit using specification-based electrical tests. We evaluate 15 agent configurations across 2,250 two-hour attempts and observe full-specification pass rates from 8.0% to 78.0%. Coding-benchmark performance correlates with analog results but leaves much of the performance spread unexplained. Our failure analysis shows that most unsuccessful submissions have no recorded legality rejection but fail electrical acceptance, identifying electrical closure as the dominant endpoint challenge. We test time, reasoning effort, agent harness, and supplied design knowledge as interventions. Longer budgets and higher reasoning effort improve performance, while general skill documents provide little benefit and sometimes reduce performance. Supplying a task-matched reference topology, an idealized form of circuit-IP retrieval, raises DeepSeek V4 Pro by 18.7 percentage points and mainly accelerates GPT-5.6 Sol.

AI.tldr: 提出Analog Design Bench，一个由17位芯片设计师贡献的50个晶体管级设计任务的长时域智能体基准，用于评估编码智能体在模拟/混合信号电路设计中对电气规格的达成能力。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体已能维持数小时的工具驱动循环，但其在长时域模拟与混合信号电路中达成电气规格的能力尚未被度量。
AI.method: 构建包含50个晶体管级任务的长时域基准，智能体使用开源仿真器，由独立验证器基于规格进行电气测试；评估15种智能体配置共2250次两小时尝试，并测试时间、推理努力、智能体框架与设计知识等干预手段。
AI.result: 全规格通过率为8.0%–78.0%；编码基准表现与模拟结果相关但无法解释大部分性能差异；多数失败提交无合法性拒绝记录，却未通过电气验收；更长预算与更高推理努力提升表现，通用技能文档收益甚微甚至有害；提供任务匹配的参考拓扑使DeepSeek V4 Pro提升18.7个百分点，对GPT-5.6 Sol主要起加速作用。
AI.conclusion: 电气收敛是长时域电路设计智能体的核心瓶颈，任务匹配的电路IP检索式知识供给比通用技能文档更有效。

title: Multilinguality in Hybrid Attention LLMs
summary: In response to the growing demand for long sequences in agentic and reasoning use cases, many state-of-the-art LLMs combine multiple variants of attention to mitigate the quadratic complexity of traditional softmax attention. These hybrid attention LLMs aim to balance the strengths and limitations of full attention and alternatives based on recurrence. This work presents a first study of how hybrid attention impacts the multilinguality of LLMs. Beyond the impact on long sequences in poorly tokenized languages, our study is motivated by the possibility that the inductive biases of the recurrent state alter linguistic processing. Our interpretability analysis confirms this, showing that cross-lingual representations in hybrid models develop in patterns tied to the ordering of recurrent and full-attention layers. Across diverse models, we notably observe a pronounced spike in cross-lingual alignment around the first full-attention layer. These findings lead us to question the conventional ordering of attention layers. In distillation experiments on multilingual data, all alternative layer orderings outperform the standard throughout training, learning up to 2.5X faster. These stark, replicable results prompt our theory that multilingual models would benefit from starting with a full-attention layer rather than recurrent layers.

AI.tldr: 本文首次研究混合注意力(hybrid attention)对LLM多语言能力的影响，发现跨语言表示与循环层/全注意力层的排列顺序相关，并提出以全注意力层开头的层序更优。
AI.motivation: LLM为应对长序列需结合多种注意力变体来缓解softmax注意力的二次复杂度，但混合注意力对多语言性的影响尚不清楚；作者推测循环状态的归纳偏置会改变语言处理方式，尤其是对分词较差的低资源语言。
AI.method: 对多种混合注意力LLM进行可解释性分析，考察跨语言表示与注意力层排列的关系；并在多语言数据上开展蒸馏实验，比较不同层排列顺序的训练效果。
AI.result: 跨语言表示的形成模式与循环层和全注意力层的排列顺序相关，在第一个全注意力层附近出现跨语言对齐的显著峰值；在多语言蒸馏实验中，所有替代层顺序均优于标准顺序，学习速度最高快2.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 多语言模型或许应从全注意力层而非循环层开始构建，这一结论具有显著且可复现的效果，挑战了传统注意力层排列方式。

title: TT-VidT: Decoupling the Temporal Axis for Efficient Motion-Centric Video Pretraining
summary: Comparisons in video self-supervised learning often evaluate complete training recipes rather than isolating the method itself: architecture, objective, data exposure, schedule, scale, and decoder capacity can all vary at once. This makes it hard to identify which choices yield motion-prioritized representations, whose gains concentrate on frame-to-frame change while retaining useful appearance. We address this with a matched $4 \times 6 = 24$ architecture-objective study at roughly 170M ~ 190M encoder scale on $\sim$1.7M OpenVid and Moments-in-Time v2 clips for 8 epochs, and propose TT-VidT. TT-VidT combines a DINOv3-initialized ViT-B/16 per-frame spatial path with a compact Temporal Transfer Layer, trained by Diff Compression to reconstruct target frames from a first-frame appearance anchor and frame-specific motion tokens. The sweep shows that TT3D with Diff Compression, not either component alone, enters the strongest motion-sensitive regime, and decoder ablations favor a compact video-pretrained decoder. In final comparison, TT-VidT leads Jester, Something-Something V2, ARID, and Diving48 fine-tuning simultaneously, improving over the strongest non-TT row by 54% ~ 121%, while using 48% fewer encoder FLOPs than DisMo and 55% fewer than VideoMAE or V-JEPA2. HMDB51, IARD, and EPIC-Kitchens bound the claim.

AI.tldr: 本文通过匹配的24组架构-目标对比研究，提出TT-VidT，在多个运动敏感数据集上取得显著领先。
AI.motivation: 视频自监督学习中的比较常评估完整训练方案而非隔离方法本身，架构、目标、数据、调度、规模和解码器容量等变量同时变化，难以识别哪些选择能产生运动优先表征。
AI.method: 在约170M~190M编码器规模、约1.7M OpenVid与Moments-in-Time v2视频片段上、训练8个epoch，进行4×6=24的架构-目标匹配研究；提出TT-VidT，结合DINOv3初始化的ViT-B/16逐帧空间路径与紧凑的Temporal Transfer Layer，通过Diff Compression从首帧外观锚点和逐帧运动token重建目标帧。
AI.result: TT3D配合Diff Compression（而非单一组件）进入最强运动敏感区间；解码器消融支持紧凑的视频预训练解码器。最终TT-VidT在Jester、Something-Something V2、ARID和Diving48微调上同时领先，比最强非TT方案提升54%~121%，编码器FLOPs比DisMo少48%，比VideoMAE或V-JEPA2少55%。HMDB51、IARD和EPIC-Kitchens界定了该方法适用边界。
AI.conclusion: 通过受控的架构-目标匹配研究可清晰识别运动优先表征的关键设计，TT-VidT以更低计算成本在运动敏感任务上显著领先，但适用范围受部分数据集限制。

title: DISCERN: Can AI Agents Work Like Scientists and Guide Discovery?
summary: Reliable automated research requires agents to vet data, verify analyses, and generate hypotheses grounded in trustworthy evidence, potentially reducing routine scientific workload while allowing scientists to focus on interpretation and discovery. Existing benchmarks often only assess analytical task completion or hypothesis generation separately rather than testing whether reliable evidence supports valid and novel claims. We introduce DISCERN (Data Integrity and Scientific Capability: Evidence, Reasoning, and Novelty), a controlled benchmark on real, publicly available datasets that evaluates three key levels of an automated research workflow. The first two levels test data integrity and analysis verification under confounds and tool traps, while the third tests hypothesis generation and revision under adversarial review, including counterfactual cases in which evidence consistent with real data and documented scientific phenomena conflicts with established expectations, motivating alternative explanations and testable hypotheses. Across 203 tasks, eight life-science tracks, and eight models, DISCERN shows that strong aggregate performance can mask level-specific weaknesses. Agents earn perfect scores in only 60.8% of Level 1, 34.2% of Level 2, and 0.6% of Level 3 evaluations, with penalties attributed to rejection of sound data, failure to carry recognized limitations into conclusions, and wide variation in hypothesis production. Cross-track rankings by token and code use are substantially more stable than rankings by evidence judgment, suggesting greater consistency in computational effort than in evidence-based reasoning. These profiles identify opportunities for supervised scientific assistance, but current agents do not yet demonstrate reliable autonomous analysis or discovery. Code and data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/discern-bench-anon/discern-benchmark

AI.tldr: 论文提出DISCERN基准，用203个真实数据任务、8个生命科学赛道、8个模型评估自动化研究流程的三个层次：数据完整性、分析验证、假设生成，发现强总体表现会掩盖层次性弱点。
AI.motivation: 可靠自动化研究需要智能体能审查数据、验证分析并生成有可信证据支撑的假设，从而减轻科研日常负担。现有基准多只单独评估分析任务完成或假设生成，未检验可靠证据是否支持有效且新颖的主张。
AI.method: 构建DISCERN受控基准，基于真实公开数据集，评估自动化研究流程三个关键层次：前两层在混杂因素和工具陷阱下测试数据完整性与分析验证；第三层在对抗性审查下测试假设生成与修正，包括反事实案例——与真实数据和已记录科学现象一致但违背既有预期的证据。
AI.result: 在203个任务、8个生命科学赛道和8个模型上，DISCERN显示强总体表现会掩盖层次性弱点。智能体仅在Level 1的60.8%、Level 2的34.2%、Level 3的0.6%评估中获得满分；扣分源于拒绝可靠数据、未能将已知局限带入结论、假设产出差异大。按token和代码使用的跨赛道排名比按证据判断的排名更稳定。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果表明当前智能体尚未展示可靠的自主分析或发现能力，但识别出可监督科学辅助的机会。

title: TRACE: Single-Pass Decoding-Trace Risk Localization for Generation Calibration
summary: Reliable confidence estimation is essential for large language model deployment. However, answer-level calibration remains challenging because generation errors are often localized: a response may be fluent and high-probability overall while still failing at a critical number, entity, or factual claim. Existing estimators compress token probabilities, sequence likelihoods, entropy, or beam statistics into a global score, which can dilute such local risk signals. We propose TRACE, a single-pass, decoded-answer-preserving confidence estimator that treats decoding-time uncertainty as a trajectory through three steps: (i) recording token-level surprisal and predictive entropy during decoding, (ii) applying local risk operators to preserve uncertainty spikes, and (iii) converting localized trace risk into answer-level confidence. TRACE produces a label-free risk score, while TRACE+ calibrates trace-only features into probabilities using a held-out split, without extra generations or external verifiers. We evaluate four tasks against 19 calibration baselines, and TRACE+ reduces Brier from 0.149 to 0.137 and improves AUROC from 0.758 to 0.792 over the strongest likelihood baseline. Across seven LLMs, TRACE+ improves over the best non-TRACE baseline pool from 0.136 to 0.120 Brier and from 0.764 to 0.817 AUROC. Results show that localizing decoding-time risk provides a general approach to calibration.

AI.tldr: 提出TRACE/TRACE+，将解码时不确定性视为轨迹，通过局部风险算子保留不确定性尖峰，实现答案级置信度估计。
AI.motivation: 现有答案级校准方法将token概率、序列似然、熵等压缩为全局分数，会稀释生成错误中局部化的关键风险信号（如关键数字、实体、事实错误）。
AI.method: TRACE为单次通行、保持解码答案不变的估计器，分三步：(i)解码时记录token级surprisal与预测熵；(ii)应用局部风险算子保留不确定性尖峰；(iii)将局部化轨迹风险转为答案级置信度。TRACE输出无标签风险分数，TRACE+用留出集校准为概率，无需额外生成或外部验证器。
AI.result: 在4个任务、19个校准基线上，TRACE+将Brier从0.149降至0.137，AUROC从0.758升至0.792；跨7个LLM，相比最佳非TRACE基线池，Brier从0.136降至0.120，AUROC从0.764升至0.817。
AI.conclusion: 局部化解码时风险为置信度校准提供了通用有效的方法。

title: TC-ADA: One-Shot Active Domain Adaptation for Semantic Segmentation
summary: Manual dense annotation remains a major obstacle to deploying semantic segmentation models in new driving environments. Active domain adaptation (ADA) seeks label-efficient transfer by annotating only a selected portion of the target domain. Existing ADA methods commonly implement this process through multiple rounds of acquisition, annotation, and retraining. We study a practical one-shot image-level setting that selects and densely annotates a fixed target subset in a single round, followed by uninterrupted adaptation. Within this setting, we develop Target-Calibrated Active Domain Adaptation (TC-ADA) as a joint design of complete-image acquisition and target-calibrated adaptation. Stage~1 uses visual representations from a vision foundation model (VFM) together with semantic predictions from a fixed unsupervised domain adaptation model to select representative and informative target images without target annotations. Stage~2 jointly uses labeled source data, labeled target data, and the remaining unlabeled target data, while calibrating source and target supervision under limited target labels. Extensive experiments across five synthetic-to-real and real-to-real driving transfers show consistent improvements over representative ADA baselines. With only 23 to 46 labeled target images on four transfers and 140 on Mapillary, TC-ADA stays within 1.9 mean intersection over union (mIoU) points of target-only full supervision. Code will be available at https://github.com/ywher/TC-ADA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TC-ADA，一种一次性图像级主动域适应方法，通过联合设计全图采集与目标校准适应，仅标注少量目标图像即可高效迁移语义分割模型。
AI.motivation: 手动密集标注是语义分割模型部署到新驾驶环境的主要障碍。现有主动域适应(ADA)方法通常需要多轮采集、标注和重训练，流程繁琐。作者研究更实用的一次性图像级设置，即单轮选择并密集标注固定目标子集后进行不间断适应。
AI.method: TC-ADA包含两个阶段：阶段1利用视觉基础模型(VFM)的视觉表征和固定无监督域适应模型的语义预测，在无目标标注情况下选择有代表性且信息量高的目标图像；阶段2联合使用有标注源数据、有标注目标数据和剩余无标注目标数据，在目标标签有限的情况下校准源与目标监督。
AI.result: 在五个合成到真实及真实到真实的驾驶迁移任务上，TC-ADA持续优于代表性ADA基线。在四个迁移任务上仅用23至46张标注目标图像，在Mapillary上仅用140张，即可达到距离目标域全监督仅1.9 mIoU的水平。
AI.conclusion: TC-ADA通过一次性图像级主动域适应与目标校准适应设计，在极少目标标注下实现高效语义分割迁移，显著缩小与全监督的差距，代码将开源。

title: DrafTS: Time-Aware Decomposition with Residual Correction for Time Series Modeling
summary: Real-world time series contain evolving underlying dynamics with irregular variations that lack stable temporal patterns and are often referred to as noise. Existing methods address this mixture by filtering frequencies or suppressing noisy observations. They either miss temporal evolution or risk suppressing useful dynamics. We propose DrafTS, a model-agnostic framework that aims to reduce noise while preserving evolving dynamics through time-aware Decomposition with ResiduAl correction For Time Series. DrafTS uses features derived from instantaneous amplitude and frequency to guide decomposition into a primary component intended to capture underlying dynamics. A task-specific backbone models the primary component, while a lightweight correction module uses residual information to correct the backbone output. Across four time series modeling tasks, DrafTS improves six diverse backbones, demonstrating its effectiveness. Code is at https://github.com/Autumn61q/DrafTS

AI.tldr: DrafTS是一个模型无关框架，通过时间感知分解与残差校正来减少噪声并保留演化动态，在四类时序任务上提升了六种骨干模型的表现。
AI.motivation: 真实时序数据具有演化的内在动态和不规则变化（常被视为噪声），现有方法通过滤波频率或抑制噪声观测来处理，但要么忽略时间演化，要么可能抑制有用动态。
AI.method: DrafTS利用瞬时振幅和频率特征指导分解，得到用于捕捉内在动态的主成分；任务专用骨干模型对主成分建模，轻量校正模块利用残差信息修正骨干输出，实现时间感知分解与残差校正。
AI.result: 在四类时序建模任务上，DrafTS提升了六种不同骨干模型的效果，验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: DrafTS作为一种模型无关框架，能在减少噪声的同时保留演化动态，具有广泛适用性和有效性。

title: AwarenessBench: Assessing Cognitive Capabilities of Language Models
summary: As language models (LMs) exhibit increasingly consciousness-like behaviors, evaluating their cognitive abilities becomes essential. We introduce AwarenessBench, the first comprehensive benchmark for assessing the cognitive abilities of LMs in four dimensions: metacognition, self-awareness, social awareness, and situational awareness, covering 15 cognitive functions and 14,381 samples. Evaluating 18 state-of-the-art LMs, we find that all consistently surpass random baselines, with more advanced models performing better. We further compare LMs with human performance across three demographic groups, where the best-performing model surpasses human averages overall, but most still fall markedly short in metacognition and self-awareness. Finally, we show that awareness is a distinct capability: progress in language modeling or reasoning does not necessarily translate into improved cognition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AwarenessBench，首个全面评估语言模型认知能力的基准，覆盖元认知、自我意识、社会意识和情境意识四个维度，包含15种认知功能和14,381个样本，评测18个先进模型并与人类对比。
AI.motivation: 随着语言模型表现出越来越多类似意识的行为，评估其认知能力变得至关重要，但此前缺乏针对认知能力的系统性评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 AwarenessBench 基准，涵盖元认知、自我意识、社会意识和情境意识四个维度，包含15种认知功能与14,381个样本；对18个最先进语言模型进行评测，并与三组不同人群的人类表现进行比较。
AI.result: 所有模型均稳定超越随机基线，且越先进的模型表现越好；最佳模型在总体上超过人类平均水平，但多数模型在元认知和自我意识方面仍明显落后于人类。
AI.conclusion: 意识/觉知是语言模型的一项独立能力：语言建模或推理能力的进步并不必然带来认知能力的提升。

title: Concept Score Relearning: A Unified Cross-Architecture Attack on Concept Erasure
summary: Concept erasure aims to suppress undesirable knowledge in text-to-image generative models. However, existing robustness evaluations typically rely on relearning attacks tailored to specific model architectures. We study concept reactivation across two substantially different generative paradigms: noise-prediction U-Nets and flow-matching Transformers. We introduce \textbf{Concept Score Relearning (CSR)}, a unified parameter-level framework that reactivates erased concepts by optimizing each model within its native prediction space. CSR requires no external target-concept image dataset and applies the same concept-directed objective to both U-Net-based Stable Diffusion and Transformer-based FLUX. Experiments across diverse concepts and multiple erasure methods demonstrate consistent concept reactivation across both architectures, highlighting the cross-architecture applicability of CSR and the persistent recoverability of apparently erased concepts. For strict nudity, CSR reaches average ASRs of 50.47\% on FLUX and 40.29\% on Stable Diffusion, consistently ranking first across all evaluated safety settings.

AI.tldr: 提出统一参数级框架CSR，可在不同生成范式（U-Net与Transformer）中重新激活被擦除概念，揭示擦除的持续可恢复性。
AI.motivation: 现有概念擦除鲁棒性评估依赖针对特定模型架构的重学习攻击，无法跨架构比较，缺乏统一评估方法。
AI.method: Concept Score Relearning (CSR)：在模型原生预测空间内优化，为噪声预测U-Net与流匹配Transformer分别设计概念导向目标，无需外部目标概念图像数据集，统一应用于Stable Diffusion（U-Net）与FLUX（Transformer）。
AI.result: 在多种概念与多种擦除方法上，两种架构均实现一致的概念重激活；严格裸体概念下，CSR在FLUX上平均ASR达50.47%，Stable Diffusion上达40.29%，在所有安全设置中均排名第一。
AI.conclusion: CSR证明跨架构概念重激活的可行性与被擦除概念的持续可恢复性，提示现有概念擦除方法的安全鲁棒性不足。

title: Cross-modal Translation via Conditional Latent Denoising for Video Deepfake Detection
summary: The growing threat of video deepfakes necessitates multimodal detection. Beyond serving as independent indicators of authenticity, audio and visual signals have intrinsic dependencies that also provide an essential criterion for detection. Previous methods often overlook the cross-modal correspondences, hindering information transfer between domains and leaving crucial detection cues unexplored. To address this challenge, we propose a framework called Cross-modal Translation via Conditional Latent Denoising (CTCLD) for video deepfake detection. It connects the distinct distributions of heterogeneous modalities in latent spaces, enabling smooth cross-domain information transfer to improve detection performance. We first establish a Bayesian foundation by decomposing the audio-visual joint distribution. Subsequently, CTCLD translates both modalities via bidirectional latent denoising conditioned on each other, effectively capturing subtle inconsistencies in the manipulated signals. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed CTCLD enables comprehensive domain alignment, resulting in a robust video deepfake detection approach with competitive performance.

AI.tldr: 提出CTCLD框架，通过条件潜空间去噪实现跨模态翻译，捕捉音视频不一致以检测视频深度伪造。
AI.motivation: 视频深度伪造威胁上升，音视频信号间存在内在依赖关系可作为检测线索，但已有方法常忽略跨模态对应关系，阻碍域间信息传递并遗漏关键检测线索。
AI.method: 建立贝叶斯基础，分解音视频联合分布；CTCLD连接异质模态在潜空间的不同分布，以彼此为条件进行双向潜去噪翻译，实现平滑跨域信息传递并捕捉被操纵信号的细微不一致。
AI.result: 实验表明CTCLD实现了全面的域对齐，形成稳健的视频深度伪造检测方法，性能具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨模态翻译与条件潜去噪对齐音视频分布，可有效利用跨模态依赖提升视频深度伪造检测性能。

title: AraDynFact: Dynamic Evaluation of Factual Knowledge in Arabic
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) continue to scale both in size and capabilities, their proficiency in the Arabic Language has seen significant advancement. However, a critical gap remains: the extent of their factual knowledge and cultural sensitivity to the diverse Arabic-speaking world remains largely underexplored. Current evaluation metrics often focus on translation or generic reasoning, failing to capture the rich historical, social, and regional nuances inherent to Arabic culture. In addition, most benchmarks rely on heavy work, with human intervention in some steps, making the evaluation of knowledge coverage expensive and slow. To address this deficiency, we introduce AraDynFact, a novel dynamic evaluation framework designed to rigorously assess the factual Arabic knowledge embedded in LLMs. Unlike static benchmarks, AraDynFact employs a dynamic approach to extract factual information and generate rich and answerable questions in a fast and automatic way. We apply AraDynFact to Arabic Wikipedia and audit the performance of several state-of-the-art models, ranging from Arabic-centric specialized LLMs to high-resource general purpose LLMs. In addition we found a high degree of correlation with existing, hand-crafted Arabic-centric benchmarks, confirming the potential of our dynamic approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AraDynFact，一个动态评估框架，用于快速、自动地评估LLM的阿拉伯语事实知识与文化敏感性，应用于阿拉伯语维基百科。
AI.motivation: LLM规模扩大，阿拉伯语能力提升，但其对多样阿拉伯世界的事实知识和文化敏感性未充分探索；现有指标多聚焦翻译或通用推理，忽略历史、社会、区域文化细微差异；且基准依赖人工干预，评估昂贵缓慢。
AI.method: AraDynFact采用动态方法自动提取事实信息并生成丰富且可回答的问题，无需繁重人工，实现快速自动化评估；应用于阿拉伯语维基百科，对多种SOTA模型（阿拉伯语专用LLM与高资源通用LLM）进行审计。
AI.result: 审计了从阿拉伯语中心化专用LLM到高资源通用LLM的多个模型性能，并发现该动态方法与现有手工制作的阿拉伯语基准具有高度相关性。
AI.conclusion: AraDynFact可快速自动评估LLM的阿拉伯语事实知识，克服静态基准和人工依赖的局限，其与手工基准高相关，验证了动态方法的潜力。

title: A Visual Classification Dataset and Model Evaluation for Historical Manuscript Illustrations
summary: Historical manuscript illustrations preserve rich visual evidence of past cultures. They depict people, animals, plants, diagrams, music notations, and decorative forms. Although large digitization projects have made many manuscripts available online, the material itself remains difficult to explore at scale. Extraction systems can find illustrations on manuscript pages, but without meaningful categories, large collections remain hard to search and explore. We address this gap by introducing a manually labeled dataset of 15,000 illustrations from manuscripts dating back hundreds of years across 22 categories, and evaluating modern vision models for image classification on this task. The problem is challenging due to stylistic diversity, degradation, and semantic ambiguity, with many images that fit more than one category. We compare fine-tuned CNN and Transformer-based classifiers, zero-shot CLIP, embedding-based classifiers, and direct vision-language models. Results show that fine-tuned image classifiers perform best overall, with ConvNeXt reaching 88.9% accuracy and 81.3% macro-F1. Using CLIP embeddings with XGBoost provides a strong alternative. In contrast, zero-shot CLIP and direct vision-language classification perform substantially worse, highlighting the limits of general-purpose models in this domain. Beyond overall performance, the analysis reveals which categories are visually separable and where errors reflect genuine semantic overlap, suggesting that some limitations arise from the taxonomy itself.

AI.tldr: 构建1.5万幅古籍插图、22类人工标注数据集，评测多种视觉模型；微调图像分类器最佳（ConvNeXt 88.9%准确率、81.3% macro-F1），通用模型表现有限。
AI.motivation: 古籍插图虽已大量数字化，但缺乏有意义类别，难以大规模检索与探索，现有抽取系统只能定位插图而无法分类。
AI.method: 构建跨数百年、22类、15000幅插图的人工标注数据集；对比微调CNN与Transformer、零样本CLIP、基于CLIP嵌入的XGBoost分类器及直接视觉语言模型。
AI.result: 微调图像分类器整体最优，ConvNeXt达88.9%准确率、81.3% macro-F1；CLIP嵌入+XGBoost为强替代；零样本CLIP与直接视觉语言分类明显更差。
AI.conclusion: 风格多样、退化与语义歧义使任务困难；分析揭示类别可分性及语义重叠所致错误，部分局限源于分类体系本身，反映通用模型在该领域的边界。

title: CoViST: Visual Token Compression via Composable States
summary: Visual token compression lowers the inference cost of vision--language models by representing images with fewer tokens. However, most existing methods compress visual tokens to a reduced set, leaving the amount of visual evidence represented by each token and its original spatial context implicit. Therefore, the compressed representation does not explicitly encode how much visual information each representative carries or where it lies in the original image. This limitation arises even after a single reduction and becomes more pronounced when compression is repeated across decoder layers. To address this issue, we propose CoViST, a training-free framework that represents a compressed image as a composable visual state. Specifically, the state combines representative features with original positions, effective contribution weights, and reusable selection metadata. CoViST constructs this state through coverage-guided selection and conservation-based contribution composition, and explicitly incorporates its contribution and positional information into decoder attention. Each component of the state retains its interpretation under successive reductions, enabling the same formulation to support both fixed compression before prefill and progressive compression within the decoder. Experimental results on seven LLaVA-1.5-7B benchmarks show that CoViST-Fixed retains 99.9\%, 99.5\%, and 98.1\% of uncompressed performance at 192, 128, and 64 tokens, respectively, and CoViST-Pro retains 99.8\%, 99.9\%, and 99.1\% at the corresponding layer-average budgets, outperforming state-of-the-art methods under their respective budget settings. Code will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的CoViST框架，将压缩图像表示为可组合视觉状态，在保持高性能的同时大幅降低视觉token数量。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉token压缩方法将token压缩到更小的集合，但每个token所代表的视觉证据量及原始空间上下文是隐式的，压缩表示未明确编码每个代表token承载多少视觉信息、位于何处，重复压缩时问题更严重。
AI.method: CoViST将压缩图像表示为可组合视觉状态，结合代表特征、原始位置、有效贡献权重和可复用选择元数据。通过覆盖引导选择和基于守恒的贡献组合构建状态，并将贡献与位置信息显式融入解码器注意力。各组件在连续压缩下保持可解释性，支持预填充前的固定压缩和解码器内的渐进压缩。
AI.result: 在七个LLaVA-1.5-7B基准上，CoViST-Fixed在192、128、64 token时分别保留99.9%、99.5%、98.1%的无压缩性能；CoViST-Pro在对应层平均预算下保留99.8%、99.9%、99.1%，优于SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: CoViST通过显式编码视觉状态的位置与贡献信息，有效解决了视觉token压缩中的信息隐式问题，在两种压缩设置下均取得优异性能。

title: Spontaneous Context Restoration: How Language Models Recover from Corrupted Inputs
summary: Language models sometimes produce correct outputs even when their inputs are corrupted by deletion, replacement, or misspelling. We study the internal processes accompanying this behavior, which we call context restoration, in controlled attention-only transformers and five pretrained LLMs (1B-32B parameters) across arithmetic, reading comprehension, and multiple-choice reasoning tasks. In the attention-only transformers, restoration emerges spontaneously despite training exclusively on clean sequences, without corruption training or an explicit denoising objective. We find that context restoration follows a two-phase process: early layers localize effects associated with repair at corrupted positions, while later layers accumulate these effects at uncorrupted positions through the residual stream and ultimately concentrate them at the output position. Repair outcome is predictable from hidden states: cosine alignment with the clean state is highly predictive in attention-only models, while linear probes recover additional information in pretrained LLMs. A linear probe using only the corrupted prompt's first-block hidden state predicts failure with mean ROC-AUC 0.78. This enables failure triage under matched or even partially shifted deployment conditions and may reduce unnecessary verification or computation. Failed examples also show substantially greater nonlinearity along corruption directions. Moderate-corruption finetuning increases corruption tolerance while simultaneously reducing displacement-normalized linearization error, associating improved robustness with a more nearly linear response to corruption.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"上下文修复"现象：语言模型对损坏输入仍能产生正确输出。作者发现修复呈两阶段过程（早期层定位、后期层汇聚至输出），且修复结果可从隐藏状态预测，并可据此进行失败分诊。
AI.motivation: 语言模型常在被删除、替换或拼错的损坏输入下仍输出正确结果，但其内部机制未知。作者希望理解这一"上下文修复"行为的内部过程，并利用它预测模型是否失败。
AI.method: 在可控的纯注意力transformer及五个预训练大模型（1B-32B）上，跨算术、阅读理解、选择题推理任务进行研究。通过逐层分析、余弦对齐、线性探针（仅用首个block隐藏状态）及沿损坏方向的非线性分析来考察修复过程。
AI.result: 修复在仅训练干净序列时自发涌现，无需损坏训练或去噪目标；遵循两阶段过程：早期层在损坏位置定位修复效应，后期层经残差流在未损坏位置累积并汇聚到输出位置。修复结果可预测：余弦对齐在纯注意力模型中高度预测，线性探针在预训练模型中恢复额外信息，仅用首block隐藏状态的探针预测失败达平均ROC-AUC 0.78。失败样本沿损坏方向非线性显著更强。中等损坏微调可提升容忍度并降低线性化误差。
AI.conclusion: 上下文修复是模型自发涌现的两阶段机制，其结果可从隐藏状态预测，支持失败分诊以减少不必要的验证/计算；鲁棒性提升与对损坏的更接近线性响应相关联。

title: Native Association: Confidence-Aware Human Perception in the Wild with a Foundation VLM
comment: Accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Human-Centered Multimodal Intelligence in the Wild (HCMIW). 16 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables; supplementary material included as ancillary file
summary: Extracting who is where, on which team, wearing which number from a broadcast frame is typically done by stitching a detector, an OCR engine, and classifiers together -- and the stitching step swaps identities under occlusion. We make association native instead: a 0.77B vision-language model (Florence-2) is fine-tuned to emit all per-person attributes as one grammar-constrained sequence, with each attribute generated inside its owner's block. Output is therefore schema-valid on every frame by construction, and no post-hoc binding step exists to attach a correctly read number to the wrong player: residual misassociation is pure perception error, $\approx4\times$ rarer than zero-shot-prompted frontier APIs' (0.057 vs. 0.21-0.24). On a frozen multi-sport test set, this single pass reaches 0.95 detection F1 (APIs: 0.65-0.75). A single extra forward pass yields a per-field confidence that supports a reject option (jersey precision $0.71\rightarrow0.96$ at half coverage) and routes a training-free zoom-and-re-read for small players. Surprisingly, once the grammar is learned, further parameter-efficient tuning yields no measurable gain under the adaptation configurations we test; the identical recipe on WIDER-Attribute reaches 93.1 mAP given-box, yields the first detection-coupled end-to-end results under its standard test protocol (84.5 mAP), and reproduces the same tuning result. In this regime, the gains live in the structure, not in added weights.

AI.tldr: 将人物身份、队伍、号码等属性通过语法约束的单一序列生成方式整合进0.77B视觉语言模型(Florence-2)，实现原生关联，无需后处理绑定，显著优于零样本提示的API。
AI.motivation: 广播帧中提取"谁在哪里、哪队、几号"通常靠检测器+OCR+分类器拼接，而拼接步骤在遮挡下会交换身份。作者希望将关联内化为模型原生能力。
AI.method: 微调0.77B的Florence-2，使其在语法约束下输出一个人物块内包含所有属性字段的单序列，输出结构天然合规，无后处理绑定步骤；额外一次前向得到逐字段置信度以支持拒识选项与放大重读。
AI.result: 残差误关联仅为纯感知误差，约为零样本提示前沿API的1/4(0.057 vs 0.21-0.24)；检测F1达0.95(API为0.65-0.75)；拒识可在半覆盖下将球衣精度从0.71升至0.96；WIDER-Attribute达93.1 mAP，标准协议下84.5 mAP。学习语法后进一步参数高效调优无测量增益。
AI.conclusion: 此设定下收益来自结构而非增加的权重，语法内化的关联范式是有效且高效的。

title: COEVO: Co-Evolving Context and Parameters for Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) seeks to move large language models beyond static training pipelines toward systems that can participate in improving their own future behavior. Existing approaches largely follow two directions: updating model parameters through online learning, or improving the external context through search, reflection, and prompt optimization. Although both mechanisms can support continued improvement, they are typically studied independently. This separation overlooks an important interaction: the context shapes the experience from which a model learns, while an evolving model may interpret and utilize the same context differently over time. We therefore formulate RSI as a problem of parameter--context co-evolution, where model parameters and the learning context adapt within a shared feedback loop. We introduce COEVO, a framework that updates model parameters from on-policy experience while adapting contextual guidance according to the state of the evolving policy. Policy entropy and prompt-conditioned attention are used as complementary signals to guide this adaptation. Experiments show that COEVO consistently improves task performance over fixed-context reinforcement learning and produces policies that are more robust to changes in system prompts. More broadly, our results suggest that external context should be viewed not merely as a fixed interface to a large language model, but as an adaptive component of recursive self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文将"递归自我改进"重新表述为参数与上下文的协同演化问题，提出COEVO框架，在共享反馈回路中同时更新模型参数和上下文引导。
AI.motivation: 现有RSI方法分为两类：通过在线学习更新模型参数，或通过搜索、反思、提示优化改进外部上下文。两者通常被独立研究，忽视了关键交互——上下文塑造模型学习的经验，而演化的模型随时间会以不同方式解读同一上下文。
AI.method: 提出COEVO框架：从on-policy经验更新模型参数，同时依据演化策略的状态自适应调整上下文引导；使用策略熵和提示条件注意力作为互补信号来指导这种自适应。
AI.result: 相比固定上下文的强化学习，COEVO持续提升任务性能，并产生对系统提示变化更鲁棒的策略。
AI.conclusion: 外部上下文不应仅被视为大语言模型的固定接口，而应作为递归自我改进的自适应组件。

title: Who Is Left of Whom? Tracing Spatial Evidence and Role Binding in Relative-Position Reasoning
summary: High instance-level accuracy can mask inconsistencies in spatial reasoning when objects exchange positions or their roles are reversed in the query. The internal representations supporting relative-position reasoning remain poorly understood. We investigate two complementary components of this process: tracking object locations in the input and representing their query roles. Across three VLMs with visual or textual inputs and their language-model backbones, activation patching reveals a staged progression from early-layer source representations through intermediate-layer query-object representations to late-layer answer states. Targeted interventions further establish causal links along this progression: manipulating source-side representations shifts location information at query-object mentions and ultimately alters relation predictions. Beyond object-location information, we also identify a stable query-side direction associated with the roles of the two objects in the comparison. Steering along directions estimated on synthetic scenes generalizes to natural-image benchmarks, improving accuracy and both forms of paired consistency in most settings without retraining. Our findings reveal complementary components of relational reasoning across visual and textual settings and show how targeted interventions can improve the consistency of models' behavior.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究视觉语言模型相对位置推理的内部机制，发现从源对象表征到查询对象表征再到答案的分阶段因果过程，并通过干预提升一致性与准确率。
AI.motivation: 高实例级准确率可能掩盖空间推理中的不一致性（如对象交换位置或角色反转时）。支持相对位置推理的内部表征尚不清楚，因此需要研究追踪对象位置与表征查询角色这两个互补环节。
AI.method: 研究三个VLM（视觉或文本输入）及其语言模型骨干；使用激活修补（activation patching）分析表征分层进程；进行定向干预验证因果联系；识别与查询中两对象角色相关的稳定"查询侧方向"，并在合成场景上估计方向后迁移到自然图像基准。
AI.result: 激活修补显示从早期源表征经中间查询对象表征到晚期答案状态的分阶段进程；操纵源侧表征会改变查询对象提及处的位置信息并最终改变关系预测；沿估计方向引导可在多数设定下提升准确率及两种配对一致性，且无需重训练，并能泛化到自然图像基准。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了视觉与文本设定下关系推理的互补组件，并表明定向干预可改善模型行为的一致性。

title: SphMind: Towards Robust, Training-Free VLM-based Spatial Reasoning with a 360 Camera
summary: Omnidirectional or 360 cameras provide embodied AI agents with a holistic, wide field-of-view (FoV) view of their surroundings, motivating the use of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for omnidirectional spatial reasoning. However, most MLLMs are trained on conventional 2D perspective images and struggle with the severe distortions and wrap-around discontinuities induced by spherical geometry. Enabling them to generalize to non-Euclidean 3D spaces without retraining therefore remains challenging. We propose SphMind, a training-free, plug-and-play framework that decouples semantic perception from geometric reasoning. Rather than requiring MLLMs to learn spherical geometry internally, SphMind preserves their semantic capabilities while handling geometry externally. We introduce a Spherical Harmonics-based Spatial Graph (SHSG) that models spatial relationships through equivariant transformations on the sphere, together with Inference-Time Geometric Grounding (IGG), a model-agnostic closed-loop optimization process that aligns MLLM representations with spherical geometric constraints during inference. Experiments on three benchmarks show that SphMind achieves over 21.4% average improvement in directional reasoning on MP3D and Stanford2D-3D, outperforms prompt-engineering baselines by 8.7% on the real-world ODI-Bench, and improves rotational invariance by 5.9% under panorama rotations, without additional training or dataset-specific tuning. In-the-wild evaluations further show that SphMind resolves directional reasoning queries that baseline vision-language models fail to answer correctly.

AI.tldr: 提出SphMind，一种免训练、即插即用的框架，将语义感知与几何推理解耦，让MLLM无需重训练即可泛化到全向360度空间。
AI.motivation: 全向/360度相机为具身AI提供广视场周围视图，但MLLM多训练于常规2D透视图像，难以应对球面几何带来的畸变和环绕不连续性，非欧几何泛化困难。
AI.method: SphMind不要求MLLM内部学习球面几何，而是将几何处理外部化：引入基于球谐的空间图(SHSG)通过球面等变变换建模空间关系，并结合推理时几何接地(IGG)——一种模型无关的闭环优化，在推理阶段对齐MLLM表示与球面几何约束。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，MP3D和Stanford2D-3D方向推理平均提升超21.4%，ODI-Bench上超越提示工程基线8.7%，全景旋转下旋转不变性提升5.9%，无需额外训练或数据集微调；实地评估可解决基线VLM失败的方向查询。
AI.conclusion: SphMind通过解耦语义与几何、外部化球面几何推理，有效提升MLLM在全向空间中的方向推理和旋转不变性，具备即插即用、免训练的优势。

title: Beyond Token Scale: Chunk-Level Sparse Autoencoders for Reliable Semantic Feature Discovery
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) expose features that help us understand and steer language models, but faithful reconstruction does not guarantee informative concepts. Token-level objectives reward lexical and formatting details alongside semantic content, all competing for a limited sparse budget. We introduce a family of chunk-level SAEs that encode mean-pooled activations over chunks, each a contiguous span of tokens: Mean-Chunk reconstructs the observed chunk, Cross-Chunk predicts an independently processed neighbor, and Joint-Chunk combines both targets. These designs separate the effect of a larger observation unit from that of predicting information shared across passages. With matched training data, chunk-level SAEs remain powerful interpretability tools while learning reliable semantic features that capture high-level concepts and respond selectively to relevant content. Their strengths are complementary: Mean-Chunk improves high-level feature discovery, reasoning detection beyond surface cues, and steering; Cross-Chunk leads document retrieval and classification transfer while producing selective, persistent features. Changing what an SAE sees and predicts yields reliable semantic features for more meaningful tasks. We demonstrate their practical value through gains across downstream tasks such as retrieval, reasoning detection, and steering.

AI.tldr: 论文提出chunk-level SAE（Mean-Chunk、Cross-Chunk、Joint-Chunk），通过改变SAE观测和预测的单元来学习可靠的语义特征。
AI.motivation: token级SAE的忠实重建不代表概念有信息量：token目标会奖励词汇和格式细节，与语义内容争夺有限的稀疏预算。
AI.method: 提出一族chunk-level SAE，对连续token块的均值池化激活进行编码：Mean-Chunk重建观测到的chunk；Cross-Chunk预测独立处理的邻居chunk；Joint-Chunk结合两者。以此分离更大观测单元与预测跨段落共享信息的作用，并使用匹配的训练数据。
AI.result: 在匹配训练数据下，chunk-level SAE仍是有力的可解释性工具，学到捕捉高层概念的可靠语义特征。Mean-Chunk提升高层特征发现、超越表面线索的推理检测与steering；Cross-Chunk在文档检索和分类迁移上领先，并产生选择性、持久特征。在检索、推理检测、steering等下游任务上取得增益。
AI.conclusion: 改变SAE"看到"和"预测"的内容能产生可靠语义特征，服务更有意义的任务，且不同设计优势互补。

title: Printability-Constrained Adversarial Decals for Near-Nadir Aerial Perception: Measured Ink Gamuts, Nested Realism Constraints, and a Physical-World Bound
summary: Adversarial patches for aerial perception are typically evaluated as digital composites, with printing left as an implementation detail. This study imposes three physical constraints during optimization rather than after it: the color range a particular printer can reproduce, the size of the flat panel a vehicle offers, and the loss of fine detail incurred when the patch is imaged from altitude. The principal comparison isolates the ink set. Two patches share all seventeen recorded optimization settings and differ only in the colors available to them. One is constrained to a uniform color cube; the other to a gamut measured by printing and scanning a 216-patch chart. Each was optimized at three seeds and evaluated against thirteen victim conditions, with every rate reported against a size-matched optimized control. The effect of the measured gamut is victim-dependent rather than uniform. Net attack success rises on three of six closed-set segmentation victims, and for these the seed ranges of the two ink sets are disjoint: $+0.120$ on DeepLabv3-R101 and $+0.041$ on SegFormer-B0. The color-cube patch is consistently stronger on the open-vocabulary segmenter and on two of four detectors, though no detector exceeds a net of $+0.026$ under either ink set. The natural explanation is that a printable palette is simply less chromatic and lower in frequency than a digital one. Eleven further patches test this account and it does not hold. Once cardinality is matched, a palette as chromatic as the cube attacks equally well. Cardinality itself shows no trend from three inks to thirty-two. Palettes matched on cardinality, lightness and chroma, and differing only in hue placement, span $0.035$ to $0.136$. A physical evaluation with printed decals did not detect transfer; it bounds the transferred rate at $0.133$, which does not exclude the simulated value of $0.121$.

AI.tldr: 本研究在对抗补丁优化阶段直接引入打印机色域、载体面板尺寸和高空成像细节损失三项物理约束，核心对比墨色集合（统一色彩立方 vs 实测色域）。结果显示物理色域的影响因受害模型而异，攻击成功率提升依赖受害者而非普遍生效，且色度、频率等"自然解释"在验证中被否定。
AI.motivation: 现有航空感知对抗补丁多以数字合成方式评估，打印环节仅作实现细节，缺乏对物理可实现性的考量。作者希望将物理约束前置于优化过程，并检验物理墨色集合是否真正影响攻击效果。
AI.method: 在优化中施加三项物理约束：打印机可复现色彩范围、车辆可提供的面板尺寸、高空成像的细节损失。设置两个仅墨色集合不同、其余17项优化参数一致的补丁：一个限制于统一色彩立方，另一个基于打印扫描216色卡实测的色域。每个补丁在3个随机种子下优化，对13种受害模型条件评估，速率均以尺寸匹配的优化对照组为基准。另用11个补丁验证可能解释。
AI.result: 实测色域的影响因受害者而异：在6个闭集分割受害者中3个净攻击成功率上升，且两墨色集合的种子区间不重叠（DeepLabv3-R101 +0.120，SegFormer-B0 +0.041）。色彩立方补丁在开放词汇分割器和4个检测器中的2个上更强，但检测器净增益均不超+0.026。11个补丁测试否定了"可打印调色板色度低、频率低"的解释：基数匹配后色度可同样强，基数从3到32无趋势，仅色调位置不同（基数、亮度、色度匹配）的调色板攻击率跨度0.035–0.136。物理打印实测未检测到迁移，迁移率上界0.133，无法排除模拟值0.121。
AI.conclusion: 物理墨色集合对对抗补丁效果的影响是模型依赖的，不存在统一的色度或频率解释；物理评估未能确认迁移，但也未排除模拟结果，说明模拟与实物之间仍存在不确定性。

title: Temporal Graph Learning of Wearable Actigraphy and Sleep Traces for Modelling Adolescent Crystallized Intelligence
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE Transactions on Computational Social Systems for possible publication
summary: Wearable actigraphy offers a scalable, ecologically valid alternative to episodic clinical assessment. However, predicting continuous adolescent crystallized intelligence ($G_c$) from such traces remains challenging due to irregular device adherence and complex behavioral-environmental interactions. We address this using daily summary data derived from 21-day Fitbit records of 6,091 adolescents in the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study (Release 5.1). We propose SATURN, a Sleep-Activity Temporal Unified Regression Network. It represents participants as 21-node temporal graphs encoding daily behaviors and temporal adjacency. To prevent imputation artifacts, invalid-day edges are dynamically pruned during forward passes. Node embeddings are refined via residual GATv2 layers, aggregated through masked attention pooling, and fused with sociodemographic covariates. Under family-controlled, age-sex-BMI-stratified cross-validation, SATURN achieves $R^2 = 0.2783 \pm 0.0127$, consistently improving upon flattened machine learning (Gradient Boosting, $R^2 = 0.2372$) and sequential deep learning (BiLSTM, $R^2 = 0.2688$) baselines. Explainability analyses identify light activity, metabolic equivalents, and sleep duration as dominant predictors, while Monte Carlo dropout and subgroup analyses confirm equitable performance across sociodemographic strata. Ultimately, SATURN establishes a rigorous computational framework for digital cognitive phenotyping, offering a scalable pathway to complement traditional assessments by highlighting macro-level behavioral anomalies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SATURN，一个睡眠-活动时间统一回归网络，利用6091名青少年21天Fitbit记录预测晶体智力，R²达0.2783，优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴设备为临床评估提供可扩展的替代方案，但从设备数据预测青少年晶体智力面临不规律佩戴和环境行为交互等挑战。
AI.method: 将参与者表示为21节点时序图编码日常行为与时间邻接，前向传播中动态剪枝无效天数边以避免插补伪影，用残差GATv2层细化节点嵌入，经掩码注意力池化聚合并融合社会人口协变量。
AI.result: 家庭控制、年龄性别BMI分层的交叉验证下R²=0.2783±0.0127，优于梯度提升(0.2372)和BiLSTM(0.2688)；可解释性显示轻度活动、代谢当量和睡眠时长为主导预测因子。
AI.conclusion: SATURN建立了数字认知表型的严谨计算框架，提供可扩展途径补充传统评估，并揭示宏观行为异常。

title: Less Sycophancy, Stronger Refusal? Lessons for AI Safety from Mechanistic Interpretability
summary: Reliable refusal of harmful requests is essential to the safe deployment of language models. Because excessive eagerness to please users may undermine existing refusal capabilities, reducing sycophancy offers a potential route to stronger refusal beyond the harmful scenarios covered by safety training. We investigate this possibility using compensatory feature injection (CFI), a training technique designed to limit the acquisition of a target concept by supplying its associated activation during learning. Across three Qwen3.5 base models, we use sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to identify the top-ranked sycophancy feature from paired sycophantic and independent responses, then validate its behavioral influence through inference steering. We subsequently inject the selected feature during supervised fine-tuning on sycophantic targets. Positive injection reduces learned sycophancy after removal (by 62.0% relative to ordinary fine-tuning in 35B-A3B), whereas modest negative injection increases it. Unexpectedly, these reductions in sycophancy do not consistently improve direct refusal of harmful requests, motivating a narrower evaluation of the same harmful intents under user pressure. In this setting, ordinary fine-tuning on sycophantic responses substantially weakens refusal, while selected checkpoints trained with positive injection recover part of the loss, including approximately 95% in 35B-A3B. These findings show that persistent sycophancy reduction does not guarantee stronger direct refusal, while identifying recovery under user pressure as a distinct, conditional benefit of training intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文用补偿性特征注入(CFI)在Qwen3.5模型上抑制谄媚特征，发现可持久降低谄媚，但不必然提升直接拒答；在用户施压下对有害请求的拒答能力得到部分恢复。
AI.motivation: 语言模型需可靠拒绝有害请求，但过度迎合用户可能削弱拒答能力。作者假设减少谄媚可成为超越安全训练覆盖范围、增强拒答的途径。
