Together, these results identify residual-stream burden as a mechanism through which prediction targets and architecture jointly shape representation learning in Diffusion Transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"残差流负担"概念，解释扩散Transformer中为何干净预测优于噪声/速度预测，并通过SiHC架构验证。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型中干净、噪声、速度三种预测目标本可互相转换，但实践中大像素块上的Diffusion Transformer用干净预测成功，用噪声或速度预测却失败，这一不对称现象缺乏解释。
AI.method: 提出"残差流负担"(residual-stream burden)理论：噪声目标要求残差流沿深度保留依赖噪声的输入变化以供最终读出，迫使后续层在噪声表示上计算；干净目标频谱集中，负担较轻。通过控制实验验证可用的结构是像素块空间的频谱集中，持久残差状态的带宽是噪声预测的关键资源。并设计空间索引超连接(SiHC)直接扩展残差流带宽。
AI.result: 控制实验支持该理论；该解释与近期解耦像素空间架构一致（其设计均降低主通路的残差流负担）；SiHC在ImageNet 256²上达到FID 1.71。
AI.conclusion: 残差流负担是预测目标与架构共同塑造扩散Transformer表示学习的机制。

title: SWE-Game: Can Coding Agents Build the Games We Want?
summary: We introduce SWE-Game, a benchmark of 247 tasks grounded in 41 executable reference Godot games spanning 13 gameplay categories in 2D and 3D. Five task types cover development from a brief, implementation from a game design document, skeleton completion, repair of 83 injected-fault cases, and Godot-to-Unity porting. Reference materials specify the intended gameplay, while a shared instrumentation interface lets evaluator-owned drivers and probes execute actions and observe independently implemented games. Evaluation combines engine-state checks, certified reference-input replay, and agent-authored feature demonstrations to assess mechanic correctness, demonstrated playability, and behavioral restoration and preservation after repairs. Game-specific vision-language rubrics separately assess presentation. Across six models, Opus5 achieves the highest overall score in all five task types. Best overall scores remain below 60 out of 100 across the three construction tasks, with Brief-to-Game reaching 50.38. Analysis of reviewed submissions identifies requirement omissions and gameplay logic errors as predominant implementation problems. On human-labeled behaviors from 100 agent-built games, executable checks achieve 92.59% balanced accuracy, compared with 78.41% for a video-based VLM judge. Rubric-based visual scores reach a Spearman correlation of 0.829 with human ratings of 200 gameplay clips. Together, these results characterize current agent capabilities across game-development activities and support combining runtime evidence with visual assessment.

AI.tldr: SWE-Game是一个包含247个任务、基于41款可执行Godot游戏的基准，覆盖5类游戏开发任务，用于评估AI智能体的游戏开发能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基准缺乏对游戏开发全流程（从设计到实现、修复、移植）的系统评估，且需要更可靠的评估手段来验证游戏机制正确性与可玩性。
AI.method: 构建247个任务，涵盖简要描述转游戏、设计文档实现、骨架补全、83个注入故障修复、Godot到Unity移植；采用共享instrumentation接口让评估驱动与探针独立执行与观察，结合引擎状态检查、认证参考输入回放、智能体特征演示及游戏专属视觉语言评分标准。
AI.result: 六个模型中Opus5在全部五类任务上总分最高；三类构建任务最佳分数均低于60，Brief-to-Game为50.38。可执行检查在100款智能体游戏上达到92.59%平衡准确率，优于视频VLM评判的78.41%；视觉评分与人类评分的Spearman相关达0.829。
AI.conclusion: 当前智能体在游戏开发任务上仍有明显局限（需求遗漏与游戏逻辑错误为主），将运行时证据与视觉评估相结合是有效方向。

title: Preserving DEG Rankings for Gene Discovery in Histology-Based Spatial Gene Expression Prediction
summary: Predicting spatial gene expression from histology images could scale spatial transcriptomics (ST) to image-only cohorts, but conventional histology-based ST prediction is trained and evaluated mainly by per-gene spatial-profile reconstruction. This objective is misaligned with a key downstream use of ST: differentially expressed gene (DEG) discovery, where genes are ranked for a biological or morphology-defined contrast by evidence of between-group expression differences. We formulate image-based differential expression ranking (IDER), which asks whether predicted expression profiles preserve the contrast-specific ranked gene list obtained from measured profiles. IDER compares gene rankings induced by differential-expression statistics, rather than raw expression magnitudes or per-gene spatial correlations. We further introduce a differentiable IDER objective that aligns these statistics across genes and can be trained with morphology-derived proxy contrasts without predefined biological group labels. Experiments on public ST datasets show improved DEG-ranking agreement and pathway-enrichment overlap over conventional reconstruction objectives, including morphology-derived and pathologist-annotated tissue-region evaluations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出基于图像差异表达排序（IDER）任务与可微目标，替代传统的逐基因重建目标，使图像预测的空间表达更契合下游差异表达基因发现。
AI.motivation: 传统基于组织学图像预测空间转录组（ST）的训练与评估主要以逐基因空间分布重建为目标，但这与ST的关键下游用途——差异表达基因（DEG）发现——并不一致。DEG发现关注的是按组间表达差异对基因进行排序，而非表达幅值或单基因空间相关性。
AI.method: 论文形式化图像差异表达排序（IDER）任务：检验预测表达谱是否保留由实测表达谱得到的、针对特定对比的基因排序。IDER比较由差异表达统计量诱导的基因排序。进一步提出可微IDER目标，在基因间对齐这些统计量，并可用形态学导出的代理对比进行训练，无需预定义生物学分组标签。
AI.result: 在公共ST数据集上，相比传统重建目标，该方法在DEG排序一致性及通路富集重叠度上均有提升，评估涵盖形态学导出和病理学家标注的组织区域。
AI.conclusion: 以差异表达排序为目标能更好对齐图像预测ST与下游DEG发现需求，可支持将空间转录组扩展到仅有图像的队列。

title: TopoMamba: A Load-Support Relation-Guided Multi-Directional State-Space Model for Topology Optimization
summary: Deep learning has emerged as an efficient alternative for predicting high-performance material distributions in topology optimization. Existing methods struggle to accurately capture load-transfer information, limiting out-of-distribution generalization, while their model architectures often incur high computational costs. To address these challenges, this paper proposes TopoMamba, a topology prediction framework incorporating a load-support relation-guided multi-directional state-space model. Coupling physical fields with load-support relations enables more effective modeling of mechanical dependencies. A load-support relation-guided spatially adaptive fusion mechanism dynamically adjusts multi-directional scan features according to spatial conditions. Mamba is coupled with the solid isotropic material with penalty method to enhance structural mechanical performance while maintaining computational efficiency. Results on two-dimensional topology optimization benchmarks demonstrate that TopoMamba achieves superior topology prediction accuracy, out-of-distribution generalization, and computational efficiency over state-of-the-art models. The proposed load-support physics-guided framework enables efficient optimization of more complex structural systems.

AI.tldr: 提出TopoMamba框架，结合载荷-支撑关系引导的多向状态空间模型，实现高效且泛化性强的拓扑优化预测。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习拓扑优化方法难以准确捕捉载荷传递信息，导致分布外泛化能力差，且模型架构计算成本高。
AI.method: 将物理场与载荷-支撑关系耦合建模力学依赖；设计载荷-支撑关系引导的空间自适应融合机制动态调整多向扫描特征；将Mamba与SIMP方法结合以兼顾力学性能与计算效率。
AI.result: 在二维拓扑优化基准上，TopoMamba在预测精度、分布外泛化和计算效率上均优于现有最优模型。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的载荷-支撑物理引导框架可高效优化更复杂的结构系统。

title: Video, Ergo Genero: Unifying Video Tasks via Spatiotemporal Analogy
summary: Adapting video models to new tasks typically requires dedicated data curation and fine-tuning. While visual analogy provides a training-free alternative by specifying tasks in-context, it remains restricted to the image domain. To explore whether analogy-based methods can unify diverse video tasks and generalize to out-of-distribution scenarios, we introduce ViGeo, a framework that extends visual in-context learning to the video domain via spatiotemporal canvas completion. Evaluated on a diverse task taxonomy with a strict train-test split, ViGeo generalizes to unseen video manipulations and zero-shot modalities (e.g., event cameras). Finally, we identify task internalization, where a query format associated with a pretrained task overrides the demonstration, and show that this shortcut can be removed with a small amount of task-unrelated data, highlighting the need to decorrelate prompt format from task identity.

AI.tldr: ViGeo将视觉上下文学习扩展到视频领域，通过时空画布补全实现免训练的视频任务统一与泛化。
AI.motivation: 视频模型适配新任务通常需要专门的数据整理与微调；视觉类比虽提供免训练方案，但仅限于图像领域。本文探索类比方法能否统一多样视频任务并泛化到分布外场景。
AI.method: 提出ViGeo框架，通过时空画布补全将视觉上下文学习扩展到视频领域，实现基于类比的视频任务规约。
AI.result: 在多样化任务分类法上以严格训练-测试划分评估，ViGeo能泛化到未见过的视频操作及零样本模态（如事件相机）。
AI.conclusion: 识别出"任务内化"现象：与预训练任务相关的查询格式会覆盖演示，该捷径可通过少量任务无关数据消除，说明需将提示格式与任务身份解耦。

title: One Latent, Many Tokens: Jointly Learning Compressed Embeddings for Efficient Language Diffusion
comment: 25 pages, 7 figures, and 8 tables. Includes appendices
summary: Most continuous diffusion language models process one latent position per token at each sampling step, making generation expensive. Two-stage methods lower the cost by reducing the latent length, but they fix the compressed embedding space before training the diffusion model. Embeddings from the fixed space can be difficult to model with diffusion and decode reliably into tokens, which limits generation quality after compression. To address this problem, we introduce JPEG-DLM (Joint-embedding Prediction for Efficient Generation with Diffusion Language Model), which jointly trains a compressor, a flow matching model and a decoding module. With joint-embedding prediction, JPEG-DLM learns compressed embeddings that are more structured, easier to model with diffusion and reliably decodable into tokens. JPEG-DLM achieves the lowest mean Gen-PPL and highest throughput among recent diffusion and flow models on LM1B and OWT. At a compression rate of 0.5 on OWT, it reaches a Gen-PPL of 34.52 and approximately 2.3 times ELF's throughput. These results suggest that jointly learning compressed embeddings offers a promising path toward efficient diffusion language modeling. Code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 提出JPEG-DLM，联合训练压缩器、流匹配模型和解码模块，学习更易建模且可可靠解码的压缩嵌入，实现高效扩散语言建模。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散语言模型每步每token处理一个隐位置，生成开销大；两阶段方法虽降本，但压缩嵌入空间在训练扩散模型前被固定，难以建模和可靠解码，限制压缩后生成质量。
AI.method: JPEG-DLM联合训练压缩器、流匹配模型与解码模块，通过联合嵌入预测学习结构化、易扩散建模且可可靠解码为token的压缩嵌入。
AI.result: 在LM1B与OWT上取得最低平均Gen-PPL和最高吞吐量；OWT压缩率0.5时Gen-PPL为34.52，吞吐量约为ELF的2.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 联合学习压缩嵌入为高效扩散语言建模提供了有前景的路径，代码即将发布。

title: Test-Time Generalized Category Discovery
summary: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) and Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) are traditionally treated as disjoint problems: the former adapts models to domain shift assuming all test classes are known, while the latter discovers novel categories assuming labeled training data for known classes. However, real-world deployment rarely fits either setting. Motivated by this gap, we introduce Test-Time Generalized Category Discovery (TT-GCD), a unified and more realistic scenario where a vision-language model must adapt to distribution shifts, classify known categories using only textual supervision, and discover novel categories, all during test time and without access to labeled data. To address this challenging scenario, we propose PACT (Prototype Assignment for Category discovery at Test time), a fully unsupervised framework that casts known-class recognition and novel-class discovery via prototype assignment. PACT first re-aligns shifted visual features with the text-derived class representations of the VLM using confident zero-shot predictions. Known and novel categories are then both represented by prototypes in the visual embedding space, estimated from the unlabeled test stream, and each test image is assigned to the category whose prototype is most similar to its visual feature. Extensive experiments across corruption and domain-shift benchmarks demonstrate that PACT outperforms adapted state-of-the-art TTA and GCD methods, effectively bridging the gap between adaptation and discovery.

AI.tldr: 论文提出TT-GCD统一场景：视觉语言模型在测试时需适应分布偏移、仅用文本监督分类已知类并发现新类。方法PACT通过原型分配实现无监督的已知类识别与新类发现。
AI.motivation: TTA假设所有测试类已知，GCD假设已知类有标注训练数据，两者在真实部署中都过于理想，存在研究空白，需统一且更现实的场景。
AI.method: PACT：先用高置信零样本预测将偏移的视觉特征与VLM文本导出的类表示重新对齐；再在视觉嵌入空间用无标注测试流估计已知类和新类的原型，将每个测试图像分配给最相似原型对应的类别。
AI.result: 在多种损坏和域偏移基准上，PACT优于经过适配的SOTA TTA与GCD方法。
AI.conclusion: PACT有效弥合了测试时适应与类别发现之间的鸿沟，为更现实的部署场景提供了统一的无监督框架。

title: Gaussian Splatting-based Volumetric Video Compression with Sparse 4D Anchors
summary: Immersive video communication requires photorealistic, render-efficient, and compact dynamic scene representations. 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) offers a promising representation, but dynamic 3DGS remains difficult to compress due to dense primitives and spatiotemporal redundancy. Anchor-based formulations improve compactness with sparse scaffolds that share geometry and appearance across primitives. However, existing designs often rely on deforming a single canonical scaffold and condition each primitive on its associated anchor in isolation, limiting their ability to handle non-local dynamics and disocclusion while under-exploiting inter-anchor correlations, particularly in motion- or texture-dense regions. To address these limitations, we propose SAGA, a volumetric video codec built upon Sparse Anchor-assisted GAussian splatting representations. SAGA represents dynamic 3D scenes using hierarchically organized sparse 4D anchors, where coordinate-based INR decoders generate fine anchors and Gaussian primitives from inter-anchor interpolations, enabling compact parameter sharing across spatiotemporal structures. For long-range dependencies among unstructured anchors, we further introduce fixed-size memory slots with orthogonality-informed updates for accurate entropy-context modeling. Experiments show that SAGA achieves strong rate-distortion performance against GIFStream, with PSNR BD-rate reductions of 80.39% and 83.94% on Neu3D and MPEG MIV, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出SAGA，一种基于稀疏锚点辅助高斯泼溅的体视频编解码器，通过分层4D锚点与INR解码实现紧凑的动态场景表示与高效压缩，率失真性能显著优于GIFStream。
AI.motivation: 沉浸式视频通信需要逼真、渲染高效且紧凑的动态场景表示。动态3DGS因密集基元与时空冗余难以压缩；现有锚点方法依赖单一规范骨架形变、孤立条件化每个基元，难以处理非局部动态与去遮挡，且未充分利用锚点间相关性。
AI.method: SAGA使用分层组织的稀疏4D锚点表示动态3D场景，由基于坐标的INR解码器从锚点间插值生成细锚点和高斯基元，实现跨时空结构的紧凑参数共享；并引入固定大小记忆槽与正交性感知更新，用于非结构化锚点间的长程依赖熵上下文建模。
AI.result: 实验显示SAGA相对GIFStream取得强率失真性能，在Neu3D和MPEG MIV上PSNR BD-rate分别降低80.39%和83.94%。
AI.conclusion: SAGA通过分层稀疏4D锚点、INR插值解码与记忆槽上下文建模，有效提升动态3DGS压缩的紧凑性与率失真表现。

title: Does Adversarial Training Improve Generalization in Multi-View VLAs? Revealing and Mitigating View Collapse
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models adapt pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) for closed-loop robot control, transferring their perceptual and semantic capabilities to action prediction. Despite strong in-distribution performance, however, VLAs often degrade under deployment shifts. Adversarial training (AT) offers a model-adaptive approach to robustness without explicitly anticipating individual shifts, but its effect on natural distribution-shift generalization in multi-view VLAs remains unclear. We study this question using a multi-view VLA directly adapted from a pretrained VLM and evaluate generalization across seven LIBERO-Plus shift axes. Direct AT substantially improves Camera Viewpoint and Sensor Noise, the two shifts affecting only the third-person view, yet produces mixed or negative effects on other shifts. Controlled view interventions reveal a surprising failure mode that we term view collapse: Direct AT can shift cross-view reliance so strongly that the policy becomes dominated by the wrist view. This exposes a \textit{robustness shortcut}: apparent robustness to a shifted view can arise from reduced use of that view rather than more robust perception of it. This motivates a distinction between robust perception, extracting reliable information under within-view shifts, and robust fusion, adapting reliance across views according to their reliability. To reduce fixed view reliance, we use a simple View Swap intervention and then re-evaluate AT. With View Swap, AT further improves Camera Viewpoint, Sensor Noise, and Robot Initial State, while its effects remain mixed on other shifts. Our results show that multi-view robustness requires separating improved perception from changes in cross-view reliance, and that AT provides selective rather than generic distribution-shift benefits.

AI.tldr: 研究多视角VLA在分布偏移下的泛化，发现直接对抗训练仅对特定偏移有效，并揭示"视角崩塌"这一鲁棒性捷径，区分鲁棒感知与鲁棒融合。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在分布内表现强，但部署偏移下性能下降。对抗训练(AT)是无需预见具体偏移的模型自适应鲁棒方法，但其对多视角VLA自然分布偏移泛化的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 使用直接由预训练VLM适配的多视角VLA，在LIBERO-Plus的七个偏移轴评估泛化；采用直接AT与受控视角干预，并引入View Swap干预以减少固定视角依赖后重新评估AT。
AI.result: 直接AT显著提升Camera Viewpoint和Sensor Noise（仅影响第三人称视角的两种偏移），但对其他偏移效果混合或负面。受控干预揭示"视角崩塌"：AT过强改变跨视角依赖，使策略被腕部视角主导。View Swap后，AT进一步改善Camera Viewpoint、Sensor Noise和Robot Initial State，其他偏移仍混合。
AI.conclusion: 多视角鲁棒性需区分鲁棒感知（视角内偏移下提取可靠信息）与鲁棒融合（按可靠性调整跨视角依赖）；AT提供的是选择性而非通用的分布偏移收益，所谓对偏移视角的鲁棒可能源于减少使用该视角而非更鲁棒的感知。

title: A Multi-Dataset Benchmark of YOLO-Based Weed Detection in Precision Agriculture
summary: Weed detection is an important component of precision agriculture, enabling site-specific weed management and reducing unnecessary herbicide use. Although deep learning methods have achieved strong results for crop and weed detection, many studies rely on single-dataset evaluation, making it difficult to assess robustness across different agricultural domains. This paper presents a multi-dataset benchmark of deep object detectors for weed detection in precision agriculture, with a focused evaluation of YOLO26 models. We evaluate nano, small, and medium variants on seven public weed-detection datasets covering different crops, weed species, field conditions, acquisition setups, and annotation protocols. The models are compared in terms of detection accuracy, model complexity, inference latency, FPS, and model size. In addition to in-dataset evaluation, we investigate cross-domain generalization using a unified one-class weed setup and evaluate multi-source training using the combined training subsets from all datasets. The results show that YOLO26 achieves strong in-dataset performance, with YOLO26m obtaining the highest average accuracy and YOLO26s providing the best practical accuracy-efficiency trade-off. However, cross-domain performance decreases substantially, with YOLO26s dropping from an average in-domain mAP$_{50:95}$ of 0.603 to 0.148 in the off-domain setting. Multi-source training improves performance on several datasets, but does not fully eliminate domain shift. Overall, the benchmark highlights the importance of dataset diversity, domain similarity, and target-domain adaptation for robust weed detection in real-world precision agriculture applications.

AI.tldr: 本文对YOLO26系列目标检测器在7个公开杂草检测数据集上进行多数据集基准评测，考察精度、复杂度、延迟等指标及跨域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习杂草检测研究多依赖单数据集评估，难以衡量模型在不同农业场景下的鲁棒性，缺乏统一的多数据集基准。
AI.method: 在7个覆盖不同作物、杂草种类、田间条件、采集设备和标注协议的公开数据集上，评测YOLO26的nano、small、medium变体；除数据集内评估外，还采用统一单类杂草设置研究跨域泛化，并用全部数据集训练子集进行多源训练评估。对比指标包括检测精度、模型复杂度、推理延迟、FPS和模型大小。
AI.result: YOLO26在数据集内表现优异，YOLO26m平均精度最高，YOLO26s在精度-效率权衡上最佳；但跨域性能大幅下降，YOLO26s的平均域内mAP50:95从0.603降至域外0.148。多源训练在多个数据集上提升性能，但未完全消除域偏移。
AI.conclusion: 基准结果凸显了数据集多样性、域相似性和目标域自适应对真实精准农业中鲁棒杂草检测的重要性。

title: BIRD: Distilling Decision Boundaries into Rationales for MLLM Adaptation
summary: Adapting general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to specialized domains requires learning domain-specific decision criteria, which often hinge on subtle visual distinctions between otherwise plausible answers. Rationale augmentation aims to expose such evidence through additional observations or inter-sample comparisons, yet a visually valid cue is not necessarily decision-relevant: it may describe how samples differ without changing the model's relative preference between competing answers. We therefore introduce BIRD, a self-improving Boundary-Informed Rationale Distillation framework that uses model-specific confusions to locate unresolved local decision boundaries and distills the evidence that resolves these confusions into rationales. For each sample, BIRD retrieves candidate neighbors from the target MLLM's own representation space and selects the most confusable one according to its answer preferences. It then generates answer-blind candidate evidence from their visual differences and functionally verifies which evidence most effectively strengthens the model's preference for the correct answer while avoiding inappropriate transfer across the pair. The verified evidence is then distilled into a single-sample rationale for standard supervised fine-tuning. Experiments on medical and chart VQA show that BIRD outperforms competing rationale-augmentation methods across two target MLLMs, while further analyses demonstrate clearer separation of confusable answers and stronger gains from model-matched supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出BIRD框架，利用模型自身混淆定位决策边界并蒸馏有效理由，提升MLLM在专业领域的表现。
AI.motivation: 将通用多模态大模型适配到专业领域需学习领域决策标准，但视觉上合理的线索未必与决策相关，现有理由增强方法难以保证证据真正改变模型的答案偏好。
AI.method: BIRD通过目标MLLM自身表示空间检索最易混淆的邻居样本，生成与答案无关的候选证据，并功能性验证哪些证据最有效增强正确答案偏好且避免不当迁移，最终将验证证据蒸馏为单样本理由用于监督微调。
AI.result: 在医学和图表VQA任务、两个目标MLLM上均优于竞争的理由增强方法，且更能清晰分离混淆答案，模型匹配监督带来更强增益。
AI.conclusion: 基于模型特定混淆的边界感知理由蒸馏能有效提升专业领域MLLM的决策能力。

title: UnfoldCRF: Structured Mask Refinement with Image-Conditioned Latent Regions
summary: Learned mask refiners improve segmentation accuracy, but it is hard to tell how much of the improvement comes from explicit structure rather than from extra capacity, and whether it holds up when the mask generator or its error distribution changes. UnfoldCRF treats refinement as inference in a conditional random field over pixel labels and latent region variables. Its energy has a corrected unary term, learned local pairwise interactions, and image-conditioned latent-region consistency, with a null state that lets a region with weak label agreement withdraw from the consistency term; inference unrolls damped mean-field updates on this one energy. To isolate the effect of structure, we compare against recurrent black-box refiners that read the same inputs and receive the same parameter budget, stage count, and supervision. On COD10K, UnfoldCRF beats the strongest matched control by 1.0 $F^ω_β$ point, improves all four COD metrics, and lowers the fraction of images made worse from 11.7\% to 8.5\%. Under a train-once protocol over five datasets and several mask sources, the 2.6M-parameter variant gains 4.2 mean $Δ$IoU against 2.0 for its control, and a variant built on frozen DINOv2 features matches the strongest foundation-model refiner with about a seventh of its resident parameters while staying ahead of its own control. On mask generators never seen in training, the gain is 2.0 $F^ω_β$ points against 0.6 for the control. Zeroing individual messages shows where the corrections come from: the pairwise messages mostly fix boundaries, the region messages mostly fix non-boundary errors. Code and supporting materials will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 提出 UnfoldCRF，将掩码精修建模为像素标签与隐区域变量的 CRF 推理，通过匹配参数预算的对照实验证明其增益源自显式结构而非额外容量。
AI.motivation: 学习式掩码精修虽提升分割精度，但难以区分增益来自显式结构还是额外容量，且不确定在掩码生成器或误差分布变化时是否仍有效。
AI.method: 将精修视为 CRF 推理：能量含校正的一元项、学习到的局部成对交互、图像条件化的隐区域一致性项，并引入可让弱标签一致区域退出的 null state；推理通过展开阻尼平均场更新实现。与读取相同输入、同参数预算/阶段数/监督的循环黑箱精修器对照。
AI.result: COD10K 上超最强匹配对照 1.0 F^ω_β，四项 COD 指标均提升，变差图像比例从 11.7% 降至 8.5%；五数据集 train-once 协议下 2.6M 变体平均 ΔIoU 增益 4.2（对照 2.0）；基于冻结 DINOv2 的变体以约 1/7 参数量匹敌最强基础模型精修器；未见掩码生成器上增益 2.0（对照 0.6）；消融显示成对消息主要修边界，区域消息主要修非边界错误。
AI.conclusion: 显式 CRF 结构本身带来可泛化、跨生成器的精修增益，且不同消息通道各司其职。

title: Self-Designed Evaluators and Warm Memory for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: A tool-using language-model agent deployed over a long stream of tasks receives no reward, so it cannot tell whether it succeeded, cannot safely retry, and cannot label the experience it needs to improve. We present SelfSuite, in which the agent's own base model, given only the world's public materials, designs a small evaluation suite of weighted judges and grounded per-task briefs, freezes it, and uses it to gate a keep-best retry and to label a typed, outcome-tracked memory. On matched five-repeat benchmarks over tau2-bench and AppWorld, SelfSuite scores above the plain agent without any labels, matches methods given ten expert labels on tau2-bench, and trails Agentic Context Engineering (ACE) on AppWorld, where code execution gives a direct success signal. In an ablation campaign run on the same tasks, it is above label-free ACE in every repeat, and the gated second attempt is the only component whose removal hurts in every repeat. We also simulate a subject-matter expert who grades ten onboarding tasks per world. Using those labels to calibrate SelfSuite's evaluator gives a small, consistent gain, and using them to warm up ACE's memory lifts ACE to tie calibrated SelfSuite. A single-run study on a second model family shows the same ordering.

AI.tldr: SelfSuite让工具使用型语言模型智能体仅凭公开材料自建小型评审套件（加权评判器+任务简报），冻结后用于门控"保留最优重试"并标注带类型的记忆，从而在无奖励信号下实现自我评估与改进。
AI.motivation: 长任务流中的智能体收不到奖励，无法判断成功与否、无法安全重试、也无法标注经验用于改进。
AI.method: 用智能体自身基座模型，仅基于世界公开材料设计加权评判器与接地任务简报组成的评估套件；冻结该套件，用于门控keep-best重试，并标注类型化、追踪结果的记忆。
AI.result: 在tau2-bench与AppWorld五次重复基准上，SelfSuite优于无标签的普通智能体，在tau2-bench上媲美用十个人工标签的方法，在AppWorld上落后于ACE（因代码执行提供直接成功信号）。消融中每次重复都优于无标签ACE，且门控二次尝试是唯一每次移除都受损的组件。用专家十个标签校准评估器有小幅稳定提升；用标签预热ACE记忆可使ACE追平校准后的SelfSuite，第二模型家族单次实验顺序一致。
AI.conclusion: 无需奖励或标签，智能体可自建冻结评估套件来自我评估、安全重试并标注记忆，效果可媲美或接近有标签方法。

title: MetaSampling: Making Frame Samplers Efficient for Long-Video Question Answering
summary: Frame selection is an important component of long-video question answering (VQA) with Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Existing frame-selection methods improve over simple top-$k$ embedding retrieval and uniform sampling, but are typically applied under a fixed global selection budget. We introduce \textbf{MetaSampling}, a training-free, plug-and-play sampling strategy that can be applied on top of existing frame selectors. MetaSampling improves downstream VQA efficiency by dynamically reducing the number of frames passed to the MLLM while preserving, and in some cases improving, answer accuracy. We evaluate MetaSampling across 36 paired frame-selector--MLLM-backbone--VQA-benchmark configurations. MetaSampling reduces the number of selected frames in all 36 configurations and improves accuracy in 25 of them, yielding an average frame reduction of $8.9\%$ while slightly improving accuracy overall.

AI.tldr: 提出MetaSampling，一种免训练、即插即用的采样策略，可叠加在现有帧选择器上，动态减少传给MLLM的帧数，同时保持甚至提升长视频问答准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有帧选择方法（如top-k嵌入检索、均匀采样）通常在固定的全局选择预算下运行，缺乏动态调整帧数的能力，导致效率与准确率难以兼顾。
AI.method: MetaSampling作为免训练、即插即用的采样策略，叠加在已有帧选择器之上，动态缩减传入MLLM的帧数量。
AI.result: 在36种"帧选择器—MLLM骨干—VQA基准"配对配置中评测：所有36种配置均减少所选帧数，25种配置准确率提升，平均帧数减少8.9%，整体准确率略有提升。
AI.conclusion: MetaSampling能在不训练、易集成的前提下，提升长视频问答的下游效率并保持或改善准确率。

title: Robust Biomolecular Complex Design Across Protein Conformational Landscapes
summary: Proteins populate conformational ensembles, yet structure-based biomolecular design typically optimizes candidates against a single target conformation. Consequently, a candidate that fits one state can lose favorable interactions or develop steric clashes when the target adopts another. We introduce FlexEvo, a model-agnostic evolutionary framework that adapts candidates once at inference time from a single target conformation to improve compatibility with alternative natural conformations unseen during adaptation, without retraining the source model or requiring a conformational ensemble. FlexEvo casts cross-state adaptation as geometry-constrained bi-objective optimization, balancing preservation of input-state interactions against robustness to plausible conformational perturbations. To limit the search space and reduce invalid structural edits, geometry-derived FlexBoxes define protected anchor regions, adaptable regions for local exploration, and forbidden regions for clash avoidance. A unified all-atom representation supports topology-preserving adaptation across diverse binder categories, while Pareto selection preserves nondominated candidates across the two objectives. We evaluate FlexEvo across multiple generation baselines and nine representative binder categories spanning diverse molecular sizes and structural topologies. FlexEvo reduces the category-balanced mean relative performance degradation from 47.8% to 4.4%, while adding only 1.4--3.1 minutes of adaptation per sample. These results establish single-state inference-time adaptation as a practical route toward robust biomolecular complex design across protein conformational landscapes.

AI.tldr: FlexEvo是一个模型无关的进化框架，在推理阶段将候选分子从单一目标构象适配到未见过的替代自然构象，提升跨构象鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质存在多种构象，但传统基于结构的生物分子设计往往针对单一目标构象优化候选分子。当目标分子切换到另一种构象时，原本契合的候选可能丢失有利相互作用或产生空间位阻。
AI.method: 将跨状态适配建模为几何约束的双目标优化，在保持输入态相互作用与对合理构象扰动的鲁棒性之间权衡。利用几何推导的FlexBoxes划分保护锚定区、可适配局部探索区和禁忌避碰区以限制搜索空间、减少无效编辑。采用统一的全原子表示支持多种结合体类别的拓扑保持适配，并用Pareto选择保留两目标上的非支配候选。
AI.result: 在多个生成基线和九类代表性结合体（涵盖不同分子大小与结构拓扑）上评估。类别均衡的平均相对性能退化从47.8%降至4.4%，每个样本仅增加1.4–3.1分钟适配时间。
AI.conclusion: 单状态推理时适配是面向蛋白质构象景观实现鲁棒生物分子复合物设计的实用途径。

title: Position Aware Layer Queries for Test Time Training in Vision Language Models
summary: Test-Time Training (TTT) adapts models to incoming test samples (e.g. out-of-distribution, (OOD)) when conventional fine-tuning is infeasible. Existing TTT methods for Vision-Language Models (VLMs) create supervision from several augmented views, each requiring forward (and often backward) passes through the entire VLM, incurring substantial computational cost. We observe that one forward pass with all the intermediate layer outputs already yields far more signal than the final embedding from all augmentations. We introduce Layer Query Network (LQN), a lightweight approach that can adapt a frozen VLM (teacher) in a single forward pass of the VLM via a small model (student). LQN uses Position-Aware Distillation (PAD) to mimic the teacher VLM's intermediate-layer spatial tokens by querying spatial coordinates of intermediate tokens. LQN additionally relies on Location Consistency Regularization (LCR), a self-supervision technique, replacing expensive O(H x W) image augmentation with O(1) coordinate sampling. Integrating these, LQN i) adapts and improves zero-shot CLIP ViT-B/16 by 9.8% Top-1 on OOD ImageNet, ii) outperforms the previous best GS-Bias on fine-grained classification by 3.9% Top-1, iii) achieves faster convergence than TPS for CLIP ResNet-50 (47 mins vs 55 mins), iv) generalizes adaptation to VLMs like SigLIP, EVA-CLIP, and CoCa, and lightweight students like MLP, ResNet, VGG, and v) extends to panoptic, instance, and semantic segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出 LQN，用轻量学生模型通过单次前向传播适配冻结的 VLM（教师），大幅降低测试时训练成本。
AI.motivation: 现有针对 VLMs 的测试时训练（TTT）方法需对多个增强视图各做前向（甚至反向）传播，计算开销巨大。作者观察到，单次前向传播的所有中间层输出所提供的信号，已远多于所有增强视图的最终嵌入。
AI.method: LQN 由小模型（学生）在冻结 VLM（教师）的单次前向中完成适配：采用位置感知蒸馏（PAD），通过查询中间 token 的空间坐标来模仿教师 VLM 的中间层空间 token；并借助位置一致性正则化（LCR）自监督，用 O(1) 坐标采样替代 O(H×W) 图像增强。
AI.result: i) 将零样本 CLIP ViT-B/16 在 OOD ImageNet 上 Top-1 提升 9.8%；ii) 细粒度分类上比此前最佳的 GS-Bias 高 3.9% Top-1；iii) 在 CLIP ResNet-50 上收敛快于 TPS（47 分钟 vs 55 分钟）；iv) 可泛化到 SigLIP、EVA-CLIP、CoCa 等 VLM，以及 MLP、ResNet、VGG 等轻量学生；v) 扩展到全景、实例和语义分割。
AI.conclusion: LQN 是一种高效、通用的 VLM 测试时适配方法，在降低计算成本的同时提升多种任务与模型上的性能。

title: HTN Planning as a Coordination Layer for Multi-Server MCP Tool Orchestration
comment: 5 pages. Camera-ready version of a paper accepted at the ICAPS 2026 Workshop on Hierarchical Planning (HPlan 2026), Dublin. Non-archival. Code: https://github.com/PCfVW/hplan26-artifact
summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) isolates servers by design: only the host can orchestrate cross-server workflows. When the host is a large language model, the resulting orchestrations are non-deterministic, non-reproducible, and pay one inference round-trip per tool call. We present a coordination architecture in which a Hierarchical Task Network (HTN) planner generates a verifiable cross-server plan once, and a runtime middleware executes it deterministically across multiple MCP servers, binding cross-action data dependencies via a template mechanism (\verb|${context.X}|) substituted at execution time. The architecture mirrors MCP's isolation constraint: each compound task decomposes into server-local primitive actions, and inter-server data flow is bound at execution time via JSON-path output extractors. We instantiate the architecture on five HTN domains spanning laboratory robotics, bioinformatics and multiscale modelling, and demonstrate end-to-end execution from a browser-based plan controller against eight live third-party MCP servers querying real biological databases.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种协调架构，利用HTN规划器生成可验证的跨服务器计划，并由运行时中间件在多个MCP服务器上确定性地执行。
AI.motivation: MCP在设计上隔离服务器，只有主机能协调跨服务器工作流。当主机为大语言模型时，其协调具有非确定性、不可复现性，且每次工具调用都需一次推理往返。
AI.method: 采用分层任务网络（HTN）规划器一次性生成可验证的跨服务器计划，运行时中间件确定性执行；通过模板机制（${context.X}）在执行时绑定跨动作数据依赖，每个复合任务分解为服务器本地原语动作，服务器间数据流通过JSON路径输出提取器绑定。
AI.result: 在涵盖实验室机器人、生物信息学和多尺度建模的五个HTN域上实例化该架构，并演示了从基于浏览器的计划控制器对八个实时第三方MCP服务器查询真实生物数据库的端到端执行。
AI.conclusion: 该架构在保持MCP隔离约束的同时，实现了确定、可复现的跨服务器工作流协调与执行。

title: Re:Cognize -- Open-Set Comic Character Re-Identification
summary: A manga reader meets a character on one page and knows them on sight a hundred pages later, without ever being handed a cast list. Re-identifying comic characters demands the same, open-set and sequential: pages arrive as a stream in reading order, new faces appear before anyone names them, and the cast is assembled as the story is read. $\textbf{Re:Cognize}$ evaluates recognition as the story is read, not against a cast handed over in advance: four protocols on one query stream, from closed-set retrieval to a cast the model must build and grow itself. The surprise is where models fail. Recognising is close to solved: one reference image per character already ranks as well as a gallery built in advance. Knowing what to believe is not: a model that adds its own matches makes its cast worse, while the same growth with correct labels would gain over twenty points of top-1 accuracy. The bottleneck is acceptance, not vision, and one comparison decides it: an addition pays exactly when it is right more often than the cast already was on the queries it takes over. The comparison has nothing to fit, and measured on half of a new corpus it calls the other half correctly. $\textbf{ReCast}$ puts it to work with nothing fitted on data: a cast sheet of one running average per character, grown only where the page itself vouches for a crop. It recovers a third to two thirds of what perfect labels would, depending on whether the cast starts from random examples or from first appearances. Re:Cognize measures whether a model can read along; ReCast is a cast that does. Our claims are on identity maintenance, recognising characters already met; the emergence of new ones is measured as a diagnostic under a fixed reference rule, and we propose no method for it.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Re:Cognize 基准与 ReCast 方法，将漫画角色识别重新定义为阅读流中的开放式时序识别，发现瓶颈在于“接受新匹配”而非视觉识别能力。
AI.motivation: 漫画角色识别应如读者阅读般进行：页面按顺序到达，新角色在命名前出现，角色表随故事逐步建立。然而现有评估通常预先给定角色集，不符合真实开放集、序列化的场景。
AI.method: Re:Cognize 在同一查询流上设计四种协议，从闭集检索到模型需自行构建并扩展角色表。ReCast 无需训练数据，仅为每个角色维护一个运行平均特征，仅当页面本身验证裁剪图时才扩展角色表。
AI.result: 识别本身已接近解决：每角色一张参考图即可媲美预建图库。模型自行添加匹配反而使角色表变差，而同样增长若用正确标签可提升超过20个top-1点。ReCast可恢复完美标签收益的三分之一到三分之二。
AI.conclusion: 瓶颈在于接受与否的判断而非视觉能力；一个无需拟合的比较规则即可决定是否添加。Re:Cognize衡量模型能否边读边识别，ReCast实现了这一目标，但新角色涌现仅作为诊断测量，未提出方法。

title: Skill2Env: Capability-Oriented Environment Synthesis from Skills for General Agents
summary: Executable environments are critical for post-training agents on tasks that require tool use and multi-step interaction, but constructing executable tasks together with their environments remains difficult to scale. Skills provide reusable domain knowledge, operational procedures, and tool-use instructions, but a substantial gap remains between the information contained in a skill and a concrete, challenging task with a complete executable environment. To address this gap, we introduce Skill2Env, a capability-oriented framework that starts from a skill and uses agent capability demands to guide task and environment synthesis. Skill2Env represents these demands through reusable difficulty patterns and instantiates them into task blueprints that specify objectives, challenges, environment facts, information boundaries, and acceptance criteria. These blueprints guide the joint construction of task instructions, execution substrates, workspaces, and rubric-based evaluators around source skills. We further propose Iterative Task Hardening, which uses solver execution evidence to identify insufficiently challenging task designs, strengthen or extend their difficulty-pattern instantiations, and revise the corresponding blueprints and environments. Using 1.5K high-scoring trajectories generated from Skill2Env environments for supervised fine-tuning, we observe consistent improvements across a broad range of agent benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of capability-oriented environment synthesis for agent post-training.

AI.tldr: 提出 Skill2Env 框架，以技能为起点、以能力需求为导向合成任务与可执行环境，并用迭代任务加固提升难度；用其生成 1.5K 高分轨迹做 SFT，在多个 agent 基准上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 训练需要工具使用与多步交互的 agent 时，可执行环境至关重要，但大规模构建任务及其环境困难。技能虽含可复用的领域知识、操作流程和工具使用说明，但技能信息与"具体且有挑战性、配有完整可执行环境的任务"之间仍有巨大鸿沟。
AI.method: Skill2Env：从技能出发，用 agent 能力需求引导任务与环境合成。以可复用难度模式(difficulty patterns)表示能力需求，实例化为任务蓝图(目标、挑战、环境事实、信息边界、验收标准)，据此围绕源技能联合构建任务指令、执行基底、工作空间与基于 rubric 的评估器。另提出 Iterative Task Hardening：用求解器执行证据识别挑战性不足的任务，强化或扩展难度模式实例，并修订蓝图与环境。
AI.result: 使用 Skill2Env 环境生成的 1.5K 高分轨迹进行监督微调后，在广泛的 agent 基准上观察到一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了以能力为导向的环境合成对 agent 后训练的有效性，为规模化构建可执行 agent 训练任务提供了可行路径。

title: 3D Point Tracking with State Space Models
comment: 20 pages, 11 figures, 9 tables. Submitted to Computer Vision and Image Understanding
summary: Tracking any point of a dynamic scene in metric 3D - in absolute meters, not up to an unknown scale - underpins 3D and 4D reconstruction, robot navigation, and autonomous driving, where decisions are made in meters, not pixels. Our objective is a 3D point tracker accurate in those absolute terms and operating within a single commodity GPU, pose-free, monocular budget. Our method rests on one observation: once a point's 2D image trajectory is fixed, the quantity that governs its metric accuracy is the depth along its pixel ray. Rather than learning tracking end-to-end, we therefore compose two frozen front-ends - dense optical flow for 2D correspondence and a monocular metric-depth network for the third dimension - and learn only the residual they cannot supply: that depth, refined by a compact state space model (Mamba-3) conditioned on appearance features (DINOv3). A state space model rather than the transformers the strongest 3D trackers adopt is what makes a single-GPU budget attainable: it summarises a track in a fixed-size recurrent state whose memory cost is constant in the number of frames, whereas attention requires a key-value cache that grows linearly with them. On the TAPVid-3D minival benchmark our best configuration attains the highest absolute metric accuracy among methods evaluated under identical conditions (mean metric Average Jaccard, 0.256), exceeding strong feed-forward trackers, while a companion analysis, reproduced with each competitor's own evaluator, explains why several published trackers lose most of their accuracy under this budget.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在单张消费级GPU、无位姿、单目条件下进行度量级3D点追踪的方法，通过组合冻结的光流与度量深度前端，并用Mamba-3状态空间模型精修深度残差，在TAPVid-3D上取得最高绝对度量精度。
AI.motivation: 动态场景的度量3D点追踪（绝对米制而非未知尺度）是3D/4D重建、机器人导航和自动驾驶的基础，这些任务要求以米而非像素做决策。目标是在单张消费级GPU、无位姿、单目预算下实现准确的绝对度量追踪。
AI.method: 核心观察：一旦点的2D图像轨迹固定，决定其度量精度的量就是沿像素射线的深度。因此不端到端学习追踪，而是组合两个冻结前端——稠密光流做2D对应、单目度量深度网络提供第三维，仅学习它们无法提供的残差深度，由紧凑状态空间模型Mamba-3结合DINOv3外观特征进行精修。用状态空间模型而非Transformer，因为其固定大小递归状态的内存开销与帧数无关，而注意力需要随帧数线性增长的KV缓存，从而适配单GPU预算。
AI.result: 在TAPVid-3D minival基准上，最佳配置在相同条件下取得最高绝对度量精度（mean metric Average Jaccard 0.256），超过强前馈追踪器；配套分析用各竞争对手自己的评估器复现，解释了为何若干已发表追踪器在该预算下损失大部分精度。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦2D对应与深度、仅学习深度残差并结合状态空间模型，可在单GPU、无位姿、单目条件下实现优于强前馈追踪器的绝对度量3D点追踪，且内存开销不随帧数增长。

title: Learning Strategies to Break Judges
summary: As AI agents surpass human performance, it becomes exceedingly hard for system designers to evaluate them directly and understand their failure modes. Consequently, agents themselves are being deployed extensively to evaluate, judge, and provide feedback on model traces. But this raises an important question: how can we trust the judge? In this work, we propose an agent-guided method to find weaknesses of agentic judges that expose interpretable failure mechanisms. Our method focuses on mathematical reasoning and proceeds in two stages: first, we deploy adversarial agents to mutate a set of sound proofs by introducing errors, attempting to misguide judges---in other words, injecting errors that judges are unable to catch. Then, we distill these attempts into a small set of mutation strategies which allow us to analyze the failure modes of the judges. To ensure that these strategies are not overfit to the initial set of proofs, we evaluate them by applying the mutation strategies to a held-out set of proofs and querying the same judge. We deploy our method on GPT-5.6-sol and Claude Opus 5, paired with their agent orchestrators, Codex and Claude Code, respectively. These are used both as mutators to introduce errors and as judges to evaluate correctness of mathematical reasoning. We find that across all the agentic judges, we are able to distill mutation strategies that consistently bypass their evaluations, thereby enabling us to ascertain actionable failure modes. Our analysis also reveals that judge reliability degrades at the frontier: errors in Olympiad-level proofs or graduate-level mathematical texts are detected more consistently, whereas flaws in research-level manuscripts are more likely to escape detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"对抗代理"方法，用于揭示代理式评判者（agentic judges）在数学推理中的失效模式。
AI.motivation: 随着AI代理超越人类表现，人们广泛部署代理来自动评估与反馈模型轨迹，但由此产生关键问题：我们如何信任这些评判者？因此需要系统性地发现其弱点。
AI.method: 两阶段方法：（1）部署对抗性代理对一组正确证明进行变异、注入错误，试图误导评判者；（2）将这些尝试蒸馏为一小组可解释的变异策略，并在留出证明集上验证以避免过拟合。使用GPT-5.6-sol与Claude Opus 5，及其编排器Codex和Claude Code，分别充当变异者与评判者。
AI.result: 对所有代理式评判者，均能蒸馏出可稳定绕过其评估的变异策略，从而确定可操作的失效模式。评分可靠性在前沿领域下降：奥赛级证明或研究生级数学文本中的错误更易被检出，而研究级手稿中的缺陷更易逃过检测。
AI.conclusion: 代理式评判者存在可被系统性利用的失效机制，且其可靠性随问题难度提升而下降，提示在高阶数学研究中直接信任代理评判者存在风险。

title: SCOPD: Sparse-Context On-Policy Self-Distillation for Efficient Vision-Language Models
summary: Reasoning vision-language models (VLMs) process images and videos as long sequences of visual tokens, making inference expensive. Training-free token pruning reduces this cost, but aggressive compression can sharply degrade performance, often attributed to irreversible loss of task-relevant visual information. We show that this explanation is incomplete. In a fixed-context Pass@K analysis, repeated sampling from the same pruned visual representation recovers many examples missed by greedy decoding, indicating that useful visual evidence can remain accessible but be used unreliably. We call this the representation-utilization gap. Motivated by this observation, we introduce SCOPD, a sparse-context on-policy self-distillation framework in which a student generates reasoning trajectories from pruned visual tokens while a privileged full-context teacher supervises the same on-policy prefixes. SCOPD requires no ground-truth responses, architectural changes, or additional inference-time computation. We further introduce SCOPD+, which uses a small visual-budget intervention to identify visually sensitive response positions and selectively distill them. At 10% visual-token retention, the Vanilla model retains 86.37% of its unpruned performance across 13 benchmarks. SCOPD raises this to 90.49%, while SCOPD+ further improves it to 92.43%. Across token budgets, benchmarks, and pruning operators, our results show that efficient reasoning depends not only on which visual information survives pruning, but also on how reliably the model learns to use it.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示视觉token剪枝导致的性能下降不仅是信息丢失，更源于"表征-利用鸿沟"；提出SCOPD自蒸馏框架让全上下文教师监督剪枝学生，显著恢复性能。
AI.motivation: 推理型VLM处理长视觉token序列导致推理昂贵。无训练token剪枝可降本，但激进压缩会严重损害性能，通常被归因于任务相关视觉信息的不可逆丢失。作者发现这一解释不完整：在固定上下文的Pass@K分析中，对同一剪枝表征重复采样能恢复许多贪婪解码漏掉的样例，说明有用视觉证据仍可获取但被不可靠地使用。
AI.method: 提出SCOPD（稀疏上下文在线策略自蒸馏）：学生模型从剪枝视觉token生成推理轨迹，特权全上下文教师对相同的在线策略前缀进行监督。无需真实答案、架构改动或额外推理计算。进一步提出SCOPD+：用小的视觉预算干预识别对视觉敏感的响应位置并选择性地蒸馏它们。
AI.result: 在10%视觉token保留率下，Vanilla模型在13个基准上保留未剪枝性能的86.37%；SCOPD提升至90.49%；SCOPD+进一步提升至92.43%。结果在不同token预算、基准和剪枝算子下一致。
AI.conclusion: 高效推理不仅取决于哪些视觉信息在剪枝后存活，还取决于模型能否可靠地学会利用这些信息。SCOPD通过在线策略自蒸馏有效弥合表征-利用鸿沟。

title: Evidence-Inference Reconstruction: When The Evidence Is Recalled But The Reasoning Goes Wrong
summary: Modern multi-hop LLM agents are equipped with built-in mechanisms to detect errors in intermediate reasoning steps. Such errors trigger corrective actions from these agents, which mostly follow the paradigm of retrying the steps or the reasoning trajectories. Not only are these retries expensive, we present in this paper that they are also potentially unnecessary. To this end, we introduce Evidence-Inference Reconstruction (EIR), which uses structured state to guide one retrieval trajectory, accumulating source evidence in the process. We show that as long as the relevant evidence has been collected, EIR is capable of generating the correct answer in a single final model call even if erroneous evidence has been mixed in due to incorrect intermediate reasoning steps. In one evaluation, using Haiku 4.5 and GPT-4.1 Mini, we evaluate EIR on matched 1,000-question subsets of HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue, showing that EIR improves Answer F1, the overlap between the model's and the correct answer, over the baseline by 8.3--32.8 points, Agentic SSR by 10.6--29.1 points, and Reflexion by 1.1--15.9 points. Additionally, we show that EIR averages 4.85 total model calls per question, compared with 35.29 for Agentic SSR and 12.41 for Reflexion. Together, these results corroborate EIR's central premise: separating evidence retrieval from the final answer model call can improve answer accuracy while utilizing substantially less computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Evidence-Inference Reconstruction (EIR)，用结构化状态引导单条检索轨迹并累积证据，证明只要收集到相关证据，即使混入错误证据也能在单次最终模型调用中生成正确答案，从而避免昂贵的重试。
AI.motivation: 现有多跳 LLM agent 检测到中间推理错误后会重试步骤或轨迹，成本高昂且往往并非必要。
AI.method: EIR 使用结构化状态引导一条检索轨迹，过程中累积源证据，将证据检索与最终答案生成分离。
AI.result: 在 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue 的 1000 题子集上（Haiku 4.5 与 GPT-4.1 Mini），Answer F1 比基线高 8.3–32.8 分，超 Agentic SSR 10.6–29.1 分、超 Reflexion 1.1–15.9 分；EIR 平均 4.85 次模型调用，而 Agentic SSR 为 35.29、Reflexion 为 12.41。
AI.conclusion: 将证据检索与最终答案调用分离，可在显著降低计算量的同时提升答案准确率。

authors: Jose Luis Garcia del Castillo y Lopez
title: ARCH-B: Architectural Representation, Comprehension and Hierarchy Benchmark
summary: Multimodal models increasingly interpret visual environments, but their ability to recognize the same building across photographs, floor plans, elevations, sections, and renderings remains poorly characterized. We introduce ARCH-B, a benchmark of 354 four-choice questions across 11 cross-representational archetypes, constructed from a building-linked corpus of 3.9 million architectural images using visually similar distractors, model-guided difficulty screening, and manual validation. We evaluate 25 multimodal models and collect 5,830 responses from non-expert human participants. Model accuracy ranges from 10.45% to 83.90%, compared with a human baseline of 35.35%. Models perform comparatively well on mixed-representation outlier detection and photograph matching, but remain weaker on floorplan-to-photograph correspondence. Human and model difficulty across archetypes is only weakly correlated (Spearman's (ρ=0.33)). Held-out evaluation confirms that the difficulty identified during screening generalizes beyond the curation models. ARCH-B provides a diagnostic evaluation of visual correspondence and representation transfer across architectural media.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ARCH-B 基准，用于评测多模态模型跨建筑表现形式（照片、平面图、立面图等）识别同一建筑的能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态模型对视觉环境的理解日益增强，但其跨不同建筑表现形式识别同一建筑的能力尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: 构建 ARCH-B 基准，包含 11 类跨表现形式题型、354 道四选一题，基于 390 万张建筑图像语料，采用视觉相似干扰项、模型引导难度筛选与人工验证；评估 25 个多模态模型并收集 5830 份非专家人类作答。
AI.result: 模型准确率 10.45%–83.90%，人类基线 35.35%；模型在混合表示异常检测和照片匹配上较好，平面图到照片对应较弱；人机难度相关性弱（ρ=0.33）；留出评估验证难度可泛化。
AI.conclusion: ARCH-B 为跨建筑媒介的视觉对应与表示迁移提供了诊断性评测工具。

title: Is your uncertainty map wrong, or is its target? Exact diagnostics for the Tweedie diagonal, and a gradient-free alternative
summary:
A diffusion model can predict a follow-up medical scan from a baseline, but a clinician needs a per-voxel map of where that prediction can be trusted. Many such maps approximate the diagonal of the Tweedie posterior covariance, and are evaluated against another approximation of it, so whether the estimator or the target limits them is unclear. We compute the exact diagonal on six checkpoints across fourteen model-corpus conditions. Hutchinson at M=200 tracks it at rank agreement of at least 0.92 everywhere, yet in four of the fourteen the exact diagonal is anti-correlated with the denoising error, reaching -0.13, so a faithful estimator reproduces that reversal. All four are real-image conditions; on the models' own samples the reversal does not appear, so evaluating on generated samples flatters this family. What limits these maps is the target, not the estimator.
  We then introduce Tweedie Probe-Tangent (T-PT), a gradient-free residual probe that corrupts one model-supported prediction repeatedly and measures the voxel-wise variance of the denoiser's response. T-PT reads a different functional of the same Jacobian, and its exact second-order form ranks with the diagonal wherever the diagonal reverses; at thirty probes it returns a map too unstable to reproduce that ranking, while Hutchinson at M=5 already reproduces it, so T-PT there is not evidence against the reversal. We offer it as an instrument, not a better approximation. On brain MRI at full resolution, where every Jacobian-based estimator we test runs out of memory, T-PT leads a twenty-chain Monte-Carlo ensemble on five of eight endpoints inside tissue and trails it on none, at 16x fewer network evaluations; over the whole volume the ensemble leads, and fifty chains close the tissue gap. On lung CT the ensemble is ahead throughout. Both lose most of their discrimination where the change is, which remains open.

AI.tldr: 该研究指出扩散模型预测随访医学影像的体素级可信度图，其瓶颈在评估目标而非估计器；并提出无梯度残差探针T-PT作为一种新工具。
AI.motivation: 临床需要逐体素的可信度图，但现有方法用近似的Tweedie后验协方差对角及其近似来评估，无法分辨是估计器还是目标限制了性能，因此需精确计算对角并检验其与去噪误差的关系。
AI.method: 在十四个模型-语料条件下、六个检查点上精确计算Tweedie后验协方差对角，并用Hutchinson估计器（M=200）对比；随后提出无梯度残差探针T-PT，通过反复扰动模型支持的预测并测量去噪器响应的体素方差，读取同一雅可比的不同泛函，研究其二阶精确形式的排序能力与稳定性。
AI.result: Hutchinson在M=200时处处排序一致性≥0.92，但14个条件中有4个精确对角与去噪误差反相关（最低-0.13），且均为真实图像条件，在生成样本上不出现。T-PT二阶精确形式在对角反转处仍与对角同序，但30次探针时不稳定，而Hutchinson M=5已能复现该排序。在全分辨率脑MRI上，T-PT以16倍更少网络评估在八个端点中五个领先二十链蒙特卡洛集成且无落后；肺CT上集成全程领先。
AI.conclusion: 限制这些可信度图的是评估目标而非估计器；T-PT是仪器而非更优近似，且在真实高分辨率场景中具有实用性，但两种方法在变化处的区分能力均大幅下降，仍是开放问题。

title: SNaP: One-Step Posterior Sampling for Noisy Inverse Problems
summary: Diffusion and flow-matching models can produce high-quality posterior samples for inverse problems, but typically require tens to thousands of network evaluations per draw. MeanFlow enables one-step generation, yet applying it to inverse problems leaves no intermediate steps at which to enforce measurement consistency. We introduce SNaP, a one-step MeanFlow posterior sampler for linear inverse problems with Gaussian noise. Its central innovation is a measurement-adapted source: a Gaussian distribution whose mean and anisotropic covariance are determined by the measurement operator, observation, and noise level. The source anchors well-measured directions while preserving variation where the measurements are weak or uninformative. We show that the exact conditional flow transports this source to the true posterior. Across natural-image restoration and multi-coil MRI, SNaP produces diverse, high-quality samples with one network evaluation per draw, 30 to 2250 $\times$ faster than iterative samplers.

AI.tldr: SNaP：面向线性逆问题的一步MeanFlow后验采样器，通过测量适配源分布实现一次网络评估生成后验样本。
AI.motivation: 扩散与flow-matching模型能为逆问题生成高质量后验采样，但每次采样需数十至上千次网络评估；MeanFlow虽支持一步生成，却因无中间步骤而无法施加测量一致性约束。
AI.method: 提出SNaP一步式MeanFlow后验采样器，用于含高斯噪声的线性逆问题。核心创新是"测量适配源"：其均值与各向异性协方差由测量算子、观测值及噪声水平决定，在测量良好的方向上锚定、在弱或无信息方向上保留变化。并证明精确条件流将该源传输至真实后验。
AI.result: 在自然图像复原与多线圈MRI任务上，SNaP以每次采样仅一次网络评估生成多样且高质量的样本，比迭代采样器快30至2250倍。
AI.conclusion: SNaP表明通过设计测量适配的源分布，可在无中间步骤的一步生成框架下实现测量一致性，兼顾质量、多样性与极高效率。

title: Dual-Vocabulary Language Model for Cross-Tokenizer Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) bridges teacher supervision and student behavior, but different teacher-student tokenizers introduce misalignment in both input tokenization (#1) and output logits (#2). Existing approaches address the former by matching same-text spans or converting tokens to bytes, often losing fine-grained token information or disrupting the native-token paradigm, while for the latter, strategies such as ranking, padding, or key-token selection retain only shared logit dimensions, resulting in much distribution loss. In this paper, we propose Dual-Vocabulary Language Model (DVLM), which replaces the teacher's LM head with a new student-vocabulary projection head and obtains full-dimensional student logits (for #2). To support student tokens (for #1), it takes a Parallel-Tokenized Sequence (PTS) as input, which concatenates the original teacher-tokenized sequence and a re-tokenized sequence formed by independently converting each student token into a teacher-token group. To avoid inference inconsistency with the original teacher tokens, the Hybrid-Prefix Attention (HPA) further restricts re-tokenized groups to their corresponding teacher prefix and uses its last state as the aggregation of the original student-token representation for projection into the student vocabulary space. Similarly, via the combined use of PTS and HPA, the DVLM teacher can provide distribution-aligned supervision with the student's input-tokenization and output-logit during OPD. Experimental results demonstrate that our DVLM teacher has a similar converged loss as the original teacher model and enables student models to improve performance across six reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出Dual-Vocabulary Language Model (DVLM)，通过Parallel-Tokenized Sequence与Hybrid-Prefix Attention解决on-policy蒸馏中师生tokenizer在输入分词与输出logits上的双重错位，实现分布对齐的监督。
AI.motivation: On-policy蒸馏需要教师监督与学生行为对齐，但师生tokenizer不同导致两处错位：输入分词不一致(#1)与输出logits维度不一致(#2)。现有方法或丢失细粒度token信息、或破坏原生token范式，logits对齐上也只保留共享维度，造成大量分布损失。
AI.method: DVLM用新的学生词表投影头替换教师LM head以获得全维学生logits(解决#2)；输入采用Parallel-Tokenized Sequence，拼接原始教师token序列与逐学生token转换成的教师token组(解决#1)；再用Hybrid-Prefix Attention将重分词组限制在对应教师前缀内，并以该前缀最后状态聚合学生token表示投影到学生词表空间，避免与原教师token推理不一致。
AI.result: DVLM教师的收敛损失与原教师模型相近，并使学生在六个推理任务上性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过PTS与HPA的联合使用，DVLM教师能在on-policy蒸馏中提供与学生的输入分词和输出logit均分布对齐的监督，兼顾细粒度信息与原生token范式。

title: WhiteCon: Semi-Supervised Domain Adaptation Regression Through Whitening Transform and Dual Consistency
summary: Domain adaptation is crucial for addressing distributional shifts that degrade model performance across domains. While most existing research has centered on classification, semi-supervised domain adaptation regression (SSDAR) for continuous-output tasks remains largely unexplored, particularly in practical scenarios with limited labeled target data. To address this gap, we propose semi-supervised domain adaptation regression through whitening transform and dual consistency (WhiteCon), which combines domain-specific whitening transform (DWT) and dual consistency regularization to enhance training stability and domain adaptation. DWT reduces the variance of the model parameters by transforming the feature covariance matrix into an identity matrix, thus stabilizing training under ordinary least squares assumptions. In addition, variance consistency regularization, as part of dual consistency regularization, aligns the variances of weak, strong, and mixup-augmented features to improve resilience against augmentation-induced perturbations. Empirical evaluations on various benchmark datasets under SSDAR settings demonstrate that the proposed WhiteCon achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to existing methods, effectively addressing domain shifts in regression tasks. The code for WhiteCon is available at https://github.com/sejin-sim/WhiteCon.

AI.tldr: 提出WhiteCon，通过域特定白化变换与双重一致性正则化解决半监督域适应回归（SSDAR）问题。
AI.motivation: 现有域适应研究多聚焦分类任务，连续输出回归任务在半监督、少标注目标域场景下的域适应（SSDAR）研究严重不足。
AI.method: 结合域特定白化变换（DWT）与双重一致性正则化。DWT将特征协方差矩阵变换为单位矩阵以降低参数方差、稳定训练；双重一致性中的方差一致性正则化对齐弱增强、强增强及mixup特征的方差，提升对增强扰动的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集的SSDAR设置下，WhiteCon相较现有方法达到state-of-the-art性能，有效应对回归任务中的域偏移。
AI.conclusion: WhiteCon有效缓解域偏移，验证了白化变换与双重一致性在回归域适应中的有效性，代码已公开。

title: Vestrum: Improving Agent Harnesses by Adapting Their Verification, Structure and Memory
summary: An agent harness controls how a language model accesses information, uses tools, preserves memory, and checks its work. Improving this software is costly when each evaluation requires a long interaction with an environment. We introduce Vestrum, a framework that turns failures in execution traces into scoped harness changes without training the task model. Its organizing overhypothesis is that tasks of a shared kind may exhibit recurring failures whose remedies transfer within that kind. Vestrum expresses failures as recognizable classes, proposes changes across verification, retrieval, decomposition, and knowledge synthesis, and screens their scope before evaluating them as a bundle. A persistent lessons file informs subsequent proposals. Across five settings and two baseline harnesses, the frozen harnesses improve held-out performance: UltraHorizon rises from 47.6 to 59.8 over GAM, Terminal-Bench 4 Hard from 63.7% to 70.3% of checks passed over Claude Code on eight held-out tasks at 1.03x test cost, and cell-type annotation agreement from 67.5% to 77.8% on held-out sections of one slide, alongside gains on LoCoMo and AMA-Bench. Across our searches, verification grounded in evidence helped both intermediate steps and final answers, at lower cost at intermediate steps, while critics asked to rebuild finished answers broke more than they repaired. On the three memory benchmarks, Vestrum also scores above the evaluated GEPA configurations in every paired evaluation.

AI.tldr: Vestrum框架将执行轨迹中的失败转化为有针对性的harness修改，无需训练任务模型，在多个基准上提升held-out性能。
AI.motivation: 改进agent harness（控制语言模型如何访问信息、使用工具、保存记忆及自我检查的软件）成本高昂，因为每次评估都需要与环境进行长时间交互。
AI.method: 核心假设是同类任务可能表现出可复现的失败，其修复方案可在同类中迁移。Vestrum将失败表达为可识别的类别，在验证、检索、分解和知识合成方面提出修改，先筛选范围再以bundle形式评估，并用持久化lessons文件指导后续提议。
AI.result: 在5个设置和2个基线harness上，冻结的harness性能提升：UltraHorizon从47.6升至59.8（对GAM）；Terminal-Bench 4 Hard从63.7%升至70.3%通过率（对Claude Code，1.03x测试成本）；细胞类型注释一致性从67.5%升至77.8%；LoCoMo和AMA-Bench也有提升。
AI.conclusion: 基于证据的验证对中间步骤和最终答案均有益，且中间步骤成本更低；而要求critic重建已完成答案弊大于利。在三个记忆基准上，Vestrum在所有配对评估中均超过所评估的GEPA配置。

title: Advancing Wildlife Conservation through Multimodal Animal Re-Identification with Environmental Metadata
summary: Identifying individual animals is crucial for effective wildlife monitoring and conservation efforts. Recent advancements in computer vision have shown promise in animal re-identification (Animal ReID) by leveraging data from camera traps. However, existing Animal ReID datasets rely exclusively on visual data, overlooking environmental metadata that ecologists have identified as highly correlated with animal behavior and identity, such as temperature and circadian rhythms. Meanwhile, modern vision-language models (VLMs) offer rich multimodal reasoning capabilities, but existing resources underutilize their text-processing potential. To address these limitations, we propose MetaWild, a multimodal Animal ReID dataset comprising 20,890 images across six species, paired with environmental metadata extracted from embedded camera trap overlays and scene contexts. Additionally, to facilitate the use of metadata in existing ReID methods, we propose the Meta-Feature Adapter (MFA), a lightweight module that can be incorporated into existing VLM-based ReID methods, allowing ReID models to leverage both environmental metadata and visual information to improve ReID performance. Experiments on MetaWild show that combining baseline ReID models with MFA to incorporate metadata consistently improves performance compared to using visual information alone, validating the effectiveness of incorporating metadata in re-identification.

AI.tldr: 提出MetaWild多模态动物重识别数据集（含20890张图像、6个物种及环境元数据）和轻量级Meta-Feature Adapter（MFA）模块，使现有VLM-based ReID方法能结合元数据与视觉信息提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有Animal ReID数据集仅依赖视觉数据，忽略了生态学家认为与动物行为和身份高度相关的环境元数据（如温度、昼夜节律）；同时现有资源未充分利用现代VLM的文本处理潜力。
AI.method: 构建MetaWild数据集，从相机陷阱叠加层和场景上下文中提取环境元数据；提出Meta-Feature Adapter（MFA）轻量级模块，可嵌入现有VLM-based ReID方法，融合环境元数据与视觉信息。
AI.result: 在MetaWild上的实验表明，将基线ReID模型与MFA结合以引入元数据，相比仅使用视觉信息能持续提升性能，验证了在重识别中引入元数据的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 引入环境元数据可有效提升动物重识别性能，MetaWild数据集与MFA模块为多模态Animal ReID研究提供了新资源与方法。

title: Laya as a Typed Probabilistic Assessor: An Independent Reproduction and a Preregistered Study of Calibration and Selective Escalation
comment: 31 pages, 8 figures. Ancillary files include the frozen preregistration, all run manifests, per-decision prediction records, and the metric code
summary: The shipped Laya Typed-Decisions checkpoint, a 421M-parameter ModernBERT-large assessor that answers typed choice/noul/score questions over workflow state, is uniformly under-confident. The signed confidence-accuracy gap is $-0.214$, every occupied reliability bin's accuracy exceeds its confidence, and that sign uniformity collapses every binned ECE variant to the same value, $0.214$. The card frames the risk as over-confidence; the measured direction is the opposite, and the direction decides which way a confidence-gated cascade fails. A single disjointly fitted temperature ($T=0.469$, sharpening) removes most of the miscalibration (held-out ECE $0.204$ to $0.037$) and outperforms the shipped per-option-count table. The frozen selection rule instead chose isotonic regression, which overfit and failed its held-out NLL contrast on both tracks, so hypothesis H2 is not supported. Re-running the released checkpoint on its full official test split reproduces the card's headline accuracy ($0.767$ vs. $0.766$). The retrospective E1 reproduction preceded the analysis freeze; E2-E8 were prospectively preregistered, and 20 of 22 executed confirmatory tests reject under Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at $q=0.05$ (two descoped). The frozen gate beats random escalation but misses its 10% accepted-set error target on both tracks, an exploratory out-of-distribution probe finds no zero-shot transfer (accuracy $0.617$), and every score measures agreement with a synthetic teacher whose self-agreement ceiling ($0.735$) the specialist exceeds. Per-decision predictions, run manifests, and the frozen preregistration are in the ancillary files. The author has no affiliation with the model's publisher, the dataset's publisher, or TypeSafe.

AI.tldr: 分析Laya Typed-Decisions检查点（421M ModernBERT-large），发现其置信度普遍偏低而非卡片声称的过度自信，温度缩放可有效校正，但冻结选择的isotonic回归过拟合失败。
AI.motivation: 原模型卡片将风险框定为过度自信，但实测方向相反（欠自信），而方向决定了置信门控级联的失效方向，因此需重新校准并验证。
AI.method: 对发布的检查点做校准分析：测算有符号置信-准确率差、可靠性分箱与ECE；拟合单一温度(T=0.469)与isotonic回归对比；在官方测试集复现；E1回顾性复现，E2-E8前瞻预注册；BH FDR(q=0.05)检验；门控级联与OOD探测。
AI.result: 有符号差距-0.214，所有分箱欠自信使各ECE变体同值0.214；温度缩放将held-out ECE从0.204降至0.037，优于发布的按选项数表；isotonic过拟合，held-out NLL对比失败，H2不成立；复现头部准确率0.767(卡片0.766)；22项确认测试中20项显著；门控优于随机但在两轨道均未达10%错误目标；OOD零样本无迁移(0.617)；专家超过合成教师自一致上限0.735。
AI.conclusion: 模型实为欠自信，方向判定对级联设计关键；单一温度缩放即可有效校准并优于发布方案；预注册选定的isotonic失败，H2不支持；同步提供逐决策预测、运行清单与冻结预注册。

title: The Devil is in the Spectrum Bias: Spectrum-Balanced Feature Matching for Robust Representation Distillation
summary: Large visual foundation models have demonstrated remarkable transferability across a wide range of downstream tasks. To deploy such models efficiently, feature matching has become a popular knowledge distillation approach that transfers teacher representations to smaller student models without requiring labeled data. However, we show that the conventional feature matching objective with L2-distance is inherently biased toward reconstructing dominant spectral directions of the teacher representation, while under-optimizing low-variance directions that often contain task-relevant information. To address this, we propose Spectrum-Balanced Feature Matching, SpecMatch, a simple objective that adaptively emphasizes under-optimized spectral directions while preserving the relative importance of dominant directions. SpecMatch is easy to implement and introduces negligible computational overhead. Extensive experiments on image recognition demonstrate that SpecMatch consistently improves downstream adaptation across diverse tasks, including image classification, anomaly detection, medical image analysis, and domain generalization. In particular, SpecMatch outperforms conventional feature matching in 40 of 42 teacher--student and training-setting combinations, while consistently improving over the original student model in all settings. We further demonstrate that the proposed objective generalizes beyond vision, improving downstream performance across six protein understanding tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出SpecMatch，一种频谱平衡的特征匹配目标，解决L2特征匹配偏重主频谱方向的偏差，在多视觉与蛋白质任务上稳定提升下游性能。
AI.motivation: 大视觉基础模型迁移性强，但高效部署需要无标签知识蒸馏。传统L2特征匹配目标存在偏差：过度重建教师表示的主频谱方向，而低估常含任务相关信息的低方差方向。
AI.method: SpecMatch自适应地强调欠优化的频谱方向，同时保留主方向的相对重要性；实现简单，计算开销几乎可忽略。
AI.result: 在图像识别中跨多种任务（分类、异常检测、医学图像、域泛化）持续提升下游适配；42种师生与训练设置组合中40种优于传统特征匹配，所有设置均优于原始学生模型；并在六个蛋白质理解任务上验证了跨领域泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 特征匹配中的频谱偏差可被简单目标有效纠正，SpecMatch具有通用性，可推广至视觉以外领域。

title: How code helps different tasks? A decompositional lens on LLM post-training
summary: Evaluating code data as a single corpus can obscure which types of code data benefit which models and downstream tasks. Effective data selection requires understanding both the benefits of individual categories and whether these benefits persist when categories are combined. We introduce a decompositional lens for studying these effects in LLM post-training. We first decompose an execution-verified code corpus into interpretable categories based on the computational patterns of its solutions. Through controlled fine-tuning experiments, we compare individual categories with a balanced mixture across instruction-tuned models on question answering, mathematics, and code generation. The resulting response maps reveal recurring gains in average question-answering performance, while the same category can improve one model or task and degrade another. The best-performing category also varies with the starting model and target task. We then compose compact mixtures guided by these results and examine whether benefits observed in individual categories persist under joint training. On selected model--task pairs, mixtures whose constituents each improve the target task outperform both their best constituent and full-corpus training while using roughly 10--15\% of the full corpus. These exploratory findings illustrate a \emph{less is more} pattern and highlight how the value of code data in post training depends on which categories are combined for which model and task.

AI.tldr: 将执行验证的代码语料库分解为可解释的计算模式类别，通过受控微调实验揭示不同代码类别对不同模型和任务的差异化影响，并发现紧凑的组合混合能以10-15%的数据量超越全语料训练。
AI.motivation: 将代码数据视为单一语料库会掩盖哪些类型的代码数据对哪些模型和下游任务有益。有效的数据选择需要理解单个类别的收益，以及这些收益在类别组合时是否持续存在。
AI.method: 提出分解视角：首先将执行验证的代码语料库按解决方案的计算模式分解为可解释类别；通过受控微调实验，在指令微调模型上比较单个类别与均衡混合在问答、数学和代码生成任务上的表现；再基于结果构造紧凑混合，检验单个类别的收益在联合训练下是否持续。
AI.result: 响应图显示问答平均性能有反复增益，但同一类别可能提升一个模型或任务却损害另一个；最佳类别随起始模型和目标任务变化。在选定的模型-任务对上，各成分均有益目标的混合优于最佳单类别和全语料训练，且仅用约10-15%的全语料。
AI.conclusion: 呈现"少即是多"的模式，说明代码数据在后训练中的价值取决于为哪个模型和任务组合哪些类别。

title: SpatialSkill: Self-Evolving Skills for Cross-View Spatial Reasoning
summary: Cross-view spatial reasoning requires a model to align different viewpoints into a coherent spatial representation, yet this ability remains challenging for vision-language models despite being natural to humans. Existing methods typically improve spatial reasoning by updating model weights, which keeps the acquired knowledge implicit and tied to a specific backbone. We propose \textit{SpatialSkill}, a weight-update-free framework that enables a frozen vision-language model to accumulate explicit natural-language reasoning skills from offline trajectories. Unlike symbolic tasks, perceptual skills cannot be reliably verified simply by executing them: a plausible spatial rule may lack visual support or require transformations that the frozen model cannot perform. SpatialSkill therefore admits candidate skills only after visual-grounding and executability checks, constrains manual evolution to prevent harmful regressions, and routes skills by spatial-reasoning category to reduce negative transfer. On CityCube, across four frozen executors, SpatialSkill yields consistent gains, and a 9B executor equipped with SpatialSkill surpasses the strongest closed-source reference in our evaluation. The skills are stored in a versioned natural-language manual, making the reasoning strategies explicit and auditable without modifying model parameters. Code at https://github.com/vindahi/SpatialSkill.

AI.tldr: SpatialSkill是一个无需更新权重的框架，让冻结的视觉语言模型通过离线轨迹积累显式自然语言推理技能，在CityCube上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 跨视角空间推理需将不同视角对齐为一致的3D理解，但现有视觉语言模型此能力不足。现有方法依赖更新模型权重，使知识隐式且绑定特定骨干网络。
AI.method: 提出SpatialSkill，无需权重更新，从离线轨迹中为冻结VLM积累显式自然语言技能。候选技能需通过视觉落地与可执行性检查，约束人工演化防退化，并按空间推理类别路由技能以减少负迁移。
AI.result: 在CityCube上，四种冻结执行器均取得一致增益；配备SpatialSkill的9B执行器超过最强闭源参考模型。
AI.conclusion: 技能存储于版本化自然语言手册，推理策略显式可审计且无需修改模型参数，代码已开源。

title: R$^2$ Flow: Recursive Self-Improvement via Recursive Skill Evolution
summary: LLM-based agents can improve themselves across tasks by reusing and revising the skills they orchestrate into executable procedures. Flow-based training fits this loop: it samples procedures in proportion to reward, and the flow through each skill credits it for the next library revision. Three obstacles stand in the way of making this self-improvement reliable: flow training suffers strategy collapse over tree-structured histories; nonnegative flow-based credit rewards frequent use as if it were benefit; and library edits rest on the task reward the policy optimizes. We introduce R$^2$ Flow, a recursive self-improvement framework that alternates policy learning, independent verification, and versioned skill-library updates on a shared-state orchestration graph. The graph merges histories that differ only in the order of independent steps, allowing flow training to pool evidence across equivalent executions. A flow-share readout of the trained flow, invariant to the backward policy, and a separate signed utility rank which skills to change, verifier evidence decides whether an edit is warranted, and a residual-variance plateau sets when to update. Committed edits reshape the graph the next policy learns on, realizing recursive skill evolution. Across question answering, mathematical reasoning, interactive decision making, and code generation, R$^2$ Flow improves task accuracy and library-edit precision over heuristic orchestration, reinforcement learning, and skill-evolution baselines, and transfers across executors. Code is available at https://github.com/beita6969/r2flow.

AI.tldr: R² Flow是一个通过策略学习、独立验证和版本化技能库更新交替进行的递归自我改进框架，在共享状态编排图上解决流训练的策略坍缩、非负信用误导及技能编辑依据问题。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体通过复用和修正技能实现自我提升，但流训练存在三大障碍：树结构历史导致策略坍缩、非负流信用将频繁使用误当收益、技能库编辑依赖任务奖励而不可靠。
AI.method: 构建共享状态编排图，合并仅独立步骤顺序不同的历史以汇聚证据；提出对后向策略不变的流份额读取，及单独的有符号效用来排序需修改的技能；由验证器证据决定编辑是否必要，残差方差平台决定何时更新，已提交编辑重塑后续策略学习图。
AI.result: 在问答、数学推理、交互决策和代码生成任务上，R² Flow在任务准确率和技能库编辑精度上优于启发式编排、强化学习和技能进化基线，并可跨执行器迁移。
AI.conclusion: R² Flow通过递归技能演化框架克服流训练障碍，实现可靠的LLM智能体自我改进，代码已开源。

title: PrefLUT: Reusable and Refinable Personalized Color Editing from Pairwise Preferences
summary: Photographic color editing is inherently personal: the same image can appear too warm, too muted, or already satisfactory to different users. Most lookup table (LUT) and reference-guided methods target a specified appearance rather than model persistent preferences from repeated user choices. To address this gap, we introduce PrefLUT, a reusable and refinable user-preference modeling framework for deployable 3D LUTs, encoding ordered preferred/non-preferred image pairs into a lightweight Reusable User Profile that is reused across queries and refined using additional user preference pairs, without per-user optimization. A Query-Conditioned LUT Predictor combines this profile with each image to predict a LUT latent vector and edit strength. An Identity-Residual LUT Decoder and Edit-Strength Controller then produce an exportable 3D LUT. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate effective personalized editing and general-purpose enhancement. Each quantized profile requires only 260 bytes, and editing takes 1.365 ms/image on an RTX 5090 GPU. We also introduce the Preference-Conditioning Verification Protocol (PCVP), an evaluation protocol to verify whether personalized image edits depend on user preferences and the query image through controlled changes to user profiles, preference orders, pair correspondences, and query images.

AI.tldr: 提出PrefLUT框架，将用户偏好的图像对编码为可复用的轻量用户画像，用于个性化3D LUT色彩编辑，并引入PCVP评估协议。
AI.motivation: 摄影色彩编辑高度个人化，同一图像对不同用户可能偏暖、偏淡或已足够好。现有LUT与参考引导方法只针对特定外观，无法从用户重复选择中建模持续偏好。
AI.method: PrefLUT将有序的偏好/非偏好图像对编码为轻量可复用用户画像，跨查询复用并可用额外偏好对细化，无需逐用户优化。查询条件LUT预测器结合画像与图像预测LUT隐向量和编辑强度；身份残差LUT解码器与编辑强度控制器生成可导出的3D LUT。另提出PCVP协议，通过控制变更用户画像、偏好顺序、图像对对应关系和查询图像来验证个性化编辑是否依赖用户偏好与查询图像。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上实现有效的个性化编辑与通用增强；量化画像仅需260字节，RTX 5090 GPU上编辑耗时1.365 ms/图。
AI.conclusion: PrefLUT实现了可复用、可细化且可部署的个性化色彩编辑，并通过PCVP提供了验证偏好条件化的评估手段。

title: When Successful Strategies Fail: Adaptation to Environmental Novelty in Terminal Agents
comment: 53 pages, including references and appendices; 10-page main text with 5 figures
summary: LLM agents increasingly solve long-horizon tasks by autonomously interacting with their environment. In doing so, their strategies rely on assumptions about that environment: which resources and tools exist, where they are located, and how they behave. When these assumptions no longer hold, reliable agents must detect the change and adapt while pursuing the same goal. We study this adaptation capability through environmental novelty: a change that keeps the task objective fixed while invalidating an assumption underlying an otherwise successful trajectory. We introduce AGNI, an automated pipeline that extracts trajectory-relevant assumptions, injects targeted environmental changes, and validates that the resulting novel tasks remain solvable. Across three terminal benchmarks, AGNI produces diverse novelties spanning resources, interfaces, constraints, and execution semantics. Evaluating multiple LLM agents reveals a substantial adaptation gap between base and novel tasks. Trajectory analysis suggests that agents often encounter evidence of the change but fail to diagnose its cause and revise their strategy. Finally, post-training for environmental novelty improves adaptation to held-out novel tasks while also improving performance on base tasks. Our results highlight a gap between task competence and adaptive capability and motivate environmental variation as a core dimension of agent training and evaluation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"环境新颖性"（environmental novelty）来研究LLM agent的适应能力，并推出AGNI自动管线生成此类任务，揭示了agent在任务能力与适应能力之间的显著差距。
AI.motivation: LLM agent在执行长程任务时依赖对环境资源、工具位置和行为的假设；当这些假设失效时，agent需检测变化并调整策略。然而现有评估多关注任务能力，缺乏对"适应能力"的系统研究。
AI.method: 提出AGNI自动管线：提取与轨迹相关的假设，注入有针对性的环境变化，并验证生成的新颖任务仍然可解，覆盖资源、接口、约束和执行语义等变化维度。
AI.result: 在三个终端benchmark上生成了多样化的新颖任务；多个LLM agent在基础任务与新颖任务间存在显著适应差距；轨迹分析显示agent常观察到变化证据却无法诊断原因并修正策略；针对环境新颖性的后训练能提升对新任务的适应，同时改善基础任务表现。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显任务能力与适应能力之间的鸿沟，呼吁将环境变化作为agent训练与评估的核心维度。

title: Analytical and Convolutional Neural Network-Based Motion-Vector Propagation for Efficient Video Object Detection
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, This work has been submitted to IEEE for possible publication
summary: Continuous video analytics requires accurate localization at low latency within embedded power budgets. This paper presents a hardware-software design methodology that reuses codec motion vectors (MVs) between detector invocations. Two alternative models support translation and scale changes: analytical motion-vector propagation (Analytical-MV) and learned propagation using a convolutional neural network (CNN) (CNN-MV). The learned model uses convolutional operations and independent object updates suited to parallel execution on an edge graphics processing unit (GPU). Analytical-MV combines a harmonic-mean precision-recall score (F1) of 0.909 with a mean end-to-end latency of 9.03 ms and an energy consumption of 0.177 J per frame, yielding the lowest latency and energy among the evaluated configurations. Relative to detection on every frame, it reduces mean latency by 25.9% and energy per frame by 36.4%. CNN-MV offers a different trade-off: its fastest configuration raises recall from 0.871 for Analytical-MV to 0.890 and lowers mean power from 19.64 to 17.32 W, while achieving a latency of 18.42 ms and an energy consumption of 0.319 J per frame. It is therefore useful when recall or operating power is more important than minimum latency and energy. Execution on a deep learning accelerator (DLA) further reduces time-averaged GPU utilization relative to GPU execution. Host-processing optimization substantially improves both latency and energy, demonstrating the value of jointly designing temporal models and their execution pipelines.

AI.tldr: 提出复用编解码器运动矢量的硬件-软件协同设计方法，用于低延迟、低功耗的连续视频分析目标定位。
AI.motivation: 连续视频分析需要在嵌入式功耗预算下实现低延迟的准确定位，逐帧检测代价过高，需复用信息降低计算量。
AI.method: 复用检测间隔间的编解码器运动矢量（MV），提出两种模型支持平移与尺度变化：解析式运动矢量传播（Analytical-MV）与基于CNN的学习式传播（CNN-MV）；CNN-MV采用卷积操作与独立目标更新以适配边缘GPU并行执行。
AI.result: Analytical-MV的F1为0.909，平均端到端延迟9.03 ms，每帧能耗0.177 J，较逐帧检测延迟降低25.9%、能耗降低36.4%。CNN-MV最快配置将召回率从0.871提升至0.890，平均功耗从19.64 W降至17.32 W，延迟18.42 ms，能耗0.319 J/帧。DLA执行进一步降低GPU平均利用率。
AI.conclusion: 联合设计时序模型与执行流水线（含主机处理优化）可显著改善延迟与能耗；Analytical-MV适合极低延迟能耗场景，CNN-MV适合重视召回率或功耗的场景。

title: Curating Merchant-Matching Training Data with Two Confidence-Gated Local LLM Judges
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables, Accepted for publication in 2026 IEEE International Conference on Data Mining Workshops (ICDMW), SENTIRE 2026 Workshop
summary: Merchant matching resolves a noisy payment descriptor to a retrieved merchant entity or returns no match. A key challenge in curating training labels is distinguishing teacher abstention from evidence that no acceptable entity exists: false no-match labels contaminate pseudo-labeled data, while conservative labeling reduces coverage. We investigate whether agreement between two local large language model judges improves pseudo-label reliability. A label is retained only when the judges agree, with separate ordered thresholds for selections and abstentions that guarantee disjoint positive and negative label sets. Retrospective replay on 2,000 expert-annotated queries shows that higher selection thresholds can improve positive-label purity, whereas higher abstention thresholds increase false no-match labels. At thresholds (0.86, 0.80), Muse Glimmer 30B and Gemma 4 31B jointly label 1,633 queries (81.7% coverage) at 96.88% purity; positive and negative purities are 99.47% and 93.38%. This exceeds either constituent model at the same thresholds by more than two percentage points, with lower coverage. A split-half check finds only 0.14 percentage points of threshold-selection optimism. A symmetric threshold of 0.86 adds 40 erroneous no-match labels, while 46 false abstentions persist even with no confidence threshold. Across five matched within-model comparisons, higher reasoning effort yields no clear F0.5 gain and increases median latency by 1.8-5.0 times. These results motivate separate thresholding and auditing for positive and negative pseudo-labels. The study establishes label purity, not student utility; fresh-data curation and student fine-tuning remain necessary to demonstrate downstream value.

AI.tldr: 研究用两个本地大模型评审员的一致性来提升商户匹配伪标签的可靠性，通过为选中与弃权分别设有序阈值保证正负标签集不相交。
AI.motivation: 商户匹配需将噪声支付描述匹配到商户实体或无匹配返回。训练标签难点在于区分"教师弃权"与"确实无可用实体"：错误的no-match标签会污染伪标签数据，而过于保守的标注又会降低覆盖率。
AI.method: 采用两个本地大模型评审员的一致性过滤：仅当两者一致时保留标签，并对选中与弃权分别设置有序阈值，保证正、负标签集互斥。在2,000条专家标注查询上做回顾性回放，并开展半分(check)检验与五种同模型内对比(推理强度)。
