Extensive experiments across four video understanding benchmarks and three representative Video LLMs show that SimpleCluster achieves competitive or superior performance over recent compression methods across a wide range of token retention ratios, with particularly strong robustness under extremely low retention rates (e.g., 1%). To understand this behavior, we analyze the feature space preserved by different compression methods in terms of local approximation fidelity and global coverage. The results show that stronger downstream performance is consistently associated with better preservation of the original visual feature distribution, especially its global coverage. These findings highlight feature-space preservation as an important consideration for video token compression under highly constrained token budgets. Our code is available at https://github.com/xiaozhang79/SimpleCluster.

AI.tldr: SimpleCluster：一种无需训练的简单基线，通过位置感知的跨帧聚类压缩视频token，在多个基准上媲美甚至超越复杂方法，尤其在极低保留率下表现出强鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: Video LLM推理效率受限于长视频产生的大量视觉token，现有压缩方法策略日益复杂，因此作者追问：仅靠保留视觉表征中的结构能获得多少压缩性能。
AI.method: 提出SimpleCluster，在视觉特征空间中进行位置感知的跨帧聚类，并用每个簇内原始视觉特征的均值来表示该簇，无需训练。
AI.result: 在4个视频理解基准和3个代表性Video LLM上，跨多种token保留率取得有竞争力或更优的性能，在极低保留率（如1%）下尤为鲁棒。分析表明更好的下游性能与更好地保持原始视觉特征分布（尤其全局覆盖）一致相关。
AI.conclusion: 特征空间保持是token预算受限时视频token压缩的重要考量，简单方法即可提供强基线。

title: Textual User Taste: Natural-Language User Context for Foundation-Model Recommender System at Scale
summary: Foundation model recommender systems require user context that can be consumed by large language models, reasoned over, and refined through natural-language interaction. Traditional behavioral embedding vectors remain highly effective for retrieval and ranking, but they are opaque to users and not natively expressed for language model workflows. We present Textual User Taste, a system that generates structured natural-language taste profiles from listening behavior, interaction signals, content metadata, and optional user feedback, and deploys them to millions of Spotify users. We describe the end-to-end production lifecycle required to generate, evaluate, optimize, and maintain these representations at industrial scale, including prompt development and compression, user steering, and integration with downstream personalization systems. Because no unique ground-truth taste profile exists, we introduce a multi-faceted evaluation framework to evaluate taste profiles as a production representation: they carry user-specific predictive signal independently, and when integrated with behavioral embeddings, improve MRR by 0.6% for future-track prediction and NDCG@7 by 2.2% for search ranking. Our evaluation also reveals that taste profiles support positive natural-language steering, while exposing important limitations, including challenges with negation and short-term temporal adaptation. These findings position taste profiles not as replacements for behavioral embeddings, but as an interpretable and steerable interface between evolving user context and foundation-model recommender systems.

AI.tldr: Spotify生产部署"Textual User Taste"系统，将用户行为信号转为结构化自然语言品味画像，作为基础模型推荐系统的可解释、可操控界面。
AI.motivation: 基础模型推荐系统需要可被大语言模型消费、推理和自然语言交互的用户语境。传统行为嵌入向量虽对检索排序有效，但对用户不透明，且非原生适配语言模型工作流。
AI.method: 从收听行为、交互信号、内容元数据和可选用户反馈生成结构化自然语言品味画像，覆盖提示开发与压缩、用户引导、与下游个性化系统集成等完整生产生命周期；并引入多面向评估框架。
AI.result: 品味画像单独携带用户特定预测信号；与行为嵌入结合后，未来曲目预测MRR提升0.6%，搜索排序NDCG@7提升2.2%；支持正向自然语言引导，但在否定和短期时序适配上存在局限。
AI.conclusion: 品味画像并非取代行为嵌入，而是作为演进用户语境与基础模型推荐系统之间的可解释、可操控界面。

title: Reduce, Then Encode: Multiscale Volumetric Reduction for 2D Foundation Models in Brain MRI
summary: Pretrained 2D foundation models offer a practical alternative to dedicated 3D pretraining for brain structural magnetic resonance imaging (sMRI), but their use on volumetric data requires bridging the mismatch between a 2D encoder and a 3D volume input. Existing methods typically encode slices independently and integrate their features afterwards. We introduce Multiscale Volumetric Reduction (MVR), a reduce-then-encode approach that compresses each anatomical view from (D) slices into (M << D) complementary 2D components before foundation-model encoding. MVR combines an uncentered-PCA base component derived from the original through-plane intensities with residual detail components constructed from multiscale spatial descriptors. The reduction is estimated from the training volumes without diagnostic labels or gradient-based optimization and remains fixed thereafter. The resulting components are independently processed by a shared frozen 2D foundation model and concatenated for linear probing. Under this frozen-encoder setting, MVR achieves strong overall performance across ADNI, OASIS, and ABIDE relative to the evaluated 2D-to-3D adaptation methods and simple input-reduction baselines, while also generalizing strongly from ADNI to AIBL.

AI.tldr: 提出MVR方法，先在编码前将3D体数据的每个解剖视图从D层压缩为M<<D个2D互补分量，再交由冻结的2D基础模型编码，实现2D基础模型在脑sMRI上的高效迁移。
AI.motivation: 2D基础模型用于3D脑sMRI时，2D编码器与3D体输入存在维度不匹配。现有方法多独立编码各切片再整合特征，效率与效果受限。
AI.method: MVR采用"先降维后编码"策略：用无中心PCA从原始穿面强度得到基分量，结合多尺度空间描述子构造残差细节分量，将D层压缩为M个互补2D分量；该降维基于训练体数据估计、无需标签与梯度优化且固定不变；各分量经共享冻结2D基础模型独立处理并拼接用于线性探针。
AI.result: 在冻结编码器设定下，MVR在ADNI、OASIS、ABIDE上整体性能优于所评估的2D-to-3D适配方法和简单输入降维基线，并从ADNI到AIBL表现强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: MVR为2D基础模型在体积脑sMRI上的应用提供了无需专门3D预训练的有效降维编码方案，具备良好跨数据集泛化性。

title: The Argument and the Letterhead: Source-Position Coherence in AI Evaluation
comment: 28 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Preregistrations, materials and code available on GitHub. Preprint; not yet peer reviewed
summary: An argument can be surprising coming from a particular speaker without being a bad argument. Do AI evaluators keep these judgments apart? Two preregistered descriptive studies and a later Jev supplement collected 2,976 usable evaluations of six fixed texts about US AI policy, Germany's debt brake and Swiss nuclear energy. Each text was presented under several source attributions. The key comparison asks whether the gap between two sources changes when the argument changes. On Sol, for example, a national-security argument received mean ratings of 0.359 under CODEPINK and 0.639 under College Republicans; a civil-rights argument received 0.742 and 0.721. A constant preference for one source cannot explain that pattern. Related interactions appeared across topics and recent model configurations, including those with reasoning enabled, while several comparisons yielded small effects. The later European Jev supplement yielded five interactions below the adopted absolute reference of 0.05; its distinct rubric and interrupted collection limit comparison with the chat systems. Some written evaluations explicitly invoked a mismatch between a source and its attributed position. Taken together, the numerical and verbal evidence supports source-position coherence as a plausible explanation, alongside competing accounts involving credibility, authenticity and interpretation of the task. The paper develops this inference through controlled comparisons, reports conditional post hoc p-values in an appendix, and documents the human decisions and delegated checks behind an AI-conducted study.

AI.tldr: AI评估系统能否区分"论证令人意外"与"论证质量差"？三项研究收集2976份评估，发现源-立场匹配度会显著影响评分，支持"源-位置一致性"解释。
AI.motivation: 同一论证来自不同说话者可能令人意外但未必是坏论证。研究动机是检验AI评估者能否将这两类判断区分开，即是否会因来源与论证立场不匹配而降低评分。
AI.method: 两项预注册描述性研究加一项Jev补充研究，对六篇固定文本（涉及美国AI政策、德国债务刹车、瑞士核能）在多种来源归属下进行重复评估，共2976份有效评价。核心比较是：两来源之间的评分差距是否随论证变化而变化（交互效应），并辅以书面评估文本分析。
AI.result: 以Sol为例，国家安全论证在CODEPINK下均分0.359、在College Republicans下0.639；民权论证则为0.742与0.721，表明存在显著交互，无法用对某来源的恒定偏好解释。此类交互跨议题和近期模型配置（含开启推理）复现，但部分比较效应较小。Jev补充研究得到五个低于0.05参考值的交互，但其独特评分标准与中断的数据收集限制与聊天系统的可比性。部分书面评估明确提到来源与立场不匹配。
AI.conclusion: 数值与文本证据共同支持"源-立场一致性"作为合理解释，但也存在可信度、真实性和任务理解等竞争性解释。论文通过受控比较推进该推论，在附录报告事后条件p值，并记录了AI主导研究中的人类决策与委托检查过程。

title: BiMoGen: Bidirectional Motion-Text Generation via Unified Masked Discrete Diffusion
summary: Text-to-motion generation and motion-to-text captioning are two fundamental tasks in human motion modeling, both grounded in the same underlying motion-text correspondence. Existing unified approaches mostly rely on autoregressive modeling, which imposes a fixed generation order and is therefore poorly suited to the bidirectional dependencies between language and motion, allowing early prediction errors to persist as fixed context and degrade both temporal coherence and cross-modal consistency. Masked discrete diffusion, which models sequences through iterative bidirectional prediction, offers a natural remedy. We therefore propose BiMoGen (Bidirectional Motion-text Generation), a unified masked discrete diffusion framework for bidirectional motion-text modeling. To stabilize training, we design Decoupled Uni- and Cross-Modal Training, in which masked pretraining first establishes cross-modal correspondence on paired motion-text sequences, after which supervised fine-tuning specializes the model for bidirectional generation. Masked diffusion nonetheless introduces its own source of error, as the model is trained on clean ground-truth context yet encounters self-generated and potentially erroneous context at inference, with errors committed under heavily masked states propagating through subsequent steps. We further introduce Generation-Aware Self-Correction that exposes the model to its own predictions during training and applies correction passes at early sampling steps to revise unreliably committed tokens. Extensive experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML demonstrate competitive performance on both tasks, validating the effectiveness of the proposed two-stage training and self-correction designs. The project page is available at https://wengwanjiang.github.io/BiMoGen-Page.

AI.tldr: 提出BiMoGen，一个基于掩码离散扩散的双向运动-文本统一生成框架，通过解耦单/跨模态训练与生成感知自校正，缓解自回归的顺序限制和扩散的错误累积问题。
AI.motivation: 文本到运动生成与运动到文本描述共享同一运动-文本对应关系。现有统一方法多依赖自回归建模，强制固定生成顺序，难以适应语言与运动之间的双向依赖，早期预测错误会作为固定上下文持续存在，损害时间连贯性和跨模态一致性。掩码离散扩散通过迭代双向预测可自然缓解该问题。
AI.method: 提出BiMoGen统一掩码离散扩散框架。训练上采用解耦单/跨模态训练（Decoupled Uni- and Cross-Modal Training）：先做掩码预训练建立跨模态对应，再监督微调实现双向生成。针对扩散中模型训练用干净上下文、推理遇自生成错误上下文导致的误差传播，引入生成感知自校正（Generation-Aware Self-Correction），训练时暴露自身预测，并在采样早期步骤进行校正以修正不可靠token。
AI.result: 在HumanML3D与KIT-ML数据集上，两项任务均取得有竞争力的性能，验证了两阶段训练和自校正设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 掩码离散扩散是双向运动-文本建模的有效范式，解耦训练与自校正机制可提升稳定性与生成质量，代码与项目页已公开。

title: Spectral Super-Resolution using Spatial-Spectral Residual Operator Networks
comment: IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS) 2026
summary: Spectral super-resolution of multispectral satellite images can enable high temporal- and spatial-resolution hyperspectral satellite imagery at a modest cost, significantly increasing the applicability of hyperspectral remote sensing. This task is inherently ill-posed, making it well-suited for deep learning-based methods. In this study, the spectral super-resolution task is framed as an operator learning problem, and SSRON is proposed as a Deep Operator Network that effectively learns function-to-function mappings from downsampled spectra to continuous spectra. The model is trained to super-resolve Sentinel-2A-like multispectral imagery to EMIT images. Compared to baseline models, SSRON achieves superior performance across all metrics. The model also demonstrates zero-shot spectral super-resolution capability by predicting bands unseen during training. Furthermore, its continuous-output formulation suggests the potential to estimate spectra at finer wavelength intervals than the native sensor. These results suggest the potential of SSRON and establishes operator learning as a promising direction for spectral super-resolution.

AI.tldr: SSRON将光谱超分辨率建模为算子学习问题，用深度算子网络学习从降采样光谱到连续光谱的函数到函数映射，可将Sentinel-2A多光谱影像超分辨至EMIT影像，性能优于基线，并具备零样本和细波长间隔估计能力。
AI.motivation: 多光谱卫星影像的光谱超分辨率能以低成本获得高时空分辨率的高光谱影像，显著提升高光谱遥感适用性；但该任务本质上是病态问题，适合用深度学习方法解决，且需要学习连续的谱函数映射。
AI.method: 将光谱超分辨率任务框定为算子学习问题，提出SSRON——一种深度算子网络，学习从降采样光谱到连续光谱的函数到函数映射；用类Sentinel-2A多光谱影像训练，超分辨到EMIT影像。
AI.result: 相比基线模型，SSRON在所有指标上取得更优性能；展现零样本光谱超分辨率能力，可预测训练中未见的波段；其连续输出公式表明有潜力估计比原生传感器更细波长间隔的光谱。
AI.conclusion: SSRON具有潜力，并确立了算子学习作为光谱超分辨率一个有前景的方向。

title: AbGaze: Attentive Geometric Representation Learning for End-to-End Antibody Design
summary: Computational antibody design requires representations that capture the geometric patterns underlying antigen--antibody interactions, yet existing approaches often rely on scalar distances or surface-intrinsic features, leaving cross-molecular geometry largely implicit. We present AbGaze, an end-to-end antibody design framework based on attentive geometric representation learning, which encodes distance, spatial direction, and surface-normal orientation of antigen surfaces relative to antibody-residue local frames, and adaptively aggregates these geometric interactions according to their interfacial context. The learned interaction representation is shared across multi-CDR co-design, complex structure prediction, and affinity optimization, with local-frame geometric supervision further constraining the representation. AbGaze outperforms prior methods across all three tasks: relative to the second-best method, it improves amino-acid recovery by 7.1% and reduces structural error by 14.9% on average over the six CDRs, improves interface docking quality (DockQ) by 6.6%, and raises the affinity improvement rate (IMP) by 32.5%.

AI.tldr: 提出AbGaze，一种基于注意力几何表示学习的端到端抗体设计框架，编码抗原表面相对抗体残基局部帧的距离、方向和法向朝向，并在多CDR协同设计、复合物结构预测和亲和力优化三项任务上超越先前方法。
AI.motivation: 计算抗体设计需要能捕捉抗原-抗体相互作用几何模式的表示，但现有方法多依赖标量距离或表面固有特征，跨分子几何信息基本是隐式的。
AI.method: AbGaze编码抗原表面相对抗体残基局部帧的距离、空间方向和表面法向朝向，并根据界面上下文自适应聚合这些几何交互；学到的交互表示在三个任务间共享，并用局部帧几何监督约束表示。
AI.result: 三个任务均优于先前方法：相比第二名，六个CDR上平均氨基酸回收率提升7.1%、结构误差降低14.9%；对接质量DockQ提升6.6%；亲和力提升率IMP提升32.5%。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模跨分子几何（距离、方向、法向朝向）并共享交互表示，可有效提升抗体设计的多任务性能。

title: When Should the Count Change? Learning State Maintenance for Causal Video Counting
summary: Continuous video counting requires distinguishing new observations from new objects or completed events. We introduce StaMina (State Maintenance), which learns to maintain counting state through state-conditioned updates. Recurrent visual context supports recognition; learned transitions maintain visibility, persistent identities, and completed-event records. A differentiable recurrence trains event transitions over legal paths constrained by count endpoints; visibility and association objectives train the object branch. A multi-source pipeline organizes 39.8K spatial queries and complementary event annotations into counting trajectories. On SVCBench, we evaluate counting adaptation with partial video overlap and held-out groups of linked annotations. Under prefix replay (Full) and persistent streaming (Stream), 4B and 8B models reach 41.9/36.4 and 44.9/38.2 Gaussian Precision Accuracy, respectively. The 8B model gains 10.9/3.2 points over Counting-SFT on the same queries. Matched-graph comparisons isolate phase conditioning and trajectory supervision, assessing training objectives alongside hard decisions. Online video benchmarks and count-conditioned decisions assess online understanding and task eligibility. Project Page: https://PLACEHOLDER.github.io/StaMina/

AI.tldr: StaMina提出一种状态维护框架，通过状态条件更新实现连续视频计数，区分新观测与新物体/已完成事件，并在SVCBench上取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 连续视频计数需要区分“新的观测”与“新的物体或已完成的事件”，这要求模型持续维护计数状态，而现有方法难以做到。
AI.method: 采用状态条件更新维护计数状态；循环视觉上下文支持识别，学习的状态转移保持可见性、持续身份与已完成事件记录。使用可微递归在计数端点约束的合法路径上训练事件转移，用可见性与关联目标训练物体分支，并通过多源流水线组织39.8K空间查询与事件标注为计数轨迹。
AI.result: 在SVCBench上，采用部分视频重叠和留出组链接标注评估计数适应。前缀回放(Full)与持续流式(Stream)下，4B和8B模型分别达到41.9/36.4和44.9/38.2高斯精度准确率；8B模型相比Counting-SFT在同一查询上提升10.9/3.2分。
AI.conclusion: 匹配图对比分离出相位条件与轨迹监督的作用，评估了训练目标与硬决策；在线视频基准和计数条件决策验证了在线理解能力与任务适用性。

title: Training-Free Clinical Reasoning through Medical Ontologies and Cognitive Mapping: A Symbolic-Probabilistic Knowledge Graph Framework
summary: Most clinical prediction systems learn patient-variable-outcome associations; we investigate a training-free diagnostic paradigm mapping patient observations to explicit medical knowledge. CKG Reasoner integrates candidate-specific Evidence Feature Nodes, patient-reference matching, a bounded Information Gate, knowledge-weighted evidence accumulation, disease similarity, and decisive clinical rules. Missing-aware normalization and coverage auditing distinguish absent from unavailable evidence. Candidate ranking is separate from outcome-label-independent K-means clustering, which uses four derived evidence coordinates (evidence strength, relative magnitude, directional similarity, and evidence completeness), not raw predictors or targets, to derive cohort-level assignments. Across six retrospective cohorts - four dengue (N = 1000, 1523, 989, 1018), malaria (N = 2190), and influenza (N = 4569) - a uniform, label-free, cohort-fitted K = 2 protocol yielded positive-class F1 scores of 0.996, 0.634, 0.936, 0.917, 0.695, and 0.842, and all-record accuracies of 0.996, 0.558, 0.914, 0.893, 0.707, and 0.906, respectively, with full partition-decision coverage using the frozen package and disease-specific knowledge representations. Neither scoring nor clustering uses outcome labels. Logistic regression provides a supervised baseline. Influenza incorporates confirmatory molecular PCR and is not independent pre-test prediction. Results characterize knowledge-grounded evidence separation, auditability, and sensitivity, not prospective clinical validity or comparative superiority. FOL/LLM-based clinical explanation remains unevaluated.

AI.tldr: 提出CKG Reasoner，一种无需训练的诊断范式，用显式医学知识将患者观测映射到候选疾病，并在六个队列上验证。
AI.motivation: 多数临床预测系统学习患者-变量-结局关联，缺少对显式医学知识的利用与可审计性。
AI.method: 整合候选特异的证据特征节点、患者-参考匹配、有界信息门、知识加权证据累积、疾病相似度和临床规则；采用缺失感知归一化与覆盖审计；排序与基于四个证据坐标（证据强度、相对幅度、方向相似性、证据完整性）的K-means聚类分离，不使用原始预测变量或结果标签。
AI.result: 六个回顾性队列（登革热1000/1523/989/1018、疟疾2190、流感4569）在统一、无标签、队列拟合的K=2协议下，阳性类F1为0.996/0.634/0.936/0.917/0.695/0.842，全记录准确率为0.996/0.558/0.914/0.893/0.707/0.906，分区决策覆盖完整；评分与聚类均不使用结果标签，逻辑回归作为监督基线，流感含PCR确认且非独立预检预测。
AI.conclusion: 结果体现知识驱动的证据分离、可审计性和敏感性，而非前瞻临床有效性或优越性；FOL/LLM临床解释尚未评估。

title: Automated Species Identification in Camera Trap Images for Wildlife Conservation
comment: 52 pages. B.Sc. thesis, Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Brac University, June 2025
summary: Wildlife conservation involves protecting, preserving, and managing wildlife species and their habitats. With today's rapid pace of human development, climate change, and other unsustainable practices, the need for wildlife conservation has heightened. Despite significant progress in species identification using deep-learning models, significant challenges still remain in effectively detecting small animals in low-contrast trap images due to limited feature extraction capabilities. This thesis presents a novel end-to-end framework integrating a self-attention mechanism to address these limitations. The proposed architecture involves a Swin-BiFPN backbone integrated in a Faster RCNN detection network, coupled with a visual semantic extraction module driven by the LLaVA v1.5 (13B) multimodal large language model. The detection framework, capable of extracting crucial features in challenging trap images, demonstrates consistently high results and robust generalization capabilities. Furthermore, the visual semantic extraction module provides zero-shot detection capability, as well as providing valuable insights and emergent cues of the animal's behavior, further supporting the conservation effort. The MLLM evaluation was conducted using both traditional NLP metrics (precision, recall, F1, and SBERT similarity) and subjective scoring by LLM-based judges (GPT-4.1 and GROK 3.0), across five MLLMs, demonstrating the model's strong performance in visual description generation. The proposed framework improves detection accuracy across low-contrast trap images and small animals while also demonstrating zero-shot detection capability leveraging the MLLM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个端到端野生动物保护检测框架：在Faster R-CNN中集成Swin-BiFPN骨干网络与自注意力机制，并加入基于LLaVA v1.5(13B)的视觉语义提取模块，提升低对比度陷阱图像与小动物检测性能，同时实现零样本检测与动物行为语义洞察。
AI.motivation: 野生动物保护需求因人类开发、气候变化及不可持续实践而日益迫切；尽管深度学习在物种识别上进展显著，但在低对比度陷阱图像中检测小动物仍面临特征提取能力不足的挑战。
AI.method: 提出端到端框架，引入自注意力机制：以Swin-BiFPN为骨干集成于Faster R-CNN检测网络，并耦合由LLaVA v1.5(13B)多模态大模型驱动的视觉语义提取模块。
AI.result: 检测框架在困难陷阱图像中持续取得高精度并具强泛化能力；视觉语义模块实现零样本检测并提供动物行为洞察。MLLM评估采用传统NLP指标（精确率、召回率、F1、SBERT相似度）及GPT-4.1与GROK 3.0主观打分，在五个MLLM中表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提升了低对比度陷阱图像及小动物检测精度，并借助MLLM实现零样本检测能力，为野生动物保护提供有效支持。

title: Narrowing the Horizon: Quantifying Topic Saliency Shifts in Generative Monoculture
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become central to how we access and share information, they play an increasingly powerful role in shaping global knowledge. However, as these models evolve, their outputs risk converging into a \textit{generative monoculture}, where the diversity of perspectives they represent narrows over time. Studies at the model level often fail to pinpoint which specific topics or viewpoints are being marginalised or amplified in this process. In this paper, we introduce a method to measure shifts in topic saliency across model families, tracking what gains or loses prominence during post-training. Applying this approach to a case study of climate change discourse, we demonstrate how homogenisation affects the representation of diverse solutions across different models. We also test interventions to counter this trend, showing that specialised models can help preserve a broader range of perspectives. This underscores the importance of monitoring topic saliency to diagnose the risks of monoculture and to ensure AI systems reflect a pluralism of ideas. Data and Code are accessible \href{https://github.com/oriane/topic_saliency_shift}{here}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种衡量模型族间主题显著性变化的方法，追踪后训练中哪些主题被边缘化或放大，并以气候变化话语为案例揭示LLM的“生成单一化”趋势，同时验证专业模型可缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在全球知识传播中扮演核心角色，其输出可能趋于收敛形成“生成单一化”，导致观点多样性随时间收窄。现有模型层面研究难以精确定位哪些主题或观点被边缘化或放大。
AI.method: 提出一种度量跨模型族主题显著性变化（topic saliency shift）的方法，追踪后训练阶段主题的兴衰；以气候变化话语为案例，分析不同模型的同质化对多元解决方案呈现的影响；并测试干预措施（如专业模型）以对抗该趋势。
AI.result: 案例研究显示同质化影响了不同模型对多元解决方案的呈现；专业模型等干预手段有助于保留更广泛的视角。
AI.conclusion: 监测主题显著性对诊断单一化风险、确保AI系统反映多元观点至关重要。数据与代码已开源。

title: DiMoP: Diffusion-Driven Motion Representation Learning With Frame-Level Pseudo-Classification for Skeleton-Based Action Recognition
comment: Accepted to IEEE TRANSACTIONS ON BIOMETRICS, BEHAVIOR, AND IDENTITY SCIENCE
summary: Robust skeleton-based action recognition requires representations that capture a wide spectrum of motions, from subtle to moderate and strong ones. Existing methods often focus on strong motions. This paper introduces DiMoP, a masking- and diffusion-driven motion representation learning method with frame-level pseudo-classification to explicitly learn the distribution of joint motions rather than regressing deterministic coordinates, as existing methods often do. By diffusing masked joints with progressive noise and denoising them conditioned on visible joints, DiMoP learns through controllable noising and denoising processes, enabling uniform learning of weak, moderate, and strong dynamics. To enable the masking-based generative diffusion learning with a discriminative capability, a pseudo-frame classifier is proposed that enforces the learning towards sequence-consistent and temporally coherent pseudo-labels without manual annotations. Together, these strategies provide a principled mechanism for joint generative and discriminative motion modeling. DiMoP achieves state-of-the-art performance across NTU RGB+D 60/120, and PKUMMD, including a 1.1 percentage point gain over prior works on NTU RGB+D 120 with the cross-subject protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DiMoP，一种结合掩码与扩散机制的动作表示学习方法，通过帧级伪分类学习关节运动分布，在NTU RGB+D 60/120及PKUMMD上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有骨架动作识别方法多关注强运动，难以统一捕捉从微弱到强烈的各类运动；且常回归确定性坐标，而非建模关节运动的分布。
AI.method: DiMoP采用掩码-扩散驱动：对掩码关节逐步加噪并以可见关节为条件去噪，实现可控加噪/去噪以均匀学习弱、中、强动态；同时引入伪帧分类器，在无标注下生成序列一致、时间连贯的伪标签，实现生成与判别式运动建模。
AI.result: 在NTU RGB+D 60/120和PKUMMD上取得SOTA；在NTU RGB+D 120跨受试者协议下比先前工作提升1.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为关节的生成式与判别式运动建模提供了统一机制，验证了掩码扩散结合伪分类在骨架动作识别中的有效性。

title: Reliability Engineering for AI Systems: Challenges, Methods, and Directions
summary: AI reliability concerns whether an AI system performs its intended function dependably over a stated period and under stated operating conditions, with stated evidence. As these systems become more autonomous, that function includes more than a correct output. Retrieval, memory, tool use, permissions, human oversight, and interactions among systems must operate consistently and safely, and, for generative systems, so must the reasoning process that produces the output. Average benchmark accuracy measures capability; it does not quantify this broader reliability claim. This paper adapts established reliability engineering methods, from failure definitions and operational envelopes to FMEA, accelerated testing, field monitoring, and reliability growth, to AI systems. A four-level diagnostic framework classifies failures as component, operational-loop, agentic-conduct, or network and governance failures. Test, evaluation, verification, and validation (TEVV), sequential monitoring, and FRACAS create and refresh evidence. SMART provides statistical guidance for measurement, analysis, assessment, and test planning; the NIST AI Risk Management Framework provides organizational guidance for governance, evaluation, monitoring, and mitigation. Three cases illustrate the program: adversarial testing of a convolutional neural network, perception-error propagation, and autonomous-vehicle disengagements. Established reliability engineering provides a usable foundation; new measurements and safety guardrails are still needed as these systems are self-evolving.

AI.tldr: 本文主张将传统可靠性工程方法（失效定义、运行包络、FMEA、加速测试、现场监测、可靠性增长）迁移到AI系统，提出四级失效诊断框架，并结合TEVV、序贯监测与FRACAS构建证据体系，辅以SMART与NIST AI RMF提供统计与治理指导，用三个案例加以说明。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统自主性增强，其"功能"不再局限于输出正确性，还涉及检索、记忆、工具调用、权限、人类监督及系统间交互，以及生成系统的推理过程。而平均基准准确率只衡量能力，无法量化这种更广泛的可靠性主张，因此需要一套系统的可靠性评估方法。
AI.method: 将既有可靠性工程方法适配到AI系统：包括失效定义与运行包络、FMEA、加速测试、现场监测、可靠性增长；提出四级失效诊断框架（组件、运行环、智能体行为、网络与治理失效）；通过TEVV、序贯监测和FRACAS生成并更新证据；用SMART提供测量、分析、评估与测试计划的统计指导，用NIST AI RMF提供组织治理指导。
AI.result: 通过三个案例展示该方案的应用：卷积神经网络的对抗测试、感知误差传播、自动驾驶脱手（disengagement）事件，说明框架在具体AI场景中的可行性与适用性。
AI.conclusion: 既有可靠性工程为AI可靠性提供了可用基础，但随着AI系统自我演化，仍需开发新的度量方法与安全护栏。

title: From internal representations to model improvement through prediction errors
comment: 27 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Supplementary Information is provided as an ancillary file
summary: With limited annotation budgets, choosing which images to label determines how much a model improves. Data-selection methods that use features from a separately trained model, or scene descriptions written by vision-language models, have been successful, but those signals do not directly capture changes in the model being improved. The target model's own internal features reflect what it has learned so far and change with retraining, making them a natural cue for choosing the next training data. However, feature rarity alone does not reveal the errors that matter for performance. Here we link internal features to prediction errors and their expected impact on performance and select images for labeling and retraining without using labels for candidate images. We evaluated the method with an object detector on two datasets and two pairs of random seeds. Adding internal features improved the identification of prediction errors in 15 of 16 conditions. When performance was averaged over successive labeling rounds, the method outperformed selection based only on feature rarity in all four evaluation settings and ranked among the top two of six methods. With other conditions held fixed, performance after retraining was again higher than with rarity-based selection, even though the latter collected more errors. With longer retraining, the proposed method ranked first among six methods. These results suggest that linking a model's internal features to its errors and their effects on performance may help select training images that improve performance, thereby allowing the model's current state to guide which images are labeled next.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种无需候选图像标签的数据选择方法，将目标模型内部特征与预测误差及其性能影响相关联，用于选择标注与重训练图像，从而让模型当前状态指导下一步标注。
AI.motivation: 在标注预算有限时，选择哪些图像标注决定模型提升程度。现有方法依赖独立模型特征或视觉语言模型的场景描述，但这些信号不能直接反映被改进模型自身的变化。目标模型的内部特征会随重训练变化，是选择下一批训练数据的自然线索，但仅凭特征稀有性无法揭示影响性能的关键错误。
AI.method: 将目标模型内部特征与预测误差及其对性能的预期影响相连接；在不使用候选图像标签的情况下，选择用于标注和重训练的图像。在目标检测器上、两个数据集、两对随机种子上评估。
AI.result: 加入内部特征后，在16种条件中的15种改善了预测误差识别。按连续标注轮次平均性能，该方法在全部4个评估设置中优于仅基于特征稀有性的选择，并在6种方法中排名前二。在其他条件固定时，重训练后性能仍高于稀有性选择，尽管后者收集了更多错误。重训练时间更长时，所提方法在6种方法中排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将模型内部特征与其误差及误差对性能的影响相连接，可能有助于选择能提升性能的训练图像，从而使模型当前状态指导下一步标注哪些图像。

title: Hyper Algorithm Design Agent: Evolving Learnable Optimizer from Zero
summary: Meta-Black-Box Optimization (MetaBBO) is one of the highlights in the recent AI for Optimization trend. This paradigm's bi-level workflow leverages the learnable algorithm design policy at meta level to ensure the performance and generalization improvement on the low-level optimization task. While MetaBBO helps advance the performance lower bound of the resulted optimization system, it is currently handcrafted and customized case by case to adapt different optimization problems, which inevitably introduces inherent subjectivity and hence restricts the performance upper bound and usability in practice. In this paper, we address this issue by regarding MetaBBO's design loop as coding task, where we could introduce openendedness into MetaBBO with recursive self-improvement capability of advanced coding agents. Specifically, we propose a dual-agent framework: i) a task agent continuously refines the codebase of a target MetaBBO approach through code evolution; ii) a hyper agent progressively modifies the task agent and itself to provide open-ended design behavior; iii) the evolved MetaBBO codebase is evaluated and all in-execution information is fed back to the agents for recursive self-referential improvement. As a result, given a naive MetaBBO template, our framework automates a design evolution and finds novel variants superior to up-to-date human-made MetaBBO baselines. Surprisingly, the experimental results also demonstrate that our framework supports fast adaption across different optimization domains. Solid interpretation analysis further reveals interesting design principles emerge in such open-ended process. This work serves as the first exploration on automating design of complex learning-assisted optimization algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文将 MetaBBO 的设计过程视为编码任务，提出双智能体框架（task agent + hyper agent）实现递归自我改进，自动演化出超越人类设计基线的 MetaBBO 变体，并支持跨域快速适应。
AI.motivation: 现有 MetaBBO 依靠人工逐案定制算法设计策略，引入主观性，限制了性能上限和实际可用性，因此需要自动化其设计过程。
AI.method: 提出双智能体框架：task agent 通过代码演化持续优化目标 MetaBBO 代码库；hyper agent 逐步修改 task agent 及其自身以提供开放式设计行为；演化后的代码库经评估后，所有执行信息反馈给智能体实现递归自指的自我改进。
AI.result: 给定朴素 MetaBBO 模板，框架自动完成设计演化并发现优于最新人类设计基线的变体；实验还表明其支持跨不同优化域快速适应，解释性分析揭示了涌现的设计原则。
AI.conclusion: 这是首次探索对复杂学习辅助优化算法进行自动化设计，验证了开放式递归自我改进在 MetaBBO 设计中的可行性与潜力。

title: How Far Are We from Removing the Visual Encoder? Scaling Laws for Encoder-Free Multimodal Pretraining
summary: Most modern multimodal large language models (MLLMs) build on a pretrained visual encoder that provides a strong visual prior. Encoder-free MLLMs instead learn visual representations directly from raw pixels, offering a simple and unified architecture, but their scaling behavior has not been systematically characterized. To fill this gap, we compare scaling laws for encoder-free and encoder-based MLLMs and report three main findings: (1) Removing the visual encoder shifts the compute-optimal allocation for the multimodal objective toward larger models, while leaving that for text nearly unchanged. (2) The two architectures exhibit nearly overlapping loss--compute frontiers on the text objective, but diverge on the multimodal objective: encoder-free models underperform at small scales yet are predicted to catch up at around $10^{22}$ FLOPs, well within practical pretraining budgets. (3) Without a visual encoder, the language model learns to take over its role via vision-specific adaptation: bidirectional interactions among visual tokens become increasingly beneficial as training compute grows, visual processing shifts toward earlier layers, and expert routing for visual tokens becomes more concentrated. Overall, our results indicate that the advantage of the visual prior provided by a pretrained encoder diminishes with scale, positioning encoder-free architectures as a promising direction for multimodal pretraining.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了无编码器与有编码器MLLM的缩放规律，发现视觉先验优势随规模缩小，无编码器架构是有前景的多模态预训练方向。
AI.motivation: 多数现代MLLM依赖预训练视觉编码器提供强视觉先验，而无编码器MLLM直接从原始像素学习视觉表示，架构简单统一，但其缩放行为尚未被系统刻画。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 对比无编码器与有编码器MLLM的缩放规律，分别分析多模态目标与文本目标的计算最优分配、损失-计算前沿，并考察无编码器模型中语言模型对视觉角色的适应性变化（视觉token双向交互、视觉处理层级、专家路由）。
AI.result: (1) 移除视觉编码器使多模态目标的最优计算分配偏向更大模型，文本目标几乎不变；(2) 两者在文本目标上损失-计算前沿几乎重合，但在多模态目标上分化：无编码器模型小规模下落后，预计约10^22 FLOPs时追平；(3) 无编码器中语言模型通过视觉特定适应接管视觉功能：视觉token间双向交互随计算增长愈发有益，视觉处理向更早层迁移，视觉token专家路由更集中。
AI.conclusion: 预训练编码器所提供的视觉先验优势随规模增长而减弱，无编码器架构是多模态预训练的有前景方向。

title: TMCS: Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Compositional Chemical Problem Solving
summary: Despite the promise of Large Language Models (LLMs) in computational chemistry, rigorous combinatorial chemistry problems remain difficult because they require quantitatively constrained molecular modification, candidate validation, and systematic revision after failed attempts. Existing tool-augmented chemical agents demonstrate useful planning and tool use, but they rarely provide a unified loop for property-driven molecular optimization and workflow-level composition. To bridge this gap, we propose Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Compositional Chemical Problem Solving (TMCS), a step-by-step multi-agent framework that formalizes chemical problem solving as an interpretable, tool-augmented workflow. At the task level, specialized agents leverage external tools, few-shot trajectory memory, and structured reflection to iteratively refine solutions. At the workflow level, TMCS chains generation, understanding, editing, description, and optimization into a closed-loop pipeline. Evaluations across multiple chemical tasks demonstrate that TMCS consistently enhances chemical reasoning across both open- and closed-source base models, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出TMCS多智能体框架，将化学问题求解形式化为可解释、工具增强的工作流，在多项化学任务上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: LLM在计算化学中虽具潜力，但严格的组合化学问题仍需定量约束的分子修改、候选验证与系统性修正。现有工具增强智能体虽能做规划与工具调用，却缺乏统一的性质驱动分子优化与工作流级组合闭环。
AI.method: TMCS为逐步多智能体框架，将化学问题求解形式化为可解释、工具增强的工作流。任务层面：专用智能体利用外部工具、few-shot轨迹记忆与结构化反思迭代优化方案。工作流层面：将生成、理解、编辑、描述与优化串成闭环流水线。
AI.result: 在多个化学任务评估中，TMCS在开源与闭源基座模型上均稳定提升化学推理能力，取得SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: TMCS通过任务级与工作流级的多智能体协作，弥补了现有工具增强智能体在分子优化与工作流组合上的不足，验证了其有效性与通用性。

title: W2Rep: Learning Visual Representations by Watching the World Change
summary: Images capture the world at one moment, whereas video reveals how it changes. Image self-supervision learns spatial structure from a single moment, while video methods commonly learn temporal relationships inside a representation computed jointly from several frames. We ask whether watching a scene change can instead improve features available from one image without sacrificing the ability to represent video. We introduce W2Rep, a masked feature-prediction framework in which an independently encoded source image participates in prediction at the same or another moment. The predictor is conditioned on visible video context, the queried location, and the signed time interval between source and target. This gives the cross-frame objective two complementary roles: the image path learns features that remain useful across time, while the video path must gather evidence that is missing from the source image. Across model scales and downstream tasks, W2Rep improves frozen and fine-tuned recognition under our comparison protocol, while joint video encoding provides further gains over frame-wise aggregation. Controlled experiments show that these gains depend on directly updating the source-image features and on using both video context and temporal displacement. Overall, change across a video can supervise a visual encoder whose representations remain useful at either image or video granularity. Code is available at~\href{https://wenooi.github.io/W2Rep}{https://wenooi.github.io/W2Rep}.

AI.tldr: W2Rep 是一个掩码特征预测框架，利用视频中的场景变化来监督单张图像可用的特征，同时不损失视频表示能力。
AI.motivation: 图像自监督只学单帧空间结构，视频方法通常在多帧联合表示中学时序关系。作者想探索：观察场景变化能否反过来提升单张图像的特征，同时保留视频表示能力。
AI.method: 提出 W2Rep 掩码特征预测框架：独立编码的源图像参与同一或另一时刻的预测。预测器以可见视频上下文、查询位置及源-目标间的带符号时间间隔为条件。跨帧目标具双重作用——图像路径学跨时间可用的特征，视频路径必须收集源图中缺失的证据。
AI.result: 在不同模型规模和下游任务上，W2Rep 在冻结和微调识别上均有提升；联合视频编码相比逐帧聚合带来额外增益。控制实验表明增益依赖直接更新源图像特征，以及同时使用视频上下文和时间位移。
AI.conclusion: 视频中的变化可以监督视觉编码器，使其表示在图像或视频粒度上都保持有用。

title: Jev thinks "I don't know'', but doesn't say it: Introducing Sys1Cal-v1 Dataset for Probability Calibration
summary:
The appearance of Jev marked the era of System One Models, foundation models that return structured decisions with probability distributions rather than text. Aside from low cost and great speed, Jev's central promise is that these probabilities are calibrated: such claim is not backed by any public test and available external benchmarks evaluate confidence calibration, not whether every returned option probability has the right numerical meaning. To tackle this issue, we introduce Sys1Cal-v1, a dataset of True/False questions about a proposition $A$ for which the exact probability $P(A)$ is known by construction. Each item is queried through the three Jev primitives - Noul, Choice and Score - and evaluated by total variation distance from the ground-truth distribution, which can be used to estimate a soft accuracy of System One Models.
  We showcase the utility of Sys1Cal-v1 as a benchmark dataset by evaluating Jev and SemIf, an open-source Choice-style baseline. In this work, however, we focus even more deeply on Jev, by studying the calibration of its Score and Choice answers. In particular, we discover a peculiar behaviour that can be explained by assuming that Jev suppresses a third truth value, going beyond True and False. In other words, in 	exttt{Choice} answers, $P(A)$ and $P(
eg A)$ are presented as if $P(A)+P(
eg A)=1$, while a term $P(U)
eq0$ is missing in the sum. Recovering $P(U)$ leads to an improvement of median soft accuracy in 	exttt{Choice} answers from $0.771$ to $0.978$, suggesting that, even in binary decisions, Jev wants to answer with a third option:``I don't know''.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Sys1Cal-v1 数据集，通过构造已知真实概率 P(A) 的 True/False 问题来评估 System One Models（如 Jev）的置信校准，发现 Jev 在 Choice 回答中隐含遗漏了第三真值 P(U)。
AI.motivation: Jev 宣称其返回的概率是校准的，但缺乏公开测试，现有外部基准只评估置信度校准而非返回选项概率的数值正确性，因此需要专门的校准评估方法。
AI.method: 构建 Sys1Cal-v1 数据集：围绕命题 A 的 True/False 问题，其精确概率 P(A) 由构造确定；通过 Jev 的三种原语 Noul、Choice、Score 查询，并用与真实分布的总变差距离评估，可估计软准确率。
AI.result: 评估 Jev 和 Choice 风格开源基线 SemIf，深入分析 Jev 的 Score 与 Choice 校准，发现 Jev 在 Choice 中假设 P(A)+P(¬A)=1 而遗漏了 P(U)≠0；恢复 P(U) 后 Choice 中位软准确率从 0.771 提升到 0.978。
AI.conclusion: 即使在二元决策中，Jev 似乎倾向返回第三种选项“我不知道”，恢复缺失的 P(U) 项能显著改善软准确率。

title: Handwritten Text Recognition Lives in the High-Pixel Variance Subspace
comment: Accepted at 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: In self-supervised pretraining for Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR), pixel reconstruction methods outperform contrastive methods, unlike in natural-image classification. We argue that this difference follows from where discriminative signal lies in pixel space: for HTR, it is concentrated in high-variance directions and largely absent from low-variance ones. This predicts that objectives preserving high-variance pixel content will transfer best. We test six SSL methods from three families (pixel-grounded MIM, JEPA, and contrastive) under matched encoder, data, and evaluation protocols on six handwriting benchmarks across five languages. With full labels, pixel-groundrounded SSL achieves the lowest CER on every benchmark and both frozen probes, exposes per-position character information that other families recover only through the readout, and is the only family to benefit from pretraining on real handwriting. Pixel-grounded representations are also more label efficient. Across datasets, encoder alignment with the high-variance pixel subspace predicts CER within every method. With a pretrained LLM decoder, a frozen pixel-grounded encoder is competitive with fully fine-tuned supervised baselines; full fine-tuning achieves the lowest mean CER and ranks first or second on every benchmark. These results show that the value of pixel reconstruction depends on where discriminative signal lies in the input.

AI.tldr: 论文证明，在HTR自监督预训练中像素重建之所以优于对比学习，是因为判别信号集中在高方差像素方向；保留高方差像素内容的目标迁移最好，像素锚定的SSL在六个基准上CER最低、更省标签，冻结编码器配合LLM解码器可与全微调监督基线竞争。
AI.motivation: 自然图像分类中对比方法常优于像素重建，但手写文本识别（HTR）中恰好相反，这一差异此前缺乏解释。作者提出假说：HTR的判别信号集中在像素空间的高方差方向、几乎不存在于低方差方向，因此保留高方差像素内容的目标应当迁移最好。
AI.method: 在匹配编码器、数据与评测协议下，比较三大类六种SSL方法——像素锚定的掩码图像建模（MIM）、JEPA、对比学习——在五种语言、六个手写基准上进行评测；并分析编码器与高方差像素子空间的对齐度，以及接入预训练LLM解码器后的表现。
AI.result: 全标签下像素锚定SSL在每个基准和两种冻结探针上CER最低；能暴露其他方法只能靠读出恢复的逐位置字符信息；是唯一能从真实手写数据预训练中获益的家族；标签效率更高。各数据集上，编码器与高方差像素子空间的对齐度可在每种方法内预测CER。冻结的像素锚定编码器配LLM解码器可与全微调监督基线竞争，全微调取得最低平均CER并在各基准排名前二。
AI.conclusion: 像素重建的价值取决于判别信号在输入中的位置：判别信号若集中于高方差像素方向，则像素锚定目标最佳。该视角解释并预测了HTR中SSL方法的表现差异，为自监督目标选择提供了依据。

title: AHMAD: Adaptive Hybrid Multi-task Vision Learning with Assisted Distillation for Keypoint Detection
summary: Generalist multitasking vision models aim to unify multiple vision tasks within a single framework, enabling more efficient and versatile learning. However, handling diverse vision tasks -- spanning dense and sparse predictions -- remains challenging due to their inherently varying output structures. In this paper, we propose AHMAD, a simple yet effective framework for generalist multitask learning that integrates different key vision tasks: semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, depth estimation, keypoint detection, and object detection. Our approach incorporates these five tasks into a unified structure: a shared encoder-decoder with several lightweight task-specific projectors. Under the multitask learning paradigm, we observed a complementary performance gain, achieving a state-of-the-art PQ of 53.1 and an mIoU of 66.5 for COCO-val panoptic and semantic segmentation, respectively. Additionally, for top-down keypoint detection, which typically incurs high computational overhead due to multiple forward passes, we introduce a knowledge distillation-based method that enables a single forward pass over the entire image, greatly improving efficiency. Ultimately, our model delivers a lightweight yet effective generalist multitask learning framework, demonstrating strong performance across five vision tasks.

AI.tldr: AHMAD是一个通用的多任务视觉框架，通过共享编解码器加轻量任务投影器统一了五个视觉任务，并利用知识蒸馏提升关键点检测效率。
AI.motivation: 通用多任务视觉模型可统一多个任务以提升学习效率，但密集预测与稀疏预测等任务输出结构差异大，难以统一处理。
AI.method: 提出AHMAD框架，融合语义分割、实例分割、深度估计、关键点检测和物体检测五类任务于统一结构：共享编解码器+多个轻量任务专属投影器；并针对自上而下关键点检测引入知识蒸馏方法，实现单次前向传播。
AI.result: 在多任务学习范式下取得互补性能增益，COCO-val全景分割PQ达53.1，语义分割mIoU达66.5；关键点检测效率显著提升。
AI.conclusion: AHMAD提供了一个轻量且有效的通用多任务学习框架，在五个视觉任务上均展现强劲性能。

title: Don't Inoculate Everything: Stratified Inoculation Prompting Narrows Backdoor Triggers and Preserves Desired Traits
summary: Supervised fine-tuning can teach language models undesired behaviours alongside desired ones. Inoculation prompting (IP) aims to limit unwanted generalisation by requesting the undesired behaviour during training and removing the request at inference. However, undesired behaviour can still appear under unrelated prompts. IP can also hinder learning of the desired behaviour. We address these limitations in settings where both behaviours co-occur in most training examples, so filtering out examples with undesired behaviour leaves only a small clean subset. We introduce stratified inoculation prompting (SIP). SIP leverages a small clean subset to demonstrate that desired behaviour should persist without the undesired one across different contexts. SIP oversamples these clean examples under diverse non-eliciting prompts while inoculating the rest. SIP substantially reduces expression of undesired behaviour while preserving more of the desired behaviour than IP. These gains persist even when we extend IP to oversample the same clean subset at the same rate as SIP. Moreover, SIP yields lower emergent misalignment rates in all harmful-advice setups we tested. SIP can be further extended to limit the undesired behaviour even under prompts that explicitly request it. We introduce backdoor dilution, which weakens expression under the inoculation prompt, and password-locked inoculation, which concentrates elicitation on a designated password. Taken together, our findings show that changing the training contexts for a small clean subset can significantly improve selective generalisation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分层接种提示（SIP），通过利用少量干净样本并在多样化的非引发提示下过采样，显著减少不良行为的同时更好地保留期望行为，优于传统接种提示（IP）。
AI.motivation: 监督微调会同时教会模型期望和不良行为。接种提示（IP）通过在训练时请求不良行为、推理时移除该请求来限制泛化，但不良行为仍会在无关提示下出现，且IP会妨碍期望行为的学习。当期望与不良行为在大多数训练样本中共现时，过滤后仅剩少量干净子集，问题更突出。
AI.method: 提出分层接种提示（SIP）：利用少量干净子集展示期望行为应在无不良行为的情况下跨语境持续；在多样化的非引发提示下过采样这些干净样本，同时对其余样本进行接种。进一步扩展为后门稀释（削弱接种提示下的表达）和密码锁定接种（将引发集中于指定密码）。
AI.result: SIP大幅减少不良行为表达，同时比IP保留更多期望行为；即使将IP扩展到以相同比率过采样同一干净子集，SIP的优势依然存在。在所有测试的有害建议设置中，SIP产生更低的涌现错位率，并可进一步在明确请求不良行为的提示下进行限制。
AI.conclusion: 改变少量干净子集的训练语境可显著改善选择性泛化，SIP为限制不良行为同时保留期望行为提供了有效方案。

title: From Scores to Samples: Elastic Forcing for Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Few-step autoregressive video generation commonly relies on Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD), requiring a bidirectional diffusion teacher and an online fake-score model. We instead learn the rollout distribution directly from reference videos, eliminating both score models during post-training. Our framework minimizes maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) in frozen self-supervised video representation spaces, using a hybrid Nyström--Monte Carlo estimator to balance approximation bias and sampling variance. Memory-efficient replay and gradient subsampling make this objective practical. Using the same architecture and initialization as Self-Forcing, our 1.3B model improves the VBench Total score from 83.80 to 84.64 while retaining 17 FPS. Removing auxiliary score models also enables 14B post-training on eight H200 GPUs. Beyond distillation, learning from reference videos enables the acquisition of new visual styles, semantic concepts, and spatial priors without a target-specific diffusion teacher.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出直接从参考视频学习rollout分布、在冻结自监督视频表示空间最小化MMD的少步自回归视频生成后训练框架，无需双向扩散教师与在线假分数模型，性能提升且能支持14B规模训练。
AI.motivation: 现有少步自回归视频生成依赖DMD，需要双向扩散教师和在线假分数模型，成本高且受限。作者希望去除这些分数模型，直接从参考视频学习分布。
AI.method: 在冻结自监督视频表示空间中最小化MMD；采用混合Nyström–Monte Carlo估计器平衡近似偏差与采样方差；使用内存高效replay与梯度子采样使目标实用化。
AI.result: 在与Self-Forcing相同架构和初始化下，1.3B模型将VBench Total从83.80提升至84.64，保持17 FPS；去除辅助分数模型后可在八张H200上完成14B后训练。
AI.conclusion: 该方法不仅可用于蒸馏，还能在无目标特定扩散教师的情况下，从参考视频获取新视觉风格、语义概念和空间先验。

title: A decision-support system applied to Law: Reasoning and explainability of the decision
summary: The emergence of the digital transition brought an increasing need to control the processing of digital information, including in Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs). At the EU level, in recent years, many regulations have emerged to control data processing and exchange. Texts other than the GDPR, such as the ''Law Enforcement Directive (LED)'', appeared to regulate specifically how Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs) could process data. A formal representation of these regulations can be part of decision systems that support LEAs in processing data in compliance with the regulations. Although many new formalisms have emerged to represent legal norms and rules, few are provided with a reasoning mechanism. Furthermore, systems used in decision-making processes in critical contexts such as medical diagnoses or legal decisions cannot be fully automated, and the explainability of their results is essential to ensure user confidence in decisions. This explainability aspect, while crucial, is lacking in most modern approaches that rely on machine learning. This paper describes a framework to operate formal rules from regulations, by focusing on explainability of the decision. After describing the general architecture of the proposed decision support framework, the paper showcases how symbolic AI and the SPARQL query language can support legal reasoning. It then describes an algorithm to generate a justification for the reasoning results, and outlines the procedure to be followed when the reasoning does not lead to a satisfactory conclusion. We notably focus on a method based on decision trees to determine what additional information to request from the user.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向执法机构（LEA）数据合规的可解释决策支持框架，利用符号AI与SPARQL进行法律推理，并生成推理结果的理由说明。
AI.motivation: 数字转型下LEA需合规处理数据，欧盟出台了GDPR、LED等法规。现有法律规范形式化方法多缺乏推理机制，且关键场景决策系统依赖机器学习、缺乏可解释性，影响用户信任，因此需要兼具形式化规则、推理与可解释性的框架。
AI.method: 提出决策支持框架总体架构；用符号AI和SPARQL查询语言支持法律推理；设计为推理结果生成justification的算法；当推理得不到满意结论时，给出后续处理流程，其中采用基于决策树的方法确定需向用户额外请求的信息。
AI.result: 展示了符号AI与SPARQL可支撑法律推理，并给出理由生成算法及推理失败时的信息补全机制。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可通过形式化规则与可解释推理，辅助LEA进行合规数据处理决策，提升决策透明性与用户信任。

title: Sprout: Building Dynamic Memory While Reasoning for Agentic Video Understanding
summary: Long video understanding relies on video memory to overcome the context limits of multimodal large language models. Existing methods follow a build-then-reasoning pipeline: memory is built offline for the entire video, then reasoned over as a static source. In practice a long video is shared by several questions, and this pipeline is costly at both ends: with few questions, building memory for the whole video costs far more than answering them; with many questions, the memory is never updated, so what is learned while answering questions is lost to the next question. To alleviate these, we introduce Sprout, an agentic framework that builds memory while reasoning: a temporal tree that sprouts detailed nodes as questions are answered. The agent watches the video segment by segment at a low frame rate, stopping when the current question can be answered, remembers each segment as a coarse node of the tree, and revisits key intervals at a higher frame rate to refine the tree with the recovered details. Once a segment is recorded as text, its video input is removed from the context history, while the original video remains reachable through the video tools. The memory tree and prior question--answer records persist across questions, so the memory is online and dynamic: built from the first question onward and updated by every question thereafter. We find that replacing accumulated video inputs with textual memory substantially reduces context usage while maintaining accuracy, with slight improvements in some settings. Across benchmarks on three models, Sprout achieves competitive or improved accuracy relative to representative offline memory methods, with no upfront construction stage and lower context cost per question.

AI.tldr: 提出 Sprout，一种"边推理边构建记忆"的智能体框架，用时间树结构按需逐步建立视频记忆，避免离线全视频建库的高昂成本。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频理解方法采用"先构建后推理"流水线：离线为整个视频建立记忆，再作为静态源使用。但在多问题共享同一视频时此流程两端都昂贵——问题少时全视频建库远超答题所需；问题多时记忆不更新，答题中获知的信息无法用于后续问题。
AI.method: Sprout 将记忆构建融入推理：一棵随答题而"发芽"的时间树。智能体以低帧率逐段观看视频，当当前问题可回答时停止；每段记为树的粗节点，并以高帧率回访关键区间细化树的细节。段落一旦转成文本即从上下文历史中移除其视频输入，但仍可通过视频工具访问原视频。记忆树与历史问答记录跨问题持久保存，使记忆在线、动态——从第一个问题起构建，被之后每个问题更新。
AI.result: 用文本记忆替代累积的视频输入，显著降低上下文占用同时保持精度，部分设置下略有提升。在三个模型的多个基准上，Sprout 相对代表性离线记忆方法取得相当或更优的精度，且无预先构建阶段、每问题上下文成本更低。
AI.conclusion: Sprout 通过"边推理边建记忆"的在线动态时间树框架，消除了离线全视频建库的必要，在多模型多基准上实现竞争性或更优的性能，并大幅降低上下文开销，为长视频理解提供更高效的方案。

title: Structural Alignment for Reliable Industrial AI: Bridging Physical Reality, Data, Models, and Human Intent
summary: Artificial intelligence is increasingly deployed in critical industrial domains, including healthcare, energy grids, subsurface exploration, where failures can have severe consequences for human safety, system stability, and economic outcomes. Yet AI is still evaluated primarily through benchmark accuracy, a model-centric metric that fails to capture the structural complexity and risks of real-world deployment. We propose a framework that views industrial AI reliability as a problem of structural alignment across four interacting worlds: physical, representational, machine, and human cognitive. These worlds are connected through two interfaces: digitalization, linking physical reality to computational representations, and goal encoding, translating human cognition to the machine objectives. Together, they define the space of admissible solutions. We characterize the solution space through four attributes: existence, non-uniqueness, robustness, and interpretability and show how mismatches arise at interfaces and propagate across worlds to produce reliability failures. Applications to healthcare, energy grids, and subsurface exploration illustrate that although dominant failure modes differ across domains, for example, interpretability in healthcare, robustness in energy grids, and non-uniqueness in subsurface exploration, all originate from a shared structural mechanism. By shifting the focus from model-centric evaluation to system-level alignment, this framework offers a principled foundation for assessing and governing reliability in industrial AI systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个将工业AI可靠性视为跨"物理、表征、机器、人类认知"四个世界结构对齐问题的框架，通过数字化与目标编码两个接口连接，用存在性、非唯一性、鲁棒性、可解释性四个属性刻画解空间，揭示不同领域故障的共同结构机制。
AI.motivation: AI日益部署于医疗、能源电网、地下勘探等关键工业领域，失败后果严重，但当前主要用基准准确率这种以模型为中心的指标评估AI，无法捕捉真实部署中的结构复杂性与风险。
AI.method: 将工业AI可靠性建模为跨四个相互作用世界（物理、表征、机器、人类认知）的结构对齐问题。四世界由两个接口连接：数字化（物理现实→计算表征）与目标编码（人类认知→机器目标），二者共同定义可容许解空间；并以存在性、非唯一性、鲁棒性、可解释性四个属性刻画该解空间。
AI.result: 展示接口处的失配如何跨世界传播导致可靠性失败。医疗、能源电网、地下勘探的应用表明，尽管主导故障模式不同（医疗为可解释性、能源电网为鲁棒性、地下勘探为非唯一性），但均源于共同的结构机制。
AI.conclusion: 将关注点从以模型为中心的评估转向系统级对齐，为工业AI系统的可靠性评估与治理提供有原则的基础。

title: SolveEdit: Benchmarking Visual Problem Solving in Generative Models
summary: Machine intelligence is often evaluated through abstract reasoning problems, yet many real-world problems are visual, such as arranging objects, repairing layouts, or tracing routes. Solving these problems requires understanding a scene, inferring what must change to achieve a goal, and realizing that change without disturbing unrelated content. However, existing benchmarks mainly evaluate perception, generation, or explicitly specified transformations, leaving goal-driven visual problem solving underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce SolveEpIT, a benchmark for visual problem solving through scene transformation. Given an image and a goal, a model must infer a valid transformation from the request, the scene, or a visually expressed rule, then execute it while preserving unrelated content. SoLvEEDrr contains 2,728 cases. Atomic transition contracts specify required and protected conditions, enabling SoLvEScoRE to measure completion and unintended changes without a single reference output. The strongest evaluated model achieves only57.0% SolvEScore. We further introduce SolveEdiT-PLAN, a two-stage visual planner that instantiates the transition before generation. Under matched single-generation evaluation, it improves SoLvEScoRE by 9.1 points on average across three tested generators, including a gain from 57.0% to 71.6% for GPT-Image-2, without modifying the editor.

AI.tldr: 提出SolveEpIT基准（2728例），评估"目标驱动的视觉问题求解"能力，并给出两阶段规划器SolveEdiT-PLAN，显著提升求解得分。
AI.motivation: 现实问题多为视觉性（摆放物体、修复布局、规划路线），需理解场景、推断目标所需变化并在不破坏无关内容的前提下实现；而现有基准多只评估感知、生成或显式指定的变换，目标驱动的视觉问题求解仍缺乏评估手段。
AI.method: 构建SolveEpIT基准：给定图像与目标，模型需从请求、场景或视觉化规则中推断有效变换并执行，同时保持无关内容不变。用"原子过渡契约"规定必须满足与必须保护的条件，从而无需单一参考输出即可用SolveEDScore衡量完成度与意外改动。另提出两阶段视觉规划器SolveEdiT-PLAN，先生成过渡表示再生成图像。
AI.result: 最强评估模型仅得57.0% SolveScore。在匹配的单次生成评估下，SolveEdiT-PLAN在三个测试生成器上平均提升9.1分，其中GPT-Image-2从57.0%提升至71.6%，且未修改编辑器。
AI.conclusion: 目标驱动的视觉问题求解是现有评测的空白；SolveEpIT与基于契约的SolveScore提供了无需参考输出的评估方式，显式过渡规划可有效提升各类生成器的求解表现。

title: ReVA: A Scene-Centric Dataset Beyond Repetition for Remote Sensing Video Question Answering
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable advances in remote sensing. However, existing remote sensing multimodal reasoning benchmarks exhibit two critical limitations: they rely on (i) template-driven questions, which causes repetitive questions; and (ii) static images that fail to capture the inherent temporal nature of drone/UAV videos. This leaves systematic evaluation of remote sensing video reasoning largely unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce ReVA, a new dataset for remote sensing video question answering, designed to assess spatiotemporal, scene-centric, and reasoning-oriented capabilities of MLLMs. ReVA comprises 2,438 drone videos spanning 18 cities worldwide (580K frames) and 22K high-quality question-answer pairs across 11 challenging QA tasks. We develop a semi-automatic annotation pipeline that leverages Text LLMs and MLLMs for question-answer generation with human verification. We evaluate 23 proprietary and open-source Video LLMs on ReVA, exposing fundamental limitations of current models. These findings position ReVA as a critical benchmark toward better remote sensing video understanding and temporal reasoning capabilities for real-world deployments. Our code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/zyaocoder/ReVA

AI.tldr: 论文提出ReVA，一个面向遥感视频问答的新数据集，用于评估MLLMs的时空、场景中心和推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感多模态推理基准存在两大局限：模板化问题导致重复、静态图像无法捕捉无人机视频的时序特性，因此遥感视频推理研究空白。
AI.method: 构建ReVA数据集，包含2,438个无人机视频（覆盖18个城市，58万帧）及2.2万条高质量问答对，涵盖11项QA任务；采用结合Text LLM与MLLM的半自动标注流程并辅以人工验证。
AI.result: 在ReVA上评估了23个专有与开源Video LLMs，揭示了当前模型的根本性局限。
AI.conclusion: ReVA为遥感视频理解与时序推理提供了关键基准，推动面向真实部署的能力提升。

title: Building Transformation Layers for Riemannian Neural Networks
summary: Recently, deep neural networks on manifold-valued representations have garnered significant attention across various machine learning applications. One recent focus is the generalization of Euclidean fully connected (FC) and convolutional layers to non-Euclidean geometries. However, previous approaches typically focus on a few selected manifolds and rely on specific properties of the target manifold. In contrast, this work proposes a framework for constructing FC and convolutional layers over computationally tractable Riemannian spaces. This framework incorporates several previous FC layers across different geometries as special cases and is instantiated on ten representative manifolds, including three hyperbolic models, five geometries of the symmetric positive definite (SPD) manifold, and two Grassmannian perspectives. Experiments on different manifolds demonstrate the effectiveness and applicability of our approach. Code can be found at https://github.com/GitZH-Chen/RieTrans.

AI.tldr: 提出统一的黎曼空间全连接与卷积层构建框架，统一多种已有几何层，并在十种代表性流形上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有非欧几何深度网络方法通常只针对少数选定流形，并依赖目标流形的特定性质，缺乏通用性。
AI.method: 构建面向可计算黎曼空间的全连接(FC)和卷积层通用框架，将多种不同几何下的已有FC层作为特例纳入，并在十种流形上实例化，包括三种双曲模型、五种SPD流形几何及两种Grassmann视角。
AI.result: 在不同流形上的实验证明了该方法的有效性和适用性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为流形值表示上的深度学习提供了通用、可扩展的方案，统一并推广了多种几何层。

title: AutoRef: Harness Optimization for Agentic Multi-Reference Image Generation
summary: Recent image generation models can take multiple reference images as input and combine them into a new image. However, multi-reference image generation remains challenging: models may omit or duplicate subjects from the references, or produce images in which multiple subjects appear unnaturally pasted. Recent work has proposed image generation agents that combine image generation models, reasoning models, and a harness, which is an executable program that specifies how reference images are interpreted, how generation is performed, how outputs are diagnosed, and how the final image is selected. In multi-reference generation, however, references play different roles and outputs must satisfy many criteria at once, such as fidelity to each reference and the naturalness of the whole image, so many parts of the harness could be improved, from how references are processed to how outputs are diagnosed. This makes it hard to predict which changes will improve performance and by how much, and good harnesses difficult to design by hand; indeed, human-written harnesses vary widely in performance. We therefore propose AutoRef, which optimizes the harness automatically while keeping both models frozen: a coding agent iteratively rewrites the harness code. AutoRef separates the tasks whose feedback informs proposals from the tasks used to select candidates, and continues the search from a beam of the top-ranked harnesses on the selection tasks. Using this procedure, we discover AutoRef-Harness, which improves the open-weight FLUX.2 [klein] 4B from 5.72 to 7.37 on held-out four-reference tasks of the MultiBanana benchmark, matching or exceeding proprietary models including Nano Banana Pro and GPT-Image-1.5. Without re-optimization, the same harness also improves results when the generator, number of references, benchmark, evaluator, or reasoning model differs from those used in the search.

AI.tldr: 提出AutoRef，自动优化多参考图像生成的harness，通过编码agent迭代改写harness代码，在不重训模型下将FLUX.2 [klein] 4B从5.72提升至7.37，媲美或超越Nano Banana Pro与GPT-Image-1.5，并具跨生成器/参考数/基准的泛化性。
AI.motivation: 多参考图像生成中，模型可能遗漏或重复主体，或产生不自然的拼接效果。现有图像生成agent的harness（可执行程序，规定如何解释参考图、执行生成、诊断输出、选择最终图像）需要处理多个方面，且参考图角色不同、需同时满足保真度与整体自然性等多重标准，导致人工设计harness性能差异大、难以预测改进效果。
AI.method: AutoRef在冻结两个模型的前提下自动优化harness：由编码agent迭代重写harness代码；将提供提案反馈的任务与用于筛选候选的任务分离；从候选任务上排名靠前的harness构成的beam继续搜索。
AI.result: 发现AutoRef-Harness，将开源权重FLUX.2 [klein] 4B在MultiBanana基准的留出四参考任务上从5.72提升到7.37，匹配或超过包括Nano Banana Pro和GPT-Image-1.5在内的专有模型。无需重新优化，同一harness在生成器、参考数量、基准、评估器或推理模型不同时也能提升结果。
AI.conclusion: 自动优化harness是提升多参考图像生成的有效途径，AutoRef能自动搜索出高性能且泛化性强的harness，为多参考生成agent设计提供了可扩展方案。

title: Just Initialize: A Training-Free Initialization Component for Large-Scale Routing Optimization
summary: Large-scale routing problems are difficult to solve efficiently as their search spaces grow rapidly with problem size. Existing approaches primarily improve the optimization procedure itself, often at increasing computational cost. We instead shift the focus to a useful initialization that can be refined into a high-quality solution with limited downstream refinement. We propose Just Initialize, a training-free and solver-agnostic initialization component for large-scale routing optimization. Just Initialize compresses a large routing instance into a compact surrogate space, optimizes its global routing structure, and recovers the resulting solution as an optimization-friendly starting point in the original space. Extensive experiments on Traveling Salesman Problems (TSPs), Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problems (CVRPs), Vehicle Routing Problems with Time Windows (VRPTWs), and Prize-Collecting Traveling Salesman Problems (PCTSPs) demonstrate that Just Initialize achieves high-quality solutions comparable to or better than state-of-the-art methods while substantially reducing computational cost across instances ranging from 1K to 100K nodes, including an average speedup of approximately 70$\times$, sub-second runtimes on 10K-node instances, and runtimes within tens of seconds on 100K-node instances.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Just Initialize，一个免训练、求解器无关的初始化组件，通过将大规模路径问题压缩到紧凑代理空间优化全局结构，再恢复为原空间的高质量起点，从而在有限后续精修下获得优质解。
AI.motivation: 大规模路径问题搜索空间随规模急剧增长，现有方法主要改进优化过程本身，计算成本高，作者转而关注高质量初始化以降低精修代价。
AI.method: 将大规模路径实例压缩为紧凑代理空间，优化其全局路径结构，再把解恢复到原空间，作为优化友好的初始解；该组件免训练且与求解器无关。
AI.result: 在 TSP、CVRP、VRPTW、PCTSP 上，1K 到 100K 节点实例中，解质量媲美或优于 SOTA，同时计算成本大幅降低：平均约 70 倍加速，10K 节点亚秒级，100K 节点数十秒级。
AI.conclusion: 高质量初始化是提升大规模路径优化效率的有效方向，Just Initialize 可广泛适配不同问题与求解器。

title: Look Before You Judge: Training-Free Region Mining for Grounded and Explainable Deepfake Detection
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can explain deepfake verdicts in natural language, but such explanations are not necessarily visually grounded in the visual evidence underlying the prediction. A model may describe plausible artifacts inferred from language priors rather than from image evidence. Existing grounding methods improve visual reliance through decoding or attention interventions, but they generally strengthen grounding over the entire image, making them ill-suited for forensic artifacts that are subtle, spatially localized, and image-dependent. We propose Look Before You Judge, a training-free framework that formulates explainable deepfake detection as a sequential evidence acquisition process. Instead of directly predicting image authenticity from holistic visual reasoning, our framework first identifies image-specific candidate evidence regions by contrasting the MLLM's decoder-to-visual attention between an original image and its Gaussian-blurred counterpart. The identified regions are then inspected individually, and the resulting local evidence is integrated with the global image context before reaching a final verdict. The framework operates without manipulation masks, external forensic models, or parameter updates, making it directly applicable to off-the-shelf MLLMs. Across five open-source MLLMs on TriDF and MMTD-Set, our framework improves detection accuracy by up to 12.8%, reduces CHAIR by up to 33.4% and hallucination rate by up to 21.3%, and outperforms representative training-free decoding and attention methods.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的"Look Before You Judge"框架，将可解释深度伪造检测建模为顺序证据获取过程，通过对比原图与高斯模糊图的注意力定位局部证据区域，再逐一检验并整合全局上下文完成判定。
AI.motivation: MLLM虽能用自然语言解释深度伪造判定，但解释未必真正视觉接地，可能依据语言先验描述似是而非的伪影。现有接地方法在整幅图像上增强视觉依赖，难以适用于细微、空间局部且因图而异的取证伪影。
AI.method: 免训练框架，将可解释检测形式化为顺序证据获取：先对比MLLM解码器到视觉的注意力在原图与高斯模糊图上的差异，识别图像特定的候选证据区域；再逐一检验各区域局部证据，并与全局图像上下文整合后给出最终判定。无需篡改掩码、外部取证模型或参数更新。
AI.result: 在TriDF和MMTD-Set上对五个开源MLLM评测，检测准确率最高提升12.8%，CHAIR最高降低33.4%，幻觉率最高降低21.3%，优于代表性免训练解码与注意力方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能直接应用于现成MLLM，有效提升深度伪造检测准确性与解释的视觉接地性并减少幻觉，且无需额外监督或训练成本。

title: AutoBCI: Forecast-Guided Agentic Neural Architecture Discovery for EEG-Based Brain--Computer Interfaces
summary: EEG-based brain-computer interfaces support a broad range of applications, yet designing decoding architectures that perform well across diverse tasks remains challenging. We introduce AutoBCI, an agentic framework in which a Designer Agent and a Forecaster Agent support the discovery and selection of EEG decoding architectures across tasks. The Designer Agent performs Pool-Guided Architecture Discovery (PGAD), generating and refining architectures through training and validation across multiple EEG tasks, such as emotion recognition, motor imagery, and sleep staging. The Forecaster Agent performs Performance Estimation from Early Knowledge (PEEK), using architecture code, the training protocol, and early learning curves to predict full-budget validation performance and select promising candidates for continued training. Across 14 EEG datasets spanning motor imagery, emotion recognition, and sleep staging, we evaluate AutoBCI with six LLMs, including Opus 5.5 and GPT 5.6 Sol, and compare the architectures selected by the search procedure against ten baselines: six conventional EEG models and four foundation models. The architecture discovered by AutoBCI with Claude Opus 5.5 achieves 64.16% average test balanced accuracy (bAcc), compared with 63.87% for REVE, the strongest baseline on this metric. Using ten observed epochs, PEEK reduces mean absolute error in predicting average validation bAcc from 2.20 to 1.36 percentage points, a 38.1% reduction relative to the best-observed-score baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AutoBCI智能体框架，通过Designer Agent与Forecaster Agent自动发现并筛选跨任务EEG解码架构，在14个数据集上超越基线与基础模型。
AI.motivation: EEG脑机接口应用广泛，但设计能跨多种任务（如情绪识别、运动想象、睡眠分期）表现良好的解码架构仍具挑战性。
AI.method: AutoBCI框架含两个智能体：Designer Agent执行池引导架构发现（PGAD），经多任务训练验证生成并精炼架构；Forecaster Agent执行基于早期知识（PEEK）的性能估计，利用架构代码、训练协议与早期学习曲线预测完整预算下的验证性能，筛选有潜力的候选继续训练。
AI.result: 在覆盖运动想象、情绪识别、睡眠分期的14个EEG数据集上，用6个LLM（含Opus 5.5和GPT 5.6 Sol）评估，并与10个基线（6个传统EEG模型+4个基础模型）比较。AutoBCI配合Claude Opus 5.5发现的架构取得64.16%平均测试平衡准确率，超过最强基线REVE的63.87%。仅用10个观测epoch，PEEK将预测平均验证bAcc的平均绝对误差从2.20降到1.36个百分点，较最佳观测分数基线降低38.1%。
AI.conclusion: AutoBCI证明智能体框架可有效自动发现并选择跨任务EEG解码架构，在性能上超越传统与基础模型基线，且PEEK能显著提升早期性能预测精度，降低训练成本。

title: Learning to Reason with Persistent Object States for Video Instance Segmentation
summary: Video segmentation models maintain object identities by carrying instance information across frames. Under prolonged occlusion, reappearance, or interactions between similar instances, however, an unreliable update can overwrite a valid history and cause persistent identity drift. We introduce POSReasoner, a trainable, plug-and-play framework that explicitly decides when an observation should change an object's state. Each persistent state records identity, confidence, and absence history. A sparse state-observation graph supports Propose-Verify reasoning: provisional associations are revisited using object history, predicted presence, and competition among identities. The verified decisions determine whether to retain, update, reactivate, or suppress each state, while a learned gate controls the evidence written back to memory. Only verified transitions update the persistent state used in subsequent frames. POSReasoner uses standard video annotations and keeps the base model frozen, enabling integration with diverse VOS and VIS architectures. Experiments across long-term VOS and VIS benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong baselines, with the largest gains under occlusion and object reappearance.

AI.tldr: 提出POSReasoner，一个可训练、即插即用的框架，通过显式决定何时用观测更新对象状态，缓解视频分割中的身份漂移问题。
AI.motivation: 视频分割模型依靠跨帧传递实例信息来维持对象身份。但在长时间遮挡、重现或相似实例交互时，不可靠的更新会覆盖有效历史，导致持续的身份漂移。
AI.method: 每个持久状态记录身份、置信度和缺失历史；用稀疏的状态-观测图支撑"提议-验证"推理，借助对象历史、预测存在性和身份间竞争重新审视暂时关联。验证后的决策决定保留、更新、重新激活或抑制状态，并用学习门控控制写回记忆的证据。仅验证过的转移才更新状态。使用标准视频标注，基础模型冻结。
AI.result: 在长期VOS和VIS基准上相比强基线取得一致提升，在遮挡和对象重现场景下增益最大。
AI.conclusion: POSReasoner可即插即用地集成到多种VOS和VIS架构，有效缓解身份漂移，在挑战性场景中提升显著。

title: A.D.A.M.O. (Agent for language-Driven Actions with Multimodal Observations): A Visual-Symbolic Framework for Virtual Humans
summary: Creating believable vh requires the coherent integration of perception, reasoning, and action mediated by language. A central challenge is to combine these components into a control loop grounded in interactive 3D environments. To this end, we present A.D.A.M.O. (Agent for language-Driven Actions with Multimodal Observations), a visual-symbolic framework for language-driven vh that leverages a pretrained vlm with tool calling to unify perception, reasoning, and action within a single control loop. A.D.A.M.O. maintains a dual visual-symbolic world model that combines egocentric visual input and synchronized symbolic state to support grounded task-oriented behavior from natural language prompts. To support diagnostic evaluation, we introduce a controlled task suite organized by a cd taxonomy that breaks down spatial tasks into procedural and linguistic complexity. Experiments in controlled scenes show that semantic labeling strongly influences task completion and failure modes, reducing perceptual ambiguity while shifting failures toward downstream execution, whereas reasoning errors remain comparatively rare.

AI.tldr: 本文提出A.D.A.M.O.，一个语言驱动的视觉-符号框架，通过让预训练VLM调用工具，在交互式3D环境中统一感知、推理与行动，实现可信虚拟人控制。
AI.motivation: 创建可信的虚拟人（VH）需要在语言媒介下将感知、推理与行动连贯整合，并构建基于交互式3D环境的控制回路，这一整合是核心挑战。
AI.method: A.D.A.M.O.采用预训练VLM加工具调用，维护由自我中心视觉输入与同步符号状态组成的双视觉-符号世界模型，以自然语言提示支撑有依据的任务导向行为；并提出基于认知难度（CD）分类法的可控任务套件用于诊断评估。
AI.result: 受控场景实验表明，语义标注显著影响任务完成度与失败模式：降低感知歧义并将失败转移到下游执行环节，而推理错误相对较少。
AI.conclusion: 语义标注对语言驱动VH任务表现至关重要，感知歧义与执行环节是主要瓶颈，推理本身并非主要错误来源。

title: WorldPlay2: Extending Real-Time Interactive World Models in Control and Horizon
summary: Interactive world models require responding in real time to versatile controls and maintaining long-horizon consistency. However, modeling heterogeneous controls remains difficult, while explosive contexts and unstable distillation impede achieving both long-horizon consistency and real-time responsiveness. In this paper, we present WorldPlay2, an interactive world model that couples a factorized hybrid control interface with a co-design of compressed memory and stable distillation. 1) Our factorized hybrid control interface integrates frame-aligned action control with structured semantic control that explicitly disentangles scene appearance, character identity, and dynamic semantic events, thereby facilitating effective control learning. 2) To achieve efficient long-horizon modeling, we compress historical contexts into compact memory tokens shared by the autoregressive student and the bidirectional teacher. This design enables clip-wise, memory-conditioned score evaluation instead of jointly processing an entire long rollout, substantially reducing distillation overhead. 3) We further propose Stable Forcing, which initializes the autoregressive student via a few-step strategy and leverages full-rollout replay to preserve the quality of long-horizon rollouts, ensuring robust and stable distillation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the strong generalizability of our model and its superior performance compared to existing methods.

AI.tldr: WorldPlay2：一种交互式世界模型，通过分解式混合控制接口 + 压缩记忆 + 稳定蒸馏的联合设计，实现实时响应、多功能控制与长时程一致性。
AI.motivation: 交互式世界模型需兼顾实时响应与长时程一致性，但面临三大挑战：异构控制难以建模、上下文爆炸、蒸馏不稳定，导致难以同时实现长时程一致性与实时性。
AI.method: 三大设计：(1) 分解式混合控制接口，将帧对齐动作控制与结构化语义控制结合，显式解耦场景外观、角色身份与动态语义事件；(2) 将历史上下文压缩为紧凑记忆token，由自回归学生与双向教师共享，实现按clip、记忆条件下的评分评估，降低蒸馏开销；(3) Stable Forcing，通过少步策略初始化学生模型并利用全rollout重放，保证长时程生成质量与蒸馏稳定性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明模型具有强泛化能力，性能优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过混合控制接口、压缩记忆与稳定蒸馏的协同设计，WorldPlay2有效平衡了长时程一致性与实时响应，为交互式世界模型提供了可行方案。

title: Why Deterministic PRM Guidance Underperforms in Discrete Diffusion Reasoning
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 27 pages, 6 figures. Code: https://github.com/dLLM-PRM-Gap/dLLM-PRM-Gap; dataset and model: https://huggingface.co/collections/YanZhanPKU/dllm-prm-gap
summary: Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) expose a denoised solution at every step, which makes process reward model (PRM) guidance look like a way to spend compute at test time. We show that once denoising, PRM scoring, and outcome reward model (ORM) scoring are charged in the same budget of forward passes, its deterministic form loses to a much simpler baseline. Our PRMs score intermediate denoising states and are trained on the correctness of the final answer. On Dream-v0-Instruct-7B with 8 candidates per GSM8K problem, keeping the candidate with the highest PRM score at every scoring step reaches 65.18%, while independent sampling plus an ORM reranker trained for the task reaches 75.13%. The gap grows to 12.69 percentage points (pp) with 32 candidates, and is 9.85 pp on MATH and 12.16 pp on MBPP. We trace it to two separable failures. First, guidance prunes on a weak signal: on GSM8K, PRM ROC-AUC falls from 0.77 to 0.54 as the mask ratio rises, a decay that persists when states are relabeled with fresh rollouts, and pruning lowers the best accuracy reachable from the candidate pool from 81.05% for independent samples to 67.30%. Second, on GSM8K and MATH, the PRM is a poor final judge: a sequential Monte Carlo sampler at the same budget restores that ceiling to 77.89%, yet selecting with the PRM gives 65.48%, on par with deterministic guidance, while a PRM retrained on final states matches the ORM on identical candidates. MBPP separates the two: there the PRM reaches 65.47% when reranking finished programs, on par with the ORM, but 50.88% when it guides denoising. The results point to two targets for dLLM guidance: keep correct partial solutions alive through early denoising, and leave the final choice to a verifier trained on final states. We release the corpus of denoising states with outcome labels and evaluation toolkit for reproducible comparisons at matched compute.

AI.tldr: 本文证明在相同前向计算预算下，离散扩散语言模型(dLLM)的确定性PRM引导不如简单的独立采样+ORM重排基线，并将问题归因于"弱信号剪枝"和"PRM非最终状态好评判者"两个可分离的失败。
AI.motivation: dLLM每步都暴露去噪解，看似适合用PRM在测试时花算力引导。但作者想在同等的foward pass预算下公平比较PRM引导与简单基线，检验PRM引导是否真的有效。
AI.method: 在Dream-v0-Instruct-7B上，用基于最终答案正确性训练的PRM对中间去噪状态打分，进行每步保留最高分候选的确定性引导；与独立采样+ORM重排对比；并借助SMC采样器、在最终状态上重训的PRM，以及MBPP的rerank/guide对照来分离失败原因。
AI.result: GSM8K 8候选：PRM引导65.18% vs ORM重排75.13%；32候选差距12.69pp；MATH差9.85pp、MBPP差12.16pp。PRM ROC-AUC随mask ratio从0.77降至0.54，剪枝把候选池可达上限从81.05%降到67.30%。SMC同预算可恢复到77.89%上限，但用PRM选择仅65.48%。MBPP上PRM重排finished程序达65.47%(与ORM相当)，引导去噪仅50.88%。
AI.conclusion: dLLM引导应聚焦两个目标：早期去噪阶段保住正确的部分解，最终选择交给在最终状态上训练的验证器。作者发布去噪状态语料及评估工具包以支持同算力可复现比较。

title: Revisiting Risky Tackle Detection with Vision Transformers
summary: This paper is a Track 2 reproducibility companion to an ICPR 2026 study on risky tackle detection in American football prac- tice videos. The original work fine-tuned a Video Vision Transformer (ViViT) on 733 clips labeled with the SATT-3 rubric. It used focal loss, Taguchi L18 augmentation, and 5-fold cross-validation. It reported risky- class recall of 0.67 and risky-class F1 of 0.59. This companion documents the released artifact and traces those numbers to specific scripts, fold out- puts, and aggregation files. The reproduced headline is run_15. It com- bines Gaussian noise with static brightness decrease and uses no rotation and no flip. Its fold-mean risky recall is 0.667 and its fold-mean risky F1 is 0.588. These values match the published headline after rounding. The ablation shows that brightness is the dominant factor. Its risky-recall main-effect range is 0.055, which is larger than the ranges for rotation, flip, and noise. Without augmentation, ViViT reaches risky recall of 0.545 and does not exceed the C3D baseline of 0.583. The raw clips show iden- tifiable student athletes, so they cannot be redistributed. The artifact provides a public sample for pipeline checks and a controlled route for full-data review.

AI.tldr: 本文是ICPR 2026美式足球危险擒抱检测研究的Track 2可复现性配套论文，公开了复现工件，成功将已发表的关键指标追溯到具体脚本与聚合文件。
AI.motivation: 原研究（ViViT微调、focal loss、Taguchi L18增强、5折交叉验证）报告了危险类召回0.67与F1 0.59，但缺乏可复现性验证与工件追踪，本文旨在提供复现配套并确认这些数字的来源。
AI.method: 对733个按SATT-3标注的片段复现实验；头条结果run_15采用高斯噪声+静态亮度降低、不用旋转和翻转；进行消融分析（亮度、旋转、翻转、噪声的主效应），并与无增强ViViT及C3D基线对比。因原始片段含可识别学生运动员，不公开分发。
AI.result: run_15折均值危险召回0.667、危险F1 0.588，四舍五入后与已发表头条一致；消融显示亮度为主导因素（主效应范围0.055，大于旋转、翻转、噪声）；无增强ViViT召回仅0.545，未超过C3D基线0.583。
AI.conclusion: 复现成功，已发表数字可被追溯与验证；亮度增强是关键因素；由于隐私限制，工件仅提供公共样本用于流程检查，并提供受控途径供全数据审查。

title: SRHarness: A Harness for Agentic Symbolic Regression
summary: Recent agentic symbolic regression approaches increasingly rely on large language models to analyze data, select scientific operations, and refine hypotheses over long search trajectories. In such systems, performance depends not only on the underlying model and search strategy, but also on the runtime infrastructure that supports scientific search. We introduce SRHarness, a domain-specific harness for agentic symbolic regression built around three mechanisms: composable scientific actions that provide a common interface over raw, transformed, and candidate-derived quantities; persistent scientific state that retains evaluated hypotheses and exposes compact model-facing views; and trajectory lifecycle management that coordinates continuation, branching, restart, and termination. On LLM-SRBench, SRHarness consistently improves both numerical generalization and symbolic recovery under matched LLM backbones. With DeepSeek-v4-flash-0731, it achieves 93.69% symbolic accuracy on LSR-Transform, compared with 62.16% for SR-Scientist, and retains 72.97% accuracy on an anonymized variant that removes scientific descriptions and variable semantics, versus 39.64% for SR-Scientist. Under the same DeepSeek-v4-flash-0731 backbone, SRHarness also substantially outperforms Codex (72.97% vs. 20.72%) and reaches performance comparable to Codex with GPT-5.5, while simply providing Codex with the same scientific tools does not reproduce this advantage.
